records.title_en: Food traceability systems and the probability of using chemical fertilizers and pesticides − empirical evidence using plot and farm household data from agriculture census
records.title_cn: 食品可追溯体系与化肥及农药使用概率——基于农业普查地块与农户数据的实证研究
records.abstract_en: In response to rising consumer demand for food safety, many countries have implemented food traceability systems (FTS) to enhance transparency and accountability along agricultural supply chains. While existing research has largely focused on demand side aspects, evidence on supply side responses remains limited. This study addresses this gap by examining the effects of FTS adoption on farm production practices, specifically the probability of using chemical fertilizers, pesticides, and groundwater, as well as farm revenue and marketing channel selection. We use microdata from Taiwan’s 2020 agriculture census, which provides both plot-level and farm household-level information covering all registered crop farms. Motivated by a farm profit maximization model, we employ an instrumental variable (IV) approach to identify the local average treatment effect of FTS adoption. At the plot level, FTS adoption reduces the probability of using chemical fertilizer, pesticide, and groundwater by 8.2, 15.4, and 40 percentage points, respectively. At the household level, FTS adoption increases farm revenues and expands sales through direct-to-consumer and distributor channels. These findings suggest that while FTS is primarily designed to ensure food safety and market transparency, its adoption may generate unintended environmental co-benefits through reducing the likelihood of using environmentally sensitive inputs in farm production.
records.abstract_cn: 为应对消费者日益增长的食品安全需求，许多国家实施了食品追溯系统（FTS），以提高农业供应链的透明度和责任追溯能力。尽管现有研究主要关注需求侧，但关于供给侧反应的实证证据尚显不足。本研究旨在填补这一空白，考察采用食品追溯系统对农业生产实践（特别是化肥、农药和地下水的使用概率）以及农户收入和销售渠道选择的影响。研究利用台湾2020年农业普查的微观数据，该数据涵盖了所有已登记的作物种植农户，并提供了地块和农户层面的详细信息。基于农户利润最大化模型，本研究采用工具变量（IV）法来识别采用食品追溯系统所产生的局部平均处理效应。在地块层面，采用食品追溯系统使化肥、农药和地下水的使用概率分别降低了8.2、15.4和40个百分点。在农户层面，采用食品追溯系统提高了农户收入，并通过面向消费者直销及分销商渠道扩大了销售规模。这些研究结果表明，尽管食品追溯系统的初衷是确保食品安全和市场透明度，但其应用也可能通过减少农业生产中对环境敏感型投入品的使用，产生意想不到的环境协同效益。

records.title_en: Assessment and valuation of government policies to improve food animal welfare
records.title_cn: 对改善食用动物福利的政府政策进行评估和评价
records.abstract_en: There is a need to assess the benefits of government policy to improve the welfare of food animals. We present a holistic, animal-centred welfare assessment method using an expert panel of independent animal welfare scientists linked to a survey of food shoppers’ willingness to pay (WTP) to improve welfare levels, using a 0–100 animal welfare scale. We apply this method to six food animal types in the UK and 15 different topical policy scenarios. We find that several current production systems have welfare scores below 50 but that some of the policy initiatives analysed could increase welfare scores substantially if implemented. We provide valuation tables of people’s WTP to increase welfare scores for each of the six animal types. Marginal WTP was found to diminish as welfare scores increased. WTP values are fully transferable across any policies affecting the animals involved and are not tied to specific production practices or contexts. The UK government has been using the method to evaluate a range of policy options to improve welfare. The method can be applied in other countries. The method enables government policy makers to better make the case for policies to improve the welfare of food animals and its application should lead to an increased likelihood of such policies being implemented. The outputs can also be used to inform consumers regarding the animal welfare provenance of the food they purchase.
records.abstract_cn: 有必要评估政府政策改善食用动物福利的效益。我们提出了一种以动物为中心的整体福利评估方法，使用由独立动物福利科学家组成的专家小组，并使用 0-100 动物福利量表对食品购物者支付意愿（WTP）进行调查，以提高福利水平。我们将此方法应用于英国的六种食用动物类型和15不同的主题政策场景。我们发现，当前的一些生产系统的福利得分低于50，但所分析的一些政策举措如果实施，可能会大幅提高福利得分。我们提供人们的支付意愿评估表，以提高每种六动物类型的福利得分。人们发现边际支付意愿随着福利分数的增加而减少。 WTP 值可以在影响所涉及动物的任何政策中完全转移，并且与特定的生产实践或环境无关。英国政府一直在使用该方法来评估一系列改善福利的政策选择。该方法可推广应用到其他国家。该方法使政府政策制定者能够更好地论证改善食用动物福利的政策，并且该方法的应用应该会增加实施此类政策的可能性。这些输出还可用于告知消费者他们购买的食品的动物福利来源。

records.title_en: zero pu“Carbon food labels have limited effects on grocery shopping behavior: Evidence from a randomized experiment”
records.title_cn: 零碳食品标签对杂货购物行为的影响有限：来自随机实验的证据
records.abstract_en: Demand-side food policies are increasingly recognized as important tools for aligning consumption patterns with climate change mitigation targets, and carbon food labels have attracted growing attention as a potential policy instrument. However, evidence on their effectiveness remains mixed, and causal evaluation results from assessing the effects of carbon food labels in real-world supermarket settings is scarce. This study presents evidence from pre-registered randomized field-embedded survey experiment with behavioral outcomes, combining a representative sample of 2,372 Swiss residents with transaction-level purchasing data covering more than five million daily food purchase decisions made by 1,601 consumers over several years. In collaboration with one of Switzerland’s largest grocery retailers, we evaluate the causal impact of an information treatment designed to increase awareness of one of the world’s first carbon food labels implemented in grocery stores on both stated preferences and revealed purchasing behavior. The results show that the information treatment significantly increases label awareness and leads to small but positive effects on attitudes, perceived behavioral control, and intentions to consider the climate compatibility of food purchases. When tracing these effects into revealed purchasing behavior, the treatment also affects actual food purchases, but effects are modest and heterogeneous across food categories. Rather than inducing broad shifts away from meat consumption, the information treatment primarily leads to a higher overall share of labeled products purchased, increased purchases of labeled convenience products, and a partial reallocation within meat consumption (e.g., lower beef and higher pork purchases). We find no evidence of substantial reductions in overall meat purchases or large cross-category substitutions toward plant-based foods. While heavy meat eaters do not react negatively to the treatment, men and more right-wing individuals show a modest behavioral backlash. Overall, the results suggest that carbon food labels capacity to substantially alter habitual food consumption patterns in stimulus-intensive retail environments is limited and should be thus complemented by additional demand-side measures.
records.abstract_cn: 需求侧食品政策日益被认为是使消费模式与气候变化减缓目标保持一致的重要工具，而碳食品标签作为一种潜在的政策工具已引起越来越多的关注。然而，关于其有效性的证据仍然不一，且在真实超市环境中评估碳食品标签影响的因果评价结果十分稀缺。本研究提供了来自预注册的随机实地嵌入调查实验的证据，该实验结合了行为结果，将2,372名瑞士居民的代表性样本与涵盖一,1,601名消费者多年间超过五百万次日常食品购买决策的交易级购买数据相结合。我们与瑞士最大的杂货零售商之一合作，评估了一项旨在提高对全球首批在杂货店实施的碳食品标签之一认知度的信息处理对陈述偏好和揭示性购买行为的因果影响。结果表明，信息处理显著提高了标签认知度，并对态度、感知行为控制和考虑食品购买气候兼容性的意图产生了虽小但积极的影响。当将这些影响追踪到揭示性购买行为时，处理也影响了实际食品购买，但效果温和且在不同食品类别间存在异质性。信息处理并未引发肉类消费的广泛转变，而主要导致购买标签产品的总体份额增加、标签便利产品购买增加以及肉类消费内的部分重新分配（例如，牛肉购买减少和猪肉购买增加）。我们未发现总体肉类购买大幅减少或向植物性食品大规模跨类别替代的证据。虽然重度肉类消费者对处理没有负面反应，但男性和更右翼的个体表现出适度的行为反弹。总体而言，结果表明，在刺激密集的零售环境中，碳食品标签大幅改变习惯性食品消费模式的能力有限，因此应辅以额外的需求侧措施。

records.title_en: The new grain giants: the reliability of USDA’s corn and soybean production forecasts for Brazil and Argentina
records.title_cn: 新的粮食巨头：美国农业部对巴西和阿根廷玉米及大豆产量预测的可靠性
records.abstract_en: While Brazil and Argentina emerged as major players in the world grain markets following a rapid expansion of corn and soybean production, little is known about their production forecasts. Our study demonstrates that the accuracy of USDA forecasts of Brazil and Argentina’s corn and soybean production varies drastically over the extended forecasting cycle. Specifically, early forecasts are not directionally consistent and offer limited statistical advantage to a naïve alternative. After 8–10 months into the forecasting cycle, these forecasts begin to provide meaningful information to market participants and become more accurate, efficient and reliable for the remainder of the forecasting cycle. These forecasts support export estimates in the US WASDE balance sheets as well as USDA baseline forecasts that have implications for federal budget outlays and may result in misallocation of resources when early projections are used.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管巴西和阿根廷在玉米和大豆产量快速扩张后成为世界粮食市场的主要参与者，但对其产量预测知之甚少。我们的研究表明，美国农业部对巴西和阿根廷玉米及大豆产量预测的准确性在延长预测周期内变化巨大。具体而言，早期预测在方向上不一致，并且相对于简单替代方案提供的统计优势有限。在预测周期开始后的8-10个月后，这些预测开始为市场参与者提供有意义的信息，并在预测周期的剩余时间内变得更加准确、高效和可靠。这些预测支持美国WASDE平衡表中的出口估计以及美国农业部基线预测，这些预测对联邦预算支出有影响，并且在早期预测被使用时可能导致资源分配不当。

records.title_en: New importer dynamics and the effects of trade shocks
records.title_cn: 新的进口商动态和贸易冲击的影响
records.abstract_en: New importers increase their conditional survival rate and import share over time. However, a model of multi-input firms with an import entry cost and stochastic import costs cannot replicate these dynamics. I show that an extended model can be reconciled with the data. I calibrate both models and use them to identify the effects of trade shocks. The simulations show that a decrease in import prices with the new importer dynamics generates lower productivity gains, but these gains are more widespread across firms.
records.abstract_cn: 随着时间的推移，新进口商的条件生存率和进口份额不断提高。然而，具有进口进入成本和随机进口成本的多投入企业模型无法复制这些动态。我证明了扩展模型可以与数据相协调。我校准了这两个模型，并用它们来确定贸易冲击的影响。模拟显示，新的进口商动态带来的进口价格下降会带来较低的生产率收益，但这些收益在企业中更为普遍。

records.title_en: State-dependent distribution friction and the transmission of monetary policy
records.title_cn: 国家依赖的分配摩擦和货币政策的传导
records.abstract_en: We examine the role of state-dependent distribution frictions in the transmission of monetary policy shocks in a dynamic multi-sector general equilibrium model. Our benchmark model predicts a counter-cyclical distribution margin, which is consistent with micro price evidence. We then estimate an augmented model with price and wage rigidities and attribute the lion’s share of this countercyclicality to service-sector productivity shocks. By allowing for distribution frictions to depend on the state of the economy, which substantially alters monetary transmission, we find that state dependence weakens the real effects of monetary policy by dampening the consumption response to monetary shocks. In stark contrast, such a result cannot be replicated when distribution frictions are time-invariant. Our findings highlight a novel channel through which the interplay between sectoral productivity and distribution frictions jointly influences monetary policy transmission.
records.abstract_cn: 我们在动态多部门一般均衡模型中研究了国家依赖的分配摩擦在货币政策冲击传导中的作用。我们的基准模型预测了反周期的分配边际，这与微观价格证据一致。然后，我们估计了一个具有价格和工资刚性的增强模型，并将这种反周期的大部分归因于服务业生产率冲击。通过允许分配摩擦取决于经济状况，从而极大地改变货币传导，我们发现国家依赖性通过抑制消费对货币冲击的反应而削弱了货币政策的实际效果。与此形成鲜明对比的是，当分配摩擦不随时间变化时，这样的结果就无法复制。我们的研究结果凸显了部门生产率和分配摩擦之间的相互作用共同影响货币政策传导的新渠道。

records.title_en: The inflationary effects of global supply chain shocks: Evidence from Swedish microdata
records.title_cn: 全球供应链冲击的通胀影响：来自瑞典微观数据的证据
records.abstract_en: We compile a unique dataset linking micro price data underlying the official Swedish producer price index with administrative firm level data and provide new evidence on the inflationary effects of global supply chain shocks. For identification, we interact exogenous shocks to global supply chains, obtained through a VAR model, with firm-specific import shares. Shocks to global supply chains lead to a significant and persistent increase in producer prices with a peak response after two years. Importantly, average responses mask heterogeneous responses across firms. Relatively larger firms, firms with lower labor costs and a higher market share raise prices more strongly.
records.abstract_cn: 我们编制了一个独特的数据集，将瑞典官方生产者价格指数的微观价格数据与行政公司层面的数据联系起来，并为全球供应链冲击的通胀影响提供了新的证据。为了进行识别，我们将通过 VAR 模型获得的全球供应链的外生冲击与特定公司的进口份额相互作用。全球供应链的冲击导致生产者价格大幅持续上涨，并在两年后达到峰值。重要的是，平均反应掩盖了各公司的异质反应。相对规模较大的企业、劳动力成本较低且市场份额较高的企业提价的力度更大。

records.title_en: Culture, institutions and growth
records.title_cn: 文化、制度和增长
records.abstract_en: How do culture and institutions jointly shape long-run growth? This paper develops an endogenous growth model in which individualism, property-rights protection, and innovation-driven growth coevolve over time. Parents choose whether to transmit individualist or collectivist values to their children according to the expected future return associated with each trait, while the degree of property-rights protection is determined in political equilibrium. The strategic complementarity between cultural transmission and property-rights protection generates two steady states – an individualistic, innovation-friendly, high-growth regime and a collectivist, expropriating, low-growth regime – and, for intermediate cultural states, an indeterminacy region in which beliefs about future property-rights protection are self-fulfilling. Institutional quality affects growth both directly, by changing the return to innovation, and indirectly, by shaping cultural transmission and the size of the innovative sector. The framework helps explain path dependence, endogenous regime switching, growth miracles, and institutional reversals.
records.abstract_cn: 文化和制度如何共同塑造长期增长？本文提出了一种内生增长模型，其中个人主义、产权保护和创新驱动的增长随着时间的推移共同演化。父母根据与每个特征相关的预期未来回报来选择向孩子传递个人主义还是集体主义价值观，而产权保护的程度则由政治均衡决定。文化传播和产权保护之间的战略互补性产生了两种稳定状态——个人主义、创新友好、高增长政权和集体主义、掠夺性、低增长政权——以及对于中间文化国家来说，产生了一个不确定性区域，在该区域中，对未来产权保护的信念是自我实现的。制度质量既通过改变创新回报直接影响增长，又通过塑造文化传播和创新部门的规模间接影响增长。该框架有助于解释路径依赖、内生政权转换、增长奇迹和制度逆转。

records.title_en: The growth of surgical robotic technology
records.title_cn: 手术机器人技术的发展
records.abstract_en: An understanding of the growth of surgical robotic technology is not only a contribution to the academic literature on the proliferation of new technology, but also it is a precursor to effective U.S. public policies toward this burgeoning new technology and possibly toward potential future standard-setting dimensions of an emerging ecosystem. Using patent application information from filings with the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office, we characterize the growth of this technology in terms of a traditional S-curve model. We also hypothesize a theory of the distribution of surgical robotic technology, and we test our theory empirically.
records.abstract_cn: 了解手术机器人技术的发展不仅是对新技术扩散的学术文献的贡献，而且也是美国针对这一新兴新技术以及可能针对新兴生态系统的未来潜在标准制定维度制定有效公共政策的先导。利用向美国专利商标局提交的专利申请信息，我们用传统的 S 曲线模型来描述该技术的增长。我们还假设了手术机器人技术的分布理论，并根据经验检验了我们的理论。

records.title_en: Visual bias in the Brexit referendum: A quantitative analysis of newspaper images
records.title_cn: 英国脱欧公投中的视觉偏见：对报纸图像的定量分析
records.abstract_en: This paper documents visual media bias in the portrayal of politicians in UK newspaper coverage during the 2016 Brexit referendum. We use computer vision and machine-learning techniques to measure facial emotion and contextual sentiment, captured from the background and surrounding visual elements in political images. Focusing on 64,089 images collected from seven national newspapers between February and August 2016, we find substantial partisan visual bias in tabloid newspapers, operating through both facial expressions and contextual tone. For instance, moving from a fully pro-Remain to a fully pro-Leave newspaper is associated with a 19-point increase in the aggregate facial emotion score of pro-Leave politicians relative to pro-Remain politicians, indicating more favorable visual portrayals, roughly 10 percent of the full scale. The bias is especially pronounced in front-page images and those featuring key political figures, while no comparable patterns are observed in broadsheet newspapers. Moreover, the partisan bias diminishes immediately after the referendum vote, suggesting that it was concentrated during the campaign period. Our results show that partisan newspapers may differ not only in textual coverage but also in visual portrayals of political actors, highlighting the growing importance of imagery in political communication.
records.abstract_cn: 本文记录了2016年英国脱欧公投期间英国报纸报道中对政治人物描绘的视觉媒体偏见。我们使用计算机视觉和机器学习技术来测量面部情绪和情境情感，这些信息从政治图像的背景和周围视觉元素中捕获。聚焦于2016年二月至八月从七家全国性报纸收集的64,089张图像，我们发现小报中存在显著的党派视觉偏见，这种偏见通过面部表情和情境语调共同体现。例如，从完全支持留欧的报纸转向完全支持脱欧的报纸，与脱欧派政治人物相对于留欧派政治人物的总体面部情绪得分增加19个百分点相关，表明视觉描绘更为有利，约占全量程的10%。这种偏见在头版图像和突出关键政治人物的图像中尤为明显，而在大报中未观察到类似模式。此外，党派偏见在公投结束后立即减弱，表明其集中在竞选期间。我们的结果表明，党派报纸不仅在文本报道上可能存在差异，而且在政治人物的视觉描绘上也可能不同，凸显了图像在政治传播中日益增长的重要性。

records.title_en: The endogenous nature of war and its economic consequences
records.title_cn: 战争的内生性及其经济后果
records.abstract_en: Is war good for economic development? Several macrohistorical theories suggest “yes”, yet the supporting evidence relies on war being shocked exogenously. We first examine the raw data from Europe, showing a negative relationship between war and production in both ancient and modern periods. We then create a model to investigate what typical statistical analyses show on data generated with standard conflict mechanisms. We show that typical statistical analyses suggest war positively affects growth in our model economy when it is in fact harmful. We caution against “mostly harmless” regressions that suggest European prosperity comes from its harmful history rather than its peaceful present.
records.abstract_cn: 战争对经济发展有好处吗？一些宏观历史理论表明“是”，但支持证据依赖于战争受到外生冲击。我们首先研究了来自欧洲的原始数据，显示了古代和现代时期战争与生产之间的负相关关系。然后，我们创建一个模型来研究典型的统计分析对标准冲突机制生成的数据显示的内容。我们表明，典型的统计分析表明战争对我们模型经济的增长产生积极影响，而实际上它是有害的。我们警告不要出现“大多无害”的倒退，这种倒退表明欧洲的繁荣来自其有害的历史，而不是和平的现在。

records.title_en: Are mass layoffs individually costly but socially beneficial?
records.title_cn: 大规模裁员对个人而言代价高昂但对社会有利吗？
records.abstract_en: This paper reexamines the consequences of mass layoffs in the French manufacturing sector by linking individual displacement costs to broader local labor-market outcomes. Using matched employer–employee data from 1995 to 2019 and a unified definition of mass layoffs, it provides the first joint assessment of their individual and aggregate effects. Displaced workers experience large and persistent employment and earnings losses. At the local level, unemployment and the number of job seekers rise sharply and remain elevated for several years, with a large local employment multiplier. Two mechanisms connect individual losses to aggregate outcomes: a demand channel, whereby larger wage losses among displaced workers amplify local unemployment, and a housing-related mobility channel linking local housing market conditions to workers’ geographic mobility. Worker reallocations themselves appear inefficient: displaced high-quality workers become less likely to match with high-productivity establishments, while destination firms display lower investment rates and lower value added. We also uncover a critical measurement bias affecting labor productivity assessments. Under standard accounting conventions — where temporary agency workers and their value added are recorded in the service sector rather than in the manufacturing establishments where they actually work — mass layoffs appear to raise productivity. Correcting for this bias fully reverses this apparent productivity gain and instead reveals a substantial productivity decline. Overall, mass layoffs appear individually and socially costly.
records.abstract_cn: 本文通过将个人失业成本与更广泛的当地劳动力市场结果联系起来，重新审视了法国制造业大规模裁员的后果。使用从1995到2019匹配的雇主-雇员数据以及大规模裁员的统一定义，它首次对其个人和总体影响进行了联合评估。流离失所的工人遭受着巨大且持续的就业和收入损失。在地方层面，失业率和求职人数急剧上升，并连续数年保持在高位，当地就业乘数很大。有两种机制将个人损失与总体结果联系起来：一个是需求渠道，即失业工人工资损失较大，从而加剧了当地失业率；另一个是与住房相关的流动渠道，将当地住房市场状况与工人的地域流动性联系起来。工人重新分配本身似乎效率低下：流离失所的高素质工人不太可能与高生产率企业相匹配，而目的地公司的投资率和附加值较低。我们还发现了影响劳动生产率评估的关键测量偏差。根据标准会计惯例——临时代理工人及其增加值记录在服务部门，而不是他们实际工作的制造企业——大规模裁员似乎可以提高生产率。纠正这种偏差会完全扭转这种明显的生产率提高，反而揭示出生产率的大幅下降。总体而言，大规模裁员对个人和社会来说代价高昂。

records.title_en: Real effects of credit supply shocks: Evidence from Danish banks, firms, and workers
records.title_cn: 信贷供应冲击的实际影响：来自丹麦银行、企业和工人的证据
records.abstract_en: Contractions in credit supply can lead firms to reduce their level of employment, yet little is known about how these shocks affect the composition of firms’ employees and outcomes at the worker level. This paper investigates how bank distress affects credit provision and its effects on employment beyond firm-level aggregates. To do so, we use a novel dataset built from administrative and tax records linking all banks, firms, and workers in Denmark. We show that banks that were particularly exposed to the 2008–09 financial crisis cut lending to firms, and firms were unable to fully compensate with financing from alternate sources. The decrease in credit supply led to a drop in firm-level employment, with effects concentrated among firms with low pre-crisis liquidity, and on employment of low-educated and non-managerial workers. At the worker level, we find that increases in the incidence of unemployment were driven by effects on low-educated, non-managerial, short-tenured, and low-earning workers.
records.abstract_cn: 信贷供应收缩可能导致企业降低就业水平，但人们对这些冲击如何影响企业员工的构成和工人层面的结果知之甚少。本文研究了银行困境如何影响信贷供应及其对企业层面以外的就业的影响。为此，我们使用了一个新颖的数据集，该数据集由连接丹麦所有银行、公司和工人的行政和税务记录构建。我们表明，特别容易受到2008-09金融危机影响的银行削减了对企业的贷款，而企业无法通过其他来源的融资来充分补偿。信贷供应的减少导致企业层面的就业下降，影响集中在危机前流动性较低的企业以及低学历和非管理人员的就业。在工人层面，我们发现失业率的上升是由低教育、非管理、短期和低收入工人的影响造成的。

records.title_en: Capital reallocation under climate policy uncertainty
records.title_cn: 气候政策不确定性下的资本再配置
records.abstract_en: Climate policy uncertainty (CPU) shocks can induce capital reallocation from carbon-intensive sectors to low-emitting sectors. We first show, using a DSGE model with financial frictions and various climate policy tools, that CPU shocks (i) lower the market value of the “dirty” sector relative to the “green” sector and (ii) reduce real investment in the “dirty” sector relative to the “green” sector. The financial channel plays a key role for this reallocation. Second, we document that these results align with firm-level evidence from the US. We find that empirical CPU shocks (i) cause financial markets to revalue firms in carbon-intensive sectors relative to firms in low-emitting sectors, and (ii) lead to substantial investment reallocation, particularly from manufacturing towards services.
records.abstract_cn: 气候政策不确定性（CPU）冲击可以诱导资本从碳密集型部门向低排放部门再配置。我们首先使用一个包含金融摩擦和各种气候政策工具的DSGE模型表明，CPU冲击（i）降低了“肮脏”部门相对于“绿色”部门的市值，（ii）减少了“肮脏”部门相对于“绿色”部门的实际投资。金融渠道在这一再配置中起着关键作用。其次，我们记录了这些结果与美国企业层面的证据一致。我们发现，实证CPU冲击（i）导致金融市场对碳密集型行业企业的估值相对于低排放行业企业发生重估，（ii）导致显著的投资再配置，特别是从制造业向服务业转移。

records.title_en: Fickle fossils: Economic growth, coal, and the European oil invasion, 1900–2015
records.title_cn: 善变的化石：经济增长、煤炭与欧洲石油入侵，1900-2015年
records.abstract_en: Fossil fuels have shaped the European economy since the Industrial Revolution. We use new long-run panel data to analyze the effect of both, coal and oil on economic growth between 1900 and 2015, exploiting variation at the level of European NUTS2 and NUTS3 regions. We show that the reversal of fortune of coal regions resulted from the second energy transition. Specifically, an “oil invasion” in the early 1960s turned regional coal abundance from a blessing into a curse. Human capital accumulation contributed to this reversal of fortune and fully explains the negative effects until today. Finally, we show that coal regions with pre-industrial urban centers were more resilient than others, in line with Glaeser’s “reinvention hypothesis”.
records.abstract_cn: 自工业革命以来，化石燃料塑造了欧洲经济。我们利用新的长期面板数据，分析了1900年至2015年间煤炭和石油对经济增长的影响，利用了欧洲NUTS2和NUTS3区域层面的变异。我们表明，煤炭地区的命运逆转源于第二次能源转型。具体而言，1960年代初的“石油入侵”将区域煤炭丰富度从福音转变为诅咒。人力资本积累促成了这一命运逆转，并完全解释了至今的负面影响。最后，我们表明，拥有前工业时代城市中心的煤炭地区比其他地区更具韧性，这与格莱泽的“再发明假说”一致。

records.title_en: Kinky Europe: Evidence from the regional Phillips curve in the euro area
records.title_cn: 古怪的欧洲：来自欧元区区域菲利普斯曲线的证据
records.abstract_en: We estimate the slope of the Phillips curve in the euro area, allowing for nonlinearities–or kinks–in the relationship between labor market slack and inflation. We exploit cross-country variation in labor market conditions in the period 2001–2024, absorbing aggregate shocks and endogenous monetary policy reactions with time fixed effects. We find that, while the Phillips curve is usually quite flat, it becomes at least three times steeper when the labor market is sufficiently tight. This kink is more pronounced in the euro area than in the United States, potentially due to more rigid labor markets. Our estimates suggest, however, that despite this nonlinearity, most of the post-pandemic inflation surge is attributable to factors other than labor market tightness.
records.abstract_cn: 我们估计了欧元区菲利普斯曲线的斜率，考虑到劳动力市场疲软与通货膨胀之间关系的非线性或扭结。我们利用2001-2024期间劳动力市场状况的跨国差异，吸收总体冲击和具有时间固定效应的内生货币政策反应。我们发现，虽然菲利普斯曲线通常相当平坦，但当劳动力市场足够紧张时，它会变得至少三倍陡峭。这种问题在欧元区比在美国更为明显，这可能是由于劳动力市场更加严格。然而，我们的估计表明，尽管存在这种非线性，但疫情后通胀飙升的大部分原因是劳动力市场紧张以外的因素。

records.title_en: An equilibrium theory of nominal exchange rates
records.title_cn: 名义汇率均衡理论
records.abstract_en: This paper proposes an equilibrium theory of nominal exchange rates, which offers a new perspective on various issues in open economy macroeconomics. The nominal exchange rate and portfolio choices are jointly determined in equilibrium, thus providing a new approach to overcoming the indeterminacy results in Kareken and Wallace (1981). The distinctive features of this theory are that the nominal exchange rate is determined in international financial markets, that the risk premium and UIP deviations are fully endogenous equilibrium objects and that the real exchange rate inherits its properties from the nominal exchange rate. In terms of policy, this novel theory implies that a country with an exchange rate peg and free asset mobility faces a tetralemma and not a trilemma, because it loses not only monetary policy independence but also fiscal policy independence.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提出了名义汇率均衡理论，为开放经济宏观经济学中的各种问题提供了新的视角。名义汇率和投资组合选择在均衡状态下共同决定，从而为克服Kareken和Wallace（1981）的不确定性结果提供了一种新方法。该理论的显着特点是，名义汇率是由国际金融市场决定的，风险溢价和UIP偏差是完全内生的均衡对象，实际汇率继承了名义汇率的属性。在政策方面，这一新颖的理论意味着，一个实行盯住汇率和资产自由流动的国家面临的是四难困境，而不是三难困境，因为它不仅失去了货币政策的独立性，而且还失去了财政政策的独立性。

records.title_en: Human-capital formation: The importance of endogenous longevity
records.title_cn: 人力资本形成：内生寿命的重要性
records.abstract_en: We present a theory of human capital, with health, skill, and longevity, endogenously determined. Using comparative dynamic analyses and a calibrated version of the theory, we uncover an important economic mechanism driving human-capital formation: whether individuals can influence their longevity. When they can, additional resources are invested in human capital. When they cannot, additional resources are used for consumption and leisure, i.e., “non-productively”. These findings point to the potential importance of endogenous longevity as an economic mechanism driving human-capital formation, and, by extension, human capital-based economic growth.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种人力资本理论，其中健康、技能和寿命是内生决定的。通过比较动态分析和理论的校准版本，我们揭示了驱动人力资本形成的一个重要经济机制：个体是否能够影响其寿命。当个体能够影响寿命时，额外资源被投资于人力资本。当不能时，额外资源用于消费和休闲，即“非生产性”用途。这些发现指出了内生寿命作为驱动人力资本形成，进而基于人力资本的经济增长的重要经济机制的潜在重要性。

records.title_en: The double-edged sword of facilitated giving: Field evidence on sales and donations
records.title_cn: 便利捐赠的双刃剑：销售和捐赠的现场证据
records.abstract_en: Facilitated giving, a common yet under-researched form of cause-related marketing (CRM), involves companies collecting donations from customers to support charitable causes. This study examines the impact of facilitated giving on revenue from ticket sales at an opera house through two large-scale field experiments involving over 50,000 customers. The charitable initiative supported a social youth project aimed at enhancing cultural education and social integration for individuals from disadvantaged households. We found that a particularly pervasive donation ask led to a significant short-term reduction in ticket purchases by non-donors. However, this adverse effect was short-lived and we did not find any effect of the program on total revenue from tickets and donations, neither in the short run nor in the long run.
records.abstract_cn: 便利捐赠是一种常见但尚未得到充分研究的公益营销 (CRM) 形式，涉及公司向客户收集捐款以支持慈善事业。本研究通过涉及超过 50,000 名客户的两项大规模现场实验，探讨了便利捐赠对歌剧院门票销售收入的影响。该慈善倡议支持一项社会青年项目，旨在加强弱势家庭个人的文化教育和社会融入。我们发现，特别普遍的捐赠要求导致非捐赠者购买门票的数量在短期内大幅减少。然而，这种不利影响是短暂的，无论从短期还是长期来看，我们都没有发现该计划对门票和捐款总收入有任何影响。

records.title_en: Gender identity and power imbalance in a group contest
records.title_cn: 团体竞赛中的性别认同和权力失衡
records.abstract_en: Many high-stakes organisational decisions are made by committees, where members exert costly influence to shape a single collective outcome. When committees are gender-imbalanced, the salience of gender identity may affect who mobilises influence and how numerical power translates into effective decision weight. We study how gender-identity salience interacts with numerical power in a controlled laboratory setting using a group-contest design. We vary the numerical balance of power (Female-Majority vs. Male-Majority) and manipulate whether gender composition is revealed. We find larger, advantaged groups invest significantly more and identity salience has asymmetric effects by gender. Among minority men facing female-majority groups, making gender salient increases investment and their initial disadvantage shrinks over time. Among minority women facing male-majority groups, investment does not increase and their relative disadvantage grows over time. These divergent responses are not explained by general social preferences or in-group cohesion. The findings suggest highlighting gender identity may intensify mobilisation by minority men without similarly empowering minority women, with implications for the design of diversity and transparency policies.
records.abstract_cn: 许多高风险的组织决策都是由委员会做出的，委员会成员为了形成单一的集体结果而施加代价高昂的影响力。当委员会性别不平衡时，性别认同的显着性可能会影响谁调动影响力以及人数权力如何转化为有效的决策权重。我们使用小组竞赛设计，在受控实验室环境中研究性别身份显着性如何与数字力量相互作用。我们改变权力的数量平衡（女性占多数与男性占多数）并操纵是否揭示性别构成。我们发现规模较大、优势群体的投资显着增加，而且身份显着性对性别的影响不对称。在面对女性占多数群体的少数男性中，突出性别会增加投资，并且随着时间的推移，他们最初的劣势会缩小。在面对男性占多数群体的少数女性中，投资并没有增加，而且她们的相对劣势随着时间的推移而增加。这些不同的反应不能用一般社会偏好或群体内凝聚力来解释。研究结果表明，强调性别认同可能会加强少数族裔男性的动员，而不会同样赋予少数族裔女性权力，这会对多样性和透明度政策的设计产生影响。

records.title_en: A small volume reduction that melts down the market: Auctions with endogenous rationing
records.title_cn: 导致市场崩溃的小幅缩减：内生配给的拍卖
records.abstract_en: Auctions with endogenous rationing are motivated by the regulatory requirement of so-called proportionality of public support and are used to allocate support for renewable energy. They reduce the auctioned volume below the tender volume when competition is low. We show theoretically that endogenous rationing has the extreme effect of deterring any participation when single-unit bidders have participation costs. Our experiment provides support for a strong negative effect on participation. We derive optimal mechanisms for three objectives and several designs for their implementation. They do not use endogenous rationing and exhibit the usual tradeoffs between objectives. However, reducing participation costs, as opposed to increasing the number of potential bidders, contributes to all three objectives and helps ensure proportionality.
records.abstract_cn: 内生配给的拍卖源于对公共支持所谓比例性的监管要求，并用于分配可再生能源支持。当竞争较低时，它们将拍卖量减少到招标量以下。我们从理论上表明，内生配给具有极端效应，即在单一单位投标人存在参与成本时阻止任何参与。我们的实验为参与度的强烈负面效应提供了支持。我们为三个目标推导了最优机制，并为其实施设计了多种方案。这些机制不使用内生配给，并表现出目标之间的常见权衡。然而，降低参与成本，而非增加潜在投标人的数量，有助于实现所有三个目标，并有助于确保比例性。

records.title_en: Oil revenues and labor market reforms
records.title_cn: 石油收入与劳动力市场改革
records.abstract_en: We examine the relationship between oil revenue shocks and labor market regulation empirically in a sample of 83 economies spanning 1970–2014. We find that oil revenue gains lead to a deregulation of the labor market in autocracies but have no effects in democracies. Oil revenue losses instead cause a sizeable deregulation in democracies but have limited effects in autocracies. We then consider possible transmission channels. Democracies appear to use the rents stemming from a positive oil revenue shock to increase government expenditures. Rent extraction and economic efficiency considerations are instead both plausible deregulation drivers following oil revenue gains in autocracies, as expenditures are not raised, while gross domestic product and employment gradually increase. Finally, the deregulation following oil revenue losses in democracies is consistent with the crisis-induced-reform hypothesis, as such losses deteriorate the current account and budget balances and increase the probability of a systemic banking crisis.
records.abstract_cn: 我们在一个涵盖83个经济体、时间跨度为1970-2014年的样本中，实证考察了石油收入冲击与劳动力市场监管之间的关系。我们发现，石油收入的增加导致专制国家的劳动力市场放松管制，但对民主国家没有影响。相反，石油收入的损失在民主国家引起了相当大的放松管制，但在专制国家影响有限。然后我们考虑了可能的传导渠道。民主国家似乎利用正向石油收入冲击带来的租金来增加政府支出。而在专制国家，石油收入增加后的放松管制，租金提取和经济效率考量都可能是合理的驱动因素，因为支出并未增加，而国内生产总值和就业则逐步增长。最后，民主国家在石油收入损失后的放松管制与危机引发的改革假说相一致，因为此类损失恶化了经常账户和预算余额，并增加了系统性银行危机的可能性。

records.title_en: From Françafrique to Chinafrica? Ecologically unequal exchange, neocolonialism, and environmental conflicts in Africa
records.title_cn: 从法非关系到中非关系？非洲的生态不平等交换、新殖民主义与环境冲突
records.abstract_en: Africa stands out as the continent where the legacies of colonialism and the ongoing dynamics of neo- and post-colonialism are felt most profoundly. In its role as the primary global supplier of raw materials, and with the ongoing technological transition towards the so-called “smart” economy and “green” energy systems, the demand for minerals from Africa is anticipated to increase significantly. European imperialism and its historically embedded extractivist logic are indispensable to understand the conditions that gradually prompted many African states to seek new trading partners. But “coloniality” is not limited to historical colonialism. Over the last two decades China has gradually assumed a prominent role in African trade, becoming Africa’s first trading partner, and leading several scholars to ask whether China is developing a new kind of colonialism. The impact of extractive activities by European, American, and Chinese private and public companies on African resources has been profound, resulting in the shifting of socio-ecological costs from industrialised countries to the African extractive peripheries. In this work, we employ a political ecology approach to examine: i) the claims of lingering French imperialism and Chinese neocolonialism; and ii) the impact of projects implemented by actors from France and China in Africa. We mobilise the theory of ecologically unequal exchange and cases of environmental conflicts involving Chinese and French industries to demonstrate how these projects have resulted in damaging impacts over African territories, leading to land pollution and detrimental effects on community health. We find evidence of ecologically unequal exchange both in the Chinese and French cases, though the dynamics characterising the trading relations of these two countries with the ensemble of African countries is markedly different.
records.abstract_cn: 非洲是殖民主义遗留影响以及新殖民主义和后殖民主义动态感受最为深刻的大陆。作为全球原材料的主要供应地，随着向所谓“智能”经济和“绿色”能源体系的技术转型持续推进，预计对非洲矿产的需求将显著增加。欧洲帝国主义及其历史嵌入的榨取主义逻辑，对于理解许多非洲国家逐渐寻求新贸易伙伴的条件不可或缺。但“殖民性”并不仅限于历史殖民主义。在过去二十年中，中国逐渐在非洲贸易中扮演重要角色，成为非洲第一大贸易伙伴，这促使多位学者质疑中国是否正在发展一种新型殖民主义。欧洲、美国和中国私营及公共公司的榨取活动对非洲资源的影响深远，导致社会生态成本从工业化国家转移到非洲榨取边缘地区。在本研究中，我们采用政治生态学方法考察：i) 法国帝国主义残余和中国新殖民主义的论断；ii) 法国和中国行为体在非洲实施项目的影响。我们运用生态不平等交换理论以及涉及中国和法国工业的环境冲突案例，证明这些项目对非洲领土造成了破坏性影响，导致土地污染和对社区健康的不利后果。我们发现了中国和法国案例中生态不平等交换的证据，尽管这两个国家与非洲各国整体贸易关系的动态特征显著不同。

records.title_en: Estimating the spillover economic effects of foreign conflict shocks: Evidence from Boko Haram
records.title_cn: 估算外国冲突冲击的溢出经济效应：来自博科圣地的证据
records.abstract_en: What are the spillover effects of foreign conflicts on regional economies, and what local factors can help mitigate the impact of such economic shocks? Adopting a difference-in-difference framework leveraging the breakout of the Boko Haram insurgency in Northeastern Nigeria in 2009, we study its effects in neighboring areas in Cameroon, Chad and Niger that were not directly targeted by Boko Haram activities until the mid 2010s. We find strong negative effects on regional economic activities – proxied by reductions in nighttime lights – particularly amongst areas within 200 km from the Boko Haram area. This negative impact is concentrated in urban areas, as trade was impacted and economic uncertainty rose. The rise of Boko Haram also resulted in more agricultural burning. Foreign conflict shocks can thus accentuate pressure on domestic resources. Focusing on the heterogeneity of the impacts, we find smaller resilience effects in those areas with a worse geography, less agricultural development, more limited infrastructure, and weaker markets and institutions. Overall, these findings suggest that conflicts may have larger spillover effects in geographically challenging and/or economically poorer regions, as is the case in various regions of Africa.
records.abstract_cn: 外国冲突对区域经济的溢出效应是什么，哪些地方因素有助于缓解此类经济冲击的影响？采用双重差分框架，利用2009年尼日利亚东北部博科圣地叛乱爆发，我们研究了其对喀麦隆、乍得和尼日尔邻近地区的影响，这些地区直到2010年代中期才直接受到博科圣地活动的波及。我们发现对区域经济活动——以夜间灯光减少为代理指标——存在强烈的负面影响，尤其是在距离博科圣地地区200公里以内的区域。这种负面影响集中在城市地区，因为贸易受到影响且经济不确定性上升。博科圣地的崛起也导致了更多的农业焚烧。因此，外国冲突冲击可能加剧对国内资源的压力。关注影响的异质性，我们发现地理条件较差、农业发展不足、基础设施有限以及市场和制度较弱的地区，其韧性效应较小。总体而言，这些发现表明，冲突在地理条件艰难和/或经济较贫困的地区可能产生更大的溢出效应，正如非洲多个地区的情况所示。

records.title_en: Solar power play: Uncovering political capture in distributing electricity access
records.title_cn: 太阳能发电博弈：揭示电力接入分配中的政治俘获
records.abstract_en: This study investigates the impact of elected politicians geographical representation on distributive decisions in a solar energy safety net program in Northern Bangladesh. Using a unique dataset on solar home system installations and political leaders’ biographies, we find strong evidence of political capture in the form of birthplace favoritism, leading to an uneven distribution of solar home systems among villages. Heterogeneous voting power within a rural council further amplifies political capture at the local level. Moreover, the extent of political capture varies based on the form of representation, power status of elected leaders, and intended beneficiaries. Finally, our results highlight that the programs effectiveness in expanding electricity access is adversely affected by the prevailing political capture within the program.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了孟加拉国北部一个太阳能安全网项目中，当选政治家的地理代表性对分配决策的影响。利用关于太阳能家庭系统安装和政治领袖传记的独特数据集，我们发现了以出生地偏袒形式存在的政治俘获的强有力证据，导致太阳能家庭系统在村庄间分布不均。农村委员会内部的异质性投票权进一步加剧了地方层面的政治俘获。此外，政治俘获的程度因代表形式、当选领导人的权力地位以及预期受益者而异。最后，我们的结果强调，该计划在扩大电力接入方面的有效性受到计划内普遍存在的政治俘获的不利影响。

records.title_en: Sterilizations and women health in India
records.title_cn: 印度女性绝育与妇女健康
records.abstract_en: Female sterilization is at the core of family planning programs in many developing countries, including India, where 37% of women older than 25 are sterilized. Emphasized advertisement and financial incentives for operations done in poor sanitary conditions have long raised controversies. We contribute to the decade long debate on the health effects of sterilization by analyzing several large scale surveys providing information on 800,000 Indian women. To address self-selection into sterilization, we control for location fixed effects and rely on an instrumental variable strategy. We exploit the fact that Indian households have different beliefs regarding child mortality risk and have a son preference. Sterilization increases when women have a boy first-born, but less so when they live in a historically malarious area, as they fear losing the boy; this situation provides an instrument. We show that sterilization deteriorates gynecological health and has no effect on nutrition indicators. Women with lower education, from scheduled castes, or having access to low-quality health care are more impacted. We also discuss the channels and interpret the effect as mostly driven by the surgery itself.
records.abstract_cn: 女性绝育是许多发展中国家（包括印度）计划生育项目的核心，在印度，37%岁以上的女性中有25已接受绝育。针对在卫生条件不佳的环境中进行的绝育手术，其广告宣传和财政激励措施长期以来一直引发争议。我们通过分析多项大规模调查（涵盖800,000万名印度女性）的数据，为这场关于绝育对健康影响的十年之久的辩论做出了贡献。为了解决绝育中的自我选择问题，我们控制了地点固定效应，并采用工具变量策略。我们利用了印度家庭对儿童死亡风险的不同信念以及重男轻女的偏好。当女性首胎为男孩时，绝育率会增加，但在历史上疟疾流行地区，由于担心失去男孩，绝育率增加较少；这种情况提供了一个工具。我们表明，绝育会恶化妇科健康，且对营养指标没有影响。教育程度较低、来自表列种姓或获得低质量医疗服务的女性受影响更大。我们还讨论了影响渠道，并将效应主要归因于手术本身。

records.title_en: Who Benefits the Most from Micro-Credit? Micro-Level Evidence from Sub-Saharan Africa
records.title_cn: 谁从微型信贷中获益最多？来自撒哈拉以南非洲的微观证据
records.abstract_en: This paper moves beyond typical mean effect analysis to examine who truly benefits from micro-credit. Utilising household-level panel data from 2010 to 2019 for a sample of Sub-Saharan African countries, via a quantile panel framework, we show that micro-credit has positive outcomes for households below specific welfare levels in low and lower-middle income countries. Conversely, the impact is less pronounced for wealthier households. Our results highlight inequalities in welfare outcomes, particularly favouring households in low to median quantiles. Notably, the effects of micro-credit vary across countries’ welfare levels, with significant impacts observed in low income countries. Policy recommendations emphasise targeting micro-credit interventions towards low to median welfare households to enhance welfare outcomes.
records.abstract_cn: 本文超越了典型的均值效应分析，探讨谁真正从微型信贷中获益。利用2010年至2019年间撒哈拉以南非洲国家样本的家庭层面面板数据，通过分位数面板框架，我们表明微型信贷对低收入和中等偏下收入国家中特定福利水平以下的家庭具有积极影响。相反，对较富裕家庭的影响则不那么显著。我们的结果凸显了福利结果中的不平等，尤其有利于处于低至中位数分位数的家庭。值得注意的是，微型信贷的效果因国家福利水平而异，在低收入国家观察到显著影响。政策建议强调将微型信贷干预措施瞄准低至中等福利家庭，以提升福利结果。

records.title_en: Effects of information about irregular migration on transit community attitudes towards migrants
records.title_cn: 关于非正规移民的信息对过境社区对移民态度的影响
records.abstract_en: European countries use information campaigns to deter irregular migration from Africa. We present results from a field experiment conducted in a transit community in Ghana testing the effects of such campaigns on local attitudes towards migrants. Respondents were randomized into three treatment arms, the first group watched a video stressing local opportunities, the second a video emphasizing the dangers of irregular migration, while the control group did not view any video. Despite power to detect reasonably small effects, we find no significant overall effect of either treatment on attitudes. We do, however, document an indirect effect of the first treatment; information stressing local opportunities reduces migration intentions of transit community members which in turn improves attitudes towards other migrants. This shows the importance of analyzing transit community members as inhabiting two roles simultaneously, they are both local residents and potential migrants in competition with other migrants. While there was little effect of the treatments on attitudes to migrants in general, results from an embedded discrete choice experiment show that treated respondents become more critical towards unskilled migrants, a result driven by skilled respondents, suggesting that information campaigns on irregular migration may reinforce socio-economic divisions in target communities.
records.abstract_cn: 欧洲国家使用信息宣传来阻止来自非洲的非正规移民。我们展示了一项在加纳过境社区进行的实地实验的结果，测试此类宣传对当地人对移民态度的影响。受访者被随机分配到三个处理组，第一组观看强调当地机会的视频，第二组观看强调非正规移民危险的视频，而对照组则不观看任何视频。尽管有足够的统计功效来检测相当小的效应，我们发现两种处理对态度均无显著总体影响。然而，我们确实记录了第一种处理的间接效应；强调当地机会的信息减少了过境社区成员的迁移意图，这反过来改善了对其他移民的态度。这表明分析过境社区成员同时扮演两个角色的重要性，他们既是当地居民，也是与其他移民竞争的潜在移民。虽然处理对一般移民态度的影响很小，但嵌入的离散选择实验结果显示，受处理的受访者变得对非技术移民更加挑剔，这一结果由技术受访者驱动，表明关于非正规移民的信息宣传可能加剧目标社区中的社会经济分化。

records.title_en: Women’s labour force participation in developing countries: The impact of gendered landownership rights
records.title_cn: 发展中国家女性劳动力参与：性别化土地所有权的影响
records.abstract_en: This paper challenges widely accepted assumptions regarding gendered patterns of labour: firstly, that capitalist development pulls women into non-agricultural employment and secondly, that women’s unpaid labour largely comprises the production of non-market goods and services within the home. Conventional demand and supply arguments on gender gaps in non-agricultural employment overlook the significance of patriarchal labour relations and the influence of women’s unpaid farm work on their participation in paid employment. Here we use cross-country panel data analysis and a case study from India with a difference-in-differences model to demonstrate that legal discrimination against women in land inheritance curtails female participation in non-agricultural paid employment. This occurs through several mechanisms, by: (1) keeping women in agriculture as unpaid family workers, (2) restricting women’s access to education, and (3) exacerbating the trend of rural women’s marriage migration. The paper thereby contributes an explanation for the apparent paradox observed in developing countries where persistent gender gaps in non-agricultural paid employment coexist with economic growth. It also suggests that tackling barriers to female labour participation by using policies which focus solely on the provision of childcare in urban areas is insufficient; rather, an exit package offering occupational training, guaranteed employment and housing is required to support women’s transition out of unpaid agricultural labour. The video abstract can be viewed here.
records.abstract_cn: 本文挑战了关于劳动性别模式的广泛接受的假设：其一，资本主义发展将女性拉入非农业就业；其二，女性的无偿劳动主要包含在家内生产非市场商品和服务。关于非农业就业性别差距的传统供需论点忽视了父权劳动关系的意义以及女性无偿农场劳动对其参与有偿就业的影响。在此，我们使用跨国面板数据分析以及来自印度的案例研究，采用双重差分模型，证明法律上对女性土地继承的歧视限制了女性参与非农业有偿就业。这通过几种机制发生，包括：（1）将女性留在农业中作为无偿家庭工人，（2）限制女性接受教育的机会，以及（3）加剧农村女性婚姻迁移的趋势。因此，本文为在发展中国家观察到的明显悖论提供了一种解释，即非农业有偿就业中持续的性别差距与经济增长并存。它还表明，仅通过提供城市儿童保育的政策来解决女性劳动参与的障碍是不够的；相反，需要一套包含职业培训、保障就业和住房的退出方案，以支持女性从无偿农业劳动中转型。视频摘要可在此处查看。

records.title_en: Catalyzing digital and environmental transformations by institutions in a diverse socio-economic world
records.title_cn: 多元社会经济世界中制度对数字与环境转型的催化作用
records.abstract_en: In a world that urgently needs to tackle the environmental crisis, many policymakers claimed that digitalization and smart technologies have the potential to catalyze green evolution. Given that there is little discussion on the readiness of a country to unlock the opportunity of green transformation via digitalization, we propose to put into question how this aspect is reflected within a sample of heterogeneous nations. The study seeks to spot the preconditions of this widespread concern related to digital and environmental advancements and to explore how institutional and economic features moderate them. To test if, on a broad scale, the dynamics of digital and environmental facets are robustly anchored in the institutional architecture of different categories of states and if, at the global level, their effects and divides evolve under the direct influence of socio-economic circumstances, we constructed a large macro panel data (1996–2021) on over 160 countries, integrating various statistics. Results from our econometric models suggest that the investigated countries are in diverse stages of digital and environmental transitions, with strong asymmetries as regards the Internet access, greenhouse gas emissions per capita, black carbon emissions, recycling, and state capacity. The findings also illustrate that the development is rather tied to digitalization and the human capital is a prerequisite of digitalization. However, a strong state capacity is required to implement relevant policies to expedite digitalization and green transformations.
records.abstract_cn: 在一个迫切需要应对环境危机的世界中，许多政策制定者声称数字化和智能技术有潜力催化绿色演进。鉴于关于一个国家是否准备好通过数字化解锁绿色转型机遇的讨论甚少，我们提出质疑这一方面如何在异质性国家样本中得到体现。本研究旨在识别这一与数字和环境进步相关的广泛关注的前提条件，并探讨制度和经济特征如何调节这些条件。为了检验在广泛层面上，数字和环境方面的动态是否稳健地锚定于不同类别国家的制度架构中，以及在全球层面上，其效应和分歧是否在社会经济状况的直接影响下演变，我们构建了一个涵盖超过160个国家的大型宏观面板数据（1996-2021年），整合了各种统计数据。我们的计量经济学模型结果表明，所研究的国家处于数字和环境转型的不同阶段，在互联网接入、人均温室气体排放、黑碳排放、回收利用和国家能力方面存在强烈的不对称性。研究结果还表明，发展更多地与数字化相关，而人力资本是数字化的先决条件。然而，需要强大的国家能力来实施相关政策，以加速数字化和绿色转型。

records.title_en: Does the homicide resource curse exist? Evidence in selected countries
records.title_cn: 杀人资源诅咒是否存在？来自选定国家的证据
records.abstract_en: Despite the increasing exploration of the relationship between natural resources and civil wars/interstate conflicts, less is known about their effects on everyday interpersonal violence during peacetime. This study assesses the effect of natural resources on intentional homicides in selected countries. It demonstrates that intentional homicides increase with natural resource dependence, with a greater effect on male homicides compared to female homicides. Men are therefore disproportionately affected by resource-induced homicide. Moreover, the traditional worse effect of point resources compared to diffuse resources is also highlighted by the results. They show that rents from coal, minerals, oil and natural gas have a strong positive effect on homicide rates, while the effect of forest rents is less precise and not significant. Finally, the study establishes that institutions shape the effect of natural resources on homicides. Homicide rates only increase in resource-rent-dependent countries with high levels of corruption and low levels of political stability, democracy and respect for the rule of law. The diversification of the economies to reduce over-dependence on resource rents in countries heavily endowed with point resources and the strengthening of institutional quality are mainly recommended.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管对自然资源与内战/国家间冲突之间关系的探索日益增多，但对其在和平时期对日常人际暴力的影响知之甚少。本研究评估了选定国家中自然资源对故意杀人的影响。研究表明，故意杀人随着自然资源依赖程度的增加而增加，且对男性杀人的影响大于女性杀人。因此，男性受到资源引发的杀人的影响不成比例地更大。此外，与分散资源相比，点资源传统上更糟糕的影响也由结果所凸显。结果显示，煤炭、矿产、石油和天然气的租金对杀人率有强烈的正向影响，而森林租金的影响则不太精确且不显著。最后，研究确定制度塑造了自然资源对杀人的影响。杀人率仅在资源租金依赖且腐败程度高、政治稳定性低、民主程度低和法治尊重程度低的国家中增加。主要建议是，在点资源丰富的国家，通过经济多元化减少对资源租金的过度依赖，并加强制度质量。

records.title_en: Contentious cities? Urban growth and electoral violence in Africa
records.title_cn: 有争议的城市？非洲的城市增长与选举暴力
records.abstract_en: How does rapid urban growth affect the risk of electoral violence in African cities? Across the continent, societies have been undergoing simultaneous processes that may affect the risk of violent upheaval: democratic change and urbanization. However, although electoral violence often disproportionally affects cities, we do not know if and how the process of urban growth in itself impacts such violence. Existing research highlights that urbanization holds a strong potential for progress and democracy-enhancement, but also for destructive and violence-inducing dynamics. Drawing on collective action theory, I develop a theoretical argument about the relationship between urban growth and the mobilization of electoral violence. I hypothesize that rapid city growth conditions elites’ strategic incentives to employ electoral violence, and may increase the risk of such violence through two mechanisms: by increasing uncertainty about local election outcomes, and by making it easier for politicians to mobilize violence based on grievances among urban groups. I assess these expectations by using georeferenced data on electoral violence, covering democratic elections in Africa (1990–2012), and matching it with data on the urban growth pace of all cities with at least 50,000 inhabitants. This approach avoids the pitfalls of focusing only on major cities, and enables an analysis of both cross- and within state dynamics. Using this approach, I identify a robust correlation between the pace of urban population growth and the risk of electoral violence in the city. Extended analysis indicates that urban growth is associated with a higher risk of election violence in larger, more established cities (including both major and secondary cities), but not in smaller, emerging cities.
records.abstract_cn: 快速的城市增长如何影响非洲城市中选举暴力的风险？在整个非洲大陆，社会一直在经历可能影响暴力动荡风险的同时进程：民主变革和城市化。然而，尽管选举暴力往往不成比例地影响城市，但我们不知道城市增长过程本身是否以及如何影响此类暴力。现有研究强调，城市化具有促进进步和增强民主的巨大潜力，但也可能引发破坏性和诱发暴力的动态。借鉴集体行动理论，我提出了一个关于城市增长与选举暴力动员之间关系的理论论点。我假设，快速的城市增长调节了精英们采用选举暴力的战略激励，并可能通过两种机制增加此类暴力的风险：增加地方选举结果的不确定性，以及使政治家更容易基于城市群体中的不满情绪动员暴力。我通过使用覆盖非洲民主选举（1990-2012年）的选举暴力地理参考数据，并将其与所有至少拥有50,000居民的城市城市增长速度数据进行匹配来评估这些预期。这种方法避免了仅关注主要城市的陷阱，并能够分析跨国和国内动态。使用这种方法，我确定了城市人口增长速度与城市选举暴力风险之间的稳健相关性。扩展分析表明，城市增长与较大、更成熟的城市（包括主要城市和次要城市）中选举暴力风险较高相关，但在较小、新兴城市中则不然。

records.title_en: Earthquake severity and child nutrition: The Haiti 2010 earthquake
records.title_cn: 地震烈度与儿童营养：海地2010年地震
records.abstract_en: Nutritional status is an important indicator of children’s health and well-being. Previous research on child nutrition in earthquake contexts has shown an increased chance of undernutrition among children in affected areas. Haiti suffered a devastating earthquake in January 2010. This paper makes an important addition to previous research by investigating variations in child nutrition (height-for-age z-scores) across birth cohorts and earthquake severity. Data from Haiti Demographic and Health Surveys from 2005–06, 2012 and 2016–17 and geocoded data on the Modified Mercalli Intensity scale and the Peak Ground Acceleration from the U.S. Geological Survey are analysed with linear regression. The results show that children born in some of the post-earthquake years located in areas with severe earthquake impact had lower HAZ relative to children in less impacted areas. It is especially important to ensure a well-coordinated response after major disasters to reduce the impact on child undernutrition, not only in the immediate aftermath but also in the long term.
records.abstract_cn: 营养状况是儿童健康和福祉的重要指标。先前关于地震情境下儿童营养的研究表明，受影响地区的儿童营养不良风险增加。海地在2010年一月遭受了毁灭性地震。本文通过调查不同出生队列和地震烈度下儿童营养（年龄别身高Z评分）的差异，对先前研究做出了重要补充。研究分析了海地2005-06年、2012年和2016-17年人口与健康调查数据，以及美国地质调查局关于修正麦加利烈度表和峰值地面加速度的地理编码数据，采用线性回归方法进行分析。结果表明，在地震后某些年份出生、位于地震严重影响地区的儿童，其HAZ相对于受影响较轻地区的儿童更低。在重大灾害后确保协调良好的应对措施尤为重要，以减少对儿童营养不良的影响，不仅在灾后立即阶段，而且在长期内也是如此。

records.title_en: Performance measurability, local government’s incentives, and regional air pollution reduction
records.title_cn: 绩效可衡量性、地方政府激励与区域空气污染减排
records.abstract_en: This study examines the impact of performance measurability on the effectiveness of local governments in mitigating air pollution. Utilizing a difference-in-differences (DiD) approach, which leverages the 2013 Air Pollution Prevention and Control Action Plan in China, this study finds a substantial and negative correlation between performance measurability on PM2.5 concentration. Mechanism analysis finds that the reduction in PM2.5 concentration is more pronounced in cities managed by leaders with stronger political promotion incentives (career concern incentive), and in those that are more reliant on financial transfers from the central government (financial incentive). Further analysis highlights the role of performance measurability in prompting genuine governmental efforts in environmental conservation. Our study emphasizes the importance of transparent reporting of environmental data in advancing sustainable development in developing countries.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了绩效可衡量性对地方政府缓解空气污染有效性的影响。利用双重差分法（DiD），借助中国2013年《大气污染防治行动计划》，研究发现绩效可衡量性与PM2.5浓度之间存在显著负相关。机制分析表明，PM2.5浓度的降低在由具有更强政治晋升激励（职业关注激励）的领导者管理的城市以及更依赖中央政府财政转移（财政激励）的城市中更为显著。进一步分析强调了绩效可衡量性在促进政府切实投入环境保护中的作用。我们的研究强调了环境数据透明报告在推动发展中国家可持续发展中的重要性。

records.title_en: Unequal contributions to CO2 emissions along the income distribution within and between countries
records.title_cn: 收入分配不平等对二氧化碳排放的不均衡贡献：国家内部与国家之间
records.abstract_en: The question of whether changes in income inequality affect CO2 emissions remains a topic of debate at both theoretical and empirical levels. The purpose of this paper is to examine the effect of changes in the full spectrum of income distribution on consumption-based CO2 emissions per capita. To do so, we estimate a dynamic difference-GMM model and a dynamic threshold regression model allowing for endogeneity on a panel database covering 107 countries between 1990 and 2019. Our analysis shows that different income groups contribute very differently to consumption-based CO2 emissions. In addition, by accounting for between-country inequalities in the average income of each income group, we uncover non-linearities in the impact on carbon emissions. More specifically, the impact of an increase in the income share of the top 10% on per capita consumption-based carbon emissions varies according to their average income level: it is non-statistically significant at lower income levels and turns positive as their income rises. The contribution of the middle 40% is negative at all income levels, while the CO2 contribution of the poorest segments is negligible.
records.abstract_cn: 收入不平等变化是否影响二氧化碳排放的问题在理论和实证层面仍存在争议。本文旨在考察收入分配全谱变化对人均消费型二氧化碳排放的影响。为此，我们估计了一个动态差分GMM模型和一个允许内生性的动态阈值回归模型，基于覆盖1990年至2019年间107个国家的面板数据。我们的分析表明，不同收入群体对消费型二氧化碳排放的贡献差异显著。此外，通过考虑各收入群体平均收入的国家间不平等，我们发现了对碳排放影响的非线性特征。具体而言，顶层10%收入份额增加对人均消费型碳排放的影响随其平均收入水平而变化：在较低收入水平下统计上不显著，随着收入上升转为正效应。中间40%群体的贡献在所有收入水平下均为负，而最贫困群体的二氧化碳贡献可忽略不计。

records.title_en: Auctioning Long-Term Projects under Financial Constraints
records.title_cn: 在财务紧张的情况下拍卖长期项目
records.abstract_en: We consider a procurement auction for the provision of a basic service to which an add-on must later be appended. Potential providers are symmetric, have private information on their cost for the basic service and the winning firm must also implement the add-on. To finance value-enhancing activities related to the add-on, this firm may need extra funding by outside financiers. Nonverifiable effort related to these activities creates a moral hazard problem which makes the firm’s payoff function for the second period concave in returns over the relevant range. Concavity has two effects. First, it makes it more attractive to backload payments to facilitate information revelation. Second, uncertainty on the cost of the add-on introduces a background risk which requires a risk premium. In this context, we characterize the optimal intertemporal structure of payments to the winning firm, equilibrium bidding behaviour and reserve prices for a first-price auction.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考虑进行采购拍卖，以提供基本服务，随后必须附加附加服务。潜在的提供商是对称的，拥有有关基本服务成本的私人信息，获胜的公司还必须实施附加服务。为了资助与附加组件相关的增值活动，该公司可能需要外部融资者提供额外资金。与这些活动相关的不可验证的努力会产生道德风险问题，使公司在第二期间的收益函数在相关范围内的回报上呈凹形。凹度有二效应。 第一，它使得延期付款更具吸引力，以促进信息披露。 第二，附加组件成本的不确定性引入了背景风险，需要风险溢价。在这种背景下，我们描述了向获胜公司支付的最优跨期结构、均衡投标行为和第一价格拍卖的底价。

records.title_en: Markups and Inequality
records.title_cn: 加价和不平等
records.abstract_en: We characterize optimal product market policy in an unequal economy in which firm ownership is concentrated and markups increase with firm market shares. We study the problem of a utilitarian regulator who designs revenue-neutral interventions in the product market. We show that optimal policy increases product market concentration. This is because policies that encourage larger producers to expand improve allocative efficiency, increase the demand for labour and equilibrium wages. We derive these results both in a static Mirrleesian setting in which we impose no constraints on the shape of interventions, as well as in a dynamic economy with wealth accumulation. In our dynamic economy optimal policy reduces wealth and income inequality by redistributing market share and profits from medium-sized businesses, which are primarily owned by relatively rich entrepreneurs, to larger diversified corporate firms.
records.abstract_cn: 我们描述了不平等经济中最优产品市场政策的特征，在这种经济中，公司所有权集中，加价随着公司市场份额的增加而增加。我们研究了一个功利主义监管者的问题，该监管者在产品市场上设计了收入中性的干预措施。我们表明，最优政策提高了产品市场集中度。这是因为鼓励较​​大生产者扩张的政策提高了配置效率，增加了对劳动力和均衡工资的需求。我们在静态米尔利斯环境（我们对干预措施的形式不施加任何限制）以及财富积累的动态经济中得出了这些结果。在我们充满活力的经济中，最优政策通过将主要由相对富裕的企业家拥有的中型企业的市场份额和利润重新分配给大型多元化企业来减少财富和收入不平等。

records.title_en: Sowing the Seeds of Financial Crises: Endogenous Asset Creation and Adverse Selection
records.title_cn: 播下金融危机的种子：内生资产创造和逆向选择
records.abstract_en: What sows the seeds of financial crises, and what policies can help avoid them? I model the interaction between the ex-ante production of assets and ex-post adverse selection in financial markets. Positive shocks that increase market prices exacerbate the production of low-quality assets and can increase the likelihood of a financial market collapse. The interest rate and the liquidity premium are endogenous and depend on the functioning of financial markets as well as the total supply of assets (private and public). Optimal policy balances the economy’s liquidity needs ex-post with the production incentives ex-ante, and it can be implemented with three instruments: government bonds, asset purchase programs, and transaction taxes. Public liquidity improves incentives but implies a higher deadweight loss than private market interventions. Optimal policy does not rule out private market collapses but mitigates the fluctuations in total liquidity.
records.abstract_cn: 金融危机的根源是什么？哪些政策可以帮助避免金融危机？我对金融市场中资产的事前生产与事后逆向选择之间的相互作用进行了建模。提高市场价格的积极冲击会加剧低质量资产的生产，并可能增加金融市场崩溃的可能性。利率和流动性溢价是内生的，取决于金融市场的运作以及资产的总供应（私人和公共）。最优政策平衡经济的事后流动性需求和事前生产激励，并且可以通过政府债券、资产购买计划和交易税等工具来实施。公共流动性改善了激励措施，但意味着比私人市场干预更高的无谓损失。最优政策并不排除私人市场崩溃，但会减轻总流动性的波动。

records.title_en: Looming Large or Seeming Small? Attitudes Towards Losses in a Representative Sample
records.title_cn: 显得大还是显得小？代表性样本对损失的态度
records.abstract_en: We measure individual-level loss aversion using three incentivized, representative surveys of the U.S. population (combined N=3,000). We find that around 50% of the U.S. population is loss tolerant—they are willing to accept negative-expected-value gambles that contain a loss. This is counter to expert predictions and earlier findings—which mostly come from laboratory/student samples—that 70–90% of participants are loss averse. Consistent with the different findings in our study versus the prior literature, loss aversion is more prevalent in people with high cognitive ability. Further, our measure of gain–loss attitudes exhibits similar temporal stability and better predictive power outside our survey than measures of risk aversion. Loss-tolerant individuals are more likely to report recent gambling, investing a higher percentage of their assets in stocks, and experiencing financial shocks. These results support the general hypothesis that individuals value gains and losses differently, and that gain–loss attitudes are an important economic preference. However, the tendency in a large proportion of the population to emphasize gains over losses is an overlooked behavioural phenomenon.
records.abstract_cn: 我们使用 三 对美国人口进行的激励性代表性调查（合并 N=3,000）来衡量个人层面的损失厌恶。我们发现，大约 50% 的美国人具有损失容忍度——他们愿意接受包含损失的负期望值赌博。这与专家预测和早期发现（主要来自实验室/学生样本）相反，即70-90%参与者厌恶损失。与我们的研究与先前文献的不同发现一致，损失厌恶在认知能力高的人中更为普遍。此外，在我们的调查之外，我们对得失态度的衡量表现出与风险厌恶衡量相似的时间稳定性和更好的预测能力。容忍损失的个人更有可能报告最近赌博、将更高比例的资产投资于股票以及经历金融冲击。这些结果支持了这样一个普遍假设：个体对收益和损失的评价不同，并且收益-损失态度是一种重要的经济偏好。然而，很大一部分人倾向于强调收益而不是损失，这是一种被忽视的行为现象。

records.title_en: Robustly Optimal Mechanisms for Selling Multiple Goods
records.title_cn: 销售多种商品的稳健最优机制
records.abstract_en: We study robustly optimal mechanisms for selling multiple items. The seller maximizes revenue against a worst-case distribution of a buyer’s valuations within a set of distributions, called an “ambiguity” set. We identify the exact forms of robustly optimal selling mechanisms and the worst-case distributions when the ambiguity set satisfies various moment conditions on the values of subsets of goods. The analysis reveals general properties of the ambiguity set that justifies categorical bundling, which includes separate sales and pure bundling as special cases.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究销售多种商品的稳健最优机制。卖方在一组称为“模糊性”的分布中，针对买方估价的最坏情况分布，实现收入最大化。当模糊集满足商品子集值的各种矩条件时，我们确定了鲁棒最优销售机制的确切形式和最坏情况分布。该分析揭示了模糊集的一般属性，这些属性证明了分类捆绑的合理性，其中包括作为特殊情况的单独销售和纯捆绑。

records.title_en: Standard Errors for Calibrated Parameters
records.title_cn: 校准参数的标准误差
records.abstract_en: Calibration, the practice of choosing the parameters of a structural model to match certain empirical moments, can be viewed as minimum distance estimation. Existing standard error formulas for such estimators require a consistent estimate of the correlation structure of the empirical moments, which is often unavailable in practice. Instead, the variances of the individual empirical moments are usually readily estimable. Using only these variances, we derive conservative standard errors and confidence intervals for the structural parameters that are valid even under the worst-case correlation structure. In the over-identified case, we show that the moment weighting scheme that minimizes the worst-case estimator variance amounts to a moment selection problem with a simple solution. Finally, we develop tests of over-identifying or parameter restrictions. We apply our methods empirically to a model of menu cost pricing for multi-product firms and to a heterogeneous agent New Keynesian model.
records.abstract_cn: 校准，即选择结构模型的参数来匹配某些经验矩的实践，可以被视为最小距离估计。此类估计量的现有标准误差公式需要对经验矩的相关结构进行一致估计，而这在实践中通常是不可用的。相反，各个经验矩的方差通常很容易估计。仅使用这些方差，我们得出即使在最坏情况相关结构下也有效的结构参数的保守标准误差和置信区间。在过度识别的情况下，我们证明了最小化最坏情况估计方差的矩加权方案相当于具有简单解决方案的矩选择问题。最后，我们开发了过度识别或参数限制的测试。我们根据经验将我们的方法应用于多产品公司的菜单成本定价模型和异质代理新凯恩斯模型。

records.title_en: Direct and Indirect Effects of Subsidized Dual Apprenticeships
records.title_cn: 补贴双元学徒的直接和间接影响
records.abstract_en: Public interventions in the apprenticeship market often aim to increase demand or returns. We set up a double-sided experiment with youth and firms to analyse a subsidized dual apprenticeship program. This intervention seeks to relax financial constraints for youth by offering a wage subsidy and to make apprenticeship more attractive by providing vocational training in technical skills that complements on-the-job training. We document a large increase in youth participation in apprenticeship, yet the inflow of apprentices induces little crowding out of traditional apprentices in firms. The intervention leads to an increase in youth demand for apprenticeship, enabling firms to fill open apprenticeship positions. The subsidy compensates apprentices for low wages but does not alleviate financial constraints. Consistent with the dual training component contributing to an increase in youth demand for apprenticeship, youth perform more complex tasks and have higher earnings 4 years after the start of the experiment.
records.abstract_cn: 对学徒市场的公共干预往往旨在增加需求或回报。我们与青年和企业进行了双边实验，以分析补贴双元学徒计划。这项干预措施旨在通过提供工资补贴来放松年轻人的经济限制，并通过提供补充在职培训的技术技能职业培训来提高学徒期的吸引力。我们记录了年轻人参与学徒制的人数大幅增加，但学徒的流入并没有导致公司中传统学徒的排挤。干预措施导致年轻人对学徒的需求增加，使公司能够填补空缺的学徒职位。该补贴补偿了学徒的低工资，但并没有缓解财务压力。与双元培训部分导致青年学徒需求增加的情况一致，青年人在实验开始几年后执行更复杂的任务并获得更高的收入4。

records.title_en: Untying the Knot: How Child Support and Alimony Affect Couples’ Dynamic Decisions and Welfare
records.title_cn: 解开这个结：子女抚养费和赡养费如何影响夫妻的动态决策和福利
records.abstract_en: In many countries, divorce law mandates post-marital maintenance payments (child support and alimony) to insure the lower earner in married couples against financial losses upon divorce. This paper studies how maintenance payments affect couples’ intertemporal decisions and welfare. I develop a dynamic model of family labour supply, home production, savings, and divorce and estimate it using Danish register and survey data. The model captures the policy tradeoff between providing insurance to the lower earner and enabling couples to specialise efficiently, on the one hand, and maintaining labour supply incentives for divorcees, on the other hand. I use the estimated model to study various counterfactual policy scenarios. I find that alimony comes with more substantial labour supply disincentives compared to child support payments and is less efficient in providing consumption insurance. The welfare maximising policy, within the status quo policy space, involves increasing child support and reducing alimony payments. My results show that Pareto improvements beyond this welfare maximising policy are feasible, highlighting limitations of how child support and alimony policies are commonly implemented.
records.abstract_cn: 在许多国家，离婚法强制要求支付婚后赡养费（子女抚养费和赡养费），以确保已婚夫妇中收入较低的人在离婚时免受经济损失。本文研究赡养费如何影响夫妻的跨期决策和福利。我开发了一个家庭劳动力供应、家庭生产、储蓄和离婚的动态模型，并使用丹麦登记和调查数据对其进行估计。该模型体现了政策权衡，一方面向低收入者提供保险，使夫妇能够有效地专业化，另一方面维持对离婚者的劳动力供应激励。我使用估计模型来研究各种反事实政策情景。我发现，与子女抚养费相比，赡养费会带来更严重的劳动力供应抑制因素，并且在提供消费保险方面效率较低。在现状政策空间内，福利最大化政策涉及增加子女抚养费和减少赡养费。我的结果表明，超越福利最大化政策的帕累托改进是可行的，突显了子女抚养和赡养费政策通常实施方式的局限性。

records.title_en: Who Bears the Welfare Costs of Monopoly? The Case of the Credit Card Industry
records.title_cn: 谁承担垄断的福利成本？信用卡行业案例
records.abstract_en: We measure the distribution of welfare losses from non-competitive behaviour in the U.S. credit card industry during the 1970s and 1980s. The early credit card industry was characterized by regional monopolies. Ensuing legal decisions led to competitive reforms that resulted in greater, but still limited, oligopolistic competition. We measure the distributional consequences of these reforms by developing and estimating a heterogeneous agent, defaultable debt framework with oligopolistic lenders. The transition from monopoly to oligopolistic competition yields welfare gains equivalent to a one-time transfer worth $3,600 (in 2016 dollars) for the bottom decile of earners (roughly 50% of their annual income) versus $1,200 for the top decile of earners. As the credit market expands, low-income households benefit more since they rely disproportionately on credit to smooth consumption. Greater competition also explains rising bankruptcies, chargeoffs, and credit to income ratios. Lastly, we bound the welfare gains from competition by computing a perfectly competitive benchmark. Aggregate welfare gains are 40% larger from perfect competition but distributed similarly to oligopolistic competition.
records.abstract_cn: 我们衡量1970和1980期间美国信用卡行业非竞争行为造成的福利损失的分布。早期的信用卡行业具有区域垄断的特点。随后的法律决定导致了竞争性改革，导致了更大但仍然有限的寡头垄断竞争。我们通过与寡头垄断贷款人开发和估计异质代理、可违约债务框架来衡量这些改革的分配后果。从垄断到寡头垄断竞争的转变所产生的福利收益相当于收入最低十分之一的人（大约是其年收入的3,600）的一时间转移价值$2016（以50%美元计），而收入最高的十分之一的人则为$1,200美元。随着信贷市场的扩大，低收入家庭受益更多，因为他们过度依赖信贷来平稳消费。更激烈的竞争也解释了破产、冲销和信贷与收入比率上升的原因。最后，我们通过计算完全竞争基准来限制竞争带来的福利收益。完全竞争带来的总福利收益40%更大，但分布与寡头垄断竞争类似。

records.title_en: Moment Conditions for Dynamic Panel Logit Models with Fixed Effects
records.title_cn: 具有固定效应的动态面板 Logit 模型的力矩条件
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates the construction of moment conditions in discrete choice panel data with individual-specific fixed effects. We describe how to systematically explore the existence of moment conditions that do not depend on the fixed effects, and we demonstrate how to construct them when they exist. Our approach is closely related to the numerical “functional differencing” construction introduced in a seminal paper by Bonhomme, but our emphasis is to find explicit analytic expressions for the moment functions. We first explain the construction and give examples of such moment conditions in various models. Then, we focus on the dynamic binary choice logit model and explore the implications of the moment conditions for the identification and estimation of the model parameters that are common to all individuals.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了具有个体特定固定效应的离散选择面板数据中矩条件的构造。我们描述了如何系统地探索不依赖于固定效应的矩条件的存在，并演示了如何在它们存在时构建它们。我们的方法与 Bonhomme 的一篇开创性论文中引入的数值“函数微分”结构密切相关，但我们的重点是找到矩函数的显式解析表达式。我们第一解释了这种结构并给出了各种模型中此类力矩条件的示例。然后，我们关注动态二元选择 Logit 模型，并探讨矩条件对所有个体共有的模型参数的识别和估计的影响。

records.title_en: Rational Expectations Models with Higher-Order Beliefs
records.title_cn: 具有高阶信念的理性预期模型
records.abstract_en: We develop a method of solving rational expectations models with dispersed information and dynamic strategic complementarities. In these types of models, the equilibrium outcome hinges on an infinite number of higher-order expectations which require an increasing number of state variables to keep track of. Despite this complication, we prove that the equilibrium outcome always admits a finite-state representation when the signals follow finite ARMA processes. We also show that such a finite-state result may not hold with endogenous information aggregation. We further illustrate how to use the method to derive comparative statics, characterize equilibrium outcomes in HANK-type network games, reconcile with empirical evidence on expectations, and integrate incomplete information with bounded rationality in general equilibrium.
records.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一种解决具有分散信息和动态战略互补性的理性预期模型的方法。在这些类型的模型中，均衡结果取决于无限数量的高阶期望，这些期望需要越来越多的状态变量来跟踪。尽管存在这种复杂性，我们还是证明，当信号遵循有限 ARMA 过程时，均衡结果总是允许有限状态表示。我们还表明，这样的有限状态结果可能不适用于内生信息聚合。我们进一步说明如何使用该方法推导比较静态，描述 HANK 型网络博弈中的均衡结果，与预期的经验证据相协调，并将不完整信息与一般均衡中的有限理性相结合。

records.title_en: The Child Penalty Atlas
records.title_cn: 儿童刑罚图集
records.abstract_en: This paper builds a world atlas of child penalties in employment based on microdata from 134 countries. The estimation of child penalties is based on pseudo-event studies of first child birth using cross-sectional data. The pseudo-event studies are validated against true event studies using panel data for a subset of countries. Most countries display clear and sizable child penalties: men and women follow parallel trends before parenthood, but diverge sharply and persistently after parenthood. While this pattern is pervasive, there is enormous variation in the magnitude of the effects across different regions of the world. The fraction of gender inequality explained by child penalties varies systematically with economic development and proxies for structural transformation. At low levels of development, child penalties represent a minuscule fraction of gender inequality. But as economies develop—incomes rise and the labour market transitions from subsistence agriculture to salaried work in industry and services—child penalties take over as the dominant driver of gender inequality. The relationship between child penalties and development is validated using historical data from current high-income countries, back to the 1700s for some countries. Finally, because parenthood is often tied to marriage, we also investigate the existence of marriage penalties in female employment. In general, women experience both marriage and child penalties, but their relative importance depends on the level of development. The development process is associated with a substitution from marriage penalties to child penalties, with the former gradually converging to zero.
records.abstract_cn: 本文根据134个国家的微观数据构建了就业中儿童处罚的世界地图集。对儿童处罚的估计是基于使用横截面数据对第一分娩进行的伪事件研究。使用部分国家的面板数据对照真实事件研究对伪事件研究进行了验证。大多数国家都表现出明确且相当大的儿童惩罚：男性和女性在成为父母之前遵循相似的趋势，但在成为父母之后却出现了急剧而持久的分歧。虽然这种模式很普遍，但世界不同地区的影响程度存在巨大差异。儿童惩罚所解释的性别不平等比例随着经济发展和结构转型的变化而系统性地变化。在发展水平较低的情况下，对儿童的惩罚只占性别不平等的一小部分。但随着经济发展，收入增加，劳动力市场从自给农业转向工业和服务业的带薪工作，对儿童的惩罚成为性别不平等的主要驱动因素。儿童惩罚与发展之间的关系是使用当前高收入国家的历史数据进行验证的，对于某些国家来说可以追溯到1700。最后，由于为人父母往往与婚姻联系在一起，我们还调查了女性就业中是否存在婚姻惩罚。一般来说，女性都会经历婚姻和孩子的惩罚，但它们的相对重要性取决于发展水平。其发展过程是从婚姻刑到子女刑的替代，并逐渐趋向于零。

records.title_en: A Dynamic Model of Authoritarian Social Control
records.title_cn: 威权社会控制的动态模型
records.abstract_en: Authoritarian regimes often use targeted social control—unequal application of the law to limit expressive freedom and enforce social conformity. At the same time, their methods appear less draconian than in the past. In this model, an authority structures punishments and rewards to compel adherence to its preferred norm. The authority’s commitment is time-limited and depends on imperfectly informative signals of a citizen’s behaviour. Given two citizens with the same observed behaviour, the authority imposes harsher punishments on the poorer and/or ex ante dissident individual. Lighter punishments are imposed on the wealthier citizen to prevent “over-compliance”. Wealth inequality increases over time. Some citizens become prosperous “lackeys” while others become destitute from confiscation. In stable regimes with high state capacity, the authority reduces punishments and/or increases rewards to allow citizens to accumulate wealth, leading to social conformity and balanced growth in the long run. In unstable regimes with low capacity, the citizenry splits into groups of wealthy lackeys and destitute proles.
records.abstract_cn: 独裁政权经常使用有针对性的社会控制——不平等的法律适用来限制言论自由并强制社会整合。与此同时，他们的方法似乎不像过去那么严厉。在这个模型中，权威机构通过惩罚和奖励来迫使人们遵守其偏好的规范。当局的承诺是有时间限制的，并且取决于公民行为的不完全信息信号。鉴于二公民具有相同的观察行为，当局对较贫穷和/或事前持不同政见者施加更严厉的惩罚。对富裕公民实施较轻的惩罚，以防止“过度遵守”。财富不平等随着时间的推移而加剧。一些公民成为富裕的“走狗”，而另一些公民则因没收而变得一贫如洗。在国家能力较高的稳定政权中，当局会减少惩罚和/或增加奖励，以允许公民积累财富，从而导致社会整合和长期平衡增长。在能力低下、不稳定的政权中，公民分裂为富有的走狗和贫困的无产阶级。

records.title_en: On the Family Origins of Human Capital Formation: Evidence from Donor Children
records.title_cn: 人力资本形成的家庭起源：来自捐助儿童的证据
records.abstract_en: We introduce a novel strategy to study the intergenerational transmission of human capital skills, net of genetic skill transfers. For this purpose, we use unique Danish data on children conceived through sperm and egg donation in in vitro fertilization treatments to estimate the relationship between child test scores and parental years of schooling. Because the assignment of donors is not selective, these parental schooling estimates allow for a causal nurture interpretation. Once we take account of genes, we find that only the education of mothers matters: the association between father’s education and child test scores (in reading and math) is insignificant and practically zero, whereas the association between mother’s education and child test scores (in reading, not in math) is significant and large, and as large as the association we estimate for mothers of non-donor children.
records.abstract_cn: 我们引入了一种新颖的策略来研究人力资本技能的代际传递（扣除遗传技能转移）。为此，我们使用丹麦独特的体外受精治疗中通过捐赠精子和卵子受孕的儿童数据来估计儿童测试成绩与父母受教育年限之间的关系。由于捐赠者的分配不是选择性的，这些父母受教育程度的估计允许对因果养育进行解释。一旦我们考虑到基因，我们就会发现只有母亲的教育才重要：父亲的教育和孩子的考试成绩（阅读和数学）之间的关联微不足道，而且几乎零，而母亲的教育和孩子的考试成绩（阅读，而不是数学）之间的关联是显着且很大的，与我们对非捐赠儿童的母亲估计的关联一样大。

records.title_en: The Causes of Ukrainian Famine Mortality, 1932–33
records.title_cn: 乌克兰饥荒死亡的原因，1932-33
records.abstract_en: We construct a novel panel dataset for interwar Soviet Union to study the causes of Ukrainian famine mortality (Holodomor) during 1932–3 and document several facts: (1) Ukraine produced enough food in 1932 to avoid famine in Ukraine; (2) 1933 mortality in the Soviet Union was increasing in the pre-famine ethnic Ukrainian population share and (3) was unrelated to food productivity across regions; (4) this pattern exists even outside of Ukraine; (5) migration restrictions exacerbated mortality; (6) actual and planned grain procurement were increasing and actual and planned grain retention (production minus procurement) were decreasing in the ethnic Ukrainian population share across regions. The results imply that anti-Ukrainian bias in Soviet policy contributed to high Ukrainian famine mortality, and that this bias systematically targeted ethnic Ukrainians across the Soviet Union.
records.abstract_cn: 我们为两次世界大战期间的苏联构建了一个新颖的面板数据集，以研究1932-3期间乌克兰饥荒死亡（Holodomor）的原因，并记录了几个事实：（1）乌克兰在1932生产了足够的粮食以避免乌克兰发生饥荒； (2) 1933 苏联的死亡率在饥荒前的乌克兰族人口中所占比例不断增加，并且 (3) 与各地区的粮食生产力无关； (4)这种模式甚至在乌克兰之外也存在； (5) 移民限制加剧了死亡率； (6) 各地区乌克兰族人口比例的实际和计划粮食采购量在增加，实际和计划粮食保留量（产量减去采购量）在减少。结果表明，苏联政策中的反乌克兰偏见导致了乌克兰饥荒的高死亡率，而且这种偏见系统性地针对整个苏联的乌克兰族人。

records.title_en: Electoral Turnovers
records.title_cn: 选举失误
records.abstract_en: In most national elections, voters face a key choice between continuity and change. Electoral turnovers occur when the incumbent candidate or party fails to win reelection. To understand how turnovers affect national outcomes, we study all presidential and parliamentary elections held globally between 1946 and 2018. We document the prevalence of turnovers over time and estimate their effects on economic performance, human development, and the quality of democracy. Using a close-elections regression discontinuity design across countries, we show that turnovers improve several measures of country performance. To explain these positive effects, we explore how electoral turnovers affect leader characteristics, shape policy decisions, reduce perceived corruption, and foster accountability.
records.abstract_cn: 在大多数全国选举中，选民面临着连续性和变革之间的关键选择。当现任候选人或政党未能赢得连任时，就会发生选举更替。为了了解人员更替如何影响国家结果，我们研究了 1946 至 2018 之间全球举行的所有总统和议会选举。我们记录了一段时间内人员流动的普遍情况，并评估了其对经济表现、人类发展和民主质量的影响。通过对各国进行势均力敌的选举回归不连续性设计，我们发现人员更替可以改善衡量国家绩效的多项指标。为了解释这些积极影响，我们探讨了选举更替如何影响领导人特征、影响政策决策、减少腐败并促进问责制。

records.title_en: Fines and Financial Wellbeing
