records.title_cn: 具有近最优速率的动态空间自回归模型的稳健估计
records.abstract_en: Spatial autoregression has been extensively studied in various applications, yet its robust estimation methods have received limited attention. In this work, we introduce two dynamic spatial autoregression (DSAR) models aimed at capturing temporal trends and depicting the asymmetric network effects of the units. For both DSAR models, we propose a truncated Yule–Walker estimation method, which is tailored to achieve robust estimation in the presence of heavy-tailed data. Additionally, we extend this robust estimation procedure to a constrained estimation framework using the Dantzig selector, enabling the identification of sparse network effects observed in real-world applications. Theoretically, the minimax optimality of proposed estimators is derived under certain conditions on the weighting matrix. Empirical studies, including an analysis of financial contagion in the Chinese stock market and the dynamics of live streaming popularity, demonstrate the practical efficacy of our methods.
records.abstract_cn: 空间自回归已在各种应用中得到广泛研究，但其稳健估计方法受到的关注有限。在这项工作中，我们引入了两个动态空间自回归（DSAR）模型，旨在捕捉时间趋势并描绘单元的非对称网络效应。对于这两个DSAR模型，我们提出了一种截断的Yule-Walker估计方法，该方法专门用于在重尾数据存在下实现稳健估计。此外，我们将这一稳健估计程序扩展到使用Dantzig选择器的约束估计框架，从而能够识别现实世界应用中观察到的稀疏网络效应。理论上，在加权矩阵的某些条件下，推导了所提出估计量的极小极大最优性。实证研究，包括对中国股市金融传染和直播流行度动态的分析，证明了我们方法的实际有效性。

records.title_en: Taking advantage of biased proxies for forecast evaluation
records.title_cn: 利用有偏代理变量进行预测评估
records.abstract_en: This paper rehabilitates biased proxies for the assessment of the predictive accuracy of competing forecasts. By relaxing the ubiquitous assumption of proxy unbiasedness adopted in the theoretical and empirical literature, we show how to optimally combine (possibly) biased proxies to maximize the probability of inferring the ranking that would be obtained using the true latent variable, a property that we dub proxy reliability. Our procedure still preserves the robustness of the loss function, in the sense of Patton (2011b), and allows testing for equal predictive accuracy, as in Diebold and Mariano (1995). We demonstrate the usefulness of the method with compelling empirical applications on GDP growth, financial market volatility forecasting, and sea surface temperature of the Niño 3.4 region.
records.abstract_cn: 本文重新评估了有偏代理变量在竞争性预测准确性评估中的作用。通过放宽理论和实证文献中普遍采用的代理变量无偏性假设，我们展示了如何最优地组合（可能）有偏的代理变量，以最大化推断出使用真实潜在变量所获得的排序的概率，这一性质我们称之为代理可靠性。我们的方法仍然保留了损失函数的稳健性，如Patton（2011b）所述，并允许进行预测准确性相等性的检验，如Diebold和Mariano（1995）所述。我们通过关于GDP增长、金融市场波动率预测以及Niño 3.4区域海表温度的令人信服的实证应用，证明了该方法的实用性。

records.title_en: Factor-guided estimation of large covariance matrix function with conditional functional sparsity
records.title_cn: 因子引导的大规模协方差矩阵函数估计与条件函数稀疏性
records.abstract_en: This paper addresses the fundamental task of estimating covariance matrix functions for high-dimensional functional data/functional time series. We consider two functional factor structures encompassing either functional factors with scalar loadings or scalar factors with functional loadings, and postulate functional sparsity on the covariance of idiosyncratic errors after taking out the common unobserved factors. To facilitate estimation, we rely on the spiked matrix model and its functional generalization, and derive some novel asymptotic identifiability results, based on which we develop DIGIT and FPOET estimators under two functional factor models, respectively. Both estimators involve performing associated eigenanalysis to estimate the covariance of common components, followed by adaptive functional thresholding applied to the residual covariance. We also develop functional information criteria for model selection with theoretical guarantees. The convergence rates of involved estimated quantities are respectively established for DIGIT and FPOET estimators. Numerical studies including extensive simulations and a real data application on functional portfolio allocation are conducted to examine the finite-sample performance of the proposed methodology.
records.abstract_cn: 本文处理了高维函数型数据/函数型时间序列中协方差矩阵函数估计的基本任务。我们考虑两种函数因子结构，分别包含具有标量载荷的函数因子或具有函数载荷的标量因子，并假设在去除共同不可观测因子后，特质误差的协方差具有函数稀疏性。为便于估计，我们依赖于尖峰矩阵模型及其函数推广，并推导出一些新颖的渐近可识别性结果，基于此我们分别在两种函数因子模型下开发了DIGIT和FPOET估计量。两种估计量都涉及执行相关的特征分析以估计共同成分的协方差，然后对残差协方差应用自适应函数阈值化。我们还开发了具有理论保证的函数信息准则用于模型选择。所涉及估计量的收敛速率分别针对DIGIT和FPOET估计量建立。数值研究包括广泛的模拟和关于函数型投资组合配置的真实数据应用，以检验所提出方法的有限样本性能。

records.title_en: Fast on-line changepoint detection using heavily-weighted CUSUM and veto-based decision rules
records.title_cn: 基于重加权CUSUM和否决式决策规则的快速在线变点检测
records.abstract_en: We study on-line changepoint detection in the context of a linear regression model, developing two novel contributions. Firstly, we propose a class of heavily weighted statistics based on the CUSUM process of the regression residuals, which are specifically designed to ensure timely detection of breaks occurring early on during the monitoring horizon. Secondly, we develop a class of composite statistics using different weighting schemes; the decision rule to mark a changepoint is based on the largest statistic across the various weights, thus effectively working like a “veto-based” voting mechanism, which ensures fast detection irrespective of the location of the changepoint. Our theory is derived under a very general form of weak dependence, thus being able to apply our tests to virtually all time series encountered in economics, finance, and other applied sciences. Monte Carlo simulations and an application to financial data show that our methodologies are able to control the procedure-wise Type I Error, and have short detection delays in the presence of breaks.
records.abstract_cn: 我们在线性回归模型的背景下研究在线变点检测，提出了两个新颖的贡献。首先，我们提出了一类基于回归残差CUSUM过程的重加权统计量，其专门设计用于确保在监测期间早期发生的断点能够被及时检测。其次，我们开发了一类使用不同加权方案的复合统计量；标记变点的决策规则基于各权重下最大的统计量，从而有效地类似于“否决式”投票机制，确保无论变点位置如何都能快速检测。我们的理论是在非常一般的弱依赖形式下推导的，因此能够将我们的检验应用于经济学、金融学及其他应用科学中遇到的几乎所有时间序列。蒙特卡洛模拟和对金融数据的应用表明，我们的方法能够控制程序层面的第一类错误，并在存在断点时具有较短的检测延迟。

records.title_en: An order-invariant score-driven dynamic factor model
records.title_cn: 一种顺序不变的得分驱动动态因子模型
records.abstract_en: This paper introduces a novel score-driven dynamic factor model designed for filtering cross-sectional co-movements in panels of time series. The model is formulated using elliptical distribution for noise terms, allowing the update of the time-varying parameter to be potentially nonlinear and robust to outliers. We derive stochastic properties of time series generated by the model, such as stationarity and ergodicity, and establish the invertibility of the filter. We prove that the identification of the factors and loadings is achieved by incorporating an orthogonality constraint on the loadings, which is invariant to the order of the series in the panel. Given the nonlinearity of the constraint, we propose exploiting a maximum likelihood estimation on Stiefel manifolds. This approach ensures that the identification constraint is satisfied numerically, enabling joint estimation of the static and time-varying parameters. Furthermore, the asymptotic properties of the constrained estimator are derived. In a series of Monte Carlo experiments, we find evidence of appropriate finite sample properties of the estimator and resulting score filter for the time-varying parameters. We demonstrate the empirical usefulness of our factor model in constructing indices of economic activity from a set of macroeconomic and financial variables during the period 1981–2022. An empirical application highlights the importance of robustness, particularly in the presence of V-shaped recessions, such as the COVID-19 recession.
records.abstract_cn: 本文介绍了一种新颖的得分驱动动态因子模型，旨在过滤时间序列面板中的横截面共同变动。该模型使用椭圆分布来设定噪声项，使得时变参数的更新可能具有非线性并对异常值具有稳健性。我们推导了该模型生成的时间序列的随机性质，如平稳性和遍历性，并建立了滤波器的可逆性。我们证明，通过在对载荷施加正交约束（该约束对面板中序列的顺序不变）可以实现因子和载荷的识别。鉴于约束的非线性，我们提出利用Stiefel流形上的最大似然估计。这种方法确保识别约束在数值上得到满足，从而能够联合估计静态和时变参数。此外，还推导了约束估计量的渐近性质。在一系列蒙特卡洛实验中，我们发现了估计量及由此产生的时变参数得分滤波器具有适当有限样本性质的证据。我们通过从1981-2022期间的一组宏观经济和金融变量构建经济活动指数，展示了我们因子模型的经验实用性。一项实证应用强调了稳健性的重要性，特别是在存在V型衰退（如COVID-19衰退）的情况下。

records.title_en: A unified test for regression discontinuity designs
records.title_cn: 回归不连续设计的一种统一检验
records.abstract_en: Diagnostic tests for regression discontinuity design face a size-control problem. We document a massive over-rejection of the diagnostic restriction among empirical studies in the top five economics journals. At least one diagnostic test was rejected for 19 out of 59 studies, whereas less than 5% of the collected 787 tests rejected the null hypotheses. In other words, one-third of the studies rejected at least one of their diagnostic tests, whereas their underlying identifying restrictions appear plausible. Multiple testing causes this problem because the median number of tests per study was as high as 12. The critical issue is the lack of a formal method to dismiss possibly false rejections caused by the multiple testing problem. Therefore, we offer unified tests to overcome the size-control problem. Our procedure is based on the new joint asymptotic normality of local polynomial mean and density estimates. In simulation studies, our unified tests outperformed the Bonferroni correction. We implement the procedure as an R package rdtest with two empirical examples in its vignettes.
records.abstract_cn: 回归不连续设计的诊断检验面临规模控制问题。我们记录了在五大经济学期刊的实证研究中，诊断限制条件被过度拒绝的严重现象。在59项研究中，有19项至少有一个诊断检验被拒绝，而收集的787项检验中，拒绝原假设的比例不足5%。换言之，三分之一的研究拒绝了至少一项诊断检验，而其潜在识别限制条件看似合理。多重检验导致了这一问题，因为每项研究检验数量的中位数高达12。关键问题在于缺乏一种正式方法来排除由多重检验问题可能导致的错误拒绝。因此，我们提供了统一检验以克服规模控制问题。我们的程序基于局部多项式均值与密度估计的新联合渐近正态性。在模拟研究中，我们的统一检验优于邦费罗尼校正。我们将该程序实现为R包rdtest，并在其插图中提供了两个实证示例。

records.title_en: Bregman model averaging for forecast combination
records.title_cn: 布雷格曼模型平均法用于预测组合
records.abstract_en: We propose a unified model averaging (MA) approach for a broad class of forecasting targets. This approach is established by minimizing an asymptotic risk based on the expected Bregman divergence of a combined forecast, relative to the optimal forecast of the forecasting target, under local(-to-zero) asymptotics. It can be flexibly applied to develop effective MA methods across various forecasting contexts, including but not limited to univariate and multivariate mean forecasting, volatility forecasting, probabilistic forecasting, and density forecasting. As illustrative examples, we present a series of simulation experiments and empirical cases that demonstrate strong numerical performance of our approach in forecasting.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种统一的模型平均（MA）方法，适用于广泛的预测目标类别。该方法通过最小化基于预期布雷格曼散度的组合预测相对于预测目标最优预测的渐近风险来建立，在局部（趋近于零）渐近条件下。它可以灵活应用于各种预测情境中开发有效的MA方法，包括但不限于单变量和多变量均值预测、波动率预测、概率预测以及密度预测。作为示例，我们展示了一系列模拟实验和实证案例，证明了我们的方法在预测中的强大数值表现。

records.title_en: Spatial panel data models with structural change
records.title_cn: 具有结构变化的空间面板数据模型
records.abstract_en: Spatial panel data models have gained widespread application in social sciences, particularly in economics, due to their ability to capture spatial dependencies. However, existing studies on spatial models typically rely on the assumption of parameter stability, which may be overly restrictive given the well-documented prevalence of structural changes in economic relationships. This paper addresses this limitation by proposing and analyzing spatial panel data models that explicitly incorporate structural change. The primary focus of this paper is on a static spatial autoregressive (SAR) panel data model, which we estimate using the quasi-maximum likelihood (QML) method. We establish a comprehensive asymptotic theory for the QML estimators, including proofs of consistency, convergence rates, and limiting distributions, under a large-N and large-T framework. Furthermore, we extend our theoretical framework in two important directions: dynamic spatial panel data models and settings with large-N and fixed-T. Additionally, we develop hypothesis testing procedures for detecting structural change, proposing three sup-type test statistics for this purpose. To validate our theoretical results, we conduct extensive Monte Carlo simulations, which demonstrate that the QML estimators perform well in finite samples. These findings underscore the practical relevance and robustness of our proposed methodology.
records.abstract_cn: 空间面板数据模型因其捕捉空间依赖性的能力，在社会科学，尤其是经济学中得到了广泛应用。然而，现有的空间模型研究通常依赖于参数稳定性的假设，鉴于经济关系中结构变化的普遍性已有充分记录，这一假设可能过于严格。本文通过提出并分析明确纳入结构变化的空间面板数据模型来解决这一局限性。本文的主要焦点是静态空间自回归（SAR）面板数据模型，我们使用拟极大似然（QML）方法进行估计。我们在大N和大T框架下，为QML估计量建立了全面的渐近理论，包括一致性、收敛速度和极限分布的证明。此外，我们在两个重要方向上扩展了我们的理论框架：动态空间面板数据模型以及大N和固定T的设置。另外，我们开发了用于检测结构变化的假设检验程序，为此提出了三种sup型检验统计量。为验证我们的理论结果，我们进行了广泛的蒙特卡洛模拟，结果表明QML估计量在有限样本中表现良好。这些发现强调了所提出方法的实际相关性和稳健性。

records.title_en: Quantile regression with group-level treatments
records.title_cn: 组级处理的 quantile 回归
records.abstract_en: To study distributional effects of group level treatments, Chetverikov et al. (2016) proposed a grouped instrumental variables quantile regression estimator, a quantile extension of the Hausman and Taylor’s 1981 instrumental variables estimator for panel data. However, their approach only allows for heterogenous distributional effects of group-level treatments that correspond to individual-level unobserved characteristics, but not group-level unobserved characteristics. In this article, we propose a quantile regression model that allows for heterogenous distributional effects of group-level treatments associated with both individual-level and group-level unobserved characteristics. We propose two-step quantile regression and instrumental variables quantile regression estimators, depending on whether the group-level treatments are correlated with the group-level unobserved characteristics. Large sample properties are presented and simulation results indicate our estimators perform well in finite samples. We apply our method to study the impact of Chinese import competition on the U.S. local wage distribution, and uncover both significant individual-level and group-level heterogeneity of the group treatment effects.
records.abstract_cn: 为了研究组级处理的分位数效应，Chetverikov 等人（2016）提出了一种分组工具变量分位数回归估计量，这是 Hausman 和 Taylor 的 1981 面板数据工具变量估计量的分位数扩展。然而，他们的方法仅允许与个体层面未观测特征相对应的组级处理的异质性分布效应，而不允许与组层面未观测特征相对应的效应。在本文中，我们提出了一个分位数回归模型，该模型允许与个体层面和组层面未观测特征相关的组级处理的异质性分布效应。我们根据组级处理是否与组层面未观测特征相关，提出了两步分位数回归和工具变量分位数回归估计量。我们给出了大样本性质，模拟结果表明我们的估计量在有限样本中表现良好。我们将我们的方法应用于研究中国进口竞争对美国地方工资分布的影响，并揭示了组级处理效应中显著的个体层面和组层面异质性。

records.title_en: On regression-adjusted imputation estimators of average treatment effects
records.title_cn: 关于平均处理效应的回归调整插补估计量
records.abstract_en: Imputing missing potential outcomes using an estimated regression function is a natural idea for estimating causal effects. In the literature, estimators that combine imputation and regression adjustments are believed to be comparable to augmented inverse probability weighting. Accordingly, people for a long time conjectured that such estimators, while avoiding directly constructing the weights, are also doubly robust (Imbens, 2004; Stuart, 2010). Generalizing an earlier result of the authors (Lin et al., 2023), this paper formalizes this conjecture, showing that a large class of regression-adjusted imputation methods are indeed doubly robust for estimating average treatment effects. In addition, they are provably semiparametrically efficient as long as both the density and regression models are correctly specified. Notable examples of imputation methods covered by our theory include kernel matching, (weighted) nearest neighbor matching, local linear matching, and (honest) random forests.
records.abstract_cn: 使用估计的回归函数来插补缺失的潜在结果，是估计因果效应的一种自然思路。文献中，结合插补和回归调整的估计量被认为与增强逆概率加权相当。因此，长期以来人们推测这类估计量在避免直接构造权重的同時，也具有双重稳健性（Imbens, 2004; Stuart, 2010）。本文推广了作者先前的结果（Lin et al., 2023），正式化了这一猜想，表明一大类回归调整插补方法在估计平均处理效应时确实具有双重稳健性。此外，只要密度和回归模型均被正确设定，这些方法可证明是半参数有效的。我们的理论所涵盖的插补方法的显著例子包括核匹配、（加权）最近邻匹配、局部线性匹配以及（诚实的）随机森林。

records.title_en: Shrinkage estimation of spatial panel data models with multiple structural breaks and a multifactor error structure
records.title_cn: 具有多重结构突变和多重因子误差结构的空间面板数据模型的收缩估计
records.abstract_en: This study investigates spatial panel data models with a multifactor error structure and multiple structural breaks occurring in the coefficients of both spatial lagged and explanatory variables. While extensive research has addressed cross-sectional dependence in panel data, including approaches that integrate spatial and factor structures within a single framework, few studies account for time-varying model parameters and achieving consistent estimation remains a significant challenge. To address the dual challenges of endogeneity and time heterogeneity, we propose a novel penalized generalized method of moments estimation with common correlated effects (PGMM-CCEX). Specifically, this method addresses the endogeneity issue by utilizing the cross-sectional averages of regressors as factor proxies when constructing the internal instrumental variables, while employing adaptive group fused Lasso to detect multiple structural breaks. The PGMM-CCEX method consistently estimates both the number of breaks and their locations. Furthermore, the post-PGMM-CCEX regime-specific coefficient estimates are consistent and asymptotically follow a normal distribution. Notably, the method remains valid even when factor loadings vary over time, whether synchronously or asynchronously with the parameters of interest. Monte Carlo simulations confirm the satisfactory finite-sample performance of the proposed PGMM-CCEX method. Finally, we apply our method to analyze cross-country economic growth across 106 countries from 1970 to 2019, revealing the time-varying influence of key economic factors on growth dynamics.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了具有多重因子误差结构以及空间滞后和解释变量系数中发生多重结构突变的空间面板数据模型。尽管已有大量研究处理面板数据中的横截面依赖性，包括在单一框架内整合空间和因子结构的方法，但很少有研究考虑时变模型参数，且实现一致估计仍是一个重大挑战。为应对内生性和时间异质性的双重挑战，我们提出了一种新颖的带共同相关效应的惩罚广义矩估计方法（PGMM-CCEX）。具体而言，该方法通过利用回归元的横截面平均值作为因子代理来构建内部工具变量，从而解决内生性问题，同时采用自适应组融合Lasso来检测多重结构突变。PGMM-CCEX方法能够一致地估计突变数量及其位置。此外，PGMM-CCEX后的制度特定系数估计是一致的，并且渐近服从正态分布。值得注意的是，即使因子载荷随时间变化，无论是与感兴趣参数同步还是异步变化，该方法仍然有效。蒙特卡洛模拟证实了所提出的PGMM-CCEX方法具有良好的有限样本性能。最后，我们将该方法应用于分析从1970年到2019年间106个国家的跨国经济增长，揭示了关键经济因素对增长动态的时变影响。

records.title_en: Identification and inference for semiparametric single index transformation models
records.title_cn: 半参数单指数变换模型的识别与推断
records.abstract_en: This paper considers a semiparametric single index model in which the dependent variable is subject to a nonparametric transformation. The model has the form G0(Y)=g0(X⊤θ0)+e, where X is a random vector of regressors, Y is the dependent variable and e is the random noise, the monotonic function G0, the smooth function g0 and the index vector θ0 are all unknown. This model is quite general in the sense that it nests many popular regression models as special cases. We first propose identification strategies for the three unknown quantities, based on which estimators are then constructed. The kernel density weighted average derivative estimator of δ (proportional to θ0) has a V-statistic representation and its asymptotical normality is established under the small bandwidth asymptotics. The kernel estimator of the transformation function G0 is a functional of the conditional distribution estimator of Y given X⊤θ0 and is shown to be n-consistent and asymptotically normal. The sieve estimator of g0 is shown to enjoy the standard nonparametric asymptotic properties. A specification test for the single index structure and extension to allow for endogeneous regressors are also developed. In addition, data-driven choices of the smoothing parameters are discussed. Simulation results illustrate the nice finite sample performance of the proposed estimators and specification test. An empirical application to studying the impact of family income on child achievement demonstrates the practical merits of the proposed model.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考虑一个半参数单指数模型，其中因变量受到非参数变换的影响。模型形式为 G0(Y)=G0(X⊤θ0)+e，其中X是回归元随机向量，Y是因变量，e是随机噪声，单调函数G0、光滑函数G0和指数向量θ0均未知。该模型非常通用，因为它将许多流行的回归模型作为特例包含在内。我们首先提出三个未知量的识别策略，并在此基础上构建估计量。δ（与θ0成比例）的核密度加权平均导数估计量具有V统计量表示，并在小带宽渐近性下建立了其渐近正态性。变换函数G0的核估计量是给定X⊤θ0条件下Y的条件分布估计量的泛函，并证明其具有n一致性和渐近正态性。G0的筛估计量被证明具有标准的非参数渐近性质。还开发了针对单指数结构的规范检验以及允许内生回归元的扩展。此外，讨论了平滑参数的数据驱动选择。模拟结果展示了所提出估计量和规范检验的良好有限样本性能。一个关于家庭收入对儿童成就影响的经验应用证明了所提出模型的实际价值。

records.title_en: Support vector decision making
records.title_cn: 支持向量决策
records.abstract_en: The paper develops a support vector machine (SVM) for binary decision-making within a utility framework. Given an information set, a decision-maker first predicts a binary outcome and then selects a binary action based on this prediction to maximize expected utility, where the utility function can depend on the action taken, observable covariates, and the binary outcome subsequently realized. The proposed maximum utility SVM differs from the traditional SVM in four key aspects. First, as a conceptual innovation, it incorporates the optimal cutoff function as a separate and special covariate. Second, there is a sign restriction on this special covariate. Third, it accounts for the dependence of the utility-induced loss on both the covariates and the binary outcome. Finally, it allows the margin to differ across different classes of outcomes. The paper proves that the proposed method is Bayes-consistent under the maximum utility criterion and establishes a finite-sample generalization bound. A simulation study shows that the proposed method outperforms existing methods under the data-generating processes considered in the literature.
records.abstract_cn: 本文开发了一种支持向量机 (SVM)，用于在实用程序框架内进行二元决策。给定信息集，决策者首先预测二元结果，然后根据该预测选择二元操作以最大化预期效用，其中效用函数可以取决于所采取的操作、可观察的协变量以及随后实现的二元结果。所提出的最大效用 SVM 在四个关键方面与传统 SVM 不同。首先，作为概念创新，它将最优截止函数作为单独且特殊的协变量纳入其中。其次，这个特殊协变量有符号限制。第三，它解释了效用引起的损失对协变量和二元结果的依赖性。最后，它允许不同类别的结果之间存在差异。论文证明了该方法在最大效用准则下是贝叶斯一致的，并建立了有限样本泛化界限。模拟研究表明，在文献中考虑的数据生成过程中，所提出的方法优于现有方法。

records.title_en: A robust residual-based test for structural changes in factor models
records.title_cn: 因子模型中结构变化的稳健残差检验
records.abstract_en: In this paper, we propose an easy-to-implement residual-based specification testing procedure for detecting structural changes in factor models, which is powerful against both smooth and abrupt structural changes with unknown break dates. The proposed test is robust to the over-specified number of factors, and serially and cross-sectionally correlated error processes. A new central limit theorem is given for the quadratic forms of panel data with dependence over both dimensions, thereby filling a gap in the literature. We establish the asymptotic properties of the proposed test statistic, and accordingly develop a simulation-based scheme to select critical value in order to improve finite sample performance. Through extensive simulations and a real-world application, we confirm our theoretical results and demonstrate that the proposed test exhibits desirable size and power in practice.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种易于实施的基于残差的规范检验程序，用于检测因子模型中的结构变化，该检验对未知断点的平滑和突变结构变化均具有功效。所提出的检验对过度设定的因子数量以及序列相关和横截面相关的误差过程具有稳健性。我们为面板数据中两个维度均存在依赖性的二次形式给出了新的中心极限定理，从而填补了文献中的空白。我们建立了所提出检验统计量的渐近性质，并据此开发了一种基于模拟的选择临界值的方法，以提高有限样本性能。通过广泛的模拟和实际应用，我们证实了理论结果，并表明所提出的检验在实践中具有理想的水平和功效。

records.title_en: Hedonic prices and quality adjusted price indices powered by AI
records.title_cn: 基于人工智能的特征价格与质量调整价格指数
records.abstract_en: We develop empirical models that efficiently process large amounts of unstructured product data (text, images, prices, quantities) to produce accurate hedonic price estimates and derived indices. To achieve this, we generate abstract product attributes (or “features”) from descriptions and images using deep neural networks. These attributes are then used to estimate the hedonic price function. To demonstrate the effectiveness of this approach, we apply the models to Amazon’s data for first-party apparel sales, and estimate hedonic prices. The resulting models have a very high out-of-sample predictive accuracy, with R2 ranging from 80% to 90%. Finally, we construct the AI-based hedonic Fisher price index, chained at the year-over-year frequency, and contrast it with the CPI and other electronic indices.
records.abstract_cn: 我们开发了能够高效处理大量非结构化产品数据（文本、图像、价格、数量）的实证模型，以生成准确的特征价格估计及由此推导的指数。为实现这一目标，我们利用深度神经网络从描述和图像中生成抽象的产品属性（或“特征”）。随后，这些属性被用于估计特征价格函数。为证明该方法的有效性，我们将模型应用于亚马逊自营服装销售数据，并估计特征价格。所得模型具有极高的样本外预测精度，R2介于80%至90%之间。最后，我们构建了基于人工智能的特征Fisher价格指数，按年度同比频率进行链式连接，并将其与CPI及其他电子指数进行对比。

records.title_en: High dimensional binary choice model with unknown heteroskedasticity or instrumental variables
records.title_cn: 具有未知异方差性或工具变量的高维二元选择模型
records.abstract_en: This paper proposes a new method for estimating high-dimensional binary choice models. We consider a semiparametric model that places no distributional assumptions on the error term, allows for heteroskedastic errors, and permits endogenous regressors. Our approaches extend the special regressor estimator originally proposed by Lewbel (2000). This estimator becomes impractical in high-dimensional settings due to the curse of dimensionality associated with high-dimensional conditional density estimation. To overcome this challenge, we introduce an innovative data-driven dimension reduction method for nonparametric kernel estimators, which constitutes the main contribution of this work. The method combines distance covariance-based screening with cross-validation (CV) procedures, making special regressor estimation feasible in high dimensions. Using this new feasible conditional density estimator, we address variable and moment (instrumental variable) selection problems for these models. We apply penalized least squares (LS) and generalized method of moments (GMM) estimators with an L1 penalty. A comprehensive analysis of the oracle and asymptotic properties of these estimators is provided. Finally, through Monte Carlo simulations and an empirical study on the migration intentions of rural Chinese residents, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed methods in finite sample settings.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种估计高维二元选择模型的新方法。我们考虑一个半参数模型，该模型对误差项不做分布假设，允许异方差误差，并允许内生回归变量。我们的方法扩展了Lewbel（2000）最初提出的特殊回归变量估计量。由于高维条件密度估计带来的维度灾难，该估计量在高维设置中变得不切实际。为克服这一挑战，我们引入了一种创新的数据驱动降维方法用于非参数核估计量，这是本研究的主要贡献。该方法将基于距离协方差的筛选与交叉验证（CV）程序相结合，使得特殊回归变量估计在高维下可行。利用这一新的可行条件密度估计量，我们解决了这些模型的变量和矩（工具变量）选择问题。我们应用带L1惩罚的惩罚最小二乘（LS）和广义矩方法（GMM）估计量。对这些估计量的预言性质和渐近性质进行了全面分析。最后，通过蒙特卡洛模拟和对中国农村居民迁移意愿的实证研究，我们证明了所提方法在有限样本设置中的有效性。

records.title_en: Deep learning based residuals in non-linear factor models: Precision matrix estimation of returns with low signal-to-noise ratio
records.title_cn: 非线性因子模型中基于深度学习的残差：低信噪比下收益率的精度矩阵估计
records.abstract_en: This paper introduces a consistent estimator and rate of convergence for the precision matrix of asset returns in large portfolios using a non-linear factor model within the deep learning framework. Our estimator remains valid even in low signal-to-noise ratio environments typical for financial markets and is compatible with the weak factor framework. Our theoretical analysis establishes uniform bounds on expected estimation risk based on deep neural networks for an expanding number of assets. Additionally, we provide a new consistent data-dependent estimator of error covariance in deep neural networks. Our models demonstrate superior accuracy in extensive simulations and the empirical application.
records.abstract_cn: 本文在深度学习框架内，利用非线性因子模型，为大规模投资组合中资产收益率的精度矩阵引入了一致估计量及其收敛速率。我们的估计量即使在金融市场典型的低信噪比环境下依然有效，并且与弱因子框架兼容。我们的理论分析基于深度神经网络，为不断增加的资产数量建立了预期估计风险的统一界限。此外，我们提供了深度神经网络中误差协方差的一种新的数据依赖一致估计量。我们的模型在广泛的模拟和实证应用中展示了优越的准确性。

records.title_en: Optimal unemployment insurance with multiple applications
records.title_cn: 多重申请下的最优失业保险
records.abstract_en: This paper examines how unemployment transfers should be allocated over the business cycle. When risk-averse workers can submit multiple applications, the optimal UI policy is countercyclical. In contrast, optimal policy in a standard search model featuring one-to-one matching is procyclical. In the latter, more generous UI during a downturn discourages search effort, dampening job creation. In the former, decreased search effort aids job creation. Because firms cannot coordinate and commit to not making the same worker an offer, lower search effort by reducing the number of applications sent mitigates this coordination friction. This in turn boosts job creation incentives, supporting employment outcomes.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了失业转移支付应如何在整个商业周期内进行分配。当风险规避的工人可以提交多重申请时，最优失业保险政策是逆周期的。相比之下，标准搜索模型中一对一的匹配所对应的最优政策则是顺周期的。在后一种情况下，经济衰退期间更为慷慨的失业保险会抑制搜索努力，从而阻碍就业创造。在前一种情况下，减少搜索努力有助于就业创造。由于企业无法协调并承诺不向同一工人发出录用通知，降低搜索努力通过减少发送的申请数量来缓解这种协调摩擦。这反过来又增强了就业创造的激励，支持了就业结果。

records.title_en: Negative nominal interest rates and monetary policy
records.title_cn: 负名义利率与货币政策
records.abstract_en: How much can central banks reduce nominal interest rates? Can the lower bound be controlled by monetary policy? If so, should central banks reduce it to implement negative interest rates? I construct a model with multiple means of payment where the costs of holding paper currency effectively reduce its rate of return, creating a negative effective lower bound on interest rates. I find that central banks can reduce this lower bound with a non-par exchange rate between currency and bank reserves, but doing so raises currency-holding costs for individuals, leading to welfare losses. Moreover, implementing a negative rate by reducing the lower bound has no benefits because this policy combination lowers both the rate of return on currency and the interest rate on financial assets, leaving relative interest rates unchanged.
records.abstract_cn: 中央银行能将名义利率降低多少？下限能否由货币政策控制？如果能，中央银行是否应降低下限以实施负利率？我构建了一个包含多种支付手段的模型，其中持有纸币的成本有效降低了其收益率，从而形成了负的有效利率下限。我发现，中央银行可以通过货币与银行准备金之间的非平价汇率来降低这一下限，但这样做会增加个人持有货币的成本，导致福利损失。此外，通过降低下限来实施负利率并无益处，因为这种政策组合同时降低了货币的收益率和金融资产的利率，使得相对利率保持不变。

records.title_en: A model of expenditure shocks
records.title_cn: 支出冲击模型
records.abstract_en: We introduce a new quantitative model of household expenditure shocks to rationalize the common anecdote of a low-income and low-liquidity household that uses additional income to save (repay debt) rather than consume. Our model also rationalizes key features of the joint dynamics of household-level consumption and income, including our finding that consumption is volatile yet disconnected from income, especially for households experiencing episodes of high consumption. The key feature of our model is stochastic consumption thresholds that yield large utility costs if violated. The stochastic thresholds increase the welfare cost of income fluctuations by an order of magnitude.
records.abstract_cn: 我们引入了一个新的家庭支出冲击定量模型，以合理化一个常见的轶事：低收入和低流动性家庭使用额外收入进行储蓄（偿还债务）而非消费。我们的模型还合理化了家庭层面消费和收入联合动态的关键特征，包括我们的发现：消费波动大且与收入脱节，尤其是对于经历高消费时期的家庭。我们模型的关键特征是随机消费阈值，如果违反这些阈值会产生巨大的效用成本。随机阈值将收入波动的福利成本提高了一个数量级。

records.title_en: Committed to flexible fiscal rules
records.title_cn: 致力于灵活的财政规则
records.abstract_en: We study the implications of fiscal rules for macroeconomic stabilization when countries are hit by adverse exogenous shocks. Exploiting the unpredictability of natural disasters, we document that economies with a fiscal rule absorb these shocks better than those without: the responses of GDP and private demand are significantly higher. This difference is coupled with more expansionary fiscal policy and hinges on fiscal space. We analyze the interaction of rule flexibility and rule tightness in a quantitative model of sovereign default that exerts strong market discipline on governments conditional on disaster shocks. The results show potential welfare gains and a countercyclical fiscal response to adverse disaster shocks in the presence of tight rules and escape clauses.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了当国家遭受不利外生冲击时，财政规则对宏观经济稳定的影响。利用自然灾害的不可预测性，我们记录了实行财政规则的经济体比没有实行财政规则的经济体更好地吸收这些冲击：GDP和私人需求的响应显著更高。这种差异伴随着更具扩张性的财政政策，并取决于财政空间。我们在一个主权违约的定量模型中分析了规则灵活性与规则严格性的相互作用，该模型在灾害冲击条件下对政府施加了强大的市场纪律。结果表明，在严格规则和例外条款存在的情况下，面对不利灾害冲击，潜在福利收益和逆周期财政响应是可能的。

records.title_en: International trade and macroeconomic dynamics with sanctions
records.title_cn: 国际制裁下的国际贸易与宏观经济动态
records.abstract_en: We develop a framework combining dynamic, intertemporal choices of general-equilibrium macro models with microfoundations of modern trade theory to study sanctions. In a two-country, two-sector setup, Home holds a comparative advantage in producing differentiated consumption goods via heterogeneous firms with endogenous entry, while Foreign in homogeneous intermediate goods from a fixed number of firms. Sanctions include trade bans and financial restrictions excluding particular Foreign agents from markets. In our model, sanctions reallocate resources across and within countries, affecting production, exchange rates, and welfare, with larger welfare losses when targeting sectors of comparative disadvantage. Focusing only on long-run outcomes, overlooking initial dynamics, inaccurately assesses welfare impacts. Sanctions weaken international comovement and fragment markets but leave business cycles intact.
records.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个框架，将一般均衡宏观模型的动态跨期选择与现代贸易理论的微观基础相结合，以研究制裁问题。在两国、两部门设定中，本国通过具有内生进入的异质性企业在生产差异化消费品方面拥有比较优势，而外国则从固定数量的企业生产同质中间产品。制裁包括贸易禁令和金融限制，将特定的外国代理人排除在市场之外。在我们的模型中，制裁在国家内部和国家之间重新配置资源，影响生产、汇率和福利，当针对比较劣势部门时，福利损失更大。仅关注长期结果，忽视初始动态，会不准确地评估福利影响。制裁削弱了国际联动并使市场碎片化，但商业周期保持不变。

records.title_en: What’s driving the decline in entrepreneurship?
records.title_cn: 是什么在推动创业活动的下降？
records.abstract_en: Why has there been a steady decline in entrepreneurship in the US in recent decades? To answer this question, I develop a general equilibrium occupation choice model and combine it with data on these choices. Skill-biased technical change can account for much of the decline in the relative entrepreneurship rate of more educated people, but cannot explain the decline in the aggregate level of entrepreneurship. The major factors in the decline in the share of people who are entrepreneurs, the firm entry rate, and the size of the entrepreneur sector are rising entry costs and outsized productivity gains by large non-entrepreneur firms.
records.abstract_cn: 为什么近几十年来美国的创业活动持续下降？为了回答这个问题，我构建了一个一般均衡的职业选择模型，并将其与这些选择的数据相结合。技能偏向的技术进步可以解释受教育程度较高人群相对创业率下降的大部分原因，但无法解释总体创业水平的下降。导致创业者比例、企业进入率和创业者部门规模下降的主要因素是进入成本的上升以及大型非创业企业生产力的超常增长。

records.title_en: Why hours worked decline less after technology shocks?
records.title_cn: 为什么技术冲击后工作时间下降幅度减小？
records.abstract_en: The contractionary effect of technology shocks on hours gradually vanishes over time in OECD countries. To rationalize the decline in hours and its disappearance, we use a VAR-based decomposition of technology shocks into symmetric and asymmetric technology improvements. While hours decline dramatically when technology improves at the same rate across sectors, hours significantly increase when technology improvements occur at different rates. Because they are primarily driven by symmetric technology improvements, permanent technology shocks drive down total hours. Such a decline progressively vanishes due to the growing importance of asymmetric technology shocks. To reach these two conclusions, we simulate a two-sector model which can reproduce the contractionary effect on hours once the economy is internationally open and we allow for production factors’ mobility costs, factor-biased technological change, and home bias. To account for the vanishing decline in hours, we have to let the share of asymmetric technology shocks increase over time.
records.abstract_cn: 在OECD国家，技术冲击对工作时间的紧缩效应随时间逐渐消失。为了解释工作时间的下降及其消失，我们使用基于VAR的分解方法，将技术冲击分解为对称性和非对称性技术进步。当各部门以相同速率技术进步时，工作时间显著下降；而当技术进步速率不同时，工作时间显著增加。由于永久性技术冲击主要由对称性技术进步驱动，它们导致总工作时间下降。这种下降因非对称性技术冲击的重要性日益增加而逐渐消失。为得出这两个结论，我们模拟了一个两部门模型，该模型能在经济开放且允许生产要素流动成本、要素偏向型技术变革和本土偏好存在的情况下，重现对工作时间的紧缩效应。为了解释工作时间下降的消失，我们必须让非对称性技术冲击的份额随时间增加。

records.title_en: Low interest rates, capital misallocation and welfare
records.title_cn: 低利率、资本错配与福利
records.abstract_en: This paper studies how the real interest rate affects the (mis)allocation of capital in a small open economy characterized by asymmetric information in the financial market. Low interest rates allow low-productivity firms to enter the pool of borrowers, imposing an information externality that negatively impacts highly productive firms and forces them to reduce their investments. This suggests that, in some cases, although lowering the interest rate can increase total investment and output, it does not necessarily improve welfare. The results align with recent empirical evidence highlighting the adverse effects of low interest rates in southern European countries.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了在金融市场存在信息不对称的小型开放经济中，实际利率如何影响资本的（错误）配置。低利率使得低生产率企业进入借款人群体，施加了一种信息外部性，对高生产率企业产生负面影响，并迫使它们减少投资。这表明，在某些情况下，尽管降低利率可以增加总投资和产出，但并不一定改善福利。研究结果与近期强调南欧国家低利率不利影响的实证证据相一致。

records.title_en: Regional content requirements and market power: Lessons from CUSFTA
records.title_cn: 区域含量要求与市场势力：来自CUSFTA的启示
records.abstract_en: Focusing on the 1989 Canada-United States Free Trade Agreement (CUSFTA), we examine how regional content requirements in Free Trade Areas (FTAs) affect competition and prices in intermediate goods markets. Content requirements in FTAs shelter firms from competition more than an equivalent trade-protection tariff would. We document patterns in US industry-level census data and Canadian product-level export data that align with theoretical predictions: stricter and binding content requirements are linked to higher prices and more firm entry. These results underscore the role of content requirements in shaping market structure and market power, with implications for the choice of preferential trade arrangements.
records.abstract_cn: 聚焦于1989年加拿大-美国自由贸易协定（CUSFTA），我们研究了自由贸易区（FTAs）中的区域含量要求如何影响中间品市场的竞争和价格。FTA中的含量要求比等效的贸易保护关税更能庇护企业免受竞争。我们记录了美国行业级普查数据和加拿大产品级出口数据中的模式，这些模式与理论预测一致：更严格且具有约束力的含量要求与更高的价格和更多的企业进入相关联。这些结果强调了含量要求在塑造市场结构和市场势力中的作用，对优惠贸易安排的选择具有启示意义。

records.title_en: Banks’ market capital and the international risk taking channel of US monetary policy
records.title_cn: 银行市场资本与美国货币政策的国际风险承担渠道
records.abstract_en: We demonstrate that banks’ market capital is a key determinant of the strength of the international risk-taking channel of US monetary policy. The impact of US monetary policy on international risk-taking is greater for banks with low market capital. The effect of market capital exists in addition to the previously documented effect of regulatory capital, which works in the opposite direction. As a result, the international risk-taking channel of monetary policy is most powerful for banks that have a combination of high regulatory capital and low market capital.
records.abstract_cn: 我们证明银行的市场资本是美国货币政策国际风险承担渠道强度的关键决定因素。美国货币政策对国际风险承担的影响对于市场资本较低的银行更为显著。市场资本的作用在先前记录的监管资本作用之外存在，且两者方向相反。因此，货币政策国际风险承担渠道对于同时具有高监管资本和低市场资本的银行最为强大。

records.title_en: Whatever it takes to understand a central banker — Embedding their words using neural networks
records.title_cn: 不惜一切代价理解央行行长——利用神经网络嵌入其言辞
records.abstract_en: Dictionary-based methods represent the most commonly used approach for quantifying the qualitative information from (central bank) communication. In this paper, we propose machine learning models that generates embeddings from words and documents. Embeddings are multidimensional numerical text representations that capture the underlying semantic relationships within text. Using a novel corpus of 22,000 documents from 128 central banks, we generate the first domain-specific embeddings for central bank communication that outperform dictionaries and existing embeddings on tasks such as predicting monetary policy shocks. We further demonstrate the efficacy of our embeddings by constructing an index that tracks the extent to which Federal Reserve communications align with an inflation-targeting stance. Our empirical results indicate that deviations from inflation-targeting language substantially affect market-based expectations and influence monetary policy decisions, significantly reducing the inflation response parameter in an estimated Taylor rule.
records.abstract_cn: 基于词典的方法是对（央行）沟通中的定性信息进行量化的最常用方法。在本文中，我们提出了从单词和文档中生成嵌入的机器学习模型。嵌入是多维数值文本表示，能够捕捉文本中潜在的语义关系。利用来自128家央行的22,000份文档的新语料库，我们生成了首个针对央行沟通的领域特定嵌入，这些嵌入在预测货币政策冲击等任务上优于词典和现有嵌入。我们进一步通过构建一个追踪美联储沟通与通胀目标立场一致程度的指数，证明了我们嵌入的有效性。我们的实证结果表明，偏离通胀目标语言的措辞显著影响市场预期并影响货币政策决策，显著降低了估计的泰勒规则中的通胀反应参数。

records.title_en: Networks in trade — Evidence from the legacy of the Hanseatic league
records.title_cn: 贸易中的网络——来自汉萨同盟遗产的证据
records.abstract_en: We study trade networks following the decline of the Hanseatic League, using a novel trade data set that covers cities and captains in Northern Europe over 190 years. By the time of its dissolution in 1669, trade on former Hansa routes is within predictions from a gravity framework. However, the Hansa continue to shape the composition of trade: Trade between cities in the Hanseatic network continues to be facilitated by Hanseatic captains for centuries. Our paper highlights the long-run stability of commercial and social networks, which persist when other economic effects do not.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用一个覆盖北欧城市和船长、跨越190年的新颖贸易数据集，研究汉萨同盟衰落后的贸易网络。到1669年同盟解散时，前汉萨航线上的贸易符合引力模型的预测。然而，汉萨同盟继续塑造贸易的构成：汉萨网络内城市间的贸易在数世纪内持续由汉萨船长促进。我们的论文强调了商业和社会网络的长期稳定性，这些网络在其他经济效应消失时依然存在。

records.title_en: Overborrowing and systemic externalities in the business cycle under imperfect information
records.title_cn: 不完全信息下商业周期中的过度借贷与系统性外部性
records.abstract_en: We study the interaction between imperfect information and financial frictions and their role in financial crises in small open economies. We use a model where households observe income growth but cannot distinguish whether the underlying income shocks are permanent or transitory, and borrowing is subject to a collateral constraint. We show that the combination of imperfect information and a borrowing constraint is a significant source of economic instability. Optimal macroprudential policy helps stabilize the economy by actively taxing debt. Furthermore, the interaction between the collateral constraint and the information friction reshapes the correlation between the optimal tax and the underlying components of income.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了不完全信息与金融摩擦之间的相互作用及其在小开放经济体金融危机中的作用。我们使用一个模型，其中家庭观察收入增长但无法区分潜在的收入冲击是永久性的还是暂时性的，并且借款受到抵押品约束。我们表明，不完全信息与借款约束的结合是经济不稳定的重要来源。最优宏观审慎政策通过积极对债务征税有助于稳定经济。此外，抵押品约束与信息摩擦之间的相互作用重塑了最优税收与收入潜在组成部分之间的相关性。

records.title_en: Sticky capital controls
records.title_cn: 粘性资本管制
records.abstract_en: With a new quarterly dataset on the intensive margin of priced-based capital controls, complemented with extensive measures (restrictions, prohibitions, and authorizations) constructed using text analysis, we document that capital controls are “sticky”. Changes to price-based controls do not occur frequently; and when they do, they display high autocorrelation. Extensive measures also show considerable persistence. We then augment a model of capital controls relying on pecuniary externalities with an (S,s) cost of implementing such policies, and illustrate how this friction goes a long way toward bringing the model closer to the data. When the extended model is calibrated to the countries in the new dataset, we find that the size of these costs is large, substantially reducing the welfare-enhancing effects of capital controls in the frictionless Ramsey benchmark without (S,s) costs. This calls for a richer set of policy constraints when modeling the optimal use of capital controls.
records.abstract_cn: 利用一个新的关于基于价格的资本管制集约边际的季度数据集，并辅以通过文本分析构建的广泛措施（限制、禁止和授权），我们记录了资本管制具有“粘性”。基于价格的管制变动并不频繁；而且一旦变动，它们表现出高度的自相关性。广泛措施也显示出相当的持续性。然后，我们在一个依赖金钱外部性的资本管制模型中加入了实施此类政策的（S,s）成本，并说明这种摩擦如何大大有助于使模型更接近数据。当扩展模型被校准到新数据集中的国家时，我们发现这些成本的规模很大，显著降低了在没有（S,s）成本的无摩擦拉姆齐基准中资本管制的福利增强效应。这要求在建模资本管制的最优使用时考虑更丰富的政策约束集。

records.title_en: The role of currencies in external balance sheets
records.title_cn: 货币在外部资产负债表中的作用
records.abstract_en: This paper constructs a dataset on the currency composition of external balance sheets for 50 countries from 1990 to 2020. Our findings reveal the persistent dominance of the US dollar and euro in global external positions, while many emerging markets have shifted from short to long foreign-currency exposures. This transformation, marking a departure from the “original sin” phenomenon, reflects reduced foreign-currency debt liabilities and increased foreign-currency assets. We introduce financial exchange rate indices to measure valuation effects, documenting that substantial wealth transfers across countries mitigated global imbalances during the 2008 financial crisis, yet exacerbated them during the COVID-19 shock.
records.abstract_cn: 本文构建了一个涵盖1990年至2020年50个国家外部资产负债表货币构成的数据集。我们的研究结果显示，美元和欧元在全球外部头寸中持续占据主导地位，而许多新兴市场已从外币空头头寸转向多头头寸。这一转变标志着对“原罪”现象的背离，反映了外币债务负债的减少和外币资产的增加。我们引入金融汇率指数来衡量估值效应，记录到2008年金融危机期间，跨国界的大量财富转移缓解了全球失衡，但在COVID-19冲击期间却加剧了这种失衡。

records.title_en: Industrial development and trade policy uncertainty: Evidence from China’s WTO accession
records.title_cn: 产业发展与贸易政策不确定性：来自中国加入WTO的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper studies how the elimination of trade policy uncertainty around WTO accession affects China’s manufacturing sector. We find a strong cross-sectional relationship between reduced uncertainty and input and output expansion by industry. The growth effect is particularly pronounced in the most labor-intensive industries in line with China’s comparative advantage, and more so in regions with lower shipping costs and a large manufacturing base. A decomposition reveals that the industry expansion can be traced to the extensive margin of new firm entry—consistent with firm-level evidence showing only a modest response among incumbent firms.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了加入WTO后贸易政策不确定性的消除如何影响中国制造业。我们发现，不确定性降低与行业投入和产出扩张之间存在强烈的横截面关系。增长效应在符合中国比较优势的最劳动密集型行业中尤为显著，并且在运输成本较低和制造业基础较大的地区更为明显。分解分析显示，行业扩张可归因于新企业进入的扩展边际——这与企业层面的证据一致，表明现有企业的反应较为温和。

records.title_en: Commodity prices and the US dollar
records.title_cn: 大宗商品价格与美元
records.abstract_en: In the aftermath of the Covid pandemic rising commodity prices went hand-in-hand with a strengthening US dollar. This was a sharp contrast to the usual relationship between commodity prices and the dollar. This paper presents evidence that post-Covid correlation patterns could become more common in the future. This conclusion rests on two observations. First, the US dollar exhibits a close and stable relationship with the US terms of trade. Second, the United States’ shift from being a net oil importer to a net oil exporter means that higher commodity prices now tend to raise the US terms of trade, rather than lowering them. Changes in the relationship between commodity prices and the US dollar will have implications for commodity exporters and importers alike.
records.abstract_cn: 在新冠疫情之后，大宗商品价格上涨与美元走强相伴而行。这与大宗商品价格与美元之间通常的关系形成鲜明对比。本文提供的证据表明，疫情后的相关性模式在未来可能变得更加普遍。这一结论基于两个观察。第一，美元与美国贸易条件表现出紧密且稳定的关系。第二，美国从石油净进口国转变为净出口国，意味着现在大宗商品价格上涨往往提升而非降低美国的贸易条件。大宗商品价格与美元之间关系的变化将对大宗商品出口国和进口国都产生影响。

records.title_en: Output divergence in fixed exchange rate regimes
records.title_cn: 固定汇率制度下的产出分化
records.abstract_en: This paper presents empirical evidence for the violation of nominal exchange regime neutrality. We find that fixing the exchange rate is associated with real output losses among countries with a high pre-peg inflation rate. In particular, ten years after fixing the exchange rate a country with a +1 percentage point (ppt) pre-peg wage inflation differential has a 2% lower real GDP per capita level and a 1% lower TFP level. The tradable sector is more affected than the non-tradable sector, which accords with the former’s greater exposure to international arbitrage.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提供了名义汇率制度中性被违背的经验证据。我们发现，在钉住汇率前通胀率较高的国家，固定汇率与实际产出损失相关联。具体而言，在固定汇率十年后，钉住前工资通胀差异每高出+1个百分点（ppt）的国家，其实际人均GDP水平低2%，全要素生产率（TFP）水平低1%。可贸易部门比不可贸易部门受到的影响更大，这与前者更易受到国际套利的影响相一致。

records.title_en: Local global watchdogs: Trade, sourcing and the internationalization of social activism
records.title_cn: 地方全球监督者：贸易、采购与社会行动主义的国际化
records.abstract_en: NGO campaigns criticizing firms for infringements along their internationalized value chains are a salient feature of economic globalization. We argue that understanding the international patterns of NGO campaigns requires accounting for the geography of their targets’ economic activities. We propose a model of global sourcing and international trade in which heterogeneous NGOs campaign against heterogeneous firms in response to infringements along their value chains. We find that campaigns are determined by a triadic gravity equation involving the country of the NGO, the country of the firm as well as the sourcing country. Importantly, independent of the location of the NGO, trade costs between the supplier and the firm shape the patterns of NGO campaigns. We use recently available data to estimate our triadic gravity equation at the NGO level and find strong support for this prediction as well as for other predictions specific to our modeling approach.
records.abstract_cn: 非政府组织针对企业在其国际化价值链中的侵权行为发起的运动，是经济全球化的一个显著特征。我们认为，理解非政府组织运动的国际模式需要考虑其目标经济活动的地理分布。我们提出了一个全球采购和国际贸易模型，在该模型中，异质性非政府组织针对异质性企业，对其价值链中的侵权行为发起运动。我们发现，运动由涉及非政府组织所在国、企业所在国以及采购国的三元引力方程决定。重要的是，无论非政府组织位于何处，供应商与企业之间的贸易成本都会影响非政府组织运动的模式。我们利用近期可获取的数据，在非政府组织层面估计了我们的三元引力方程，并发现该预测以及我们建模方法特有的其他预测得到了强有力的支持。

records.title_en: Sovereign Debt Disclosure
records.title_cn: 主权债务披露
records.abstract_en: This paper studies debt and default dynamics under alternative disclosure arrangements in a sovereign default model. The government can access both observable and hidden debt. We show that when debt is not fully disclosed, the government does not internalize the full effects of hidden debt choices on bond prices, thereby reducing the cost of holding hidden debt. We find that switching to a full disclosure regime shifts the portfolio from hidden to observable debt, exacerbating the debt dilution problem. Thus, contrary to conventional wisdom, this switch generates welfare losses.
records.abstract_cn: 本文在一个主权违约模型中研究了不同披露安排下的债务与违约动态。政府可以同时获得可观察债务和隐性债务。我们表明，当债务未被完全披露时，政府不会内化隐性债务选择对债券价格的全面影响，从而降低了持有隐性债务的成本。我们发现，转向完全披露制度会将投资组合从隐性债务转向可观察债务，加剧债务稀释问题。因此，与传统观点相反，这种转变会产生福利损失。

records.title_en: Bank lending and firm internal capital markets following a deglobalization shock
records.title_cn: 去全球化冲击下的银行贷款与企业内部资本市场
records.abstract_en: We examine the effects of a deglobalization shock on bank lending, firm internal capital markets, and the real economy. Leveraging a unique dataset, we are able to observe both domestic and cross-border credit exposures of German banks as well as internal capital market dynamics within multinational corporations (MNCs). We analyze the response to the Brexit referendum shock. On average, banks reduced lending to United Kingdom (UK) firms following the shock due to increased uncertainty about future losses. More prudent banks reduced their credit more extensively, and less profitable subsidiaries experienced greater reductions. However, UK subsidiaries of large MNCs, with access to internal capital markets, offset this credit supply shock through internal funding, shielding them from negative real effects. Our findings underscore that while international financial frictions following deglobalization shocks can imply negative real effects, firms integrated into global networks mitigate these impacts through internal capital markets.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了去全球化冲击对银行贷款、企业内部资本市场以及实体经济的影响。利用一个独特的数据集，我们能够观察到德国银行的国内和跨境信贷敞口以及跨国公司（MNCs）内部的资本市场动态。我们分析了英国脱欧公投冲击的响应。平均而言，在冲击发生后，由于对未来损失的不确定性增加，银行减少了对英国（UK）企业的贷款。更为审慎的银行信贷削减幅度更大，而盈利能力较弱的子公司则经历了更大的削减。然而，能够利用内部资本市场的跨国公司大型子公司在英国的分支机构，通过内部融资抵消了这一信贷供给冲击，从而免受负面实际影响。我们的研究结果强调，尽管去全球化冲击后的国际金融摩擦可能带来负面实际影响，但融入全球网络的企业通过内部资本市场缓解了这些影响。

records.title_en: Commitment in the canonical sovereign default model
records.title_cn: 经典主权违约模型中的承诺
records.abstract_en: We study the role of lack of commitment in the canonical incomplete-markets sovereign default model of Eaton and Gersovitz (1981). We show the very different set of functional equations that appear under commitment relative to the standard ones. We document how in the standard yearly specification of Arellano (2008) with short-term debt there is no default if there is commitment to the circumstances of when to default. A bad enough disaster makes default under commitment appear. In contrast, with long-term debt, in the standard quarterly Chatterjee and Eyigungor (2012) environment commitment only to one-period-ahead default barely changes the no-commitment allocation, but commitment to both the one-period-ahead default circumstances and the one-period-ahead dilution, or commitment to a longer horizon (a year or a bit more), eliminates default completely and is equivalent to commitment in the one-period-ahead default with short-term debt.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在Eaton和Gersovitz（1981）的经典不完全市场主权违约模型中缺乏承诺的作用。我们展示了在承诺条件下出现的与标准函数方程截然不同的函数方程组。我们记录了在Arellano（2008）的标准年度设定中，若存在对何时违约的承诺，短期债务下不会发生违约。一场足够严重的灾难会使承诺下的违约出现。相比之下，在长期债务下，在Chatterjee和Eyigungor（2012）的标准季度环境中，仅对一期前瞻违约的承诺几乎不改变无承诺配置，但对一期前瞻违约情形和一期前瞻稀释的承诺，或对更长时期（一年或略多）的承诺，则完全消除违约，并等同于短期债务下对一期前瞻违约的承诺。

records.title_en: Fear of appreciation and current account adjustment
records.title_cn: 升值恐惧与经常账户调整
records.abstract_en: This paper finds that one-sided nominal exchange rate intervention in the form of “fear of appreciation” slows adjustment of current account surpluses, providing novel support for Friedman's claims of faster adjustment under flexible exchange rates. We find evidence that countries classified as more flexible have faster convergence than peggers for current account deficits, but not so for surpluses. This asymmetry is associated with a one-sided muting of exchange rate appreciations among some countries. We then develop a multi-country monetary model augmented with a “fear of appreciation” policy rule governing foreign exchange intervention, solved as an occasionally binding constraint. The model demonstrates a mechanism by which government capital flows supporting exchange rate regimes can impinge on international financial adjustment. The model accounts for substantial asymmetries in the speed of current account adjustment, based on exchange rate regime and current account sign.
records.abstract_cn: 本文发现，以“升值恐惧”形式进行的单边名义汇率干预减缓了经常账户盈余的调整，为弗里德曼关于浮动汇率下调整更快的论断提供了新的支持。我们发现，被归类为更灵活汇率制度的国家在经常账户赤字方面的收敛速度快于钉住汇率国家，但在盈余方面并非如此。这种不对称性与一些国家单方面抑制汇率升值有关。随后，我们构建了一个多国货币模型，该模型加入了管理外汇干预的“升值恐惧”政策规则，并作为偶尔约束条件求解。该模型展示了一种机制，即支持汇率制度的政府资本流动可能影响国际金融调整。该模型基于汇率制度和经常账户符号，解释了经常账户调整速度的显著不对称性。

records.title_en: Asset price changes, external wealth and global welfare
records.title_cn: 资产价格变动、外部财富与全球福利
records.abstract_en: U.S. equity outperformance and sustained dollar appreciation have led to large valuation gains for the rest of the world on the U.S. external position. I construct their global distribution, carefully accounting for the role of tax havens. Valuation gains are concentrated and large in developed countries, while developing countries have been mostly bypassed. To assess the welfare implications of these capital gains, I adopt a sufficient statistics approach. In contrast to the large wealth changes, most countries so far did not benefit much in welfare terms. This is because they did not rebalance their portfolios and realize their gains. In contrast, direct welfare effects from the dollar appreciation on import and export prices are an order of magnitude larger.
records.abstract_cn: 美国股市的优异表现和美元的持续升值，导致世界其他地区在美国外部头寸上获得了巨大的估值收益。我构建了这些收益的全球分布，并仔细考虑了避税天堂的作用。估值收益集中在发达国家且规模巨大，而发展中国家大多未能受益。为评估这些资本收益的福利影响，我采用了充分统计量方法。与巨大的财富变化相比，迄今为止大多数国家在福利方面并未获得太多好处。这是因为它们没有重新平衡其投资组合并实现收益。相比之下，美元升值对进口和出口价格的直接福利效应要大一个数量级。

records.title_en: Paper tiger? Chinese science and home bias in citations
records.title_cn: 纸老虎？中国科学及引用中的本土偏好
records.abstract_en: We investigate the phenomenon of home bias in scientific citations, where researchers disproportionately cite work from their own country. We develop a benchmark for expected citations based on the relative size of countries, defining home bias as deviations from this norm. Our findings reveal that China exhibits the largest home bias across all major countries and in nearly all scientific fields studied. This stands in contrast to the pattern of home bias for China’s trade in goods and services, where China does not stand out from most industrialized countries. After adjusting citation counts for home bias, we demonstrate that China’s apparent rise in citation rankings is overstated. Our adjusted ranking places China fourth globally, behind the US, the UK, and Germany, tempering the perception of China’s scientific dominance.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了科学引用中的本土偏好现象，即研究人员不成比例地引用本国的工作。我们基于国家相对规模制定了一个预期引用的基准，将本土偏好定义为偏离此基准的情况。我们的发现表明，在所有主要国家和几乎所有研究的科学领域中，中国表现出最大的本土偏好。这与中国的商品和服务贸易中的本土偏好模式形成对比，在该模式中，中国并不比大多数工业化国家突出。在调整引用次数以消除本土偏好后，我们证明中国在引用排名中的表面上升被夸大了。我们的调整排名将中国置于全球第四位，仅次于美国、英国和德国，从而缓和了对中国科学主导地位的看法。

records.title_en: Tickets to the global market: First US patent award and Chinese firm exports
records.title_cn: 通往全球市场的门票：首次美国专利授权与中国企业出口
records.abstract_en: We investigate how international patent activity enables firms from emerging economies to thrive in the global marketplace. We match Chinese customs data to US patent records, and leverage the quasi-random assignment of USPTO patent examiners to identify the causal effect of a US patent grant on the subsequent export performance of Chinese firms. Successful first-time patent applicants achieve significantly higher export growth, compared to otherwise similar first-time applicants that failed. This effect operates only in small part through market protection for technologically patent-related products in the US, and is largely driven by expansion in other markets. The response across destinations and products reveals that a US patent award signals the Chinese firm’s capacity to produce high-quality products and credibility to honor contracts, mitigating information frictions in international trade. There is little evidence for the relaxation of financial constraints or the promotion of follow-on innovation.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了国际专利活动如何使新兴经济体的企业在全球市场中蓬勃发展。我们将中国海关数据与美国专利记录相匹配，并利用美国专利商标局（USPTO）专利审查员的准随机分配来识别美国专利授权对中国企业后续出口绩效的因果效应。与首次申请失败但其他方面相似的申请人相比，成功的首次专利申请人实现了显著更高的出口增长。这种效应仅在小部分程度上通过美国对技术相关专利产品的市场保护发挥作用，而主要驱动力来自其他市场的扩张。不同目的地和产品的反应表明，美国专利授权信号传递了中国企业生产高质量产品的能力和履行合同的信誉，从而减轻了国际贸易中的信息摩擦。几乎没有证据表明财务约束得到缓解或后续创新得到促进。

records.title_en: Measuring foreign exposure
records.title_cn: 衡量外部敞口
records.abstract_en: We introduce a model-based approximation for assessing foreign exposure via direct and indirect trade. In the model, exposure can be approximated by the fraction of production sold abroad, either directly or indirectly. Simulations show that this ratio accurately reflects the responses of value added to foreign supply shocks across most of the parameter space. It also effectively captures the responses of value added to foreign demand or trade shocks for a more restricted range of parameters. Conversely, other well-known metrics of foreign exposure do not perform well in the simulations. Data show that our measure of foreign exposure correlates significantly with various measures of economic activity, even in service sectors generally thought to be insulated from foreign influences. In contrast, these correlations are either insignificant or incorrectly signed when alternative measures of foreign exposure are used.
records.abstract_cn: 我们引入了一种基于模型的近似方法，通过直接和间接贸易来评估外部敞口。在该模型中，敞口可以近似为生产中被直接或间接销售到国外的比例。模拟显示，该比率在大部分参数空间内能准确反映增加值对外国供给冲击的反应。它也能在更有限的参数范围内有效捕捉增加值对外国需求或贸易冲击的反应。相反，其他知名的外部敞口指标在模拟中表现不佳。数据显示，我们的外部敞口衡量指标与各种经济活动指标显著相关，即使在通常被认为不受外国影响的服务业也是如此。相比之下，当使用替代的外部敞口指标时，这些相关性要么不显著，要么符号错误。

records.title_en: Demographics and real interest rates across countries and over time
records.title_cn: 各国及跨时期的人口结构与实际利率
records.abstract_en: We explore implications of demographic trends for real interest rates across countries and over time in a tractable multicountry model with imperfect capital mobility. We calibrate it to examine how the interaction of international financial integration and both domestic and foreign demographics shapes low-frequency movements in a country’s real rate. In more financially integrated countries, real rates are more sensitive to global developments than to domestic factors. We estimate panel error-correction models relating real rates to various drivers, imposing some structure informed by the model. Empirical results confirm global factors and domestic demographics are robust determinants of real rates. Alternative specifications highlight the importance of accounting for time-varying financial integration and a broad set of real rate drivers. Both model and empirical results suggest demographic trends explain a meaningful share of the global decline in real rates. Given projections, demographics should continue to exert downward pressure on real rates.
records.abstract_cn: 我们在一个具有不完全资本流动性的可处理多国模型中，探讨人口结构趋势对各国及跨时期实际利率的影响。我们校准该模型，以考察国际金融一体化与国内外人口结构的相互作用如何塑造一国实际利率的低频变动。在金融一体化程度更高的国家，实际利率对全球动态的敏感度高于对国内因素的敏感度。我们估计了将实际利率与各种驱动因素联系起来的面板误差修正模型，并施加了由模型提供的一些结构约束。实证结果证实，全球因素和国内人口结构是实际利率的稳健决定因素。替代规格强调了考虑时变金融一体化和广泛实际利率驱动因素的重要性。模型和实证结果均表明，人口结构趋势解释了全球实际利率下降的相当大一部分。根据预测，人口结构应继续对实际利率施加下行压力。

records.title_en: Skill-biased imports, skill acquisition, and migration
records.title_cn: 技能偏向型进口、技能获取与迁移
records.abstract_en: Imported capital goods, which embody skill-complementary technologies, can increase the supply of skills in developing countries. Focusing on China and using a shift-share design, we show that city-level capital goods import growth increases the local skill share and that both skill acquisition and migration play a role. We develop and quantify a spatial equilibrium model with these two mechanisms to examine the aggregate effects of capital goods imports, accounting for trade and migration linkages between cities. Counterfactual experiments suggest that the growth in capital goods imports in China between 2000 and 2010 led to a 3.1–7.3 million increase in the stock of college graduates, representing 4.4–10.4% of the total increase over this period, with the increase disproportionately occurring in coastal regions. These endogenous skill supply responses reduce by half the increase in the aggregate skill premium due to capital goods imports.
records.abstract_cn: 进口资本品，其内含技能互补技术，可以增加发展中国家的技能供给。以中国为研究对象，并采用偏移-份额设计，我们表明城市层面的资本品进口增长提高了本地技能份额，且技能获取和迁移均发挥作用。我们构建并量化了一个包含这两种机制的空间均衡模型，以考察资本品进口的总体效应，同时考虑城市间的贸易和迁移联系。反事实实验表明，中国在2000年至2010年间资本品进口的增长导致大学毕业生存量增加了3.1万至7.3万，占该时期总增量的4.4至10.4%，且这一增长不成比例地集中在沿海地区。这些内生的技能供给反应使资本品进口导致的总体技能溢价增幅减少了一半。

records.title_en: The Real effects of Brexit on labor demand: Evidence from firm-level data
records.title_cn: 英国脱欧对劳动力需求的真实影响：来自企业层面数据的证据
records.abstract_en: Using the distance to the Irish border of UK firms that have not changed their location since the 2016 Referendum to isolate the effects of Brexit at the firm level, we find that Brexit implementation in 2020 caused exposed firms to cut their workforce by up to 15.7% on average relative to non-exposed firms. These exposed firms are also more likely to have lower growth expectations and more likely to increase their research and development (R&D) expenditure. In addition, having ex-ante trade exposure, either with or outside the EU, can help alleviate such negative effects of Brexit. Such results highlight the role of trade exposure and the expectation channel, and support the hypothesis that firms prioritize innovations in response to Brexit.
records.abstract_cn: 利用自2016年公投以来未改变所在地的英国企业距离爱尔兰边境的远近，来隔离英国脱欧在企业层面的影响，我们发现2020年英国脱欧的实施导致受影响企业相对于未受影响企业平均裁员高达15.7%。这些受影响企业也更可能具有较低的增长预期，并更可能增加其研发（R&D）支出。此外，事先具有与欧盟内部或外部的贸易暴露，有助于缓解英国脱欧的这些负面影响。这些结果凸显了贸易暴露和预期渠道的作用，并支持了企业为应对英国脱欧而优先进行创新的假设。

records.title_en: The bank-lending channel of macroprudential policy: Evidence from cross-border bank flows
records.title_cn: 宏观审慎政策的银行信贷渠道：来自跨境银行流动的证据
records.abstract_en: We study the transmission of foreign macroprudential policy to domestic bank loan issuance in emerging markets via cross-border bank flows. We use the universe of bilateral cross-border bank credit transactions to destination countries matched to the macroprudential policy stance in source countries combined with bank balance sheet data in destination markets to document that a tightening of macroprudential policy in source countries reduces the positive impact of cross-border flows on the credit supply of banks in the destination. We show that the negative spillover effect of foreign macroprudential policy is operational only for capital-based and international-exposure policy tools. We also find evidence that macroprudential regulation in source countries shifts credit demand by borrowing firms and households across banks in the destination, whereas regulation performed by destination countries does not change the inward spillovers associated with cross-border flows.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了外国宏观审慎政策通过跨境银行流动对新兴市场国内银行贷款发放的传导。我们使用了目的地国家的双边跨境银行信贷交易全样本，这些交易与来源国的宏观审慎政策立场相匹配，并结合目的地市场的银行资产负债表数据，记录了来源国宏观审慎政策的收紧降低了跨境流动对目的地银行信贷供给的正面影响。我们表明，外国宏观审慎政策的负面溢出效应仅对基于资本和国际敞口的政策工具起作用。我们还发现证据表明，来源国的宏观审慎监管将借款企业和家庭的信贷需求在目的地的银行之间转移，而目的地国实施的监管并未改变与跨境流动相关的向内溢出效应。

records.title_en: Multinational production, technology diffusion, and economic growth
records.title_cn: 跨国生产、技术扩散与经济增长
records.abstract_en: We develop a tractable growth model to study the dynamic macroeconomic effects of multinational production (MP) across countries. In this framework, MP serves as the channel of international idea diffusion: when firms operate in a foreign country, they contribute to the local stock of knowledge. By embedding this mechanism into a quantitative model of trade and MP, we characterize the evolution of bilateral MP flows, trade flows, and technology dynamics across 54 economies. Counterfactual analysis reveals that reduction in MP costs boosted economic growth, especially in developing economies. We show that a 10-year MP sanction on Russia would reduce the welfare by 9.11%, although the immediate effect is small. We find that increasing outward MP costs for U.S. firms has immediate positive wage effects but negative growth implications. Additionally, a 10% increase in U.S. inward trade costs results in a 0.2% decline in the country’s present value of welfare.
records.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一个易处理的增长模型，以研究跨国生产（MP）在各国间的动态宏观经济效应。在此框架中，跨国生产作为国际思想扩散的渠道：当企业在外国运营时，它们对当地知识存量做出贡献。通过将此机制嵌入一个包含贸易和跨国生产的定量模型，我们刻画了54个经济体中双边跨国生产流动、贸易流动和技术动态的演变。反事实分析显示，跨国生产成本的降低促进了经济增长，尤其是在发展中经济体。我们表明，对俄罗斯实施为期10年的跨国生产制裁将使其福利减少9.11%，尽管即时效应较小。我们发现，提高美国企业的对外跨国生产成本具有即时的正向工资效应，但带来负面的增长影响。此外，美国进口贸易成本增加10%将导致该国福利现值下降0.2%。

records.title_en: Making America great again? The economic impacts of Liberation Day tariffs
records.title_cn: 让美国再次伟大？解放日关税的经济影响
records.abstract_en: On April 2, 2025, President Trump declared “Liberation Day,” announcing broad tariffs to reduce trade deficits and revive U.S. industry. We analyze the long-term economic impacts of these tariffs. If trading partners do not retaliate, the tariffs could decrease the U.S. trade deficit and improve its terms of trade, yielding modest welfare gains when tariff revenues reduce the income tax burden for American workers. However, reciprocal retaliation results in net welfare losses for the U.S. economy. We derive the unilaterally optimal tariff policy and find that the USTR proposed tariffs, based on bilateral trade deficits, diverge markedly from the optimal design. The optimal tariff is 19%, uniformly applied across all trading partners, and determined solely by the aggregate trade deficit, rather than bilateral imbalances. Under optimal foreign retaliation to the USTR tariffs, U.S. welfare declines by up to 3.38% when accounting for input–output linkages, while global employment contracts by 0.58%.
records.abstract_cn: 2025年四月2日，特朗普总统宣布“解放日”，宣布广泛关税以减少贸易逆差并重振美国工业。我们分析了这些关税的长期经济影响。如果贸易伙伴不进行报复，关税可能减少美国贸易逆差并改善其贸易条件，当关税收入减轻美国工人的所得税负担时，带来适度的福利收益。然而，对等报复导致美国经济净福利损失。我们推导出单边最优关税政策，并发现基于双边贸易逆差的USTR提议关税与最优设计显著偏离。最优关税为19%，统一适用于所有贸易伙伴，仅由总贸易逆差决定，而非双边失衡。在外国对USTR关税的最优报复下，考虑投入产出关联时，美国福利下降高达3.38%，而全球就业收缩0.58%。

records.title_en: Has globalization changed the international transmission of U.S. monetary policy?
records.title_cn: 全球化是否改变了美国货币政策的国际传导？
records.abstract_en: We estimate a time-varying parameter vector autoregression to examine the evolution of international spillovers of U.S. monetary policy in light of increasing globalization in real and financial markets. We find that the adverse international effects of a U.S. tightening have substantially increased over the past three decades, peaking during the Great Recession before stabilizing – a timing that aligns well with observed trends in globalization and slowbalization dynamics. Cross-country analysis and counterfactual simulations suggest that the estimated amplification of the spillover effects over time has been primarily driven by the surge in trade integration, while rising financial integration has contributed only modestly.
records.abstract_cn: 我们估计了一个时变参数向量自回归模型，以考察在实体和金融市场日益全球化的背景下，美国货币政策国际溢出效应的演变。我们发现，美国紧缩政策的负面国际影响在过去三十年中显著增加，在大衰退期间达到顶峰，随后趋于稳定——这一时间点与观察到的全球化和缓慢全球化动态趋势高度吻合。跨国分析和反事实模拟表明，随时间推移估计的溢出效应放大主要受到贸易一体化激增的驱动，而金融一体化的上升仅贡献了适度的影响。

records.title_en: Chinese roads in India: The effect of transport infrastructure on economic development
records.title_cn: 印度境内的中国道路：交通基础设施对经济发展的影响
records.abstract_en: India and China followed different strategies in the design of their recent highway networks. India first focused on connecting the four largest economic centers of the country, the Golden Quadrilateral, while China had the explicit strategy of connecting intermediate-sized cities. This paper analyzes the aggregate and distributional effects of transport infrastructure in India based on a general equilibrium trade framework. I compare the effect of the Golden Quadrilateral to a counterfactual network that connects India’s intermediate-sized cities. To construct the counterfactual network, I propose a heuristic network design algorithm to maximize aggregate real income net of road construction costs in the general equilibrium model, and I show that the heuristic algorithm provides a good approximation of the optimal network. The results suggest that the actual network led to sizable aggregate gains but unequal effects across regions. The income-maximizing counterfactual network is substantially larger than the actual Indian network, would imply further aggregate gains, and would benefit the lagging regions of India.
records.abstract_cn: 印度和中国在近期高速公路网络的设计上采取了不同的策略。印度首先聚焦于连接国内四大经济中心，即“黄金四边形”，而中国则明确采取了连接中等规模城市的策略。本文基于一般均衡贸易框架，分析了印度交通基础设施的总体及分配效应。我将“黄金四边形”的效果与一个连接印度中等规模城市的反事实网络进行了比较。为构建该反事实网络，我提出了一种启发式网络设计算法，以在一般均衡模型中最大化扣除道路建设成本后的总实际收入，并证明该启发式算法能很好地近似最优网络。结果表明，实际网络带来了可观的总体收益，但各地区间效应不均。以收入最大化为目标的反事实网络规模远大于印度实际网络，将带来进一步的总体收益，并惠及印度落后地区。

records.title_en: Real exchange rate and net trade dynamics: Financial and trade shocks
records.title_cn: 实际汇率与净贸易动态：金融冲击与贸易冲击
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the drivers of the US real exchange rate (RER), with a particular focus on its comovement with net trade (NT) flows. We consider the entire spectrum of frequencies, as the low-frequency variation accounts for 62 and 64 percent of the unconditional variance of the RER and NT, respectively. We develop a generalization of the standard international business cycle model that successfully rationalizes the joint dynamics of the RER and NT while accounting for the major puzzles of the RER. We find that, while financial shocks are necessary to capture high frequency variation in the RER, trade shocks are essential for the lower frequency fluctuations.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了美国实际汇率（RER）的驱动因素，特别关注其与净贸易（NT）流动的联动性。我们考虑了整个频率谱，因为低频变动分别占RER和NT无条件方差的62和64%。我们开发了标准国际商业周期模型的推广形式，该模型成功解释了RER与NT的联合动态，同时考虑了RER的主要谜题。我们发现，虽然金融冲击对于捕捉RER的高频变动是必要的，但贸易冲击对于低频波动至关重要。

records.title_en: Household responses to trade shocks
records.title_cn: 家庭对贸易冲击的反应
records.abstract_en: We study the impact of Chinese import competition in the 2000s on workers and their households in England and Wales. We document both the direct employment changes of individuals affected by trade exposure, as well as the employment response of individuals whose partner is exposed to trade. We find substantial differences by gender. Men respond to import competition by increasing labour force participation at older ages, and by moving into self-employment. This is true both in response to their own trade exposure, and as an ‘added worker effect’ when their partner is exposed to the shock. By contrast, we find no such response for women, who do not increase labour supply following shocks affecting their partners. Male workers exposed to import competition largely enter self-employed jobs in historically male-dominated occupations, as do men reacting to shocks affecting their partners.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了2000年中国进口竞争对英格兰和威尔士工人及其家庭的影响。我们记录了受贸易暴露影响的个人直接就业变化，以及其伴侣受贸易暴露影响的个人的就业反应。我们发现性别之间存在显著差异。男性通过提高老年时的劳动力参与率以及转向自雇来应对进口竞争。这既体现在他们自身贸易暴露的反应中，也体现在当伴侣受到冲击时的‘附加工人效应’中。相比之下，我们发现女性没有这样的反应，她们在伴侣受到冲击后不会增加劳动力供给。受进口竞争影响的男性工人主要进入历史上以男性为主的职业中的自雇工作，对伴侣受到冲击作出反应的男性也是如此。

records.title_en: The tails of gravity: Using expectiles to quantify the trade-margins effects of economic integration agreements
records.title_cn: 引力模型的尾部：利用期望分位数量化经济一体化协定对贸易边际的影响
records.abstract_en: Although there is evidence suggesting that the effects of trade liberalizations likely vary across the distribution of trade flows, trade economists have focused almost entirely on conditional mean estimates of their trade elasticities. We propose the novel use of Poisson-based expectile regressions to estimate the heterogeneous effects of trade liberalizations across the entire conditional distribution. Like standard Poisson regression, this method does not need the dependent variable to be logged, accommodates a mass of observations at zero, and is easy to implement, allowing the estimation of gravity equations with the standard three-way fixed effects specification. Using the proposed estimator, we find systematic evidence that trade liberalizations have larger effects at the lower tail of the conditional distribution. We then use the proposed method to investigate the causes of this heterogeneity, and our results suggest that the success of trade liberalizations strongly depends on potential for expansions along the extensive margin.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管有证据表明贸易自由化的效应可能随贸易流分布的不同而变化，但贸易经济学家几乎完全集中于其贸易弹性的条件均值估计。我们提出了一种新颖的方法，即基于泊松的期望分位数回归，来估计贸易自由化在整个条件分布中的异质性效应。与标准泊松回归类似，此方法无需对因变量取对数，能容纳大量零值观测，且易于实施，允许使用标准的三维固定效应设定来估计引力方程。利用所提出的估计量，我们发现了系统性证据，表明贸易自由化在条件分布的下尾部分具有更大的效应。随后，我们使用所提出的方法探究这种异质性的原因，结果表明贸易自由化的成功在很大程度上取决于扩展边际上的扩张潜力。

records.title_en: Quantitative easing and the supply of safe assets: Evidence from international bond safety premia
records.title_cn: 量化宽松与安全资产供给：来自国际债券安全溢价的证据
records.abstract_en: Through large-scale asset purchases, widely known as quantitative easing (QE), central banks around the world have affected the supply of safe assets by buying quasi-safe bonds in exchange for truly safe reserves. We examine the pricing effects of the European Central Bank’s bond purchases in the 2015–2021 period on an international panel of bond safety premia from four highly rated countries: Denmark, Germany, Sweden, and Switzerland. We find statistically significant negative effects for all four countries, highlighting an international spillover channel through which QE programs reduce bond safety premia by expanding the supply of truly safe assets.
records.abstract_cn: 通过大规模资产购买，即广为人知的量化宽松（QE），世界各地的中央银行通过购买准安全债券以换取真正安全的准备金，影响了安全资产的供给。我们考察了欧洲央行在2015-2021年期间的债券购买对来自四个高评级国家（丹麦、德国、瑞典和瑞士）的国际债券安全溢价面板数据的定价效应。我们发现对所有四个国家都有统计上显著的负面效应，突显了一种国际溢出渠道，通过该渠道，量化宽松计划通过扩大真正安全资产的供给来降低债券安全溢价。

records.title_en: A search and learning model of export dynamics
records.title_cn: 出口动态的搜索与学习模型
records.abstract_en: Exporting is harder than selling at home, and overcoming barriers takes time. We identify key obstacles to exporting and measure their importance by developing a model of firm-level export dynamics with costly customer search, visibility effects, and learning about product appeal. Fitting the model to U.S. import data on Colombian manufactures, we replicate patterns of exporter maturation. A firm’s customer base and market knowledge are valuable intangible assets: losing both through “market amnesia” would cost Colombian exporters US$14.2 billion, over twice annual exports to the U.S. About a quarter of this reflects lost future sales to current customers; the rest stems from the cost of relearning product appeal and regaining visibility. The frictions we estimate slow trade’s response to shocks: the 10-year export sales response to an exchange rate shock is 48 percent larger than the 1-year response.
records.abstract_cn: 出口比在国内销售更为困难，克服这些障碍需要时间。我们识别了出口的关键障碍，并通过构建一个包含昂贵客户搜索、可见性效应和产品吸引力学习的企业层面出口动态模型来衡量其重要性。将该模型拟合至美国进口哥伦比亚制成品的贸易数据，我们复现了出口商成熟化的模式。企业的客户基础和市场知识是有价值的无形资产：因“市场失忆”而失去这两者将使哥伦比亚出口商损失14.2亿美元，超过其对美国年出口额的两倍。其中约四分之一反映了当前客户未来销售的损失；其余部分则源于重新学习产品吸引力和恢复可见性的成本。我们估计的摩擦减缓了贸易对冲击的响应：汇率冲击后10年的出口销售响应比48%年的响应大1。

records.title_en: Beyond the spike at zero: Understanding nominal wage rigidity through empirical and model-based approaches
records.title_cn: 超越零点的尖峰：通过实证与模型方法理解名义工资刚性
records.abstract_en: I examine the cyclical properties of nominal wage change distributions across time and US states using nationally representative household surveys from 1979 to 2018. The novel finding is that the share of workers with no wage changes, which accounts for the large spike at zero in the nominal wage change distribution, is more countercyclical than the share of workers with wage cuts. I analyze heterogeneous agent models with six alternative wage-setting schemes and conclude that the model with downward nominal wage rigidity is the most consistent with empirical findings regarding the shape and cyclicality of wage change distributions.
records.abstract_cn: 我利用1979年至2018年间具有全国代表性的家庭调查数据，考察了美国各州及不同时期名义工资变化分布的周期性特征。新发现是，无工资变化的工人比例（这解释了名义工资变化分布中零点的巨大尖峰）比工资削减的工人比例更具逆周期性。我分析了六种不同工资设定方案的异质性主体模型，并得出结论，具有向下名义工资刚性的模型在工资变化分布的形状和周期性方面与实证发现最为一致。

records.title_en: Can trade policy change gender equality? Evidence from Chile
records.title_cn: 贸易政策能否改变性别平等？来自智利的证据
records.abstract_en: Do firms reorganize gender composition of their employment in response to trade shocks? Using novel data on gender composition of employment across several occupational groups for Chilean manufacturing firms matched with customs data for 1995–2007, a developing country with low gender equality, and utilizing the 1998 Chile–Mexico Free Trade Agreement (FTA) as the quasi-natural shock, we document the first evidence that the share of female white-collar workers increased by 10% for new exporters exporting to Mexico due to the FTA. This happened through a substitution effect from male to female high-skilled workers due to higher use of technology (both domestic and foreign), high-skilled non-production tasks, and reduction in discrimination. We also show that this increase in this share of white-collar female workers is due to a demand- rather than supply-side effect. Overall, we emphasize that trade policy can play an important role in addressing the gender gap in employment.
records.abstract_cn: 企业是否会因贸易冲击而重组其就业的性别构成？利用智利制造业企业多个职业群体就业性别构成的新数据，结合1995-2007年的海关数据，以及一个性别平等程度较低的发展中国家，并利用1998年智利-墨西哥自由贸易协定（FTA）作为准自然冲击，我们记录了首个证据：由于该自由贸易协定，向墨西哥出口的新出口商中，女性白领工人的比例增加了10%。这一变化是通过从男性高技能工人向女性高技能工人的替代效应实现的，原因是技术（国内和国外）使用增加、高技能非生产性任务增多以及歧视减少。我们还表明，白领女性工人比例的增加是由于需求侧而非供给侧效应。总体而言，我们强调贸易政策在解决就业性别差距方面可以发挥重要作用。

records.title_en: Surviving the fintech disruption
records.title_cn: 在金融科技颠覆中生存
records.abstract_en: We examine the impact of fintech on firm labor demand, job turnover, and firm performance. Occupations with higher exposure to fintech experience a net decline in job postings and employment, though both complementary and substitutive effects emerge across different sectors. Fintech blurs traditional industry boundaries, creating demand for workers with a combination of finance and technology skills.
