records.abstract_en: We develop a tractable small‐open‐economy framework to characterize the constrained efficient use of the monetary policy rate, foreign exchange (FX) intervention, capital controls, and domestic macroprudential measures. The model features dominant currency pricing, positive premia on local currency debt arising from financiers' portfolio constraints, and occasionally‐binding external and domestic borrowing constraints. We characterize the conditions under which the traditional prescription—relying solely on the policy rate and exchange rate flexibility—remains sufficient, even in the presence of externalities. By contrast, to manage noise trader flows into and out of the local currency debt market, FX intervention and in some cases capital inflow taxes should be used instead of the traditional prescription. Moreover, if a country faces a mix of local currency premia and external borrowing constraints, we establish that certain regulations to limit FX mismatch may alleviate the external borrowing constraint but exacerbate the local currency premia. Finally, we show that capital controls may dominate domestic macroprudential measures in cases when external shocks trigger stress in domestic housing markets.
records.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一个易于处理的小型开放经济框架，以描述货币政策利率、外汇干预、资本管制和国内宏观审慎措施的有限有效使用。该模型的特点是主导货币定价、金融家投资组合限制导致的本币债务正溢价以及偶尔具有约束力的外部和国内借款限制。我们描述了即使存在外部性，传统处方（仅依赖政策利率和汇率灵活性）仍然足够的条件。相比之下，为了管理流入和流出本币债务市场的噪音交易者，应使用外汇干预，并在某些情况下使用资本流入税，而不是传统的处方。此外，如果一个国家同时面临本币溢价和外部借款限制，我们制定某些限制外汇错配的法规可能会缓解外部借款限制，但会加剧本币溢价。最后，我们表明，当外部冲击引发国内房地产市场压力时，资本管制可能会主导国内宏观审慎措施。

records.title_en: Competing Platforms and Transport Equilibrium
records.title_cn: 竞争平台和运输平衡
records.abstract_en: I study whether platform competition in app‐based transportation generates waste and whether consolidating competing networks would improve efficiency. I build a spatial model of a ride‐hailing market where competing platforms set prices strategically and estimate it using detailed data from two major platforms in New York City. Comparing the status quo to simulated counterfactuals, I find that: (i) platform market power and the fragmentation of users across networks cause a $176 million annual loss in social welfare and waste 21% of driver‐generated traffic; (ii) a platform merger would trade off gains from pooling all users into a single network against harms from greater market power, reducing traffic by 8% but lowering consumer surplus by $77 million per year due to a 4% price hike; and (iii) interoperability regulations would bring these gains without undermining competition, reducing wasteful traffic by 6% while raising consumer surplus by $63 million per year.
records.abstract_cn: 我研究基于应用程序的交通中的平台竞争是否会产生浪费，以及整合竞争网络是否会提高效率。我建立了一个叫车市场的空间模型，其中竞争平台战略性地设定价格，并使用来自二纽约市主要平台的详细数据进行估算。将现状与模拟反事实进行比较，我发现：(i) 平台市场力量和跨网络用户的分散导致每年 $176 百万 美元的社会福利损失和驾驶员产生的流量浪费 21%； (ii) 平台合并将权衡将所有用户集中到一个网络中的收益与更大市场力量带来的损害，流量减少8%，但由于77价格上涨，消费者剩余每年减少4%百万美元； (iii) 互操作性法规将在不损害竞争的情况下带来这些收益，减少 6% 的浪费流量，同时每年将消费者剩余提高 63 百万 美元。

records.title_en: The Social Tax: Redistributive Pressure and Labor Supply
records.title_cn: 社会税：再分配压力和劳动力供给
records.abstract_en: In low‐income communities in both rich and poor countries, redistributive transfers within kin and social networks are frequent. Such arrangements may distort labor supply—acting as a “social tax” that dampens the incentive to work. We document that across countries, from the United States to Côte d'Ivoire, low‐income groups report strong pressure to share earned income with others; in addition, social groups that undertake more interpersonal transfers work fewer hours. Using a field experiment, we enable piece‐rate factory workers in Côte d'Ivoire to shield income using blocked savings accounts over 9 months. Workers may only deposit earnings increases, relative to baseline, mitigating income effects on labor supply. Offering Private accounts raises work attendance by 6.5% and earnings by 9.4%. These treatment effects are concentrated among workers who report higher redistributive pressure at baseline. To obtain further suggestive evidence on mechanisms, in a supplementary experiment, we vary whether blocked accounts are private or known to the worker's network. When accounts are private, take‐up is substantively higher (60% vs. 14%), with a resultant 8.8% higher earnings. Outgoing transfers do not decline, indicating no loss in redistribution. The welfare benefits of informal redistribution may come at a cost, depressing labor supply and productivity.
records.abstract_cn: 在富国和穷国的低收入社区，亲属和社会网络内的再分配转移都很常见。这种安排可能会扭曲劳动力供给——充当“社会税”，抑制工作积极性。我们记录了从美国到科特迪瓦的各国低收入群体报告的与他人分享收入的巨大压力；此外，承担更多人际转移的社会群体的工作时间也更少。通过现场实验，我们使科特迪瓦的计件工厂工人能够在 9 个月内使用冻结的储蓄账户来保护收入。工人只能存入相对于基线收入增加的资金，从而减轻收入对劳动力供应的影响。提供私人账户可提高工作出勤率 6.5% 和收入 9.4%。这些治疗效果集中在基线时报告分配压力较高的工人身上。为了获得有关机制的进一步提示性证据，在补充实验中，我们改变了被阻止的帐户是私有的还是为工作人员网络所知的。当账户为私人账户时，使用率大幅提高（60% 对比 14%），从而带来 8.8% 更高的收入。传出转移没有下降，表明再分配没有损失。非正式再分配的福利好处可能会付出代价，抑制劳动力供应和生产率。

records.title_en: International Trade Responses to Labor Market Regulations
records.title_cn: 国际贸易对劳动力市场法规的反应
records.abstract_en: This paper demonstrates that labor market regulations, such as minimum wages or payroll taxes, shape trade competition in labor-intensive activities. I exploit data from a large European trade program where firms from different countries supply labor services at the same location but face different payroll taxes and minimum wage rules. Country case studies and model-consistent gravity estimates show large trade responses to tax and regulatory reforms, with an elasticity of trade in services to labor costs larger than one. The results imply that absent regulatory and fiscal harmonization, export competitiveness depends, in part, on domestic labor market policies.
records.abstract_cn: 本文表明，最低工资或工资税等劳动力市场法规影响着劳动密集型活动的贸易竞争。我利用了一个大型欧洲贸易项目的数据，其中来自不同国家的公司在同一地点提供劳务服务，但面临不同的工资税和最低工资规则。国家案例研究和模型一致的引力估计显示，贸易对税收和监管改革的反应很大，服务贸易对劳动力成本的弹性大于 一。结果表明，如果缺乏监管和财政协调，出口竞争力部分取决于国内劳动力市场政策。

records.title_en: Just a Few Seeds More: The Value of Network Data for Diffusion
records.title_cn: 再多一些种子：网络数据传播的价值
records.abstract_en: Identifying the optimal set of individuals to first receive information ("seeds") in a social network to maximize expected diffusion is a widely studied question in many settings. Several studies propose network-centrality-based heuristics to select seeds likely to increase diffusion. Here, we show that, for the classic independent cascade model of diffusion, either seeding a few more individuals at random can prompt a larger diffusion than optimal seeding or optimal seeding itself results in limited spread. These findings hold across a broad range of random networks and are supported by simulations on real-world networks.
records.abstract_cn: 在社交网络中确定 第一 接收信息（“种子”）的最佳个体集以最大化预期扩散是许多环境中广泛研究的问题。一些研究提出了基于网络中心性的启发法来选择可能增加扩散的种子。在这里，我们表明，对于经典的独立级联扩散模型，随机播种更多个体可以促进比最佳播种更大的扩散，或者最佳播种本身会导致有限的扩散。这些发现适用于广泛的随机网络，并得到了现实世界网络模拟的支持。

records.title_en: Default Options and Retirement Saving Dynamics
records.title_cn: 默认选项和退休储蓄动态
records.abstract_en: Using data from over 100 US retirement plans and a representative UK panel, I document the impact of auto-enrollment (AE) on retirement savings at different horizons. I replicate the impact of AE on participation and contributions in the short run (at 12 months), but I show that these gains are attenuated over the medium run (at 36 months). At this longer horizon, the average savings increases are modest, though AE significantly lowers inequality in savings. To assess AE's lifetime impact, I estimate a life cycle consumption-savings model that can fit the observed patterns with a switching cost of approximately $250, smaller than previous estimates.
records.abstract_cn: 我使用来自多个 100 美国退休计划和英国代表性小组的数据，记录了自动注册 (AE) 对不同时期退休储蓄的影响。我复制了 AE 对短期（12 月）参与和贡献的影响，但我表明这些收益在中期（36 月）会减弱。在这个较长的时期，平均储蓄增长幅度不大，尽管 AE 显着降低了储蓄不平等。为了评估 AE 的生命周期影响，我估计了一个生命周期消耗节省模型，该模型可以适应观察到的模式，转换成本约为 $250，小于之前的估计。

records.title_en: A Preferred-Habitat Model of Term Premia, Exchange Rates, and Monetary Policy Spillovers
records.title_cn: 期限溢价、汇率和货币政策溢出效应的首选栖息地模型
records.abstract_en: We develop a two-country model in which currency and bond markets are populated by different investor clienteles, and segmentation is partly overcome by arbitrageurs with limited capital. Risk premia in our model are time-varying, connected across markets, and consistent with the empirical violations of uncovered interest parity and expectations hypothesis. Through risk premia, large-scale bond purchases lower domestic and foreign bond yields and depreciate the currency, and short-rate cuts lower foreign yields, with smaller effects than bond purchases. Currency returns are disconnected from long-maturity bond returns, and yet the currency market is instrumental in transmitting bond demand shocks across countries.
records.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一个 二 国家模型，其中货币和债券市场由不同的投资者客户组成，而资本有限的套利者在一定程度上克服了分割问题。我们模型中的风险溢价是随时间变化的，与各个市场相关，并且与未揭露利率平价和预期假设的实证违反相一致。通过风险溢价，大规模购债降低国内外债券收益率并导致货币贬值，而短期降息则降低国外收益率，但效果比购债要小。货币回报与长期债券回报脱节，但货币市场在跨国家传递债券需求冲击方面发挥着重要作用。

records.title_en: Quid Pro Quo, Knowledge Spillovers, and Industrial Quality Upgrading: Evidence from the Chinese Auto Industry
records.title_cn: 交换条件、知识溢出与产业质量升级：来自中国汽车工业的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the impact of quid pro quo (technology for market access) in facilitating knowledge spillovers and quality upgrading in the Chinese automobile industry. The identification strategy exploits within-product quality variation across a rich set of quality dimensions. We find affiliated domestic automakers adopt more similar quality strengths of their joint venture partners, consistent with knowledge spillovers. Additional analysis suggests worker flows and supplier networks mediate knowledge spillovers. Knowledge spillovers due to ownership affiliation under quid pro quo contributed 8.3 percent of the quality improvement experienced by affiliated domestic models from 2001 to 2014, relative to nonaffiliated domestic models.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了交换条件（市场准入技术）对促进中国汽车行业知识溢出和质量升级的影响。该识别策略利用了一系列丰富的质量维度中的产品内质量变化。我们发现关联的国内汽车制造商采用了与其合资伙伴更相似的质量优势，这与知识溢出一致。其他分析表明，工人流动和供应商网络可以调节知识溢出。相对于非附属国内车型，由于交换条件下的所有权附属关系而产生的知识溢出贡献了附属国内模型从 8.3% 到 2001 的 2014 质量改进。

records.title_en: Nonlinear Pricing and Misallocation
records.title_cn: 非线性定价和错配
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the effect of nonlinear pricing on markups and misallocation. In a general equilibrium model in which firms are allowed to set a quantity-dependent pricing schedule, markup heterogeneity is not a sign of misallocation. Instead, we point to a new source of misallocation: high-taste consumers are allocated too much of each good, low-taste consumers too little. Using micro data from the retail sector, we show that nonlinear pricing is prevalent and quantify the model. Welfare losses from misallocation across consumers are substantially larger than those from misallocation across firms under linear pricing.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了非线性定价对加价和错配的影响。在一般均衡模型中，企业被允许设定与数量相关的定价表，加成异质性并不是错配的标志。相反，我们指出了错误分配的新根源：高品味消费者获得的每种商品过多，而低品味消费者获得的每种商品过少。使用零售行业的微观数据，我们表明非线性定价是普遍存在的，并对模型进行了量化。消费者之间的不当配置造成的福利损失远大于线性定价下企业之间的不当配置造成的福利损失。

records.title_en: Borrowing and Spending in the Money: Debt Substitution and the Cash-Out Refinance Channel of Monetary Policy
records.title_cn: 货币借贷与支出：债务替代与货币政策套现再融资渠道
records.abstract_en: We show that the strong negative effect of higher mortgage rates on cash-out refinancing reflects substitution into other borrowing products, not large changes in total new household borrowing. We exploit plausibly exogenous changes in interest rates due to unconventional monetary policy surprises to show that changes in cash-out and other borrowing are roughly offsetting. The elasticity of new household borrowing with respect to mortgage rates is low and varies little with the borrower's outstanding mortgage rate. Our results suggest that the cash-out refinance channel of unconventional monetary policy is weak and not path dependent.
records.abstract_cn: 我们发现，较高的抵押贷款利率对现金再融资的强烈负面影响反映了对其他借贷产品的替代，而不是新家庭借贷总额的巨大变化。我们利用非常规货币政策意外导致的看似外生的利率变化来表明，现金支出和其他借款的变化大致抵消了这一影响。新家庭借贷相对抵押贷款利率的弹性较低，且随借款人未偿还抵押贷款利率变化不大。我们的研究结果表明，非常规货币政策的套现再融资渠道较弱且不具有路径依赖性。

records.title_en: Anatomy of the Phillips Curve: Micro Evidence and Macro Implications
records.title_cn: 菲利普斯曲线剖析：微观证据和宏观含义
records.abstract_en: We develop a bottom-up approach to estimate the slope of the primitive form of the New Keynesian Phillips curve, which features marginal cost as the real activity variable. Using quarterly micro data on prices, costs, and output, we estimate dynamic pass-through regressions that identify the slope as a function of primitive parameters. We find a high slope for the cost-based Phillips curve, which contrasts with the low estimates of the conventional output gap–based formulation found in the literature. We reconcile by showing that the output elasticity of marginal cost is low, at least during moderate inflation periods (e.g., pre-pandemic).
records.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一种自下而上的方法来估计新凯恩斯菲利普斯曲线原始形式的斜率，该曲线以边际成本作为实际活动变量。使用关于价格、成本和产出的季度微观数据，我们估计动态传递回归，将斜率识别为原始参数的函数。我们发现基于成本的菲利普斯曲线的斜率很高，这与文献中基于传统产出缺口的公式的低估计形成鲜明对比。我们通过证明边际成本的产出弹性较低来调和，至少在温和通胀时期（例如大流行前）是这样。

records.title_en: The Trade-Off between Flexibility and Robustness in Instrumental Variables Analysis
records.title_cn: 工具变量分析中灵活性与稳健性的权衡
records.abstract_en: In additive instrumental variables models, the robustness to some failure of instrumental validity or additive separability depends on the strength of a priori restrictions on the structural relationship between outcomes and treatments. I provide theoretical analysis of the problem, discuss the implications for empirical practice, and demonstrate with a numerical study calibrated on real-world data.
records.abstract_cn: 在加性工具变量模型中，对工具有效性或加性可分离性某些失败的鲁棒性取决于对结果和治疗之间结构关系的先验限制的强度。我提供了对该问题的理论分析，讨论了对实证实践的影响，并通过根据现实世界数据校准的数值研究进行了论证。

records.title_en: Distinguishing Causes of Neighborhood Racial Change: A Nearest-Neighbor Design
records.title_cn: 区分邻里种族变化的原因：最近邻设计
records.abstract_en: We study neighborhood choice using a novel research design that contrasts the move rate of homeowners who receive a new different-race neighbor immediately next-door versus slightly farther away on the same block. This approach isolates a component of preferences directly attributable to neighbors' identities. Both Black and White homeowners are more likely to move after receiving a new different-race neighbor. Findings are robust to additional controls (e.g., income) and alternative research designs. We find evidence of heterogeneity in responses, especially associated with housing density, which has implications for understanding contemporary neighborhood racial change and prospects for maintaining stable, integrated neighborhoods.
records.abstract_cn: 我们使用一种新颖的研究设计来研究邻里选择，该设计对比了在隔壁接收新的不同种族邻居的房主与在同一街区稍远的地方接收新的不同种族邻居的房主的搬家率。这种方法隔离了直接归因于邻居身份的偏好的组成部分。黑人和白人房主在收到新的不同种族邻居后更有可能搬家。研究结果对于额外的控制（例如收入）和替代研究设计是稳健的。我们发现了反应异质性的证据，尤其是与住房密度相关的异质性，这对于理解当代社区种族变化以及维持稳定、一体化社区的前景具有重要意义。

records.title_en: Managers and Public Hospital Performance
records.title_cn: 管理者和公立医院绩效
records.abstract_en: We study whether the quality of managers can affect public service provision in the context of public health. Using novel data from public hospitals in Chile, we show how the introduction of a competitive recruitment system and better pay for public hospital CEOs reduced hospital mortality by 8 percent. The effect is not explained by a change in patient composition. We find that the policy changed the pool of CEOs by displacing doctors with no management training in favor of CEOs who had studied management. Productivity improvements were driven by hospitals that recruited higher quality CEOs.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究管理者的素质是否会影响公共卫生背景下的公共服务提供。使用来自智利公立医院的新数据，我们通过 8% 展示了引入竞争性招聘系统和提高公立医院首席执行官薪酬如何降低医院死亡率。这种影响不能用患者成分的变化来解释。我们发现，该政策改变了首席执行官的阵容，取代了没有受过管理培训的医生，取而代之的是学习过管理学的首席执行官。医院聘请了更高素质的首席执行官，从而推动了生产力的提高。

records.title_en: Increasing Degree Attainment among Low-Income Students: The Role of Intensive Advising and College Quality
records.title_cn: 提高低收入学生的学位获得率：强化咨询和大学质量的作用
records.abstract_en: A college degree offers a pathway to economic mobility for low-income students. Using a multisite randomized controlled trial combined with administrative and survey data, we demonstrate that intensive advising during high school and college significantly increases bachelor's degree attainment among lower-income students. We leverage unique data on preadvising college preferences and causal forest methods to show that these gains are primarily driven by improvements in initial enrollment quality. Our results suggest that strategies targeting college choice may be a more effective and efficient means of increasing degree attainment than those focused solely on affordability.
records.abstract_cn: 大学学位为低收入学生提供了经济流动的途径。通过多中心随机对照试验结合行政和调查数据，我们证明高中和大学期间的强化咨询可以显着提高低收入学生的学士学位获得率。我们利用关于预先建议大学偏好和因果森林方法的独特数据来表明，这些收益主要是由初始入学质量的提高所驱动的。我们的研究结果表明，针对大学选择的策略可能比那些只关注负担能力的策略更有效和高效地提高学位获得率。

records.title_en: Digging deep: Resource exploitation and higher education
records.title_cn: 深挖：资源开采与高等教育
records.abstract_en: Do resource-extraction booms deter postsecondary education? We explore this question by examining the higher education-related decisions of Chilean high school graduates during the 2000s commodities boom. Mineral extraction boosts enrollment in technical education but lowers completion rates for four-year professional degrees. Effects vary by economic background, with dropout rates higher among public high school graduates, who typically serve low-income groups. Our study highlights the unequal impact of natural resources on human capital accumulation across income groups within resource-rich developing economies.
records.abstract_cn: 资源开采热潮是否会阻碍高等教育？我们通过考察智利高中毕业生在2000年大宗商品繁荣期间的高等教育相关决策来探讨这一问题。矿产开采提高了技术教育的入学率，但降低了四年制专业学位的完成率。影响因经济背景而异，公立高中毕业生（通常服务于低收入群体）的辍学率更高。我们的研究强调了在资源丰富的发展中经济体中，自然资源对人力资本积累在不同收入群体间的不平等影响。

records.title_en: Community norms, peer influence, and women’s digital financial inclusion: evidence from India
records.title_cn: 社区规范、同伴影响与女性数字金融包容性：来自印度的证据
records.abstract_en: Despite rapid advances in digital finance, significant gender gaps persist, especially in South Asia. Using nationally representative data from India’s NFHS-5 survey (n = 84,213), this study explores how community norms and peer behavior shape women’s adoption of digital financial services. Employing a 2–2–1 multilevel moderated mediation model, we find that women are significantly more likely to engage in digital finance when embedded in communities with high peer usage, aligning with behavioral diffusion theory. However, this peer influence is curtailed in communities with restrictive gendered mobility norms. Our findings underscore the layered interaction between individual agency and community-level social structures. The study reveals that women’s employment and relative income foster digital adoption both directly and via increased peer exposure. Yet, this pathway weakens in socially restrictive environments. These insights highlight the necessity of norm-sensitive, community-level interventions to promote inclusive digital finance for women in low- and middle-income countries.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管数字金融取得了快速进展，但显著的性别差距依然存在，尤其是在南亚。利用印度国家家庭健康调查（NFHS-5）的全国代表性数据（n = 84,213），本研究探讨了社区规范和同伴行为如何影响女性对数字金融服务的采用。通过采用2-2–1多层调节中介模型，我们发现，当女性置身于同伴使用率高的社区时，她们参与数字金融的可能性显著增加，这与行为扩散理论相符。然而，在具有限制性性别流动规范的社区中，这种同伴影响受到抑制。我们的发现强调了个人能动性与社区层面社会结构之间的分层互动。研究揭示，女性的就业和相对收入通过直接途径以及增加同伴暴露的间接途径促进数字采纳。然而，这一路径在社会限制性环境中会减弱。这些见解凸显了采取对规范敏感、社区层面的干预措施以促进中低收入国家女性包容性数字金融的必要性。

records.title_en: Studying economic black holes: Lessons from North Korea
records.title_cn: 研究经济黑洞：来自朝鲜的教训
records.abstract_en: Some economies are “black holes” where reliable data is scarce due to government control, low capacity, or conflict. Despite these challenges, researchers have found ways to gather useful information. This paper draws on the literature on North Korea to review six key methods: satellite imagery, reports from aid agencies, trade data, prices, refugee surveys, and official documents. These sources are imperfect, and require close attention to research design and measurement error. Nonetheless, they demonstrate that it is possible to extract information from economic black holes and to draw meaningful insights about them.
records.abstract_cn: 一些经济体是“黑洞”，由于政府控制、能力低下或冲突，可靠数据稀缺。尽管存在这些挑战，研究人员已找到收集有用信息的方法。本文借鉴关于朝鲜的文献，回顾了六种关键方法：卫星图像、援助机构报告、贸易数据、价格、难民调查和官方文件。这些来源并不完美，需要密切关注研究设计和测量误差。尽管如此，它们表明从经济黑洞中提取信息并得出有意义的见解是可能的。

records.title_en: Climate change vulnerability and the resilience of energy consumption
records.title_cn: 气候变化脆弱性与能源消费的韧性
records.abstract_en: This study examines the influence of climate change vulnerability on the resilience of national energy consumption. We develop a novel measure of the resilience of energy consumption, considering both scale and temporal dimensions, and employ a panel data model to examine the impact of climate change vulnerability on this resilience. The findings indicate that, despite increasing global uncertainties, the resilience of energy consumption exhibits a rising trend in most countries. Climate change vulnerability exerts a significant negative effect on the resilience of energy consumption: a one-unit increase in climate change vulnerability results in a 0.4307-unit decrease in the absorption intensity of the resilience of energy consumption. Furthermore, through an in-depth analysis of its underlying mechanisms, we find that this impact primarily occurs through a weakening of energy supply, a reduction in energy intensity, the enhancement of governmental environmental regulations, a distortion of energy prices, and the instability of energy technologies. Our study contributes to the literature on energy supply and demand balance, specifically within the discourse on energy consumption in the face of climate change challenges. It broadens the concept of resilience to encompass energy consumption and introduces new resilience metrics, namely absorption intensity and absorption duration, thereby enhancing the comprehensiveness and comparability of resilience assessments. These findings are pivotal for improving strategic decision-making regarding energy in the context of increasing climate change challenges.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了气候变化脆弱性对国家能源消费韧性的影响。我们开发了一种新的能源消费韧性衡量方法，综合考虑了规模和时间维度，并采用面板数据模型来检验气候变化脆弱性对这一韧性的影响。研究结果表明，尽管全球不确定性增加，大多数国家的能源消费韧性呈现上升趋势。气候变化脆弱性对能源消费韧性产生显著的负面影响：气候变化脆弱性每增加一个单位，能源消费韧性的吸收强度将减少0.4307个单位。此外，通过对其潜在机制的深入分析，我们发现这种影响主要通过削弱能源供应、降低能源强度、加强政府环境规制、扭曲能源价格以及能源技术的不稳定性来实现。我们的研究为能源供需平衡的文献做出了贡献，特别是在面对气候变化挑战的能源消费讨论中。它将韧性的概念扩展到涵盖能源消费，并引入了新的韧性指标，即吸收强度和吸收持续时间，从而增强了韧性评估的全面性和可比性。这些发现对于在气候变化挑战日益加剧的背景下改进能源战略决策至关重要。

records.title_en: On risk-based poverty traps
records.title_cn: 基于风险的贫困陷阱
records.abstract_en: Much development policy has followed from the idea of poverty traps, the belief that the poor (and poor countries) lack capital and the ability to borrow, thus cannot invest sufficiently to build a better future for themselves. Poverty is thus self-reinforcing. This essay explores a complementary, alternate hypothesis, that poverty traps may be driven not only by lack of access to capital, but also (or instead) by differential exposure to uninsured risk and ability to cope with that risk. We explain the hypothesis and its historical roots, discuss empirical evidence, and tease out prospective solutions to the possibility of risk-based poverty traps.
records.abstract_cn: 许多发展政策都源于贫困陷阱的概念，即认为穷人（以及贫困国家）缺乏资本和借贷能力，因此无法进行足够的投资来为自己创造更美好的未来。贫困因此自我强化。本文探讨了一个互补的、替代性的假设，即贫困陷阱可能不仅由缺乏资本获取途径驱动，还可能（或取而代之）由未保险风险的不同暴露程度及应对该风险的能力差异所驱动。我们阐述了这一假设及其历史根源，讨论了实证证据，并梳理了针对基于风险的贫困陷阱可能性的前瞻性解决方案。

records.title_en: The order behind disorder: informality, power, and the resilience of a transport policy trap in Lima, Peru
records.title_cn: 混乱背后的秩序：秘鲁利马的非正规性、权力与交通政策陷阱的韧性
records.abstract_en: Massive internal migration in the sixties, a severe economic and social crisis in the eighties, and a radical neoliberal transport reform adopted in 1991 (Legislative Decree N° 651–1991) led to the emergence of a disorganized, inefficient, and costly transport system in Lima, Peru. In dialogue with the business power and policy feedback literature, we show that this system is rooted in the empowerment of leading private formal and informal transport actors and in the weakening of state transport control offices. These arrangements constitute what experts call a “policy trap,” a situation in which a trajectory is adopted that is difficult to escape due to prior reforms, public policies, and/or government decisions (Holland, 2017). This article analyzes two reform attempts to break the policy trap: the Integrated Transportation System (SIT) reform of 2011 and the creation of the Urban Transport Authority (ATU) in 2018. By focusing on the implementation of these reforms, we demonstrate the structural and instrumental power of informal and low-quality formal actors that sustain the system’s continuity, particularly their successful strategies of resistance and adaptation to the reforms. We document how these actors engage politically to oppose the implementation of reforms, lobby and support political actors who can represent their interests, and adopt new modes of informal transport to circumvent or profit from the new conditions promoted by the reforms. These findings exemplify the considerable challenges that middle- and low-income states face in adopting and sustaining reforms to regulate informal activities, such as transport.
records.abstract_cn: 六十年代的大规模内部移民、八十年代的严重经济和社会危机，以及1991年（第651-1991号立法法令）采纳的激进新自由主义交通改革，导致了秘鲁利马出现一个无序、低效且成本高昂的交通系统。在与商业权力和政策反馈文献的对话中，我们表明，这一系统根植于领先的私营正规和非正规交通行为者的赋权，以及国家交通控制办公室的弱化。这些安排构成了专家所称的“政策陷阱”，即由于先前的改革、公共政策和/或政府决策而难以摆脱的轨迹（Holland，2017）。本文分析了两次打破政策陷阱的改革尝试：2011年的综合交通系统（SIT）改革和2018年城市交通管理局（ATU）的设立。通过关注这些改革的实施，我们展示了维持系统连续性的非正规和低质量正规行为者的结构性和工具性权力，特别是他们成功抵制和适应改革的策略。我们记录了这些行为者如何政治参与以反对改革的实施，游说并支持能够代表其利益的政治行为者，以及采用新的非正规交通模式来规避或利用改革推动的新条件。这些发现例证了中低收入国家在采纳和维持改革以规范交通等非正规活动方面面临的巨大挑战。

records.title_en: Insuring those who bear the risk: The impact of gender-inclusive framing on insurance uptake in Kenya
records.title_cn: 为承担风险者提供保险：性别包容性框架对肯尼亚保险购买的影响
records.abstract_en: Most insurance for crop and livestock loss that has been developed in low income countries protects against shocks in traditionally male spheres of economic activity. Often overlooked are women, the particularities of their indirect exposure to these shocks, and their socially constructed responsibility to manage family well-being. To fill this lacuna, this paper studies the effect of a low-cost intervention that reformulates a male-focused livestock insurance contract so that it addresses women’s risks and is sold in units that are commensurate with women’s expenditure responsibilities. We measure the effect of this contractual reformulation using a randomized trial amongst pastoralist communities in Kenya. Twenty-nine percent of previously subsidized households that received the novel, gender-inclusive contractual formulation purchased insurance (without subsidy), compared to nineteen percent of previously subsidized households offered insurance under the standard male-exclusive formulation. Households that had not received prior insurance subsidies purchased no insurance, irrespective of the inclusivity of the insurance design. Protecting women, their assets, and those who depend on them ultimately requires a combination of smart subsidies and gender-inclusive insurance design.
records.abstract_cn: 在低收入国家开发的大多数农作物和牲畜损失保险，旨在防范传统上属于男性经济活动领域的冲击。女性、她们对这些冲击的间接暴露的特殊性，以及她们在社会建构中承担的家庭福祉管理责任，往往被忽视。为填补这一空白，本文研究了一项低成本干预措施的效果，该措施重新制定了以男性为重点的牲畜保险合同，使其针对女性的风险，并以与女性支出责任相称的单位出售。我们通过肯尼亚牧民社区的随机试验来衡量这种合同重新制定的效果。在之前接受补贴的家庭中，收到新颖的、性别包容的合同形式的家庭中有百分之二十九购买了保险（无补贴），而在标准男性专属形式下提供保险的之前接受补贴的家庭中，这一比例为百分之十九。之前未接受保险补贴的家庭无论保险设计是否包容性别，均未购买保险。保护女性、她们的资产以及依赖她们的人，最终需要智能补贴与性别包容性保险设计的结合。

records.title_en: Decentralization and the persistence of centralized power in Liberia
records.title_cn: 权力下放与利比里亚中央集权的持续性
records.abstract_en: Why have decentralization reforms in Liberia, despite consistent external support, repeatedly faltered? The conventional explanation of lacking political ownership, rooted in corruption and elite self-interest, offers only a partial answer, risking circularity: reforms fail because of the very governance deficits they seek to address. Drawing on original fieldwork, this article explores how a perceived lack of political ownership is enacted in practice. It argues that Liberian political and bureaucratic elites are strategically choosing not to ‘own’ reforms to balance domestic political risks and donor expectations, producing a ‘twisted win-win’ dynamic. This concept helps unpack how a “lack of ownership” in Liberia functions in practice: state actors demonstrate limited commitment to sustain donor support while minimizing threats to entrenched power structures and privileges, and donors accept ‘good enough’ progress to satisfy institutional and reporting needs. The result is a dynamic that sustains piecemeal reform without altering the underlying neopatrimonial order. Liberia showcases how political ownership in aid-dependent contexts is relational, bounded, and co-produced rather than being merely absent.
records.abstract_cn: 为什么利比里亚的权力下放改革，尽管有持续的外部支持，却屡屡受挫？关于缺乏政治自主性的传统解释，根植于腐败和精英自身利益，仅提供了部分答案，且有循环论证之嫌：改革之所以失败，正是因为它们试图解决的那些治理缺陷。基于原始田野调查，本文探讨了感知到的政治自主性缺失在实践中是如何体现的。文章认为，利比里亚的政治和官僚精英正策略性地选择不“拥有”改革，以平衡国内政治风险与捐助者期望，从而产生一种“扭曲的双赢”动态。这一概念有助于解析利比里亚“缺乏自主性”在实践中如何运作：国家行为体表现出有限的承诺以维持捐助者支持，同时最小化对根深蒂固的权力结构和特权的威胁，而捐助者则接受“足够好”的进展以满足制度和报告需求。其结果是一种动态，维持了零敲碎打的改革，却不改变底层的世袭庇护秩序。利比里亚展示了在援助依赖情境中，政治自主性是如何具有关系性、受限性和共同生产性的，而非仅仅是缺失的。

records.title_en: ICT diffusion, gender inclusion, and structural transformation in Africa: A synergistic analysis for sustainable development
records.title_cn: 信息通信技术扩散、性别包容与非洲结构转型：面向可持续发展的协同分析
records.abstract_en: The purpose of this study is twofold: First, to investigate the unconditional impact of gender inclusion on Africa’s structural transformation. Second, to investigate the role of ICT diffusion in moderating the impact of gender inclusion on Africa’s structural transformation. The analysis focuses on 48 African countries, utilizing data from 2010 to 2023. The Generalized Method of Moments (GMM) is employed as the baseline estimation technique, with the Driscoll-Kraay Fixed Effects regression adopted as a robustness check. To enhance policy relevance, gender inclusion is measured using indicators like female labor force participation, female political representation, female self-employment, and female employment. ICT diffusion is examined in terms of access, usage, and skills. The estimation strategy is designed to interact various components of ICT diffusion with gender inclusion indicators, to positively influence Africa’s structural transformation. The study finds that, although gender inclusion has an unconditional negative impact on Africa’s structural transformation, ICT diffusion serves as a positive moderating factor, mitigating this adverse effect. Specifically, the ICT diffusion thresholds required to offset the negative impact of gender inclusion on structural transformation are as follows: (i) for manufacturing value-added, 8.23%–11.33% for ICT usage, 11.67% for ICT access, 185%–195% for ICT skills and 1.89% for overall ICT diffusion and (ii) for industrial value added, 6.78%–13.18% for ICT usage and 6.67% for ICT access. The policy implications of these findings are discussed in alignment with the African Union’s Agenda 2063 and the Sustainable Development Goals.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究的目的有两方面：第一，考察性别包容对非洲结构转型的无条件影响。第二，考察信息通信技术（ICT）扩散在调节性别包容对非洲结构转型影响中的作用。分析聚焦于48个非洲国家，利用2010年至2023年的数据。采用广义矩估计（GMM）作为基准估计技术，并以Driscoll-Kraay固定效应回归作为稳健性检验。为增强政策相关性，性别包容通过女性劳动力参与率、女性政治代表比例、女性自雇率和女性就业率等指标衡量。ICT扩散则从接入、使用和技能三个方面考察。估计策略旨在将ICT扩散的各组成部分与性别包容指标交互作用，以积极影响非洲的结构转型。研究发现，尽管性别包容对非洲结构转型具有无条件负面影响，但ICT扩散作为正向调节因素，缓解了这一不利影响。具体而言，抵消性别包容对结构转型负面影响的ICT扩散阈值如下：（i）对于制造业增加值，ICT使用率为8.23%–11.33%，ICT接入率为11.67%，ICT技能为185%–195%，整体ICT扩散为1.89%；（ii）对于工业增加值，ICT使用率为6.78%–13.18%，ICT接入率为6.67%。这些发现的政策含义结合非洲联盟《2063年议程》和可持续发展目标进行了讨论。

records.title_en: Climate stressors and rural incomes: multi-country evidence on wealth, gender, and age disparities
records.title_cn: 气候压力源与农村收入：关于财富、性别和年龄差异的多国证据
records.abstract_en: Wealth status, gender, and age are widely acknowledged to influence a person’s vulnerability to climate stressors. However, there is a lack of multicounty evidence to quantify the magnitude and nature of these vulnerabilities, particularly in rural areas. Using cross-sectional household survey data from 24 countries combined with georeferenced temperature and precipitation data, we estimate the differential effects of extreme precipitation, extreme heat, and long-run temperature changes on the total, on-farm, and off-farm incomes of poor households, households headed by women and younger people in rural areas, relative to their comparison groups. We show that every day of extreme heat is associated with a reduction of the total income of poor and female-headed households by between 0.8 and 1.5 per cent, respectively, relative to non-poor and male-headed households. Conversely, households headed by younger people increase their total incomes relative to households headed by older people when extreme events occur through relative increases in off-farm income. Moreover, we show that a 1 degree Celsius increase in long-run average temperatures compels poor rural households to rely more heavily on agricultural income sources, compared to non-poor households, while female headed households lose 37 per cent more of their income relative to male-headed households. We conclude that income vulnerabilities to climate stressors in rural areas are diverse and distinct, and that addressing these differences is essential for achieving our collective ambition to reduce global poverty in the context of climate change.
records.abstract_cn: 财富状况、性别和年龄被广泛认为影响个人对气候压力源的脆弱性。然而，缺乏多国证据来量化这些脆弱性的程度和性质，尤其是在农村地区。利用来自24个国家的横截面家庭调查数据，结合地理参考的温度和降水数据，我们估计了极端降水、极端高温和长期温度变化对贫困家庭、女户主家庭和农村年轻户主家庭的总收入、农业收入和非农收入的差异化影响，相对于其对照组。我们发现，每增加一天极端高温，贫困家庭和女户主家庭的总收入相对于非贫困家庭和男户主家庭分别减少0.8至1.5%%。相反，当极端事件发生时，年轻户主家庭相对于老年户主家庭的总收入增加，这得益于非农收入的相对增长。此外，我们表明，长期平均温度每升高1摄氏度，贫困农村家庭相对于非贫困家庭更依赖农业收入来源，而女户主家庭相对于男户主家庭损失37%%更多的收入。我们得出结论，农村地区对气候压力源的收入脆弱性是多样且独特的，解决这些差异对于在气候变化背景下实现减少全球贫困的共同目标至关重要。

records.title_en: Dutch disease and the resource curse: the progression of views from exchange rates to women’s agency and well-being
records.title_cn: 荷兰病与资源诅咒：从汇率到女性能动性与福祉的观点演进
records.abstract_en: This article provides an overview of the history of economic thought on natural resource extraction, which has long been considered an enclave industry with few benefits for areas beyond the local economy. We focus on more recent scholarship examining the social impacts of natural resource extraction, emphasizing gender-related outcomes and determinants. An important lesson from this scholarship is that it is difficult to discuss sustainable development in its contemporary sense without paying due diligence to the gender dimensions of natural resource extraction. A lesson highlighted is that the “resource curse” view of natural capital may not be as pervasive as previously thought.
records.abstract_cn: 本文概述了关于自然资源开采的经济思想史，该领域长期以来被视为一种飞地产业，对地方经济以外的地区益处甚少。我们聚焦于近期研究自然资源开采社会影响的学术成果，强调与性别相关的结果及其决定因素。这些学术研究的一个重要启示是，若不充分关注自然资源开采的性别维度，便难以讨论当代意义上的可持续发展。另一个突出的教训是，关于自然资本的“资源诅咒”观点可能并不像先前认为的那样普遍存在。

records.title_en: What we have learned since Rostow
records.title_cn: 自罗斯托以来我们学到了什么
records.abstract_en: This short paper is an attempt to highlight the path trodden by development economists and scholars since Rostow published his famous book “The Take-Off into Self-Sustaining Growth”. It proceeds along three major themes: prerequisites or endogenous outcomes; abrupt and gradual changes; and the possibility of non-monotonous development. Its central conclusion is that significant advances have consisted of explorations of incremental changes and their interaction with abrupt shifts, and of applications of political economics to development, including investigations of the political sources of reform stalemate. The authors argue that these new approaches have enabled us to make progress toward a better understanding of the deep factors underpinning development successes or failures, whether temporary or more permanent.
records.abstract_cn: 这篇短文旨在强调自罗斯托出版其著名著作《起飞进入自我持续增长》以来，发展经济学家和学者所走过的道路。它沿着三个主要主题展开：前提条件或内生结果；突变与渐变；以及非单调发展的可能性。其核心结论是，重大进展在于探索渐进变化及其与突变相互作用，以及将政治经济学应用于发展问题，包括对改革僵局的政治根源的研究。作者认为，这些新方法使我们能够更好地理解支撑发展成功或失败的深层因素，无论是暂时的还是更为持久的。

records.title_en: On Violent Conflict, Land Scarcity, and Power in an urban Frontier in Congo
records.title_cn: 论刚果城市边缘地带的暴力冲突、土地稀缺与权力
records.abstract_en: The relationship between land and violent conflict in Africa has long been a focal point for scholarly inquiry and development policy. According to an influential neo-Malthusian narrative, violent land conflicts erupt when land scarcity, population pressure, and state failure combine. In this paper we join a growing corpus of researchers arguing that the links between violent conflict and land scarcity are not linear, but embedded in complex and entangled social, economic and political processes. Using an extended case-study approach we explore land disputes in the Panzi neighbourhood of Bukavu, which is situated in the conflict-affected eastern part of the Democratic Republic of Congo and appears to embody a neo-Malthusian crisis. We present three main findings.
records.abstract_cn: 非洲土地与暴力冲突之间的关系长期以来一直是学术研究和发展政策的焦点。根据一种有影响力的新马尔萨斯主义叙事，当土地稀缺、人口压力和国家失败相结合时，就会爆发暴力的土地冲突。在本文中，我们加入了越来越多的研究者行列，他们认为暴力冲突与土地稀缺之间的联系并非线性的，而是嵌入在复杂且相互交织的社会、经济和政治进程中。采用扩展案例研究方法，我们探讨了布卡武的潘齐社区的土地纠纷，该社区位于刚果民主共和国受冲突影响的东部地区，似乎体现了新马尔萨斯主义的危机。我们提出了三个主要发现。

records.title_en: Can indigenous political representation improve forest conservation? India’s experience
records.title_cn: 原住民政治代表能否改善森林保护？印度的经验
records.abstract_en: Can political representation by indigenous communities – often seen as stewards of forests – help enhance forest conservation? Or would indigenous political control over forests catalyse greater extraction for revenue gains? Does the level of representation matter? This paper addresses these under-researched questions, drawing on India’s multi-layered enactments which granted Scheduled Tribes political representation, and hence influence over local resources including forests, in constituencies reserved for them in state assemblies and village councils.
records.abstract_cn: 原住民社区——常被视为森林的守护者——的政治代表能否有助于加强森林保护？还是原住民对森林的政治控制会催化更多的资源开采以获取财政收入？代表层级是否重要？本文基于印度多层次的法案，这些法案在邦议会和村务委员会中为表列部落保留了选区，赋予其政治代表权，从而对包括森林在内的当地资源产生影响，探讨了这些研究不足的问题。

records.title_en: A behavioral approach to social security compliance targeting self-employed workers in Brazil
records.title_cn: 针对巴西自雇工人的社会保障遵从行为方法
records.abstract_en: This paper examines a large-scale behavioral intervention to boost social security compliance among self-employed workers. In 2014, the Brazilian Ministry of Social Security gradually delivered mailed booklets to nearly 3 million self-employed workers, reminding them of their obligation to contribute to social security. We find that sending the booklet increased payments by 15 percent and compliance rates by 7 percentage points. This effect is concentrated in the delivery month and fades after three months, a pattern of action and backsliding. Heterogeneity in effects suggests that the impact was stronger in wealthier municipalities, consistent with the prepayment of multiple contributions and pointing to administrative simplification as the likely dominant mechanism. Our results highlight the potential of behavioral interventions to increase social security compliance in developing countries, particularly among the self-employed.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了一项旨在提高自雇工人社会保障遵从度的大规模行为干预。在2014年，巴西社会保障部逐步向近3万名自雇工人邮寄了小册子，提醒他们有义务缴纳社会保障金。我们发现，寄送小册子使缴费增加了15%，遵从率提高了7个百分点。这一效应集中在投递当月，并在三个月后消退，呈现出行动与回退的模式。效应的异质性表明，在较富裕的市镇影响更强，这与预缴多期缴费相符，并指向行政简化可能是主要机制。我们的结果凸显了行为干预在发展中国家，特别是自雇工人中，提高社会保障遵从度的潜力。

records.title_en: The Impact of EITC on Education, Labour Market Trajectories, and Inequalities
records.title_cn: EITC 对教育、劳动力市场轨迹和不平等的影响
records.abstract_en: As a complement to the federal earned income tax credit (EITC), some states offer their own EITC, typically calculated as a percentage of the federal EITC. In this paper, we analyse the effect of state EITC on education using policy discontinuities at US state borders. Our estimates reveal that an increase in the state EITC leads to a statistically significant increase in the high school dropout rate. We then use a life-cycle matching model with directed search and endogenous educational choices, search intensities, hirings, hours worked, and separations to investigate the effects of EITC on the labour market in the long run and along the transitional dynamics. We show that a tax credit targeted at low-wage (and low-skilled) workers reduces the relative return to schooling, thereby generating a powerful disincentive to pursue long-term studies. In the long run, this results in an increase in the proportion of low-skilled workers in the economy, which may have important implications for employment, productivity, and income inequality. Finally, we use the model to determine the optimal design of the EITC.
records.abstract_cn: 作为联邦所得税抵免 (EITC) 的补充，一些州提供自己的 EITC，通常按联邦 EITC 的百分比计算。在本文中，我们利用美国各州边界政策的不连续性来分析州 EITC 对教育的影响。我们的估计显示，州 EITC 的增加导致高中辍学率在统计上显着增加。然后，我们使用具有定向搜索和内生教育选择、搜索强度、招聘、工作时间和离职的生命周期匹配模型来研究 EITC 对劳动力市场的长期影响和转型动态。我们表明，针对低工资（和低技能）工人的税收抵免降低了受教育的相对回报，从而对追求长期学习产生了强大的抑制作用。从长远来看，这会导致经济中低技能工人的比例增加，这可能对就业、生产率和收入不平等产生重要影响。最后，我们使用该模型来确定 EITC 的优化设计。

records.title_en: Globalization and the Ladder of Development: Pushed to the Top or Held at the Bottom?
records.title_cn: 全球化与发展阶梯：推向顶端还是停留在底层？
records.abstract_en: We study the relationship between international trade and development in a model where countries differ in their capability, goods differ in their complexity, and capability growth is a function of a country’s pattern of specialization. Theoretically, we show that it is possible for international trade to increase capability growth in all countries and, in turn, to push all countries up the development ladder. This occurs if (i) shifting employment towards more complex sectors raises capability growth and if (ii) foreign competition is tougher in less complex sectors for all countries. Empirically, we provide causal evidence consistent with (i) using the entry of countries into the World Trade Organization as an instrumental variable for other countries’ patterns of specialization. The opposite of (ii), however, holds in the data. Through the lens of our model, these two empirical observations imply dynamic welfare losses from trade that are pervasive, albeit small for the median country. The same economic forces also suggest that the emergence of China has held back capability growth for a number of African countries who are pushed away from their most-complex sectors, which China exports, and into their least-complex sectors, which China imports.
records.abstract_cn: 我们在一个模型中研究国际贸易与发展之间的关系，其中各国的能力不同，商品的复杂性不同，而能力增长是一个国家专业化模式的函数。从理论上讲，我们表明国际贸易有可能促进所有国家的能力增长，进而推动所有国家登上发展阶梯。如果（i）将就业转向更复杂的行业提高了能力增长，并且（ii）所有国家在不太复杂的行业中外国竞争更加激烈，就会出现这种情况。根据经验，我们提供的因果证据符合以下观点：（i）使用国家加入世界贸易组织作为其他国家专业化模式的工具变量。然而，数据却与(ii)相反。通过我们模型的视角，这些二经验观察表明，贸易带来的动态福利损失是普遍存在的，尽管对于中等国家来说规模很小。同样的经济力量还表明，中国的崛起阻碍了一些非洲国家的能力增长，这些国家被迫从中国出口的最复杂的部门转向中国进口的最简单的部门。

records.title_en: Religion, Education, and the State
records.title_cn: 宗教、教育和国家
records.abstract_en: This paper explores how state and religious providers of education compete during the nation building process. Using novel administrative data, we characterize the evolution of Indonesia’s Islamic education system and religious school choice after the introduction of mass public primary schooling in the 1970s. Funded through informal taxation, Islamic schools competed with the state by entering in the same markets. While primary enrollment shifted towards state schools, religious education increased overall as Islamic schools absorbed growing demand for secondary education. In the short run, electoral support for the secular regime weakened in markets with greater public school construction. Over the long run, Islamic schools established at this juncture are more differentiated in terms of religious curriculum, and cohorts exposed to mass public schooling as children are more invested in religion than in the national identity. Our findings offer a new perspective on the political economy of education reforms and the emergence of parallel systems of public goods provision.
records.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了国家和宗教教育提供者在国家建设过程中如何竞争。使用新颖的行政数据，我们描述了在 1970 引入大众公立小学之后印度尼西亚伊斯兰教育体系和宗教学校选择的演变。通过非正式税收资助，伊斯兰学校通过进入相同的市场与国家竞争。虽然小学入学率转向公立学校，但随着伊斯兰学校吸收了对中等教育不断增长的需求，宗教教育总体上有所增加。短期内，随着公立学校建设规模的扩大，市场对世俗政权的选举支持减弱。从长远来看，此时建立的伊斯兰学校在宗教课程方面更加差异化，而接受大众公立学校教育的儿童对宗教的投入比对国家认同的投入更多。我们的研究结果为教育改革的政治经济学和公共产品提供平行系统的出现提供了新的视角。

records.title_en: Does Tax-Benefit Linkage Matter for the Incidence of Payroll Taxes?
records.title_cn: 税收与​​福利的联系对于工资税的发生率重要吗？
records.abstract_en: We analyse earnings responses to six large payroll tax and income tax reforms in France. Our findings indicate full pass-through to workers when there is a strong and transparent link between contributions and expected benefits. In contrast, employer payroll taxes with no tax-benefit linkage exhibit limited pass-through to workers, while income tax nominally borne by employees show nearly full pass-through. Together with a meta-analysis of the literature, we interpret these results as empirical support for the long-standing hypothesis that tax-benefit linkage matters for the incidence of payroll taxes. In the absence of such linkage, our findings suggest that the individual-level incidence of payroll taxes aligns with their statutory incidence.
records.abstract_cn: 我们分析了法国对六大规模工资税和所得税改革的收入反应。我们的研究结果表明，当捐款和预期收益之间存在牢固且透明的联系时，就会完全传递给工人。相比之下，没有税收福利联系的雇主工资税对工人的转嫁有限，而名义上由雇员承担的所得税几乎完全转嫁。结合对文献的荟萃分析，我们将这些结果解释为对长期存在的假设的实证支持，即税收与福利的联系对工资税的发生率很重要。在缺乏这种联系的情况下，我们的研究结果表明，个人层面的工资税发生率与其法定发生率一致。

records.title_en: Women in the Courtroom: Technology and Justice
records.title_cn: 法庭上的女性：技术与正义
records.abstract_en: Our study analyses 6 million civil judgments in China from 2014 to 2018, documenting gender disparities that disfavour female litigants. We investigate the impact of an open justice reform that mandated courts to broadcast legal proceedings live on a centralized online platform. By exploiting variations in its implementation across courts and over time and employing both difference-in-differences and Bartik IV approaches, we find that gender disparities in chances of winning decrease as broadcast intensity increases. Analysis of the textual content of judicial decisions provides further evidence that these changes in judicial outcomes stem from altered judge behaviours (i.e. attention and effort) under enhanced judicial transparency. Our results demonstrate how information technology shapes judges’ conduct, underscoring its broader potential to improve accountability in public institutions.
records.abstract_cn: 我们的研究分析了6至2014中国的2018百万民事判决，记录了不利于女性诉讼当事人的性别差异。我们调查了公开司法改革的影响，该改革要求法院在集中的在线平台上直播法律诉讼。通过利用不同法院和不同时间的实施差异，并采用双重差分法和 Bartik IV 方法，我们发现获胜机会的性别差异随着广播强度的增加而减少。对司法判决文本内容的分析进一步证明，司法结果的这些变化源于司法透明度增强下法官行为（即注意力和努力）的改变。我们的结果展示了信息技术如何塑造法官的行为，强调了其在改善公共机构问责制方面的更广泛潜力。

records.title_en: Policy Diffusion and Polarization across U.S. States
records.title_cn: 美国各州的政策扩散和两极分化
records.abstract_en: Economists have studied the impact of numerous state laws, from welfare rules to voting ID requirements. Yet for all this policy evaluation, what do we know about policy diffusion—how these policies are introduced and spread from state to state? We present a series of facts based on a data set of 602 U.S. state policies spanning the past seven decades. First, proxies of state capacity do not predict a higher likelihood of innovating new policies, but the political leaning of the state does predict a higher likelihood of introducing partisan laws since 1990. Second, the diffusion of policies from 1950 to 2000 is best predicted by proximity—a state is more likely to adopt a policy if nearby states have already done so—as well as similarity in voter policy preferences. Third, since 2000, party alignment has become the strongest predictor of diffusion, and the speed of adoption has increased. Models of learning and correlated preferences can account for the earlier patterns, but the findings for the last two decades indicate a sharply increasing role of party control. We conclude that party polarization has emerged as a key factor recently for policy adoption, plausibly leading to a worse match between state policies and voter preferences.
records.abstract_cn: 经济学家研究了从福利规则到投票身份要求等众多州法律的影响。然而，对于所有这些政策评估，我们对政策扩散了解多少——这些政策如何在一个州之间引入和传播？我们根据过去七几十年的602美国国家政策数据集提出了一系列事实。 第一，国家能力的代理并不能预测创新新政策的更高可能性，但国家的政治倾向确实预测自1990以来引入党派法律的可能性更高。 第二，政策从1950到2000的传播最好通过邻近性来预测——如果附近的州已经采取了一项政策，那么该州更有可能采取政策——以及选民政策偏好的相似性。 第三，自2000以来，政党联盟已成为扩散的最强预测因素，并且采用的速度有所加快。学习模型和相关偏好可以解释早期的模式，但过去几十年的研究结果表明政党控制的作用急剧增强。我们的结论是，政党两极分化最近已成为政策采纳的关键因素，这可能导致国家政策与选民偏好之间的匹配度较差。

records.title_en: Capital Requirements with Non-Bank Finance
records.title_cn: 非银行融资的资本要求
records.abstract_en: I quantitatively analyse the macroeconomic impacts of raising capital requirements in a model in which heterogeneous firms may choose either intermediated or direct finance. Heterogeneous banks compete with other banks and the bond market, fund loans with insured deposits and costly equity (subject to a minimum capital-to-asset ratio), and monitor borrowers. I find that tighter capital requirements reduce costly bank failures while having only small effects on key macroeconomic aggregates, and that raising capital requirements above current levels can be welfare-improving. Three main forces give rise to these results. First, even though banks cut loan supply for a given level of net worth under a tighter capital requirement, in equilibrium banks’ net worth rises to dampen this effect. Second, intense competition from the non-bank sector disciplines banks’ lending responses to tighter regulation. Third, substitution by corporate firms offsets much of the decline in debt financing associated with tighter bank loan supply. As a corollary, almost all of the modest costs associated with tighter capital requirements are concentrated within the bank-dependent non-corporate sector.
records.abstract_cn: 我在一个模型中定量分析了提高资本要求对宏观经济的影响，在该模型中，异质企业可以选择中介融资或直接融资。异构银行与其他银行和债券市场竞争，用受保险的存款和昂贵的股权（受最低资本资产比率限制）为贷款提供资金，并监控借款人。我发现，更严格的资本要求可以减少代价高昂的银行倒闭，同时对关键宏观经济总量的影响很小，而且将资本要求提高到当前水平之上可以改善福利。 三主要力量造成了这些结果。 第一，即使银行在资本要求收紧的情况下削减给定净值水平的贷款供应，在均衡状态下，银行净值的上升会抑制这种影响。 第二，来自非银行部门的激烈竞争限制了银行对更严格监管的放贷反应。 第三，公司企业的替代抵消了与银行贷款供应收紧相关的债务融资的大部分下降。由此推论，几乎所有与资本要求收紧相关的适度成本都集中在依赖银行的非企业部门。

records.title_en: A Dynamic Theory of Random Price Discounts
records.title_cn: 随机价格折扣的动态理论
records.abstract_en: A seller with commitment power sets prices over time. Risk-averse buyers arrive to the market and decide when to purchase. We show that it is optimal for the seller to choose a constant high price punctuated by occasional episodes of sequential discounts that occur at random times. This optimal price-path has the property that the price a buyer ends up paying is independent of his arrival and purchase times, and only depends on his valuation. Our theory accommodates empirical findings on the timing of discounts.
records.abstract_cn: 具有承诺权的卖家会随着时间的推移设定价格。规避风险的买家到达市场并决定何时购买。我们表明，对于卖方来说，选择一个恒定的高价，并偶尔出现随机发生的连续折扣是最佳的。这种最优价格路径具有以下特性：买方最终支付的价格与他的到达和购买时间无关，并且仅取决于他的估价。我们的理论适应了折扣时机的实证研究结果。

records.title_en: Brokering Votes With Information Spread Via Social Networks
records.title_cn: 通过社交网络传播信息来促成投票
records.abstract_en: Politicians rely on political brokers to buy votes throughout much of the developing world. We investigate how social networks facilitate these vote-buying exchanges. Our conceptual framework suggests brokers should be particularly well-placed within the network to learn about non-copartisans’ reciprocity in order to target transfers effectively. As a result, parties should recruit brokers who are central among non-copartisans. We combine village network data from brokers and citizens with broker reports of vote buying, allowing us to use broker and citizen fixed effects. We show that networks diffuse information about citizens to brokers who leverage it to target transfers. In particular, among those citizens who are not registered to their party, brokers target reciprocal citizens about whom they can learn more through their network, and these citizens are more likely to support the brokers’ party. Moreover, recruited brokers are significantly more central than other citizens among non-copartisans, but not among copartisans. These results highlight the importance of information diffusion through social networks for vote buying, broker recruitment, and ultimately for political outcomes.
records.abstract_cn: 政客们依靠政治掮客在大部分发展中国家收买选票。我们研究社交网络如何促进这些买票交换。我们的概念框架表明，经纪人应该在网络中处于特别有利的位置，以了解非党派的互惠性，以便有效地瞄准转移。因此，政党应该招募在非党派人士中处于核心地位的经纪人。我们将经纪人和公民的村庄网络数据与经纪人购买选票的报告结合起来，使我们能够使用经纪人和公民的固定效应。我们表明，网络将有关公民的信息传播给经纪人，经纪人利用这些信息来进行目标转移。特别是，在那些未注册政党的公民中，经纪人瞄准了他们可以通过他们的网络了解更多信息的互惠公民，而这些公民更有可能支持经纪人的政党。此外，在非共和党人中，招募的经纪人比其他公民更重要，但在共和党人中则不然。这些结果凸显了通过社交网络传播信息对于购买选票、招募经纪人以及最终实现政治结果的重要性。

records.title_en: A Tale of Two Networks: Common Ownership and Product Market Rivalry
records.title_cn: 二网络的故事：共同所有权和产品市场竞争
records.abstract_en: We study the welfare implications of the rise of common ownership in the U.S. from 1995 to 2021. We build a general equilibrium model with a hedonic demand system in which firms compete in a network game of oligopoly. Firms are connected through two large networks: the first reflects ownership overlap, the second product market rivalry. In our model, common ownership of competing firms induces unilateral incentives to soften competition and the magnitude of the common ownership effect depends on how much the two networks overlap. We estimate our model for the universe of U.S. public corporations using a combination of firm financials, investor holdings, and text-based product similarity data. We perform counterfactual calculations to evaluate how the efficiency and the distributional impact of common ownership have evolved over time. Under the assumption that firms maximise a share-weighted average of their shareholders’ income, we find that the welfare cost of common ownership, measured as the ratio of deadweight loss to total surplus, has increased about ninefold between 1995 and 2021. Under alternative assumptions about corporate governance, the deadweight loss of common ownership ranges between 3.5 and 13.2% of total surplus in 2021. The rise of common ownership has also led to a significant reallocation of surplus from consumers to producers.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了从1995到2021美国共同所有权兴起的福利影响。我们建立了一个具有享乐需求系统的一般均衡模型，其中企业在寡头垄断的网络博弈中竞争。企业通过二大型网络连接起来：第一反映了所有权重叠，第二产品市场竞争。在我们的模型中，竞争企业的共同所有权会引发单方面激励来软化竞争，而共同所有权效应的大小取决于二网络重叠的程度。我们结合公司财务状况、投资者持股和基于文本的产品相似性数据来估计美国上市公司的模型。我们进行反事实计算，以评估共同所有权的效率和分配影响如何随着时间的推移而演变。假设公司最大化股东收入的股票加权平均值，我们发现共同所有权的福利成本（以无谓损失与总盈余之比衡量）在1995和2021之间增加了约九倍。在有关公司治理的替代假设下，共同所有权的无谓损失范围在3.5总盈余的13.2%和2021之间。共同所有制的兴起也导致剩余从消费者到生产者的大量重新分配。

records.title_en: The Value of Information in a Congested Fishery
records.title_cn: 拥挤渔业中的信息价值
records.abstract_en: We model a fishery with potential congestion, in which firms obtain public and private signals about the location of the densest fish stock. We analytically determine the regions of parameter space where greater precision of public and/or private information increases welfare, and we examine the effects of two types of information sharing. Using high-resolution data from the world’s largest fishery, we estimate the structural model. Point estimates imply that more precise private information raises welfare, whereas more precise public information has a negligible effect on welfare. Moreover, welfare is much more sensitive to changes in the precision of private information than to changes in the precision of public information. This difference reflects the fact that public information increases congestion more than private information does. We also find empirically that a small amount of information sharing can reduce welfare, whereas more extensive information sharing raises welfare, as do information clubs.
records.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个可能存在拥挤的渔业模型，在模型中，企业获得关于鱼群最密集位置的公共信号和私人信号。我们从理论上确定了提高公共信息和（或）私人信息精度能够增进福利的参数区域，并考察两类信息共享的影响。利用来自全球最大渔业的高分辨率数据，我们估计了这一结构模型。点估计结果表明，更精确的私人信息会提高福利，而更精确的公共信息对福利的影响可以忽略不计。此外，福利对私人信息精度变化的敏感度远高于对公共信息精度变化的敏感度。这一区别源于公共信息导致的拥挤程度高于私人信息。实证结果还表明，少量信息共享可能降低福利，而更广泛的信息共享会提高福利，信息俱乐部同样能够增进福利。

records.title_en: The Effect of Provider Diversity on Racial Health Disparities: Evidence from the Military
records.title_cn: 提供者多元化对种族健康差异的影响：来自军方的证据
records.abstract_en: We assess the relationship between the racial diversity of medical providers and racial health disparities in the use of preventive care and in patient outcomes. We use unique data from the Military Health System, where we observe providers as patients so that we can identify their race, and where moves across bases change exposure to provider race in a plausibly exogenous fashion. We consider patients with four chronic, deadly, but manageable illnesses, where the relationship with the provider may have the most direct impact on health. We find striking evidence that provider racial diversity leads to reduced disparities in maintenance of preventive care and mortality.
records.abstract_cn: 我们评估医疗服务提供者的种族多样性与预防性护理使用和患者结果方面的种族健康差异之间的关系。我们使用来自军事卫生系统的独特数据，在该系统中，我们将提供者视为患者，以便我们能够识别他们的种族，并且跨基地的流动以一种看似合理的外生方式改变了提供者种族的暴露程度。我们考虑患有四慢性、致命但可控制疾病的患者，其中与提供者的关系可能对健康产生最直接的影响。我们发现惊人的证据表明，提供者的种族多样性可以减少维持预防性护理和死亡率方面的差异。

records.title_en: Counterfactual Identification and Latent Space Enumeration in Discrete Outcome Models
records.title_cn: 离散结果模型中的反事实识别和潜在空间枚举
records.abstract_en: This article provides a unified framework for studying the identification of counterfactual parameters in a general class of discrete outcome models, allowing for endogenous regressors and multidimensional latent variables, all without parametric distributional assumptions. Our main theoretical result is that, when the covariates are discrete, the infinite-dimensional latent variable distribution can be replaced with a finite-dimensional version that is equivalent from an identification perspective. The finite-dimensional latent variable distribution is constructed in practice by enumerating regions of the latent variable space with a new and efficient cell enumeration algorithm for hyperplane arrangements. We then show that bounds on a certain class of counterfactual parameters can be computed by solving a sequence of linear programming problems, and show how the researcher can introduce additional assumptions as constraints in the linear programmes. Finally, we apply the method to a mobile phone choice example with heterogeneous choice sets, and to an airline entry game example.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提供了一个统一的框架，用于研究一般类离散结果模型中反事实参数的识别，允许内生回归量和多维潜在变量，所有这些都没有参数分布假设。我们的主要理论结果是，当协变量是离散的时，无限维潜变量分布可以用从识别角度等效的有限维版本代替。在实践中，通过使用一种新的、高效的超平面排列单元枚举算法枚举潜变量空间区域来构造有限维潜变量分布。然后，我们展示了可以通过解决一系列线性规划问题来计算某类反事实参数的界限，并展示研究人员如何在线性规划中引入额外的假设作为约束。最后，我们将该方法应用于具有异构选择集的手机选择示例以及航空公司进入游戏示例。

records.title_en: Bewley Banks
records.title_cn: 比尤利银行
records.abstract_en: How do movements in the distributions of bank size and income affect the macroeconomy? To answer this question, we develop a dynamic general equilibrium model with heterogeneous financial intermediaries, incomplete markets, and aggregate uncertainty. We find that market incompleteness and uninsured idiosyncratic bank rate of return risk generate minimal concentration in the bank net worth distribution, leading to an “as-if” result, whereby the economy behaves as if it had a representative bank. However, introducing ex ante heterogeneity in the banks’ rates of return significantly raises concentration and amplifies real and financial fluctuations relative to the representative-bank case, as this increases a key sufficient statistic, the average marginal propensity to lend. We then extend the model with two empirically validated features of the banking sector—countercyclical return risk and deposit market power—and show that these amplify and dampen aggregate fluctuations, respectively. Finally, because in the model with ex ante heterogeneity the distribution of bank size is highly concentrated, shocks to the largest banks can account for almost all of the aggregate variation that is due to idiosyncratic risk, leading to granular banking and economic cycles. The failure of granular banks (“too big to fail”) produces sizeable macroeconomic crises.
records.abstract_cn: 银行规模和收入分布的变动如何影响宏观经济？为了回答这个问题，我们开发了一个具有异构金融中介、不完全市场和总体不确定性的动态一般均衡模型。我们发现，市场的不完整性和未投保的特殊银行回报率风险导致银行净值分布的集中程度最低，从而导致“假设”结果，即经济表现得就像有一家代表性银行一样。然而，在银行回报率中引入事前异质性会显着提高集中度，并放大相对于代表性银行案例的实际波动和金融波动，因为这增加了一个关键的充分统计数据，即平均边际贷款倾向。然后，我们用二经过实证验证的银行业特征——反周期回报风险和存款市场力量——来扩展该模型，并表明这些特征分别会放大和抑制总波动。最后，由于在事前异质性模型中，银行规模的分布高度集中，因此对最大银行的冲击可以解释几乎所有由特殊风险引起的总体变化，从而导致银行业和经济周期的细化。颗粒银行的倒闭（“太大而不能倒闭”）会产生相当大的宏观经济危机。

records.title_en: The Micro and Macro Effects of Changes in the Potential Benefit Duration
records.title_cn: 潜在受益期限变化的微观和宏观影响
records.abstract_en: We quantify micro and macro effects of changes in the potential benefit duration (PBD) in unemployment insurance. In Poland, the PBD is 12 months for the newly unemployed if the previous year’s county unemployment rate is more than 150% of the national average, and 6 months otherwise. We exploit this cut-off using regression discontinuity estimates on registry data containing the universe of unemployed from 2005 to 2019. For those whose PBD is directly affected by the policy rule, benefit recipients younger than 50, a PBD increase from 6 to 12 months leads to 13% higher unemployment. A decomposition analysis reveals that 12 months after an increase in the PBD, only half of the increase in unemployment is due to the effect on search effort (the micro effect) while the other half is due to increased inflows into unemployment. The total effect on unemployment, which includes equilibrium effects, is entirely explained by the increase in unemployment of workers directly affected by the policy change. We find no evidence of spill-overs on two distinct groups of unemployed whose PBD is unchanged and no effect on measures of labour market tightness.
records.abstract_cn: 我们量化失业保险潜在福利期限（PBD）变化的微观和宏观影响。在波兰，如果上一年县失业率超过全国平均水平的 12，新失业人员的 PBD 为 150% 个月，否则为 6 个月。我们利用对包含 2005 到 2019 失业人群的登记数据的回归不连续性估计来利用这一截止点。对于那些 PBD 直接受政策规则影响的人，即年龄小于 50 的受益人，PBD 从 6 增加到 12 个月会导致 13% 更高的失业率。分解分析表明，在 PBD 增加 12 个月后，失业增加中只有一半是由于对搜索工作的影响（微观效应），而另一半是由于失业流入增加。对失业的总影响（包括均衡效应）完全可以用受政策变化直接影响的工人失业增加来解释。我们没有发现任何证据表明对二不同失业群体的PBD没有变化的溢出效应，并且对劳动力市场紧张程度没有影响。

records.title_en: Estimating Welfare Effects in a Non-Parametric Choice Model: The Case of School Vouchers
records.title_cn: 估计非参数选择模型中的福利效应：学券案例
records.abstract_en: We develop new robust discrete choice tools to learn about the average willingness to pay for a price subsidy and its effects on demand given exogenous, discrete variation in prices. Our starting point is a non-parametric, non-separable model of choice. We exploit the insight that our welfare parameters in this model can be expressed as functions of demand for the different alternatives. However, while the variation in the data reveals the value of demand at the observed prices, the parameters generally depend on its values beyond these prices. We show how to sharply characterize what we can learn when demand is specified to be entirely non-parametric or to be parametrized in a flexible manner, both of which imply that the parameters are not necessarily point identified. We use our tools to analyse the welfare effects of price subsidies provided by school vouchers in the DC Opportunity Scholarship Program. We find that the provision of the status quo voucher and a wide range of counterfactual vouchers of different amounts can have positive and potentially large benefits net of costs. The positive effect can be explained by the popularity of low-tuition schools in the programme; removing them from the programme can result in a negative net benefit. We also find that various standard logit specifications, in comparison, limit attention to demand functions with low demand for the voucher, which do not capture the large magnitudes of benefits credibly consistent with the data.
records.abstract_cn: 我们开发了新的稳健的离散选择工具，以了解支付价格补贴的平均意愿及其在价格外生离散变化的情况下对需求的影响。我们的出发点是选择一个非参数、不可分离的模型。我们利用这样的见解：该模型中的福利参数可以表示为不同替代方案的需求函数。然而，虽然数据的变化揭示了观察价格下的需求价值，但参数通常取决于这些价格之外的需求价值。我们展示了当需求被指定为完全非参数化或以灵活的方式参数化时，如何清晰地描述我们可以学到的东西，这两者都意味着参数不一定是点识别的。我们使用我们的工具来分析 DC 机会奖学金计划中学校优惠券提供的价格补贴的福利影响。我们发现，提供现状凭证和各种不同金额的反事实凭证可以带来积极且潜在的巨大收益（扣除成本后）。积极效果可以通过该计划中低学费学校的受欢迎程度来解释；将它们从计划中删除可能会导致净收益为负。相比之下，我们还发现各种标准 Logit 规范限制了对优惠券需求较低的需求函数的关注，而这些需求函数无法捕获与数据可信一致的大量收益。

records.title_en: A Walrasian Mechanism with Markups for Nonconvex Markets
records.title_cn: 非凸市场加价的瓦尔拉斯机制
records.abstract_en: We introduce markup equilibrium—an extension of Walrasian equilibrium in which consumers pay a fixed percentage markup over producer prices. In quasilinear markets, markup equilibria exist despite nonconvexities. They are resource-feasible and envy-free, incur no budget deficit, and require little more communication and computation than ordinary Walrasian equilibrium. The associated markup mechanism is asymptotically incentive-compatible. We also introduce a Bound-Form First Welfare Theorem, which states that for any feasible allocation, the welfare loss compared to the first-best is bounded, using any price vector, by the sum of the resulting (i) budget surplus and (ii) rationing losses suffered by the participants. Using producer prices, this bound implies that any markup equilibrium with a small markup and few unallocated goods is nearly efficient.
records.abstract_cn: 我们引入加价均衡——瓦尔拉斯均衡的延伸，其中消费者支付比生产者价格固定百分比的加价。在拟线性市场中，尽管存在非凸性，但加价均衡仍然存在。它们资源可行、无嫉妒，不会产生预算赤字，并且比普通的瓦尔拉斯均衡需要更多的沟通和计算。相关的加价机制是渐近激励兼容的。我们还引入了有界形式第一福利定理，该定理指出，对于任何可行的分配，使用任何价格向量，与第一最佳分配相比，福利损失受到由此产生的（i）预算盈余和（ii）参与者遭受的配给损失之和的限制。使用生产者价格，这个界限意味着任何具有小加价和少量未分配商品的加价均衡几乎是有效的。

records.title_en: Homeownership, Polarization, and Inequality
records.title_cn: 住房拥有率、两极分化和不平等
records.abstract_en: Why are job polarization and income inequality higher in large U.S. cities? I offer a new explanation: when house prices grow faster in large cities, middle-income households increasingly cannot afford to own a house there. They move to smaller cities and the middle of the income distribution in large cities hollows out, making them more polarized and unequal. I document that (1) cities with higher price growth experienced larger polarization and increase in inequality since 1980 and (2) middle-income households migrate more often to cheaper locations for housing-related reasons than low- or high-income households. Using a spatial equilibrium model with tenure choice and skill heterogeneity, I find that excess growth of prices relative to incomes and rents in large cities accounts for nearly all of the gap in polarization and almost one-half of the gap in inequality growth between large and small cities from 1980 to 2019.
records.abstract_cn: 为什么美国大城市的就业两极分化和收入不平等更加严重？ I offer a new explanation: when house prices grow faster in large cities, middle-income households increasingly cannot afford to own a house there.他们搬到较小的城市，大城市收入分配的中间部分被掏空，使他们更加两极分化和不平等。 I document that (1) cities with higher price growth experienced larger polarization and increase in inequality since 1980 and (2) middle-income households migrate more often to cheaper locations for housing-related reasons than low- or high-income households. Using a spatial equilibrium model with tenure choice and skill heterogeneity, I find that excess growth of prices relative to incomes and rents in large cities accounts for nearly all of the gap in polarization and almost 一-half of the gap in inequality growth between large and small cities from 1980 to 2019.

records.title_en: Reallocative Auctions and Core Selection
records.title_cn: 重新分配拍卖和核心选择
records.abstract_en: When selling goods like wireless spectrum or electricity contracts, designers often opt for core-selecting mechanisms—i.e. those that induce outcomes in the core—in order to balance revenue and efficiency goals. But increasingly, auctions—such as the Federal Communications Commission’s Incentive Auction and those explored for natural resources—seek to reallocate goods, not just sell them. We show that when bidders can both buy and sell, substitutability among goods is no longer sufficient or necessary for core selection. In particular, in these environments, core selection can fail even with a single good and positive revenue, and can succeed even when some or all bidders view goods as complements. Instead, we show that the key feature that determines core selection is heterogeneity among the bidders. With too much heterogeneity, reallocation mostly realises pre-existing gains from trade among the bidders, and core selection fails. With limited heterogeneity, most gains from trade among the bidders are created by the quantity auctioned, and a core-selecting mechanism is possible.
records.abstract_cn: 在销售无线频谱或电力合同等商品时，设计者通常会选择核心选择机制，即那些在核心中产生结果的方法——以平衡收入和效率目标。 But increasingly, auctions—such as the Federal Communications Commission’s Incentive Auction and those explored for natural resources—seek to reallocate goods, not just sell them.我们表明，当投标人既可以购买也可以出售时，商品之间的可替代性对于核心选择来说不再是充分或必要的。 In particular, in these environments, core selection can fail even with a single good and positive revenue, and can succeed even when some or all bidders view goods as complements.相反，我们表明决定核心选择的关键特征是投标人之间的异质性。由于异质性太大，重新分配大多实现了投标人之间交易的既有收益，核心选择失败。 With limited heterogeneity, most gains from trade among the bidders are created by the quantity auctioned, and a core-selecting mechanism is possible.

records.title_en: The Geography of Business Dynamism and Skill-Biased Technical Change
records.title_cn: 商业动态的地理和以技能为导向的技术变革
records.abstract_en: This paper shows that the growing disparities between big and small cities in the U.S. since 1980 can be explained by firms endogenously responding to a skill-biased technology shock. With the introduction of a new skill-biased technology that is high fixed cost but low marginal cost, firms endogenously adopt more in big cities, cities that offer abundant amenities for high-skilled workers, and cities that are more productive in using high-skilled labour. In cities with more adoption, small and unproductive firms are more likely to exit the market, increasing the equilibrium rate of turnover or business dynamism—a selection effect similar to Melitz (2003). Differences in technology adoption and selection account for three key components of the growing regional disparities, known as the Great Divergence: (1) big cities saw a larger increase in the relative wages and supply of skilled workers, (2) big cities saw a smaller decline in business dynamism, and (3) firms in big cities invest more intensively in information and communication technology.
records.abstract_cn: This paper shows that the growing disparities between big and small cities in the U.S. since 1980 can be explained by firms endogenously responding to a skill-biased technology shock.随着固定成本高但边际成本低的偏向技能的新技术的引入，企业会在大城市、为高技能工人提供丰富便利设施的城市以及在使用高技能劳动力方面效率更高的城市内生地采用更多技术。 In cities with more adoption, small and unproductive firms are more likely to exit the market, increasing the equilibrium rate of turnover or business dynamism—a selection effect similar to Melitz (2003). Differences in technology adoption and selection account for 三 key components of the growing regional disparities, known as the Great Divergence: (1) big cities saw a larger increase in the relative wages and supply of skilled workers, (2) big cities saw a smaller decline in business dynamism, and (3) firms in big cities invest more intensively in information and communication technology.

records.title_en: The Macroeconomic Impact of Climate Change: Global Versus Local Temperature
records.title_cn: 气候变化的宏观经济影响：全球温度与当地温度
records.abstract_en: This article estimates that the macroeconomic damages from climate change are an order of magnitude larger than previously thought. Exploiting natural global temperature variability, we find that 1ºC warming reduces world GDP by over 20% in the long run. Global temperature correlates strongly with extreme climatic events, unlike country-level temperature used in previous work, explaining our larger estimate. We use this evidence to estimate damage functions in a neoclassical growth model. Business-as-usual warming implies a present welfare loss of more than 30%, and a social cost of carbon in excess of $1,200 per ton. These impacts suggest that unilateral decarbonization policy is cost-effective for large countries such as the United States.
records.abstract_cn: 本文估计，气候变化对宏观经济造成的损害比之前认为的要大一个数量级。利用全球自然温度变化，我们发现从长远来看，1°C 变暖会使世界 GDP 减少超过 20%。与之前工作中使用的国家级温度不同，全球温度与极端气候事件密切相关，这解释了我们更大的估计。我们利用这一证据来估计新古典增长模型中的损害函数。一切照旧的变暖意味着目前的福利损失超过30%，碳的社会成本超过每吨1,200美元。这些影响表明，单边脱碳政策对于美国等大国来说是具有成本效益的。

records.title_en: A Theory of How Workers Keep up with Inflation
records.title_cn: 工人如何应对通货膨胀的理论
records.abstract_en: We develop a model that integrates modern theories of labor market flows with nominal wage rigidities to study the consequences of inflation on the labor market. Nominal wage stickiness incentivizes workers to engage in job-to-job transitions after an unexpected increase in the price level. Such dynamics lead to a rise in aggregate vacancies associating a seemingly tight labor market with lower real wages—two facts observed during the recent inflation period. The calibrated model jointly matches aggregate and cross-sectional trends in worker flows and wages during the 2021–2024 period. Using historical data, we show that prior periods of high inflation were also associated with increasing vacancies and upward shifts in the Beveridge curve. Our results suggest that policy makers and academics should be cautious about viewing the rise in the vacancy-to-unemployment rate as a sign of a tight labor market during inflationary periods without holistically looking at other labor market indicators.
records.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一个模型，将现代劳动力市场流动理论与名义工资刚性相结合，以研究通货膨胀对劳动力市场的影响。名义工资粘性会激励工人在物价水平意外上涨后进行工作转换。这种动态导致总职位空缺的增加，将看似紧张的劳动力市场与较低的实际工资联系起来——二在最近的通货膨胀时期观察到的事实。校准模型共同匹配2021-2024期间工人流动和工资的总体和横截面趋势。利用历史数据，我们发现先前的高通胀时期也与职位空缺增加和贝弗里奇曲线上移有关。我们的研究结果表明，政策制定者和学者应该谨慎对待，不要将空缺率与失业率的上升视为通胀时期劳动力市场紧张的迹象，而不全面考虑其他劳动力市场指标。

records.title_en: Disaggregated Economic Accounts
records.title_cn: 分类经济账户
records.abstract_en: We develop a system of disaggregated economic accounts. The system breaks down national accounting positions into bilateral flows between consistently defined groups of consumers (consumer cells), groups of producers (producer cells), the government, and the rest of the world. We disaggregate the full circular flow of money, including consumer spending, labor compensation, firm profits, intermediates trade, foreign trade, and government transactions, while satisfying all national accounting identities. We implement the disaggregated system for small region-by-industry cells in Denmark and present stylized facts, such as variation in domestic spending, local and urban bias in consumer spending, and a pattern of triangular flows across regions. Cell-level measures of spending intensity capture how much spending by a cell contributes to the income of cells experiencing unemployment after a shock. Using a general equilibrium model, we show that fiscal transfers raise aggregate GDP by more when they target cells with high spending intensity on unemployed cells. The disaggregated economic accounts help governments select more effective policies.
records.abstract_cn: 我们开发了分类经济账户体系。该系统将国民核算头寸分解为一致定义的消费者群体（消费者细胞）、生产者群体（生产者细胞）、政府和世界其他地区之间的双边流动。我们对货币的完整循环流动进行分类，包括消费者支出、劳动报酬、企业利润、中间品贸易、对外贸易和政府交易，同时满足所有国民核算恒等式。我们在丹麦按行业划分的小区域实施了分类系统，并提供了程式化的事实，例如国内支出的变化、消费者支出的地方和城市偏见以及跨区域的三角流动模式。支出强度的单元级衡量指标反映了单元的支出对冲击后经历失业的单元的收入做出了多少贡献。使用一般均衡模型，我们表明，当财政转移支付针对失业细胞的高支出强度的细胞时，可以使总 GDP 提高更多。分类经济账户有助于政府选择更有效的政策。

records.title_en: Complete Pass-Through in Levels
records.title_cn: 关卡中的完整传递
records.abstract_en: Empirical studies find that the pass-through of input cost changes to prices is incomplete: a 10% increase in costs causes downstream prices to rise less than 10%, even at long horizons. Using microdata from gas stations, food products, and manufacturing industries, I find that incomplete pass-through in percentages often disguises complete pass-through in levels: a $1/unit increase in input costs leads to $1/unit higher downstream prices. Pass-through appears incomplete in percentages due to a gap between prices and costs. Complete pass-through in levels contrasts with workhorse macroeconomic models that feature homothetic industry demand systems. I identify an alternative class of demand systems that yields pass-through in levels and highlight four implications. First, measuring pass-through in percentages can lead to spurious evidence of asymmetry and size dependence. Second, pass-through in levels leads to systematic fluctuations in relative price and markup dispersion that are not associated with changes in allocative efficiency. Third, pass-through in levels can explain dynamics of industry gross margins, operating profits, and entry in the data that are at odds with workhorse models. Finally, incorporating pass-through in levels into an input-output model of the U.S. economy better matches the volatility of consumer price inflation and the response of inflation to identified shocks.
records.abstract_cn: 实证研究发现，投入成本变化对价格的传递是不完全的：成本的10%增加导致下游价格的涨幅低于10%，即使从长远来看也是如此。使用来自加油站、食品和制造业的微观数据，我发现不完全的百分比传递常常掩盖了完全的水平传递：投入成本每单位$1的增加导致下游价格上涨$1/单位。由于价格和成本之间的差距，转嫁百分比似乎不完整。水平上的完全传递与以拟似行业需求系统为特征的主力宏观经济模型形成鲜明对比。我确定了另一种需求系统，它产生级别传递并强调四影响。 第一，以百分比测量传递可能会导致不对称和尺寸依赖性的虚假证据。 第二，水平的传递导致相对价格和加价离散度的系统性波动，而这些波动与配置效率的变化无关。 第三，水平传递可以解释与主力模型不一致的行业毛利率、营业利润和数据条目的动态。最后，将水平传递纳入美国经济的投入产出模型可以更好地匹配消费者价格通胀的波动性以及通胀对已确定冲击的反应。

records.title_en: Changing Opportunity: Sociological Mechanisms Underlying Growing Class Gaps and Shrinking Race Gaps in Economic Mobility
records.title_cn: 不断变化的机会：经济流动性中阶级差距扩大和种族差距缩小的社会学机制
records.abstract_en: We show that intergenerational mobility changed rapidly by race and class in recent decades in the United States and study the causal mechanisms underlying those changes. Between the 1978 and 1992 birth cohorts, earnings increased for white children from high-income families relative to white children from low-income families, increasing earnings gaps by parental income (class) by 30%. Earnings increased for Black children at all parental income levels, reducing white-Black earnings gaps for children from low-income families by 30%. Class gaps grew and race gaps shrank similarly for nonmonetary outcomes such as educational attainment, standardized test scores, and mortality rates. Using a quasi-experimental design, we show that the divergent trends in economic mobility were caused by differential changes in childhood environments, as proxied by parental employment rates, in local communities defined by race, class, and childhood county. Outcomes improve across birth cohorts for children who grow up in communities with increasing parental employment rates, with larger effects for children who move to such communities at younger ages.
