Due to the non-Ricardian nature of our framework, a demand for liquidity emerges and the supply of bonds matters. We show that shocks affecting the supply or demand of assets have very different international spillovers for an economy in a liquidity trap. A decrease in the supply of assets issued abroad leads to an asset shortage domestically. In normal times, the nominal interest rate decreases, stimulating investment and output. In a liquidity trap, deflation hits instead and the currency appreciates, which may cause a recession.
records.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个包含二个国家的异质代理非里卡多模型，模型中体现了资产稀缺性和国际资本市场的金融摩擦。由于框架的非里卡多性质，流动性需求出现，债券供给变得重要。我们展示了影响资产供给或需求的冲击对处于流动性陷阱经济体的国际溢出效应截然不同。国外发行资产供给的减少导致国内资产短缺。在正常时期，名义利率下降，刺激投资和产出。而在流动性陷阱中，则出现通货紧缩，货币升值，可能引发经济衰退。

records.title_en: Careers in multinational enterprises
records.title_cn: 跨国企业中的职业发展
records.abstract_en: Do workers in multinational enterprises (MNEs) build stronger CVs? We track the careers of all workers entering the Dutch labor market over the years 2006–2021 and find large, portable wage premia of MNE employment experience. Workers with experience at MNEs instead of domestic firms earn up to 14% higher wages within the MNE, and up to 11% higher wages after moving to another firm. Consistent with a model of MNEs that leverage their employment experience premia, we document that MNEs hire more juniors, pay lower starting wages, and are more selective in the employment of senior workers than domestic firms.
records.abstract_cn: 跨国企业（MNEs）的员工是否能打造更强的简历？我们追踪了所有在2006-2021年进入荷兰劳动力市场的工人职业轨迹，发现跨国企业工作经验带来了显著且可转移的工资溢价。拥有跨国企业工作经验的员工在跨国企业内部的工资最高可比国内企业高出14%，在跳槽到其他公司后工资最高可高出11%。与跨国企业利用其就业经验溢价的模型一致，我们记录到跨国企业雇佣更多初级员工，起薪较低，并且在雇佣高级员工时比国内企业更具选择性。

records.title_en: Domestic wedges and the (in)sensitivity of CPI to exchange rates
records.title_cn: 国内楔子与CPI对汇率的（不）敏感性
records.abstract_en: Earlier literature highlights domestic wedges — distribution costs, variable markups, and nominal rigidities — in limiting exchange rate pass-through to consumer prices. Using granular Chilean data, I quantify their impact, considering input–output linkages and sectoral heterogeneity. Domestic wedges reduce CPI sensitivity to exchange rate fluctuations by 57%. Distribution costs account for 48% of the overall reduction in sensitivity, variable markups for 29%, and nominal rigidities for 23%. These factors dampen CPI sensitivity more than incomplete pass-through into prices at the border. Eliminating sectoral heterogeneity in wedges increases CPI response by 55%, as import exposure positively correlates with wedge strength. Ignoring this heterogeneity misidentifies key sectors driving exchange rate effects on consumer prices. Contrary to earlier quantification strategies, I show that CPI sensitivity mainly stems from imported consumption goods, as domestic wedges weaken the amplification role of input–output linkages.
records.abstract_cn: 早期文献强调国内楔子——分销成本、可变加价和名义刚性——在限制汇率传递至消费者价格中的作用。利用细化的智利数据，我量化了它们的影响，考虑了投入产出联系和部门异质性。国内楔子使CPI对汇率波动的敏感性降低了57%。分销成本占整体敏感性降低的48%，可变加价占29%，名义刚性占23%。这些因素对CPI敏感性的抑制作用超过了边境价格的不完全传递。消除楔子的部门异质性会使CPI响应增加55%，因为进口暴露度与楔子强度正相关。忽视这种异质性会错误识别推动汇率对消费者价格影响的关键部门。与早期量化策略相反，我表明CPI敏感性主要源自进口消费品，因为国内楔子削弱了投入产出联系的放大作用。

records.title_en: Preferential credit policy with sectoral markup heterogeneity
records.title_cn: 具有行业加价异质性的优惠信贷政策
records.abstract_en: Many emerging economies employ preferential credit policies that target selected sectors. This paper quantifies the implications of such policies for aggregate productivity and welfare. Using Chinese firm-level data from 2009–2020, we first document that sectors with higher markups receive larger credit subsidies and exhibit higher revenue-based productivity. Motivated by these facts, we develop a multi-sector quantitative model with endogenously determined markups and calibrate it to match the distribution of sales both within and across sectors. We find that preferential credit subsidies raise aggregate productivity and welfare by reallocating market shares toward high-markup sectors. These gains persist in an extended framework with endogenous firm entry.
records.abstract_cn: 许多新兴经济体采用针对特定行业的优惠信贷政策。本文量化了此类政策对整体生产率和福利的影响。利用来自2009-2020的中国企业层面数据，我们记录到加价较高的行业获得更大规模的信贷补贴，并表现出更高的基于收入的生产率。基于这些事实，我们构建了一个多行业定量模型，模型中加价是内生决定的，并对模型进行了校准，以匹配行业内及行业间的销售分布。研究发现，优惠信贷补贴通过将市场份额重新分配到加价较高的行业，提高了整体生产率和福利。这些收益在包含内生企业进入的扩展框架中依然存在。

records.title_en: Exports and intergenerational mobility
records.title_cn: 出口与代际流动性
records.abstract_en: Using eight rounds of the Vietnam Household Living Standards Surveys spanning 16 years and exploiting the US-Vietnam Bilateral Trade Agreement (BTA) in 2001, we investigate the impact of this large export shock on intergenerational occupational mobility. The BTA has, on average, led to greater upward absolute occupational mobility among sons and daughters, with effects following roughly a U-shape by age for sons and an inverse-U for daughters. However, relative occupational mobility, inversely related to the gradient of the child’s occupational rank as a function of the parent’s, decreased on average as a result of the BTA, with this effect also varying across age groups. While the BTA improved occupational mobility for an average child, children born to top-ranked parents benefited disproportionately. Also, the BTA increased human capital investment in college education across genders and vocational training for sons. Furthermore, higher individual and initial province-level human capital facilitated this mobility.
records.abstract_cn: 利用涵盖16年间的越南家庭生活标准调查的八轮数据，并利用2001年签署的美越双边贸易协定（BTA），我们研究了这一重大出口冲击对代际职业流动性的影响。BTA平均而言促进了子女的绝对职业向上流动，儿子的影响呈大致U型年龄分布，女儿则呈倒U型。然而，作为子女职业排名相对于父母职业排名梯度的反函数的相对职业流动性，平均来看因BTA而下降，该效应在不同年龄组间也存在差异。尽管BTA改善了平均子女的职业流动性，但出身于顶级职业父母的子女受益更为显著。此外，BTA促进了男女子女在大学教育上的人力资本投资，以及儿子的职业培训投资。进一步地，更高的个体及初始省级人力资本水平促进了这种流动性。

records.title_en: Firm networks and global technology diffusion
records.title_cn: 企业网络与全球技术扩散
records.abstract_en: This paper examines how multinational firms and global value chain linkages facilitate the cross-country diffusion of emerging technologies. Leveraging detailed data on online job postings across 17 countries and multinational firm linkages from 2014 to 2022, we analyze the propagation of jobs related to emerging technologies through firm networks. Our findings reveal that emerging technology jobs are highly concentrated within multinational firms and their supply chains, with nearly one-third of postings from Fortune 500 firms, their affiliates, buyers, suppliers, or innovation partners. Although related job openings initially cluster in locations where technologies originate, this advantage diminishes over time as technologies diffuse to wealthier and geographically closer countries and regions. This paper highlights the important role of firm-to-firm linkages in channeling technology diffusion: firms that were previously buyers or innovation partners of establishments in technology-originating locations exhibit faster growth in technology-related jobs.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了跨国企业和全球价值链联系如何促进新兴技术的跨国扩散。利用涵盖17个国家的在线职位发布详细数据以及从2014到2022的跨国企业联系数据，我们分析了新兴技术相关职位通过企业网络的传播。研究结果显示，新兴技术职位高度集中于跨国企业及其供应链，近一-第三的职位发布来自财富500企业、其附属机构、买方、供应商或创新合作伙伴。尽管相关职位最初集中于技术起源地，但随着技术向更富裕且地理位置更近的国家和地区扩散，这一优势随时间减弱。本文强调了企业间联系在技术扩散中的重要作用：此前作为技术起源地机构买方或创新合作伙伴的企业，其技术相关职位增长更快。

records.title_en: Trade in appliances, household production, and labor force participation
records.title_cn: 家用电器贸易、家庭生产与劳动参与
records.abstract_en: We examine how trade influences female labor supply through reductions in the prices of household appliances that substitute for domestic labor. Using a comprehensive data set from 1981 to 2017, which includes four population censuses, household surveys, and customs records from Peru, we show that labor force participation rose at the same time that appliance import prices fell. We then develop and estimate a dynamic general equilibrium model of trade and household production, to quantitatively evaluate the aggregate impact of declining appliance prices. We find that the reduction in appliance prices during the sample period leads to an increase in female labor force participation that explains one tenth of the total rise in female labor participation in Peru over the past 30 years.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究贸易如何通过降低替代家庭劳动的家用电器价格来影响女性劳动供给。利用涵盖1981至2017期间的秘鲁四人口普查、家庭调查和海关记录的综合数据集，我们发现劳动参与率在家用电器进口价格下降的同时上升。随后，我们构建并估计了一个贸易与家庭生产的动态一般均衡模型，以定量评估家用电器价格下降的总体影响。结果显示，样本期间家用电器价格的下降导致女性劳动参与率的提高，解释了过去30年秘鲁女性劳动参与率总增长的一 第十。

records.title_en: Structural change in sub-Saharan Africa: An open economy perspective
records.title_cn: 撒哈拉以南非洲的结构变迁：开放经济视角
records.abstract_en: We study the evolution of manufacturing value-added shares in 11 sub-Saharan African (SSA) countries through the lens of an open economy model of structural change. Our analysis leverages recent developments in input–output tables in SSA countries. Our model allows for income effects, substitution and relative price effects, and comparative advantage and specialization effects. We calibrate our model to include each SSA country with nine major economies for each year between 2000 and 2018. We do similar calibrations for 11 developing Asian (DA) countries. Our main results are that domestic and foreign sectoral TFP are important drivers of structural change. Trade integration over time plays a small role. However, trade is important as a transmission mechanism of foreign productivity trends. While the drivers and mechanisms of industrialization are broadly similar in SSA and DA countries, one difference is the larger mining sector in SSA countries, which generates Dutch disease-type effects.
records.abstract_cn: 我们通过开放经济结构变迁模型研究了11个撒哈拉以南非洲（SSA）国家制造业增加值份额的演变。我们的分析利用了SSA国家投入-产出表的最新发展。我们的模型允许收入效应、替代和相对价格效应，以及比较优势和专业化效应。我们校准了我们的模型，以包括每个SSA国家与2000年至2018年每年九个主要经济体。我们对11个发展中亚洲（DA）国家进行了类似的校准。我们的主要结果是，国内和外国部门的全要素生产率是结构变迁的重要驱动因素。随着时间的推移，贸易一体化发挥了较小的作用。然而，贸易作为外国生产率趋势的传导机制很重要。虽然SSA和DA国家的工业化驱动因素和机制大体相似，但一个区别是SSA国家更大的采矿业，这产生了荷兰病类型的效应。

records.title_en: The US-China trade war creates jobs (elsewhere)
records.title_cn: 美中贸易战创造了（其他地区的）就业岗位
records.abstract_en: We examine the indirect effects of the 2018-2019 US-China trade war on Brazil’s labor market. We construct a measure of regional exposure to the trade conflict using industry-specific tariff changes and the sectoral employment distribution across local labor markets. Following higher Brazilian exports to China, our findings reveal that regions more exposed to Chinese retaliatory tariffs on US exports experienced a relative increase in formal employment and wage bills. In contrast, American tariffs on Chinese exports had no significant impact on Brazilian labor markets. These asymmetric responses are consistent with Brazil’s pattern of comparative advantage. Our results contribute to a better understanding of the intricate worldwide implications of bilateral trade wars.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考察了美中贸易战（2018-2019）对巴西劳动力市场的间接影响。我们利用行业特定的关税变动和地方劳动力市场的部门就业分布，构建了一个衡量地区对贸易冲突暴露程度的指标。随着巴西对中国出口的增加，我们的研究发现，受中国对美出口报复性关税影响较大的地区，其正规就业和工资总额相对增加。相比之下，美国对中国出口的关税对巴西劳动力市场没有显著影响。这种不对称反应与巴西的比较优势模式相一致。我们的结果有助于更好地理解双边贸易战在全球范围内复杂的影响。

records.title_en: Multinational investment activity under policy uncertainty in host and competing countries
records.title_cn: 东道国与竞争国政策不确定性下的跨国投资活动
records.abstract_en: This paper examines how economic policy uncertainty (EPU) in host and competing countries reshapes U.S. multinationals’ greenfield foreign direct investment (FDI). Using firm–destination level data from 2003 to 2021, we show that while host-country EPU deters investment, EPU in competing destinations attracts it through a spillover effect. We document a structural shift around 2015: as global EPU rose unevenly, the spillover effect from competitors became the dominant driver of investment decisions, supplanting the direct effect of host-country policy instability. Our findings indicate that in an era of heightened global uncertainty and risk, FDI allocation is governed by relative, not just absolute, policy stability.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了东道国与竞争国的经济政策不确定性（EPU）如何重塑美国跨国公司的绿地外商直接投资（FDI）。利用2003至2021期间的企业-目的地层面数据，我们发现东道国的EPU抑制投资，而竞争目的地的EPU通过溢出效应吸引投资。我们记录了2015前后的结构性转变：随着全球EPU不均衡上升，竞争国的溢出效应成为投资决策的主导因素，取代了东道国政策不稳定性的直接影响。我们的研究表明，在全球不确定性和风险加剧的时代，FDI配置受相对政策稳定性而非仅绝对政策稳定性的支配。

records.title_en: Globalization and the gender gap in mental well-being
records.title_cn: 全球化与心理健康性别差距
records.abstract_en: Working with business partners in distant countries often requires operating outside standard working hours, potentially harming workers’ mental well-being—especially for women balancing professional and family responsibilities. This hypothesis is investigated using matched employer–employee data from Denmark merged with information on workers’ use of prescription antidepressants (AD) and firms’ import and export transactions. The analysis exploits variation within job spells and controls for both unobservable firm-year heterogeneity and for the average differential in annual AD use among men and women. The results indicate that a decline in the business hours overlap between a Danish firm and its foreign trading partners leads to an increased AD use among women relative to men. This effect is economically meaningful, largest for college-educated workers under 45 and more pronounced for single mothers. In addition to the gender effect, workers in occupations that requires establishing relationships with others are more strongly affected than those in other occupations.
records.abstract_cn: 与远方国家的商业伙伴合作通常需要在标准工作时间之外工作，这可能损害工人的心理健康——尤其是对于平衡职业和家庭责任的女性。本文利用丹麦匹配的雇主-雇员数据，结合工人处方抗抑郁药（AD）使用信息及企业进出口交易数据，检验该假设。分析利用职位期间内的变异，控制了不可观测的企业年度异质性及男女年均AD使用差异。结果表明，丹麦企业与其外国贸易伙伴的工作时间重叠减少，会导致女性相较男性的AD使用增加。该效应具有经济意义，在45下受过大学教育的工人中最大，且对单亲母亲更为显著。除性别效应外，需要建立人际关系的职业工人受影响程度也高于其他职业工人。

records.title_en: Estimating export-productivity cutoff contours with profit data: A novel threshold estimation approach
records.title_cn: 利用利润数据估计出口-生产率临界轮廓：一种新颖的阈值估计方法
records.abstract_en: This paper develops a novel method to estimate firm-specific market-entry thresholds in international economics, allowing fixed costs to vary across firms alongside productivity. Our framework models market entry as an interaction between productivity and observable fixed-cost measures, extending traditional single-threshold models to ones with set-valued thresholds. Applying this approach to Chinese firm data, we estimate export-market entry thresholds as functions of domestic sales and surrogate variables for fixed costs. The results reveal substantial heterogeneity and threshold contours, challenging conventional single-threshold-point assumptions. These findings offer new insights into firm behavior and provide a foundation for further theoretical and empirical advancements in trade research.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种新颖的方法，用于估计国际经济中企业特定的市场进入阈值，允许固定成本随企业而异，同时考虑生产率。我们的框架将市场进入建模为生产率与可观测固定成本指标的交互作用，扩展了传统的单一阈值模型，形成了集合值阈值模型。将该方法应用于中国企业数据，我们估计了出口市场进入阈值，作为国内销售额和固定成本代理变量的函数。结果显示出显著的异质性和阈值轮廓，挑战了传统的单一阈值点假设。这些发现为企业行为提供了新的见解，并为贸易研究中的理论和实证进展奠定了基础。

records.title_en: The global network of liquidity lines
records.title_cn: 全球流动性额度网络
records.abstract_en: At the end of 2025, there were 177 cross-border liquidity lines between central banks connecting countries that accounted for 81% of world GDP. This paper maps the evolution of these arrangements since 2000. We show that the lines form a network through which banks can indirectly obtain access to the USD even when their central bank has no agreement with the Federal Reserve. These indirect connections give the People’s Bank of China a central role and show the fragility of liquidity provision to geopolitical tensions. We present cross-country evidence that the indirect connections reduce CIP deviations at the tails, and causal evidence that liquidity lines are substitutes to FX reserves.
records.abstract_cn: 截至2025，中央银行之间存在177条跨境流动性额度，连接的国家占全球GDP的81%。本文绘制了自2000以来这些安排的演变过程。我们展示了这些额度形成了一个网络，通过该网络，即使某国中央银行与美联储没有协议，银行也能间接获得美元流动性。这些间接连接赋予中国人民银行核心地位，并揭示了流动性供应对地缘政治紧张局势的脆弱性。我们提供了跨国证据表明，间接连接减少了利差平价偏离的极端值，并提供了因果证据表明流动性额度是外汇储备的替代品。

records.title_en: Agricultural imports, labor mobility, and welfare
records.title_cn: 农业进口、劳动力流动性与福利
records.abstract_en: Using household- and firm-level data, we show that reductions in soybean tariffs lowered agricultural labor input and output, and improved agricultural efficiency. The shock induced a large reallocation of low-skilled labor into manufacturing, expanding firms’ employment but reducing firm-level productivity, while intensifying competition in urban low-skilled labor markets. Our quantitative analysis implies a small aggregate welfare loss, with substantial heterogeneity across sectors, regions, and skill groups. Importantly, lowering migration costs can substantially mitigate this welfare loss, highlighting the need to coordinate trade liberalization with domestic labor-market reforms. Comparing forces behind structural transformation, we find that agricultural import liberalization (“push”) was an important driver for labor reallocation, whereas manufacturing export expansion (“pull”) was the sole source of welfare gains.
records.abstract_cn: 利用家庭和企业层面数据，我们表明大豆关税的降低减少了农业劳动力投入和产出，并提高了农业效率。该冲击引发了大量低技能劳动力向制造业的重新配置，扩大了企业的就业规模，但降低了企业层面的生产率，同时加剧了城市低技能劳动力市场的竞争。我们的定量分析表明总体福利损失较小，但在部门、地区和技能群体之间存在显著异质性。重要的是，降低迁移成本可以显著缓解这一福利损失，凸显了将贸易自由化与国内劳动力市场改革协调推进的必要性。比较结构转型背后的驱动力，我们发现农业进口自由化（“推动”）是劳动力重新配置的重要驱动因素，而制造业出口扩张（“拉动”）则是福利增长的唯一来源。

records.title_en: The local-area incidence of exporting
records.title_cn: 出口的地方发生率
records.abstract_en: We develop a new algorithm to map confidential firm-level export transactions to their underlying establishments that can be implemented on U.S. microdata. Using this procedure, we construct a novel micro-dataset of U.S. exports at the plant level. Aggregation of these data permits more accurate measurement of exporting at the subnational level (e.g., county, MSA, etc.) than was previously possible. The data reveal exports to be much more geographically concentrated than both employment and manufacturing sales, implying that some regions are heavily reliant on foreign demand. To illustrate the consequences of such exposure, we study the effects of the trade collapse during the Great Recession on local labor markets. Counties experiencing greater declines in foreign demand performed worse in terms of employment, pay, and wages during the Great Recession. A similar analysis implemented with publicly available imputed export data—a common practice in the literature—fails to replicate these estimates.
records.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一种新的算法，将机密的企业级出口交易映射到其基础的生产单位，该算法可在美国微观数据上实施。利用该程序，我们构建了一个新颖的美国工厂级出口微观数据集。对这些数据的聚合使得在次国家层面（如县、都市统计区等）对出口的测量比以往更为准确。数据表明，出口的地理集中度远高于就业和制造业销售额，这意味着某些地区高度依赖外国需求。为说明这种依赖的后果，我们研究了大衰退期间贸易崩溃对地方劳动力市场的影响。经历更大外国需求下降的县在大衰退期间在就业、薪酬和工资方面表现更差。使用公开可得的估算出口数据进行的类似分析——这是文献中的常见做法——未能复制这些估计结果。

records.title_en: Real exchange rate dynamics beyond business cycles
records.title_cn: 超越经济周期的实际汇率动态
records.abstract_en: We examine the determinants of medium-run movements in real exchange rates. Using historical US–UK and cross-country data, we find that the real exchange rate co-moves with GDP at medium-run frequencies and the co-movements are significantly weakened by banking crises. This relationship can be rationalized by an extension of the IRBC model with non-stationary productivity shocks and risk-averse financial intermediaries, where crises increase intermediary risk aversion. Using a global solution method, GDSGE, we demonstrate that the transmission of productivity shocks depends critically on the international borrowing capacity which is hindered by banking crises. The mechanism differs from the Harrod–Balassa–Samuelson effect which does not generate these state dependent co-movements.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考察了实际汇率中期波动的决定因素。利用历史的美英及跨国数据，我们发现实际汇率在中期频率上与GDP呈现共同波动，且银行危机显著削弱了这种共同波动关系。该关系可通过扩展的国际真实商业周期（IRBC）模型加以解释，该模型包含非平稳生产率冲击和风险厌恶的金融中介机构，其中危机会增加中介机构的风险厌恶。采用全球解法GDSGE，我们证明了生产率冲击的传导关键依赖于国际借贷能力，而银行危机会阻碍该能力。该机制不同于哈罗德–巴拉萨–塞缪尔森效应，后者无法产生这些状态依赖的共同波动。

records.title_en: The global transmission of U.S. monetary policy
records.title_cn: 美国货币政策的全球传导
records.abstract_en: Fed’s decisions affect global economic conditions, with tightenings leading to widespread recessionary effects. Using a state-of-the-art identification strategy, a dataset covering 30 economies, and techniques for constructing empirical counterfactuals, we show that commodity and oil prices play a critical role in propagating US monetary policy to global headline inflation, generating predominantly deflationary effects. We refer to this novel mechanism as the ‘commodity price channel’ of US monetary policy.
records.abstract_cn: 美联储的决策影响全球经济状况，紧缩政策导致广泛的衰退效应。利用最先进的识别策略、涵盖30经济体的数据集以及构建经验反事实的技术，我们展示了大宗商品和石油价格在将美国货币政策传导至全球总体通胀中发挥关键作用，主要产生通缩效应。我们将这一新机制称为美国货币政策的“大宗商品价格渠道”。

records.title_en: Trade liberalization, wage rigidity, and labor market dynamics with heterogeneous firms
records.title_cn: 贸易自由化、工资刚性与异质性企业的劳动力市场动态
records.abstract_en: Trade liberalization triggers substantial within-sector labor reallocation, a pattern captured by heterogeneous-firm trade models. We study transition dynamics of firms and workers in response to changes in trade costs, incorporating labor market frictions. Responses vary by firm productivity: high-productivity exporters expand employment, while lower-productivity firms exit, downsize before exit, or gradually shrink. As a result, jobs with similar initial wages differ ex post, with high-productivity firms offering higher wages and greater stability. Calibrating the model, we quantify adjustment channels and show that gains from lower consumer prices outweigh losses from wage cuts, job destruction, and capital losses, although these losses are concentrated among a subset of workers. Downward wage rigidity can improve welfare, creating a trade-off between worker displacement and income loss.
records.abstract_cn: 贸易自由化引发了部门内大量的劳动力重新配置，这一模式被异质性企业贸易模型所捕捉。我们研究了企业和工人对贸易成本变化的过渡动态，纳入了劳动力市场摩擦。不同生产率的企业反应各异：高生产率的出口企业扩大就业，而低生产率企业则退出市场、在退出前缩减规模或逐步萎缩。因此，初始工资相似的岗位在事后表现出差异，高生产率企业提供更高工资和更大稳定性。通过模型校准，我们量化了调整渠道，显示消费者价格下降带来的收益超过了工资削减、岗位流失和资本损失带来的损失，尽管这些损失集中在部分工人群体中。向下工资刚性可以提升福利，形成了工人置换与收入损失之间的权衡。

records.title_en: Global value chains and inflation dynamics
records.title_cn: 全球价值链与通胀动态
records.abstract_en: We study the inflationary effects of pandemic lockdown shocks and fiscal and monetary stimulus over 2020-22 using a novel harmonized dataset covering producer prices and input–output linkages for 1254 country–industry pairs across 55 countries. Our identification strategy employs a Bartik shift-share design, where country–industry shares capture the heterogeneous exposure to each shock. The results show that pandemic lockdowns – and the subsequent reopening policies – were the dominant drivers of global inflation during this period. Fiscal and monetary policies played an important role in preventing deflation in the first year of the pandemic, but their effects waned during the recovery years.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用一套涵盖2020国家中22国家-行业对的生产者价格和投入产出联系的创新统一数据集，研究了疫情封锁冲击及财政和货币刺激对1254-55期间通胀的影响。我们的识别策略采用Bartik移位份额设计，其中国家-行业份额反映了对每种冲击的异质暴露。结果显示，疫情封锁及随后的重启政策是该期间全球通胀的主要驱动力。财政和货币政策在疫情第一年防止通缩方面发挥了重要作用，但其效应在复苏年间减弱。

records.title_en: Europe falling behind: Structural transformation and labor productivity growth differences between Europe and the U.S
records.title_cn: 欧洲落后：欧洲与美国之间的结构转型与劳动生产率增长差异
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates the convergence and subsequent divergence of labor productivity between the U.S. and Europe through a quantitative general equilibrium framework that integrates endogenous changes in employment shares as a function of exogenous and unbalanced labor productivity growth rates across sectors. We calibrate our model to the U.S. and test it against Europe from 1970 to 2019. Our model accurately captures structural transformation and aggregate labor productivity paths, as well as the timing of Europe’s transition from convergence to divergence relative to the U.S. Leveraging a set of numerical experiments, we find that the reallocation of labor toward less productive sectors in response to sectoral productivity changes hinders the potential effects that the productivity growth in market services may have on the aggregate labor productivity: The heterogeneous productivity observed within services brings forth a Baumol cost disease whereby productive sectors gain less employment share than their productivity growth would imply under constant shares, despite their strong income effects. An extended version of our model that accounts for international trade suggests that it is implausible for Europe to export its way out of the aggregate stagnation unleashed by labor reallocation toward unproductive sectors.
records.abstract_cn: 本文通过一个定量的一般均衡框架，研究了美国与欧洲之间劳动生产率的趋同及其后分化。该框架将就业份额的内生变化作为各部门外生且不平衡的劳动生产率增长率的函数。我们将模型校准至美国，并以欧洲从1970到2019期间的数据进行检验。模型准确捕捉了结构转型和整体劳动生产率路径，以及欧洲相对于美国从趋同转向分化的时间节点。通过一系列数值实验，我们发现，劳动力向生产率较低部门的重新配置，阻碍了市场服务业生产率增长对整体劳动生产率的潜在影响：服务业内部观察到的生产率异质性引发了鲍莫尔成本病，即尽管具有强烈的收入效应，生产率较高的部门获得的就业份额增长仍低于在就业份额不变情况下其生产率增长所暗示的水平。考虑国际贸易的模型扩展版本表明，欧洲通过出口来摆脱因劳动力向低生产率部门重新配置而引发的整体停滞是不太可能的。

records.title_en: Have global value chains shifted?
records.title_cn: 全球价值链是否发生了转移？
records.abstract_en: Building on a unified accounting framework for value-added trade, this paper introduces a method for quantifying the paths in global value chains (GVCs) using inter-country input–output tables, which evaluates the indirect linkages between two countries through a third-party intermediary. The GVC path index identifies the “hub-and-spoke” structure within GVC networks and refines the concept of GVC exposure. We apply this index to detect recent shifts in global value chains following the U.S.-China trade war. Our analysis reveals a notable rise in the GVC path from China to Mexico and Vietnam, and subsequently to the U.S. We provide a theoretical justification for the trade rerouting phenomenon and quantify the impact of the U.S.-China trade war on the GVC shifts with a general equilibrium model. Additionally, the GVC paths through which major exporters supply the U.S. market have been redirected away from China subsequent to the trade war.
records.abstract_cn: 基于统一的增值贸易核算框架，本文引入了一种利用国家间投入产出表量化全球价值链（GVC）路径的方法，该方法评估了通过多方中介国家间的间接联系。GVC路径指数识别了GVC网络中的“枢纽-辐射”结构，并细化了GVC暴露的概念。我们应用该指数检测了美中贸易战后全球价值链的最新转变。分析显示，从中国经由墨西哥和越南再到美国的GVC路径显著上升。我们为贸易重定向现象提供了理论依据，并利用一般均衡模型量化了美中贸易战对GVC转移的影响。此外，贸易战后，主要出口国通过的供应美国市场的GVC路径已从中国转移。

records.title_en: Cross-border trade competition and international stock return comovement
records.title_cn: 跨境贸易竞争与国际股票收益联动性
records.abstract_en: Stock markets of countries that actively engage in international trade may move together more or less depending on their international trade linkages. This paper demonstrates that the stock markets of two countries are less likely to move together if these countries compete intensely in their export product markets. This is in contrast to the higher stock co-movement of countries that share similar exposures to common demand shocks. The empirical patterns imply that stronger cross-border trade linkages may not result in higher cross-market return correlations.
records.abstract_cn: 积极参与国际贸易的国家的股票市场可能会根据其国际贸易联系的强弱表现出不同程度的联动性。本文表明，如果二国家在其出口产品市场中竞争激烈，这些国家的股票市场不太可能表现出同步波动。这与那些对共同需求冲击具有相似暴露的国家表现出更高股票联动性的情况形成对比。实证模式表明，更强的跨境贸易联系未必导致更高的跨市场收益相关性。

records.title_en: Complements or substitutes? Labor market effects of foreign inputs in developing economies
records.title_cn: 互补还是替代？发展中经济体中外国产品对劳动力市场的影响
records.abstract_en: This paper examines how import liberalization affects labor markets when labor and intermediate inputs can be complements or substitutes. We embed a constant-elasticity-of-substitution production function in a dynamic trade model, showing that labor market responses depend on sector-specific substitution elasticities. Empirically, we exploit tariff reductions in Colombia using a difference-in-differences design that decomposes trade shocks into import-competition and input channels. Import competition reduces the wage bill, while cheaper intermediate inputs increase it; these gains are driven by services, are imprecisely estimated in manufacturing, and reverse in agriculture. Combining the model with reduced-form estimates, we use indirect inference to recover sector-specific elasticities. We find substitution between labor and intermediates in agriculture and manufacturing, but complementarity in services. Allowing for this flexibility relative to a Cobb–Douglas benchmark amplifies worker reallocation toward services and away from agriculture. It also increases welfare in services and reduces it in manufacturing and agriculture.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了当劳动力与中间投入品可能是互补或替代关系时，进口自由化如何影响劳动力市场。我们在一个动态贸易模型中嵌入了常弹性替代生产函数，表明劳动力市场的反应取决于部门特定的替代弹性。实证上，我们利用哥伦比亚的关税削减，采用双重差分设计，将贸易冲击分解为进口竞争和投入品渠道。进口竞争降低了工资总额，而更便宜的中间投入品则提高了工资总额；这些收益主要由服务业驱动，在制造业中估计不精确，在农业中则呈现相反趋势。结合模型与简约形式估计，我们使用间接推断法恢复了部门特定的弹性。结果发现农业和制造业中劳动力与中间投入品存在替代关系，而服务业中则表现为互补关系。相较于柯布-道格拉斯基准模型，允许这种灵活性加剧了劳动力向服务业的重新配置，远离农业。同时，这也提升了服务业的福利，降低了制造业和农业的福利。

records.title_en: Liquidity characteristics of market anomalies and institutional trading
records.title_cn: 市场异象的流动性特征与机构交易
records.abstract_en: We find that market anomalies exhibit heterogeneous liquidity characteristics — long–short portfolios based on long-horizon (short-horizon) anomalies have liquidity-provision (liquidity-demanding) characteristics. Consistent with such liquidity characteristics, institutional investors tend to trade in the wrong (right) direction of long-horizon (short-horizon) anomalies. Further analysis shows that exogenous liquidity factors and institutional liquidity preferences have causal effects on the observed institutional trading patterns. Finally, despite the perception that liquidity improves market efficiency, we find that liquidity can exacerbate the magnitude of anomalies through its influence on institutional trading.
records.abstract_cn: 我们发现市场异象表现出异质的流动性特征——基于长视界（短视界）异象的多空组合具有流动性提供（流动性需求）特征。与这些流动性特征一致，机构投资者倾向于在长视界（短视界）异象的错误（正确）方向进行交易。进一步分析表明，外生流动性因素和机构流动性偏好对观察到的机构交易模式具有因果效应。最后，尽管存在流动性改善市场效率的认知，我们发现流动性可以通过其对机构交易的影响加剧异象的幅度。

records.title_en: Partial homeownership: A quantitative analysis
records.title_cn: 部分产权：一项定量分析
records.abstract_en: A convex combination of renting and traditional homeownership – Partial Ownership (PO) – is increasingly popular in many countries. We incorporate an existing for-profit PO contract into a life-cycle model to quantify its impact on housing investments, households’ welfare, and financial stability. We have three results: (1) PO makes more households invest in (some) housing. (2) Willingness to pay for PO increases with housing unaffordability and is highest among low-income and renting households. (3) PO increases the mean DTI in the population while compressing the right tail, and it lowers defaults under a house price collapse and a rise in aggregate unemployment.
records.abstract_cn: 租赁与传统自有住房的凸组合——部分产权（PO）——在许多国家日益流行。我们将一种现有的营利性PO合约纳入生命周期模型，以量化其对住房投资、家庭福利和金融稳定的影响。我们得到三个结果：（1）PO使更多家庭投资于（部分）住房。（2）对PO的支付意愿随住房不可负担性的增加而增加，且在低收入和租房家庭中最高。（3）PO提高了人口中的平均DTI，同时压缩了右尾分布，并在房价崩溃和总体失业率上升的情况下降低了违约率。

records.title_en: Which investors drive anomaly returns and how?
records.title_cn: 哪些投资者驱动了异象回报，以及如何驱动？
records.abstract_en: We decompose variation in anomaly returns across investor types and trading motives, linking returns to holdings within a demand system. Fundamental-based trading is the primary driver of anomalies, and both this channel and non-fundamental trading are driven disproportionately by small investors. Institution-led channels — flows and industry tilts — are secondary and concentrated in specific anomalies. These patterns favor theories with heterogeneous investors and distinct trading behaviors over pure flow- or risk-only explanations. Small investors account for a large share of the cash-flow news component of fundamentals-based trading, suggesting that biases in processing information play a role in anomaly returns.
records.abstract_cn: 我们在需求系统内，将异象回报的变动按投资者类型和交易动机进行分解，并将回报与持有量联系起来。基于基本面的交易是异象的主要驱动因素，且这一渠道和非基本面交易均不成比例地由小投资者驱动。机构主导的渠道——资金流和行业倾斜——是次要的，并集中在特定的异象中。这些模式支持具有异质投资者和不同交易行为的理论，而非纯粹的流量或风险解释。小投资者在基于基本面交易的现金流新闻成分中占很大份额，这表明信息处理中的偏差在异象回报中发挥作用。

records.title_en: Innovation spillovers across U.S. tech clusters
records.title_cn: 美国科技集群的创新溢出效应
records.abstract_en: The vast majority of U.S. inventors work for firms that also have inventors and plants in other tech clusters. Using merged USPTO–U.S. Census Bureau plant-level data, we show that larger tech clusters not only make local inventors more productive but also raise the productivity of inventors and plants in distant clusters, which are connected to the focal cluster through their parent firms’ networks of innovating plants. To rationalize these findings, we develop a tractable model of spatial innovation that features both within- and cross-cluster innovation spillovers. Within our model, we derive a sufficient statistic for the wedge between the social and private returns to innovation in a given location. Taking the model to the data, we find a 41% correlation between the location wedges and locations’ connectedness to other tech clusters.
records.abstract_cn: 绝大多数美国发明家所工作的公司在其他科技集群中也拥有发明家和工厂。使用合并后的 USPTO-U.S.根据人口普查局工厂级数据，我们表明，较大的技术集群不仅可以提高当地发明家的生产力，还可以提高远处集群中的发明家和工厂的生产力，这些集群通过其母公司的创新工厂网络与焦点集群相连。为了合理化这些发现，我们开发了一个易于处理的空间创新模型，该模型具有集群内和跨集群创新溢出效应。在我们的模型中，我们针对给定地点的社会和私人创新回报之间的差距得出了足够的统计数据。将模型应用到数据中，我们发现位置楔子和位置与其他技术集群的连通性之间存在 41% 相关性。

records.title_en: Intervening against the Fed
records.title_cn: 干预美联储
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the effectiveness and mechanism of foreign exchange interventions (FXIs) for mitigating US monetary policy spillovers. Without interventions, contractionary US monetary policy shocks trigger foreign exchange depreciations, raise risk premiums, and induce portfolio outflows, thereby reducing foreign stock prices. The stock prices of firms with US dollar debt decline significantly more, indicating a strong role for a balance sheet channel. However, “intervening against the Fed” stabilizes exchange rate depreciations, the risk premium, and portfolio flows. FXIs also disproportionately cushion the reduction in stock prices for firms with US dollar debt, muting the balance sheet channel of exchange rates.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了外汇干预（FXIs）在缓解美国货币政策溢出效应方面的有效性和机制。在没有干预的情况下，紧缩性美国货币政策冲击引发外汇贬值，提高风险溢价，并诱导投资组合外流，从而降低外国股票价格。拥有美元债务的公司股票价格下降幅度显著更大，表明资产负债表渠道作用强烈。然而，“干预美联储”稳定了汇率贬值、风险溢价和投资组合流动。外汇干预还不成比例地缓冲了拥有美元债务公司股票价格的下跌，削弱了汇率的资产负债表渠道。

records.title_en: Blockchain congestion facilitates currency competition
records.title_cn: 区块链拥堵促进货币竞争
records.abstract_en: Blockchain capacity constraints induce congestion when many users want to transact at the same time. This paper argues that blockchain capacity constraints, coupled with the need to incentivize miners to maintain blockchain security, lead to low inflation outcomes when cryptocurrencies compete for user demand. If two coins are both used as medium of exchange, a low-inflation coin must experience higher congestion than a high-inflation coin; otherwise demand for the latter is zero. Lowering coin growth rates then boosts transaction demand, limiting the equilibrium inflation rate. However, some gains from trade are not realized due to congestion and the cost of blockchain security. The paper also identifies anti-competitive dynamics in Proof-of-Stake: while higher coin growth reduces transaction-based demand, it may increase demand from validators even more.
records.abstract_cn: 当许多用户同时想要交易时，区块链的容量限制会导致拥堵。本文认为，区块链的容量限制，加上需要激励矿工维护区块链安全，导致在加密货币竞争用户需求时出现低通胀结果。如果两种硬币都用作交换媒介，低通胀硬币必须经历比高通胀硬币更高的拥堵；否则对后者的需求为零。降低硬币增长率随后会提升交易需求，限制均衡通胀率。然而，由于拥堵和区块链安全的成本，部分贸易收益未能实现。本文还指出了权益证明中的反竞争动态：虽然更高的硬币增长率减少了基于交易的需求，但它可能更大幅度地增加验证者的需求。

records.title_en: Player strength and effort in contests
records.title_cn: 竞赛中的选手实力与努力
records.abstract_en: In competitive settings, disparities in player strength are common. It is intuitively unclear whether a stronger player would opt for larger or smaller effort compared to weaker players. Larger effort could leverage their strength, while lower effort might be justified by their higher probability of winning regardless of effort. We analyze multi-prize contests with three or more heterogeneous players, exploring when stronger players exert larger or lower effort. To rank efforts, it suffices to compare marginal utilities in situations where efforts are equal. Effort ranking depends on differences in hazard rates (which are smaller for stronger players) and reversed hazard rates (which are larger for stronger players). Compared to weaker players, stronger players choose larger effort in winner-takes-all contests and lower effort in loser-gets-nothing contests. Effort rankings can be non-monotonic in contests with several identical prizes, and they depend on the slopes of players’ pdfs in contests with linear prize structure.
records.abstract_cn: 在竞争环境中，选手实力的差异是常见的。直觉上并不清楚，实力较强的选手相比实力较弱的选手会选择更大还是更小的努力。更大的努力可能利用其优势，而较低的努力可能因其无论努力与否都有较高的获胜概率而合理。我们分析了具有三个或更多异质选手的多奖项竞赛，探讨了何时实力较强的选手会付出更大或更小的努力。要对努力进行排序，只需在努力相等的情况下比较边际效用即可。努力排序取决于风险率（实力较强的选手风险率较小）和逆风险率（实力较强的选手逆风险率较大）的差异。与实力较弱的选手相比，实力较强的选手在赢者通吃的竞赛中选择更大的努力，在输者一无所有的竞赛中选择更小的努力。在具有多个相同奖项的竞赛中，努力排序可以是非单调的，并且在具有线性奖项结构的竞赛中，它们取决于选手概率密度函数的斜率。

records.title_en: Revisiting “A theory of debt maturity and innovation” [J. Econ. Theory 218 (2024) 105828]
records.title_cn: 重访“债务期限与创新理论”[J. Econ. Theory 218 (2024) 105828]
records.abstract_en: We reconsider the incomplete contracting framework of Mitkov (2024) in which an entrepreneur seeks funding for a project and can privately choose its type. Renegotiation is permitted at an intermediate date. We characterize the conditions under which pay-for-failure is necessary to incentivize the entrepreneur to undertake the value-maximizing innovative project. When pay-for-failure is necessary, we generalize Mitkov (2024)’s results by showing that callable long-term debt can replicate the state-contingent contract for a strictly positive measure of parameters, and hence, we provide a rationale for its use in this setting.
records.abstract_cn: 我们重新考虑了Mitkov（2024）的不完全契约框架，在该框架中，企业家寻求项目融资，并可以私下选择项目类型。在中间日期允许重新谈判。我们刻画了在何种条件下，失败支付对于激励企业家承担价值最大化的创新项目是必要的。当失败支付是必要时，我们推广了Mitkov（2024）的结果，表明可赎回的长期债务可以在严格正的参数测度下复制状态依存的契约，因此，我们为其在此环境中的使用提供了合理性依据。

records.title_en: Strengthening incentives for truth-telling in Majority voting
records.title_cn: 强化多数投票中真实表达的激励
records.abstract_en: All currently known mechanisms that fully implement Majority rule are either infinite (integer games) or rely on off-equilibrium transfers. We propose a finite mechanism with no transfers, called Bloc formation, that achieves this goal in pure and mixed strategies. It increases the set of instances where any agent is pivotal by relying on off-equilibrium lotteries, and thus, incentivizes truth-telling.
records.abstract_cn: 所有目前已知的能完全实施多数规则的机制要么是无限的（整数博弈），要么依赖于非均衡转移支付。我们提出了一种无转移支付的有限机制，称为集团形成，该机制在纯策略和混合策略中实现了这一目标。它通过依赖非均衡抽签扩大了任何代理人成为关键行动者的情形集合，从而激励了真实表达。

records.title_en: Axiomatic characterizations of draft rules
records.title_cn: 选秀规则的公理化刻画
records.abstract_en: Drafts are sequential round-robin allocation procedures for distributing heterogeneous and indivisible objects among agents subject to some priority order (e.g., allocating players’ contract rights to teams in professional sports leagues). Agents report ordinal preferences over objects and bundles are partially ordered by pairwise comparison. We provide a simple characterization of draft rules: they are the only allocation rules that are respectful of a priority (RP), envy-free up to one object (EF1), non-wasteful (NW), and resource monotonic (RM). RP and EF1 are crucial for competitive balance in sports leagues. We also prove two related impossibility theorems showing that the competitive-balance axioms RP and EF1 are generally incompatible with strategy-proofness. Nevertheless, draft rules satisfy maxmin strategy-proofness. If agents may declare some objects unacceptable, then draft rules are characterized by RP, EF1, NW, and RM, in conjunction with individual rationality and truncation invariance.
records.abstract_cn: 选秀是按顺序循环分配的程序，用于在受某种优先顺序约束的代理人之间分配异质且不可分割的物品（例如，在职业体育联盟中将球员的合同权利分配给球队）。代理人报告对物品的序数偏好，并通过两两比较对组合进行偏序排序。我们提供了选秀规则的一个简单刻画：它们是唯一同时尊重优先顺序（RP）、至多一个物品的无嫉妒性（EF1）、非浪费性（NW）和资源单调性（RM）的分配规则。RP和EF1对于体育联盟中的竞争平衡至关重要。我们还证明了两个相关的不可能性定理，表明竞争平衡公理RP和EF1通常与策略防止性不相容。然而，选秀规则满足最大最小策略防止性。如果代理人可以声明某些物品不可接受，那么选秀规则由RP、EF1、NW和RM，连同个体理性和截断不变性共同刻画。

records.title_en: Cautiousness when experts disagree
records.title_cn: 专家意见分歧时的谨慎态度
records.abstract_en: Experts often disagree. A decision-maker may want to be cautious and prefer alternatives that have expert consensus over those that do not. Existing models of decision making under expert disagreement rest on ambiguity-averse preferences adopting a unanimity principle: If all experts consider one choice better than another, so should the decision-maker. Such unanimity among experts, however, can be spurious, masking substantial disagreement on the underlying reasons. We introduce a novel notion of cautiousness to distinguish spurious from genuine unanimity and develop a model that can capture cautiousness in our sense. The central element of our model is the cautious aggregation of experts’ beliefs.
records.abstract_cn: 专家们常常意见不一。决策者可能希望保持谨慎，倾向于选择那些获得专家共识的备选方案，而非那些缺乏共识的方案。现有的关于专家意见分歧下的决策模型依赖于采用一致性原则的模糊厌恶偏好：如果所有专家都认为一个选择优于另一个，那么决策者也应如此。然而，专家之间的这种一致性可能是虚假的，掩盖了在根本原因上的重大分歧。我们引入了一种新颖的谨慎概念，以区分虚假的一致性与真正的一致性，并开发了一个能够捕捉我们意义上谨慎态度的模型。我们模型的核心要素是对专家信念的谨慎聚合。

records.title_en: Meta-preference, endogenous preference formation and dynamic choice
records.title_cn: 元偏好、内生偏好形成与动态选择
records.abstract_en: In a dynamic environment, this paper builds a model of layers of meta-preferences which explains endogenous preference formation as a consequence of subjective judgment by the decision maker’s current self about welfare of her successor self. The model allows us to describe how much the decision maker is willing to pay for investment in her preference formation. The paper provides a recursive utility representation of the layers of meta-preferences and applies it to the problems of investment in time preference and taste.
records.abstract_cn: 在动态环境中，本文构建了一个多层元偏好模型，将内生偏好形成解释为决策者当前自我对其继任自我福利的主观判断结果。该模型使我们能够描述决策者愿意为其偏好形成投资支付多少。本文提供了多层元偏好的递归效用表示，并将其应用于时间偏好和品味投资问题。

records.title_en: Evidence design and voluntary disclosure
records.title_cn: 证据设计与自愿披露
records.abstract_en: A sender seeks hard evidence to persuade a receiver to accept a project by designing a quality test. Testing is imperfectly reliable and produces evidence only with some probability. If the sender obtains the evidence, she can choose to disclose it or pretend not to have obtained it. When reliability is low, in equilibrium the sender chooses a pass/fail test that reveals only whether the quality is above or below a threshold. The pass/fail threshold is decreasing in reliability. If the sender can also commit to test design, the structure of the equilibrium test is the same, except that the pass/fail threshold is lower and increasing in reliability. The ability to commit to test design does not affect the outcome when reliability is high, but hurts the receiver otherwise. In an extension of the model in which the sender also chooses reliability, we provide sufficient conditions for the emergence of pass/fail tests.
records.abstract_cn: 发送者寻求硬证据，通过设计质量测试来说服接收者接受项目。测试并非完全可靠，且仅以一定概率产生证据。如果发送者获得了证据，她可以选择披露或假装未获得。当可靠性较低时，在均衡中发送者会选择一种通过/失败测试，该测试仅揭示质量是否高于或低于某个阈值。通过/失败阈值随可靠性递减。如果发送者还能承诺测试设计，均衡测试的结构相同，只是通过/失败阈值更低且随可靠性递增。承诺测试设计的能力在可靠性高时不影响结果，但在其他情况下损害接收者。在模型的一个扩展中，发送者还选择可靠性，我们为通过/失败测试的出现提供了充分条件。

records.title_en: Portfolio choice and settlement frictions: A theory of endogenous convenience yields
records.title_cn: 投资组合选择与结算摩擦：内生便利收益的理论
records.abstract_en: We study settlement frictions that arise from the need to finance negative balances through an over-the-counter (OTC) market. We derive a closed-form expression for the endogenous convenience yield and show how it can be incorporated into a canonical portfolio problem. Using this framework, we examine how shifts in settlement frictions affect liquidity premia, the volume of overnight funding, the dispersion of market rates, and optimal portfolio allocations. From a normative perspective, we show that in the competitive equilibrium, investors may either over- or under-invest in liquid assets; moreover, both higher risk aversion and tighter aggregate liquidity increase the likelihood of under-accumulation. Finally, we apply our framework to monetary policy implementation, showing that the transition from an abundant to a merely ample reserve regime can produce sharp movements in interbank rates.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了因需要通过场外交易（OTC）市场为负余额融资而产生的结算摩擦。我们推导出内生便利收益的闭式表达式，并展示了如何将其纳入经典的投资组合问题。利用这一框架，我们考察了结算摩擦的变化如何影响流动性溢价、隔夜融资量、市场利率的离散度以及最优投资组合配置。从规范角度看，我们表明在竞争均衡中，投资者可能过度或不足投资于流动性资产；此外，更高的风险厌恶和更紧的总体流动性都会增加积累不足的可能性。最后，我们将框架应用于货币政策实施，表明从充裕到仅充足的准备金制度的转变可能导致银行间利率的剧烈波动。

records.title_en: Self-insurance and market insurance substitutability: An established tenet reconsidered
records.title_cn: 自我保险与市场保险的替代性：对既有原则的再思考
records.abstract_en: We study the interaction between self-insurance and market insurance when accident losses are multivalued. We show that self-insurance and market insurance may be complementary when self-insurance expenses do not affect much the probability distribution of large losses and the loading factor is high. This contrasts sharply with the conclusion of Ehrlich and Becker (1972) who establish the substitutability between self-insurance and market insurance when the cost of an accident is single-valued.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了当事故损失为多值时自我保险与市场保险之间的相互作用。我们表明，当自我保险支出对重大损失的概率分布影响不大且附加费率较高时，自我保险与市场保险可能是互补的。这与Ehrlich和Becker（1972）的结论形成鲜明对比，他们在事故成本为单值的情况下确立了自我保险与市场保险之间的替代性。

records.title_en: The Emerging Role of Competition in Health Care
records.title_cn: 竞争在医疗保健中的新兴作用
records.abstract_en: This essay, commissioned to serve as an introduction to the JEP symposium on current competition in health care, provides a historical perspective on the role of both competition and regulation in the financing and delivery of health services since the implementation of Medicare and Medicaid in the mid-1960s. At the beginning of this period, few could perceive a role for competition in healthcare given the key role played by physicians in providing and ordering care and concerns that lower prices might signal lower quality. Initial attempts to slow rapidly rising costs involved various regulatory tools, but over time, regulation increasingly incorporated incentives for providers, to control costs. Competitive approaches began to develop in the late 1970s, in part reflecting broad changes in the nation’s political culture. Competitive approaches are now are quite widespread, but regulation plays an important role in the structuring of competition and in addressing areas where competition is seen as having less potential.
records.abstract_cn: 本文受委托为 JEP 研讨会介绍当前医疗保健领域的竞争，提供了自 1960 中期实施 Medicare 和 Medicaid 以来竞争和监管在医疗服务融资和提供中的作用的历史视角。在此时期初期，考虑到医生在提供和订购医疗服务方面发挥的关键作用，以及人们担心较低的价格可能意味着较低的质量，很少有人能够意识到医疗保健领域竞争的作用。最初试图减缓成本快速上升的速度涉及各种监管工具，但随着时间的推移，监管越来越多地纳入对提供商的激励措施，以控制成本。竞争性方法在 1970 后期开始发展，部分反映了国家政治文化的广泛变化。竞争方法现在相当普遍，但监管在竞争结构和解决竞争被认为潜力较小的领域方面发挥着重要作用。

records.title_en: Competition in Health Insurance Markets
records.title_cn: 健康保险市场的竞争
records.abstract_en: The United States relies primarily on private health insurance markets, yet these markets are highly concentrated and becoming more so over time. We document concentration across commercial, Medicare Advantage, and Medicaid markets. We then examine how asymmetric information—particularly adverse selection—interacts with market power to shape premiums, plan design, and consumer welfare. Empirical evidence confirms that insurer consolidation raises premiums. We discuss how antitrust enforcement, risk adjustment, regulation, and informational interventions shape competition and consumer welfare in these markets.
records.abstract_cn: 美国主要依赖私人健康保险市场，但这些市场高度集中，并且随着时间的推移变得更加集中。我们记录了商业、医疗保险优势和医疗补助市场的集中度。然后，我们研究不对称信息（尤其是逆向选择）如何与市场力量相互作用，从而影响保费、计划设计和消费者福利。经验证据证实保险公司合并会提高保费。我们讨论反垄断执法、风险调整、监管和信息干预如何影响这些市场的竞争和消费者福利。

records.title_en: Regulated Competition in Health Insurance Markets on Two Sides of the Atlantic
records.title_cn: 二 大西洋两岸健康保险市场的监管竞争
records.abstract_en: Many high-income countries implement their policy of universal health insurance by individual health insurance in combination with regulated competition among insurers. Supported by public intervention, regulated competition can, in principle, address market failures in health insurance and smooth out some inequities in the financial consequences of ill health and in the ability to pay for health insurance. We compare the national systems in Germany, the Netherlands, and Switzerland to the US Marketplaces, all of which use versions of regulated competition. While they show many similarities (for example, open enrollment, community-rated premiums with subsidies, comprehensive benefit package, risk adjustment), we focus on three major differences and their implications for market functioning: (1) mandatory and universal versus voluntary and partial (applying to only one sector of health insurance); (2) greater or lesser profit orientation of insurers; and (3) reliance on markets or regulation to contain costs.
records.abstract_cn: 许多高收入国家通过个人健康保险结合保险公司之间的规范竞争来实施全民健康保险政策。在公共干预的支持下，受监管的竞争原则上可以解决健康保险市场失灵的问题，并消除健康不良造成的财务后果和健康保险支付能力方面的一些不平等现象。我们将德国、荷兰和瑞士的国家系统与美国市场进行比较，所有这些国家都使用受监管竞争的版本。虽然它们表现出许多相似之处（例如，开放注册、社区定额保费和补贴、综合福利方案、风险调整），但我们重点关注 三 的主要差异及其对市场运作的影响：（1）强制性和普遍性与自愿性和部分性（仅适用于健康保险的 一 部门）； (2) 保险公司的利润导向或多或少； (3) 依靠市场或监管来控制成本。

records.title_en: Anticompetitive Contracts Between Insurers and Providers in Health Care
records.title_cn: 保险公司与医疗保健提供者之间的反竞争合同
records.abstract_en: For people with private health insurance in the United States, contracts between insurers and providers are important to fostering health care competition and improving efficiency. However, insurer-provider contract provisions do not always advance competition and consumer welfare. This essay discusses the contracting strategies used by insurers to increase competition, and four anticompetitive contract terms: anti-tiering or anti-steering, all-or-nothing, most favored nation, and gag clauses, that may be used by dominant health systems to protect themselves from competition. I conclude with a discussion of policy responses that can be used to address provider use of anticompetitive clauses and that can reduce the negative impacts of provider market power. Understanding anticompetitive contract provisions and the potential policy responses to limit their impact is critical to health care competition.
records.abstract_cn: 对于在美国拥有私人医疗保险的人来说，保险公司和提供者之间的合同对于促进医疗保健竞争和提高效率非常重要。然而，保险公司-提供商合同条款并不总是能促进竞争和消费者福利。本文讨论了保险公司为增加竞争而使用的签约策略，以及 四 反竞争合同条款：反分级或反转向、全有或全无、最惠国待遇和禁止性条款，这些条款可能被占主导地位的卫生系统用来保护自己免受竞争。最后，我讨论了可用于解决供应商使用反竞争条款并减少供应商市场力量的负面影响的政策反应。了解反竞争合同条款以及限制其影响的潜在政策应对措施对于医疗保健竞争至关重要。

records.title_en: The Current Era of Health Care Consolidation
records.title_cn: 当前医疗保健整合时代
records.abstract_en: Consolidation in the last few decades has reshaped the organization and structure of US health care markets, among both providers and insurers. Nearly all US hospital and insurer markets exceed established regulatory thresholds for competitive markets, and over half of physicians are now employed by a hospital or health system, which can increase spending for patients, payers, and taxpayers. Increased supply-side concentration can alter the balance of negotiations between providers and insurers. Prices for patients with commercial insurance are approximately 2.5 times the prices paid by those with public insurance. High and variable prices have minimal link with higher quality, and the United States leads peer nations in health care spending. These dynamics have created ongoing national debates over an “affordability crisis” and generates frustrations with the US health care system. This article discusses sources of rising health care spending and potential policy solutions.
records.abstract_cn: 过去几十年的整合重塑了美国医疗保健市场的组织和结构，包括供应商和保险公司。几乎所有美国医院和保险公司市场都超过了竞争市场的既定监管门槛，超过一半的医生现在受雇于医院或卫生系统，这可能会增加患者、付款人和纳税人的支出。供应方集中度的提高可能会改变提供商和保险公司之间的谈判平衡。拥有商业保险的患者的价格大约是拥有公共保险的患者支付的价格的 2.5 倍。高且不稳定的价格与更高的质量之间的联系微乎其微，而美国在医疗保健支出方面领先于其他国家。这些动态引发了关于“负担能力危机”的持续全国性辩论，并引发了人们对美国医疗保健系统的不满。本文讨论医疗保健支出增加的来源和潜在的政策解决方案。

records.title_en: Physician Competition: Entry and Substitution
records.title_cn: 医师竞赛：参赛与替补
records.abstract_en: We describe competition in the physician market, focusing on how entry barriers and substitution possibilities have changed in recent decades. Regulatory caps on medical school seats and residency slots—especially for high-paying specialties—continue to ration entry, generate high returns for those who gain these slots, and direct the most academically accomplished trainees toward lucrative fields. But trained physicians increasingly compete with nurse practitioners, physician assistants, and other mid-level practitioners in the market for patients. Training of these substitutes has expanded far more rapidly than physician supply. We present key facts about the physician pipeline, a conceptual framework linking specialty earnings to entry barriers, and describe the rise of mid-level providers. These facts mean that effective competition policy in physician markets must look beyond conventional concentration measures and focus on the institutions and laws that govern who can provide medical care.
records.abstract_cn: 我们描述了医生市场的竞争，重点关注近几十年来进入壁垒和替代可能性的变化。对医学院席位和住院医师名额的监管上限（特别是针对高薪专业）继续限制入学，为获得这些名额的人带来高回报，并将学术上最有成就的学员引向利润丰厚的领域。但训练有素的医生越来越多地与执业护士、医师助理和其他中级执业人员在患者市场上竞争。这些替代人员的培训扩张速度远远快于医生供应的扩张速度。我们介绍了有关医生管道的关键事实，一个将专业收入与进入壁垒联系起来的概念框架，并描述了中级医疗服务提供者的崛起。这些事实意味着，医生市场中有效的竞争政策必须超越传统的集中措施，重点关注管理谁可以提供医疗服务的机构和法律。

records.title_en: Substitutes for Success? Public Versus Private Competition in Medicare Advantage
records.title_cn: 成功的替代品？医疗保险优势方面的公共与私人竞争
records.abstract_en: We assess the evolving role of competition in Medicare Advantage and its implications for beneficiary welfare. We describe how competition from the public option, traditional Medicare, and other private insurers within Medicare Advantage act as substitutes in incentivizing plans to deliver value. We show that while historically the choice between traditional Medicare and Medicare Advantage provided a vital competitive dynamic, traditional Medicare's strength as a competitor has declined significantly, driven by generous payments favoring private plans. Consequently, the burden of ensuring value for enrollees has shifted to competition within the Medicare Advantage market. While county-level competition among private insurers has increased, this growth is primarily driven by the expansion of large national carriers rather than new entrants. Insurers still wield substantial market power due to significant barriers to entry, raising concerns about the ability of the program to incentivize private insurers to use public dollars to maximize value for beneficiaries.
records.abstract_cn: 我们评估了竞争在 Medicare Advantage 中不断变化的作用及其对受益人福利的影响。我们描述了来自公共选择、传统医疗保险和医疗保险优势内其他私人保险公司的竞争如何作为激励计划提供价值的替代品。我们表明，虽然从历史上看，传统医疗保险和医疗保险优势之间的选择提供了至关重要的竞争动力，但由于有利于私人计划的慷慨支付，传统医疗保险作为竞争对手的实力已显着下降。因此，确保参保者价值的负担已转移到 Medicare Advantage 市场内的竞争上。虽然县级私营保险公司之间的竞争有所加剧，但这种增长主要是由大型全国性保险公司的扩张而非新进入者推动的。由于存在巨大的进入壁垒，保险公司仍然拥有巨大的市场力量，这引发了人们对该计划能否激励私人保险公司使用公共资金为受益人实现价值最大化的担忧。

records.title_en: Understanding Medicaid Managed Care: The Procured Competition Model
records.title_cn: 了解医疗补助管理式医疗：采购竞争模式
records.abstract_en: Medicaid is one of the largest public programs in the United States—providing health insurance to over 75 million low-income Americans—and over three quarters of its enrollees receive care via private “managed care” insurers. In this article, we make three central points about the economics of contracting out Medicaid to private insurers. First, the empirical evidence on Medicaid privatization is mixed: contracting out has not meaningfully reduced public costs or improved quality of care. Second, we propose a framework, which we call “procured competition,” to describe the unique structure of Medicaid managed care as a hybrid of public procurement and regulated competition. Third, we discuss the key policy levers across procurement, competition, and consumer choice in this model. Throughout, we highlight open research questions, arguing that the enormous variation in how states design these programs—combined with limited evidence on what works—represents a promising area for high-impact scholarship.
records.abstract_cn: 医疗补助计划是美国最大的公共计划之一，为超过 75 百万 名低收入美国人提供健康保险，超过 三 四分之一的参保者通过私人“管理式医疗”保险公司获得医疗服务。在本文中，我们以 三 为中心，阐述将医疗补助计划外包给私人保险公司的经济效益。 第一，医疗补助私有化的经验证据好坏参半：外包并没有显着降低公共成本或提高护理质量。 第二，我们提出了一个框架，我们称之为“采购竞争”，来描述医疗补助管理式医疗的独特结构，作为公共采购和监管竞争的混合体。 第三，我们讨论了该模型中采购、竞争和消费者选择的关键政策杠杆。自始至终，我们都强调开放性研究问题，认为各州设计这些项目的方式存在巨大差异，再加上有效的证据有限，代表了高影响力学术的一个有前途的领域。

records.title_en: A Users’ Guide to Uncovering Worker and Firm Effects: The ABC of AKM
records.title_cn: 揭示工人和公司影响的用户指南：AKM ABC
records.abstract_en: The AKM model introduced by Abowd, Kramarz, and Margolis (1999) has become a workhorse to study worker and firm heterogeneity, and to understand the sources of wage dispersion in the labor market using linked employer-employee data. In this article, we introduce the model and estimator, discuss some best practices for estimation, and review some empirical findings on the role of worker and firm heterogeneity in wage dispersion. While the AKM methodology has proven useful to analyze a host of questions in a variety of settings within labor economics and beyond, we also point to the need for methodological developments.
records.abstract_cn: Abowd、Kramarz 和 Margolis (1999) 提出的 AKM 模型已成为研究工人和企业异质性的主力，并使用关联的雇主-雇员数据了解劳动力市场工资离散的来源。在本文中，我们介绍了模型和估计器，讨论了一些估计的最佳实践，并回顾了有关工人和企业异质性在工资分散中的作用的一些实证研究结果。虽然 AKM 方法已被证明有助于分析劳动经济学及其他领域的各种环境中的许多问题，但我们也指出了方法论发展的必要性。

records.title_en: The Economics of Paid Sick Leave
records.title_cn: 带薪病假的经济学
records.abstract_en: This article examines the economics of paid sick leave from both theoretical and empirical perspectives. Research on paid sick leave has evolved dynamically over the last decade, primarily driven by the spread of US sick pay mandates, which have increased paid sick leave access from 63 percent to 77 percent in all US jobs. We begin by discussing the economic rationales for government regulation of paid sick leave, particularly the negative externalities associated with contagious diseases when individuals work while sick. After that, we discuss the key trade-offs in the general design of paid sick leave schemes, along with the trade-offs when setting specific policy parameters. Finally, we review economic modeling approaches to study optimal paid sick leave policies.
records.abstract_cn: 本文从理论和实证角度探讨了带薪病假的经济学。过去十年中，带薪病假研究不断发展，这主要是受美国病假工资强制规定的推动，这使得美国所有工作中带薪病假的使用范围从 63% 增加到 77%。我们首先讨论政府监管带薪病假的经济原理，特别是当个人带病工作时与传染病相关的负外部性。之后，我们讨论带薪病假计划总体设计中的关键权衡，以及设定具体政策参数时的权衡。最后，我们回顾了研究最佳带薪病假政策的经济模型方法。

records.title_en: Retrospectives: The Great Dollar-Shortage Debate
records.title_cn: 回顾：美元短缺大辩论
records.abstract_en: The dollar shortage debate—Paul Samuelson called it “the big open question of our time”—dominated international macroeconomics in the 15 years following the end of World War II. There were two main views regarding its cause: financial frictions that limited capital flows to Western Europe (Kindleberger); and overvalued fixed exchange rates versus the US dollar (Friedman). According to Kindleberger the dollar shortage was attenuated by two real factors that contributed to current account deficits: a large technological gap between the United States and Europe; and European impatience to improve living standards. Kindleberger believed that the current account deficit would prove chronic because of the persistence of the productivity gap, a view that was challenged by Bloomfield who argued that it would dissipate through income growth in Europe. We argue that Kindelberger’s analytical framework is closely connected to the modern intertemporal approach to current account determination; and, also, that the international reserve function of the US dollar—the Triffin dilemma—did not play a role in the dollar shortage.
records.abstract_cn: 美元短缺的争论——保罗·萨缪尔森称之为“我们这个时代的重大悬而未决的问题”——在二战结束后的 15 年间主导了国际宏观经济。 二 对其原因有主要观点：金融摩擦限制了资本流向西欧（Kindleberger）；以及对美元的固定汇率被高估（弗里德曼）。根据金德尔伯格的说法，导致经常账户赤字的 二 真实因素削弱了美元短缺：美国和欧洲之间巨大的技术差距；以及欧洲对提高生活水平的不耐烦。金德尔伯格认为，由于生产率差距的持续存在，经常账户赤字将长期存在，这一观点受到布卢姆菲尔德的挑战，他认为经常账户赤字将通过欧洲收入增长而消失。我们认为，金德尔伯格的分析框架与经常账户确定的现代跨期方法密切相关。此外，美元的国际储备功能——特里芬困境——并没有在美元短缺中发挥作用。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Might India’s use of groundwater be weakly sustainable?
records.title_cn: 印度地下水的使用是否可能为弱可持续性？
records.abstract_en: In many parts of the world, groundwater is being extracted at rates that exceed natural renewal rates, leading many experts to conclude that groundwater mining is an unsustainable strategy for rural development. However, groundwater extraction could still be considered to be ‘weakly sustainable’ if it generates investments in man-made capital that offset the loss of natural ‘groundwater capital’ and enable income to be sustained even as the resource is depleted. In this paper, we examine whether the withdrawals of groundwater for irrigation in India have resulted in household-level investments in physical and human capital. Our empirical strategy compares villages in the same administrative units that overlie aquifers with different water storage capacities and, therefore, endowed with different levels of access to the resource. We find that greater access to the resource results in more irrigation, as expected, as well as higher asset wealth and educational attainment. The results suggest that deeming India’s irrigation-based rural development as unsustainable purely because of the decline in water tables may require reconsideration, provided that human capital is used to productively shift income from farm to off-farm sources.
records.abstract_cn: 在世界许多地区，地下水的开采速度超过了自然补给率，导致许多专家认为地下水开采是农村发展的不可持续策略。然而，如果地下水开采能够产生对人工资本的投资，从而抵消自然“地下水资本”的损失，并使得即使在资源耗竭的情况下收入也能得以维持，那么这种开采仍可被视为“弱可持续”。在本文中，我们考察了印度用于灌溉的地下水抽取是否导致了家庭层面的物质资本和人力资本投资。我们的实证策略比较了位于同一行政单位内、覆盖不同储水能力含水层且因此拥有不同资源获取水平的村庄。我们发现，正如预期，更大的资源获取带来了更多的灌溉，以及更高的资产财富和教育成就。结果表明，如果人力资本被用于有效地将收入从农业转向非农来源，那么仅因水位下降而将印度基于灌溉的农村发展视为不可持续可能需要重新考虑。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Heat, power outages, and mortality in the United States
records.title_cn: 美国的高温、停电与死亡率
records.abstract_en: We examine the mortality impacts of exposures to high temperatures and power outages using a county-month data set in the United States from 2015 to 2019. We find that each additional hour of power outage leads to a 0.04% increase in the monthly mortality rate. Furthermore, we show that the mortality effects of hot days are exacerbated by the co-occurrence of power outages, with each hour of power outage on a hot day increasing the harm from the hot day by 61%. Widespread and long-lasting power outages during hot days have disproportionately large effects on mortality. We also show heterogeneity across climate regions in the estimated relationships, which is consistent with heavier reliance on technological adaptations to heat such as air conditioning in hotter climate regions. Taken together, our results suggest that the reliability of electricity grids serves as an important means of adaptation to high temperatures and climate change.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用美国2015年至2019年的县级月度数据集，考察了高温暴露和停电对死亡率的影响。我们发现，每增加一小时的停电时间，月度死亡率将上升0.04%。此外，我们表明，高温日的死亡率影响因停电的同时发生而加剧，高温日每停电一小时会使高温日的危害增加61%。高温期间广泛且持久的停电对死亡率产生了不成比例的巨大影响。我们还展示了不同气候区域在估计关系上的异质性，这与较热气候区域更依赖空调等技术性适应措施相一致。综合来看，我们的结果表明，电网的可靠性是适应高温和气候变化的重要手段。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Using satellite-observed geospatial inundation data to identify the impacts of floods on firm-level performance: The case of China during 2000–2009
records.title_cn: 利用卫星观测地理空间淹没数据识别洪水对企业绩效的影响：以中国2000-2009年为例
records.abstract_en: This paper compiles high-resolution geospatial inundation areas of China for the period 2000–2009 based on satellite imagery repositories filtered by the Global Flood Database (GFD). In parallel, we geocode a comprehensive firm-level dataset of China and combine these two sets of geospatial data to identify the set of inundated firms in each year of flood events, as well as the distances of all non-inundated firms from the inundated areas. Given the high-resolution inundation data, we adopt a generalized dynamic-panel specification to estimate dynamic and spatial spillover effects of floods on firm-level production activities (including outputs, capital and labor inputs, and productivities). We find negative and persistent effects of floods on firm-level performance measures, and negative but short-run spillover effects on non-inundated firms in nearby neighborhoods. In contrast, non-inundated firms located 6–12 km away from the inundated area expanded their production in the long run, suggesting reallocation of production activities/facilities away from the inundation area toward the outer rings of the neighborhood. We conduct various robustness checks and extended analyses, identify moderating/aggravating factors of inundation impacts, assess the aggregate effects at the economy-wide, province, and sector levels, and quantify the propagation of flood exposures via the input–output linkages.
records.abstract_cn: 本文基于全球洪水数据库（GFD）筛选的卫星影像库，编制了中国2000-2009年期间高分辨率的地理空间淹没区域。同时，我们对中国的综合企业级数据集进行地理编码，并将这两组地理空间数据结合起来，以识别每年洪水事件中被淹没的企业，以及所有未被淹没企业距离淹没区域的距离。鉴于高分辨率的淹没数据，我们采用广义动态面板设定来估计洪水对企业级生产活动（包括产出、资本和劳动投入以及生产率）的动态和空间溢出效应。我们发现洪水对企业绩效指标具有负向且持续的影响，并且对邻近地区的未被淹没企业具有负向但短期的溢出效应。相比之下，位于淹没区域6-12公里外的未被淹没企业在长期内扩大了生产，这表明生产活动/设施从淹没区域向邻近区域的外围地带重新配置。我们进行了各种稳健性检验和扩展分析，识别了淹没影响的调节/加剧因素，评估了经济整体、省级和部门层面的总体效应，并通过投入产出关联量化了洪水暴露的传播。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Split incentives and energy efficiency investment: Evidence from the housing market
records.title_cn: 分拆激励与能效投资：来自住房市场的证据
records.abstract_en: Investments in energy efficiency in the built environment play a crucial role in global efforts to combat climate change. However, a significant obstacle to these investments arises from the differing incentives between landlords and tenants in the housing market. Landlords, who are typically not responsible for utility costs, may choose to invest less in energy efficiency improvements if these investments are not adequately reflected in rents. Our study provides empirical evidence of this market distortion, drawing on a comprehensive panel dataset from the Dutch housing market covering 3.8 million homes. We implement a quasi-experimental event study design that exploits transitions from rental to owner-occupied status while holding both the dwelling and the household constant. This identification strategy enables us to isolate changes in energy use attributable to tenure status. Our findings indicate a gradual decline in natural gas consumption following the transition to home-ownership, with an average reduction of about 2% that increases to as much as 5% nine years after the transition. In electricity consumption, split incentives are less important, given that tenants control the use and stock of their appliances, and we find no effect of changes in tenure status. Together, these findings provide empirical support for the relevance of tenure-based incentives in shaping energy-related decisions and can inform the design of targeted policies aimed at improving the energy performance of the rental housing stock.
records.abstract_cn: 建筑环境中的能效投资在全球应对气候变化的努力中扮演着关键角色。然而，这些投资面临的一个重大障碍源于住房市场中房东与租户之间激励的差异。房东通常不承担公用事业费用，如果这些投资未能充分反映在租金中，他们可能选择减少能效改进的投资。我们的研究基于荷兰住房市场覆盖3.8百万套住房的全面面板数据集，提供了这一市场扭曲的经验证据。我们实施了一个准实验性事件研究设计，利用从租赁到自有住房状态的转变，同时保持住房和家庭不变。这一识别策略使我们能够隔离出因产权状态变化引起的能源使用变化。我们的研究结果显示，在转为自有住房后，天然气消耗逐渐下降，平均减少约2%，在转变后九年时增加至高达5%。在电力消耗方面，由于租户控制其电器的使用和存量，分拆激励的重要性较低，我们发现产权状态变化没有影响。综合这些发现，为基于产权的激励在塑造能源相关决策中的相关性提供了经验支持，并可为旨在改善租赁住房存量能源性能的针对性政策设计提供信息。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: High temperature and learning outcomes: Evidence from Ethiopia
records.title_cn: 高温与学习成果：来自埃塞俄比亚的证据
records.abstract_en: What is the impact of high temperatures on human capital accumulation in Sub-Saharan Africa? Rising temperatures, due to climate change, and the role of human capital in driving development make answering this question imperative to understand the long-term impacts of climate change in the world’s most climate vulnerable region. We use data from 2003–2019 for 2.47 million test takers of a national high-stakes high-school leaving exam in Ethiopia to study the impacts of temperature on learning outcomes. We find that high temperatures during the school year leading up to the exam reduce test scores, controlling for temperatures during the exam. Female students appear slightly less affected by heat compared to their male counterparts. We do not find evidence to reject the hypothesis that these effects are driven primarily by within-classroom temperatures rather than indirect effects on agriculture.
records.abstract_cn: 高温对撒哈拉以南非洲地区人力资本积累有何影响？由于气候变化导致的气温上升，以及人力资本在推动发展中的作用，使得回答这一问题对于理解气候变化在全球最易受气候影响地区的长期影响至关重要。我们使用了2003-2019年间埃塞俄比亚全国高风险高中毕业考试的2.47万名考生的数据，来研究温度对学习成果的影响。我们发现，在考试前的学年中，高温会降低考试成绩，同时控制考试期间的温度。女学生似乎比男学生受高温影响略小。我们没有发现证据拒绝这一假设，即这些影响主要由教室内的温度驱动，而非对农业的间接影响。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: How air pollution makes firms less innovative: Human capital and adaptive strategies
records.title_cn: 空气污染如何降低企业创新：人力资本与适应策略
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the long-term effects of air pollution on firms’ human capital accumulation and the adaptive strategies they adopt in response. Leveraging a spatial regression discontinuity (RD) design based on China’s Huai River heating policy and utilizing a novel dataset with detailed firm-level human capital information, we show that air pollution significantly reduces the share of R&D staff with advanced degrees, particularly PhD and master’s degrees. To offset these challenges, firms in more polluted regions increasingly turn to external strategies, such as acquiring technology and collaborating with universities, as well as internal measures, including expanding welfare subsidies for R&D staff and investing in experimental instruments. However, despite these adaptive efforts, firms in polluted areas still generate fewer innovations than their counterparts in cleaner regions. Overall, our findings highlight the role of internal human capital in sustaining innovative capacity.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了空气污染对企业人力资本积累的长期影响以及企业为应对污染所采取的适应策略。利用基于中国淮河供暖政策的空间断点回归（RD）设计，并采用包含详细企业层面人力资本信息的新数据集，我们表明空气污染显著降低了拥有高等学位（尤其是博士和硕士学位）的研发人员比例。为应对这些挑战，污染较严重地区的企业越来越多地转向外部策略，如获取技术和与大学合作，以及内部措施，包括扩大对研发人员的福利补贴和投资实验仪器。然而，尽管采取了这些适应努力，污染地区的企业产生的创新仍少于清洁地区的同行。总体而言，我们的发现强调了内部人力资本在维持创新能力中的作用。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Physical climate risk and the pricing of bank loans
records.title_cn: 物理气候风险与银行贷款定价
records.abstract_en: This paper analyses how physical climate risk affects the pricing of loans. Using a global dataset of almost 86,000 syndicated bank loans, we find that a higher climate vulnerability of a firm’s host country leads to higher costs of borrowing. The effects of physical climate risk on loan pricing are particularly large if loans have long maturities and if borrowing firms are in financial distress. In addition to loan pricing, banks also adjust other loan terms, such as loan size, collateral requirements, or fees, to manage their exposure to their borrowers’ physical climate risk. As climate risk may also directly affect loan pricing, e.g., via general updates of credit risk models due to observed changes in climate risk, we extend the analysis to firm-level credit risk ratings. The results show that physical climate risk negatively affects long-term credit risk ratings, while it does not play a role in short-term credit risk, and hence support the proposed channel that physical climate risk affects loan pricing via its effect on firms’ default probabilities.
records.abstract_cn: 本文分析了物理气候风险如何影响贷款定价。利用一个包含近86,000笔银团贷款的全球数据集，我们发现企业所在国气候脆弱性越高，借贷成本越高。当贷款期限较长且借款企业处于财务困境时，物理气候风险对贷款定价的影响尤为显著。除贷款定价外，银行还会调整其他贷款条款，如贷款规模、抵押品要求或费用，以管理其对借款人物理气候风险的敞口。由于气候风险也可能直接影响贷款定价，例如通过因观察到的气候风险变化而对信用风险模型进行一般性更新，我们将分析扩展到企业层面的信用风险评级。结果表明，物理气候风险对长期信用风险评级有负面影响，而对短期信用风险无影响，从而支持了物理气候风险通过影响企业违约概率进而影响贷款定价的拟议渠道。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Climate change and population growth: A reassessment
records.title_cn: 气候变化与人口增长：重新评估
records.abstract_en: It is widely believed that population growth has a negative impact on global warming. Here, we set up an integrated assessment model (a simplified DICE model) and derive analytically a condition under which a higher world population causally leads to a lower long-run temperature increase under optimal carbon taxation. The condition is easily fulfilled for standard IAM parameters and is independent of the discount rate, the degree of utilitarianism in the objective function, the calibration of the emission and abatement technologies, and other economic parameters. We also show that at the steady state, a larger population implies higher social and individual welfare. We also investigate a refinement of the DICE approach that could mitigate or reverse the predicted negative effect of population growth on climate change.
records.abstract_cn: 普遍认为人口增长对全球变暖有负面影响。在此，我们建立了一个综合评估模型（简化的DICE模型），并分析性地推导出一个条件，在该条件下，在最优碳税下，更高的世界人口因果性地导致长期温度升幅降低。该条件对于标准的IAM参数容易满足，并且独立于贴现率、目标函数中的功利主义程度、排放和减排技术的校准以及其他经济参数。我们还表明，在稳态下，更大的人口意味着更高的社会和个人福利。我们还研究了DICE方法的一种改进，该改进可能减轻或逆转人口增长对气候变化的预测负面影响。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: European energy crisis: Did electricity prices shock real estate markets?
records.title_cn: 欧洲能源危机：电价是否冲击了房地产市场？
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates how the 2021–2022 European energy crisis, a major macro-financial shock, affected the relative valuation of energy-efficient homes in Norway. Leveraging the country’s electricity market—characterized by five distinct regions with varying exposure to European power prices—we analyze how energy price shocks influence housing market dynamics with a triple difference-in-differences regression framework. We find that home prices fell significantly in regions affected by the shock, with average value losses ranging from 1.2% to 3.6%. Energy-efficient homes experienced smaller price declines, particularly in the single-family home segment, indicating a differential price response during the shock. Moreover, the negative price effects persist despite the introduction of electricity price subsidies. These findings highlight the complex relations among energy costs, real estate market valuations, and housing characteristic heterogeneity by offering generalizable insights into the resilience of housing markets to unanticipated shocks and the role of policy interventions in mitigating their effects.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了2021-2022年欧洲能源危机这一重大宏观金融冲击如何影响挪威节能住宅的相对估值。利用该国电力市场——其特征为五个不同地区对欧洲电价的暴露程度各异——我们通过三重差分回归框架分析能源价格冲击如何影响住房市场动态。我们发现，受冲击影响地区的房价显著下跌，平均价值损失范围在1.2%至3.6%之间。节能住宅的价格跌幅较小，尤其是在独栋住宅部分，表明在冲击期间存在差异化的价格反应。此外，尽管引入了电价补贴，负面价格效应仍然持续。这些发现通过提供关于住房市场对未预期冲击的韧性以及政策干预在缓解其影响中的作用的可推广见解，强调了能源成本、房地产市场估值和住房特征异质性之间的复杂关系。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: The impact of land use on water quality: Evidence from California wells
records.title_cn: 土地利用对水质的影响：来自加州水井的证据
records.abstract_en: Nitrate pollution threatens human health and ecosystems in many regions of the world. Although scientists agree that nitrogen compounds from human activity, notably agriculture, enter groundwater systems, empirical estimates of the impacts of land use on nitrate concentrations in well water are still lacking. We provide evidence on such impacts by combining nitrate measurements from 6016 groundwater wells with remotely sensed California land use data from 2007–2023. We categorize agricultural land uses according to crops’ propensities to leach nitrogen and further consider urban development, in addition to undeveloped land—the default land use. Results show that a 10 percentage point increase in the share of land used to grow high-nitrogen crops within 500 m of a well is associated with an 11.6% increase in nitrate concentrations a decade later, while the same increase in urban developments contributes about a 10% increase. When conditioning on initial nitrate measurements, the impact of nearby land use attenuates while initial concentrations explain a large share of future variation in concentrations, demonstrating the persistent nature of nitrates in groundwater. A calculation based on our regression estimates implies that replacing high-nitrogen with low-nitrogen crops around sample wells would achieve a 4.6% reduction in nitrate concentrations, saving municipal water systems $25 million annually. We evaluate the opportunity cost of such crop substitution to be large; however, targeting only the crops with the highest propensity to leach nitrates easily passes a cost-benefit test.
records.abstract_cn: 硝酸盐污染威胁着世界许多地区的人类健康和生态系统。尽管科学家们一致认为人类活动（尤其是农业）产生的氮化合物会进入地下水系统，但关于土地利用对井水中硝酸盐浓度影响的实证估计仍然缺乏。我们通过将6016口地下水井的硝酸盐测量数据与2007-2023年加州遥感土地利用数据相结合，提供了此类影响的证据。我们根据作物淋溶氮的倾向对农业用地进行分类，并进一步考虑城市发展，以及未开发土地——默认的土地利用类型。结果表明，在井周围500米范围内，用于种植高氮作物的土地比例每增加10个百分点，十年后硝酸盐浓度平均增加11.6%，而城市发展的相同比例增加则贡献约10%的增幅。当以初始硝酸盐测量值为条件时，邻近土地利用的影响减弱，而初始浓度解释了未来浓度变化的很大一部分，这表明硝酸盐在地下水中的持久性。基于我们的回归估计的计算表明，在样本井周围用低氮作物替代高氮作物将使硝酸盐浓度降低4.6%，每年为市政供水系统节省$25百万。我们评估了这种作物替代的机会成本较大；然而，仅针对淋溶硝酸盐倾向最高的作物进行替代，则很容易通过成本效益检验。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Hot and cold choices: The role of extreme temperatures in shaping industrial geographical distribution
records.title_cn: 冷热选择：极端温度在塑造产业地理分布中的作用
records.abstract_en: This paper examines how extreme temperatures shape firm entry decisions and industrial geography. Leveraging comprehensive firm registration data from China, we identify an inverted U-shaped relationship between temperature and firm entry, while firm exit remains largely unresponsive. Mechanism analyses reveal that temperature shocks disproportionately reduce entry in labor-intensive industries within tradable sectors. This effect operates through temperature-induced labor productivity losses, whereas entry in non-tradable sectors, such as services, declines indirectly through reduced local demand from downstream industrial clients. Firms also adapt by shifting equity investments toward new firm establishments in regions with milder climates. Climate projections indicate that continued warming will substantially reshape industrial geography. These findings highlight firm location choice as a critical channel of climate adaptation and underscore the role of temperature risk in driving long-term spatial economic change.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了极端温度如何影响企业进入决策和产业地理分布。利用中国全面的企业注册数据，我们发现温度与企业进入之间存在倒U型关系，而企业退出则基本不受影响。机制分析表明，温度冲击不成比例地减少了可贸易部门中劳动密集型产业的进入。这一效应通过温度引起的劳动生产率损失发挥作用，而不可贸易部门（如服务业）的进入则通过下游工业客户本地需求的减少间接下降。企业还通过将股权投资转向气候较温和地区的新企业设立来适应。气候预测表明，持续变暖将大幅重塑产业地理分布。这些发现凸显了企业选址作为气候适应关键渠道的重要性，并强调了温度风险在驱动长期空间经济变化中的作用。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Environmental impacts of agricultural intensification: Evidence from Brazil’s double-cropping boom
records.title_cn: 农业集约化的环境影响：来自巴西双季种植繁荣的证据
