The existing literature shows that when two populations of agents are randomly matched to play the hawk–dove game, then there is convergence to one of the pure equilibria from almost any initial state. By contrast, we show that plausible dynamics, in which agents occasionally revise their actions based on the payoffs obtained in a few trials, often give rise to the opposite result: convergence to one of the interior stationary states.
records.abstract_cn: 鹰鸽博弈承认两种类型的均衡：一种是不对称纯均衡，其中一个群体的玩家采取“鹰”策略，另一个群体的玩家采取“鸽”策略；另一种是对称混合均衡，其中鹰策略者经常相互对抗。现有文献表明，当两个群体的代理随机配对进行鹰鸽博弈时，从几乎任何初始状态出发都会收敛到其中一个纯均衡。相比之下，我们表明，合理的动态——代理偶尔根据几次试验中获得的收益来修订其行动——往往产生相反的结果：收敛到内部静止状态之一。

records.title_en: Comparative statics of minimum-cost-spanning-tree games
records.title_cn: 最小成本生成树博弈的比较静态分析
records.abstract_en: We conduct a comparative static analysis for the cores of minimum-cost-spanning-tree games. We introduce a new category of cover, termed as the matrix-exact cover. Our investigation underscores the pivotal role played by the matrix-exact cover, in conjunction with the classical irreducible cost matrix. (i) When edge costs experience a decrease, the core remains invariant as long as the costs of all edges are weakly above their respective matrix-exact covers. (ii) When the costs of certain edges do fall below the matrix-exact cover, and simultaneously all edge costs remain weakly above the irreducible costs, the core contracts, forming a proper subset of the original core. (iii) Furthermore, should the costs of some edges continue to decrease and fall below the irreducible costs, the core shifts away from the original core.
records.abstract_cn: 我们对最小成本生成树博弈的核心进行了比较静态分析。我们引入了一种新的覆盖类别，称为矩阵精确覆盖。我们的研究强调了矩阵精确覆盖与经典不可约成本矩阵共同发挥的关键作用。(i) 当边成本下降时，只要所有边的成本仍弱高于其各自的矩阵精确覆盖，核心保持不变。(ii) 当某些边的成本确实低于矩阵精确覆盖，同时所有边成本仍弱高于不可约成本时，核心收缩，形成原核心的真子集。(iii) 此外，如果某些边的成本继续下降并低于不可约成本，核心将偏离原核心。

records.title_en: Accountability in Markovian elections
records.title_cn: 马尔可夫选举中的问责制
records.abstract_en: We study electoral accountability in a dynamic environment with complete information. As our normative benchmark, we take the solution of the dynamic programming problem facing the representative voter as if he chose policy directly. There always exist equilibria in which the congruent politician type, whose policy preferences match those of the voter, is accountable, in the sense that these politicians achieve the idealized benchmark. We demonstrate that challenges to electoral accountability stem from multiple equilibria with undesirable normative properties, and we give examples of novel political failures in a model of dynamic public investment. We do not allow the voter or politicians to commit. Nevertheless, we identify a class of reciprocal equilibria such that voter welfare converges to the normative benchmark, and we give conditions under which non-congruent politician types are asymptotically accountable, for every selection of such equilibria as the players become patient.
records.abstract_cn: 我们在一个具有完全信息的动态环境中研究选举问责制。作为我们的规范基准，我们采用代表性选民直接选择政策时的动态规划问题的解。总是存在均衡，其中与选民政策偏好一致的政客类型是负责任的，即这些政客能够达到理想化的基准。我们证明，选举问责制面临的挑战源于具有不良规范性质的多重均衡，并在动态公共投资模型中给出了新颖的政治失败的例子。我们不允许选民或政客做出承诺。然而，我们识别出一类互惠均衡，使得选民福利收敛于规范基准，并且我们给出了条件，在这些条件下，非一致政客类型在渐近意义上是负责任的，对于玩家变得耐心时的每一个这样的均衡选择。

records.title_en: Going through the roof: On prices for drugs sold through insurance
records.title_cn: 冲破屋顶：关于通过保险销售的药品价格
records.abstract_en: This paper studies public concern grounds for high prices of drugs treating rare and debilitating diseases. We offer a theory that explains how drug indivisibility, individual budget constraints, and insurance interact to drive up drug prices, especially for drugs treating rare and severe diseases. For a broad range of drug production costs and income distributions, our model predicts that drug prices are either set at their highest levels covered by insurance or inversely related to the prevalence of the disease. In the latter case, producer profits decrease with prevalence. The effect of production costs on prices and profits is non-monotonic.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了公众对治疗罕见和衰弱性疾病的高药价担忧的依据。我们提出了一种理论，解释了药品不可分割性、个人预算约束和保险如何相互作用推高药价，尤其是针对罕见和严重疾病的药品。在广泛的药品生产成本和收入分布范围内，我们的模型预测，药品价格要么设定在保险覆盖的最高水平，要么与疾病患病率呈反比。在后一种情况下，生产者利润随患病率增加而减少。生产成本对价格和利润的影响是非单调的。

records.title_en: Fertilizer demand and profitability amid global fuel-food-fertilizer crisis: Evidence from Ethiopia
records.title_cn: 全球燃料-食品-化肥危机中的化肥需求与盈利能力：来自埃塞俄比亚的证据
records.abstract_en: We assess fertilizer demand and profitability in Ethiopia in the face of the recent global fuel–food–fertilizer price crisis and other domestic shocks. We first examine farmers’ response to changes in both fertilizer and food prices by estimating price elasticity of demand. We then evaluate the profitability of fertilizer by computing average value–cost ratios (AVCRs) associated with fertilizer application before and after these crises. We use detailed longitudinal household survey data collected in three rounds, covering both pre-crisis (2016 and 2019) and post-crisis (2023) production periods, focusing on three main staple crops in Ethiopia (maize, teff, and wheat). Our analysis shows that fertilizer adoption, and yield levels were increasing until the recent crises, but these trends have been halted by these crises. We also find slightly larger fertilizer price elasticity of demand estimates than previous estimates, ranging between −0.40 and −1.12, which vary across crops. We find that farmers are more responsive to fertilizer prices than to output prices. Farmers’ response to increases in staple prices was statistically insignificant and hence not as strong as theoretically perceived. Households with smaller farm sizes are relatively more responsive to changes in fertilizer prices. Finally, we show important dynamics in the profitability of chemical fertilizer. While the AVCRs show profitable trends for most crops, the share of farmers with profitable AVCRs declined following the fertilizer price surges. Our findings offer important insights for policy focusing on mitigating the adverse effects of fertilizer price shocks.
records.abstract_cn: 我们评估了埃塞俄比亚在近期全球燃料-食品-化肥价格危机及其他国内冲击下化肥需求与盈利能力。我们首先通过估计需求的价格弹性来考察农民对化肥和食品价格变化的反应。然后，我们通过计算危机前后化肥应用相关的平均价值-成本比率（AVCRs）来评估化肥的盈利能力。我们使用了三轮收集的详细纵向农户调查数据，涵盖危机前（2016年和2019年）和危机后（2023年）的生产时期，重点关注埃塞俄比亚的三种主要 staple 作物（玉米、苔麸和小麦）。我们的分析显示，化肥采用率和产量水平在近期危机前一直在上升，但这些趋势已被这些危机所遏制。我们还发现化肥需求的价格弹性估计值略高于以往估计，范围在-0.40至-1.12之间，且因作物而异。我们发现农民对化肥价格的反应比对产出价格的更敏感。农民对主粮价格上升的反应在统计上不显著，因此不如理论上认为的那么强烈。农场规模较小的家庭对化肥价格变化的反应相对更敏感。最后，我们展示了化学肥料盈利能力的重要动态。虽然AVCRs显示大多数作物呈盈利趋势，但在化肥价格飙升后，具有盈利AVCRs的农民比例有所下降。我们的发现为旨在减轻化肥价格冲击不利影响的政策提供了重要见解。

records.title_en: Fertilizer and conflicts: Evidence from Myanmar
records.title_cn: 化肥与冲突：来自缅甸的证据
records.abstract_en: The number of farmers residing in fragile and conflict-affected countries is rising globally, yet the impacts of conflict on the economics of inorganic fertilizer in these settings remain poorly understood. We study how conflicts in Myanmar, combined with global fertilizer market disruptions, have affected inorganic fertilizer prices, use, response, and efficiency. We utilize unique nationally representative household panel survey data and a comprehensive approach that employs various analytical methods to examine the nexus between conflicts and fertilizer-related issues. Our findings reveal that greater intensity of violent events is associated with higher prices of major types of inorganic fertilizer, particularly in areas farther from major import locations. These price changes and increases in violent events have suppressed both the likelihood and quantity of inorganic fertilizer usage, leading to decreased rice yield responses at given nitrogen application levels. Panel stochastic frontier analyses, combined with a method addressing the endogeneity of inorganic fertilizer use, suggest a significant decline in fertilizer use efficiency each year since the onset of conflict. The increase in violent events is also associated with the reduced use of extension services, seeds from markets, irrigation, and optimal fertilizer blends, which may partly explain the diminished returns and efficiency of inorganic fertilizer use. Conflict therefore seems to be associated with a change in the economics of inorganic fertilizer use through various impact channels, affecting agricultural performance in these fragile and conflict-affected settings.
records.abstract_cn: 全球居住在脆弱和受冲突影响国家的农民数量正在上升，然而冲突对这些环境中无机化肥经济学的影响仍知之甚少。我们研究了缅甸的冲突，结合全球化肥市场的中断，如何影响无机化肥的价格、使用、响应和效率。我们利用独特的全国代表性住户面板调查数据和一种综合方法，采用多种分析方法来考察冲突与化肥相关问题之间的联系。我们的发现表明，暴力事件强度的增加与主要类型无机化肥价格的上涨相关，尤其是在距离主要进口地点较远的地区。这些价格变化和暴力事件的增加抑制了无机化肥使用的可能性和数量，导致在给定氮施用水平下水稻产量响应下降。面板随机前沿分析，结合一种处理无机化肥使用内生性的方法，表明自冲突爆发以来，化肥使用效率每年显著下降。暴力事件的增加还与推广服务、市场种子、灌溉和最佳化肥配方的使用减少相关，这可能部分解释了无机化肥使用回报和效率的下降。因此，冲突似乎通过各种影响渠道与无机化肥使用的经济学变化相关，影响这些脆弱和受冲突影响环境中的农业绩效。

records.title_en: Early growing season temperature variation and fertilizer use among smallholder farmers
records.title_cn: 生长季早期温度变化与小农户的化肥使用
records.abstract_en: This study examines the impact of early growing season temperature variation on fertilizer use among maize-producing smallholder farmers in Ethiopia. A unique, decade-long dataset collected at the plot level was integrated with climate data to construct weather variation indicators that are comparable across time and space. The findings reveal that smallholder farmers adapt their fertilizer application strategies in response to early growing season temperature variations. Heterogeneity analyses show that environmental factors such as altitude affect fertilizer use when farmers face early growing season temperature variations.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了生长季早期温度变化对埃塞俄比亚玉米种植小农户化肥使用的影响。一项独特的地块层面十年期数据集与气候数据相结合，构建了在时间和空间上可比较的天气变化指标。研究结果表明，小农户会根据生长季早期的温度变化调整其化肥施用策略。异质性分析显示，当农户面临生长季早期温度变化时，海拔等环境因素会影响化肥使用。

records.title_en: Maize yield responsiveness and profitability of fertilizer: New survey evidence from six African countries
records.title_cn: 玉米产量响应性与肥料盈利性：来自六个非洲国家的新调查证据
records.abstract_en: Enhancing maize productivity growth is pivotal for revolutionizing the agrifood system in Africa, with inorganic fertilizer serving as a fundamental input for catalyzing this progress. However, concerns are mounting about the low and decreasing yield response and profitability of inorganic fertilizer use, particularly in Sub-Saharan Africa. This study aims to refine yield response and profitability models by incorporating recent data from nationally representative and panel datasets spanning six countries. Most countries exhibited low nitrogen yield responsiveness (4–7 kg), while Ghana and Uganda showed higher responsiveness (15–20 kg) per additional 1 kg of nitrogen. Analysis of fertilizer-to-maize price ratios from 2010 to 2023 showed a downward trend, with spikes in 2022 in Ghana, Malawi, Nigeria, and Tanzania. Overall, except for those years, the data suggest a trend of increasingly favorable price incentives for fertilizer use. Ethiopia, Tanzania, and Uganda experienced declines in the fertilizer-to-maize price ratio. Increasing inorganic fertilizer use would be profitable in Ethiopia, Ghana, Nigeria, and Uganda at current market prices, but not in Malawi or Tanzania. Subsidies in Malawi and Tanzania have boosted profitability, but these may not be necessary in Ghana, Nigeria, or Uganda, which already have favorable price incentives; Malawi could benefit by substantially reducing its 80 percent subsidy while maintaining decent price incentives and farm profits. The paper proposes policy options based on factors influencing yield responsiveness and potential improvements drawn from new modeling and synthesis of the literature.
records.abstract_cn: 提升玉米产量增长对于变革非洲农业食品体系至关重要，无机肥料作为促进这一进程的基础投入品。然而，人们日益担忧无机肥料使用的产量响应性和盈利性低且不断下降，尤其是在撒哈拉以南非洲地区。本研究旨在通过纳入来自六个国家的全国代表性及面板数据集的最新数据，改进产量响应性和盈利性模型。大多数国家的氮肥产量响应性较低（4-7公斤），而加纳和乌干达表现出较高的响应性（15-20公斤），每增加1公斤氮肥。对2010年至2023年肥料与玉米价格比率的分析显示下降趋势，其中2022年在加纳、马拉维、尼日利亚和坦桑尼亚出现峰值。总体而言，除那些年份外，数据表明肥料使用的价格激励趋势日益有利。埃塞俄比亚、坦桑尼亚和乌干达的肥料与玉米价格比率出现下降。在当前市场价格下，增加无机肥料使用在埃塞俄比亚、加纳、尼日利亚和乌干达将是盈利的，但在马拉维或坦桑尼亚则不然。马拉维和坦桑尼亚的补贴提高了盈利性，但在加纳、尼日利亚或乌干达可能并无必要，这些国家已有有利的价格激励；马拉维可以通过大幅减少其80%的补贴，同时保持合理的价格激励和农场利润而受益。本文基于影响产量响应性的因素以及从新模型和文献综述中得出的潜在改进，提出了政策选项。

records.title_en: Fertilizer policy reforms in the midst of crisis: Evidence from Rwanda
records.title_cn: 危机中的肥料政策改革：来自卢旺达的证据
records.abstract_en: Fertilizer subsidies are a prominent feature of many agricultural development strategies in sub-Saharan Africa, but few countries have the necessary data to make rapid decisions about their management in the face of exogenous shocks. This was the case in Rwanda following the rapid increase in international fertilizer prices in 2021–22. Working within a constrained fiscal space that followed the economic downturn caused by the COVID-19 pandemic, the Government of Rwanda aimed to revise its fertilizer subsidy system to accommodate higher fertilizer import pric-es without compromising progress against its agricultural growth targets. This paper explores both the economic analysis and policy process that shaped decision-making around Rwanda’s fertilizer subsidy system during the period 2020–23. The paper centers on the design and application of a microsimulation model that estimated—almost in real time—the impact of increased fertilizer prices on crop production during this period. It then explores the policy outcomes that followed, emphasizing the scope for subsidy reductions even in the midst of crisis, the critical importance of strengthening agricultural data systems, and lessons for countries facing similar challenges.
records.abstract_cn: 肥料补贴是撒哈拉以南非洲许多农业发展战略的一个显著特征，但很少有国家拥有必要的数据来在面对外部冲击时迅速做出管理决策。在2021-22年国际肥料价格迅速上涨之后，卢旺达的情况就是如此。在因COVID-19大流行导致的经济衰退之后，卢旺达政府在有限的财政空间内工作，旨在修订其肥料补贴系统，以适应更高的肥料进口价格，同时不损害其农业增长目标的进展。本文探讨了在2020-23年期间塑造卢旺达肥料补贴系统决策的经济分析和政策过程。本文重点介绍了一个微观模拟模型的设计和应用，该模型几乎实时地估计了这一时期肥料价格上涨对作物生产的影响。随后，本文探讨了随后的政策结果，强调了即使在危机中削减补贴的空间、加强农业数据系统的关键重要性，以及为面临类似挑战的国家提供的教训。

records.title_en: Input subsidies, fertilizer intensity and imbalances amidst climate change: Evidence from Bangladesh
records.title_cn: 气候变化下的投入补贴、化肥强度与失衡：来自孟加拉国的证据
records.abstract_en: This study investigates whether input subsidies to rural households with exposure to droughts affect fertilizer application rates. The study uses a comprehensive panel dataset of rice plots from the Bangladesh Integrated Household Survey. The study uses a heteroskedasticity-based instrumental variable approach (Lewbel estimator) to account for the potential endogeneity of input subsidies on input usage. Findings show that while input subsidies are generally associated with increased fertilizer application, the effect is attenuated by household vulnerability to climate shocks. Input subsidies widen the gap between recommended and actual fertilizer usage for urea but narrow it down to diammonium phosphate and muriate of potassium. However, the aggregate effect on balanced fertilizer application is a higher degree of imbalance when households are exposed to climate shocks. The analysis highlights the heterogeneous effect of subsidies on fertilizer use across different farm sizes, seed varieties, and soil quality. The heterogeneities underscore the need for targeted subsidy programs and complementary policies to promote balanced fertilizer application while addressing climate change adaptation strategies.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了遭受干旱风险的农村家庭所获得的投入补贴是否会影响化肥施用量。研究使用了孟加拉国综合家庭调查中水稻地块的全面面板数据集。研究采用基于异方差性的工具变量方法（Lewbel估计量）来解决投入补贴对投入使用的潜在内生性问题。研究结果表明，虽然投入补贴总体上与化肥施用量的增加相关，但这种效应因家庭对气候冲击的脆弱性而减弱。投入补贴扩大了尿素推荐施用量与实际施用量之间的差距，但缩小了磷酸二铵和氯化钾的差距。然而，当家庭面临气候冲击时，对平衡施肥的总体效应是失衡程度更高。分析强调了补贴对不同农场规模、种子品种和土壤质量的化肥使用存在异质性影响。这些异质性凸显了制定有针对性的补贴计划和配套政策以促进平衡施肥，同时应对气候变化适应策略的必要性。

records.title_en: Deconstructing fertilizer price spikes: Evidence from Chinese urea fertilizer market
records.title_cn: 解构化肥价格飙升：来自中国尿素化肥市场的证据
records.abstract_en: Recent fertilizer price spikes in 2021–2022, coupled with government interventions by major exporting countries, have raised global concerns about food security. This study investigates the key drivers of urea prices in China—the world’s largest producer and a major exporter. First, we analyze price transmission between China’s domestic spot and export urea markets, finding no cointegration even prior to the export restrictions introduced in October 2021. Next, we employ a structural vector autoregression model to examine domestic urea price spikes, using a heteroskedasticity-based identification strategy that allows for smoothly transitioning covariances. We decompose urea prices into four structural shocks: supply shocks driven by energy price changes, demand shocks linked to crop price fluctuations, export demand shocks, and market-specific idiosyncratic shocks unrelated to the first three. The findings reveal that rising energy costs and idiosyncratic factors were the main drivers of urea prices in China from 2018 to 2023, while shocks to corn prices and export demand had a smaller impact. Overall, the results indicate that recent export restrictions have had limited influence on domestic urea prices, calling into question the effectiveness of China’s October 2021 export restrictions as a price stabilization measure.
records.abstract_cn: 最近2021-2022化肥价格飙升，加上主要出口国的政府干预，引发了全球对粮食安全的担忧。本研究调查了中国——世界上最大的生产国和主要出口国——尿素价格的主要驱动因素。首先，我们分析了中国国内现货和出口尿素市场之间的价格传递，发现即使在十月2021实行出口限制之前也不存在协整关系。接下来，我们采用结构向量自回归模型来检查国内尿素价格飙升，并使用基于异方差的识别策略来平滑过渡协方差。我们将尿素价格分解为四种结构性冲击：由能源价格变化驱动的供应冲击、与作物价格波动相关的需求冲击、出口需求冲击以及与前三种冲击无关的市场特定冲击。研究结果表明，能源成本上涨和特殊因素是2018至2023中国尿素价格的主要驱动因素，而玉米价格和出口需求的冲击影响较小。总体而言，结果表明，近期的出口限制对国内尿素价格的影响有限，令人质疑中国十月2021出口限制作为价格稳定措施的有效性。

records.title_en: The economic consequences of fertilizer supply shocks
records.title_cn: 化肥供应冲击的经济后果
records.abstract_en: This paper develops a fertilizer supply index to measure global fertilizer supply disruptions using text-mining analysis of newspaper articles from over 30 countries. The index captures events including export restrictions, tariff changes, raw material shortages, and international sanctions. Using a structural BVAR framework, the analysis examines how fertilizer supply shocks affect Portugal’s food industry across three dimensions: market activity (domestic and foreign turnover), output prices, and labor market dynamics. The results show that fertilizer supply shocks trigger immediate increases in output prices across both domestic and foreign markets, with firms passing input costs to consumers. Labor market responses are delayed: wages and hours worked remain stable initially before rising, consistent with delayed adjustment to inflation expectations. This research also provides new evidence on how a critical agricultural input shocks propagate through food supply chains in a small open economy, with implications for both policymaking and industry strategy.
records.abstract_cn: 本文通过对来自多个 30 个国家的报纸文章进行文本挖掘分析，开发了一个化肥供应指数来衡量全球化肥供应中断情况。该指数反映了出口限制、关税变化、原材料短缺和国际制裁等事件。该分析使用结构性 BVAR 框架，研究化肥供应冲击如何从三个维度影响葡萄牙食品工业：市场活动（国内和国外营业额）、产出价格和劳动力市场动态。结果表明，化肥供应冲击引发国内外市场产出价格立即上涨，企业将投入成本转嫁给消费者。劳动力市场的反应被延迟：工资和工作时间在上升之前最初保持稳定，这与通胀预期的延迟调整一致。这项研究还提供了新的证据，说明关键的农业投入冲击如何通过小型开放经济体的食品供应链传播，对政策制定和行业战略都有影响。

records.title_en: The impact of site-specific soil-test-based extension advice on farm management in Malawi
records.title_cn: 基于特定地点土壤测试的推广建议对马拉维农场管理的影响
records.abstract_en: Agricultural extension services in Africa face many challenges in reaching farmers with information for sustainable and improved crop production. A critical gap for many smallholders is a lack of knowledge of their soils, including soil organic carbon (SOC) content, a key soil health indicator driving fertiliser responsiveness and crop production. We use a randomised control trial (RCT) to estimate the causal effects of real-time diagnostics and soil carbon measurement to support behavioural change and farmers’ adaptive capacity to improve farm management practices. Treatment group farmers receive context-specific extension services through site-specific soil tests using a handheld reflectometer as a starting point for in-depth discussions with extension agents about soil management. The results suggest significant improvements in sustainable intensification within the treatment group, with gains in farmer experimentation and adoption of organic inputs and management practices in both the year of advice and one year later. Treatment farmers are 40 percent more likely to apply organic fertilisers, 18 percent more likely to incorporate crop residues into their soils, and 7 percent more likely to intercrop maize with a legume. Further, treatment farmers show better timing of inorganic fertiliser applications, though use decisions are largely unchanged. The widespread fertiliser subsidy program may have influenced this last finding. This research demonstrates that a low-cost soil testing tool combined with individualised soil management advice can influence farmers’ soil nutrient-management behaviours and improve the capacity of extension to deliver site-specific soil information. This can lead to marked improvements in the effectiveness of farm management practices and agricultural extension services.
records.abstract_cn: 非洲的农业推广服务在向农民提供可持续和改进作物生产的信息方面面临着许多挑战。许多小农户面临的一个关键差距是缺乏对土壤的了解，包括土壤有机碳 (SOC) 含量，这是驱动肥料响应性和作物生产的关键土壤健康指标。我们使用随机对照试验（RCT）来估计实时诊断和土壤碳测量的因果效应，以支持行为改变和农民改善农场管理实践的适应能力。处理组的农民通过使用手持式反射计进行特定地点的土壤测试来获得针对具体情况的推广服务，作为与推广机构深入讨论土壤管理问题的起点。结果表明，治疗组内的可持续集约化取得了显着改善，在建议当年和一年后，农民的试验以及有机投入和管理实践的采用都取得了进展。接受处理的农民40%更有可能施用有机肥，18%更有可能将农作物残留物纳入土壤中，并且7%更有可能将玉米与豆科作物间作。此外，接受处理的农民表现出更好的无机肥施用时机，尽管使用决策基本上没有变化。广泛的肥料补贴计划可能影响了最后的发现。这项研究表明，低成本的土壤测试工具与个性化的土壤管理建议相结合可以影响农民的土壤养分管理行为，并提高提供特定地点土壤信息的推广能力。这可以显着提高农场管理实践和农业推广服务的有效性。

records.title_en: Once bitten, twice shy? Direct and indirect effects of weather shocks on fertilizer and improved seeds use
records.title_cn: 一朝被蛇咬，两次害羞？天气冲击对肥料和改善种子使用的直接和间接影响
records.abstract_en: Evidence suggests that negative weather shocks, such as droughts, can influence input use in agriculture by reducing available income and shaping farmers’ behavioral responses. Yet, the relative importance of these two pathways remains unclear. This study proposes a method to disentangle the direct (behavioral) and indirect (income) effects of a drought shock on the use of inorganic fertilizer and improved maize seed. We employed a two-way fixed-effects regression combined with causal mediation analysis and entropy balancing to account for income endogeneity on a rich farm-level data from 6058 smallholder households in Zambia in 2012 and 2015. Our results show that farmers who experienced a drought in the previous growing season are less likely to use inorganic fertilizer but more likely to use improved seeds. The indirect income effect accounts for approximately 10% of the total effect for both inputs, amplifying the direct effect for inorganic fertilizer while diminishing it for improved seeds. The contribution of the indirect effect increases with the severity of drought shocks, although the direct effect remains the dominant channel. We also provide suggestive evidence that changes in risk aversion drive behavioral responses, while access to credit mitigates the income effect. These results highlight how drought shocks influence the timing and type of technology adopted in agriculture. Understanding the relative importance of these direct and indirect effects offers critical insights for policies aimed at enhancing climate change adaptation and agricultural productivity in the developing world.
records.abstract_cn: 有证据表明，干旱等负面天气冲击可能会减少可用收入并影响农民的行为反应，从而影响农业投入品的使用。然而，这两条途径的相对重要性仍不清楚。本研究提出了一种方法来理清干旱冲击对无机肥料和改良玉米种子使用的直接（行为）和间接（收入）影响。我们采用双向固定效应回归结合因果中介分析和熵平衡来解释2012和2015赞比亚6058小农家庭丰富农场层面数据的收入内生性。我们的结果表明，在上一个生长季节经历干旱的农民不太可能使用无机肥料，但更有可能使用改良种子。间接收入效应约占两种投入总效应的10%，放大了无机肥料的直接效应，同时减弱了改良种子的直接效应。尽管直接影响仍然是主要渠道，但间接影响的贡献随着干旱冲击的严重程度而增加。我们还提供了提示性证据，表明风险规避的变化会驱动行为反应，而获得信贷会减轻收入影响。这些结果凸显了干旱冲击如何影响农业采用的技术的时机和类型。了解这些直接和间接影响的相对重要性为旨在加强发展中国家气候变化适应和农业生产力的政策提供了重要见解。

records.title_en: Smallholder farming, fertilizer use, and the polycrisis period: Cross-country evidence from longitudinal surveys in Sub-Saharan Africa
records.title_cn: 小农耕作、化肥使用和多危机时期：来自撒哈拉以南非洲地区纵向调查的跨国证据
records.abstract_en: Smallholder agriculture continues to be the main source of livelihood for a large portion of Sub-Saharan Africa’s population. In recent years, compounding crises and shocks have threatened this livelihood basis. How did smallholder farmers in Sub-Saharan Africa fare throughout this period? What measures did they take to cope with the repeated disruption to their farming activities? We address this knowledge gap using nationally representative, cross-country comparable longitudinal microdata collected from over 16,000 agricultural households in six Sub-Saharan African countries between 2018 and 2024. While overall fertilizer adoption remained relatively stable, we find considerable cross-country heterogeneity and poorer households to be more likely to have discontinued fertilizer use. At the intensive margin, 47% of farmers could not access their desired quantity of fertilizer. On average, these farmers used less than half as much inorganic fertilizer as they desired with affordability being the main constraint. Households adopted a range of coping strategies, some of which may compromise productivity and heighten future vulnerability.
records.abstract_cn: 小农农业仍然是撒哈拉以南非洲大部分人口的主要生计来源。近年来，不断加剧的危机和冲击威胁着这一生计基础。在此期间，撒哈拉以南非洲的小农表现如何？他们采取了哪些措施来应对农业活动一再受到干扰？我们使用2018至2024期间从六个撒哈拉以南非洲国家的16,000多个农业家庭收集的具有全国代表性的、跨国可比较的纵向微观数据来解决这一知识差距。虽然化肥的总体使用量保持相对稳定，但我们发现各国之间存在相当大的异质性，贫困家庭更有可能停止使用化肥。在集约边际，47%的农民无法获得他们想要的肥料数量。平均而言，这些农民使用的无机肥料还不到他们想要的一半，而负担能力是主要限制因素。家庭采取了一系列应对策略，其中一些可能会损害生产力并加剧未来的脆弱性。

records.title_en: Global shocks and local sellers: Kenyan fertilizer markets’ response to the fuel-fertilizer-food price crisis
records.title_cn: 全球冲击和当地卖家：肯尼亚化肥市场对燃料化肥食品价格危机的反应
records.abstract_en: Global fertilizer prices doubled during the 2020–2022 fuel-fertilizer-food crisis, pushing an additional 210 million people into acute food insecurity. We use transaction-level data from agro-dealers to analyze how this global shock transmitted through Kenyan retail markets. How global price shocks spread across rural markets to affect firms and farmers in low-income countries remains poorly understood. We show that retail fertilizer prices in Kenya rose 81% on average during the crisis, with remarkable spatial variation ranging from 5% decreases to 138% increases across shops. We use dyadic panel analysis to identify changes in price transmission and in market integration across Kenyan fertilizer retailers and to evaluate the effects of government policy intervention. We find evidence of asymmetric price transmission; agro-dealer prices responded faster to import price increases than decreases. We show that larger shops and major agricultural production zones experienced faster price transmission and stronger integration with import markets relative to high-poverty areas. Kenya’s National Fertilizer Subsidy Program slowed price transmission but may have prolonged higher fertilizer retail prices. Our results imply that farmers do not benefit as rapidly from input price reductions as they would under symmetric transmission. Our results also demonstrate that global shocks transmit unevenly across markets, suggesting effective stabilization policies should account for heterogeneity in market conditions and variable pass-through behavior.
records.abstract_cn: 在2020-2022燃料肥料粮食危机期间，全球化肥价格翻了一番，使另外210百万人陷入严重的粮食不安全。我们使用农产品经销商的交易级数据来分析这种全球冲击如何通过肯尼亚零售市场传播。全球价格冲击如何在农村市场蔓延并影响低收入国家的企业和农民，人们仍然知之甚少。我们发现，危机期间肯尼亚化肥零售价格平均上涨 81%，各商店的空间差异显着，从 5% 下降到 138% 上涨。我们使用二元面板分析来确定肯尼亚化肥零售商的价格传导和市场一体化的变化，并评估政府政策干预的效果。我们发现了价格传导不对称的证据；农产品经销商价格对进口价格上涨的反应快于进口价格下降的反应。我们发现，相对于高贫困地区，较大的商店和主要农产品产区的价格传导速度更快，与进口市场的一体化程度也更强。肯尼亚国家化肥补贴计划减缓了价格传导，但可能延长了化肥零售价格的上涨。我们的结果表明，农民从投入价格下降中受益的速度不如对称传导下那么快。我们的研究结果还表明，全球冲击在各个市场之间的传导不均匀，这表明有效的稳定政策应考虑到市场条件的异质性和可变的传导行为。

records.title_en: Fertilizer, soil health, and economic shocks: A synthesis of recent evidence
records.title_cn: 肥料、土壤健康和经济冲击：最新证据综合
records.abstract_en: Most countries, at all stages of development, adopt policies to improve agricultural productivity through the application of inorganic fertilizer and the management of soil health. Unfortunately, global and local economic shocks can quickly erode the impact of these policies, as was evident during the global food, fuel, and fertilizer price crisis that began in 2020. This paper synthesizes recent evidence on the magnitude and distribution of—and responses to— the recent shocks to international fertilizer markets, building on evidence from this Special Issue of Food Policy and other recent contributions to the literature. The available evidence suggests that although international fertilizer prices increased dramatically in 2020–2022 and remained above their pre-COVID-19 pandemic level through 2024, the medium-term effects on global fertilizer demand were relatively modest. However, global aggregates obscure important short-term effects, including reduced fertilizer use and lower farm profits in smallholder production systems in many low- and middle-income countries. Although these effects varied considerably by country, dependence on fertilizer imports and vulnerability to idiosyncratic domestic shocks likely played a key role in driving these effects. The evidence synthesized in this paper reveals varying responses (across countries and farmers) and patterns of price transmission (across local and international markets) while also highlighting the potential of fertilizer subsidy programs and other policy interventions to mitigate the effects of fertilizer price volatility and improve soil health, particularly in the midst of a climate crisis that adds uncertainty to agricultural production. From a longer-term perspective, much research is still needed to unpack the effects of this crisis—and the possible effects of future crises—on the international transmission of fertilizer price shocks, policy response options to both immediate shocks and more protracted threats, farm-level strategies to increase resilience to these shocks and to encourage more judicious fertilizer use and soil health management.
records.abstract_cn: 大多数国家在各个发展阶段都采取政策，通过施用无机肥料和管理土壤健康来提高农业生产力。不幸的是，全球和地方经济冲击可能会迅速削弱这些政策的影响，正如2020开始的全球粮食、燃料和化肥价格危机期间所体现的那样。本文以本期《粮食政策》特刊和其他近期文献贡献的证据为基础，综合了有关近期国际化肥市场冲击的规模和分布以及应对措施的最新证据。现有证据表明，尽管国际化肥价格在2020-2022期间大幅上涨，并在2024期间保持在新冠疫情19大流行前的水平之上，但对全球化肥需求的中期影响相对较小。然而，全球总量掩盖了重要的短期影响，包括许多中低收入国家小农生产系统化肥使用量减少和农场利润下降。尽管这些影响因国家而异，但对化肥进口的依赖和对特殊国内冲击的脆弱性可能在推动这些影响方面发挥了关键作用。本文综合的证据揭示了不同的反应（跨国家和农民）和价格传导模式（跨本地和国际市场），同时还强调了化肥补贴计划和其他政策干预措施在减轻化肥价格波动影响和改善土壤健康方面的潜力，特别是在气候危机增加农业生产不确定性的情况下。从长远来看，仍需要开展大量研究来揭示这场危机以及未来危机可能对化肥价格冲击的国际传播产生的影响、针对直接冲击和更长期威胁的政策应对方案、提高对这些冲击的抵御能力并鼓励更明智地使用化肥和土壤健康管理的农场战略。

records.title_en: Global shocks to fertilizer markets: Impacts on prices, demand and farm profitability
records.title_cn: 全球化肥市场冲击：对价格、需求和农场盈利能力的影响
records.abstract_en: During 2021–2022, spiking fertilizer prices raised fears that fertilizer application would drop around the world, leading to lower crop production, higher food prices, and greater food insecurity. Even writing mid-2024, a paucity of data impedes a full assessment of how the underlying global market shocks may have affected farmers and food production around the world. Using proxy indicators for fertilizer demand and farm profitability, we find that despite the steep increase in input costs, global demand for fertilizer fell only modestly during the 2022–2023 crop cycle, suggesting many (commercial) farmers were able and willing to absorb increased input costs in the context of generally good harvest prospects and, at the time, high crop prices. However, we also find the fertilizer price spikes have not been felt equally, with many farmers in Africa estimated to have been affected more adversely, even though with varied impacts also amongst those farmers.
records.abstract_cn: [2021-2022]期间，化肥价格飙升引发了人们对世界各地化肥施用量下降的担忧，导致农作物减产、粮食价格上涨和粮食不安全加剧。即使在2024中期撰写，数据的缺乏也阻碍了对潜在的全球市场冲击如何影响世界各地农民和粮食生产的全面评估。使用肥料需求和农场盈利能力的代理指标，我们发现，尽管投入成本急剧增加，但全球肥料需求在2022-2023作物周期期间仅小幅下降，这表明许多（商业）农民能够并且愿意在总体良好的收成前景和当时农作物价格高的背景下吸收增加的投入成本。然而，我们还发现化肥价格上涨的影响并不相同，许多非洲农民估计受到的影响更为不利，尽管这些农民之间的影响也各不相同。

records.title_en: Leveraging agricultural production organizations to reduce fertilizer use: Evidence from China
records.title_cn: 利用农业生产组织减少化肥使用：来自中国的证据
records.abstract_en: Smallholder-dominated agriculture in China faces severe fertilizer overuse due to fragmented land, limited mechanization, and low adoption of advanced agricultural technologies. Agricultural production organizations (e.g., family farms, agricultural cooperatives, and agricultural enterprises), characterized by their relatively large scale and advanced agricultural practices, are considered potential solutions for promoting more sustainable practices. This study investigates whether and how different agricultural production organization forms are associated with fertilizer use in China. Linking detailed business registry data with county-level panel data, we find that agricultural enterprises and cooperatives are associated with reductions in fertilizer use at the county level, while family farms do not show a significant relationship. Agricultural mechanization and land consolidation are potential channels through which agricultural enterprises and cooperatives are linked to these reductions. Further analysis with household survey data suggests associations between these two types of organizations and reductions in smallholders’ fertilizer inputs through agricultural services. Heterogeneity analysis indicates that agricultural enterprises have a more pronounced effect in areas with extensive land transfer, advanced fertilization techniques, and in the eastern and plain regions of China. Agricultural cooperatives, benefiting from their unique governance structure, consistently show negative associations with fertilizer use regardless of land transfer, fertilization techniques, and topography constraints. Our findings provide insights into pathways for transitioning smallholder farming toward sustainable agriculture.
records.abstract_cn: 由于土地分散、机械化水平有限以及先进农业技术采用率低，中国以小农为主的农业面临着严重的化肥过度使用问题。农业生产组织（例如家庭农场、农业合作社和农业企业）以其规模相对较大和先进的农业实践为特点，被认为是促进更可持续实践的潜在解决方案。本研究调查了中国不同的农业生产组织形式是否与化肥使用相关以及如何相关。将详细的企业登记数据与县级面板数据联系起来，我们发现农业企业和合作社与县级化肥使用量的减少有关，而家庭农场则没有表现出显着的关系。农业机械化和土地整理是农业企业和合作社与这些减排挂钩的潜在渠道。对家庭调查数据的进一步分析表明，这两类组织与通过农业服务减少小农化肥投入之间存在关联。异质性分析表明，在土地流转广泛、施肥技术先进的地区以及东部和平原地区，农业企业的效应更为显着。农业合作社受益于其独特的治理结构，无论土地流转、施肥技术和地形限制如何，都始终与化肥使用呈负相关。我们的研究结果为小农农业向可持续农业转型的途径提供了见解。

records.title_en: Unit cost expectations: Firms’ perspectives on inflation
records.title_cn: 单位成本预期：企业对通胀的看法
records.abstract_en: We propose a novel survey-based measure of nominal marginal cost expectations held by business decision makers to track building inflationary pressures and augment the existing set of inflation expectations data policymakers frequently monitor. Unlike other surveys of firms or households that elicit “aggregate” expectations, we focus on idiosyncratic costs that firms are well-aware of, plan for, and matter for price setting. We document four key findings. First, once aggregated, firms’ unit cost realizations closely comove with U.S. inflation statistics. Second, in aggregate, firms’ unit cost expectations significantly outperform households’ inflation expectations when inflation is low and are at least as accurate as the expectations of professional forecasters in out-of-sample forecasting exercises in high and low inflation environments. Third, utilizing special questions, we find evidence that information treatments about aggregate inflation and policymakers’ forecasts do little to alter firms’ unit cost expectations. And, lastly, we show that unit costs, at the firm level, are an important determinant of their own price setting behavior.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种基于调查的新颖的衡量商业决策者名义边际成本预期的措施，以跟踪不断上升的通胀压力并扩大政策制定者经常监控的现有通胀预期数据集。与其他引发“总体”预期的企业或家庭调查不同，我们关注的是企业充分意识到、计划好的、对定价至关重要的特殊成本。我们记录了四个主要发现。首先，一旦汇总，企业的单位成本实现与美国通胀统计数据密切相关。其次，总体而言，当通胀较低时，企业的单位成本预期明显优于家庭的通胀预期，并且至少与专业预测者在高通胀和低通胀环境下进行样本外预测时的预期一样准确。第三，利用特殊问题，我们发现证据表明，有关总体通胀和政策制定者预测的信息处理对于改变企业的单位成本预期几乎没有作用。最后，我们表明，在公司层面，单位成本是其自身定价行为的重要决定因素。

records.title_en: More effort with less pay: On information avoidance, optimistic beliefs, and performance
records.title_cn: 付出更多，回报更少：论信息回避、乐观信念与绩效
records.abstract_en: Neoclassical theory presumes that agents value instrumental information. In contrast, recent behavioral studies motivate and model information avoidance. We study preferences for and against instrumental information in a real-effort task varying information structures on performance pay. Our study offers three main results. First, we confirm that both, preferences for and against instrumental information, exist. Second, information avoiders outperform information receivers. This result holds independently of effects of self-selection. Third, our findings about information avoiders can be aligned with behavioral theories of optimistic belief design.
records.abstract_cn: 新古典理论假定经济主体重视工具性信息。相反，近期的行为研究激发并模型化了信息回避行为。我们在一个真实努力任务中研究对工具性信息的偏好与回避，该任务改变了绩效薪酬的信息结构。我们的研究提供了三个主要结果。首先，我们确认了对工具性信息的偏好与回避均存在。其次，信息回避者的绩效优于信息接收者。这一结果独立于自我选择效应。第三，我们关于信息回避者的发现可以与乐观信念设计的行为理论相吻合。

records.title_en: Global value chains and the Phillips curve: A challenge for monetary policy
records.title_cn: 全球价值链与菲利普斯曲线：对货币政策的挑战
records.abstract_en: This paper studies how participation and position in Global Value Chains (GVCs) affect the slope of the Phillips Curve (PC) and, consequently, the ability of monetary policy to control inflation. Using data from the European Monetary Union (EMU) and value added measures of GVCs, we show that, beyond the role of trade openness, higher participation leads to a flatter PC. This evidence is consistent with the theoretical literature emphasising how globalisation can reduce the sensitivity of prices to unemployment due to stronger strategic complementarities, to higher market power and to imperfect exchange rate pass-through. On the other hand, the role of GVC position is not statistically significant.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究全球价值链（GVCs）中的参与度和位置如何影响菲利普斯曲线（PC）的斜率，进而影响货币政策控制通胀的能力。利用欧洲货币联盟（EMU）的数据和GVCs的增加值衡量指标，我们表明，除了贸易开放度的作用外，更高的参与度会导致更平坦的PC。这一证据与强调全球化如何通过更强的战略互补性、更高的市场支配力和不完全的汇率传递效应来降低价格对失业敏感性的理论文献一致。另一方面，GVC位置的作用在统计上不显著。

records.title_en: Market competition and the adoption of clean technology: Evidence from the taxi industry
records.title_cn: 市场竞争与清洁技术采纳：来自出租车行业的证据
records.abstract_en: Environmental policies may be ineffective when firms lack incentives to adopt cleaner technologies due to their market power. This paper examines whether a competition shock in a concentrated industry can stimulate the adoption of policy-favored cleaner technologies. Using a unique panel dataset covering the universe of vehicles purchased by taxi drivers in Spain, we exploit the entry of ride-hailing platforms as a natural experiment to identify the impact on their vehicle choices. We find that increased competition led to a 30% surge in the adoption of electric-powered vehicles among taxi drivers. Back-of-the-envelope calculations suggest an overall reduction in CO2 emissions, highlighting the potential of competition policy to promote environmental sustainability while mitigating market power.
records.abstract_cn: 当企业因市场势力而缺乏采纳更清洁技术的激励时，环境政策可能无效。本文考察了集中行业中的竞争冲击是否能刺激政策偏好的清洁技术的采纳。利用覆盖西班牙出租车司机购买的所有车辆的独特面板数据集，我们将网约车平台的进入作为自然实验，以识别其对车辆选择的影响。我们发现，竞争加剧导致出租车司机中电动汽车采纳率激增了30%。粗略计算表明，二氧化碳排放总体减少，凸显了竞争政策在促进环境可持续性的同时缓解市场势力的潜力。

records.title_en: On explaining why the (human) world is rich
records.title_cn: 论为何（人类）世界是富有的
records.abstract_en: The wealth of the modern world is a natural historical marvel. Explaining it has traditionally been the purview of economic historians, as exemplified by the recent book How the World Became Rich by Mark Koyama and Jared Rubin. Economic historians, though, tend to only ask process-oriented “how” and “by what means” questions of the Great Enrichment. The eight co-authors of Explaining Technology, who are not economic historians, engage the debate asking a different question. Their goal is to explain the exponential shape of our enrichment with a model of the combinatorial evolution of technology. With an eye toward how we ask questions of the Great Enrichment, I propose broadening our inquiries to include questions typically overlooked in modern economic science, namely, “What form does it take? and “For what purpose?”
records.abstract_cn: 现代世界的财富是一个自然历史奇迹。解释这一现象传统上是经济史学家的领域，正如马克·科亚马和贾里德·鲁宾最近出版的《世界如何变得富有》一书所示。然而，经济史学家往往只对“大富裕”提出过程导向的“如何”和“通过何种方式”的问题。《解释技术》的八位合著者并非经济史学家，他们以不同的提问方式参与了这场辩论。他们的目标是通过技术组合演化的模型来解释我们富裕的指数形态。着眼于我们如何对“大富裕”提问，我建议拓宽我们的探究范围，纳入现代经济科学中通常被忽视的问题，即：“它采取什么形式？”以及“为了什么目的？”

records.title_en: Greenflation: Empirical evidence using macro, regional and sectoral data
records.title_cn: 绿色通胀：基于宏观、区域和部门数据的实证证据
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates the impact of climate change policies on inflation, for a large sample of 177 developed and developing economies, 78 subnational territorial areas and 17 sectors, over the period 1989–2022. We show that carbon taxes lead to inflationary pressures. The effect is not negligible: a one standard deviation carbon tax shock—corresponding to a 5$/tCO2 increase in emissions-weighted carbon taxes—leads to an increase of the price level of about 0.7 percent one year after the implementation of the policy, and between 1.6 and 4 percent in the medium term. These results hold at the national, sub-national and sectoral level. The effect is larger when inflation is initially high, and in regions (sectors) characterized by high emissions and low innovation capacity. In contrast, we find that emissions trading systems as well as non-market-based climate change policies (such as R&D subsidies) do not have statistically significant effects on prices.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了气候变化政策对通货膨胀的影响，样本涵盖177个发达和发展中经济体、78个次国家领土区域以及17个部门，时间跨度为1989-2022年。我们发现碳税会导致通胀压力。这一效应不容忽视：一个标准差碳税冲击——相当于排放加权碳税增加5美元/tCO2——在政策实施一年后导致价格水平上升约0.7%，中期内上升幅度在一.1.6至4%之间。这些结果在国家、次国家和部门层面均成立。当初始通胀较高时，以及在高排放和低创新能力特征的区域（部门）中，这一效应更为显著。相比之下，我们发现排放交易体系以及非市场型气候变化政策（如研发补贴）对价格没有统计上显著的影响。

records.title_en: Fiscal tightening and skills mismatch
records.title_cn: 财政紧缩与技能错配
records.abstract_en: The paper establishes a new link between fiscal tightening and the vertical skills mismatch rate, defined as the share of over-qualified workers. Using cross-country evidence for Europe, we show that fiscal tightening can increase skills mismatch. We then introduce the latter in a DSGE model with heterogeneous households, capital-skill complementarity (CSC) and labor frictions. We calibrate the model for Greece, where the over-qualification rate exceeds one-third. A fiscal tightening shock raises the mismatch rate in the model, in line also with SVAR analysis. Skills mismatch can act as a buffer for high-skilled workers during recessions induced by tax shocks and is more counter-cyclical when CSC is weak. We also use the model to conduct welfare and policy analyses.
records.abstract_cn: 本文建立了财政紧缩与纵向技能错配率之间的新联系，该错配率定义为过度合格工人的比例。利用欧洲的跨国证据，我们表明财政紧缩可以增加技能错配。然后，我们将后者引入一个具有异质性家庭、资本-技能互补性（CSC）和劳动力摩擦的DSGE模型中。我们针对希腊校准模型，其过度合格率超过三分之一。财政紧缩冲击在模型中提高了错配率，这与SVAR分析一致。技能错配在税收冲击引起的衰退期间可以作为高技能工人的缓冲，并且在CSC较弱时更具逆周期性。我们还使用该模型进行福利和政策分析。

records.title_en: Monetary policy interactions: The policy rate, asset purchases, and optimal policy with an interest rate peg
records.title_cn: 货币政策相互作用：政策利率、资产购买和与利率挂钩的最优政策
records.abstract_en: We study monetary policy in a New Keynesian model with a variable credit spread and scope for central bank asset purchases to matter. A novel financial and labor market interaction generates an endogenous cost-push channel in the Phillips curve and a credit wedge in the IS curve. These channels arise due to a liquidity premium to long-term debt present in our model. The “divine coincidence” holds with the nominal short rate and central bank balance sheet available as policy tools—dual-instrument policy. Targeting the liquidity premium using balance sheet policy provides a determinate equilibrium with a fixed policy rate, as does inflation-targeting balance sheet policy. While the liquidity premium in our model depends on unobservable components, the slope of the yield curve serves as a proxy for the liquidity premium when thinking about implementable monetary policy strategies that respond to observable variables alone. We quantify the welfare costs to various monetary policy strategies relative to the analytically derived optimal dual-instrument policy.
records.abstract_cn: 我们在新凯恩斯主义模型中研究货币政策，该模型具有可变的信用利差和央行资产购买的范围。一种新颖的金融和劳动力市场相互作用在菲利普斯曲线中产生了内生成本推动通道，在 IS 曲线中产生了信贷楔子。这些渠道的出现是由于我们模型中存在的长期债务的流动性溢价。 “神圣的巧合”与作为政策工具的名义短期利率和央行资产负债表——双工具政策——是一致的。使用资产负债表政策来确定流动性溢价可以在固定政策利率下实现确定的均衡，就像通胀目标资产负债表政策一样。虽然我们模型中的流动性溢价取决于不可观察的组成部分，但在考虑仅响应可观察变量的可实施货币政策策略时，收益率曲线的斜率可以作为流动性溢价的代理。我们相对于分析得出的最优双工具政策量化了各种货币政策策略的福利成本。

records.title_en: Do equal employment opportunity statements encourage racial minorities? evidence from a large natural field experiment
records.title_cn: 平等就业机会声明是否鼓励种族少数群体？来自大型自然田野实验的证据
records.abstract_en: Labor force composition and the allocation of talent remain of vital import to organizations. For their part, governments and companies around the globe have implemented equal employment opportunity (EEO) regulations to influence labor market flows. Even though such regulations are pervasive, surprisingly little is known about their impacts. We use a natural field experiment conducted across 10 U.S. cities to investigate if EEO statements affect the first step in the employment process, application rates. Making use of data from over 2,000 job seekers, we find that the presence of an EEO statement in job advertisements does not encourage racial minorities’ willingness to apply for jobs. Our results highlight that if one goal of EEO regulations is to enhance the pool of minority applicants, then it is not working as we also observe discouragement effects in some cities.
records.abstract_cn: 劳动力构成和人才分配对组织仍然至关重要。就政府和企业而言，全球各地已实施平等就业机会（EEO）法规以影响劳动力市场流动。尽管此类法规普遍存在，但令人惊讶的是，对其影响知之甚少。我们在10个美国城市进行了一项自然田野实验，以调查EEO声明是否影响就业过程的第一步，即申请率。利用来自超过2,000名求职者的数据，我们发现招聘广告中存在EEO声明并不会鼓励种族少数群体申请工作的意愿。我们的结果强调，如果EEO法规的目标之一是增加少数族裔申请者的数量，那么它并未奏效，因为我们在一些城市还观察到了抑制效应。

records.title_en: Institutional diversity and innovative recombination
records.title_cn: 制度多样性与创新性重组
records.abstract_en: In Explaining Technology, Koppl et al. (2023) argue that “recombination is the essential driver of technological evolution” (p. 3). Modelling combinatorial innovation as a self-propelling, “autocatalytic” process raises the question of what explanatory role, if any, is left for institutional analysis. Although the authors grant institutions only an auxiliary explanatory role, they hint at the functional importance of market institutions, trade networks, patent law, and entrepreneurship. Our paper argues that institutions matter because they crucially affect aggregate levels and rates of recombination and innovation, as well as shaping patterns of recombination and innovation that occur. This paper builds upon Koppl et al.’s acknowledgement of these institutional effects by integrating combinatorial evolution within recent developments in commons theory and institutional economics. Specifically, we argue the burgeoning literature on Governing Knowledge Commons offers a fruitful framework and body of empirical case studies that illuminates the diverse institutions individuals use to facilitate and steer combinatorial innovation. Whilst healthy institutional diversity may incentivize more recombination than any single monocentric institutional arrangement, the non-teleological aspect of recombination means that innovative processes can exude either productive, unproductive, or destructive effects. The institutional diversity fostered by flourishing knowledge commons may allow people to put combinatorial innovations into more productive uses while internalizing their complex externalities. At the same time, it may generate socio-cultural resistances to some forms of innovation processes. We illustrate our theory using cases related to several applied topics including intellectual property, competition policy, and the development of unmanned aerial vehicles.
records.abstract_cn: 在《解释技术》一书中，Koppl等人（2023）认为“重组是技术进化的核心驱动力”（第3页）。将组合创新建模为一个自我推进的、“自催化”的过程，引发了一个问题：制度分析是否还留有解释性角色，如果有的话，是什么。尽管作者仅赋予制度辅助性的解释角色，但他们暗示了市场制度、贸易网络、专利法和创业精神的功能重要性。我们的论文认为，制度之所以重要，是因为它们关键性地影响重组的总体水平和速率以及创新，并塑造所发生的重组和创新的模式。本文基于Koppl等人对这些制度效应的承认，将组合进化与最近在公地理论和制度经济学中的发展相结合。具体来说，我们认为，关于知识公地治理的新兴文献提供了一个富有成效的框架和实证案例研究体系，阐明了个人用来促进和引导组合创新的多样化制度。虽然健康的制度多样性可能比任何单一的中心化制度安排更能激励更多的重组，但重组的非目的论方面意味着创新过程可能产生生产性、非生产性或破坏性的效应。繁荣的知识公地所培育的制度多样性可能使人们能够将组合创新用于更具生产性的用途，同时将其复杂的外部性内部化。与此同时，它可能对社会文化产生对某些形式创新过程的抵制。我们通过涉及知识产权、竞争政策和无人机发展等几个应用主题的案例来说明我们的理论。

records.title_en: Making Subsidies Work: Rules versus Discretion
records.title_cn: 让补贴发挥作用：规则与自由裁量权
records.abstract_en: We estimate the employment effects of a large program of public investment subsidies to private firms that ranked applicants on a score reflecting both objective rules and local politicians' discretion. Leveraging the rationing of funds as an ideal Regression Discontinuity Design, we characterize the heterogeneity of treatment effects and cost‐per‐new‐job across inframarginal firms and estimate the cost‐effectiveness of subsidies under factual and counterfactual allocations. Firms ranking high on objective rules and firms preferred by local politicians generated larger employment growth on average, but the latter did so at a higher cost per job. We estimate that relying only on objective criteria would reduce the cost per job by 11%, while relying only on political discretion would increase such cost by 42%.
records.abstract_cn: 我们估计了一项针对私营企业的大型公共投资补贴计划对就业的影响，该计划根据反映客观规则和当地政治家自由裁量权的分数对申请人进行排名。利用资金配给作为理想的断点回归设计，我们描述了超边际企业的治疗效果和每个新工作成本的异质性，并估计了事实和反事实分配下补贴的成本效益。在客观规则上排名靠前的企业和当地政客青睐的企业平均带来了更大的就业增长，但后者的单位成本更高。我们估计，仅依赖客观标准将使每份工作的成本降低11%，而仅依赖政治自由裁量权将使此类成本增加42%。

records.title_en: The Cost of Consumer Collateral: Evidence From Bunching
records.title_cn: 消费者抵押品的成本：来自捆绑的证据
records.abstract_en: How do collateral requirements impact consumer borrowing behavior? Using administrative loan application and performance data from the U.S. Federal Disaster Loan Program, we exploit a loan amount threshold above which households must post their residence as collateral. Our bunching estimates suggest that the median borrower is willing to give up 40% of their loan amount to avoid posting collateral. Exploiting time variation in the threshold, we estimate collateral causally reduces default rates by 36%. Finally, we structurally estimate households' attachment to their homes, net of any equity, and find a median value of $11,000. Attachment creates a wedge between lender and borrower valuation of collateral of 15%. Our results explain high perceived default costs in the mortgage market, and document the importance of collateral for reducing moral hazard in consumer credit markets.
records.abstract_cn: 抵押品要求如何影响消费者的借贷行为？利用美国联邦灾难贷款计划的行政贷款申请和绩效数据，我们设定了贷款金额阈值，高于该阈值的家庭必须将其住宅作为抵押品。我们的聚类估计表明，中位借款人愿意放弃 40% 的贷款金额以避免提供抵押品。利用阈值的时间变化，我们估计抵押品会因果性地将违约率降低36%。最后，我们从结构上估计了家庭对其房屋的依恋（扣除任何资产），并找到中值 $11,000。附件在贷款人和借款人之间对15%的抵押品估值产生了隔阂。我们的研究结果解释了抵押贷款市场中高感知违约成本，并证明了抵押品对于减少消费信贷市场道德风险的重要性。

records.title_en: Insurance and Inequality With Persistent Private Information
records.title_cn: 持久私人信息的保险和不平等
records.abstract_en: We study the implications of optimal insurance provision for long‐run welfare and inequality in economies with persistent private information. A principal insures an agent whose private type follows an ergodic, finite‐state Markov chain. The optimal contract always induces immiseration : the agent's consumption and utility decrease without bound. Under positive serial correlation, it also backloads high‐powered incentives : the sensitivity of the agent's utility with respect to his reports increases without bound. These results extend—and help elucidate the limits of—the hallmark immiseration results for economies with i.i.d. private information. Numerically, we find that persistence yields faster immiseration, higher inequality, and novel short‐run distortions. Our analysis uses recursive methods for contracting with persistent types and allows for binding global incentive constraints.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了最优保险条款对具有持久私人信息的经济体中的长期福利和不平等的影响。委托人为代理人提供保险，其私有类型遵循遍历的有限状态马尔可夫链。最优契约总是会导致贫困：代理人的消费和效用无限制地减少。在正序列相关的情况下，它还加载了强大的激励：代理人的效用对其报告的敏感性无限增加。这些结果扩展了独立同分布经济体的标志性贫困结果，并有助于阐明其局限性。私人信息。从数字上看，我们发现坚持会导致更快的贫困、更高的不平等和新的短期扭曲。我们的分析使用递归方法与持久类型签订合同，并允许绑定全局激励约束。

records.title_en: Auctioning Control and Cash‐Flow Rights Separately
records.title_cn: 分别拍卖控制权和现金流权
records.abstract_en: We consider a classical auction setting in which an asset/project is sold to buyers who privately receive signals about expected payoffs, and payoffs are more sensitive to a bidder's signal if he runs the project than if another bidder does. We show that a seller can increase revenues by sometimes allocating cash‐flow rights and control to different bidders, for example, with the highest bidder receiving cash flows and the second‐highest receiving control. Separation reduces a bidder's information rent, which depends on the importance of his private information for the value of his awarded cash flows. As project payoffs are most sensitive to a bidder's information if he controls the project, allocating cash flow to another bidder lowers bidders' informational advantage. As a result, when signals are close, the seller can increase revenues by splitting rights between the top two bidders.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考虑一种经典的拍卖设置，其中资产/项目被出售给私下接收有关预期收益信号的买家，并且如果投标人运行该项目，则收益对投标人的信号比其他投标人运行该项目更敏感。我们表明，卖方有时可以通过将现金流权和控制权分配给不同的投标人来增加收入，例如，出价最高的投标人获得现金流，而最高的投标人获得控制权。分离降低了投标人的信息租金，这取决于他的私人信息对于他所获得的现金流价值的重要性。由于项目收益对投标人的信息最为敏感（如果投标人控制了项目），因此将现金流分配给另一个投标人会降低投标人的信息优势。因此，当信号接近时，卖方可以通过在最高二出价者之间分配权利来增加收入。

records.title_en: Soaking up the Sun: Battery Investment, Renewable Energy, and Market Equilibrium
records.title_cn: 沐浴阳光：电池投资、可再生能源和市场均衡
records.abstract_en: Renewable energy and battery storage are seen as complementary technologies that can together facilitate reductions in carbon emissions. We develop and estimate a framework to calculate the equilibrium effects of large‐scale battery storage. Using data from California, we find that the first storage unit breaks even by 2024 without subsidies when the renewable energy share reaches 50%. Equilibrium effects are important: the first 5000 MWh of storage capacity would reduce wholesale electricity prices by 5.6%, but an increase from 25,000 to 50,000 MWh would only reduce these prices by 2.6%. Large‐scale batteries will reduce revenues to both dispatchable generators and renewable energy sources. The equilibrium effects lead battery adoption to be virtually non‐existent until 2030, without a storage mandate or subsidy. A 30% capital cost subsidy—such as the one in the U.S. Inflation Reduction Act—achieves 5000 MWh of battery capacity by 2024, similar to the level required under California's storage mandate.
records.abstract_cn: 可再生能源和电池存储被视为互补技术，可以共同促进减少碳排放。我们开发并估计了一个框架来计算大规模电池存储的平衡效应。使用加利福尼亚州的数据，我们发现当可再生能源份额达到2024时，第一存储单元在50%没有补贴的情况下实现收支平衡。均衡效应很重要：第一5000兆瓦时的存储容量将使批发电价降低5.6%，但从25,000增加到50,000兆瓦时只会使这些价格降低2.6%。大型电池将减少可调度发电机和可再生能源的收入。在没有存储授权或补贴的情况下，均衡效应导致电池的采用在2030之前几乎不存在。 30%资本成本补贴——例如美国通货膨胀削减法案中的一——可以在5000之前实现2024兆瓦时的电池容量，类似于加州储能指令要求的水平。

records.title_en: Personalized Pricing and the Value of Time: Evidence From Auctioned Cab Rides
records.title_cn: 个性化定价和时间价值：来自拍卖出租车的证据
records.abstract_en: We recover valuations of time using detailed data from a large ride‐hail platform, where drivers bid on trips and consumers choose between a set of rides with different prices and wait times. Leveraging a consumer panel, we estimate demand as a function of both prices and wait times and use the resulting estimates to recover heterogeneity in the value of time across consumers. We study the welfare implications of personalized pricing and its effect on the platform, drivers, and consumers. Taking into account drivers' optimal reaction to the platform's pricing policy, personalized pricing lowers consumer surplus by 2.5% and increases overall surplus by 5.2%. Like the platform, drivers benefit from personalized pricing. By conditioning prices on drivers' wait times and not on consumers' data, the platform can capture a significant portion of the profits garnered from personalized pricing, and simultaneously benefit consumers.
records.abstract_cn: 我们使用大型网约车平台的详细数据来恢复时间估值，在该平台上，司机对行程进行竞价，消费者在一组具有不同价格和等待时间的乘车服务中进行选择。利用消费者小组，我们将需求估计为价格和等待时间的函数，并使用由此产生的估计来恢复消费者时间价值的异质性。我们研究个性化定价的福利影响及其对平台、司机和消费者的影响。考虑到驾驶员对平台定价政策的最佳反应，个性化定价将消费者剩余降低2.5%，并将总体剩余增加5.2%。与该平台一样，司机也可以从个性化定价中受益。通过根据司机的等待时间而不是消费者的数据来调整价格，该平台可以从个性化定价中获取很大一部分利润，同时使消费者受益。

records.title_en: Quality Disclosure and Regulation: Scoring Design in Medicare Advantage
records.title_cn: 质量披露和监管：医疗保险优势中的评分设计
records.abstract_en: Policymakers and market intermediaries often use quality scores to alleviate asymmetric information about product quality. Scores affect the demand for quality and, in equilibrium, its supply. Equilibrium effects break the rule whereby more information is always better, and the optimal design of scores must account for them. In the context of Medicare Advantage, I find that consumers' information is limited, and quality is inefficiently low. A simple design alleviates these issues and increases total welfare by 3.7 monthly premiums. More than half of the gains stem from scores' effect on quality rather than information. Scores can outperform full‐information outcomes by regulating inefficient oligopolistic quality provision, and a binary certification of quality attains 98% of this welfare. Scores are informative even when coarse; firms' incentives are to produce quality at the scoring threshold, which consumers know. The primary design challenge of scores is to dictate thresholds and thus regulate quality.
records.abstract_cn: 政策制定者和市场中介机构经常使用质量评分来缓解有关产品质量的信息不对称。分数影响对质量的需求，并在均衡状态下影响其供给。均衡效应打破了信息越多越好的规则，分数的优化设计必须考虑到它们。在Medicare Advantage的背景下，我发现消费者的信息有限，而且质量低下。一个简单的设计可以缓解这些问题，并通过 3.7 每月保费增加总福利。超过一半的收益来自分数对质量的影响，而不是信息。通过调节低效的寡头垄断质量提供，分数可以优于全信息结果，并且质量的二元认证实现了这种福利的98%。即使分数很粗糙，也能提供丰富的信息；企业的动机是在评分阈值上生产质量，这一点消费者都知道。分数设计的主要挑战是规定阈值，从而调节质量。

records.title_en: Risk and Optimal Policies in Bandit Experiments
records.title_cn: Bandit 实验中的风险和最优策略
records.abstract_en: We provide a decision‐theoretic analysis of bandit experiments under local asymptotics. Working within the framework of diffusion processes, we define suitable notions of asymptotic Bayes and minimax risk for these experiments. For normally distributed rewards, the minimal Bayes risk can be characterized as the solution to a second‐order partial differential equation (PDE). Using a limit of experiments approach, we show that this PDE characterization also holds asymptotically under both parametric and non‐parametric distributions of the rewards. The approach further describes the state variables it is asymptotically sufficient to restrict attention to, and thereby suggests a practical strategy for dimension reduction. The PDEs characterizing minimal Bayes risk can be solved efficiently using sparse matrix routines or Monte Carlo methods. We derive the optimal Bayes and minimax policies from their numerical solutions. These optimal policies substantially dominate existing methods such as Thompson sampling; the risk of the latter is often twice as high.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提供了局部渐近下老虎机实验的决策理论分析。在扩散过程的框架内，我们为这些实验定义了渐近贝叶斯和极小极大风险的合适概念。对于正态分布的奖励，最小贝叶斯风险可以表征为 第二 阶偏微分方程 (PDE) 的解。使用极限实验方法，我们表明这种偏微分方程表征在奖励的参数和非参数分布下也渐近成立。该方法进一步描述了渐近足以限制注意力的状态变量，从而提出了一种实用的降维策略。表征最小贝叶斯风险的偏微分方程可以使用稀疏矩阵例程或蒙特卡罗方法有效地求解。我们从数值解中推导出最优贝叶斯和极小极大策略。这些最优策略在很大程度上主导了汤普森抽样等现有方法；后者的风险往往是后者的两倍。

records.title_en: Location Sorting and Endogenous Amenities: Evidence From Amsterdam
records.title_cn: 位置排序和内生便利设施：来自阿姆斯特丹的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper shows the endogeneity of amenities plays a crucial role in determining the welfare distribution of a city's residents. We quantify this mechanism by building a dynamic model of residential choice with heterogeneous households, where consumption amenities are the equilibrium outcome of a market for non‐tradables. We estimate our model using Dutch microdata and leveraging variation in Amsterdam's spatial distribution of tourists as a demand shifter, finding significant heterogeneity in residents' preferences over amenities and in the supply responses of amenities to changes in demand composition. This two‐way heterogeneity dictates the degree of horizontal differentiation across neighborhoods, residential sorting, and inequality. Finally, we show the distributional effects of mass tourism depend on this heterogeneity: following rent increases due to growing tourist demand for housing, younger residents—whose amenity preferences are closest to tourists—are compensated by amenities tilting in their favor, while the losses of older residents are amplified.
records.abstract_cn: 本文表明，便利设施的内生性在决定城市居民福利分配方面发挥着至关重要的作用。我们通过建立异质家庭住宅选择的动态模型来量化这种机制，其中消费设施是非贸易品市场的均衡结果。我们使用荷兰微观数据并利用阿姆斯特丹游客空间分布的变化作为需求转移者来估计我们的模型，发现居民对设施的偏好以及设施对需求构成变化的供应响应存在显着异质性。这种二方式的异质性决定了社区、住宅排序和不平等之间的横向分化程度。最后，我们表明大众旅游的分配效应取决于这种异质性：由于游客对住房的需求不断增长而导致租金上涨，年轻居民（他们的便利设施偏好最接近游客）得到了有利于他们的便利设施的补偿，而老年居民的损失则被放大。

records.title_en: Adaptive Maximization of Social Welfare
records.title_cn: 社会福利的适应性最大化
records.abstract_en: We consider the problem of repeatedly choosing policies to maximize social welfare. Welfare is a weighted sum of private utility and public revenue. Earlier outcomes inform later policies. Utility is not observed, but indirectly inferred. Response functions are learned through experimentation. We derive a lower bound on regret, and a matching adversarial upper bound for a variant of the Exp3 algorithm. Cumulative regret grows at a rate of T 2/3 . This implies that (i) welfare maximization is harder than the multiarmed bandit problem (with a rate of T 1/2 for finite policy sets), and (ii) our algorithm achieves the optimal rate. For the stochastic setting, if social welfare is concave, we can achieve a rate of T 1/2 (for continuous policy sets), using a dyadic search algorithm. We analyze an extension to nonlinear income taxation, and sketch an extension to commodity taxation. We compare our setting to monopoly pricing (which is easier), and price setting for bilateral trade (which is harder).
records.abstract_cn: 我们考虑重复选择政策以最大化社会福利的问题。福利是私人公用事业和公共收入的加权总和。早期的结果为后来的政策提供依据。效用不是观察到的，而是间接推断的。响应函数是通过实验学习的。我们得出了后悔的下界，以及 Exp3 算法变体的匹配对抗性上限。累积后悔以 T 2/3 的速度增长。这意味着 (i) 福利最大化比多臂老虎机问题更难（有限策略集的速率为 T 1/2），并且 (ii) 我们的算法实现了最优速率。对于随机设置，如果社会福利是凹的，我们可以使用二元搜索算法实现 T 1/2（对于连续政策集）的比率。我们分析了非线性所得税的延伸，并概述了商品税的延伸。我们将我们的设置与垄断定价（更容易）和双边贸易的价格设置（更难）进行比较。

records.title_en: Presidential Address: Investing in Children to Address the Child Mental Health Crisis
records.title_cn: 总统讲话：投资儿童以解决儿童心理健康危机
records.abstract_en: The child mental health crisis has been described as the "defining public health crisis of our time." This article addresses three myths about the crisis: (i) the idea that the crisis is new; (ii) the belief that increases in youth suicide mainly reflect deterioration in children's underlying mental health; and (iii) the myth that investments in children have little impact on children's mental health. In fact, the crisis has existed for decades, youth suicides vary asynchronously with other mental health measures and are impacted by external factors such as firearms legislation, and investments can improve child mental health and prevent suicide.
records.abstract_cn: 儿童心理健康危机被描述为“我们这个时代的决定性公共卫生危机”。本文阐述了关于这场危机的 三 神话：(i) 认为这场危机是新的； (二) 认为青少年自杀率上升主要反映了儿童潜在心理健康状况的恶化； (iii) 认为对儿童的投资对儿童的心理健康几乎没有影响的神话。事实上，这场危机已经存在了几十年，青少年自杀与其他心理健康措施不同步，并受到枪支立法等外部因素的影响，而投资可以改善儿童心理健康并预防自杀。

records.title_en: Does Entry Remedy Collusion? Evidence from the Generic Prescription Drug Cartel
records.title_cn: 进入可以补救共谋吗？来自非专利处方药卡特尔的证据
records.abstract_en: Entry represents a fundamental threat to cartels. We study the extent and effect of this behavior in the largest price-fixing case in US history, which involves generic drug manufacturing. We link information on the cartel's internal operations to regulatory filings and market data. There is a substantial increase in entry after cartel formation, but regulatory approvals delay most entrants by two to four years. We estimate a structural model and simulate counterfactual equilibria. Absent entry, cartel profits would be dramatically higher. Correspondingly, reducing regulatory delays by just 1–2 years equates to consumer compensating variation of $612 million–$1.5 billion.
records.abstract_cn: 进入对卡特尔构成根本威胁。我们研究了美国历史上最大的涉及仿制药制造的价格垄断案件中这种行为的程度和影响。我们将卡特尔内部运营的信息与监管备案和市场数据联系起来。卡特尔成立后，进入者数量大幅增加，但监管部门的批准将大多数进入者延迟了 二 至 四 年。我们估计结构模型并模拟反事实均衡。如果没有进入，卡特尔的利润将会大幅增加。相应地，将监管延迟减少 1-2 年就相当于消费者补偿 $612 百万–$1.5 十亿 的变化。

records.title_en: The Role of People versus Places in Individual Carbon Emissions
records.title_cn: 人与地方在个人碳排放中的作用
records.abstract_en: There is substantial spatial heterogeneity in household carbon emissions. I leverage movers in two decades of administrative Decennial Census and American Community Survey data to estimate place effects—the amount by which carbon emissions change for the same household living in different places—for almost 1,000 cities and roughly 61,500 neighborhoods across the United States. I estimate that place effects account for 14–23 percent of overall heterogeneity. A change in neighborhood-level place effects from 1 standard deviation above the mean to 1 below would reduce household carbon emissions from residential energy and commuting by about 40 percent.
records.abstract_cn: 家庭碳排放存在显着的空间异质性。我利用 二 几十年的行政十年一次人口普查和美国社区调查数据中的移动者来估计美国几乎 1,000 个城市和大约 61,500 个社区的地方效应，即生活在不同地方的同一家庭的碳排放量变化量。我估计地点效应解释了总体异质性的 14-23%。邻里层面的地方效应从高于均值的 1 标准差变为低于均值的 1，将减少来自住宅能源和通勤的家庭碳排放量约 40%。

records.title_en: Efficiency in Household Decision-Making: Evidence from the Retirement Savings of US Couples
records.title_cn: 家庭决策效率：来自美国夫妇退休储蓄的证据
records.abstract_en: We study how couples allocate retirement-saving contributions across each spouse's account. In a new dataset covering over a million US individuals, we find retirement contributions are not allocated to the account with the highest employer match rate. This lack of coordination—which goes against the assumptions of most models of household decision-making—is common, costly, persistent over time, and cannot be explained by inertia, auto-enrollment, or simple heuristics. Complementing the administrative evidence with an online survey, we find that inefficient allocations reflect both financial mistakes as well as deliberate choices, especially when trust and commitment inside the households are weak.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究夫妻如何在各自的账户上分配退休储蓄供款。在涵盖超过 百万 个美国个人的新数据集中，我们发现退休金并未分配给雇主匹配率最高的账户。这种缺乏协调的现象与大多数家庭决策模型的假设背道而驰，这种情况很常见，成本高昂，而且随着时间的推移会持续存在，并且不能用惯性、自动注册或简单的启发法来解释。通过在线调查补充行政证据，我们发现低效的分配既反映了财务错误，也反映了深思熟虑的选择，特别是当家庭内部的信任和承诺薄弱时。

records.title_en: Changing Tracks: Human Capital Investment after Loss of Ability
records.title_cn: 变轨：丧失能力后的人力资本投资
records.abstract_en: We provide the first evidence on how workers invest in human capital after losing ability. Using quasi-random work accidents in Danish administrative data, we find that workers enroll in bachelor's programs after physical injuries, pursuing degrees that build on their past training and experience. Exploiting institutional differences in the stackability of degrees, we find that higher education moves injured workers from disability benefits to full-time employment, earning 25 percent more than before injury. Reskilling subsidies for injured workers pay for themselves four times over, and current rates of reskilling are substantially below the social optimum, especially for middle-aged workers.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提供 第一 证据，说明工人在失去能力后如何投资人力资本。利用丹麦行政数据中的准随机工伤事故，我们发现工人们在身体受伤后报名参加学士学位课程，在过去的培训和经验的基础上攻读学位。利用学位可叠加性方面的制度差异，我们发现高等教育将受伤工人从残疾福利转移到全职工作，获得比受伤前更多的 25%。为受伤工人提供的再培训补贴其成本是 四 数倍，而目前的再培训率远低于社会最佳水平，尤其是对中年工人而言。

records.title_en: When Do "Nudges" Increase Welfare?
records.title_cn: “助推”何时会增加福利？
records.abstract_en: We use public finance sufficient statistic approaches to characterize the welfare effects of "nudges," such as simplified information and warning labels, in markets with taxes and endogenous prices. While many studies focus on average effects, we show that welfare also depends on how the nudge affects the variance of choice distortions, and average effects become irrelevant with zero pass-through or optimal taxes. We implement the framework with experiments evaluating automotive fuel economy labels and sugary drink health labels. Labels decrease purchases of low-fuel economy cars and sugary drinks but may decrease welfare because they increase the variance of choice distortions.
records.abstract_cn: 我们使用公共财政充分的统计方法来描述“助推”的福利效应，例如在有税收和内生价格的市场中简化信息和警告标签。虽然许多研究关注平均效应，但我们表明福利还取决于助推如何影响选择扭曲的方差，并且平均效应与 零 传递或最优税收无关。我们通过评估汽车燃油经济性标签和含糖饮料健康标签的实验来实施该框架。标签减少了低燃油经济性汽车和含糖饮料的购买量，但可能会减少福利，因为它们增加了选择扭曲的方差。

records.title_en: Risk Aversion and Insurance Propensity
records.title_cn: 风险规避和保险倾向
records.abstract_en: We provide a new foundation of risk aversion by showing that this attitude is fully captured by the propensity to seize insurance opportunities. In our main results, we first characterize Arrow-Pratt (1963–1964) risk aversion in terms of propensity to full insurance and the stronger notion of risk aversion of Rothschild and Stiglitz (1970) in terms of propensity to partial insurance. We then extend the analysis to comparative risk aversion by showing that the classical notion of Yaari (1969) corresponds to comparative propensity to full insurance, while the stronger notion of Ross (1981) corresponds to comparative propensity to partial insurance.
records.abstract_cn: 我们通过证明抓住保险机会的倾向充分体现了这种态度，从而为风险规避提供了新的基础。在我们的主要结果中，我们 第一 在全面保险倾向方面描述了 Arrow-Pratt (1963-1964) 风险厌恶，在部分保险倾向方面描述了罗斯柴尔德和斯蒂格利茨 (1970) 更强的风险厌恶概念。然后，我们将分析扩展到比较风险厌恶，表明经典的 Yaari 概念 (1969) 对应于完全保险的比较倾向，而更强的 Ross 概念 (1981) 对应于部分保险的比较倾向。

records.title_en: Selling Subscriptions
records.title_cn: 销售订阅
records.abstract_en: We study one benefit to firms of selling subscriptions: the prospect that consumers will continue to pay for subscriptions they no longer value. We use comprehensive data from a large payment card network to document that months during which cards are replaced, when active renewal is required, are associated with much higher rates of cancellation. Using two stylized models of consumer inertia—driven by inattention or switching costs—we estimate that these cancellation frictions roughly double seller revenues on average, holding fixed initial subscribers. We use the estimated models to explore the impact of possible regulatory remedies.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究 一 对销售订阅的公司的好处：消费者将继续为他们不再重视的订阅付费的前景。我们使用来自大型支付卡网络的综合数据来记录更换卡的月份，当需要主动续订时，取消率会高得多。使用 二 风格化的消费者惰性模型（由疏忽或转换成本驱动），我们估计这些取消摩擦使卖家平均收入大约翻倍，从而保持固定的初始订户。我们使用估计模型来探讨可能的监管补救措施的影响。

records.title_en: How Do Mental Health Treatment Delays Impact Long-Term Mortality?
records.title_cn: 心理健康治疗延迟如何影响长期死亡率？
records.abstract_en: With a growing mental health crisis and a shortage of behavioral health specialists, those seeking mental health treatment often face long wait times to obtain care. I study how clinic congestion affects mortality for veterans experiencing mental health emergencies. I find that longer waiting times make it more likely that patients miss their follow-up mental health visit, consequently increasing the probability that they permanently disengage from care. A 1 standard deviation increase in wait time between the emergency department visit and follow-up appointment date (11.7 days) increases two-year mortality by about 1.5 percent.
records.abstract_cn: 随着心理健康危机日益严重和行为健康专家的短缺，寻求心理健康治疗的人往往面临漫长的等待时间才能获得护理。我研究诊所拥挤如何影响经历心理健康紧急情况的退伍军人的死亡率。我发现，较长的等待时间使患者更有可能错过后续的心理健康就诊，从而增加了他们永久脱离护理的可能性。急诊科就诊和随访预约日期（1 天）之间等待时间的 11.7 标准差增加会使 二 年死亡率增加约 1.5%。

records.title_en: How green is China’s development finance? Power generation and air pollution in Africa
records.title_cn: 中国的发展融资有多绿色？非洲的发电与空气污染
records.abstract_en: China has emerged as an internationally leading creditor of development finance and is now competing with traditional Western donors and lenders. Between 2000 and 2021, Chinese public sector institutions committed more than USD 1.3 trillion to low- and middle-income countries. The flagship Belt and Road Initiative, launched in 2013, has enabled unprecedented infrastructure investment in about 150 countries. Western criticism of a lack of transparency has prompted speculation about the environmental impact of Chinese lending abroad. We examine whether Chinese official finance to Africa between 2000 and 2021 is associated with “greener” electricity generation—which can serve as the backbone for a sustainable energy transition on the continent—and whether it has contributed to emission reduction. To mitigate endogeneity concerns, we employ an instrumental variable approach that relies on the exogenous variation in the availability of Chinese official finance over time. Our findings suggest that Chinese official finance has increased the adoption of renewable energy for electricity generation, although the impact differs between development-oriented and commercial finance and changes over time. Furthermore, while Chinese official finance has contributed to reducing emissions and improving electricity access, commercial projects appear to offset some of the emission reductions.
records.abstract_cn: 中国已成为国际领先的发展融资债权国，目前正与传统的西方捐助者和贷款机构竞争。在2000年至2021年间，中国公共部门机构向低收入和中等收入国家承诺了超过1.3万亿美元的资金。2013年启动的旗舰项目“一带一路”倡议，已在约150个国家实现了前所未有的基础设施投资。西方对中国海外贷款缺乏透明度的批评，引发了对中国海外贷款环境影响的猜测。我们考察了2000年至2021年间中国对非洲的官方融资是否与“更绿色”的电力生产相关联——这可以作为非洲大陆可持续能源转型的支柱——以及它是否促进了减排。为缓解内生性问题，我们采用了工具变量方法，该方法依赖于中国官方融资可用性随时间的外生变化。我们的研究结果表明，中国官方融资增加了可再生能源在电力生产中的采用，尽管影响因发展导向型融资和商业融资而异，并随时间变化。此外，虽然中国官方融资有助于减少排放和改善电力获取，但商业项目似乎抵消了部分减排效果。

records.title_en: The impact of foreign media on political mobilization during the Arab Spring
records.title_cn: 外国媒体对阿拉伯之春期间政治动员的影响
records.abstract_en: We investigate how foreign media influenced political mobilization during the Arab Spring in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region. Focusing on two prominent transnational networks, Al Jazeera and Al Arabiya, we use Arab Barometer survey data to track political mobilization and media use indicators in Jordan, Lebanon, and the Palestinian Territories. To address potential endogeneity, we use the frequency of lightning strikes and submarine cable seaquake shocks as instrumental variables, which help isolate exogenous variation in access to foreign media. Our results show that access to foreign media has a positive and statistically significant effect on political mobilization. A one-standard-deviation increase corresponds to a rise in the likelihood of participating in protests of approximately 6.5 percentage points, a gain of approximately 39% at the sample mean. We argue that this effect is primarily driven by the informational dimension of foreign media, rather than its ideological content.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了外国媒体如何影响中东和北非（MENA）地区阿拉伯之春期间的政治动员。聚焦于两个著名的跨国网络，半岛电视台和阿拉比亚电视台，我们使用阿拉伯晴雨表调查数据来追踪约旦、黎巴嫩和巴勒斯坦领土的政治动员和媒体使用指标。为解决潜在的内生性问题，我们使用闪电频率和海底电缆海震冲击作为工具变量，这有助于隔离外国媒体可及性的外生变异。我们的结果表明，外国媒体的可及性对政治动员有正向且统计显著的影响。一个标准差增加对应于参与抗议可能性上升约6.5个百分点，在样本均值处约为39%的增益。我们认为，这一效应主要由外国媒体的信息维度驱动，而非其意识形态内容。

records.title_en: Urbanization and decentralization in the Congo: Examining governance in rural towns
records.title_cn: 刚果的城市化与权力下放：考察农村城镇的治理
records.abstract_en: How are rural towns governed in a context of fragility? This paper provides descriptive evidence to describe and quantify urbanization and the local organization of the state in 67 rural towns in four provinces of the Democratic Republic and the Congo. We present rich data on urbanization, state and local governance, taxation, public good provision, and citizens’ perceptions of governance. Three stories emerge. First, rural towns are growing, boosting high levels of ethnic diversity, and local trust, but are still largely agrarian and with unclear property rights. Second, a recent decentralization reform has been poorly implemented ten years on. Less than half the towns have a state administrators, no local elections took place, and revenue sharing is limited. Third, the governance goals of the reform remain largely unfulfilled. We observe a lack of democratic accountability, high levels of corruption, and an acute gap in financing. Finally, we find that these governance challenges are not correlated with levels of urbanization, implementation of the reforms, or levels of state capacity.
records.abstract_cn: 在脆弱性背景下，农村城镇是如何治理的？本文提供了描述性证据，以描述和量化刚果民主共和国四个省份中67个农村城镇的城市化及地方国家组织情况。我们呈现了关于城市化、国家与地方治理、税收、公共物品供给以及公民对治理感知的丰富数据。三个故事浮现出来。首先，农村城镇正在增长，促进了高度的民族多样性和地方信任，但仍以农业为主，且产权不明确。其次，近期的权力下放改革在十年后实施效果不佳。不到一半的城镇设有国家行政官员，没有举行地方选举，且收入分享有限。第三，改革的目标在很大程度上仍未实现。我们观察到缺乏民主问责、腐败程度高以及资金缺口严重。最后，我们发现这些治理挑战与城市化水平、改革实施程度或国家能力水平并不相关。

records.title_en: Fabricated justice: How due process reform enables evidence manipulation
records.title_cn: 伪造的正义：正当程序改革如何助长证据操纵
records.abstract_en: This paper examines how due process reforms enable evidence manipulation. During the past two decades, most Latin American countries have radically reformed their criminal justice systems, with the aim of strengthening rights protections and curbing abuses. Focusing on Mexico, we uncover a paradox of these institutional reforms: confronted with social pressures to punish crimes, police officers and prosecutors with limited investigation capacities fabricate criminal cases that pretend to conform with stricter judicial standards. Using difference-in-differences designs with a representative prison survey and ethnographic fieldwork among criminal prosecutors, we document a decline in torture and a parallel rise in convictions grounded in fabricated evidence, most commonly planted drugs and weapons. This shift toward what we call “fabricated justice” has fueled an increase in drug trafficking convictions. This recent increase in planted evidence suggests that when rule of law reforms are implemented without corresponding investments in state capacity, they can generate new and unexpected forms of abuse.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了正当程序改革如何助长证据操纵。在过去二十年中，大多数拉丁美洲国家对其刑事司法系统进行了彻底改革，旨在加强权利保护和遏制滥用。以墨西哥为研究对象，我们揭示了这些制度改革的悖论：面对惩罚犯罪的社会压力，调查能力有限的警察和检察官伪造刑事案件，以假装符合更严格的司法标准。利用具有代表性的监狱调查中的双重差分设计以及对刑事检察官的田野民族志调查，我们记录了刑讯逼供的减少以及基于伪造证据（最常见的是栽赃毒品和武器）的定罪同步上升。这种向我们所称的“伪造正义”的转变推动了贩毒定罪的增加。近期栽赃证据的增加表明，当法治改革在没有相应国家能力投资的情况下实施时，可能产生新的、意想不到的滥用形式。

records.title_en: Balancing efficiency and equity in fiscal decentralization: theory and evidence from China
records.title_cn: 财政分权中的效率与公平平衡：来自中国的理论与证据
records.abstract_en: Fiscal decentralization is widely acknowledged as a pivotal contributor to China’s economic growth. However, there is a paucity of literature examining the underlying drivers of fiscal decentralization in China. This paper examines the drivers of intergovernmental fiscal relations in China: fostering economic development and mitigating regional disparities. After reviewing the evolution of the fiscal system since the Reform and Opening Up, we build a theoretical model to shed light on the objectives of fiscal decentralization and derive two theoretical propositions. By using panel data of prefecture-level cities from 2004 to 2016 and incorporating a newly developed fiscal decentralization indicator, we empirically test the theoretical propositions. The empirical analysis shows that the degree of fiscal decentralization decreases with an increase in GDP growth goals or larger fiscal disparities of subordinate county-level governments.
