We find that the effect of cold on IPV is mostly driven by low temperatures that occur during the agricultural growing season, when income is most affected; 10 degree hours below -9 °C during the growing season increases the probability of experiencing IPV by 1.6 percentage points. In contrast, we find that cold exposure outside of the growing season has no statistically significant effect on IPV.
records.abstract_cn: 针对女性的暴力——尤其是亲密伴侣暴力（IPV）——是全球女性面临的健康问题。我们研究了寒冷暴露对秘鲁女性IPV的影响。利用将女性与天气暴露相匹配的数据集，我们发现寒冷冲击增加了IPV：低于-9°C的10度小时使遭受家庭暴力的概率增加0.5个百分点。这些效应在更极端的温度阈值下更大。我们提供证据表明寒冷通过两个主要渠道影响IPV。首先，极端寒冷减少了收入。其次，极端寒冷限制了在户外度过的时间，可能增加女性接触暴力伴侣的机会。据我们所知，我们是首个通过利用寒冷时间的差异来区分通过收入变化影响IPV的冲击与通过室内时间影响IPV的冲击，从而衡量这两个渠道相对重要性的研究。我们发现寒冷对IPV的影响主要由农业生长季节期间发生的低温驱动，此时收入受影响最大；生长季节期间低于-9°C的10度小时使经历IPV的概率增加1.6个百分点。相比之下，我们发现生长季节之外的寒冷暴露对IPV没有统计显著影响。

records.title_en: CO2 emission regulation and generation allocation with heterogeneous coal-fired generators
records.title_cn: 二氧化碳排放规制与异质性燃煤发电机的发电分配
records.abstract_en: Using a generator-level framework, we analyze the impacts of different regulation levels of CO2 emissions on total emissions and generation costs in the China Southern Power Grid Corporation. We employ a structural approach to estimating the generator-level production functions that incorporate heterogeneous returns to scale and unobserved productivity, using a novel generator-level dataset. We find substantial heterogeneity in generation efficiency across generators, and large generators are the most efficient. Counterfactual analyses show that regulating emissions and allocating generation at a more aggregate level (province or region) can reduce total emissions and generation costs by shifting generation toward more efficient generators and plants. The generator-level framework allows for more efficient allocation than the plant-level framework.
records.abstract_cn: 利用发电机层面的框架，我们分析了不同二氧化碳排放规制水平对中国南方电网公司总排放量和发电成本的影响。我们采用结构化方法，利用新颖的发电机层面数据集，估计包含异质性规模报酬和未观测生产率的发电机层面生产函数。我们发现发电机之间的发电效率存在显著异质性，大型发电机效率最高。反事实分析表明，在更聚合的层面（省或区域）规制排放和分配发电，可以通过将发电转移至更高效的发电机和电厂，减少总排放量和发电成本。发电机层面的框架比电厂层面的框架允许更有效的分配。

records.title_en: Informal fiscal systems in developing countries
records.title_cn: 发展中国家的非正式财政体系
records.abstract_en: Governments in developing countries have low fiscal capacity yet face pressures to provide public goods and services, leading them to rely on various unusual fiscal arrangements. We uncover one such arrangement – informal fiscal systems that rely on local bureaucrats to fund the delivery of public goods and services – cataloging its existence in at least 20 countries. Using survey data and government accounts from Pakistan, we show that public officials are expected to cover funding gaps in public services and they do so, at least partially, through extracted bribes. We develop a model of bureaucratic agency to explore when governments benefit from sustaining such systems and investigate their implications for welfare and bureaucrat selection. Informal fiscal systems are more likely to arise when corruption is widespread but public service delivery is relatively easy to monitor. While they provide an effective second-best solution in the presence of moral hazard and adverse selection, they can distort the effective incidence of the tax burden, reduce the incentives of governments to fight corruption, and legitimize bribe-taking. This makes corruption more widespread and thus makes informal systems self-reinforcing.
records.abstract_cn: 发展中国家的政府财政能力较低，却面临提供公共产品和服务的压力，这导致它们依赖各种不寻常的财政安排。我们揭示了一种此类安排——依赖地方官僚资助公共产品和服务交付的非正式财政体系——并记录了其在至少20个国家中的存在。利用巴基斯坦的调查数据和政府账户，我们表明，公共官员被期望弥补公共服务中的资金缺口，并且他们至少部分通过索取贿赂来做到这一点。我们开发了一个官僚代理模型，以探讨政府何时从维持此类体系中受益，并研究其对福利和官僚选拔的影响。当腐败普遍但公共服务交付相对易于监督时，非正式财政体系更可能出现。尽管它们在存在道德风险和逆向选择的情况下提供了有效的次优解决方案，但它们可能扭曲税收负担的实际归宿，降低政府打击腐败的激励，并使受贿行为合法化。这使得腐败更加普遍，从而使非正式体系自我强化。

records.title_en: Resisting social conformity pressure: Impact of a gender norms intervention for adolescents in Somalia
records.title_cn: 抵制社会从众压力：索马里青少年性别规范干预的影响
records.abstract_en: Using a randomized controlled trial, this paper evaluates the impact of a gender norms intervention for young adolescents in Somalia. The program leads to greater support for gender equality in the privately reported attitudes of girls and boys; with further positive effects on mental health, aspirations, and boys’ engagement in housework. A novel lab-in-the-field experiment is used to observe social group dynamics among adolescent peers to examine the program’s impact on receptivity to social conformity. We adopt Asch-inspired conformity measures to demonstrate a treatment effect on conformity in gender beliefs (when stated publicly) versus conformity in a more general class of publicly stated beliefs as a placebo test. We find that private changes in gender beliefs lead to differences in an adolescent’s willingness to conform to group beliefs. Treated adolescents are less likely to succumb to peer pressure to conform when stating their gender attitudes in public, leading to greater public expression of egalitarian ideals. The effects on conformity are observed only for the gender norms domain. Our findings suggest that social norms interventions can be effective in positively shaping gender attitudes, helping to empower adolescents to withstand normative pressures.
records.abstract_cn: 利用随机对照试验，本文评估了针对索马里青少年早期性别规范干预的影响。该计划在私下报告的男孩和女孩态度中增强了对性别平等的支持；并对心理健康、抱负以及男孩参与家务劳动产生了进一步的积极影响。采用一种新颖的实地实验室实验来观察青少年同伴间的社会群体动态，以考察该计划对社会从众接受度的影响。我们采用受阿希启发的从众测量，以证明在性别信念（当公开陈述时）上的从众处理效应，与作为安慰剂检验的更为一般类别的公开陈述信念上的从众效应。我们发现，性别信念的私下改变导致青少年在群体信念中从众意愿的差异。接受治疗的青少年在公开陈述其性别态度时，不太可能屈服于同伴压力而从众，从而更公开地表达平等主义理想。从众效应仅在性别规范领域观察到。我们的研究结果表明，社会规范干预能有效积极塑造性别态度，帮助青少年增强抵御规范性压力的能力。

records.title_en: Firms under fire! How insecurity affects formal firms’ existence
records.title_cn: 战火下的企业：不安全如何影响正规企业的存续
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the effect of insecurity on formal firms’ existence. We develop a flexible theoretical framework in which insecurity, a latent production cost, affects firms’ market entry, exit, and formality decisions. In our empirical analysis, we combine an original dataset on Afghan firms with georeferenced data on military events that we use to proxy insecurity. In the state-building context of post-2003 Afghanistan, military events reflect not only violence but also state capacity expansion. For formal firms, this latter channel dominates. As a result, increased exposure to military events conveys on average a reduction in effective insecurity and positively impacts formal firm existence. Nonetheless, this effect is highly heterogeneous depending on actors, location, timing and firms’ characteristics. The Afghan conflict has the specificity of deeply involving foreign countries. Mobilizing this particular source of exogenous variation, we identify the causal effect of an insecurity reduction on formal firms’ existence. We show that an increase of 1% in the exposure to instrumented military events raises the formal activity probability by 3.8%.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了不安全对正规企业存续的影响。我们构建了一个灵活的理论框架，其中不安全作为一种潜在的生产成本，影响企业的市场进入、退出和正规化决策。在实证分析中，我们将阿富汗企业的原始数据集与用于代理不安全的军事事件地理参考数据相结合。在2003年后阿富汗的国家建设背景下，军事事件不仅反映暴力，还反映国家能力的扩张。对于正规企业而言，后一种渠道占主导地位。因此，军事事件暴露的增加平均意味着有效不安全的减少，并对正规企业的存续产生积极影响。然而，这种效应因行动者、地点、时间和企业特征的不同而高度异质。阿富汗冲突的特殊性在于外国深度介入。利用这一特定的外生变异来源，我们识别了不安全减少对正规企业存续的因果效应。我们表明，工具化军事事件暴露每增加1%，正规活动概率提高3.8%。

records.title_en: Kinship ties in politics and response to extreme weather shocks
records.title_cn: 政治中的亲属关系与极端天气冲击的应对
records.abstract_en: It is well-established that ties between politicians influence the distribution of public resources, particularly in policy domains where officials enjoy substantial discretion. Other policy areas, such as disaster response, have more limited scope for discretionary targeting. To what extent does political alliance influence the allocation of resources in these settings? Focusing on the case of the Philippines, I examine if kinship ties between two major local politicians – provincial governor and congressperson – influence the response to typhoon shocks. Using a close-election regression discontinuity design, I find that kin-connected governors respond better than other governors to strong typhoon shocks. I argue that the effect can be explained by both supply and demand channels. I find suggestive evidence that governors leverage their connections to congresspersons to request more assistance from the national government. Furthermore, voters reward kin-connected governors for their response to strong typhoons. These results provide a lower-bound estimate on the effects of political alliances on the allocation of fiscal resources.
records.abstract_cn: 已有充分研究表明，政治家之间的联系影响公共资源的分配，尤其是在官员拥有较大自由裁量权的政策领域。其他政策领域，如灾害应对，自由裁量性定向分配的空间较为有限。在这些情境下，政治联盟在多大程度上影响资源分配？以菲律宾为例，我考察了两位主要地方政治家——省长和国会议员——之间的亲属关系是否影响对台风冲击的应对。利用接近选举的断点回归设计，我发现与亲属有联系的省长在应对强台风冲击时比其他省长表现更好。我认为这一效应可以通过供给和需求两个渠道来解释。我发现了暗示性证据，表明省长利用与国会议员的联系向国家政府请求更多援助。此外，选民会奖励与亲属有联系的省长对强台风的应对。这些结果为政治联盟对财政资源配置的影响提供了一个下界估计。

records.title_en: Aging in Haze
records.title_cn: 雾霾中的老龄化
records.abstract_en: We study how the environment shapes aging. Leveraging a natural experiment in China where coal-powered winter heating caused persistently higher levels of particulate matters (PMs) north of a policy boundary for over three decades, we find that prolonged PM exposure accelerates aging beyond the biological age, leading to higher rates of multiple chronic conditions, functional disabilities, and cognitive decline in the working-age population. These effects were dormant in the early adulthood, emerged and developed rapidly in age 40s to 50s, and persisted long after exposure ends. Older cohorts experience faster and more enduring aging effects than younger ones under the same exposure, indicating greater life-cycle vulnerability to pollution-induced aging. We highlight that sustained PM exposure accelerates aging and exacerbates physical and cognitive decline in the working-age population.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究环境如何塑造老龄化。利用中国一项自然实验，其中燃煤冬季供暖导致政策边界以北的颗粒物（PM）浓度持续高于南部超过三十年，我们发现长期PM暴露加速了超越生物学年龄的老龄化，导致劳动年龄人口中多种慢性疾病、功能障碍和认知衰退的发生率升高。这些效应在成年早期处于潜伏状态，在40至50岁之间出现并迅速发展，并在暴露结束后持续很长时间。在相同暴露条件下，较年长的队列比年轻队列经历更快、更持久的老龄化效应，表明生命周期中对污染诱导老龄化的脆弱性更大。我们强调，持续的PM暴露加速老龄化，并加剧劳动年龄人口的身体和认知衰退。

records.title_en: Labor market consequences of homicides: A gender perspective from Mexico
records.title_cn: 凶杀案的劳动力市场后果：来自墨西哥的性别视角
records.abstract_en: This paper explores how fluctuations in crime rates influence labor market outcomes in Mexico. Using detailed survey data and an individual-fixed effect estimation, the analysis reveals distinct gender dynamics in response to rising homicide rates. Men are more likely to exit the labor market, while women increasingly join the workforce, mainly in the informal sector. This pattern is consistent with an added-worker effect, which we document using household-level evidence. This outcome is largely driven by the presence of drug trafficking organizations, which primarily employ men in their operations. Escalating violence also increases labor mobility, leading to higher job separations, especially among women. Our results highlight that while increasing crime in the form of homicides may not induce large changes in the aggregate level of employment, there is evidence of labor reallocation across and within sectors. This suggests an increase in labor market misallocation.
records.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了犯罪率波动如何影响墨西哥的劳动力市场结果。利用详细的调查数据和个体固定效应估计，分析揭示了在凶杀率上升时明显的性别动态。男性更可能退出劳动力市场，而女性则越来越多地加入劳动力队伍，主要是在非正规部门。这一模式与附加劳动者效应一致，我们通过家庭层面的证据对此进行了记录。这一结果在很大程度上是由贩毒组织的存在所驱动的，这些组织主要在其运营中雇佣男性。暴力升级也增加了劳动力流动性，导致更高的离职率，尤其是在女性中。我们的结果强调，尽管以凶杀形式增加的犯罪可能不会引起总就业水平的大幅变化，但有证据表明跨部门和部门内部的劳动力重新配置。这表明劳动力市场错配的增加。

records.title_en: Beliefs, information sharing, and mental health care use among university students
records.title_cn: 大学生中的信念、信息共享与心理健康服务使用
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates the role of beliefs and stigma in shaping students’ use of professional mental health services at a large private university in Mexico, where supply-side barriers are minimal and services are readily accessible. In a survey experiment with 680 students, we find that nearly 50% of students in distress do not receive professional mental health support despite a high level of awareness and perceived effectiveness, constituting a substantial treatment gap. We document stigmatized beliefs and misconceptions correlated with the treatment gap. As three-quarters of students incorrectly believe that those in distress perform worse academically and that the majority of students going to therapy are in severe distress, we implement an information intervention to correct these beliefs. We find that it increases students’ sharing of on-campus mental health resources with peers and encourages them to recommend these resources when advising a friend in distress. Interestingly, we find that it lowers respondents’ willingness to pay for private therapy at the end of the intervention. Yet, this effect does not translate into a long-run reduction in self-reported therapy use 6 months after the experiment, with prior therapy users showing increased off-campus take-up.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了信念和污名在塑造墨西哥一所大型私立大学学生使用专业心理健康服务中的作用，该校的供给侧障碍极小，服务易于获取。在一项包含680名学生的调查实验中，我们发现，尽管学生有较高的认知度和感知有效性，但近50%处于困扰中的学生未获得专业心理健康支持，构成了显著的治疗缺口。我们记录了与治疗缺口相关的污名化信念和误解。由于四分之三的学生错误地认为处于困扰中的学生学业表现更差，且大多数接受治疗的学生处于严重困扰中，我们实施了一项信息干预以纠正这些信念。我们发现，该干预增加了学生与同伴分享校园心理健康资源的行为，并鼓励他们在建议处于困扰中的朋友时推荐这些资源。有趣的是，我们发现该干预降低了受访者在干预结束时对私人治疗的支付意愿。然而，这一效应并未转化为实验后6个月自我报告治疗使用的长期减少，先前使用治疗的学生显示出校外使用增加。

records.title_en: Algorithmic collusion and a folk theorem from learning with bounded rationality
records.title_cn: 算法合谋与有界理性学习中的民间定理
records.abstract_en: We prove a Folk theorem when players with bounded rationality learn as they play a repeated potential game. We use a dynamic generalization of smooth fictitious play with bounded m-recall strategies to model learning with bounded rationality that is consistent with learning by algorithms. In a repeated potential game with perfect monitoring, we use this learning model to show that for any feasible and individually rational payoff profile, if players have sufficient recall, are sufficiently patient, and best respond with sufficiently few mistakes, then the players have a non-zero probability of learning an m-recall strategy profile that achieves an average payoff close to the specified payoff profile for an appropriate continuation game. Moreover, the strategy profile learned is an m-recall ϵ-subgame perfect equilibrium of the repeated game. This finding demonstrates that competition authorities are correct in their concern about algorithmic collusion.
records.abstract_cn: 我们证明了当具有有界理性的参与者在重复势博弈中边玩边学时的一个民间定理。我们使用带有有界m-回忆策略的平滑虚拟博弈的动态推广来建模与算法学习一致的有界理性学习。在具有完美监测的重复势博弈中，我们使用此学习模型表明，对于任何可行且个体理性的收益分布，如果参与者具有足够的回忆能力、足够的耐心，并且以足够少的错误进行最佳响应，那么参与者有非零概率学习到一个m-回忆策略分布，该分布在适当的延续博弈中实现接近指定收益分布的平均收益。此外，学习到的策略分布是重复博弈的m-回忆ε-子博弈完美均衡。这一发现表明，竞争主管部门对算法合谋的担忧是正确的。

records.title_en: Repugnant transactions: The role of agency and severe consequences
records.title_cn: 令人反感的事务：代理作用与严重后果
records.abstract_en: Repugnance constrains market design because inacceptable or repugnant transactions must be avoided. To better understand what makes a transaction repugnant, we study two potential causes: limited agency, e.g., one party being forced to accept an offer, and severe consequences of the transaction. In a laboratory experiment, we find that spectators prohibit transactions with limited agency more frequently than with full agency, especially when the consequences are severe rather than mild. The main findings of the experiment are corroborated by a vignette study on the acceptability of kidney sales. The results point to policies that can mitigate repugnance.
records.abstract_cn: 反感限制了市场设计，因为不可接受或令人反感的事务必须避免。为了更好地理解什么使一项事务令人反感，我们研究了两个潜在原因：有限的代理，例如一方被迫接受报价，以及事务的严重后果。在实验室实验中，我们发现旁观者禁止有限代理的事务比完全代理的事务更频繁，尤其是在后果严重而非轻微时。实验的主要发现得到了关于肾脏销售可接受性的情景研究的证实。结果指向了能够减轻反感的政策。

records.title_en: Outcome destabilization
records.title_cn: 结果的不稳定性
records.abstract_en: In a game in extensive form, we say that a sequence of trembles destabilizes an outcome if there is no corresponding sequence of payoff perturbations and Nash outcomes converging to the outcome. We use equilibrium destabilization to characterize sequential equilibria and sequentially stable outcomes, and to reinterpret standard selection criteria in signaling games as a means of ruling out implausible equilibria by identifying destabilizing tremble sequences. We show that the existence of a maximally destabilizing sequence of trembles (destabilizing all outcomes but one) significantly simplifies studying strategically stable behavior in complex games such as finitely repeated games.
records.abstract_cn: 在扩展形式博弈中，我们说，如果不存在相应的收益扰动序列和纳什结果序列收敛到该结果，则颤抖序列会使该结果不稳定。我们利用均衡不稳定性来刻画序贯均衡和序贯稳定结果，并将信号博弈中的标准选择准则重新解释为通过识别不稳定的颤抖序列来排除不合理均衡的手段。我们证明，最大不稳定颤抖序列（使除一个结果外的所有结果都不稳定）的存在显著简化了对复杂博弈（如有限重复博弈）中策略稳定行为的研究。

records.title_en: Conventions in large games with randomly drawn payoffs
records.title_cn: 随机支付大博弈中的惯例
records.abstract_en: By showing that a one-shot deviation property holds for almost all large games with i.i.d. randomly drawn payoffs in which a convention (in the sense of Young, 1993a) exists, long-run outcomes under behavioral rules are characterized by social choice rules.
records.abstract_cn: 通过证明在几乎所有具有独立同分布随机支付的大博弈中，若存在惯例（按Young，1993a的定义），则一次性偏离性质成立，行为规则下的长期结果可由社会选择规则来刻画。

records.title_en: Justified-envy-minimal efficient mechanisms for priority-based matching
records.title_cn: 基于优先级的匹配中合理嫉妒最小化有效机制
records.abstract_en: We study priority-based matching markets. We propose a novel partial order for comparing matching mechanisms in terms of their “fairness.” Using this order, we show that efficiency-adjusted deferred acceptance (EADA) is justified-envy minimal in the class of efficient mechanisms, while top trading cycles (TTC) and other popular mechanisms are not. Our findings highlight EADA as an interesting alternative to TTC in the context of transplantation-organ markets. Restricting attention to strategyproof mechanisms, we show that TTC is justified-envy minimal, providing robustness to the result of Abdulkadiroğlu et al. (2020).
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究基于优先级的匹配市场。我们提出了一种新的偏序关系，用于比较匹配机制在“公平性”方面的表现。利用这一顺序，我们证明了效率调整的延迟接受（EADA）在有效机制类别中是合理嫉妒最小的，而顶级交易循环（TTC）及其他流行机制则不然。我们的发现凸显了EADA在移植器官市场背景下作为TTC的一个有趣替代方案。将注意力限制在策略证明机制上，我们证明了TTC是合理嫉妒最小的，这为Abdulkadiroğlu等人（2020）的结果提供了稳健性。

records.title_en: Duality in financial networks
records.title_cn: 金融网络中的对偶性
records.abstract_en: This article introduces the concept of duality in financial networks, which entails the division of losses versus gains. In bankruptcy problems, in which a bankrupt entity divides its non-negative assets among a group of claimants, duality is well understood. Financial networks generalize bankruptcy problems by allowing for multiple agents with individual assets interconnected by mutual claims. We argue that allowing for negative assets is imperative to adequately formulate duality for financial networks. We show that there is a linear relationship between transfer schemes based on claims rules in a financial network and transfer schemes based on the dual of those claims rules in the dual financial network. Moreover, dual financial networks enable us to define dual transfer rules and dual allocation rules. We show that both self-dual transfer rules and self-dual allocation rules have to be based on self-dual claims rules. On the other hand, we demonstrate that transfer rules based on self-dual claims rules need not be self-dual, whereas allocation rules based on self-dual claims rules are always self-dual.
records.abstract_cn: 本文介绍了金融网络中对偶性的概念，这涉及损失与收益的划分。在破产问题中，破产实体将其非负资产分配给一组索赔人，对偶性已被充分理解。金融网络通过允许多个拥有个体资产且相互索赔相互关联的代理人，对破产问题进行了推广。我们认为，允许负资产对于充分表述金融网络的对偶性是必要的。我们证明，在金融网络中基于索赔规则的转移方案与在对偶金融网络中基于这些索赔规则对偶的转移方案之间存在线性关系。此外，对偶金融网络使我们能够定义对偶转移规则和对偶分配规则。我们表明，自对偶转移规则和自对偶分配规则都必须基于自对偶索赔规则。另一方面，我们证明基于自对偶索赔规则的转移规则不一定是自对偶的，而基于自对偶索赔规则的分配规则则总是自对偶的。

records.title_en: Timing and skewness of information revelation: Evidence on information structures and compound lotteries
records.title_cn: 信息揭示的时机与偏度：关于信息结构与复合彩票的证据
records.abstract_en: In a series of three experiments, we investigate intrinsic preferences for timing and skewness of information resolution in a “compound lottery” (CL) and “information structure” (IS) environment. In the first experiment, we rule out predeterminedness of the outcome, i.e., realization before making the decision, as a driver of different timing preferences between the environments. In the second experiment, we show that skewness preferences in a two-outcome setting differ between the two environments. In the third comprehensive experiment, we integrate all three dimensions (timing, skewness, and environment) into a three-outcome setting, which allows a rigorous treatment of skewness. With respect to timing, participants prefer to receive information early in both environments. In case of a gradual resolution, participants strictly prefer positively skewed information in the IS environment, but symmetric information in the CL environment. Our results show that skewness and environment must be jointly taken into account when studying preferences for information resolution.
records.abstract_cn: 在一系列三个实验中，我们研究了在“复合彩票”（CL）和“信息结构”（IS）环境中，对信息解析时机和偏度的内在偏好。在第一个实验中，我们排除了结果的预定性质，即在做决定之前实现，作为不同环境之间不同时机偏好的驱动因素。在第二个实验中，我们展示了在两种结果设置中，偏度偏好在两个环境之间有所不同。在第三个综合实验中，我们将所有三个维度（时机、偏度和环境）整合到一个三种结果的设置中，这允许对偏度进行严格处理。关于时机，参与者在两种环境中都倾向于尽早接收信息。在逐步解析的情况下，参与者严格偏好IS环境中的正偏信息，但在CL环境中偏好对称信息。我们的结果表明，在研究信息解析偏好时，必须同时考虑偏度和环境。

records.title_en: Strategyproof mechanism for two heterogeneous facilities with constant approximation ratio
records.title_cn: 具有常数近似比的两个异质设施的防策略机制
records.abstract_en: In this paper, we study the two-facility location games with optional preference where the acceptable set of facilities for each agent could be different and an agent’s cost is his distance to the closest facility within his acceptable set. The objective is to minimize the total cost of all agents while achieving strategyproofness. For general metrics, we design a deterministic strategyproof mechanism for the problem with an approximation ratio of 1+2α, where α is the approximation ratio of the offline optimization version. In particular, for the setting on a line, our mechanism achieves an approximation ratio of 1+2, which is tight and improves the previous best upper bound of n/2+1 (Chen et al., 2020).
records.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们研究了具有可选偏好的两设施选址博弈，其中每个代理的可接受设施集合可能不同，代理的成本是其到其可接受集合内最近设施的距离。目标是在实现防策略性的同时最小化所有代理的总成本。对于一般度量空间，我们设计了一个确定性的防策略机制，其近似比为1+2α，其中α是离线优化版本的近似比。特别地，对于直线上的设置，我们的机制实现了1+2的近似比，这是紧的，并改进了之前的最佳上界n/2+1（Chen等人，2020）。

records.title_en: Algorithms and complexity for computing Nash equilibria in adversarial team games
records.title_cn: 对抗性团队博弈中纳什均衡计算的算法与复杂性
records.abstract_en: Adversarial team games model multiplayer strategic interactions in which a team of identically-interested players is competing against an adversarial player in a zero-sum game. Such games capture many well-studied settings in game theory, such as congestion games, but go well-beyond to environments wherein the cooperation of one team—in the absence of explicit communication—is obstructed by competing entities; the latter setting remains poorly understood despite its numerous applications. Since the seminal work of Von Stengel and Koller (GEB ‘97), different solution concepts have received attention from an algorithmic standpoint. Yet, the complexity of the standard Nash equilibrium has remained open.
records.abstract_cn: 对抗性团队博弈模拟了多人策略互动，其中一组利益一致的玩家团队在零和博弈中与一个对抗性玩家竞争。这类博弈涵盖了许多博弈论中研究充分的场景，如拥塞博弈，但远远超出了这些场景，延伸至一个团队的合作——在缺乏明确沟通的情况下——受到竞争实体阻碍的环境；尽管后者应用广泛，但对其理解仍然不足。自Von Stengel和Koller（GEB ‘97）的开创性工作以来，不同的解概念已从算法角度受到关注。然而，标准纳什均衡的复杂性仍然悬而未决。

records.title_en: Strategy vs. direct-response method: evidence from a large online experiment on simple social dilemmas
records.title_cn: 策略法与直接反应法：一项关于简单社会困境的大规模在线实验证据
records.abstract_en: This paper examines behavioral differences in sequential games that arise when choices are elicited via the direct-response method, where players observe the choices made by those who acted earlier and respond with a single choice, or strategy method, where they make their choice(s) in response to all possible choices by those who acted before regardless of whether such actions were taken. We conducted a 2 × 2 between-subject large-scale online experiment with over 8000 participants on Amazon MTurk, manipulating both the elicitation method and participants’ ex-ante beliefs about player 1’s choices via an information-provision treatment. In neutrally framed binary-choice games, a sequential Prisoners’ Dilemma and a mini-Ultimatum Game, we document that the strategy method does not appear to alter player 2’s preferences, i.e., their tendency to reward cooperation or reject unfair offers. However, it reduces the tendency to reward defection and reject fair offers, which we interpret as a reduction in mistakes.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了在序贯博弈中，当通过直接反应法（玩家观察先行动者的选择并做出单一回应）或策略法（玩家对所有可能的先行动者选择做出回应，无论这些行动是否实际发生）引出选择时所产生的行为差异。我们在Amazon MTurk上开展了一项超过8000名参与者的2×2被试间大规模在线实验，通过信息提供处理同时操纵引出方法和参与者对玩家1选择的先验信念。在中性框架的二元选择博弈中，即序贯囚徒困境和迷你最后通牒博弈，我们发现策略法似乎并未改变玩家2的偏好，即奖励合作或拒绝不公平提议的倾向。然而，它降低了奖励背叛和拒绝公平提议的倾向，我们将其解释为错误的减少。

records.title_en: Present-bias and the value of sophistication: Splurging vs. smoothing
records.title_cn: 现时偏差与成熟度的价值：挥霍与平滑
records.abstract_en: This paper develops a dynamic wealth management model for risk-averse agents displaying present-bias in the form of hyperbolic discounting. The agent chooses optimal consumption and labor supply policies and allocates her funds between a risk-free asset, a traded liquid asset, and a non-traded illiquid asset. We characterize these policies for both sophisticated and naive present-biased agents. There are three results. First, sophisticated agents overconsume more and supply less labor than their naive counterparts if and only if their elasticity of intertemporal substitution (EIS) is greater than one. This result arises from the interplay of the smoothing and the splurging effect, which exactly cancel out when the EIS equals one. As a result, sophistication is welfare reducing (increasing) when EIS is high (low). Second, higher stock market volatility and worsening investment opportunities make the sophisticated agent relatively better off than her naive counterpart. Finally, when borrowing constraints are binding and absorbing asset illiquidity serves as a commitment device to mitigate overconsumption and thereby increase welfare.
records.abstract_cn: 本文针对具有双曲贴现形式的现时偏差的风险厌恶代理人，构建了一个动态财富管理模型。代理人选择最优消费和劳动供给政策，并将其资金分配于无风险资产、可交易流动资产和不可交易的非流动资产之间。我们刻画了成熟型和天真型现时偏差代理人的这些政策。有三个结果。首先，当且仅当跨期替代弹性（EIS）大于一时，成熟型代理人比天真型代理人过度消费更多且劳动供给更少。这一结果源于平滑效应和挥霍效应的相互作用，当EIS等于一时，两者恰好抵消。因此，当EIS高（低）时，成熟度会降低（提高）福利。其次，股市波动性增加和投资机会恶化使成熟型代理人相对优于天真型代理人。最后，当借贷约束具有约束力时，吸收资产非流动性可作为承诺机制，以缓解过度消费并从而提高福利。

records.title_en: A generalization of von Neumann’s reduction from the assignment problem to zero-sum games
records.title_cn: 冯·诺依曼从指派问题到零和博弈归约的推广
records.abstract_en: The equivalence between von Neumann’s Minimax Theorem for zero-sum games and the LP Duality Theorem connects cornerstone problems of the two fields of game theory and optimization, respectively, and has been the subject of intense scrutiny for seven decades. Yet, as observed in this paper, the proof of the difficult direction of this equivalence is unsatisfactory: It does not assign distinct roles to the two players of the game, as is natural from the definition of a zero-sum game.
records.abstract_cn: 零和博弈的冯·诺依曼极小极大定理与线性规划对偶定理之间的等价性，分别连接了博弈论和优化这两个领域的基石问题，并且七十年来一直是深入研究的主题。然而，正如本文所观察到的，这一等价性中困难方向的证明并不令人满意：它没有像零和博弈定义所自然要求的那样，为博弈中的两个参与者分配不同的角色。

records.title_en: Privately designed correlated equilibrium
records.title_cn: 私人设计的关联均衡
records.abstract_en: We consider a setting where each player of a simultaneous-move game privately designs an information structure before playing the game. One of these information structures is chosen at random to determine the distribution of the private messages that players receive. These messages allow players to correlate their actions; however, their private design implies a push from correlated to Nash equilibria. Indeed, the sequential equilibrium payoffs of the extensive-form game with privately designed information structures are correlated equilibrium payoffs of the underlying simultaneous-move game, but not all correlated equilibrium payoffs are sequential equilibrium payoffs. In generic 2-player games, the latter are specific convex combinations of two Nash equilibrium payoffs.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考虑一个场景，其中每个参与者在进行同时行动博弈之前，私下设计一个信息结构。这些信息结构中的一个被随机选择，以决定参与者收到的私人信息的分布。这些信息允许参与者关联他们的行动；然而，他们的私人设计意味着从关联均衡向纳什均衡的推动。实际上，具有私人设计信息结构的扩展形式博弈的序贯均衡收益是底层同时行动博弈的关联均衡收益，但并非所有关联均衡收益都是序贯均衡收益。在一般的2人博弈中，后者是两个纳什均衡收益的特定凸组合。

records.title_en: Success functions in large contests
records.title_cn: 成功在大型比赛中发挥作用
records.abstract_en: We consider contests with a large set (continuum) of participants and axiomatize contest success functions that arise when performance is composed of both effort and a random element, and when winners are those whose performance exceeds a cutoff determined by the designer’s budget constraint. Any such Random Performance Function (RPF) satisfies a Co-monotonicity property, which implies that opponents’ effort distributions can be unambiguously ranked based on how competitive they are. We prove that Co-monotonicity, along with standard continuity and monotonicity properties, in fact characterize the class of RPFs. We also describe necessary and sufficient conditions for the noise term to have an additive structure. “The idea of a continuum of traders may seem outlandish to the reader. Actually, it is no stranger than a continuum of prices or of strategies or a continuum of ‘particles’ in fluid mechanics... It should be emphasized that our consideration of a continuum of traders is not merely a mathematical exercise; it is the expression of an economic idea.” In: Markets with a continuum of traders, Robert J. Aumann, Econometrica 1964
records.abstract_cn: 我们考虑有大量（连续体）参与者的竞赛，并将竞赛成功函数公理化，当表现由努力和随机元素组成时，以及当获胜者是那些表现超过由设计者的预算约束确定的截止值时，就会出现这种函数。任何这样的随机性能函数（RPF）都满足共单调性属性，这意味着对手的努力分布可以根据他们的竞争力进行明确的排名。我们证明，共单调性以及标准的连续性和单调性属性实际上表征了 RPF 的类别。我们还描述了噪声项具有加性结构的充分必要条件。 “交易者连续体的想法对读者来说可能显得很奇怪。实际上，它与价格或策略的连续体或流体力学中‘粒子’的连续体并不奇怪……应该强调的是，我们对交易者连续体的考虑不仅仅是一种数学练习；它是一种经济思想的表达。”见：具有连续交易者的市场，Robert J. Aumann，计量经济学 1964

records.title_en: Sequential unanimity voting rules for binary social choice
records.title_cn: 二元社会选择的序贯一致同意投票规则
records.abstract_en: We consider a group of voters that needs to decide between two candidates. In this setting, M-winning coalition rules are characterized by neutrality and strategy-proofness (Moulin, 1983). Their practical implementation motivates the introduction of sequential unanimity rules. We develop algorithms that transform a given M-winning coalition rule into an equivalent sequential unanimity rule and vice versa. The sequential unanimity rules that are constructed present computational advantages compared to their M-winning counterparts. The analysis extends to the full preference domain. Since M-winning coalition rules are closely related to strong and proper simple games, the analysis is relevant to this strand of the game-theoretic literature as well.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考虑一组选民需要在两位候选人之间做出决定的情形。在此设定下，M-获胜联盟规则以中立性和策略证明性为特征（Moulin, 1983）。其实践实施促使了序贯一致同意规则的引入。我们开发了算法，将给定的M-获胜联盟规则转换为等价的序贯一致同意规则，反之亦然。所构建的序贯一致同意规则相比其M-获胜对应规则具有计算优势。该分析扩展至完全偏好域。由于M-获胜联盟规则与强且适当的简单博弈密切相关，该分析对博弈论文献的这一分支也具有相关性。

records.title_en: Equilibrium cycle: A “Dynamic” equilibrium
records.title_cn: 均衡循环：一种“动态”均衡
records.abstract_en: In this paper, we introduce a novel equilibrium concept, called the equilibrium cycle, which seeks to capture the outcome of oscillatory game dynamics. Unlike the (pure) Nash equilibrium, which defines a fixed point of mutual best responses, an equilibrium cycle is a set-valued solution concept that can be demonstrated even in games where best responses do not exist (for example, in discontinuous games). The equilibrium cycle identifies a Cartesian product set of action profiles that satisfies three important properties: stability against external deviations, instability against internal deviations, and minimality. This set-valued equilibrium concept generalizes the classical notion of the minimal curb set to discontinuous games. In finite games, the equilibrium cycle is related to strongly connected sink components of the best response graph.
records.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们引入了一种新颖的均衡概念，称为均衡循环，旨在捕捉振荡博弈动态的结果。与（纯）纳什均衡（定义相互最佳响应的不动点）不同，均衡循环是一种集值解概念，即使在最佳响应不存在的博弈中（例如，不连续博弈）也能被证明。均衡循环识别了一个笛卡尔积行动组合集合，该集合满足三个重要性质：对外部偏离的稳定性、对内部偏离的不稳定性以及最小性。这种集值均衡概念将经典的最小限制集概念推广到不连续博弈。在有限博弈中，均衡循环与最佳响应图的强连通汇分量相关。

records.title_en: Auction design with ambiguity: Optimality of the first-price auction
records.title_cn: 模糊环境下的拍卖设计：第一价格拍卖的最优性
records.abstract_en: We study the optimal auction design problem when bidders are ambiguity averse and follow the max-min expected utility model. Each bidder’s set of priors consists of beliefs that are close to the seller’s belief, where “closeness” is defined by a divergence. For a given allocation rule, we show that optimal transfers belong to a specific class of transfers, termed win-lose dependent transfers, in which bidders’ transfers upon winning and losing depend only on their own types but not on their opponents’ type reports. This result effectively reduces the infinite-dimensional problem of identifying an optimal transfer function into a two-dimensional problem of determining two constants-one for winning and another for losing. Solving this reduced problem, we show that among efficient mechanisms without transfers to losing bidders, the first-price auction is optimal, thereby outperforming other auction formats such as the second-price auction. We also discuss how the structure of the set of priors is related to the revenue ranking between the first- and second-price auctions.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了当竞拍者具有模糊厌恶并遵循最大最小期望效用模型时的最优拍卖设计问题。每个竞拍者的先验集合由与卖方信念接近的信念组成，其中“接近”通过散度来定义。对于给定的分配规则，我们证明最优转移属于一类特定的转移，称为胜负依赖转移，其中竞拍者在获胜和失败时的转移仅取决于他们自己的类型，而不取决于对手的类型报告。这一结果有效地将确定最优转移函数的无限维问题简化为确定两个常数——一个用于获胜，另一个用于失败——的二维问题。解决这个简化问题后，我们表明，在没有向失败竞拍者转移的有效机制中，第一价格拍卖是最优的，从而优于其他拍卖形式，如第二价格拍卖。我们还讨论了先验集合的结构如何与第一价格和第二价格拍卖之间的收入排名相关。

records.title_en: Adapting stable matchings to evolving preferences
records.title_cn: 适应演化偏好的稳定匹配
records.abstract_en: Adaptivity to changing environments and constraints is key to success in modern society. We address this principle by proposing “incrementalized versions” of Stable Marriage and Stable Roommates, asking what the computational cost is of adapting an existing stable matching after agents’ preferences have changed. We additionally require that the new stable matching should not deviate too much from the old one. After formalizing these incremental versions, we provide a comprehensive computational complexity landscape of Incremental Stable Marriage and Incremental Stable Roommates. To this end, we exploit the parameters “degree of change” in the input (difference between old and new preference profile) and in the output (difference between old and new stable matching). We obtain both hardness and tractability results. In particular, with ties in preferences, both problems remain computationally intractable even under minimal preference changes, whereas with strict preferences, both become (fixed-parameter) tractable, regardless of the extent of preference changes.
records.abstract_cn: 适应变化的环境和约束是现代社会中成功的关键。我们通过提出“增量版本”的稳定婚姻和稳定室友问题来探讨这一原则，询问在代理人的偏好发生变化后，调整现有稳定匹配的计算成本是多少。我们还要求新的稳定匹配不应偏离旧匹配太多。在形式化这些增量版本后，我们提供了增量稳定婚姻和增量稳定室友问题的全面计算复杂性图谱。为此，我们利用了输入中的“变化程度”参数（旧偏好与新偏好之间的差异）和输出中的“变化程度”参数（旧稳定匹配与新稳定匹配之间的差异）。我们获得了难解性和可解性结果。特别是，在偏好中存在并列的情况下，即使偏好变化最小，这两个问题仍然计算上难解；而在严格偏好下，无论偏好变化程度如何，这两个问题都变得（固定参数）可解。

records.title_en: Transaction fee mechanisms robust to welfare-increasing collusion
records.title_cn: 对福利增加型共谋具有稳健性的交易费用机制
records.abstract_en: To allocate transactions to blocks, cryptocurrencies use auction-esque transaction fee mechanisms (TFMs). A conjecture of Roughgarden (2024) asks whether there is a TFM that is incentive compatible for both users and the miner and is also resistant to a collusion that allows them to jointly increase overall welfare. We resolve this question in the negative for deterministic TFMs, through a comprehensive characterization of designs robust to this form of collusion. For randomized TFMs, we show limits on the efficiency they can achieve.
records.abstract_cn: 为了将交易分配到区块中，加密货币使用类似拍卖的交易费用机制（TFMs）。Roughgarden（2024）的一个猜想询问是否存在一种对用户和矿工都具有激励兼容性，并且能够抵抗允许他们共同增加整体福利的共谋的TFM。我们通过全面刻画对这种共谋形式具有稳健性的设计，以否定方式解决了确定性TFM的问题。对于随机化TFM，我们展示了它们所能达到的效率限制。

records.title_en: Rent dissipation and streamlined costs: Laboratory experiments
records.title_cn: 租金耗散与精简成本：实验室实验
records.abstract_en: The effect of group size and effort cost on rent dissipation in the standard Tullock rent seeking model is examined using a laboratory experiment. Data support qualitative comparative static Nash equilibrium predictions as reductions in both group size and effort cost increase effort levels. However, effort and dissipation rates are above Nash predictions for all treatments. In addition, while cutting per-unit effort costs in half increases individual effort levels, they do not fully double as predicted and therefore lower rent dissipation, creating a policy-relevant “streamlining effect”. A quantal response equilibrium, which adds stochastic elements into the game structure, predicts the observed higher effort levels and dissipation but is proven to be unable to explain the streamlining effect. A modification of quantal response that incorporates implementation error noise and loss aversion outperforms other estimated models and tracks the observed all data patterns more closely, including the streamlining effect.
records.abstract_cn: 通过实验室实验检验了群体规模和努力成本对标准塔洛克寻租模型中租金耗散的影响。数据支持定性比较静态纳什均衡预测，即群体规模和努力成本的降低都会增加努力水平。然而，所有处理中的努力和耗散率均高于纳什预测。此外，虽然将单位努力成本减半会增加个体努力水平，但并未如预测那样完全翻倍，因此降低了租金耗散，产生了具有政策相关性的“精简效应”。一种将随机元素纳入博弈结构的量子响应均衡预测了观察到的更高努力水平和耗散，但被证明无法解释精简效应。一种结合了实施误差噪声和损失厌恶的量子响应修正模型优于其他估计模型，并更紧密地追踪了观察到的所有数据模式，包括精简效应。

records.title_en: An experimental study of prisoners' dilemma and stag hunt games played by teams of players
records.title_cn: 囚犯困境与玩家团队狩猎雄鹿游戏的实验研究
records.abstract_en: We compare behavior in six variations of prisoners' dilemma and stag hunt games played by 5-member teams to behavior in the same games played by individuals. The experimental design is informed by a theory of team equilibrium that generates hypotheses about systematic differences between teams and individuals in these games. We also compare three different team collective choice procedures: majority rule; majority rule preceded by a poll; and majority rule preceded by chat. In all six games, we observe significant bandwagon effects that drive consensus in the poll and chat treatments, but voting procedures have no significant effects on team decision frequencies except for the poll treatment of the stag hunt games. Surprisingly, teams do not always defect more than individuals. In prisoners' dilemma games with higher incentives to cooperate, teams cooperate more than individuals. A one-parameter logit specification of the team equilibrium model provides a good fit to the prisoners' dilemma data across all treatments. Teams coordinate more successfully than individuals in the stag hunt games. Additional data are gathered using Amazon Mechanical Turk, including data for much larger (25-member) teams. The observed MTurk behavior differs quantitatively from laboratory behavior, but with similar qualitative comparative statics.
records.abstract_cn: 我们将 5 成员团队玩的六种囚犯困境和猎鹿游戏的行为与个人玩的相同游戏中的行为进行比较。实验设计以团队平衡理论为基础，该理论生成有关这些游戏中团队和个人之间系统差异的假设。我们还比较了三种不同的团队集体选择程序：多数决定；投票表决之前的多数规则；多数规则先于聊天。在所有六款游戏中，我们观察到显着的跟风效应，在民意调查和聊天处理中推动共识，但除了猎鹿游戏的民意调查处理之外，投票程序对团队决策频率没有显着影响。令人惊讶的是，团队的背叛并不总是比个人更多。在合作动机较高的囚徒困境博弈中，团队合作多于个人。团队平衡模型的单参数 Logit 规范非常适合所有治疗中囚犯的困境数据。在猎鹿游戏中，团队的协调比个人的协调更成功。使用 Amazon Mechanical Turk 收集其他数据，包括更大的（25-成员）团队的数据。观察到的 MTurk 行为在数量上与实验室行为不同，但具有相似的定性比较统计数据。

records.title_en: High-stakes failures of backward induction
records.title_cn: 高 stakes 下的逆向归纳失败
records.abstract_en: We examine high-stakes strategic choice using more than 40 years of data from the American TV game show The Price Is Right. In every episode, contestants play the Showcase Showdown, a sequential game of perfect information for which the optimal strategy can be found through backward induction. We find that contestants systematically deviate from the subgame perfect Nash equilibrium. These departures from optimality are well explained by a modified agent quantal response model that allows for limited foresight. The results suggest that many contestants simplify the decision problem by adopting a myopic representation, and optimize their chances of beating the next contestant only. In line with learning, contestants' choices improve over the course of our sample period.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用美国电视游戏节目《价格猜猜猜》超过40年的数据，考察了高 stakes 下的策略选择。在每一集中，参赛者参与“展示对决”，这是一个完美信息的序贯博弈，其最优策略可通过逆向归纳得出。我们发现参赛者系统性地偏离了子博弈完美纳什均衡。这些偏离最优的行为可以通过一个允许有限前瞻的修正代理分位数响应模型得到很好的解释。结果表明，许多参赛者通过采用短视的表述来简化决策问题，仅优化击败下一位参赛者的机会。与学习一致，参赛者的选择在我们的样本期内有所改善。

records.title_en: Endogenous barriers to learning
records.title_cn: 学习的内生障碍
records.abstract_en: Building on the idea that lack of experience is a source of errors but that experience should reduce them, we model agents' behavior using a stochastic choice model (logit quantal response), leaving endogenous the accuracy of their choices. In some games, higher accuracy leads to unstable logit-response dynamics. Starting from the lowest possible accuracy, we define the barrier to learning as the maximum accuracy which keeps the logit-response dynamic stable (for all lower accuracies). This defines a limit quantal response equilibrium. We apply the concept to centipede, travelers' dilemma, and 11-20 money-request games and to first-price and all-pay auctions, and discuss the role of strategy restrictions in reducing or amplifying barriers to learning.
records.abstract_cn: 基于缺乏经验是错误来源但经验应减少错误的观点，我们使用随机选择模型（logit分位数响应）来建模代理人的行为，使其选择的准确性保持内生性。在某些博弈中，更高的准确性会导致不稳定的logit响应动态。从最低可能的准确性出发，我们将学习障碍定义为保持logit响应动态稳定（对于所有更低的准确性）的最大准确性。这定义了一个极限分位数响应均衡。我们将该概念应用于蜈蚣博弈、旅行者困境和11-20金钱请求博弈，以及一级价格拍卖和全支付拍卖，并讨论策略限制在减少或放大学习障碍方面的作用。

records.title_en: Pork barrel politics, voter turnout, and inequality: An experimental study
records.title_cn: 猪肉桶政治、选民投票率与不平等：一项实验研究
records.abstract_en: We experimentally study pork barrel politics in repeated two-candidate majoritarian elections with costly voting. Candidates form distinct supporter groups by favoring some voters in budget spending and ignoring others. Relative to compulsory voting, voluntary voting induces on average larger, more narrowly targeted favors and therefore more inequality among otherwise identical voters. Against our prediction, candidate participants tend to cultivate policy polarization by repeatedly favoring their exclusive supporters and avoiding those of the opponent. With compulsory voting, they tolerate some additional policy overlap for a separate subset of voters. Relating to theory, actual levels and patterns of voluntary turnout are well captured by quantal response equilibrium (QRE) for a noise parameter estimate external to our experiment. Importantly, and surprisingly, for reasonable assumption we find unique QRE solutions for our polity games, which include the policymaking stage and each of the many possible elections that can emerge from that stage.
records.abstract_cn: 我们在重复的两候选人多数决选举中，通过实验研究了猪肉桶政治，其中投票是有成本的。候选人通过偏向某些选民在预算支出中而忽视其他选民，形成独特的支持者群体。相对于强制投票，自愿投票平均诱导出更大、更精准的定向优惠，因此在原本相同的选民中造成更多的不平等。与我们的预测相反，候选人参与者倾向于通过反复偏袒其专属支持者并避开对手的支持者来培养政策极化。在强制投票下，他们容忍为另一部分选民提供一些额外的政策重叠。与理论相关，自愿投票的实际水平和模式被量子响应均衡（QRE）很好地捕捉，该均衡基于我们实验外部估计的噪声参数。重要的是，且令人惊讶的是，在合理的假设下，我们发现我们的政体博弈存在唯一的QRE解，这些博弈包括政策制定阶段以及该阶段可能产生的许多可能选举中的每一个。

records.title_en: Electoral accountability in the lab
records.title_cn: 实验室中的选举问责制
records.abstract_en: We propose a model of electoral accountability, and we test it in a lab setting. As predicted by the model, moral incentives and the desire for reelection interact to deter politicians from accepting bribes early in their careers. Treatments with weaker reelection incentives perform worse in encouraging good initial behavior among politicians, but are more effective in promoting good behavior later on. The probability of voter errors and politicians' intrinsic motivation for good behavior in the final period vary across treatments, with opportunistic behavior being more prevalent in environments with stronger electoral incentives.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个选举问责制模型，并在实验室环境中进行了测试。正如模型所预测的，道德激励和连任愿望相互作用，阻止政治家在职业生涯早期接受贿赂。连任激励较弱的处理在鼓励政治家初期良好行为方面表现较差，但在促进后期良好行为方面更为有效。选民错误的概率和政治家在最后时期对良好行为的内在动机在不同处理间有所变化，机会主义行为在选举激励更强的环境中更为普遍。

records.title_en: Quantal response equilibrium and rationalizability: Inside the black box
records.title_cn: 分位数响应均衡与理性化：黑箱之内
records.abstract_en: This paper aims to connect epistemic and behavioral game theory by examining the epistemic foundations of quantal response equilibrium (QRE) in static games. We focus on how much information agents possess about the probability distributions of idiosyncratic payoff shocks, in addition to the standard assumptions of rationality and common belief in rationality. When these distributions are transparent, we obtain a solution concept called Δp-rationalizability, which includes action distributions derived from QRE; we also give a condition under which this relationship holds true in reverse. When agents only have common belief in the monotonicity of these distributions (for example, extreme value distributions), we obtain another solution concept called ΔM-rationalizability, which includes action distributions derived from rank-dependent choice equilibrium, a parameter-free variant of QRE. Our solution concepts also provide insights for interpreting experimental and empirical data.
records.abstract_cn: 本文旨在通过考察静态博弈中分位数响应均衡（QRE）的认识论基础，连接认知博弈论与行为博弈论。我们关注在理性及理性共同信念的标准假设之外，代理人对于特质性支付冲击的概率分布拥有多少信息。当这些分布是透明的时，我们得到一个称为Δp-理性化的解概念，它包含了由QRE导出的行动分布；我们还给出了这一关系反向成立的条件。当代理人仅对这些分布的单调性（例如，极值分布）有共同信念时，我们得到另一个称为ΔM-理性化的解概念，它包含了由等级依赖选择均衡（QRE的一种无参数变体）导出的行动分布。我们的解概念也为解释实验和实证数据提供了见解。

records.title_en: The refinement of Nash equilibrium based on equilibrium models of imperfectly rational behavior
records.title_cn: 基于不完全理性行为均衡模型的纳什均衡精炼
records.abstract_en: This paper introduces a refinement of Nash equilibrium (NE) to determine the relevance of weakly dominated NE in games. We adapt Harsanyi (1973)'s concept of “approachability,” originally based on games with randomly disturbed payoffs, and extend it to a broader family that encompasses the most widely used equilibrium models of imperfectly rational behavior. We identify a singular NE refinement, approximate payoff monotone equilibrium (APME), that coincides with the set of NE that are approachable by regular quantal response equilibria as well as control cost models. We advocate for APME based on its 1) foundation in models that rationalize empirically observed behavior; 2) ability to discriminate between equilibria without automatically discarding weakly dominated behavior; and 3) computational simplicity in applications where the structure of NE is known. We illustrate the value of APME in three applications in which empirical studies suggest that weakly dominated NE are relevant.
records.abstract_cn: 本文引入了一种纳什均衡（NE）的精炼，以确定弱支配纳什均衡在博弈中的相关性。我们改编了Harsanyi（1973）的“可接近性”概念，该概念最初基于随机扰动收益的博弈，并将其扩展到更广泛的家族，涵盖最常用的不完全理性行为均衡模型。我们确定了一个独特的纳什均衡精炼——近似收益单调均衡（APME），它与由正则量子响应均衡以及控制成本模型可接近的纳什均衡集合相吻合。我们主张采用APME，基于其1在合理化经验观察行为的模型中的基础；2在不自动丢弃弱支配行为的情况下区分均衡的能力；以及3在已知纳什均衡结构的应用中的计算简便性。我们通过三个应用实例展示了APME的价值，在这些应用中，实证研究表明弱支配纳什均衡具有相关性。

records.title_en: On the smooth unfolding of bifurcations in quantal-response equilibria
records.title_cn: 关于量子响应平衡中分岔的平滑展开
records.abstract_en: We report on the topological structure of logit quantal response equilibria for asymmetric, two-player, two-choice games in normal form, via catastrophe theory. We present three main outcomes: first, a novel, smooth potential function for the underlying dynamics, relative to which logit equilibria arise as stationary points comprising a parameterised hyper-surface; secondly, a proof that all catastrophes within this manifold are of order at most three, i.e. “folds and cusps”; thirdly, discovery of a new topological phenomenon, the “pleated loop”, corresponding to a pair of opposed pitchfork bifurcations. This we exhibit for games, such as Prisoner's Dilemma, that have a unique Nash equilibrium, with multiple logit equilibria for finite precision parameters. These results extend work at the intersection of stochastic decision theory and catastrophe theory with economic games. Their application to the problem of bifurcations in the tracing procedure for logit solutions, proposed by McKelvey and Palfrey, is discussed throughout.
records.abstract_cn: 我们通过突变理论报告了正常形式的非对称、两人、二选博弈的 Logit 量子响应平衡的拓扑结构。我们提出了三个主要成果：首先，一个新颖的、平滑的潜在动力学势函数，相对于该势函数，logit 平衡作为包含参数化超曲面的驻点出现；其次，证明该流形内的所有灾难最多为三阶，即“折叠和尖点”；第三，发现了一种新的拓扑现象，即“褶环”，对应于一对相对的干草叉分叉。我们在囚徒困境等游戏中展示了这一点，这些游戏具有独特的纳什均衡，对于有限精度参数具有多个 Logit 均衡。这些结果扩展了随机决策理论和灾难理论与经济博弈交叉点的工作。全文讨论了 McKelvey 和 Palfrey 提出的它们在 Logit 解决方案的追踪过程中的分叉问题中的应用。

records.title_en: Quantal response equilibrium with a continuum of types: Characterization and nonparametric identification
records.title_cn: 具有连续类型的分位数响应均衡：刻画与非参数识别
records.abstract_en: Quantal response equilibrium (QRE), a statistical generalization of Nash equilibrium, is a standard benchmark in the analysis of experimental data. Despite its influence, nonparametric characterizations and tests of QRE are unavailable beyond the case of finite games. We address this gap by completely characterizing the set of QRE in a class of binary-action games with a continuum of types. Our characterization provides sharp predictions in settings such as global games, volunteer's dilemma, and the compromise game. Further, we leverage our results to develop nonparametric tests of QRE. As an empirical application, we revisit the experimental data from Carrillo and Palfrey (2009) on the compromise game.
records.abstract_cn: 分位数响应均衡（QRE）作为纳什均衡的一种统计推广，是实验数据分析中的标准基准。尽管其影响深远，但在有限博弈之外，QRE的非参数刻画和检验尚不可得。我们通过完全刻画一类具有连续类型的二元行动博弈中的QRE集合来填补这一空白。我们的刻画为全局博弈、志愿者困境和妥协博弈等情境提供了精确预测。此外，我们利用我们的结果开发了QRE的非参数检验。作为实证应用，我们重新审视了Carrillo和Palfrey（2009）关于妥协博弈的实验数据。

records.title_en: Quantal response equilibrium as a structural model for estimation: The missing manual
records.title_cn: 作为估计结构模型的量化反应均衡：缺失手册
records.abstract_en: One of the original objectives of the (logit) quantal response equilibrium (LQRE) model was to provide a method for structural estimation of behavior in games, when behavior deviated from Nash equilibrium predictions. To date, only Chapter 6 of the book on quantal response equilibrium by Goeree et al. (2016) focuses on how such estimation can be implemented. We build on that chapter to provide here a more detailed treatment of the methodological issues of implementing maximum likelihood estimation of QRE. We compare the equilibrium correspondence and empirical payoff approaches to estimation, and identify some considerations in interpreting the results of those approaches when applied to the same data on the same game. We also provide a more detailed “field guide” to using numerical continuation methods to accomplish estimation, including guidance on how to tailor implementations to games with different structures.
records.abstract_cn: （对数）量化反应均衡（LQRE）模型的原始目标之一是在行为偏离纳什均衡预测时，为博弈中的行为结构估计提供一种方法。迄今为止，Goeree等人（2016）关于量化反应均衡的书中仅有第6章专注于如何实施此类估计。我们基于该章，在此提供对实施QRE最大似然估计的方法论问题的更详细处理。我们比较了均衡对应和经验支付两种估计方法，并指出了在将这两种方法应用于同一博弈的同一数据时解释结果的一些考虑因素。我们还提供了使用数值延拓方法完成估计的更详细的“实地指南”，包括如何针对不同结构的博弈调整实施方法的指导。

records.title_en: Bayesian inference for Quantal Response Equilibrium in normal-form games
records.title_cn: 正态形式博弈中量化响应均衡的贝叶斯推断
records.abstract_en: This paper develops a framework for estimating Quantal Response Equilibrium models from experimental data using Bayesian techniques. Bayesian techniques offer some advantages over the more commonly-used maximum likelihood approach: (i) more favorable small-sample properties, and (ii) ease of handling unobservable heterogeneity. As Quantal Response Equilibrium is a non-linear model, I also discuss some issues with choosing appropriate priors.
records.abstract_cn: 本文开发了一个框架，利用贝叶斯技术从实验数据中估计量化响应均衡模型。贝叶斯技术相较于更常用的最大似然方法具有一些优势：（i）更有利的小样本性质，以及（ii）易于处理不可观测的异质性。由于量化响应均衡是一个非线性模型，我还讨论了选择适当先验的一些问题。

records.title_en: Non-parametric identification and testing of quantal response equilibrium
records.title_cn: 量子响应平衡的非参数辨识与检验
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the falsifiability and identification of Quantal Response Equilibrium (QRE) when each player's utility and error distribution are relaxed to be unknown non-parametric functions. Using the variation of players' choices across a series of games, we first show that both the utility function and the distribution of errors are non-parametrically over-identified. This over-identification result further suggests a straightforward testing procedure for QRE which achieves the desired type-1 error and maintains a small type-2 error. To apply this methodology, we conduct an experimental study of the matching pennies game. Our non-parametric estimates strongly reject the conventional Logit choice probability. Moreover, when the utility and the error distribution are sufficiently flexible and heterogeneous, the quantal response hypothesis cannot be rejected for 70% of participants. However, strong assumptions such as linear utility, logistically distributed errors, and homogeneity lead to substantially higher rejection rates.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了当每个参与者的效用和误差分布放宽为未知的非参数函数时，量子响应均衡（QRE）的可证伪性和可识别性。利用一系列游戏中玩家选择的变化，我们首先表明效用函数和错误分布都是非参数过度识别的。这种过度识别结果进一步表明了 QRE 的简单测试程序，它实现了所需的类型 1 误差并保持较小的类型 2 误差。为了应用这种方法，我们对匹配便士游戏进行了实验研究。我们的非参数估计强烈拒绝传统的 Logit 选择概率。此外，当效用和误差分布足够灵活和异质时，对于70%的参与者来说，量子响应假设不能被拒绝。然而，线性效用、逻辑分布误差和同质性等强假设会导致更高的拒绝率。

records.title_en: Weak pulse: a Q-methodology study of stakeholder viewpoints on barriers in European food legume value chains
records.title_cn: 微弱脉搏：欧洲食用豆类价值链障碍的利益相关者观点Q方法研究
records.abstract_en: European ambitions for more sustainable food systems rely, in part, on expanding the production and consumption of food legumes. Yet European food legume value chains remain marginal, and EU and national level supporting policies are few. We apply Q–methodology to provide novel evidence about stakeholder perceptions of the relative importance of current value chain barriers and their interrelationship, while also exploring how these perceptions vary among stakeholders from different European countries. Based on a Principal Component Analysis of 91 Danish, German, Polish, and Spanish value chain stakeholders’ sorting of 28 barrier statements, we extract five shared viewpoints, pointing out the perceived most important barriers: (1) a lack of capacity for end-product production and use; (2) unattractive legume products; (3) governance, institutional and capacity gaps; (4) unfavorable food system conditions; and (5) a restricted domestic raw material production. Cross–country analyses reveal that some viewpoints are widely shared, whereas others are country–specific. Our findings underscore the need for a flexible portfolio of European and national policy measures, such as educational initiatives, institutional support, network development, and coordinated national and regional strategies, to effectively address the value chain barriers currently inhibiting the realization of the full potential of food legumes as a pathway toward a more sustainable European food system.
records.abstract_cn: 欧洲对更可持续食品系统的雄心部分依赖于扩大食用豆类的生产和消费。然而，欧洲食用豆类价值链仍然边缘化，欧盟和国家层面的支持政策寥寥无几。我们采用Q方法，提供关于利益相关者对当前价值链障碍相对重要性及其相互关系的感知的新证据，同时探讨这些感知在不同欧洲国家利益相关者之间的差异。基于对91名丹麦、德国、波兰和西班牙价值链利益相关者对28条障碍陈述排序的主成分分析，我们提取了五个共享观点，指出感知的最重要障碍：(1)终端产品生产和利用能力不足；(2)豆类产品缺乏吸引力；(3)治理、制度和能力缺口；(4)不利的食品系统条件；以及(5)国内原材料生产受限。跨国分析显示，一些观点被广泛共享，而另一些则具有国家特定性。我们的研究结果强调，需要灵活组合欧洲和国家政策措施，如教育倡议、制度支持、网络发展以及协调的国家和区域战略，以有效解决当前阻碍食用豆类作为通往更可持续欧洲食品系统路径的全部潜力实现的价值链障碍。

records.title_en: Profitability and exit decisions of organic dairy farmers in the EU
records.title_cn: 欧盟有机奶农的盈利能力和退出决策
records.abstract_en: Global policy goals have been set for the expansion of organic farming. However, in most European countries, progress towards this goal is limited, with some organic farmers reverting to conventional production or ceasing production altogether. While various studies have addressed the profitability of organic farming, holistic evidence on the EU level and on farmers’ exit decisions is still lacking. We use a large dataset covering 71% of the EU market to analyze the relationship between dairy farmers’ decision to produce organically and their profitability. Moreover, we investigate the decision of these farmers to exit organic production. Our results reveal that organic farms achieve, on average, a higher profitability. However, the probability of exiting the organic market increases consistently in the years after conversion, peaking in year eight, which reflects difficulties in the transition process. Subsequently, exit probabilities decrease as farms seem to have familiarized themselves with organic production methods and positioned themselves in the sector. Finally, downward fluctuations in profitability and price premiums for organic milk are associated with a higher exit probability. The results show that policy-makers should specifically target the early phase after conversion and provide risk management instruments to support policy targets for organic production.
records.abstract_cn: 全球政策目标已设定为扩大有机农业。然而，在大多数欧洲国家，实现这一目标的进展有限，一些有机农民回归传统生产或完全停止生产。尽管已有各种研究探讨了有机农业的盈利能力，但在欧盟层面和农民退出决策方面的整体证据仍然缺乏。我们使用一个覆盖欧盟市场71%的大型数据集，分析奶农决定进行有机生产与其盈利能力之间的关系。此外，我们调查了这些农民退出有机生产的决策。我们的结果显示，有机农场平均实现了更高的盈利能力。然而，在转换后的几年中，退出有机市场的概率持续增加，在第八年达到峰值，这反映了转型过程中的困难。随后，随着农场似乎已熟悉有机生产方法并在该领域定位自己，退出概率下降。最后，盈利能力和有机牛奶价格溢价的向下波动与更高的退出概率相关。结果表明，政策制定者应特别针对转换后的早期阶段，并提供风险管理工具以支持有机生产的政策目标。

records.title_en: Refining pesticide use to reduce yield loss: How drone plant protection transforms smallholder pest management
records.title_cn: 精细化农药使用以减少产量损失：无人机植保如何改变小农户的病虫害管理
records.abstract_en: Digital technologies hold potential to transform smallholder agriculture, but their impacts on production are not yet well understood. Using original survey data from Chinese maize farmers, we examine the adoption and impacts of Drone Plant Protection (DPP), a rapidly emerging agricultural technology. We find that adoption is associated with both economic and health considerations: DPP is linked to substantially lower operational costs (-29%) and pesticide exposure time (-90%), and suggests a lower incidence of self-reported pesticide-related health symptoms (-83%). Regarding impacts, a two-way fixed-effects model reveals that DPP users’ pesticide application frequency is 33% higher, primarily during post-tasseling stages. Estimating a damage control production function, we show that these behavioral adjustments are associated with a reduction in yield loss by 4.6% and align with farmer profit maximization. However, despite drones’ precision capabilities, per-round pesticide expenditure remains unchanged. Our findings demonstrate digital technologies’ potential to enhance yield at lower health risk while highlighting the need for policy interventions addressing institutional and technological barriers to unlock their environmental benefits.
records.abstract_cn: 数字技术有潜力改变小农农业，但其对生产的影响尚未得到充分理解。利用来自中国玉米种植户的原始调查数据，我们考察了无人机植保（DPP）这一快速兴起农业技术的采用及其影响。我们发现，采用与经济和健康考量均相关：DPP与显著较低的运营成本（-29%）和农药暴露时间（-90%）相关联，并提示自我报告的农药相关健康症状发生率较低（-83%）。关于影响，双向固定效应模型显示，DPP使用者的农药施用频率高出33%，主要发生在抽雄期后阶段。通过估计损害控制生产函数，我们表明这些行为调整与产量损失减少4.6%相关，并与农户利润最大化一致。然而，尽管无人机具有精准能力，每轮农药支出保持不变。我们的发现证明了数字技术在降低健康风险的同时提高产量的潜力，同时强调了需要政策干预以解决制度和技术障碍，从而释放其环境效益。

records.title_en: Funeral reform, land use, and environmental consequences: evidence from China
records.title_cn: 殡葬改革、土地利用与环境后果：来自中国的证据
records.abstract_en: Against the backdrop of China’s twin objectives to uphold the 1.8 billion mu arable land baseline and alleviate air pollution, this research employs the national pilot for funeral reform as a policy intervention for a natural experiment. The analysis adopts a DID methodology to estimate the causal effects of this reform on two fronts: the multifunctionality of cultivated land and the concentrations of urban air pollutants, specifically carbon monoxide (CO) and sulfur dioxide (SO2). The results indicated that the implementation of funeral reform significantly enhanced the multifunctionality of cultivated land, particularly by improving its production function and living function. These effects were more pronounced in transportation hubs and major grain-producing regions across North, Northeast, East, and Central China. Mechanism analysis demonstrated that these improvements were primarily driven by the expansion of land transfers and the reduction of land fragmentation, which facilitated the development of large-scale agricultural operations. However, a trade-off was identified, where funeral reform significantly increased local air pollution, with average CO concentrations rising by 0.0949 mg/m3 and SO2 concentrations increasing by 3.2490 µg/m3, respectively. This adverse environmental effect was largely attributable to the expansion of cemeteries and funeral home facilities accompanying the reform.
records.abstract_cn: 在中国维护1.8亿亩耕地红线和缓解空气污染的双重目标背景下，本研究将全国殡葬改革试点作为政策干预进行自然实验。分析采用双重差分法估计该改革在两个方面的因果效应：耕地多功能性和城市空气污染物浓度，具体包括一氧化碳（CO）和二氧化硫（SO2）。结果表明，殡葬改革的实施显著增强了耕地的多功能性，特别是改善了其生产功能和居住功能。这些效应在交通枢纽和北方、东北、华东及华中地区的主要粮食产区更为明显。机制分析表明，这些改善主要由土地流转的扩大和土地碎片化的减少驱动，这促进了大规模农业经营的发展。然而，存在一种权衡，即殡葬改革显著增加了当地空气污染，平均CO浓度上升了0.0949毫克/立方米，SO二浓度增加了3.2490微克/立方米。这种不利的环境效应主要归因于伴随改革而扩大的墓地和殡仪馆设施。

records.title_en: Female earnings and dietary diversity: Evidence from an inflationary economic crisis
records.title_cn: 女性收入与膳食多样性：来自通货膨胀性经济危机的证据
records.abstract_en: Which households experience the most significant changes in their nutritional profile during economic crises? This paper presents evidence from Nigeria’s economic crisis of 2023–24, marked by food price inflation of more than 40% at its peak. Our study investigates how household income can help alleviate the adverse effects of inflation, particularly in households with female income earners. Our findings reveal that households with income-earning women had higher dietary diversity, all else equal. However, these households are more susceptible to inflation-induced declines, particularly in rural areas. Overall, our study highlights the critical role of women income earners and the importance of diversifying household income sources to enhance resilience against economic shocks.
records.abstract_cn: 在经济危机期间，哪些家庭的营养状况变化最为显著？本文提供了尼日利亚2023-24年经济危机的证据，该危机以食品价格通胀在峰值时超过40%为特征。我们的研究探讨了家庭收入如何有助于缓解通胀的不利影响，特别是在有女性收入者的家庭中。我们的研究结果显示，在其他条件相同的情况下，有女性收入的家庭膳食多样性更高。然而，这些家庭更容易受到通胀导致的下降影响，尤其是在农村地区。总体而言，我们的研究强调了女性收入者的关键作用以及多样化家庭收入来源以增强抵御经济冲击能力的重要性。

records.title_en: Addressing conflict and weather shocks in agrifood value chains: policy preferences of Nigerian maize wholesalers
records.title_cn: 应对农产品价值链中的冲突和天气冲击：尼日利亚玉米批发商的政策偏好
records.abstract_en: We study the preferences of Nigerian maize wholesalers regarding interventions or measures (henceforth, “policies”) aimed at preventing or mitigating the effects of violent conflicts and extreme weather events on their trade. Using the best-worst scaling method, we evaluate their preferences for nine policy options related to conflict shocks and eight policy options for weather shocks, categorized into hard and soft infrastructure policy measures. The method was implemented using primary survey data collected from 300 urban and regional market maize wholesalers across major maize-producing and consuming states in Nigeria, including Kaduna, Kano, Katsina, and Plateau in the north, as well as Oyo in the south. The key findings include: (1) wholesalers strongly prefer road security soft infrastructure for conflict shocks and flood-proofing hard infrastructure for weather shocks; (2) wholesalers, in general, value cash relief after shocks; (3) women wholesalers prioritize public hard infrastructure over cash relief; (4) wholesalers in the relatively safer southern region prioritize road security against conflict and banditry on long supply routes from the northern maize-producing region more than northern wholesalers, who source locally; and (5) more educated wholesalers favor market-oriented solutions like insurance and loans. These results highlight the need for tailored policy responses aligned with different shocks and wholesaler characteristics.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了尼日利亚玉米批发商对旨在预防或减轻暴力冲突和极端天气事件对其贸易影响的干预措施或措施（以下简称“政策”）的偏好。使用最佳-最差缩放方法，我们评估了他们对与冲突冲击相关的九种政策选项和针对天气冲击的八种政策选项的偏好，分为硬基础设施政策措施和软基础设施政策措施。该方法是利用从尼日利亚主要玉米生产和消费州的300城市和区域市场玉米批发商收集的初步调查数据来实施的，这些批发商包括北部的卡杜纳、卡诺、卡齐纳和高原，以及南部的奥约。主要调查结果包括：（1）批发商强烈喜欢道路安全软基础设施来应对冲突冲击和防洪硬基础设施应对天气冲击； (2)批发商一般看重冲击后的现金救济； (3) 女性批发商优先考虑公共硬件基础设施而不是现金救济； (4) 相对安全的南部地区的批发商比在当地采购的北部批发商更重视道路安全，以防止来自北部玉米产区的长供应路线上的冲突和土匪行为； (5) 受过更多教育的批发商青睐保险和贷款等以市场为导向的解决方案。这些结果凸显了需要根据不同的冲击和批发商特征制定量身定制的政策应对措施。

records.title_en: “It was a force for good but…”: a mixed-methods evaluation of the implementation of the high in fat, sugar and salt (HFSS) legislation in England
records.title_cn: “这是一股向善的力量，但是……”：对英格兰高脂肪、高糖和高盐 (HFSS) 立法实施情况的混合方法评估
records.abstract_en: In 2022, legislation in England restricted products high in fat, sugar, or salt (HFSS) in prominent store locations. This study explores retail sector (including enforcement of legislation in retail) responses to the legislation’s implementation.
records.abstract_cn: 在2022中，英格兰立法限制在显着商店位置出售高脂肪、高糖或高盐 (HFSS) 的产品。本研究探讨了零售部门（包括零售立法的执行）对立法实施的反应。

records.title_en: Decision support system using rough DEMATEL for evaluating blockchain adoption in food bank supply chain
records.title_cn: 基于粗糙DEMATEL的食品银行供应链区块链采纳决策支持系统
records.abstract_en: Food banks (FBs) play a vital role in food security by recovering surplus food and redistributing it to people who lack reliable access to sufficient nutrition. However, FBs face persistent operational challenges, particularly in balancing supply and demand. This study presents a novel approach to examining blockchain technology (BT) adoption within the food bank supply chain (FBSC) to boost food donation efficiency, enabling real-time inventory tracking, reliability, and strengthening compliance with food safety regulations. We identified the key barriers, categorized them into external and internal dimensions, and analyzed them using a pairwise comparison survey based on insights from academics and experts (N = 21) within the food bank network (FBN). The decision-making trial and evaluation laboratory (DEMATEL) methodology was used to model and quantify the causal relationships among these barriers. To address subjectivity and ambiguity in expert opinions during group decision-making, rough theory was integrated with DEMATEL, providing a reliable approach to managing conflicting perspectives and uncertainty. Results indicate that the lack of access to technology is the most significant barrier hindering the implementation and growth of blockchain adoption in FBSC. Also, the lack of regulation and legislation related to donated food was assigned the minimum normalized weight, indicating it has the least influence on the system. Further, a lack of government support for implementing BT represents another critical barrier, reflecting the early stage of BT development. The study offers valuable insights to support FBs and policymakers in developing long-term sustainability strategies.
records.abstract_cn: 食品银行在食品安全中扮演着至关重要的角色，通过回收剩余食物并将其重新分配给无法可靠获取充足营养的人群。然而，食品银行面临持续的操作挑战，尤其是在平衡供需方面。本研究提出了一种新颖的方法，用于考察食品银行供应链中区块链技术的采纳，以提高食品捐赠效率，实现实时库存追踪、增强可靠性，并加强遵守食品安全法规。我们识别了关键障碍，将其分类为外部和内部维度，并基于食品银行网络内学者和专家的见解（N = 21）通过成对比较调查进行了分析。采用决策试验与评价实验室方法对这些障碍之间的因果关系进行建模和量化。为了解决群体决策过程中专家意见的主观性和模糊性，将粗糙集理论与DEMATEL相结合，提供了一种可靠的方法来管理冲突观点和不确定性。结果表明，缺乏技术获取途径是阻碍食品银行供应链中区块链采纳实施和发展的最重要障碍。此外，与捐赠食品相关的法规和立法缺失被赋予最小归一化权重，表明其对系统影响最小。进一步地，缺乏政府支持实施区块链技术是另一个关键障碍，反映了区块链技术发展的早期阶段。本研究为支持食品银行和政策制定者制定长期可持续性战略提供了宝贵的见解。

records.title_en: Stocks and shocks: Assessing the relative roles of public and private inventories in buffering rice price volatility in the Philippines
records.title_cn: 股票与冲击：评估公共和私人库存对菲律宾大米价格波动缓冲的相对作用
records.abstract_en: Public stockholding of food is politically contentious and economically challenging. Although private stocks are generally understood to be more efficient than public stocks at providing a reliable buffer against production shortfalls, private stocks often fail to stabilize prices during extreme food market shocks. Moreover, maintaining large public stock programs in which the government acts as the buyer or seller of last resort, can be very costly. This paper analyzes the recent historical success of public and private rice stocks in stabilizing domestic rice prices in the Philippines, the world’s largest net importer of rice. Relying on competitive storage theory and disaggregated rice stock data, we identify statistically independent global demand, global supply, domestic production and domestic demand shocks using Independent Component Analysis (ICA) in a Structural Vector Autoregression (SVAR) framework. We use monthly retail price data for 2000 to 2024 which allows us to leverage an exogeneous policy shift in stock policy. Using impulse response functions, counterfactual paths and historical decompositions we find that inventories have successfully buffered shocks, yet their relative efficacy has depended upon holder and size. Commercial stocks smooth routine volatility, while modest, rule-based public reserves are indispensable during large food market crises and when domestic production shortfalls coincide with international price hikes. We suggest that a hybrid strategy which combines private working stocks with a modest public reserve program, and which is flexible in terms of budget and procurement regulation, can be a cost-effective tool to dampen food-price volatility.
records.abstract_cn: 公共粮食储备在政治上具有争议性，在经济上具有挑战性。尽管普遍认为私人库存在提供可靠缓冲以应对生产短缺方面比公共库存更有效率，但在极端粮食市场冲击期间，私人库存往往无法稳定价格。此外，维持政府作为最后买家或卖家的庞大公共库存计划可能成本高昂。本文分析了菲律宾（世界上最大的大米净进口国）公共和私人大米库存稳定国内大米价格的历史成效。基于竞争性储存理论和分类大米库存数据，我们使用独立成分分析（ICA）在结构向量自回归（SVAR）框架中识别统计上独立的全球需求、全球供给、国内生产和国内需求冲击。我们使用2000年至2024年的月度零售价格数据，这使我们能够利用库存政策的外生政策转变。通过脉冲响应函数、反事实路径和历史分解，我们发现库存成功缓冲了冲击，但其相对有效性取决于持有者和规模。商业库存平滑常规波动，而适度、基于规则的公共储备在大型粮食市场危机以及国内生产短缺与国际价格飙升同时发生时不可或缺。我们建议，将私人营运库存与适度公共储备计划相结合，并在预算和采购监管方面保持灵活性的混合策略，可以成为抑制食品价格波动的成本效益工具。

records.title_en: Patterns in sustainable food choices and policy support: Novel evidence from nine countries
records.title_cn: 可持续食品选择与政策支持的模式：来自九个国家的新证据
records.abstract_en: This analysis uses OECD survey data from over 8,000 households in nine countries. The paper analyses household profiles via latent class analysis on the basis of both diet composition, as well as purchasing habits for products that are generally perceived to be socially responsible. Results reveal four main household profiles that are distinguished by different broad patterns in these two behaviours. Household profiles are found to differ in terms of their sociodemographic characteristics and attitudes towards the environment, as well as with respect to their level of support for various food policies. Interestingly, results regarding the relationship between environmental attitudes and red meat consumption may suggest the existence of another “meat paradox” in the sense that one group of respondents reports high levels of environmental concern but also a high frequency of meat consumption.
records.abstract_cn: 本分析使用了来自九个国家的超过8,000户家庭的经济合作与发展组织（OECD）调查数据。本文基于饮食构成以及通常被认为具有社会责任的产品的购买习惯，通过潜在类别分析对家庭概况进行了分析。结果揭示了四种主要的家庭概况，这些概况在这两种行为的不同广泛模式上有所区别。研究发现，家庭概况在社会人口特征、对环境的态度以及对各种食品政策的支持水平方面存在差异。有趣的是，关于环境态度与红肉消费之间关系的结果可能表明存在另一种“肉类悖论”，即一组受访者报告了高水平的环境关注，但同时也报告了高频率的肉类消费。

records.title_en: Pricing and incentives in the housing market
records.title_cn: 住房市场中的定价与激励
records.abstract_en: We study the housing market effects of a mark-down in the listing of a unit. We define a mark-down as an ask price below a publicly observed estimate of a housing unit’s market value. Using a unique bid-log dataset as well as transaction-level data, we demonstrate that, empirically, a mark-down implies more bidders, but lower opening bids. The net effect is a lower spread between the sell price and the estimated market value. Therefore, our empirical findings point to a relatively important direct effect of ask price changes on the expected sell price and a more limited role of the indirect effect arising from ask price changes directing the flow of buyers. We argue that our empirical findings are consistent with a simple directed search model of ask price determination in the presence of a conflict of interest between the seller and real estate agent over how to trade-off a higher sell price against a longer time-on-market.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了挂牌价格下调对住房市场的影响。我们将下调定义为要价低于公开观察到的住房单元市场价值估计。利用独特的竞价日志数据集以及交易层面数据，我们实证表明，下调意味着更多的竞标者，但初始出价更低。净效应是销售价格与估计市场价值之间的价差更小。因此，我们的实证发现指向要价变化对预期销售价格的相对重要的直接效应，以及要价变化引导买家流动所产生的间接效应作用较为有限。我们认为，我们的实证发现与一个简单的定向搜索模型一致，该模型在卖方与房地产经纪人之间关于如何在更高销售价格与更长市场停留时间之间权衡存在利益冲突的情况下，决定要价。

records.title_en: #IamLGBT: Social networks and coming out
records.title_cn: #IamLGBT：社交网络与出柜
records.abstract_en: In recent decades, the number of people disclosing their LGBTQ identity has increased substantially. We use newly collected data from two waves of a spontaneous Twitter coming out campaign to study the role of peer effects in coming out. Importantly, we are able to distinguish actual public coming out decisions — costly, explicit disclosures — from mere engagement with the campaign. We combine data on users’ pre-campaign networks with the information on the exact time of coming out actions to construct a time-varying measure of the exposure to peers coming out as LGBTQ. A one standard deviation increase in the exposure increases the hourly probability of coming out by almost 20 percent. We also exploit the non-overlapping network structure of users’ peer groups as an exogenous source of variation, and we confirm the baseline results.
records.abstract_cn: 近几十年来，公开其LGBTQ身份的人数大幅增加。我们利用来自两轮自发Twitter出柜活动的新收集数据，研究同伴效应在出柜中的作用。重要的是，我们能够区分实际的公开出柜决定——代价高昂的、明确的披露——与仅仅参与活动。我们将用户活动前网络的数据与出柜行为的确切时间信息相结合，构建了一个随时间变化的衡量同伴出柜暴露程度的指标。暴露程度的一个标准差增加会使每小时出柜概率提高近20%。我们还利用用户同伴群体非重叠的网络结构作为外生变异来源，并确认了基线结果。

records.title_en: On robustness of average inflation targeting
records.title_cn: 关于平均通胀目标制的稳健性
records.abstract_en: This paper considers average inflation targeting (AIT) policy in a New Keynesian model with adaptive learning agents. There are stability concerns regarding AIT when agents have imperfect knowledge and the averaging window length is not public knowledge. These stability risks near the inflation target steady state would likely be avoided under inflation targeting (IT) or price level targeting (PLT). Near the zero interest rate steady state, AIT under-performs PLT and does not necessarily outperform IT. Communicating the averaging window length or adopting an asymmetric average inflation target that judges below-target average inflation more negatively avoids these pitfalls.
records.abstract_cn: 本文在具有适应性学习主体的新凯恩斯模型中考虑了平均通胀目标制（AIT）政策。当主体拥有不完全知识且平均窗口长度并非公开信息时，AIT存在稳定性问题。在通胀目标稳态附近，这些稳定性风险在通胀目标制（IT）或价格水平目标制（PLT）下可能得以避免。在零利率稳态附近，AIT的表现不如PLT，且不一定优于IT。沟通平均窗口长度或采用对低于目标的平均通胀评价更为负面的不对称平均通胀目标，可以避免这些缺陷。

records.title_en: The asymmetric effects of commodity price shocks in emerging economies
records.title_cn: 新兴经济体大宗商品价格冲击的非对称效应
records.abstract_en: This paper estimates the asymmetric effects of commodity price shocks in emerging economies. We employ non-linear panel local projections to show that negative commodity price shocks induce more abrupt effects on output and investment than positive shocks. The response of financial conditions, in terms of increased country spreads and reduced net capital inflows, is crucial in driving the sign-dependent responses. In contrast, neither the exchange rate regime nor fiscal policy explain the asymmetry. These empirical findings are consistent with a small open economy model with occasionally binding borrowing constraints proposed in previous works.
records.abstract_cn: 本文估计了新兴经济体中大宗商品价格冲击的非对称效应。我们采用非线性面板局部投影方法，表明负向大宗商品价格冲击对产出和投资的影响比正向冲击更为急剧。金融条件的反应，表现为国家利差扩大和净资本流入减少，对于驱动符号依赖的反应至关重要。相比之下，汇率制度或财政政策均不能解释这种非对称性。这些实证发现与先前研究中提出的具有偶尔约束借款约束的小型开放经济模型一致。

records.title_en: Femicides, anti-violence centers, and policy targeting
records.title_cn: 女性谋杀、反暴力中心与政策靶向
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates the socio-economic and geographic patterns associated with femicides and examines the role of local policies in combating gender-based violence. First, we construct a novel, granular dataset of femicide cases in Italy spanning 2006–2022 and analyze it with machine learning techniques. This empirical analysis identifies areas at highest risk for women and pinpoints the main territorial predictors of the phenomenon. Second, we collect data on all local anti-violence centers (AVCs) and show that our femicide risk map only partially aligns with the local deployment of existing public support, suggesting that predictive analytics could enhance targeting strategies. Third, using detailed information on the timing of AVC openings in each province and a staggered non-parametric difference-in-differences approach, we find that, on average, AVC openings did not significantly reduce the number of femicides, although they led to a notable decline in sexual violence. These findings suggest ample room to improve the targeting and effectiveness of public policies aimed at combating violence against women.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了与女性谋杀相关的社会经济和地理模式，并考察了地方政策在打击性别暴力中的作用。首先，我们构建了一个新颖的、细粒度的意大利女性谋杀案例数据集，时间跨度为2006年至2022年，并运用机器学习技术进行分析。这一实证分析识别出女性面临最高风险的区域，并指出了该现象的主要地域预测因素。其次，我们收集了所有地方反暴力中心（AVCs）的数据，并表明我们的女性谋杀风险地图与现有公共支持的地方部署仅部分吻合，这表明预测分析可以增强靶向策略。第三，利用各省份反暴力中心开设时间的详细信息，并采用交错非参数双重差分方法，我们发现，平均而言，反暴力中心的开设并未显著减少女性谋杀数量，尽管它们导致了性暴力的显著下降。这些发现表明，在改善旨在打击针对女性的暴力的公共政策的靶向性和有效性方面，存在充足的空间。

records.title_en: Another chance: Number of exam retakes and university students’ outcomes
records.title_cn: 另一次机会：考试重考次数与大学生学业成果
records.abstract_en: Using a difference-in-differences design, we demonstrate that a policy reducing the number of exam retakes per year at one Italian university significantly improved students’ first-year outcomes, resulting in lower dropout rates, increased exam pass rates, and enhanced credit accumulation. Only a small share of these improvements can be explained by changes in the average quality of students enrolling after the reform. The policy also raised on-time graduation rates – the reform’s main objective – without adversely affecting students’ grade point average. Overall, our findings suggest that a cost-effective intervention, such as limiting exam retakes, can substantially enhance student progression and reduce the age at graduation.
records.abstract_cn: 利用双重差分设计，我们证明了一项减少某意大利大学每年考试重考次数的政策显著改善了学生第一年的学业成果，表现为辍学率降低、考试通过率提高以及学分积累增加。这些改善中只有一小部分可以用改革后入学学生平均质量的变动来解释。该政策还提高了按时毕业率——这是改革的主要目标——且未对学生的平均绩点产生不利影响。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，一项成本效益高的干预措施，如限制考试重考次数，可以显著促进学生学业进展并降低毕业年龄。

records.title_en: Labor productivity, effort and the Euro Area business cycle
records.title_cn: 劳动生产率、努力程度与欧元区商业周期
records.abstract_en: Labor productivity is highly procyclical in the Euro Area. We investigate the sources of this procyclicality in an estimated New Keynesian business cycle model with labor search frictions and variable factor utilization in both capital and labor.
