records.abstract_en: Widening access to higher education remains a significant policy goal. Universities often frame and pursue these goals via access targets (target number of students from disadvantaged backgrounds) as part of their intake targets (target total number of students). However, universities' desire to exercise flexibility in their access and intake targets constitutes a novel challenge in designing a centralised admissions system. We introduce the Flexible Access and Intake Targets mechanism that is strategy-proof for the students and enables the universities to pursue their flexible access and intake targets with the most qualified applicants possible. The mechanism is based on an iterative market clearing procedure whose key element is its systematic adjustment of targets in each step in response to fluctuations in applicant numbers. We formulate a fairness concept for matchings that strikes a balance between widening access and merit-based allocation. Our mechanism finds the unique student-optimal fair matching.
records.abstract_cn: 扩大高等教育准入仍然是一个重要的政策目标。大学通常通过准入目标（来自弱势背景的学生目标人数）作为其招生目标（学生总目标人数）的一部分来设定和追求这些目标。然而，大学在准入和招生目标上寻求灵活性的愿望，构成了设计集中式招生系统的新挑战。我们引入了灵活准入与招生目标机制，该机制对学生而言是策略-proof的，并使大学能够以最合格的申请者来追求其灵活的准入和招生目标。该机制基于一个迭代的市场清算程序，其关键要素是每一步根据申请者数量的波动系统性地调整目标。我们为匹配制定了一个公平性概念，在扩大准入和基于成绩的分配之间取得平衡。我们的机制找到了唯一的学生最优公平匹配。

records.title_en: Revealed reciprocity
records.title_cn: 揭示互惠性
records.abstract_en: We propose and characterize the General Reciprocity Model in a framework of context-dependent choice. In the model, the second mover can establish their own rules regarding when or why to reciprocate. The model disentangles the baseline social preference from reciprocity: reciprocity occurs when people deviate from their baseline preference due to the context in which the first mover's choice is made. Our model provides a condition to reveal reciprocity, which aligns with the standard model-free criterion commonly used to identify reciprocity in experimental settings. Thus, it enables us to examine the behavioral foundation of this criterion through the lens of our model. Moreover, in some situations where the standard criterion cannot be applied due to imperfect data, our model offers an additional condition to reveal reciprocity by imposing assumptions about the second mover's psychological processes. Finally, we apply the model to several past experiments, demonstrating how it identifies reciprocity.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出并刻画了在情境依赖选择框架下的广义互惠模型。在该模型中，第二行动者可以自行设定关于何时或为何进行互惠的规则。该模型将基线社会偏好与互惠性分离开来：互惠发生在人们因第一行动者选择所处的情境而偏离其基线偏好时。我们的模型提供了一个揭示互惠性的条件，这与实验设置中常用于识别互惠性的标准无模型准则相一致。因此，它使我们能够通过模型的视角来审视这一准则的行为基础。此外，在某些因数据不完善而无法应用标准准则的情况下，我们的模型通过对第二行动者心理过程施加假设，提供了另一个揭示互惠性的条件。最后，我们将该模型应用于几个过去的实验，展示了它如何识别互惠性。

records.title_en: General theory of equilibrium in models with complementarities
records.title_cn: 具有互补性模型中均衡的一般理论
records.abstract_en: We provide a new and general theory of order nearest comparative statics for subsets of equilibria in models with complementarities used widely in economics and other disciplines. Order nearest equilibria are motivated naturally in the theory of monotone comparative statics of equilibrium, but their existence does not follow from results based on weak set order or strong set order, in general. We provide such results and develop the general theory using weak monotonicity of selections from best response correspondences and two new set comparison relations: Star complete relation and star lattice relation. We do not require any continuity properties. Our results hold for standard models with complementarities prevalent in the literature and allow for new cases.
records.abstract_cn: 我们为经济学及其他学科中广泛使用的具有互补性模型的均衡子集提供了一种新的、一般的最近序比较静态理论。最近序均衡在均衡的单调比较静态理论中自然产生，但一般而言，其存在性并不遵循基于弱集序或强集序的结果。我们提供了这样的结果，并利用最佳响应对应的选择函数的弱单调性以及两种新的集合比较关系——星完备关系和星格关系——来发展一般理论。我们不需要任何连续性性质。我们的结果适用于文献中普遍存在的标准互补性模型，并允许新的情形。

records.title_en: Spatial search
records.title_cn: 空间搜索
records.abstract_en: This paper considers a random search model where some locations provide sellers with better chances of meeting many buyers than other locations (for example popular shopping streets or the first page of a search engine). When sellers are heterogeneous in terms of the quality of their product and/or the probability that a given buyer likes their product, it is desirable that sellers of high-quality niche products sort into the best locations (positive assortative matching, PAM). We show that this does not always happen in a decentralized market. Finally, we endogenize the location distribution and show that PAM between sellers and locations always arises in equilibrium. However, the equilibrium distribution of locations is too favorable for the sellers of high-quality, niche products.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考虑了一个随机搜索模型，其中某些地点为卖家提供了比其他地点更好的遇到众多买家的机会（例如繁华的商业街或搜索引擎的第一页）。当卖家在产品质量和/或特定买家喜欢其产品的概率方面存在异质性时，高质量利基产品的卖家应被分配到最佳地点（正匹配，PAM）。我们表明，在分散市场中这并不总是发生。最后，我们将地点分布内生化，并表明卖家与地点之间的PAM在均衡中总是出现。然而，地点的均衡分布对高质量利基产品的卖家过于有利。

records.title_en: Solid outcomes in finite games
records.title_cn: 有限博弈中的稳健结果
records.abstract_en: A new solution concept for finite games is presented and analyzed. It is defined in terms of outcomes—probability distributions over the plays of the game. Solid outcomes are robust to the representation of the game, whether in normal or extensive form, and are consistent with backward induction. They are also unaffected by the removal or addition of dominated strategies. Solid outcome sets exist in all finite extensive-form games with perfect recall. They have support in minimal “game blocks,” a class of product sets of pure-strategy profiles that are robust set-valued candidates for conventions and social norms in recurrent population play of the game. Algorithms for identifying all solid outcomes are presented, and simulations illustrate the solution concept's significant cutting power and computational efficiency.
records.abstract_cn: 提出并分析了一种针对有限博弈的新解概念。它根据结果来定义——即博弈进行路径上的概率分布。稳健结果对博弈的表示形式具有鲁棒性，无论是正规形式还是扩展形式，并且与逆向归纳法一致。它们也不受支配策略的移除或添加的影响。在所有具有完美回忆的有限扩展形式博弈中，稳健结果集存在。它们支持于最小的“博弈块”，这是一类纯策略组合的乘积集，是重复人口博弈中惯例和社会规范的稳健集合值候选。提出了识别所有稳健结果的算法，模拟实验展示了该解概念显著的削减能力和计算效率。

records.title_en: General equilibrium with unhedgeable fundamentals and heterogeneous agents
records.title_cn: 不可对冲基本面与异质性 agents 的一般均衡
records.abstract_en: This paper examines the implications of unhedgeable fundamental risk, combined with agents' heterogeneous preferences and wealth allocations, on dynamic asset pricing and portfolio choice. We solve in closed form a continuous-time general equilibrium model in which unhedgeable fundamental risk affects aggregate consumption dynamics, rendering the market incomplete. Several long-lived agents with heterogeneous risk-aversion and time-preference make consumption and investment decisions, trading risky assets and borrowing from and lending to each other. We find that a representative agent does not exist. Agents trade assets dynamically. Their consumption rates depend on the history of unhedgeable shocks. Consumption volatility is higher for agents with preferences and wealth allocations deviating more from the average. Unhedgeable risk reduces the equilibrium interest rate only through agents' heterogeneity and proportionally to the cross-sectional variance of agents' preferences and allocations.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了不可对冲的基本面风险，结合 agents 的异质性偏好和财富分配，对动态资产定价和投资组合选择的影响。我们以闭式解形式求解了一个连续时间一般均衡模型，其中不可对冲的基本面风险影响总消费动态，导致市场不完全。多个长寿 agents 具有不同的风险厌恶和时间偏好，做出消费和投资决策，交易风险资产并相互借贷。我们发现代表性 agent 不存在。Agents 动态交易资产。他们的消费率取决于不可对冲冲击的历史。对于偏好和财富分配偏离平均水平较大的 agents，消费波动性更高。不可对冲风险仅通过 agents 的异质性降低均衡利率，并且与 agents 偏好和分配的横截面方差成比例。

records.title_en: Modeling machine learning: A cognitive economic approach
records.title_cn: 机器学习建模：一种认知经济学方法
records.abstract_en: We investigate whether the predictions of modern machine learning algorithms are consistent with economic models of human cognition. To test these models we run an experiment in which we vary the loss function used in training a leading deep learning convolutional neural network to predict pneumonia from chest X-rays. The first cognitive economic model we test, capacity-constrained learning, corresponds with an intuitive notion of machine learning: that an algorithm chooses among a feasible set of learning strategies in order to minimize the loss function used in training. Our experiment shows systematic deviations from the testable implications of this model. Instead, we find that changes in the loss function impact learning just as they might if the algorithm was a human being who found learning costly.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了现代机器学习算法的预测是否与人类认知的经济模型一致。为了检验这些模型，我们进行了一项实验，在该实验中，我们改变了用于训练一个领先的深度学习卷积神经网络以从胸部X光片中预测肺炎的损失函数。我们测试的第一个认知经济模型，即容量受限学习，与机器学习的一个直观概念相对应：算法在可行的学习策略集合中进行选择，以最小化训练中使用的损失函数。我们的实验显示，该模型的可检验含义存在系统性偏差。相反，我们发现损失函数的变化对学习的影响，就像算法是一个发现学习成本高昂的人类时可能产生的影响一样。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Raided by the storm: How three decades of thunderstorms shaped U.S. incomes and wages
records.title_cn: 风暴侵袭：三十年的雷暴如何塑造了美国的收入与工资
records.abstract_en: Climate change and weather events are increasingly affecting the macroeconomic performance of countries and regions. However, their effects on income inequality are less understood. We estimate the dynamic impact of thunderstorms on income and wages and reveal a robust asymmetric effect. We leverage a comprehensive dataset covering more than 200,000 events affecting contiguous U.S. counties across three decades. Storms have caused the highest number of billion-dollar disaster events since the eighties, but they have the lowest average event cost. They are short-lived, locally confined, relatively frequent, difficult-to-predict, and hazardous albeit not fully destructive events. While such features are convenient for the identification of impacts, previous studies mostly focused on more extreme events. We document a robust negative association between storm activity, income and wages growth. While income tends to recover in the long run, wages exhibit a significantly more stubborn decline, suggesting persistent and adverse impacts on (functional) income inequality. A one standard deviation increase in wind exposure generates a loss of 0.15% (0.21%) in wages after three (nine) years; incomes fall by a larger extent initially (0.19% after three years) while fully recovering in the longer run. In addition to their notable asymmetry, such estimates are non-negligible—especially given the downward rigidity of U.S. wages. Our analyses also highlight a lack of effective adaptation and stronger negative impacts in economically disadvantaged regions. Finally, we find evidence for a sizable shock-absorbing role of federal assistance.
records.abstract_cn: 气候变化和天气事件日益影响着国家和地区的宏观经济表现。然而，它们对收入不平等的影响尚不十分清楚。我们估计了雷暴对收入和工资的动态影响，并揭示了一个稳健的非对称效应。我们利用了一个涵盖超过200,000起影响美国本土县、跨越三十年的综合数据集。自八十年代以来，风暴造成的十亿美元级灾害事件数量最多，但它们的平均事件成本最低。它们是短暂的、局部受限的、相对频繁的、难以预测的，且具有危险性但并非完全破坏性的事件。尽管这些特征便于识别影响，但以往的研究大多集中在更极端的事件上。我们记录了风暴活动与收入和工资增长之间稳健的负相关关系。虽然收入在长期内趋于恢复，但工资却表现出显著更持久的下降，表明对（功能性）收入不平等存在持续的不利影响。风暴露度每增加一个标准差，三年（九年）后工资损失0.15%（0.21%）；收入在初期下降幅度更大（三年后为0.19%），但在更长期内完全恢复。除了显著的非对称性外，这些估计值不可忽视——尤其是考虑到美国工资的向下刚性。我们的分析还强调了缺乏有效的适应措施，以及在经济落后地区存在更强的负面影响。最后，我们发现了联邦援助在吸收冲击方面发挥重要作用的证据。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Environmental taxes, offshoring and welfare: The effects of environmental damage and pollution intensity
records.title_cn: 环境税、离岸外包与福利：环境损害与污染强度的影响
records.abstract_en: We analyze the effects of domestic environmental damage and pollution intensity on a monopolist final good producer’s incentive for offshoring a critical intermediate good. Contrary to the usual pollution haven hypothesis, we find that a higher domestic environmental damage, which creates a higher domestic environmental tax, may decrease the incentive for offshoring. This trend is enhanced by a higher pollution intensity of the final good production. Hence, a lower pollution intensity of the final good production may increase offshoring and pollution leakage. Offshoring in our analysis can be excessive or insufficient from the point of view of the domestic country.
records.abstract_cn: 我们分析了国内环境损害和污染强度对垄断最终产品生产商将关键中间产品离岸外包的激励的影响。与通常的污染避难所假说相反，我们发现，更高的国内环境损害（这会导致更高的国内环境税）可能会降低离岸外包的激励。这一趋势因最终产品生产的更高污染强度而增强。因此，最终产品生产的较低污染强度可能会增加离岸外包和污染泄漏。从国内国家的角度来看，我们分析中的离岸外包可能是过度的或不足的。

records.title_en: Research paperAuthority and screening in a principal agent model
records.title_cn: 委托代理模型中的权威与筛选
records.abstract_en: I compare authority structures in a principal agent screening model where the agent’s type determines his payoff and his preferred activity level. The uninformed principal incurs an externality and she is able to propose a revelation mechanism with contingent transfers. Under ‘principal authority’ (the agent needs the principal’s agreement for his activity), the optimal mechanism is a standard screening contract and activities are downwards distorted. Under ‘agent authority’ (the agent can pursue the activity at his own discretion), reservation utilities become type dependent and the sign of the payoff externality shapes contractual outcomes. Specifically, (1) negative externalities (the principal prefers a smaller activity than her agent) now trigger upwards distortions; (2) a subset of agents is being ‘left alone’ under the mechanism; and (3) agent authority is always associated with larger activities than principal authority. Finally, I show that under simple symmetry assumptions, agent authority always generates a higher total surplus than principal authority.
records.abstract_cn: 我在一个委托代理筛选模型中比较权威结构，其中代理人的类型决定其收益和其偏好的活动水平。不知情的委托人承担外部性，并且她能够提出一个带有条件转移支付的揭示机制。在“委托人权威”下（代理人需要委托人同意其活动），最优机制是标准的筛选合同，活动被向下扭曲。在“代理人权威”下（代理人可以自行决定从事该活动），保留效用变得依赖于类型，并且收益外部性的符号影响合同结果。具体来说，（1）负外部性（委托人偏好比其代理人更小的活动）现在引发向上扭曲；（2）在该机制下，一部分代理人被“单独留下”；（3）代理人权威总是与比委托人权威更大的活动相关联。最后，我表明在简单的对称性假设下，代理人权威总是产生比委托人权威更高的总剩余。

records.title_en: Research paperShifting social norms through endorsements
records.title_cn: 研究论文通过背书转变社会规范
records.abstract_en: The attitude of individuals towards prevailing social norms can change over time. When these changes are not observable, norm abidance can remain high due to social costs. We study how an opinion leader with private information about the societal change can influence norm abidance. We show that the opinion leader can affect abidance when she is neither too ideologically sided in favor of the norm violation nor too popularity concerned. The opinion leader has a stronger impact on society when social costs are higher, the societal change is more uncertain, and citizens interact more often with like-minded individuals.
records.abstract_cn: 个体对主流社会规范的态度会随时间变化。当这些变化不可观察时，由于社会成本，规范遵守可能仍然很高。我们研究了一位拥有关于社会变化私人信息的意见领袖如何影响规范遵守。我们表明，当意见领袖既不过分意识形态上偏向于违反规范，也不过分关注人气时，她能够影响遵守情况。当社会成本更高、社会变化更不确定，以及公民更频繁地与志同道合的人互动时，意见领袖对社会的影响更强。

records.title_en: Research paperDifferent defaults affect different groups differently
records.title_cn: 研究论文不同的默认选项对不同群体的影响不同
records.abstract_en: We analyze heterogeneity in default effects on retirement saving in a randomized survey experiment. In the Dutch context of universal, mandatory, and high pensions, respondents make realistic choices in which they can maintain the status-quo, suspend, or double pension contributions for one, three, or five years. The aggregate effect sizes of defaults at a three-year suspension and doubling of contributions are similar, increasing the fraction choosing these options by 22%-points. The former most strongly affects those with low incomes and high pension entitlements, while the latter affects patient, non-procrastinating, and especially impulsive individuals. Average savings are influenced in different directions, depending on the alternatives that individuals would have chosen in absence of the default. When setting defaults, it is important to consider variation in counterfactuals.
records.abstract_cn: 我们在随机调查实验中分析了默认选项对退休储蓄影响的异质性。在荷兰普遍、强制且高额养老金的背景下，受访者做出现实的选择，他们可以维持现状、暂停或加倍养老金缴费，期限为一年、三年或五年。默认选项在三年暂停和加倍缴费方面的总体效应大小相似，使选择这些选项的比例增加了22%个百分点。前者对低收入和高养老金权益的人群影响最为显著，而后者则影响有耐心、不拖延、尤其是冲动型个体。平均储蓄受到不同方向的影响，这取决于在没有默认选项的情况下个体本会选择的替代方案。在设定默认选项时，考虑反事实的差异非常重要。

records.title_en: Research paperThe determinants of missed funding: Predicting the paradox of increased need and reduced allocation
records.title_cn: 研究论文 资金缺口的决定因素：预测需求增加与拨款减少的悖论
records.abstract_en: This research investigates how local governments overlook funding opportunities within the cohesion policies, utilizing machine learning and analysing data from open calls within the European Next Generation EU funds. The focus is on predicting which local governments may face challenges in utilizing available funding, specifically examining the allocation of funds for Italian childcare services. The results demonstrate that it is possible to make out-of-sample predictions of municipalities likely to abstain from invitations, by identifying key determinants. Population-related factors play an important role in predicting inertia, alongside other demand-related elements, particularly in regions with limited services. The study emphasizes the importance of local institutional quality and individual attributes of policymakers. The factors justifying fund allocation have adverse effects on participation, placing regions with greater investment needs at a competitive disadvantage. Anticipating non-participation in calls can aid in achieving policy targets and optimizing the allocation of funds across various local governments.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究调查地方政府如何在凝聚政策中忽视资金机会，利用机器学习并分析欧洲下一代欧盟基金中公开征集的数据。重点在于预测哪些地方政府在利用可用资金方面可能面临挑战，特别考察意大利儿童保育服务的资金分配。结果表明，通过识别关键决定因素，可以对可能放弃邀请的市镇进行样本外预测。人口相关因素在预测惯性方面发挥重要作用，同时还有其他需求相关要素，尤其是在服务有限的地区。研究强调了地方机构质量和政策制定者个人属性的重要性。证明资金分配合理的因素对参与产生不利影响，使投资需求更大的地区处于竞争劣势。预测不参与征集有助于实现政策目标并优化各地方政府之间的资金分配。

records.title_en: Research PaperStock market reactions to a sovereign wealth fund's broad-based public sustainability engagement: European evidence
records.title_cn: 研究论文：股票市场对主权财富基金广泛公开可持续性参与的反应：来自欧洲的证据
records.abstract_en: This study examines investor reactions to a broad-based public engagement by the world's largest sovereign wealth fund (SWF). We use the SWF's announcement to vote against firms with insufficient sustainability performance in an event study comprising 1,169 portfolio firms headquartered in Europe. The results show an average negative reaction of USD 39.99 million to the announcement. The negative effect is concentrated in portfolio firms with low sustainability performance measured by Refinitiv's environmental, social, and governance (ESG) score. Focusing on the SWF's voting share, we find that firms with low sustainability performance and a high voting share experience the most negative market reaction. Notably, the moderating effect of ESG score uncertainty becomes apparent, as firms with both low sustainability performance and low ESG score uncertainty experience more pronounced negative stock market reactions. In contrast, firms with low performance and high uncertainty show no statistically significant effect. Several robustness tests—including a regression discontinuity in time design—confirm our results. Overall, our findings reveal that broad-based public sustainability engagement can exert pressure on European portfolio firms, suggesting that this form of indirect engagement complements direct engagement strategies in their objective to enhance firms’ sustainability performance. Our findings have valuable implications for researchers, practitioners, and policymakers interested in understanding the evolving landscape of investor-firm interactions.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了投资者对世界上最大的主权财富基金（SWF）广泛公开参与的反应。我们利用该主权财富基金宣布将对可持续性表现不足的公司投反对票的事件，对总部位于欧洲的1,169家投资组合公司进行了事件研究。结果显示，公告平均引发39.99百万美元的负面反应。这一负面效应集中在可持续性表现较低的投资组合公司中，这些公司的表现通过Refinitiv的环境、社会和治理（ESG）评分来衡量。关注主权财富基金的投票份额，我们发现可持续性表现较低且投票份额较高的公司市场反应最为负面。值得注意的是，ESG评分不确定性的调节效应变得明显，因为可持续性表现较低且ESG评分不确定性较低的公司股票市场负面反应更为显著。相反，表现较低但不确定性较高的公司没有显示出统计上显著的影响。包括时间回归不连续性设计在内的多项稳健性检验证实了我们的结果。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，广泛的公开可持续性参与可以对欧洲投资组合公司施加压力，这表明这种间接参与形式补充了直接参与策略，以实现提升公司可持续性表现的目标。我们的发现对于有兴趣理解投资者与公司互动不断演变格局的研究人员、从业者和政策制定者具有重要价值。

records.title_en: Research PaperThe politician, the party, and the president: How do political scandals propagate across the party network?
records.title_cn: 研究论文：政治家、政党与总统：政治丑闻如何在政党网络中传播？
records.abstract_en: This study documents that news about a local politician's misbehavior has strong repercussions on their party: cross-border and cross-electoral spillovers emerge. For identification, I use random audits conducted in Brazilian municipalities. I also use detailed geospatial information on radio antenna coverage to construct the relevant neighborhoods where information spreads. Furthermore, by analyzing a decade of newspaper articles, I show that local corruption is covered by the national media and that high corruption cases receive more coverage. The sentiment of news coverage during national elections is more likely to be negative for parties with national candidates, highlighting the important role national media plays in amplifying local events and shaping public sentiment. This study helps us better understand the interplay between local and national political dynamics and provides insights into how local misbehavior can have national repercussions.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究记录了关于地方政治家不当行为的新闻对其政党产生的强烈反响：出现了跨境和跨选举的溢出效应。为进行识别，我使用了在巴西市政当局进行的随机审计。我还利用详细的无线电天线覆盖地理空间信息来构建信息传播的相关邻域。此外，通过分析十年的报纸文章，我表明地方腐败被国家媒体报道，且高腐败案件获得更多报道。在国家选举期间，新闻报道的情绪更可能对拥有国家候选人的政党持负面态度，突显了国家媒体在放大地方事件和塑造公众情绪方面的重要作用。本研究有助于我们更好地理解地方与国家政治动态之间的相互作用，并提供关于地方不当行为如何产生国家影响的见解。

records.title_en: Research paperDisinformation in group chat social media network
records.title_cn: 群聊社交媒体网络中的虚假信息研究
records.abstract_en: This paper introduces a model exploring disinformation propagation within group chat social media networks and its sway on public opinions. The model highlights the observation that disinformation disseminators not only distribute misleading content to sway undecided individuals but also engage in a learning process to augment their influence. Undecided agents form divergent long-term opinions influenced by both their direct exposure to disinformation and their interactions within the social network. Identifying the key influencers in the network becomes crucial in mitigating the impact of disinformation. This study proposes novel centrality measures to pinpoint these influencers, providing social media companies with effective strategies to mitigate the impact of disinformation on their platforms.
records.abstract_cn: 本文介绍了一个模型，探讨群聊社交媒体网络中虚假信息的传播及其对公众舆论的影响。该模型强调了一个观察结果：虚假信息传播者不仅分发误导性内容以影响未决定个体，还参与学习过程以增强其影响力。未决定的行动者形成不同的长期观点，这些观点受到他们直接接触虚假信息以及他们在社交网络内互动的双重影响。识别网络中的关键影响者对于减轻虚假信息的影响至关重要。本研究提出了新颖的中心性度量方法来定位这些影响者，为社交媒体公司提供有效策略，以减轻其平台上虚假信息的影响。

records.title_en: The poor, the rich and the middle class: Experimental evidence from heterogeneous public good games
records.title_cn: 穷人、富人与中产阶级：来自异质性公共品博弈的实验证据
records.abstract_en: This study sheds light on how different sources of inequality can affect cooperation in public good games. We present the results of one-shot and repeated public good experiments that seek to understand the interaction between the endowment and marginal return in heterogeneous groups. Our focus is on situations where endowments and marginal returns are either inversely or proportionally related. While two normatively appealing contribution rules are aligned in the proportional treatment, a conflict arises in the inverse treatment. In the one-shot experiment, we do not find significant differences across treatments. Contributions increase when the endowment, the marginal return or both increase. This is observed in all treatments except when endowment and marginal return are inversely related. Then the ‘middle class’ participants (those with medium endowment and marginal return) contribute more than both the high and low endowment types, mirroring real world observations of a ‘squeezed middle’. This suggests a conflict between the highly endowed subjects (but with low marginal return) and those with a high marginal return (but with low endowment). This pattern is similar when eliciting beliefs about others’ contributions - the two conflicting types expect others to contribute more than they do themselves. The novel treatments are repeated for 15 periods in a subsequent experiment to investigate potential convergence and dynamics. The results are similar to those of the one-shot interaction.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究揭示了不平等来源的不同如何影响公共品博弈中的合作。我们展示了一次性和重复公共品实验的结果，旨在理解异质性群体中禀赋与边际回报之间的相互作用。我们关注的是禀赋与边际回报呈反向或比例关系的情形。在比例处理中，两个规范上具有吸引力的贡献规则是一致的，而在反向处理中则出现冲突。在一次性实验中，我们未发现各处理之间存在显著差异。当禀赋、边际回报或两者同时增加时，贡献增加。这一现象在所有处理中均被观察到，除非禀赋与边际回报呈反向关系。此时，“中产阶级”参与者（即禀赋和边际回报均为中等水平者）的贡献高于高禀赋和低禀赋类型，这反映了现实世界中“被挤压的中层”现象。这表明高禀赋（但低边际回报）的参与者与高边际回报（但低禀赋）的参与者之间存在冲突。在引出关于他人贡献的信念时，这一模式类似——两种冲突类型预期他人的贡献高于自身。新颖的处理在后续实验中重复进行15期，以考察潜在的收敛性和动态变化。结果与一次性互动相似。

records.title_en: Research paperTesting profit maximization in the U.S. cement industry
records.title_cn: 研究论文：检验美国水泥行业的利润最大化
records.abstract_en: Motivated by a commonly held intuition that the cement industry is not competitive, we perform a revealed preference test to examine whether the United States cement industry could have been profit maximizing from 1993–1998. Rather than looking at technical efficiency, we create and examine a measure of necessary competitive price taking profit loss of the cement industry using information on aggregate output and aggregate inputs. One contribution of this paper is to compile a comprehensive dataset of United States cement producers, cement production, cement inputs data, and input/output prices. In particular, we combine data found in the U.S. Mines Geological Yearbooks, the Portland Cement Association, the American Energy Review, and the St. Louis Federal Reserve. Assuming technology is static, non-negative profits for firms, and a priori knowledge of inputs/outputs, we find the U.S. cement industry had a necessary competitive price taking profit loss of 755.1 million 1996 dollars.
records.abstract_cn: 受水泥行业不具有竞争性这一普遍直觉的驱动，我们进行了一项显示性偏好检验，以考察美国水泥行业在1993年至1998年间是否可能实现利润最大化。我们并未关注技术效率，而是利用总产出和总投入的信息，构建并检验了水泥行业在必要竞争性价格接受条件下的利润损失指标。本文的贡献之一在于汇编了美国水泥生产商、水泥产量、水泥投入数据以及投入产出价格的综合数据集。具体而言，我们整合了美国矿山地质年鉴、波特兰水泥协会、美国能源评论以及圣路易斯联邦储备银行的数据。假设技术是静态的、企业利润非负，并且对投入产出有先验知识，我们发现美国水泥行业在必要竞争性价格接受条件下的利润损失为755.1亿美元（按1996年美元计算）。

records.title_en: Research paperFrom me to we: Beating procrastination in teams
records.title_cn: 研究论文从我到我们：在团队中战胜拖延症
records.abstract_en: Can team incentives increase workers’ productivity and decrease procrastination in intertemporal tasks? We recruited 597 online workers to engage in tedious tasks over three days. They were randomly assigned to either individualistic (Solo) incentives or to one of two team-based incentives (Cooperative and Competitive). Contrary to theoretical predictions, workers under Cooperative incentives surpassed the performance of those working under either Solo or Competitive incentives. Productivity on Day 1, which in theory should inversely relate to procrastination, was also significantly higher in both team treatments. Our structural analysis confirms that teams increase productivity by enhancing intrinsic motivation and by reducing the tendency to delay work. Finally, teams increase productivity further under Competitive incentives, when workers can observe and react to the efforts of their team members.
records.abstract_cn: 团队激励能否提高员工的生产力并减少跨期任务的拖延？我们招募了597在线工作人员来从事三天的繁琐任务。他们被随机分配到个人主义（单独）激励措施或两种基于团队的激励措施（合作和竞争）之一。与理论预测相反，合作激励下的工人的表现超过了单独或竞争激励下的工人。白天的生产力1，理论上应该与拖延成反比，在两个团队治疗中也显着更高。我们的结构分析证实，团队通过增强内在动机和减少拖延工作的倾向来提高生产力。最后，当员工可以观察团队成员的努力并对其做出反应时，团队在竞争激励下进一步提高生产力。

records.title_en: Research PaperOpening the black box of college major choice: Evidence from an information intervention
records.title_cn: 研究论文打开大学专业选择的黑箱：来自信息干预的证据
records.abstract_en: This study examines the role of job-related and non-job-related factors in college major choice. Using a staggered intervention, we provide students information on various aspects of majors and assess the impact of different pieces of information on their stated choices. We show that major choices depend on a wide set of factors, especially for students who are initially unsure about their major choice. The non-job-related factors, such as a major’s course difficulty and gender composition, are particularly important to students. Male and female students value different major characteristics in different ways. Female students – particularly those with below-median high school GPA – avoid majors that are more difficult than they originally believed, while male students are averse to majors with more female faculty but prefer those with more female students. Our findings help us understand gender gaps in college major choice and have a number of implications for researchers and policymakers seeking to study major choice or influence those choices.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了与工作相关和非工作相关因素在大学专业选择中的作用。通过一项分阶段干预，我们向学生提供了关于专业各个方面的信息，并评估了不同信息片段对其陈述选择的影响。我们表明，专业选择依赖于广泛的因素，尤其是对于最初不确定专业选择的学生而言。非工作相关因素，如专业的课程难度和性别构成，对学生尤为重要。男性和女性学生以不同方式重视不同的专业特征。女性学生——尤其是那些高中GPA低于中位数的学生——会避开那些比她们最初认为更困难的专业，而男性学生则厌恶女性教师比例较高的专业，但偏好女性学生比例较高的专业。我们的发现有助于理解大学专业选择中的性别差距，并对希望研究专业选择或影响这些选择的研究人员和政策制定者具有若干启示。

records.title_en: Research paperLong-run choice anomalies in reinforcement learning with bounded memory
records.title_cn: 有限记忆强化学习中的长期选择异常
records.abstract_en: Violations of expected utility (EU) maximization have been demonstrated in many settings; however, anomalies are often reduced after repeated choices. We examine if sufficient experiential learning allows convergence to EU-maximization. In the model, a decision maker with long but finite memory repeatedly makes choices in the same decision problem with uncertainty. We focus on the existence and severity of a certain unambiguous type of long-run choice anomaly: ranking reversals (a non-EU maximizing action being most frequently chosen in the long run). We show reversals exist for almost all preferences, even in realistic examples. Reversals tend to happen when payoff differences are heavily skewed. Longer memory does not eliminate the possibility of ranking reversals, but it does make reversals less severe. Our key takeaway is that finite memory can produce major violations of the expected utility ranking even in a model where both memory and the decision-making process are unbiased.
records.abstract_cn: 预期效用（EU）最大化违背已在许多情境中得到证实；然而，在重复选择后，异常现象往往减少。我们考察充分的经验学习是否能使行为收敛至EU最大化。在该模型中，具有长但有限记忆的决策者在同一不确定决策问题中重复进行选择。我们关注一类明确的长期选择异常的存在性和严重性：排序反转（非EU最大化行动在长期中最频繁被选择）。我们证明，即使在现实例子中，反转也几乎对所有偏好存在。当收益差异严重偏斜时，反转往往发生。更长的记忆并不能消除排序反转的可能性，但确实使反转不那么严重。我们的关键结论是，即使在记忆和决策过程均无偏的模型中，有限记忆也能产生对预期效用排序的重大违背。

records.title_en: Research PaperAn experiment on creativity in virtual teams
records.title_cn: 研究论文虚拟团队创造力实验
records.abstract_en: The organization of work and the characteristics of tasks have undergone considerable changes in recent years. The developments include (i) an increased relevance of virtual teams and (ii) a higher demand for non-routine tasks in organizations, including creativity. Existing research on creative teams focuses on one-shot or existing teams, overlooking the importance of the formation phase of teams. This formation phase is particularly relevant for teams working in a virtual workplace setting, where communication and coordination may be constrained by the environment. Next to virtual work, hybrid working models ascend, also for teams. Therefore, we examine the influence of workplace settings and changes in these settings on creative performance of teams. We also investigate whether the individuals’ ability to choose their workplace affects creative performance. We answer those questions by conducting a 2-phase experiment with dyadic teams in the lab and online to model a presence and a virtual workplace setting and account for the formation phase of teams. We implemented the “Unusual-Uses Task” as non-routine creative task. Our results showed that teams working in presence outperform those working online. Interestingly, working at least one phase in presence induces higher creative performance than entirely working online, underscoring the relevance of hybrid workplace settings. Moreover, no significant effects of self-selection on performance were found.
records.abstract_cn: 近年来，工作安排和任务特点发生了较大变化。这些发展包括（i）虚拟团队的相关性增强，以及（ii）对组织中非常规任务（包括创造力）的更高要求。现有的创意团队研究主要集中于一次性或现有团队，忽视了团队形成阶段的重要性。这个形成阶段对于在虚拟工作场所环境中工作的团队尤其重要，其中沟通和协调可能受到环境的限制。除了虚拟工作之外，混合工作模式也在兴起，对于团队来说也是如此。因此，我们研究工作场所环境以及这些环境的变化对团队创造性绩效的影响。我们还调查了个人选择工作场所的能力是否会影响创造性表现。我们通过在实验室和在线对二元团队进行2阶段实验来回答这些问题，以模拟存在和虚拟工作场所环境，并解释团队的形成阶段。我们将“非常用任务”作为非常规创意任务来实施。我们的结果表明，现场工作的团队比在线工作的团队表现更好。有趣的是，与完全在线工作相比，至少一个阶段的在线工作会带来更高的创造性表现，这强调了混合工作场所环境的相关性。此外，没有发现自我选择对绩效有显着影响。

records.title_en: Research PaperPrice expectations and reference-dependent preferences
records.title_cn: 研究论文价格预期和参考相关偏好
records.abstract_en: We test Kőszegi and Rabin's (2006, 2007) theory of reference-dependent preferences in the context of sellers’ price expectations. In a well-powered laboratory experiment, participants are endowed with a good and report their willingness to accept to sell it. We manipulate the price in an exogenous forced sale scenario, which is predicted to produce a “comparison effect”, moving WTA in the opposite direction to the forced sale price. We find a small (Cohen's d=0.18) and marginally significant effect in the hypothesised direction for incentivised reservation prices. More unexpectedly, we find a larger (d=0.32) and highly significant effect in the same direction on unincentivised estimates of the value of the good. Our results cannot be explained by anchoring or signalling effects of the forced sale price, but also highlight some challenges in identifying the effects of expectations manipulations using valuation designs.
records.abstract_cn: 我们在卖方价格预期的背景下测试了 Kőszegi 和 Rabin (2006, 2007) 的参考依赖偏好理论。在一项强有力的实验室实验中，参与者被赋予一种商品，并报告他们愿意接受出售它。我们在外生强制出售情况下操纵价格，预计这会产生“比较效应”，使 WTA 向与强制出售价格相反的方向移动。我们发现激励预订价格的假设方向存在很小的影响（科恩的 d=0.18）且边际显着。更出乎意料的是，我们发现在同一方向上对商品价值的无激励估计有更大的（d=0.32）且非常显着的影响。我们的结果不能用强制出售价格的锚定或信号效应来解释，但也凸显了使用估值设计识别预期操纵影响的一些挑战。

records.title_en: The environmental-financial nexus: Centralized environmental monitoring, eco-consciousness, and green revenues
records.title_cn: 环境与金融的联结：集中式环境监测、生态意识与绿色收入
records.abstract_en: Amid tightening environmental governance, we examine whether and how firms’ eco-consciousness leads to a harmonious balance between environmental and economic performance in the form of green revenues. We utilize China's centralization of environmental monitoring in 2015 as the basis for a difference-in-differences methodology, using highly and less eco-conscious firms as the treatment and control groups. We find that relative to less eco-conscious firms, highly eco-conscious firms derive greater green revenues post-centralization. This finding is robust to underlying firm characteristics and unobservable industry- and time-specific heterogeneity. Regional internet infrastructure development and corporate greenwashing mitigation facilitate the effect on highly eco-conscious firms’ green revenues, suggesting that effective centralized monitoring relies on an integrated information transmission network and an improvement in firms’ genuine environmental accountability. Overall, eco-consciousness facilitates a win-win scenario between environmental and economic performance under an increasingly strict environmental regulatory landscape.
records.abstract_cn: 在环境治理日益收紧的背景下，我们考察企业生态意识是否以及如何以绿色收入的形式实现环境与经济绩效的和谐平衡。我们利用中国2015年环境监测的集中化作为双重差分法的基础，将生态意识高和低的企业分别作为处理组和对照组。我们发现，相对于生态意识较低的企业，生态意识高的企业在集中化后获得了更多的绿色收入。这一发现在考虑企业基本特征和不可观测的行业及时间特定异质性后依然稳健。区域互联网基础设施发展和企业绿色洗白行为的缓解促进了生态意识高的企业绿色收入的增加，这表明有效的集中监测依赖于整合的信息传输网络和企业真实环境责任感的提升。总体而言，在日益严格的环境监管环境下，生态意识有助于实现环境与经济绩效的双赢局面。

records.title_en: Do female experts face an authority gap? Evidence from economics
records.title_cn: 女性专家是否存在权威差距？来自经济学的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper reports results from a survey experiment comparing the effect of (the same) opinions expressed by visibly senior, female versus male experts. Members of the public were asked for their opinion on topical issues and shown the opinion of either a named male or a named female economist, all professors at leading US universities. There are three findings. First, experts can persuade members of the public – the opinions of individual expert economists affect the opinions expressed by the public. Second, the opinions expressed by visibly senior female economists are more persuasive than the same opinions expressed by male economists. Third, removing credentials (university and professor title) eliminates the gender difference in persuasiveness, suggesting that credentials act as a differential information signal about the credibility of female experts.
records.abstract_cn: 本文报告了一项调查实验的结果，该实验比较了（相同的）由明显资深的女性专家与男性专家表达的意见所产生的影响。公众被询问他们对热点问题的看法，并看到一位具名的男性或女性经济学家的意见，这些经济学家均为美国顶尖大学的教授。有三个发现。第一，专家能够说服公众——个体经济学家的意见会影响公众表达的观点。第二，明显资深的女性经济学家表达的意见比男性经济学家表达的相同意见更具说服力。第三，去除资历证明（大学和教授头衔）消除了说服力上的性别差异，这表明资历证明作为关于女性专家可信度的差异化信息信号。

records.title_en: Research PaperIs there moral hazard in medical savings accounts? Evidence from Singapore
records.title_cn: 研究论文医疗储蓄账户是否存在道德风险？来自新加坡的证据
records.abstract_en: Medical savings accounts (MSAs) are designed to provide tax incentives for individuals to save for future healthcare needs, with the goal of reducing overall health expenditures. This paper first examines how individuals adjust their healthcare spending when receiving additional transfers to their MSAs. Using a comprehensive monthly longitudinal survey and a staggered difference-in-differences design, I find that individuals increase their monthly medical expenditure by 13 %, with the marginal propensity to consume from MSAs estimated at 0.6. Second, I analyze the impact of a 25 % price reduction for services at General Practitioner (GP) Clinics and Specialist Outpatient Clinics (SOCs) on healthcare utilization. The results show that MSA holders increase their medication spending by 10.7 % at the extensive margin in response to the price reduction. These findings suggest that both MSA top-ups and price reductions lead to increased healthcare utilization, indicating that MSA holders may respond to these financial incentives by consuming more healthcare in the present, prioritizing immediate healthcare needs over future savings. While this behavior may reflect moral hazard within MSAs, it may also point to unmet healthcare needs that are being addressed through increased liquidity.
records.abstract_cn: 医疗储蓄账户（MSAs）旨在通过税收激励鼓励个人为未来的医疗需求储蓄，以减少总体医疗支出。本文首先考察了当个人获得额外的MSA转账时，他们如何调整医疗支出。利用全面的月度纵向调查和交错双重差分设计，我发现个人月度医疗支出增加了13%，从MSA中消费的边际倾向估计为0.6。其次，我分析了全科医生诊所和专科门诊诊所服务价格降低25%对医疗利用的影响。结果显示，MSA持有者因价格降低而在广泛边际上增加了10.7%的药品支出。这些发现表明，MSA的补充资金和价格降低都导致了医疗利用的增加，这表明MSA持有者可能通过消费更多当前医疗服务来回应这些财务激励，优先考虑即时医疗需求而非未来储蓄。虽然这种行为可能反映了MSA内部的道德风险，但也可能指向通过增加流动性来解决的未满足医疗需求。

records.title_en: Research paperNorm enforcement on minorities: Evidence from traffic violations
records.title_cn: 研究论文少数群体中的规范执行：来自交通违规的证据
records.abstract_en: Compliance with social rules is crucial for fostering cooperation in societies. Motivated by observational evidence from large-scale traffic violation data in a major city in China, we investigate the impact of social identity on rule-following behavior. We empirically showed that traffic violations are significantly less severe when individuals drive in foreign cities rather than the local city where the car is registered, a phenomenon we describe as the “compliance minority effect”. We next conducted a laboratory experiment with a street-crossing task, to further investigate the key drivers behind the compliance minority phenomenon. We found that participants exhibit more rule compliance when identifying as an outgroup minority than a local majority only when both observability and social sanctions are at play. Participants form the prior belief that being part of a minority in the community is associated with a higher chance of being monitored and punished than when they are part of the local majority, which is consistent with the posterior observations. Our results suggest that majorities can enforce augmented social norms on minority groups through an interplay of observability and punishment, which could lead to unintended consequences of local privilege that hamper the equality and efficiency of society.
records.abstract_cn: 遵守社会规则对于促进社会合作至关重要。受中国某大城市大规模交通违规数据观察性证据的启发，我们研究了社会身份对遵守规则行为的影响。我们实证表明，当个人在异地城市驾驶而非在车辆注册的本地城市驾驶时，交通违规的严重程度显著降低，我们将这一现象称为“合规少数群体效应”。接下来，我们进行了一项带有过马路任务的实验室实验，以进一步调查合规少数群体现象背后的关键驱动因素。我们发现，只有当可观察性和社会制裁同时起作用时，参与者作为外群体少数群体时比作为本地多数群体时表现出更多的规则合规行为。参与者形成先验信念，即作为社区中的少数群体成员，比作为本地多数群体成员时更有可能被监控和惩罚，这与后验观察结果一致。我们的结果表明，多数群体可以通过可观察性和惩罚的相互作用，对少数群体加强社会规范，这可能导致本地特权的意外后果，从而损害社会的平等和效率。

records.title_en: Research paperInequity aversion, mandates, and the provision of threshold public goods
records.title_cn: 研究论文：不平等厌恶、强制规定与门槛公共品的供给
records.abstract_en: Previous research has shown that individuals have preferences for equity that deviate from traditional payoff maximizing economic theory. In this research, we use an adapted model of inequity aversion to predict how inequity induced through mandated contributions influences voluntary contribution behavior in a threshold public goods game. Contrary to the model’s predictions, we find that individuals do not have preferences for equitable outcomes. Rather, we find that individuals tend to have preferences for equitable contributions to the public good among group members, regardless of income inequities within groups. In addition, we find that mandates significantly decrease the voluntary provision of the public good. That is, groups exposed to mandated contributions met the threshold less frequently than groups not exposed to mandated contributions. Thus, suggesting that mandates can have significant and negative impacts on voluntary action. The results of this research illustrate the impacts of mandates on voluntary contribution behavior, as well as the behavioral implications of inequity in the provision of public goods.
records.abstract_cn: 以往研究表明，个体具有偏离传统收益最大化经济理论的公平偏好。在本研究中，我们采用一个修正的不平等厌恶模型，预测通过强制贡献引发的不平等如何影响门槛公共品博弈中的自愿贡献行为。与模型预测相反，我们发现个体并不偏好公平的结果。相反，我们发现个体倾向于偏好群体成员之间对公共品的公平贡献，而不论群体内部的收入不平等如何。此外，我们发现强制规定显著降低了公共品的自愿供给。也就是说，受到强制贡献影响的群体达到门槛的频率低于未受强制贡献影响的群体。因此，这表明强制规定可能对自愿行动产生显著的负面影响。本研究的结果阐明了强制规定对自愿贡献行为的影响，以及不平等在公共品供给中的行为含义。

records.title_en: Research paperFrom pandemics to portfolios: Long-term impacts of the 2009 H1N1 outbreak on household investment choices
records.title_cn: 从疫情到投资组合：2009年H1N1疫情对家庭投资选择的长期影响
records.abstract_en: This study examines how experiencing a pandemic affects household investment behaviors. By leveraging cross-state variations in the H1N1 mortality rate in 2009, our difference-in-differences analysis reveals interesting findings. Although the pandemic does not significantly affect stock market participation, it depresses the proportion of liquid assets invested in risky assets among households who participate in the stock market. This effect persists for up to eight years after the pandemic and is particularly pronounced among households characterized by higher risk aversion and greater income volatility. Analysis conducted using different datasets consistently suggests that the pandemic primarily influences portfolio choices through a shift in risk attitudes.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了经历疫情如何影响家庭投资行为。通过利用2009年H1N1死亡率在各州间的差异，我们的双重差分分析揭示了有趣的发现。尽管疫情并未显著影响股市参与，但它降低了参与股市的家庭中投资于风险资产的流动资产比例。这一效应在疫情后持续长达八年，并且在风险厌恶程度较高和收入波动性较大的家庭中尤为明显。使用不同数据集进行的分析一致表明，疫情主要通过风险态度的转变影响投资组合选择。

records.title_en: Research PaperThe contractual dispute resolution game: Real-effort experiments on contract negotiation and arbitration
records.title_cn: 研究论文合同争议解决博弈：关于合同谈判与仲裁的真实努力实验
records.abstract_en: In many contractual arrangements where product or service delivery occurs sometime after contracts have been concluded, conditions may change, leading to disputes that need to be resolved often by a third party (arbitrator/mediator). In this paper we introduce the Contractual Dispute Resolution Game (CDRG), which allows us to study dispute resolution through arbitration. Unlike prior research studying arbitration at impasse using zero-sum bargaining games, we analyze a situation where parties can create additional value. We introduce a novel real-effort task, the Car Assembly Real-effort Task (CART), and show in two studies how automated arbitration rules (Study 1) and human arbitrators (Study 2) affect dispute resolution and surplus creation. In Study 1, we find that high-accuracy arbitration enhances efficiency. In Study 2, we find that arbitrators who are incentivized based on the total surplus of the negotiation do also promote greater efficiency. The CDRG provides a valuable tool for examining the effects of arbitration and mediation in settings where contracts are incomplete and can be impacted by shocks.
records.abstract_cn: 在许多合同安排中，产品或服务的交付发生在合同签订后的一段时间，条件可能发生变化，导致争议往往需要由第三方（仲裁员/调解员）解决。在本文中，我们引入了合同争议解决博弈（CDRG），使我们能够通过仲裁研究争议解决。与先前使用零和讨价还价博弈研究僵局仲裁的研究不同，我们分析了一种各方可以创造额外价值的情境。我们引入了一项新颖的真实努力任务，即汽车组装真实努力任务（CART），并通过两项研究展示了自动化仲裁规则（研究1）和人类仲裁员（研究2）如何影响争议解决和剩余创造。在研究1中，我们发现高精度仲裁提高了效率。在研究二中，我们发现基于谈判总剩余获得激励的仲裁员也促进了更高的效率。CDRG为在合同不完全且可能受到冲击影响的背景下检验仲裁和调解的效果提供了有价值的工具。

records.title_en: Expectations matter in bottom-line setting: Theory and evidence
records.title_cn: 底线设定中的预期重要性：理论与证据
records.abstract_en: Highlights•We find responders’ expectations for proposers’ offers have a causal influence on their minimum acceptable offers (MAOs) in bilateral ultimatum games.•Our research demonstrates that bounded rationality is the underlying mechanism driving the causal impact of responders’ expectations on their MAOs.•Our findings underscore the significant role of expectations in shaping decisions derived using the strategy method, in contrast to those derived using the direct response method.AbstractThe bottom-line, or minimum acceptable offer (MAO), is a crucial concept in real-world economic negotiations. This study demonstrated a causal relationship between responders’ expectations of proposers’ offer and their MAOs setting, in a controlled ultimatum game. We develop three theoretical models (reference dependence, frustration aversion and bounded rationality) to further investigate the underlying mechanism. By considering two distinct scenarios - responders setting MAOs before and after knowing the proposer's offer - we generate distinguishable predictions from our models. We then conduct two experiments to test these predictions, exogenously manipulating subjects’ offer expectations and comparing the observed shifts in MAOs to our theoretical predictions. Our findings indicate that bounded rationality significantly contributes to the causal effect of responders’ expectations on their MAOs, providing a new perspective on how expectations shape bargaining behavior. Furthermore, our results help reconcile divergent findings under the strategy method and direct-response method, highlighting the effects of expectations as a key driver alongside emotion.
records.abstract_cn: 亮点•我们发现回应者对提议者出价的预期对其在双边最后通牒博弈中的最低可接受出价（MAOs）具有因果影响。•我们的研究表明，有限理性是驱动回应者预期对其MAOs产生因果影响的潜在机制。•我们的发现强调了预期在塑造使用策略方法得出的决策中的重要作用，与直接反应方法得出的决策形成对比。摘要底线，或最低可接受出价（MAO），是现实世界经济谈判中的一个关键概念。本研究在受控的最后通牒博弈中证明了回应者对提议者出价的预期与其MAOs设定之间的因果关系。我们开发了三个理论模型（参考依赖、挫折厌恶和有限理性）以进一步探究潜在机制。通过考虑两种不同的情景——回应者在知道提议者出价之前和之后设定MAOs——我们从模型中产生了可区分的预测。然后我们进行了两个实验来测试这些预测，外生地操纵受试者的出价预期，并将观察到的MAOs变化与我们的理论预测进行比较。我们的发现表明，有限理性显著促进了回应者预期对其MAOs的因果效应，为预期如何塑造讨价还价行为提供了新的视角。此外，我们的结果有助于调和策略方法和直接反应方法下的不同发现，强调预期作为关键驱动因素与情绪并列的作用。

records.title_en: Alliances and strategic advantage in sequential-move contests: Implications for offensive vs. defensive strategies
records.title_cn: 联盟与序贯行动竞赛中的战略优势：进攻与防御策略的启示
records.abstract_en: This paper examines the impact of alliances and moving order on strategic advantage, conflict intensity, and expected payoffs in three-player sequential-move contests. The study shows that in a scenario where multiple players act as defenders while facing aggression from a lone player that moves first as an attacker, they must make their arming decisions jointly to gain a strategic advantage. Conversely, when attacking a lone player that moves second as a defender, multiple players acting as first movers must make their arming decisions autonomously. Compared to the benchmark equilibrium in a simultaneous-move game, the overall conflict intensity is higher if multiple players arm independently and lower if they arm cooperatively as an alliance. The expected payoffs of all players are the highest in a sequential-move game when two players ally, regardless of their moving order. Based on the analysis, we find that it is effective to launch an offensive strategy when allied players make arming decisions autonomously and strike first as attackers. On the other hand, a defensive strategy is effective when allied players make arming decisions collectively and move second as defenders.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了联盟和行动顺序对三人序贯行动竞赛中战略优势、冲突强度和预期收益的影响。研究表明，在多个玩家作为防御者面对一个先行动作为攻击者的单独玩家侵略的场景中，他们必须联合做出武装决策以获得战略优势。相反，当攻击一个后行动作为防御者的单独玩家时，作为先行动者的多个玩家必须自主做出武装决策。与同时行动博弈中的基准均衡相比，如果多个玩家独立武装，总体冲突强度更高；如果他们作为联盟合作武装，则总体冲突强度更低。在序贯行动博弈中，当两个玩家结盟时，所有玩家的预期收益最高，无论他们的行动顺序如何。基于分析，我们发现，当联盟玩家自主做出武装决策并作为攻击者先发制人时，采取进攻策略是有效的。另一方面，当联盟玩家集体做出武装决策并作为防御者后行动时，防御策略是有效的。

records.title_en: Framing effects in consumer expectations surveys
records.title_cn: 消费者预期调查中的框架效应
records.abstract_en: Highlights•Response behavior in consumer surveys can be strongly influenced by framing.•This study demonstrates these effects using a randomized control trial embedded in a survey.•Simpler wording is shown to yield higher expected inflation and uncertainty.•Asking for minimum, maximum and mode alleviates shortcomings of the probabilistic format.AbstractIn a randomized survey experiment, I test how variations in question wording and format influence response behavior. Participants from a representative sample in Germany are divided into four groups, each receiving a different version of a question about expected inflation over the next 12 months. I compare two wordings used in leading consumer surveys: (i) the change in prices in general and (ii) the inflation rate. Additionally, I examine responses to a question about probabilistic beliefs regarding future inflation and a simpler one asking for the expected minimum, maximum, and most likely inflation rate. The findings show that response behavior varies significantly with framing. Simpler wording like ‘prices in general’ and less restrictive format produce higher mean expected inflation. While simpler wording leads to higher individual uncertainty, asking for the minimum, maximum, and mode yields lower uncertainty. The results suggest that framing in consumer expectations surveys can shape the elicited data, underscoring the importance of careful question design.
records.abstract_cn: 亮点•消费者调查中的回答行为可能受到框架的强烈影响。•本研究通过嵌入调查的随机对照试验展示了这些效应。•更简单的措辞被证明能产生更高的预期通胀和不确定性。•询问最小值、最大值和众数可缓解概率格式的缺陷。摘要在一项随机调查实验中，我测试了问题措辞和格式的变化如何影响回答行为。来自德国代表性样本的参与者被分为四组，每组收到关于未来12个月预期通胀的不同版本问题。我比较了主要消费者调查中使用的两种措辞：（i）总体价格变化和（ii）通胀率。此外，我考察了对关于未来通胀概率信念的问题的回答，以及一个更简单的询问预期最小值、最大值和最可能通胀率的问题。研究结果显示，回答行为随框架变化显著。更简单的措辞如“总体价格”和较少限制的格式产生更高的平均预期通胀。虽然更简单的措辞导致更高的个体不确定性，但询问最小值、最大值和众数则产生较低的不确定性。结果表明，消费者预期调查中的框架可以影响所获取的数据，强调了仔细设计问题的重要性。

records.title_en: Epidemic disease and innovation
records.title_cn: 流行病与创新
records.abstract_en: It is well-documented that the TseTse fly, which transmits an epidemic disease lethal to livestock, has precluded technology adoption in Africa. In this study, we systematically examine the impact of the TseTse fly on firm innovation in modern Africa. Exploiting newly georeferenced firm data across the world, we find that firms in places that satisfy the TseTse survival conditions are less likely to innovate, and this relationship is unique to Africa and more pronounced in industries with higher innovation intensity. Exploring the channel, we find that people hold more hostile attitude towards technology in historically heavily infested areas.
records.abstract_cn: 已有充分文献记载，传播对牲畜致命的流行病的采采蝇阻碍了非洲的技术采用。在本研究中，我们系统考察了采采蝇对现代非洲企业创新的影响。利用全球范围内新近地理参照的企业数据，我们发现，在满足采采蝇生存条件地区的企业更不可能进行创新，且这一关系在非洲独有，并在创新强度更高的行业中更为显著。在探究机制时，我们发现，在历史上采采蝇 infestation 严重的地区，人们对技术持有更敌对的态度。

records.title_en: The effect of superstitious beliefs on financial reporting conservatism: Evidence from Chinese “Zodiac Year”
records.title_cn: 迷信信念对财务报告稳健性的影响：来自中国“本命年”的证据
records.abstract_en: Superstition persists in human societies despite economic and social progress, influencing behavior and decision-making across cultures. In this paper, we investigate the impact of superstitious beliefs on financial reporting practices. By exploiting within-individual variation in superstitious beliefs among top executives of Chinese private firms, we provide solid evidence that companies led by chairpersons in their zodiac year tend to respond to perceived misfortune by timely writing off impaired assets and are more likely to exhibit greater financial reporting conservatism. Further evidence suggests that both pessimism and regulatory concerns induced by zodiac year beliefs can explain the increase in financial reporting conservatism. Overall, our findings advance behavioral finance research on the relationship between top executives’ superstitious beliefs and firm outcomes.
records.abstract_cn: 迷信在人类社会中持续存在，尽管经济和社会进步，它影响着不同文化中的行为和决策。在本文中，我们研究了迷信信念对财务报告实践的影响。通过利用中国私营企业高层管理人员迷信信念的个体内部变化，我们提供了坚实的证据表明，由处于本命年的董事长领导的公司倾向于通过及时核销减值资产来应对感知到的不幸，并且更可能表现出更高的财务报告稳健性。进一步的证据表明，本命年信念引发的悲观情绪和监管担忧都可以解释财务报告稳健性的增加。总体而言，我们的发现推进了关于高层管理人员迷信信念与企业结果之间关系的行为金融研究。

records.title_en: Peer effects in the hierarchy: Evidence from the workplace
records.title_cn: 层级中的同伴效应：来自工作场所的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper studies consumption peer effect and its relation to promotion from a unique hierarchical perspective, using credit card data of employees in the workplace. We show that one's consumption is significantly influenced by coworkers at the same or higher levels, with a stronger peer effect observed among those who are more likely to be promoted. We also find that the peer effect rises before and falls after a promotion event for the promoted workers. These results highlight the interplay between peer effects and hierarchy within the firm.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用工作场所员工的信用卡数据，从独特的层级视角研究消费同伴效应及其与晋升的关系。我们发现，个人的消费显著受到同级别或更高级别同事的影响，且在被晋升可能性更高的人群中观察到的同伴效应更强。我们还发现，对于被晋升的员工，同伴效应在晋升事件前上升，在晋升事件后下降。这些结果凸显了公司内部同伴效应与层级之间的相互作用。

records.title_en: Attenuation and reinforcement mechanisms over the life course
records.title_cn: 生命历程中的衰减与强化机制
records.abstract_en: We analyse the complex dynamic feedback effects between different life domains over the life course, providing a quantification of the direct (not mediated) and indirect (mediated) effects. To extend the analysis in scope and time beyond the limitations of existing data, we use a rich dynamic microsimulation model of individual life course trajectories parameterised and validated to the UK context. We interpret findings in terms of the implied attenuation or reinforcement mechanisms at play, and discuss implications for health and economic inequalities.
records.abstract_cn: 我们分析了生命历程中不同生活领域之间复杂的动态反馈效应，量化了直接（非中介）和间接（中介）效应。为了在范围和时间上超越现有数据的限制，我们使用了一个丰富的动态微观模拟模型，该模型针对英国背景进行了参数化和验证。我们根据所涉及的隐含衰减或强化机制来解释研究结果，并讨论了对健康和经济不平等的影响。

records.title_en: Does bank expansion reduce domestic violence? Causal evidence from India
records.title_cn: 银行扩张是否减少了家庭暴力？来自印度的因果证据
records.abstract_en: Multiple studies have shown that dowry payments are among the main causes of domestic violence in developing countries. This paper studies the effects of banking expansion on dowry payments and domestic violence in India. Using a fuzzy regression discontinuity design, we present robust evidence that financial inclusion brought about by banking expansion reduces dowry-related deaths and cruelty by husbands. We propose two primary mechanisms underlying this relationship. First, banking expansion enhances the ability of the bride's family to make higher cash payments and more wedding gifts to the groom's family at the time of marriage, often known as dowry. Second, banking expansion empowered women as reflected by better education outcomes for girls. Additionally, by enhancing the household's ability to make dowry payments and improving girls’ education outcomes, banking expansion led to better spouse quality as measured by their education and earnings, reducing the likelihood of domestic violence.
records.abstract_cn: 多项研究表明，在发展中国家，嫁妆支付是家庭暴力的主要原因之一。本文研究了银行扩张对印度嫁妆支付和家庭暴力的影响。利用模糊断点回归设计，我们提供了稳健的证据表明，银行扩张带来的金融包容性减少了与嫁妆相关的死亡和丈夫的虐待行为。我们提出了这一关系背后的两种主要机制。首先，银行扩张增强了新娘家庭在结婚时向新郎家庭支付更高现金和提供更多婚礼礼物的能力，这通常被称为嫁妆。其次，银行扩张通过改善女孩的教育成果赋予女性权力。此外，通过增强家庭支付嫁妆的能力和改善女孩的教育成果，银行扩张导致了更好的配偶质量（以其教育和收入衡量），从而降低了家庭暴力的可能性。

records.title_en: Shooting down trade: Firm-level effects of embargoes
records.title_cn: 击落贸易：禁运的企业层面效应
records.abstract_en: In November 2015, Turkey’s unexpected downing of a Russian military jet in Syria prompted Russia to impose a swift and comprehensive embargo on specific Turkish exports. This study leverages this quasi-natural experiment to estimate both the immediate and longer-term effects of the imposition and subsequent lifting of these sanctions. Utilizing administrative data encompassing all Turkish exporters, we first examine the impact on trade at the firm level, assessing the direct effects of the embargo, the redirection of trade to alternative markets, and the circumvention through other products. Second, we investigate broader repercussions on domestic operations, including firms’ sales, procurement, and employment. Our findings show that while the embargo caused immediate and substantial declines in exports of affected products to Russia, firms partially mitigated these losses through trade diversion. Although relative trade patterns normalized post-sanctions, absolute trade values remained subdued. The analysis reveals that affected firms experienced declines in domestic sales and supplier relationships, with temporary disruptions in employment. However, most negative effects dissipated following the embargo’s removal, except for some persistent reductions in procurement and supplier links, likely linked to persistent lower trade volumes after the lifting of the embargo.
records.abstract_cn: 在2015年十一月，土耳其意外击落俄罗斯军用飞机于叙利亚，促使俄罗斯对特定土耳其出口实施迅速而全面的禁运。本研究利用这一准自然实验，评估了这些制裁实施及随后解除的即时和长期效应。利用涵盖所有土耳其出口商的行政数据，我们首先考察了企业层面的贸易影响，评估禁运的直接效应、向替代市场的贸易转移以及通过其他产品的规避行为。其次，我们调查了对国内运营的更广泛影响，包括企业的销售、采购和就业。我们的研究结果显示，尽管禁运导致受影响产品对俄罗斯的出口立即大幅下降，但企业通过贸易转移部分缓解了这些损失。尽管制裁后相对贸易模式恢复正常，但绝对贸易值仍保持低迷。分析表明，受影响企业在国内销售和供应商关系方面出现下滑，就业出现暂时中断。然而，在禁运解除后，大多数负面效应消散，除了采购和供应商联系方面的一些持续减少，这可能与禁运解除后贸易量持续低迷有关。

records.title_en: On the properties of the two main types of global poverty lines
records.title_cn: 两种主要类型的全球贫困线的性质
records.abstract_en: Global poverty lines belong to two main types that differ on how the poverty line’s nominal monetary amount is adjusted to prevailing prices and preferences. “Objective” poverty lines capture the cost of a fixed list of achievements. “Welfaristic” poverty lines capture the cost of a fixed level of welfare. Longstanding debates oppose their respective proponents. This conceptual paper is the first to contrast the properties of these two types of poverty lines. Our framework considers both heterogeneous prices and heterogeneous preferences. Our results clarify the normative principles that differentiate them and shed light on these debates. Which type of poverty line satisfies stronger versions of our properties depends on the extent of preferences heterogeneity. We show that, under heterogeneous preferences, the World Bank’s International Poverty Line cannot consistently reflect a fixed list of achievements.
records.abstract_cn: 全球贫困线分为两种主要类型，其不同之处在于贫困线的名义货币金额如何根据现行价格和偏好进行调整。 “客观”贫困线反映了一系列固定成就的成本。 “福利主义”贫困线反映了固定福利水平的成本。长期的争论反对各自的支持者。这篇概念性论文首次对比了这两种贫困线的特性。我们的框架考虑了异质价格和异质偏好。我们的结果阐明了区分它们的规范原则，并阐明了这些争论。哪种类型的贫困线满足我们财产的更强版本取决于偏好异质性的程度。我们表明，在不同偏好的情况下，世界银行的国际贫困线不能始终如一地反映固定的成就清单。

records.title_en: What matters for the decision to study abroad? A lab-in-the-field experiment in Cape Verde
records.title_cn: 出国留学的决定最重要的是什么？佛得角的现场实验室实验
records.abstract_en: Study abroad migration is the fastest growing international migration flow. However, the college completion rates of students from low-income countries are often modest in OECD countries, raising the hypothesis that these migrants are poorly informed about the costs and benefits of their decision. Our work tests this hypothesis by running a lab-in-the-field experiment where graduating high school students in Cape Verde are faced with incentivized decisions to apply for college studies abroad. Our results show that potential migrants react strongly to information about the availability of financial support and about college completion rates. Since subjects’ prior beliefs on availability of financial support are overestimated, it is likely that study migrants need to shift their time from study to work after uninformed migration, which likely harms their scholar performance. Policies that inform potential migrants of actual study funding possibilities should decrease study migration flows but may improve successful graduation.
records.abstract_cn: 留学移民是增长最快的国际移民流。然而，在经合组织国家，来自低收入国家的学生的大学毕业率通常较低，这提出了这样的假设：这些移民对其决定的成本和收益知之甚少。我们的工作通过进行现场实验室实验来检验这一假设，在该实验中，佛得角即将毕业的高中生面临着申请出国大学学习的激励决定。我们的研究结果表明，潜在移民对有关财务支持的可用性和大学毕业率的信息反应强烈。由于受试者对经济支持可用性的先前信念被高估，留学移民在不知情的移民后可能需要将时间从学习转移到工作，这可能会损害他们的学术表现。让潜在移民了解实际学习资助可能性的政策应该会减少学习移民流量，但可能会提高成功毕业的几率。

records.title_en: Early maternity and paternity. Effects on educational trajectories
records.title_cn: 早期生育与父亲身份：对教育轨迹的影响
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates the dynamic effects of adolescent parenthood on education enrollment in Chile using administrative data covering six cohorts born between 1990 and 1995. Employing an event study methodology, the analysis reveals substantial and persistent declines for both teen mothers and fathers in school enrollment, but more pronounced and enduring effects for mothers. Heterogeneity assessments expose socioeconomic disparities, indicating larger effects among parents from disadvantaged backgrounds. The study sheds light on the short-term dynamics of educational disruptions caused by early parenthood, offering insights for policy interventions aimed at retaining or reintegrating socioeconomically vulnerable students into the education system.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用覆盖1990年至1995年间出生的六个队列的行政数据，调查了智利青少年父母身份对教育入学的动态影响。采用事件研究方法，分析显示青少年母亲和父亲在入学率上均出现显著且持续的下降，但对母亲的影响更为显著且持久。异质性评估揭示了社会经济差异，表明来自不利背景的父母受到的影响更大。该研究揭示了早期生育导致的教育中断的短期动态，为旨在留住或重新融入社会经济弱势学生进入教育体系的政策干预提供了见解。

records.title_en: Better strategies for saving more: Evidence from three interventions in Chile
records.title_cn: 更好的储蓄更多策略：来自智利三项干预措施的证据
records.abstract_en: Individual behavioral biases can affect savings behavior. We conduct an experiment to evaluate different strategies to increase savings. We compare an automatic savings plan (or default rule), monthly reminders, and a rule-of-thumb savings package that appeals to careful spending. We find that rule-of-thumb and default rules can increase savings for one year after the intervention. In contrast, reminders can reduce account balances and debt levels. The increase in savings under the default rule is produced by a (mechanical) increase in deposits, but savings is later decreased by an increase in withdrawals.
records.abstract_cn: 个人行为偏差会影响储蓄行为。我们进行了一项实验来评估增加储蓄的不同策略。我们比较了自动储蓄计划（或默认规则）、每月提醒以及吸引谨慎支出的经验法则储蓄方案。我们发现，经验法则和默认规则可以在干预后一年内增加储蓄。相反，提醒可以减少账户余额和债务水平。默认规则下储蓄的增加是由于存款（机械）增加而产生的，但储蓄随后因取款的增加而减少。

records.title_en: The local human capital costs of oil exploitation
records.title_cn: 石油开采的当地人力资本成本
records.abstract_en: This paper explores the local-level impacts of oil exploitation on human capital accumulation in Colombia, a resource-rich developing country. We provide evidence based on detailed spatial and temporal data on oil exploitation and education, using the number of wells to measure treatment intensity at the school level. To derive causal estimates, we rely on an instrumental variable approach that exploits the exogeneity of international oil prices and a proxy of local oil endowments. The results indicate that although oil exploitation does not impact enrollment in higher education, it may negatively affect human capital in Colombia since it generates a delay in the decision to enroll. Furthermore, it incentivizes talent allocation away from STEM and professional degrees. Our results suggest no effect on either the quality of secondary education or tertiary education completion. These results are robust to a number of specification changes, and we stress the role of local markets and spillovers as the main transmission channel. In particular, we find that higher oil production increases formal wages, without finding evidence of a premium to tertiary education enrollment in oil-producing areas, and there is a positive spillover to other economic sectors.
records.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了哥伦比亚这个资源丰富的发展中国家石油开采对当地人力资本积累的影响。我们根据石油开采和教育的详细时空数据提供证据，使用油井数量来衡量学校层面的处理强度。为了得出因果估计，我们依靠工具变量方法，该方法利用了国际石油价格的外生性和当地石油禀赋的代理。结果表明，虽然石油开采不会影响高等教育的入学率，但它可能会对哥伦比亚的人力资本产生负面影响，因为它会导致入学决定的延迟。此外，它还激励人才配置远离 STEM 和专业学位。我们的结果表明，这对中等教育的质量或高等教育的完成没有影响。这些结果对于许多规范变化都是稳健的，我们强调当地市场和溢出效应作为主要传播渠道的作用。特别是，我们发现，石油产量的增加会提高正式工资，但没有发现石油生产地区高等教育入学率增加的证据，而且对其他经济部门有积极的溢出效应。

records.title_en: Labor market effects of bounds on domestic outsourcing
records.title_cn: 国内外包限制的劳动力市场效应
records.abstract_en: In early 2022, Peru enacted regulations to curtail widespread outsourcing, limiting it to activities outside a firm’s core functions. Utilizing quarterly data from Peru’s National Household Surveys (ENAHO) from 2021 to 2022 and yearly data from 2023, this study applies difference-in-differences techniques to assess short-term labor market outcomes. Results show that while outsourcing decreased by 1.7 percentage points, the restrictions had no significant adverse effects on employment, wages, or labor formalization. If anything, employment and labor force participation showed slight, though non-causal, increases. These findings are robust to various tests and alternative specifications, suggesting that the policy primarily impacted outsourcing practices without markedly influencing broader labor outcomes. It did neither destroy jobs nor improve workers’ employment conditions.
records.abstract_cn: 2022年初，秘鲁颁布法规以遏制普遍的外包行为，将其限制在企业核心职能之外的活动。利用秘鲁国家家庭调查（ENAHO）2021年至2022年的季度数据以及2023年的年度数据，本研究应用双重差分技术评估短期劳动力市场结果。结果显示，虽然外包下降了1.7个百分点，但这些限制对就业、工资或劳动正规化没有显著的负面影响。若说有何影响，就业和劳动力参与率略有上升，尽管这种上升并非因果关系。这些发现在各种检验和替代设定下均保持稳健，表明该政策主要影响了外包实践，而未显著影响更广泛的劳动力结果。它既未破坏就业，也未改善工人的就业条件。

records.title_en: On strategy-proofness and the salience of single-peakedness in a private goods allotment problem
records.title_cn: 论策略性证明与私有物品分配问题中单峰性的显著性
records.abstract_en: We consider strategy-proof rules operating on a rich domain of preference profiles in a set up where multiple private goods have to be assigned to a set of agents with entitlements and where preferences display satiation. We show that if the rule is in addition tops-only, same-sided and individually rational with respect to the entitlements, then the preferences in the domain have to satisfy a variant of single-peakedness (referred to as multi-dimensional single-peakedness relative to the entitlements). We also provide a converse of this main finding. It turns out that this domain coincides with the one already identified in a general set up with public goods. We relate the domain of multi-dimensional single-peaked preferences relative to the entitlements to well-known restricted domains with private goods under which non-trivial and strategy-proof rules do exist.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考虑在多个私有物品需分配给一组具有权利的代理人且偏好表现出饱和性的设定下，作用于丰富偏好域上的策略性证明规则。我们证明，如果该规则还满足仅基于顶部、同侧性以及相对于权利的个人理性，则域中的偏好必须满足单峰性的一种变体（称为相对于权利的多维单峰性）。我们还提供了这一主要发现的逆命题。结果表明，该域与在公共物品的一般设定中已识别的域一致。我们将相对于权利的多维单峰偏好域与已知的私有物品受限域联系起来，在这些受限域中，非平凡且策略性证明的规则确实存在。

records.title_en: Taming selten's horse with impulse response
records.title_cn: 用脉冲响应驯服塞尔顿的马
records.abstract_en: The paper experimentally examines the predictive power of the trembling-hand perfect equilibrium concept in the three-player Game of Selten's Horse. At first sight, our data show little support of the trembling-hand perfect equilibrium and rather favor the imperfect equilibrium. We introduce deterministic impulse response trajectories that converge on the trembling-hand perfect equilibrium. The impulse response trajectories are remarkably close – closer than the trajectories from a reinforcement learning model – to the observed dynamics of the game in the short run (50 periods). The quantal response approach also converges on the trembling-hand perfect equilibrium as the error rates decline, suggesting that the trembling-hand perfect equilibrium may be reached in the long run. In the long run (up to 250 periods), however, behavior seems to settle at a non-equilibrium distribution of strategies that rather supports efficient outcomes, instead of converging to the trembling-hand perfect equilibrium.
records.abstract_cn: 本文通过实验检验了颤抖手完美均衡概念在三方塞尔顿马博弈中的预测力。乍一看，我们的数据对颤抖手完美均衡的支持甚少，反而更倾向于非完美均衡。我们引入了确定性脉冲响应轨迹，这些轨迹收敛于颤抖手完美均衡。脉冲响应轨迹与游戏短期（50期）观察到的动态非常接近——比强化学习模型的轨迹更为接近。随着错误率下降，量子响应方法也收敛于颤抖手完美均衡，这表明颤抖手完美均衡可能在长期内达到。然而，在长期（最多250期）中，行为似乎稳定在一种非均衡的策略分布上，这种分布更支持有效结果，而非收敛于颤抖手完美均衡。

records.title_en: Supermodularity and incentive reversal in teams
records.title_cn: 团队中的超模性与激励逆转
records.abstract_en: This paper takes a new look at the issue of incentive reversal in (strategic) team games, by relying on supermodularity techniques. In a setting with no contractual possibilities, we provide minimal sufficient conditions for one or both players to supply less effort in exogenously more productive environments, at the two extremal Nash equilibria. Unlike the existing literature, the analysis does not utilize concavity and other unnecessary assumptions and explicitly takes into account existence and possible multiplicity of pure-strategy Nash equilibria. We derive respective sufficient conditions for strong and weak incentive reversal for asymmetric games under strategic complementarity and substitutability respectively. We also consider incentive reversal for a broad class of symmetric games. These parsimonious conditions allow for a more transparent intuitive interpretation of the results.
records.abstract_cn: 本文通过依赖超模性技术，对（策略性）团队博弈中的激励逆转问题进行了新的审视。在无契约可能性的设定下，我们提供了在外部更具生产力的环境中，一个或两个参与者在两个极端纳什均衡下提供较少努力的最小充分条件。与现有文献不同，本分析不利用凹性及其他不必要的假设，并明确考虑了纯策略纳什均衡的存在性和可能的多重性。我们分别在战略互补和战略替代下，为非对称博弈的强激励逆转和弱激励逆转推导了相应的充分条件。我们还考虑了一类广泛的对称博弈中的激励逆转。这些简约的条件使得结果具有更透明的直观解释。

records.title_en: Efficient public good provision between and within groups
records.title_cn: 群体内与群体间的有效公共品供给
records.abstract_en: We generalize the model of Gallice and Monzón (2019) to incorporate a public goods game with groups, position uncertainty, and observational learning. Contributions are simultaneous within groups, but groups play sequentially based on their observation of an incomplete sample of past contributions. We show that full cooperation between and within groups is possible with self-interested players on a fixed horizon. Position uncertainty implies the existence of an equilibrium where groups of players conditionally cooperate in the hope of influencing further groups. Conditional cooperation implies that each group member is pivotal, so that efficient simultaneous provision within groups is an equilibrium.
records.abstract_cn: 我们将Gallice和Monzón（2019）的模型推广，纳入一个包含群体、位置不确定性和观察学习的公共品博弈。群体内部的贡献是同时进行的，但群体根据其对过去贡献的不完全样本的观察依次行动。我们证明，在固定时间范围内，自利玩家之间可以实现群体内和群体间的完全合作。位置不确定性意味着存在一个均衡，其中玩家群体以条件合作的方式行动，以期影响后续群体。条件合作意味着每个群体成员都是关键的，因此群体内的高效同时供给是一个均衡。

records.title_en: Asymptotic full revelation in cheap talk with many senders
records.title_cn: 多发送者廉价交谈中的渐近完全揭示
records.abstract_en: I construct an equilibrium in a cheap talk game with multiple senders that converges to full revelation exponentially fast as the number of senders increases. The senders' biases can be relatively large (comparable to the size of the state space) and have any signs. The equilibrium is robust to replacement noise and exists even if the senders can send only two types of messages.
records.abstract_cn: 我在一个多发送者的廉价交谈博弈中构建了一个均衡，该均衡随着发送者数量的增加以指数速度收敛到完全揭示。发送者的偏差可以相对较大（与状态空间的大小相当）且具有任意符号。该均衡对替换噪声具有稳健性，并且即使发送者只能发送两种类型的消息也存在。

records.title_en: Endogenous network formation in local public goods: An experimental analysis
records.title_cn: 地方公共品中的内生网络形成：一项实验分析
records.abstract_en: We experimentally explore public good production levels and the endogenous formation of network structures to facilitate output sharing among agents with heterogeneous production costs and consumption valuations. Results corroborate the key theoretical insights of Kinateder and Merlino (2017) characterizing how agents form core-periphery networks. However, subjects often produce more and form denser networks than predicted, which sometimes reduces efficiency. There is some tendency for behaviour to converge towards the theoretical equilibrium over repeated play. Our results help us understand the emergence of the law of the few in real-world networks, and suggest it is driven by endogenous sorting of heterogeneous agents.
records.abstract_cn: 我们通过实验探讨了公共品生产水平以及网络结构的内生形成，以促进具有异质性生产成本和消费估值的代理人之间的产出共享。结果证实了Kinateder和Merlino（2017）的关键理论见解，该理论描述了代理人如何形成核心-边缘网络。然而，受试者往往比预测生产更多并形成更密集的网络，这有时会降低效率。在重复博弈中，行为有趋向理论均衡的倾向。我们的结果有助于理解现实世界中“少数法则”的出现，并表明它是由异质性代理人的内生分类驱动的。

records.title_en: Foundation and identification of multi-attribute Shannon entropy
records.title_cn: 多属性香农熵的基础与识别
records.abstract_en: By weakening Shannon's original axioms to allow for attributes of the choice environment to differ in their associated learning costs, this paper provides an axiomatic foundation for Multi-Attribute Shannon Entropy, a natural multi-parameter generalization of Shannon Entropy. Sufficient conditions are also provided for a simple dataset that provides a closed-form solution for the Multi-Attribute Shannon Entropy cost function for information by analyzing stochastic choice data produced by a rationally inattentive agent that is picking between pairs of options when relatively few states of the world have a positive probability of being realized.
records.abstract_cn: 通过弱化香农原始公理以允许选择环境的属性具有不同的相关学习成本，本文为多属性香农熵提供了公理化基础，这是香农熵的一种自然多参数推广。本文还提供了简单数据集的充分条件，该数据集通过分析理性疏忽代理在相对较少的世界状态具有正实现概率时在成对选项之间进行选择的随机选择数据，为多属性香农熵的信息成本函数提供了闭式解。

records.title_en: NoteOptimal contracts under interpersonal projection
records.title_cn: 注记：人际投射下的最优契约
records.abstract_en: We study a moral hazard model where multiple agents exhibit interpersonal projection bias, perceiving their peers' production states as similar to their own. Each agent's production state is private information. We characterize optimal contracts with limited liability that induce effort from agents in a production state better than a given cutoff. When the cutoff is sufficiently low (high), relative (resp. joint) performance evaluation is optimal if individual outcomes are contractible despite the absence of common shocks and informational or technological externalities. By exploiting agents' biases, the principal reduces expected wages. However, if only joint outcomes are contractible, optimal wages may increase with the degree of projection bias.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一个道德风险模型，其中多个代理人表现出人际投射偏差，认为同伴的生产状态与自己的相似。每个代理人的生产状态是私人信息。我们刻画了在有限责任下诱导处于优于给定临界值的生产状态的代理人付出努力的最优契约。当临界值足够低（高）时，相对（分别地，联合）绩效评估是最优的，即使个体结果可契约化且不存在共同冲击或信息或技术外部性。通过利用代理人的偏差，委托人降低了预期工资。然而，如果只有联合结果可契约化，最优工资可能随着投射偏差的程度而增加。

records.title_en: Occupational segregation in a Roy model with composition preferences
records.title_cn: 具有构成偏好的罗伊模型中的职业隔离
records.abstract_en: We propose a model of labor market sector self-selection that combines comparative advantage, as in the Roy model, and sector composition preference. Two groups choose between two sectors based on heterogeneous potential incomes and group compositions in each sector. Potential incomes incorporate group specific human capital accumulation and wage discrimination. Composition preferences are interpreted as reflecting group specific amenity preferences as well as homophily and aversion to minority status. We show that occupational segregation is amplified by the composition preferences and we highlight a resulting tension between redistribution and diversity. The model also exhibits tipping from extreme compositions to more balanced ones. Tipping occurs when a small nudge, associated with affirmative action, pushes the system to a very different equilibrium, and when the set of equilibria changes abruptly when a parameter governing the relative importance of pecuniary and composition preferences crosses a threshold.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个劳动力市场部门自我选择模型，该模型结合了罗伊模型中的比较优势和部门构成偏好。两个群体根据异质的潜在收入和各部门的群体构成在两个部门之间进行选择。潜在收入包含群体特定的人力资本积累和工资歧视。构成偏好被解释为反映群体特定的便利偏好以及同质性和对少数群体地位的厌恶。我们表明，职业隔离被构成偏好放大，并强调了由此产生的再分配与多样性之间的张力。该模型还表现出从极端构成向更平衡构成的倾斜。当与平权行动相关的小推动将系统推向一个非常不同的均衡时，以及当控制金钱偏好和构成偏好相对重要性的参数跨越阈值时均衡集合突然改变时，就会发生倾斜。

records.title_en: Occupational segregation in a Roy model with composition preferences

records.abstract_en: We propose a model of labor market sector self-selection that combines comparative advantage, as in the Roy model, and sector composition preference. records.abstract_en: By weakening Shannon's original axioms to allow for attributes of the choice environment to differ in their associated learning costs, this paper provides an axiomatic foundation for Multi-Attribute Shannon Entropy, a natural multi-parameter generalization of Shannon Entropy. records.abstract_cn: 通过弱化香农原始公理以允许选择环境的属性具有不同的相关学习成本，本文为多属性香农熵提供了公理化基础，这是香农熵的一种自然多参数推广。本文还提供了简单数据集的充分条件，该数据集通过分析理性疏忽代理在相对较少的世界状态具有正实现概率时在成对选项之间进行选择的随机选择数据，为多属性香农熵的信息成本函数提供了闭式解。

records.title_en: NoteOptimal contracts under interpersonal projection

records.abstract_en: We study a moral hazard model where multiple agents exhibit interpersonal projection bias, perceiving their peers' production states as similar to their own. When the cutoff is sufficiently low (high), relative (resp. joint) performance evaluation is optimal if individual outcomes are contractible despite the absence of common shocks and informational or technological externalities. By exploiting agents' biases, the principal reduces expected wages. However, if only joint outcomes are contractible, optimal wages may increase with the degree of projection bias.
