To do so, we construct a micro–macro consistent wealth distribution by extending existing methodologies to integrate administrative pension fund balances into household wealth surveys using machine learning techniques. Our results reveal pronounced wealth concentration: the top 1% hold roughly one-third of total private wealth—levels comparable to those observed in the United States—driven by their disproportionate ownership of financial assets. By contrast, the bottom 50% hold 7–9%, primarily through housing and pension assets, shares that exceed those reported in most European countries. We also document a modest decline in wealth inequality over the period, particularly after 2016. A counterfactual analysis suggests that this decline reflects the interaction of two opposing forces: housing appreciation, which predominantly benefited the bottom 90% of households, and pension withdrawals, which reduced wealth across the distribution while relatively increasing inequality. Our findings on levels, trends, and counterfactuals are robust across alternative methodological specifications.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了2007至2021期间智利财富不平等的水平与动态，背景为私人养老金制度强制实施且政府住房政策以私人所有权为中心。我们关注二个主要宏观经济事件：2016年新建住房增值税出台后住房价格急剧上涨，以及近期疫情期间通过提前提取大规模清算养老金资产。为此，我们通过扩展现有方法，将行政养老金基金余额整合进家庭财富调查，并采用机器学习技术，构建微观-宏观一致的财富分布。结果显示财富高度集中：最顶端1%约持有全部私人财富的一-第三，水平与美国相当，主要源于其对金融资产的过度拥有。相比之下，底端50%主要通过住房和养老金资产持有7–9%，比例高于多数欧洲国家。我们还记录到该期间财富不平等略有下降，尤其是在2016之后。反事实分析表明，这一下降反映了二种相互作用的力量：住房升值主要惠及底端90%家庭，而养老金提取则在整个分布中减少财富并相对增加不平等。关于水平、趋势和反事实的发现在不同方法设定下均具有稳健性。

records.title_en: Ballots, budgets and bricks: Brexit and the polarisation of individual economic behaviours
records.title_cn: 选票、预算与砖块：脱欧与个人经济行为的极化
records.abstract_en: Does political polarisation influence actual economic behaviours? Using British nationally representative surveys and administrative data, we document how the Brexit referendum triggered stark divergences in individual micro and macro expectations between Leave and Remain supporters. Compared to existing research, we show how these polarising effects were driven by a specific policy issue and only marginally related to traditional partisan identities. We also demonstrate how these diverging beliefs influenced major real financial decisions. Leavers became more likely to purchase durable goods and engage in housing transactions, and areas with higher proportions of Leave voters experienced increased housing transaction volumes and rising prices.
records.abstract_cn: 政治极化是否影响实际经济行为？利用英国全国代表性调查和行政数据，我们记录了脱欧公投如何在Leave和Remain支持者之间引发了个人微观和宏观预期的显著分歧。与现有研究相比，我们展示了这些极化效应是由特定政策议题驱动的，并且与传统党派认同仅有边际相关。我们还证明了这些分歧信念如何影响了重大实际金融决策。Leave支持者更有可能购买耐用消费品并参与住房交易，而Leave投票者比例较高的地区经历了住房交易量增加和价格上涨。

records.title_en: Drain the swamp: A theory of anti-elite populism
records.title_cn: 清除腐败：反精英民粹主义理论
records.abstract_en: We study a model of popular demand for anti-elite populist reforms that drain the swamp: replace experienced public servants with novices who will only acquire experience with time. Voters benefit from experienced public servants because they are more effective at delivering public goods and more competent at detecting emergency threats. However, public servants’ policy preferences do not always align with those of voters. This tradeoff produces two key forces in our model: public servants’ incompetence spurs disagreement between them and voters, and their effectiveness grants them more power to dictate policy. Both of these effects fuel mistrust between voters and public servants, sometimes inducing voters to drain the swamp in cycles of anti-elite populism. We study which factors can sustain a responsive democracy or induce a technocracy. When populism arises, we discuss which reforms may reduce the frequency of populist cycles, including the recruitment of public servants and isolating them from politics. Our results support the view that a more inclusive and representative bureaucracy protects against anti-elite populism.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一个关于反精英民粹主义改革需求的模型，这种改革旨在清除腐败：用新手替换有经验的公务员，而新手只有随着时间才能获得经验。选民受益于有经验的公务员，因为他们在提供公共品和识别紧急威胁方面更有效、更有能力。然而，公务员的政策偏好并不总是与选民一致。这种权衡在我们的模型中产生了关键力量：公务员的无能加剧了他们与选民之间的分歧，而他们的有效性又赋予他们更多制定政策的权力。这两种效应都加剧了选民与公务员之间的不信任，有时会导致选民周期性地清除腐败，形成反精英民粹主义循环。我们研究了哪些因素可以维持一个有响应性的民主或导致技术官僚制。当民粹主义出现时，我们讨论了哪些改革可以减少民粹主义循环的频率，包括公务员的招聘以及将他们与政治隔离。我们的结果支持这样一种观点：更具包容性和代表性的官僚体系能够防止反精英民粹主义。

records.title_en: Distributional tax analysis in theory and practice: Harberger meets Diamond-Mirrlees
records.title_cn: 理论与实践中的税收分布分析：Harberger与Diamond-Mirrlees的对话
records.abstract_en: This paper proposes a new framework to study the distribution of current taxes and the effects of tax reforms. For current taxes, labor taxes are assigned to the corresponding workers, capital taxes to the corresponding asset owners, and consumption taxes to the corresponding consumers. Current taxes capture the wedges between pre-tax prices (relevant for production) and after-tax prices (relevant for the work, saving, and consumption decisions of households) as well as the direct equity effects of taxes while being silent about efficiency. Our method does not require structural assumptions, is internally consistent, and maximizes the comparability of tax progressivity and inequality over time and across countries. Applying this methodology to the United States, we find that the effective tax rate of the top 1% has declined from about 50% in the early 1950s to 32% in 2021. It is through the corporate tax that a high degree of tax progressivity was achieved in the middle of the 20th century. To analyze the distributional effects of tax reforms, mechanical changes in tax liability by income groups and aggregate revenue effects due to household (but not firms’) behavioral responses are sufficient statistics in the neoclassical optimal tax model of Diamond and Mirrlees (1971). The effects of taxes on pre-tax prices at the heart of classical tax incidence analysis are normatively irrelevant.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一个新的框架，用于研究现行税收的分布及税收改革的影响。对于现行税收，劳动税分配给相应的工人，资本税分配给相应的资产所有者，消费税分配给相应的消费者。现行税收反映了税前价格（与生产相关）与税后价格（与家庭的工作、储蓄和消费决策相关）之间的楔子，以及税收的直接公平效应，但对效率保持沉默。我们的方法不需要结构性假设，内部一致，并最大化了税收累进性和不平等在不同时间和国家之间的可比性。将该方法应用于美国，我们发现顶层1%的有效税率从50%的早期1950下降到32%的2021。正是通过公司税，在20世纪中期实现了高度的税收累进性。为了分析税收改革的分布效应，按照收入组的税负机械变化和由于家庭（但非企业）行为反应导致的总收入效应，是Diamond和Mirrlees（1971）新古典最优税收模型中的充分统计量。税收对税前价格的影响——这是经典税收归宿分析的核心——在规范上并不相关。

records.title_en: The effect of emergency financial assistance on employment and earnings
records.title_cn: 紧急经济援助对就业和收入的影响
records.abstract_en: We examine the labor supply effects of short-term income transfers for families experiencing a housing crisis. We link callers to an emergency assistance homelessness prevention hotline to their federal tax records and measure their earnings in the years surrounding their calls. Our methodology exploits quasi-random variation in the availability of assistance to compare similar families receiving and not receiving funds. Looking up to four years post-assistance, we find evidence, especially for the lowest earners, of earnings gains, and overall we find no evidence that assistance lowers earnings. Our results indicate that any income effect of temporary transfers for those in crisis is minimal and that these targeted transfers may convey labor market benefits for the poorest of the poor.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考察了针对遭遇住房危机家庭的短期收入转移对劳动供给的影响。我们将拨打紧急援助防止无家可归热线的来电者与其联邦税务记录进行关联，并测量他们在来电前后几年的收入。我们的方法利用援助可得性的准随机变化，比较获得和未获得资金的类似家庭。在援助后最长四年内，我们发现，尤其是最低收入者，存在收入增长的证据，整体上未发现援助降低收入的证据。我们的结果表明，对于处于危机中的人群，临时转移支付的收入效应极小，这些有针对性的转移可能为最贫困者带来劳动力市场上的益处。

records.title_en: Formalizing microentrepreneurs through targeted tax systems: Evidence from Brazil
records.title_cn: 通过有针对性的税收制度使微型企业家正规化：来自巴西的证据
records.abstract_en: We study the effects of reducing formalization costs by exploiting the introduction of a simplified tax regime for microentrepreneurs in Brazil. Using novel administrative data and industry-level eligibility criteria, we show that a large reduction in entry and compliance costs significantly increased formal firm creation. Despite the increase in formalization, newly formal firms exhibit no growth or earnings gains. We then evaluate the new tax system’s fiscal consequences, showing that the expansion in social security coverage generated costs that exceed the additional tax revenue collected by 2.56 times. These costs arise as microentrepreneurs gain access to subsidized contributory benefits after registering through the system, highlighting the broader social value of bringing microentrepreneurs into the formal sector even in the absence of positive government net revenue or improvements in firm performance.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了通过为巴西微型企业家引入简化税收制度来降低正规化成本的效果。使用新颖的管理数据和行业级别的资格标准，我们表明，进入和合规成本的大幅降低显着增加了正式公司的创建。尽管正规化程度有所提高，但新成立的正规公司并没有表现出增长或盈利增长。然后，我们评估了新税收制度的财政后果，结果表明，社会保障覆盖面的扩大所产生的成本超过了 2.56 倍征收的额外税收收入。这些成本是随着微型企业家在通过系统注册后获得补贴的缴款福利而产生的，这凸显了即使在政府净收入不为正或公司业绩没有改善的情况下，将微型企业家引入正规部门所具有的更广泛的社会价值。

records.title_en: Choosing (not) to choose: Uncovering intrinsic preferences for choice autonomy
records.title_cn: 选择（不）选择：揭示选择自主权的内在偏好
records.abstract_en: Personal autonomy has been argued to be fundamental to well-being and is often discussed as an important driver of economic and political behavior. However, preferences for autonomy remain poorly understood. We propose a novel elicitation method for an individual’s intrinsic preference for choice autonomy that fully controls for instrumental value benefits of choice. We show that, while a majority of subjects in our experiment display a preference for choice autonomy, a significant minority is averse to their own choice.
records.abstract_cn: 个人自主权被认为是福祉的基础，并且经常被视为经济和政治行为的重要驱动力。然而，人们对自治的偏好仍然知之甚少。我们针对个人对选择自主权的内在偏好提出了一种新颖的启发方法，该方法完全控制选择的工具价值收益。我们表明，虽然我们实验中的大多数受试者表现出对选择自主权的偏好，但仍有相当少数人反对自己的选择。

records.title_en: A quantitative urban model for transport appraisal
records.title_cn: 用于交通评估的定量城市模型
records.abstract_en: Transport cost-benefit analysis (CBA) has evolved since its inception to become one of the most influential and ubiquitous applications of microeconomic theory, shaping billions of dollars of investment in the infrastructure sector. A key limitation of transport appraisal practice is its reliance on partial equilibrium (PE) models, which restricts the ability to quantify potentially transformative impacts outside the transport market. In this paper, we build on the principles of quantitative spatial economics and design an appraisal method that integrates the causal estimation of key parameters into an invertible spatial general equilibrium (SGE) model. Our specification yields travel time valuations that are micro-founded through an explicit leisure–labour trade-off, making them unique to each residence–workplace pair. We decompose the aggregate welfare change in SGE into direct user benefits and wider economic impacts, quantify the statistical uncertainty surrounding each welfare component, and compare the welfare estimates in SGE with those of the mainstream PE method. As a case study, we replicate Greater London with 983 spatial units. We find that the welfare result in SGE is similar in magnitude to the PE CBA outcome in the case of the Elizabeth Line, a major urban rail project. For a series of randomly simulated transport improvements, the two approaches scale proportionately, but the occasional project-specific deviations can be substantial. The paper illustrates that the SGE approach complements aggregate welfare estimates with a detailed spatial pattern of local economic outcomes and is well suited to assessing transport and land-use policies simultaneously.
records.abstract_cn: 交通成本效益分析（CBA）自诞生以来，已成为微观经济学理论最具影响力和最广泛应用的领域之一，影响着基础设施领域数十亿美元的投资。交通评估实践的一个关键局限是其依赖于局部均衡（PE）模型，这限制了量化交通市场之外潜在变革性影响的能力。本文基于定量空间经济学原理，设计了一种将关键参数因果估计整合到可逆空间一般均衡（SGE）模型中的评估方法。我们的模型设定通过明确的休闲—劳动权衡微观基础化了出行时间价值，使其对每个居住—工作地点对都是独特的。我们将SGE中的总福利变化分解为直接用户收益和更广泛的经济影响，量化每个福利组成部分的统计不确定性，并将SGE中的福利估计与主流PE方法进行比较。作为案例研究，我们以983个空间单元复现了大伦敦。我们发现，在伊丽莎白线这一主要城市轨道项目的案例中，SGE的福利结果与PE CBA结果在数量级上相似。对于一系列随机模拟的交通改善，二方法呈比例扩展，但偶尔出现的项目特定偏差可能相当显著。本文表明，SGE方法通过详细的地方经济结果空间分布补充了总福利估计，并且非常适合同时评估交通和土地利用政策。

records.title_en: Using price incentives to bound welfare from pay as you go solar electricity
records.title_cn: 利用价格激励界定按需付费太阳能电力的福利效应
records.abstract_en: Quantifying the welfare effects of rural electrification is often hindered by non-price barriers that depress demand at the adoption margin. I study demand for pay-as-you-go (PAYGo) solar using a randomized experiment with 800 existing PAYGo customers in Kenya and Rwanda post-adoption. The experiment randomly assigns incentives that lower the effective price of usage for consumers who meet monthly purchase thresholds. Although average demand is unchanged, consumers with the highest pre-experimental demand increase their purchases by 6–7% in response to the incentive. I use these responses to estimate a lower bound on consumer surplus from PAYGo solar. I find large gains for high-demand consumers, but benefits deteriorate substantially for low-demand consumers. Combining my estimates with evidence from the literature on the environmental externalities of solar home systems, I calculate that the marginal value of public funds for PAYGo solar subsidies is at most 1.7 in Kenya and 2 in Rwanda.
records.abstract_cn: 农村电气化的福利效应量化常常受到非价格障碍的影响，这些障碍在采纳边际抑制了需求。本文通过对肯尼亚和卢旺达现有按需付费（PAYGo）太阳能客户进行随机实验，研究了PAYGo太阳能的需求，实验对象为800名已采纳PAYGo的客户。实验随机分配激励措施，降低达到月度购买门槛的消费者的实际使用价格。尽管平均需求未发生变化，但前期实验需求最高的消费者在激励下将购买量提高了6至7%。作者利用这些反应估算了PAYGo太阳能消费者剩余的下限。结果显示高需求消费者获得了显著福利增益，但低需求消费者的福利效益大幅下降。结合作者的估算与太阳能家用系统环境外部性的文献证据，计算得出PAYGo太阳能补贴的公共资金边际价值在肯尼亚最多为1.7，在卢旺达最多为2。

records.title_en: Two-faced on facebook: Ad tailoring in U.S. house campaigns
records.title_cn: 二在Facebook上的表现：美国众议院竞选中的广告定制
records.abstract_en: Congressional candidates simultaneously seek votes from local residents and money from partisan potential donors who live across the United States. Ad targeting allows political candidates an inexpensive way not only to reach this dispersed partisan audience but also to deliver messages tailored to donors, whose preferences are more extreme than voters’. Using data on geographically-targeted Facebook ads, I find that the national ads of Democratic and Republican candidates have less issue overlap — and are more extreme — than their local, voter-targeted ads. Candidates’ ability to direct tailored, extreme communication to receptive audiences via targeted ads facilitates divergent political speech.
records.abstract_cn: 国会候选人同时寻求来自当地居民的选票和来自全美各地党派潜在捐赠者的资金。广告定向不仅为政治候选人提供了一种低成本的方式来接触分散的党派受众，还能向捐赠者传递定制信息，而捐赠者的偏好比选民更为极端。利用地理定向Facebook广告的数据，我发现民主党和共和党候选人的全国性广告在议题重叠度上较低，并且比面向当地选民的广告更为极端。候选人通过定向广告向接受度高的受众传递定制且极端的信息的能力，促进了政治言论的分化。

records.title_en: The employment effects of disability benefit reassessment
records.title_cn: 残疾福利重新评估的就业效应
records.abstract_en: We study the consequences of a large-scale reassessment of the health and working capacity of disability insurance beneficiaries in Hungary. Leveraging birthday and health cutoffs in the reassessment, we estimate employment responses to the threat of disability benefit loss and the actual termination or reduction of benefits. We show that due to the threat of benefit removal, many beneficiaries stopped working after the reassessment was announced but before it took place. Another group of beneficiaries lost their benefits and increased their labor supply significantly. Overall, the reassessment had a negative short-term and neutral medium-term impact on employment and earnings. Our results suggest that unintended responses to the threat of benefit loss operate as a substitution effect that can reduce labor supply even without binding formal earnings limits, and thus should be considered in the design of reassessments.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了匈牙利对残疾保险受益人健康和工作能力的大规模重新评估的后果。利用重新评估中的生日和健康标准，我们估算了对残疾福利丧失威胁以及福利实际终止或减少的就业反应。我们发现，由于福利取消的威胁，许多受益人在重新评估宣布后但尚未实施前停止了工作。另一部分受益人失去了福利，并显著增加了劳动供给。总体来看，重新评估对就业和收入的短期影响为负，中期影响为中性。我们的结果表明，对福利丧失威胁的非预期反应作为替代效应发挥作用，即使没有正式的收入限制，也可能减少劳动供给，因此在重新评估设计中应予以考虑。

records.title_en: The (fiscal) dividend of infrastructure: Roads and revenues in Rwanda
records.title_cn: （财政）基础设施红利：卢旺达的公路与税收
records.abstract_en: This paper shows that infrastructure investments enhance local tax outcomes. Drawing on a novel dataset combining information on the location and timing of all road upgrades in Rwanda with 12 years of administrative tax and census records, we estimate large and significant increases in tax revenues in municipalities near upgraded roads. These effects are driven by firm entry as well as land value appreciation, captured through taxes on rental income at the local level. Finally, we show that while the additional revenues do not fully recover the central government’s initial investment, local municipalities’ revenues more than double within five years following the upgrades.
records.abstract_cn: 本文表明，基础设施投资能够提升地方税收绩效。基于一套新颖的数据集，将卢旺达所有公路升级的地理位置与时间信息与12年行政税收及人口普查记录相结合，我们估算出靠近升级公路的市政当局税收出现了大幅且显著的增长。这一效应主要由企业进入以及土地价值提升所驱动，后者通过地方层面的租金收入税得以体现。最后，我们发现，尽管新增税收未能完全覆盖中央政府的初始投资，但地方市政当局的税收在升级后五年内增长超过一倍。

records.title_en: Training, Communications Patterns, and Spillovers inside Organizations
records.title_cn: 培训、沟通模式与组织内部溢出效应
records.abstract_en: This paper examines how training affects productivity across hierarchical layers within organizations. After a randomized training program for frontline employees at a government agency, trained workers’ output increased while their requests for managerial assistance fell. This freed managers to focus on strategic tasks—particularly managers with the strongest connections to trained employees. A structural model of organizational hierarchy shows that spillovers to managers account for approximately 45% of the program’s total benefits, indicating that evaluations focused solely on individual trainees may substantially understate the full value of training investments.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了培训如何影响组织内不同层级的生产率。在对某政府机构一线员工进行随机培训项目后，受训员工的产出提升，同时他们对管理层的协助请求减少。这使得管理者能够将更多精力集中于战略性任务，尤其是与受训员工联系最紧密的管理者。组织层级的结构模型显示，管理者的溢出效应约占项目总收益的45%，表明仅关注个体受训者的评估可能会大幅低估培训投资的整体价值。

records.title_en: A Method to Estimate Discrete Choice Models That Is Robust to Consumer Search
records.title_cn: 一种对消费者搜索具有稳健性的离散选择模型估计方法
records.abstract_en: We state conditions under which choice data suffice to identify preferences when consumers may not be fully informed about attributes of goods. Our approach can be used to test for full information, forecast how consumers will respond to information, and conduct welfare analysis when consumers are imperfectly informed. In a lab experiment, we successfully forecast the average response to new information when consumers engage in costly search. In data from Expedia, our method identifies which attribute was not immediately visible to consumers in search results and allows us to compute the value of additional information.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了在消费者可能对商品属性并非完全知情的情况下，仅凭选择数据即可识别偏好的条件。我们的方法可用于检验完全信息、预测消费者对信息的反应，并在消费者信息不完全时进行福利分析。在一项实验室实验中，当消费者进行有成本的搜索时，我们成功预测了其对新信息的平均反应。在Expedia的数据中，我们的方法识别出搜索结果中消费者未能立即看到的属性，并使我们能够计算额外信息的价值。

records.title_en: The Macroeconomic Consequences of Early Childhood Development Policies
records.title_cn: 早期儿童发展政策的宏观经济后果
records.abstract_en: To study long-run large-scale early childhood policies, this paper incorporates early childhood investments into a general equilibrium heterogeneous agent overlapping generations model calibrated using US data. A randomized controlled trial evaluation of a short-run small-scale early childhood program in the model predicts effects on children’s education and income that are similar to the empirical evidence. A long-run large-scale program, however, yields over twice as large welfare gains as those of a short-run small-scale program even after considering general equilibrium and taxation effects. Key to this difference is that investing in a child not only improves her skills but also creates better ancestors for future generations.
records.abstract_cn: 为研究长期、大规模的早期儿童政策，本文将早期儿童投资纳入一个基于美国数据校准的异质性代理人重叠世代一般均衡模型。模型中对短期、小规模早期儿童项目的随机对照试验评估预测了对儿童教育和收入的影响，与实证证据相似。然而，长期、大规模项目即使考虑一般均衡和税收效应，其福利增益也超过短期、小规模项目的两倍。造成这一差异的关键在于，对儿童的投资不仅提升其技能，还为未来世代创造更优的祖先。

records.title_en: The Zero-Beta Interest Rate
records.title_cn: 零贝塔利率
records.abstract_en: We use equity returns to construct a time-varying measure of the zero-beta interest rate: the expected return of a stock portfolio orthogonal to the stochastic discount factor. In contrast to safe rates, the zero-beta rate fits the aggregate consumption Euler equation remarkably well both unconditionally and conditional on monetary policy shocks and is high, volatile, and persistent enough to explain the average return and most of the volatility of the market portfolio. The puzzle is why safe rates are so low, stable, and disconnected from both consumption and the zero-beta rate.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用股票收益率构建了一个随时间变化的零贝塔利率度量：即与随机贴现因子正交的股票投资组合的预期收益率。与无风险利率相比，零贝塔利率无论在无条件还是在货币政策冲击条件下，都能非常好地拟合总体消费的欧拉方程，并且其水平较高、波动性大且具有持续性，足以解释市场投资组合的平均收益和大部分波动性。令人困惑的是，无风险利率为何如此低、稳定，并且与消费和零贝塔利率都脱节。

records.title_en: Financial Aid and Upward Mobility: Evidence from Colombia’s Ser Pilo Paga
records.title_cn: 助学金与向上流动：来自哥伦比亚“Ser Pilo Paga”项目的证据
records.abstract_en: We study the impact of financial aid on upward mobility. We estimate the causal impacts of a Colombian policy targeting high-achieving, low-socioeconomic-status students on later-life educational and labor market outcomes. Using regression discontinuity design, difference-in-differences, and population-wide administrative microdata, we find that the policy boosted attendance and completion at high-value-added colleges, particularly in STEM fields. Improved college quality led to greater skill development. Nine years later, recipients earn 18 log points more and are more likely to reach the top 1%. The policy narrowed socioeconomic gaps in college quality, attainment, skill development, earnings, and returns to ability, improving equity and efficiency.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究助学金对向上流动的影响。我们估计哥伦比亚一项针对高成就、低社会经济地位学生的政策对其后期教育和劳动力市场结果的因果影响。采用回归不连续设计、双重差分方法以及覆盖全体人口的行政微观数据，我们发现该政策提升了学生在高增值高校，尤其是STEM领域的入学率和毕业率。高校质量的提升带来了更高的技能发展。九年后，受益者的收入高出18个对数点，并且更有可能进入收入前1%。该政策缩小了社会经济地位在高校质量、学历、技能发展、收入和能力回报方面的差距，提升了公平性和效率。

records.title_en: The Gas Trap: Outcompeting Coal versus Renewables
records.title_cn: 天然气陷阱：与煤炭和可再生能源的竞争
records.abstract_en: We analyze a fundamental dilemma and time-inconsistency problem facing climate-concerned producers of natural gas. In the short term, it is tempting to produce more to outcompete coal. When this policy is anticipated, however, investments in renewables fall and emissions may ultimately increase. When the gas producers cannot precommit, their policies can be counterproductive. A simulated version applied to Europe verifies that the gas trap is quantitatively important. We discuss the robustness of this result and possible solutions, ranging from direct investments in renewables to taxes on the search and exploration of gas.
records.abstract_cn: 我们分析了关注气候的天然气生产商所面临的一个基本困境和时间不一致性问题。短期内，增加产量以击败煤炭具有诱惑力。然而，当这一政策被预期时，可再生能源的投资会下降，排放最终可能增加。当天然气生产商无法事先承诺时，其政策可能适得其反。应用于欧洲的模拟结果验证了天然气陷阱在量化上具有重要意义。我们讨论了这一结果的稳健性及可能的解决方案，包括直接投资可再生能源和对天然气勘探征税等。

records.title_en: The Origin of the State: Land Productivity or Appropriability? A Comment
records.title_cn: 国家起源：土地生产率还是可攫取性？——评论
records.abstract_en: Mayshar, Moav, and Pascali apply an instrumental variables identification strategy to data from nearly 1,000 societies included in the Ethnographic Atlas to claim that cultivation of cereals (appropriable by elites), rather than increased land productivity following the adoption of agriculture, led to the development of the state. We show two things. (1) Evidence for the appropriability theory holds when moving from a tribe-chiefdom to a state and not more broadly. (2) Conclusions are driven by a handful of outliers with statistical significance at the 10% level lost with winsorization at 2.1% (or trimming at 1.2%) of locations by cereal advantage.
records.abstract_cn: Mayshar、Moav和Pascali利用工具变量识别策略，分析《民族志图谱》收录的近1,000个社会，认为与农业出现后土地生产率提高相比，精英能够攫取的谷物种植更能解释国家的形成。本文提出两点修正：（1）可攫取性理论的证据只适用于从部落酋邦向国家转变的情形，并不具有更普遍的解释力；（2）结论主要由少数离群值驱动。当按谷物优势对地点进行2.1%的缩尾处理（或1.2%的截尾处理）后，其在10%水平上的统计显著性消失。

records.title_en: Semiparametric Bayesian estimation in an ordinal probit model with application to life satisfaction across countries, age and gender
records.title_cn: 基于半参数贝叶斯估计的有序Probit模型及其在国家、年龄和性别间生活满意度的应用
records.abstract_en: We employ a novel semiparametric Bayesian ordinal probit model to re-examine the relationships between age and life satisfaction (“happiness”) across countries and gender. Within our ordinal choice framework we introduce a new scheme for cutpoint simulation and develop a locally adaptive method for smoothing an otherwise erratic collection of age dummy variable coefficients. We find strong evidence that employment status is deeply intertwined with the reported happiness of men, that employment status is relatively more important for men than it is for women, and that the common use of quadratic models to report ages when happiness is minimized can produce inference that is inaccurate and misleadingly precise. We also find evidence that refines the “U”-shaped pattern between age and happiness that has been reported and/or debated in this literature: For men in most of the European countries we consider, happiness is found to rise sharply before traditional retirement age and then into the beginning of retirement, followed by a flattening or decline in the right-tail of the age distribution. Often-used models that are quadratic in age fail to reproduce this pattern and are frequently at odds with the data.
records.abstract_cn: 我们采用一种新颖的半参数贝叶斯有序Probit模型重新审视了不同国家和性别间年龄与生活满意度（“幸福感”）之间的关系。在我们的有序选择框架中，我们引入了一种新的切点模拟方案，并开发了一种局部自适应方法来平滑原本不规则的年龄虚拟变量系数集合。我们发现，男性的就业状态与其报告的幸福感密切相关，且就业状态对男性的重要性相对高于女性，并且常用的二次模型在报告幸福感最小化的年龄时可能产生不准确且误导性精确的推断。我们还发现了一些证据，进一步细化了文献中报告和/或讨论的年龄与幸福感之间的“U”型模式：在我们考虑的大多数欧洲国家中，男性的幸福感在传统退休年龄之前和刚开始退休时急剧上升，随后在年龄分布的右尾部分趋于平稳或下降。常用的关于年龄的二次模型未能重现这一模式，并且常常与数据相悖。

records.title_en: Weak-instrument-robust subvector inference in instrumental variables regression: A subvector Lagrange multiplier test and properties of subvector Anderson-Rubin confidence sets
records.title_cn: 工具变量回归中的弱工具鲁棒子向量推理：子向量拉格朗日乘子检验和子向量Anderson-Rubin置信集的属性
records.abstract_en: We propose a weak-instrument-robust subvector Lagrange multiplier test for instrumental variables regression. We show that it is asymptotically size-correct under a technical condition or as the number of instruments grows to infinity. This is the first weak-instrument-robust subvector test for instrumental variables regression to recover the degrees of freedom of the commonly used non-weak-instrument-robust Wald test. Additionally, we provide a closed-form solution for subvector confidence sets obtained by inverting the subvector Anderson-Rubin test. We show that they are centered around a k-class estimator. We show that the subvector confidence sets for single coefficients of the causal parameter are jointly bounded if and only if Anderson’s likelihood-ratio test rejects the null hypothesis that the first-stage regression parameter is of reduced rank, that is, that the causal parameter is not identified. Finally, we show that if a confidence set obtained by inverting the Anderson-Rubin test is bounded and nonempty, it is equal to a Wald-based confidence set with a data-dependent confidence level. We explicitly compute this Wald-based confidence set and its confidence level.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种用于工具变量回归的弱工具鲁棒子向量拉格朗日乘数检验。我们证明，在技术条件下或随着仪器数量增长到无穷大，它是渐近尺寸正确的。这是第一个用于工具变量回归的弱工具鲁棒子向量检验，以恢复常用的非弱工具鲁棒 Wald 检验的自由度。此外，我们还为通过反转子向量 Anderson-Rubin 测试获得的子向量置信集提供了封闭式解决方案。我们证明它们以 k 类估计器为中心。我们证明，当且仅当安德森的似然比检验拒绝第一阶段回归参数降序的零假设（即因果参数未识别）时，因果参数的单个系数的子向量置信集才是联合有界的。最后，我们证明，如果通过反转 Anderson-Rubin 检验获得的置信集是有界且非空的，则它等于具有数据相关置信水平的基于 Wald 的置信集。我们明确计算这个基于 Wald 的置信集及其置信水平。

records.title_en: Large Bayesian matrix autoregressions
records.title_cn: 大型贝叶斯矩阵自回归
records.abstract_en: High-dimensional matrix-valued time-series are increasingly common in economics and finance. Prominent examples include large cross-region panels and dynamic economic networks. As the dimensions of the matrix grow, conventional approaches based on vector autoregressions—implemented by vectoring the matrix-valued data—become computationally infeasible. We introduce a class of large Bayesian matrix autoregressions (BMARs) that can accommodate time-varying volatility, non-Gaussian errors and COVID-19 outliers. To tackle parameter proliferation, we propose Minnesota-type shrinkage priors on the MAR coefficients. We develop a unified approach for estimating this class of models, which scales well to high dimensions. The empirical relevance of these new BMARs is illustrated using a US state-level dataset that contains 6 macroeconomic times-series for each of the 50 states, with a total of 300 times-series.
records.abstract_cn: 高维矩阵值时间序列在经济学和金融中越来越常见。显著的例子包括大型跨区域面板和动态经济网络。随着矩阵维度的增加，基于向量自回归的传统方法——通过将矩阵值数据向量化实现——变得在计算上不可行。我们引入了一类大型贝叶斯矩阵自回归（BMARs），可以适应时间变化的波动性、非高斯误差和COVID-19异常值。为了解决参数膨胀问题，我们对MAR系数提出了明尼苏达型收缩先验。我们开发了一种统一的方法来估计这一类模型，该方法在高维情况下表现良好。这些新BMARs的实证相关性通过使用一个包含6宏观经济时间序列的美国州级数据集进行说明，该数据集涵盖了50个州，共有300个时间序列。

records.title_en: Semi-nonparametric models of multidimensional matching: An optimal transport approach
records.title_cn: 多维匹配的半非参数模型：一种最优传输方法
records.abstract_en: This paper develops a set of empirically tractable and flexible sieve estimators for semi-nonparametric multidimensional matching models with transferable utility, focusing on worker-job matching. We generalize the parametric quadratic-Gaussian framework employed by Bojilov and Galichon (2016) and Lindenlaub (2017), which relies on joint normality of observed characteristics. We allow unrestricted distributions of characteristics and show identification of the production technology and the equilibrium wage and matching functions using optimal transport theory. Given identification, we propose efficient, consistent, and asymptotically normal sieve estimators. We revisit Lindenlaub’s empirical application and show that, between 1990 and 2010, the U.S. economy experienced much larger technological progress favoring cognitive abilities than the original findings suggest. Furthermore, our flexible model specifications provide a significantly better fit for patterns in the evolution of wage inequality.
records.abstract_cn: 本文针对具有可转移效用的半非参数多维匹配模型，开发了一套经验上易于处理且灵活的筛子估计量，重点关注工人-工作匹配。我们推广了Bojilov和Galichon（2016）以及Lindenlaub（2017）所采用的参数二次高斯框架，该框架依赖于观测特征的联合正态性。我们允许特征分布不受限制，并利用最优传输理论证明了生产技术以及均衡工资和匹配函数的可识别性。在识别的基础上，我们提出了有效、一致且渐近正态的筛子估计量。我们重新审视了Lindenlaub的实证应用，并表明，在1990至2010年间，美国经济经历了比原始发现所暗示的更大的有利于认知能力的技术进步。此外，我们的灵活模型设定对工资不平等演变模式的拟合显著更好。

records.title_en: Deviance Information Criterion for Bayesian model selection: Theoretical justification and applications
records.title_cn: 贝叶斯模型选择的偏差信息准则：理论依据与应用
records.abstract_en: This paper provides a theoretical justification for the Deviance Information Criterion (DIC) as a Bayesian model selection tool using MCMC output. Unlike Akaike Information Criterion (AIC) and Bayesian Information Criterion (BIC), which balance model adequacy against complexity without considering prior information, DIC incorporates priors into this trade-off. The contributions of this paper are two-fold. First, it demonstrates that when a plug-in predictive distribution — obtained by substituting parameter values with their optimal estimates to yield the plug-in estimated sampling distribution — is used under a set of regularity conditions, the DIC serves as an asymptotically unbiased estimator of the expected Kullback–Leibler divergence between the data-generating process and the plug-in predictive distribution. Second, it develops higher-order expansions for DIC and the effective number of parameters, highlighting the effect of the priors. We employ DIC to compare discrete-choice models, stochastic frontier models, and copula models in three empirical applications; the results align with theoretical expectations, showing the utility of DIC as a versatile tool outperforming the traditional model selection criteria. It is found that the logit model is better than the probit model for investigating the marginal effects of parents’ education on children’s completion of high school. Additionally, the stochastic frontier model with an exponential distribution better fits electricity utility data than the normal distribution. Finally, the chosen copula models for S&P index returns exhibit heavy tails and strong tail dependence. By modelling the effect of priors through higher order expansions, we also find the above empirical models outperforming their benchmark counterparts in terms of predictive accuracy.
records.abstract_cn: 本文为偏差信息准则（DIC）作为贝叶斯模型选择工具的理论依据提供了支持，使用MCMC输出。与阿卡伊克信息准则（AIC）和贝叶斯信息准则（BIC）不同，后者在不考虑先验信息的情况下平衡模型适 adequacy与复杂性，DIC将先验信息纳入这一权衡中。本文的贡献为二-fold。第一，本文证明，当在一组正则条件下使用通过将参数值替换为其最优估计值以获得插件估计采样分布的插件预测分布时，DIC作为数据生成过程与插件预测分布之间的期望Kullback-Leibler散度的渐近无偏估计量。第二，本文为DIC和有效参数数量发展了高阶展开，突出了先验的影响。我们在三的实证应用中使用DIC比较离散选择模型、随机前沿模型和copula模型；结果与理论预期一致，显示DIC作为一种多功能工具的效用，优于传统模型选择标准。研究发现，logit模型在研究父母教育对孩子高中毕业的边际效应时优于probit模型。此外，具有指数分布的随机前沿模型比正态分布更好地拟合电力公用事业数据。最后，选择的S&P指数收益的copula模型表现出重尾和强尾依赖性。通过高阶展开建模先验的影响，我们还发现上述实证模型在预测准确性方面优于其基准对应物。

records.title_en: Treatment effects with targeting instruments
records.title_cn: 目标工具下的处理效应
records.abstract_en: Multivalued treatments are commonplace in applications. We explore the use of discrete-valued instruments to control for selection bias in this setting. Our discussion revolves around the concept of targeting: which instruments target which treatments. It allows us to establish conditions under which counterfactual averages and treatment effects are point- or partially-identified for composite complier groups. We explore the additional identifying power of a positive selection assumption. We illustrate its usefulness by revisiting the findings of Kline and Walters (2016) on the Head Start Impact Study. We derive informative bounds that suggest less beneficial effects of Head Start expansions than their parametric estimates.
records.abstract_cn: 多值处理在应用中很常见。我们探讨在此设定下使用离散值工具来控制选择偏差。我们的讨论围绕目标定位的概念展开：哪些工具针对哪些处理。这使我们能够建立条件，在这些条件下，反事实平均值和处理效应对于复合编译器组是点识别或部分识别的。我们探讨了正选择假设的额外识别力。我们通过重新审视Kline和Walters（2016）关于“启智计划影响研究”的发现来说明其有用性。我们推导出信息丰富的边界，这些边界表明启智计划扩展的益处比他们的参数估计所显示的更小。

records.title_en: A Bayesian approach to modeling economic growth: Variable selection and cross-sectional dependence
records.title_cn: 一种贝叶斯经济增长建模方法：变量选择与横截面依赖性
records.abstract_en: This paper introduces a Bayesian framework designed to address two critical econometric challenges in empirical growth studies: variable selection and cross-sectional dependence. We first propose a growth regression model that incorporates cross-sectional dependence through a multi-factor structure and accounts for variable selection with sparse coefficients. We then introduce a new Bayesian Adaptive LASSO estimator specifically designed for this model, capable of performing variable selection while simultaneously addressing cross-sectional dependence. To validate this framework, we conduct a Monte Carlo study, demonstrating that our Adaptive Bayesian LASSO growth regression model with a factor structure consistently outperforms three benchmark models across all evaluation metrics. Furthermore, we apply our model to a dataset encompassing 55 candidate variables across 71 countries from 1961 to 2019. Our empirical comparison confirms the superiority of our model over the benchmark models. Additionally, our model identifies five global factors and 16 key growth determinants, with robustness checks using Principal Component Analysis and instrumental variables confirming the reliability of our findings.
records.abstract_cn: 本文引入了一种贝叶斯框架，旨在解决实证增长研究中的关键计量经济学挑战：变量选择和横截面依赖性。我们提出了一种增长回归模型，该模型通过多因子结构纳入横截面依赖性，并通过稀疏系数考虑变量选择。接着，我们引入了一种专门为该模型设计的新贝叶斯自适应LASSO估计量，能够在同时解决横截面依赖性的同时进行变量选择。为了验证这一框架，我们进行了蒙特卡洛研究，证明我们的自适应贝叶斯LASSO增长回归模型在所有评估指标上始终优于基准模型。此外，我们将模型应用于一个包含55个候选变量的数据库，该数据库涵盖了71个国家，从1961到2019。我们的实证比较确认了我们的模型优于基准模型。此外，我们的模型识别了五全球因素和16关键增长决定因素，使用主成分分析和工具变量的稳健性检验确认了我们发现的可靠性。

records.title_en: Bounding treatment effects by pooling limited information across observations
records.title_cn: 通过跨观测有限信息汇集界定处理效应
records.abstract_en: We provide novel bounds on average treatment effects (on the treated) that are valid under an unconfoundedness assumption. Our bounds are designed to be robust in challenging situations, for example, when the conditioning variables take on a large number of different values in the observed sample, or when the overlap condition is violated. This robustness is achieved by only using limited “pooling” of information across observations. Namely, the bounds are constructed as sample averages over functions of the observed outcomes such that the contribution of each outcome only depends on the treatment status of a limited number of observations. No information pooling across observations leads to so-called “Manski bounds”, while unlimited information pooling leads to standard inverse propensity score weighting. We explore the intermediate range between these two extremes and provide corresponding inference methods. We show in Monte Carlo experiments and through two empirical applications that our bounds are indeed robust and informative in practice.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提供了在无混杂假设下有效的平均处理效应（对受处理者）的新界限。我们的界限旨在在具有挑战性的情境中保持稳健，例如，当条件变量在观测样本中取大量不同值时，或当重叠条件被违反时。这种稳健性是通过仅使用跨观测的有限“信息汇集”实现的。具体而言，这些界限是作为观测结果函数的样本平均值构建的，使得每个结果的贡献仅取决于有限数量观测的处理状态。无跨观测信息汇集导致所谓的“曼斯基界限”，而无限制的信息汇集则导致标准的逆倾向得分加权。我们探索了这两个极端之间的中间范围，并提供了相应的推断方法。我们在蒙特卡洛实验和两个实证应用中表明，我们的界限在实践中确实稳健且具有信息量。

records.title_en: Model uncertainty in the cross-section of stock returns
records.title_cn: 股票收益截面中的模型不确定性
records.abstract_en: We develop a transparent Bayesian framework to measure uncertainty in asset pricing models. By assigning a modified class of g-priors to the risk prices of asset pricing factors, our method quantifies the trade-off between mean–variance efficiency and parsimony for asset pricing models to achieve high posterior probabilities. Model uncertainty is defined as the entropy of these model probabilities. We prove the model selection consistency property of our procedure, which is missing from the classic g-priors. Acknowledging the possibility of omitting true asset pricing factors in real applications, we also characterize the maximum degree of contamination that the omitted factors can introduce to our model uncertainty measure. Empirically, we find that model uncertainty escalates during major market events and carries a significantly negative risk premium of approximately half the magnitude of the market. Positive shocks to model uncertainty predict persistent outflows from US equity funds and inflows to Treasury funds.
records.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一个透明的贝叶斯框架来测量资产定价模型中的不确定性。通过将修改后的 g-prior 类分配给资产定价因素的风险价格，我们的方法量化了资产定价模型在实现高后验概率时均值-方差效率与简约性之间的权衡。模型不确定性被定义为这些模型概率的熵。我们证明了我们程序的模型选择一致性特性，这是经典 g-prior 所缺失的。承认在实际应用中可能遗漏真实的资产定价因素，我们还表征了遗漏因素对我们模型不确定性度量所能引入的最大污染程度。从实证上看，我们发现模型不确定性在重大市场事件期间加剧，并且带有大约市场一半幅度的显著负风险溢价。对模型不确定性的正向冲击预测美国股票基金的持续流出和国债基金的流入。

records.title_en: A kernelization-based approach to nonparametric binary choice models
records.title_cn: 基于核化方法的非参数二元选择模型
records.abstract_en: We propose a new estimator for nonparametric binary choice models that does not impose a parametric structure on either the systematic function of covariates or the distribution of the error term. A key advantage of our approach is its computational scalability in the number of covariates. For instance, even when assuming a normal error distribution as in probit models, commonly used sieves for approximating an unknown function of covariates can lead to a large-dimensional optimization problem when the number of covariates is moderate. Our approach, motivated by kernel methods in machine learning, views certain reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces as special sieve spaces, coupled with spectral cut-off regularization for dimension reduction. We establish the consistency of the proposed estimator and asymptotic normality of the plug-in estimator for weighted average partial derivatives. Simulation studies show that, compared to parametric estimation methods, the proposed method effectively improves finite sample performance in cases of misspecification, and has a rather mild efficiency loss if the model is correctly specified. Using administrative data on the grant decisions of US asylum applications to immigration courts, along with nine case-day variables on weather and pollution, we re-examine the effect of outdoor temperature on court judges’ “mood”, and thus, their grant decisions.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种新的非参数二元选择模型估计方法，该方法不对协变量的系统函数或误差项的分布施加参数结构。我们方法的一个关键优势在于其计算可扩展性，尤其是在协变量数量方面。例如，即使假设误差分布为正态（如概率单位模型），当协变量数量适中时，常用的用于逼近未知协变量函数的筛子也可能导致高维优化问题。我们的方法受机器学习中的核方法启发，将某些再生核希尔伯特空间视为特殊的筛子空间，并结合谱截断正则化进行降维。我们证明了所提估计量的一致性，以及加权平均偏导数的插入估计量的渐近正态性。模拟研究表明，与参数估计方法相比，所提方法在模型误设情况下能有效改善有限样本性能，且在模型正确设定时效率损失相当轻微。利用美国移民法院庇护申请裁决的行政数据，以及九个关于天气和污染的案例日变量，我们重新审视了室外温度对法官“情绪”及其裁决决定的影响。

records.title_en: Structural breaks, model uncertainty and factor selection
records.title_cn: 结构性断裂、模型不确定性与因子选择
records.abstract_en: This paper addresses the non-standard problem of detecting multiple structural breaks when the data-generating model in each regime is uncertain, with an application to factor selection in empirical asset pricing. Detection is based on the marginal likelihood of break points, obtained by a novel integration over all possible pairings of models across regimes, from all possible models within regimes. The optimal break points maximize this marginal likelihood. Applying this method to the six Fama–French factors on monthly data from 1963–2023, the analysis identifies three breaks – 1982, 1998, and 2009 – and a shift toward more parsimonious models after 1998. Before 1998, five or six factors are selected, but two afterward. Thus, with breaks, there is a move to parsimony, which has implications for the factor zoo literature. Moreover, within each regime, all omitted factors are spanned by the ones selected. Incorporating breaks also leads to substantially different weight allocations in the maximum Sharpe ratio risk factor portfolio.
records.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了在每个状态下数据生成模型不确定时检测多个结构性断裂的非标准问题，并将其应用于实证资产定价中的因子选择。检测基于断裂点的边际似然，通过对各状态下所有可能模型的配对进行新颖的积分来获得。最优断裂点最大化该边际似然。将此方法应用于来自1963-2023的六 Fama–French因子的月度数据，分析识别出三断裂——1982、1998和2009——以及在1998之后向更简约模型的转变。在1998之前，选择五或六因子，但在此之后选择二。因此，随着断裂的出现，向简约性转变，这对因子动物园文献具有重要意义。此外，在每个状态下，所有被省略的因子都被所选因子所涵盖。纳入断裂还导致最大夏普比率风险因子投资组合中的权重配置显著不同。

records.title_en: Time domain estimation of non-fundamental ARMA models in the presence of heteroskedasticity of unknown form
records.title_cn: 存在未知形式异方差时非基本ARMA模型的时域估计
records.abstract_en: This paper considers time domain estimation of possibly non-fundamental (that is, non-causal and/or non-invertible) non-Gaussian linear ARMA models with martingale difference innovations that may display conditional heteroskedasticity of unknown form. Instead of explicitly parametrizing the underlying volatility process (the higher order dependence) and employing maximum likelihood procedures, we propose a time domain minimum distance objective function based on innovations predictability using second and third powers of past innovations. Using the proposed efficient GMM estimator, which is consistent and asymptotically normal, we estimate possibly non-fundamental ARMA models to inflation data from 29 OECD countries and find widespread evidence on non-fundamentalness.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考虑了在可能非基本（即非因果和/或不可逆）的非高斯线性ARMA模型中进行时域估计的问题，这些模型具有鞅差创新，可能表现出未知形式的条件异方差。我们不显式参数化潜在的波动率过程（高阶依赖）并采用极大似然方法，而是提出了一种基于过去创新的平方和三次方的创新可预测性的时域最小距离目标函数。使用所提出的有效GMM估计器，该估计器具有一致性和渐近正态性，我们估计了可能非基本的ARMA模型，应用于29个OECD国家的通胀数据，并发现了非基本性的广泛证据。

records.title_en: Bayesian model comparison for large Bayesian VARs after the COVID-19 pandemic
records.title_cn: COVID-19疫情后大型贝叶斯VAR的贝叶斯模型比较
records.abstract_en: There is an increasing interest in applying variational Bayes techniques to estimating large Bayesian vector autoregressions (VARs) with stochastic volatility. However, less attention has been paid to the development of appropriate tools for comparing these high-dimensional models, especially among those designed to address COVID-19 outliers. This paper develops a marginal likelihood estimator that combines importance sampling and variational approximation for comparing large VARs with different time-varying volatility specifications and outlier adjustments. Through a Monte Carlo study, we show that the proposed approach is fast and able to identify the correct models. The effectiveness of the proposed method is further illustrated through an empirical application of comparing a variety of 180-variable VARs.
records.abstract_cn: 对应用变分贝叶斯技术估计具有随机波动的大型贝叶斯向量自回归（VAR）模型的兴趣日益增加。然而，对于比较这些高维模型的适当工具的开发关注较少，尤其是在针对COVID-19异常值的模型中。本文开发了一种边际似然估计量，结合重要性抽样和变分近似，用于比较具有不同时间变化波动性规格和异常值调整的大型VAR。通过蒙特卡洛研究，我们表明所提出的方法快速且能够识别正确的模型。通过比较多种180变量VAR的实证应用进一步说明了该方法的有效性。

records.title_en: Estimation and inference in boundary discontinuity designs: Distance-based methods
records.title_cn: 边界不连续设计中的估计与推断：基于距离的方法
records.abstract_en: We study nonparametric distance-based (isotropic) local polynomial methods for estimating the boundary average treatment effect curve, a causal functional that captures treatment effect heterogeneity in boundary discontinuity designs. We establish identification, estimation, and inference results both pointwise and uniformly along the treatment assignment boundary. We show that the geometric regularity of the boundary, a one-dimensional manifold, plays a central role in determining feasible convergence rates and valid inference procedures. Our theoretical contributions are threefold. First, we derive uniform lower and upper bounds on the convergence rate of the misspecification bias of isotropic local polynomial estimators. Second, we obtain uniform distributional approximations that justify boundary-robust inference. Third, we establish minimax lower bounds for a broad class of nonparametric isotropic regression estimators. These results yield practical guidance for empirical implementation, including new bandwidth selection rules that adapt to local irregularities of the treatment-assignment boundary. We illustrate the proposed methods using simulation evidence and an empirical application, and provide companion general-purpose software.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了非参数基于距离（各向同性）的局部多项式方法，用于估计边界平均处理效应曲线，这是一个在边界不连续设计中捕捉处理效应异质性的因果泛函。我们在处理分配边界上逐点和一致地建立了识别、估计和推断结果。我们表明，边界（一维流形）的几何正则性在确定可行收敛速度和有效推断程序中起着核心作用。我们的理论贡献有三方面。首先，我们推导了各向同性局部多项式估计量误设偏差收敛速度的一致下界和上界。其次，我们获得了一致分布近似，为边界稳健推断提供了依据。第三，我们为一大类非参数各向同性回归估计量建立了极小极大下界。这些结果为实证实施提供了实用指导，包括适应处理分配边界局部不规则性的新带宽选择规则。我们通过模拟证据和一个实证应用说明了所提出的方法，并提供了配套的通用软件。

records.title_en: Bayesian space–time varying coefficient modeling for climate econometrics: A spatial–temporal Gaussian process approach
records.title_cn: 气候计量经济学的贝叶斯时空变系数建模：一种时空高斯过程方法
records.abstract_en: Quantifying the economic impacts of weather variables has been a key empirical topic in understanding the impacts of climate change. While panel methods, which utilize cross-sectional differences in within-unit over-time changes in weather variables, have been widely used to credibly identify the average effect of interest, there has been a growing interest in understanding the distribution of potentially heterogeneous weather effects. The heterogeneity of the effects across space and time, which can shed light on the differences in the local capacity of adaptation across regions or its evolution over time, provides important insights into developing climate policies. In this paper, we propose a novel Bayesian hierarchical modeling approach to estimate heterogeneous effects of weather variables using panel data. Our proposed approach models space–time varying coefficients via Gaussian process priors. Using the data of the corn yield from the US corn belt, we show that our proposed model outperforms several alternatives. Our findings are consistent with the literature and also provide additional insights into the localized nuances of climate change adaptation.
records.abstract_cn: 量化天气变量的经济影响一直是理解气候变化影响的关键实证主题。虽然面板方法利用单位内随时间变化的天气变量的横截面差异，已被广泛用于可靠识别感兴趣的平均效应，但对潜在异质天气效应分布的理解日益受到关注。跨空间和时间的效应异质性可以揭示不同地区适应能力的差异或其随时间的演变，为制定气候政策提供重要见解。本文提出了一种新颖的贝叶斯层次建模方法，利用面板数据估计天气变量的异质效应。我们提出的方法通过高斯过程先验建模时空变系数。使用美国玉米带的玉米产量数据，我们展示了所提模型优于几种替代方案。我们的发现与文献一致，并为气候变化适应的局部细微差别提供了额外见解。

records.title_en: Estimation of characteristics-based quantile factor models
records.title_cn: 基于特征的量化因子模型的估计
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the estimation of characteristics-based quantile factor models where the factor loadings are unknown functions of observed individual characteristics, and the idiosyncratic error terms are subject to conditional quantile restrictions. We propose a three-stage estimation procedure that is easy to implement and has nice properties. The convergence rates, the limiting distributions of the estimated factors and loading functions, plus a consistent selection criterion for the number of factors at each quantile are derived under general conditions. Our proposed estimators are shown to work satisfactorily when: (i) the idiosyncratic errors have heavy tails, (ii) the time dimension of the panel dataset is not large, and (iii) the number of factors differs from the number of characteristics. Further, a consistent estimation method based on quantile factor analysis and sieve regression is proposed when the factor loadings depend on additional unobserved characteristics. Monte Carlo simulations and an empirical application aimed at estimating the loading functions of the daily returns of a large panel of S&P 500 index securities help illustrate these properties.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了基于特征的量化因子模型的估计问题，其中因子载荷是观测到的个体特征的未知函数，且特质误差项受条件分位数限制。我们提出了一种易于实现且具有良好性质的三阶段估计程序。在一般条件下，推导了估计因子和载荷函数的收敛速度、极限分布，以及每个分位数下因子数量的一致选择准则。我们提出的估计量在以下情况下表现令人满意：（i）特质误差具有重尾分布，（ii）面板数据集的时间维度不大，（iii）因子数量与特征数量不同。此外，当因子载荷依赖于额外的未观测特征时，提出了一种基于分位数因子分析和筛回归的一致估计方法。蒙特卡洛模拟和一项旨在估计S&P 500指数证券大面板日收益载荷函数的实证应用有助于说明这些性质。

records.title_en: Bayesian estimation of a semiparametric stochastic frontier model with persistent and transient inefficiencies
records.title_cn: 具有持久性和暂时性无效率的半参数随机边界模型的贝叶斯估计
records.abstract_en: We propose kernel estimators for the densities of persistent and transient inefficiencies in a generalized panel data stochastic frontier model. This approach relaxes the conventional distributional assumptions imposed on the inefficiencies, thereby increasing robustness. A Bayesian sampling algorithm is developed to estimate all model parameters and unobserved entities, as well as the bandwidths needed to construct the densities of persistent and transient inefficiencies. The advantages of our estimator and sampling algorithm are demonstrated through numerical studies based on pseudo-samples. We find that our estimation approach outperforms conventional Bayesian estimation, providing more accurate estimates of firm-level inefficiencies. We also apply the approach to analyze the cost frontier and related characteristics for a panel of large US commercial banks, and discuss differences relative to the traditional Bayesian framework. Our estimator reveals that the high-density region of transient inefficiency varies over time, whereas the conventional approach does not possess such a feature. Moreover, the contribution of persistent inefficiency to the total inefficiency revealed by our approach is slightly more than half of that suggested by the conventional framework.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了用于持久性和暂时性无效率密度的核估计量，应用于广义面板数据随机边界模型。该方法放宽了对无效率施加的传统分布假设，从而提高了稳健性。我们开发了一种贝叶斯采样算法，以估计所有模型参数和未观察到的实体，以及构建持久性和暂时性无效率密度所需的带宽。通过基于伪样本的数值研究，我们展示了估计量和采样算法的优势。我们发现，我们的估计方法优于传统的贝叶斯估计，提供了更准确的公司层面无效率估计。我们还应用该方法分析了一组大型美国商业银行的成本边界及相关特征，并讨论了与传统贝叶斯框架的差异。我们的估计量揭示，暂时性无效率的高密度区域随时间变化，而传统方法则不具备此特征。此外，我们的方法揭示的持久性无效率对总无效率的贡献略高于传统框架所建议的贡献的一半。

records.title_en: Distributional effects with two-sided measurement error: An application to intergenerational income mobility
records.title_cn: 双边测量误差下的分布效应：代际收入流动性的应用
records.abstract_en: This paper considers identification and estimation of distributional effect parameters that depend on the joint distribution of an outcome and another variable of interest (“treatment”) in a setting with “two-sided” measurement error—that is, where both variables are possibly measured with error. Examples of these parameters in the context of intergenerational income mobility include transition matrices, rank-rank correlations, and the poverty rate of children as a function of their parents’ income, among others. Building on recent work on quantile regression (QR) with measurement error in the outcome (particularly, Hausman et al. (2021)), we show that, given (i) two linear QR models separately for the outcome and treatment conditional on other observed covariates and (ii) assumptions about the measurement error for each variable, one can recover the joint distribution of the outcome and the treatment. Besides these conditions, our approach does not require an instrument, repeated measurements, or distributional assumptions about the measurement error. Using recent data from the 1997 National Longitudinal Study of Youth, we find that accounting for measurement error notably reduces several estimates of intergenerational mobility parameters.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考虑了在“双边”测量误差——即结果变量和另一感兴趣变量（“处理”）都可能存在测量误差——的情况下，依赖于结果变量与处理变量联合分布的分布效应参数的识别与估计。在代际收入流动性的背景下，这些参数的例子包括转换矩阵、秩-秩相关性以及作为父母收入函数的儿童贫困率等。基于近期关于结果变量存在测量误差的分位数回归（QR）研究（特别是Hausman等人（2021）），我们证明，在给定（i）分别针对结果变量和处理变量在其他观测协变量条件下的两个线性QR模型，以及（ii）关于每个变量测量误差的假设的情况下，可以恢复结果变量与处理变量的联合分布。除了这些条件外，我们的方法不需要工具变量、重复测量或关于测量误差的分布假设。使用来自1997年全国青年纵向研究的最新数据，我们发现考虑测量误差显著降低了几项代际流动性参数的估计值。

records.title_en: A semiparametric Bayesian estimator of copula density
records.title_cn: 半参数贝叶斯估计器的 copula 密度
records.abstract_en: We propose a semiparametric Bayesian estimator for copula density, formulated as a generalized exponential family that combines a parametric baseline copula with a flexible adjustment modeled by a Gaussian Process (GP). The baseline captures the main features of dependence and accommodates possibly unbounded densities, while the GP component introduces nonparametric refinement. To modulate the influence of the baseline, we further introduce a tuning parameter that adjusts its weight in the final estimate. Both the GP hyperparameters and this tuning parameter are inferred jointly within a Bayesian framework. We also present a posterior sampler based on importance sampling, with the baseline copula serving as a natural approximating distribution. Simulations demonstrate the efficacy of the proposed estimator and the efficiency of the sampler. The method is further illustrated with an application to commodity futures markets.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种半参数贝叶斯估计器用于 copula 密度，形式化为一个广义指数族，结合了一个参数基线 copula 和一个由高斯过程（GP）建模的灵活调整。基线捕捉了依赖关系的主要特征，并适应可能无界的密度，而 GP 组件引入了非参数的细化。为了调节基线的影响，我们进一步引入了一个调节参数，以调整其在最终估计中的权重。GP 超参数和该调节参数在贝叶斯框架内共同推断。我们还基于重要性抽样提出了一个后验采样器，基线 copula 作为自然的近似分布。模拟结果展示了所提估计器的有效性和采样器的效率。该方法还通过对商品期货市场的应用进行了进一步说明。

records.title_en: AIC for many-regressor heteroskedastic regressions
records.title_cn: 多回归元异方差回归的AIC准则
records.abstract_en: The original and corrected Akaike information criteria (AIC) have been routinely used for model selection for ages. The penalty terms in these criteria are tied to the classical normal linear regression, characterized by conditional homoskedasticity and a small number of regressors relative to the sample size. We derive, from the same principles, a general version that takes account of conditional heteroskedasticity and regressor numerosity. The new AICm penalty takes a form of a ratio of certain weighted average error variances. The classical results on asymptotic prediction optimality of AIC are extended to AICm in heteroskedastic possibly misspecified models. Further, the infeasible AICm penalty can be operationalized via unbiased estimation of individual variances. Under suitable conditions, the feasible AICm criterion differs from the infeasible counterpart up to an asymptotically negligible term, and also possesses the property of asymptotic optimality. In simulations, the feasible AICm tends to select models that deliver systematically better out-of-sample predictions than the classical criteria. In the empirical application to an impact of legalized abortion on crime reduction, AICm tends to select a more parsimonious model than non-heteroskedasticity-robust versions of AIC.
records.abstract_cn: 原始的及修正的赤池信息准则（AIC）长期以来一直被常规用于模型选择。这些准则中的惩罚项与经典正态线性回归相关联，其特征是条件同方差性和相对于样本量而言回归元数量较少。我们从相同的原理出发，推导出一个考虑条件异方差性和回归元众多性的一般版本。新的AICm惩罚项采取某种加权平均误差方差之比的形式。关于AIC渐近预测最优性的经典结果被扩展到异方差且可能误设的模型中的AICm。此外，不可行的AICm惩罚项可以通过对个体方差的无偏估计来实施。在适当条件下，可行的AICm准则与不可行的对应准则之间的差异在渐近意义下可忽略，并且也具有渐近最优性。在模拟中，可行的AICm倾向于选择比经典准则系统性地产生更好样本外预测的模型。在关于合法堕胎对减少犯罪影响的经验应用中，AICm倾向于选择比非异方差稳健版本的AIC更简约的模型。

records.title_en: Bayesian evaluation of mutual fund performance with non-random missing data: Application to the Chinese market
records.title_cn: 具有非随机缺失数据的贝叶斯共同基金绩效评估：中国市场的应用
records.abstract_en: This paper studies mutual fund performance evaluation, where non-random missing data is an important issue. Ignoring sample selection issues can lead to biased parameter estimates and invalid performance evaluation. Therefore, we propose a novel Beta selection model to characterize this non-random missingness mechanism. We can significantly reduce the bias in alpha estimates, by introducing our Beta selection mechanism into the Noise-Reduced Alpha (NRA) model of Harvey and Liu (2018). A computationally attractive Bayesian estimation procedure is also provided. Simulation results show that our proposed method achieves superior finite-sample performance compared to classical fund-by-fund ordinary least squares (OLS) and the baseline NRA model. Finally, we apply our method to Chinese mutual fund data, and find that: (i) our out-of-sample alpha forecasts exhibit greater predictive accuracy across all tested missingness rates; (ii) approximately 18% of funds exhibit statistically significant positive alphas, suggesting market-beating skill; and (iii) portfolios constructed using our method deliver significantly higher returns than those using alternative approaches.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了共同基金绩效评估，其中非随机缺失数据是一个重要问题。忽略样本选择问题可能导致参数估计偏差和无效的绩效评估。因此，我们提出了一种新颖的Beta选择模型来表征这种非随机缺失机制。通过将我们的Beta选择机制引入Harvey和Liu（2018）的降噪Alpha（NRA）模型，我们可以显著减少Alpha估计中的偏差。我们还提供了一种计算上具有吸引力的贝叶斯估计程序。模拟结果表明，与经典的逐基金普通最小二乘法（OLS）和基准NRA模型相比，我们提出的方法在有限样本中表现出更优的性能。最后，我们将我们的方法应用于中国共同基金数据，发现：（i）我们的样本外Alpha预测在所有测试的缺失率下都表现出更高的预测准确性；（ii）大约18%的基金表现出统计上显著的正Alpha，表明其具有超越市场的技能；（iii）使用我们的方法构建的投资组合比使用替代方法构建的投资组合带来了显著更高的回报。

records.title_en: Singular vector autoregressions
records.title_cn: 奇异向量自回归
records.abstract_en: This paper develops methods for the empirical analysis of singular processes, particularly in macroeconomics. A strong rationale, a well-developed theoretical framework and, as we show, empirical support exist for multivariate time series with a singular spectral density. A singular spectral density is consistent with economic theory underlying, for example, DSGE models in which the number of variables is greater than the number of structural shocks. This assumption guarantees the existence of a finite order VAR representation but there does not exist a unique probability density function with respect to the Lebesgue measure. We therefore define a density on a compact linear submanifold with respect to the Hausdorff measure and, in a Bayesian framework, develop an HMC algorithm that jointly samples coefficients, lag length, and the number of shocks. We use the proposed framework to carry out structural analysis on the US macroeconomy with fewer shocks than variables.
records.abstract_cn: 本文开发了用于奇异过程实证分析的方法，特别是在宏观经济学中。对于具有奇异谱密度的多元时间序列，存在强有力的理由、完善的理论框架以及我们所示的实证支持。奇异谱密度与经济理论一致，例如，在变量数量大于结构冲击数量的DSGE模型中。这一假设保证了有限阶VAR表示的存在，但不存在相对于勒贝格测度的唯一概率密度函数。因此，我们在紧致线性子流形上相对于豪斯多夫测度定义密度，并在贝叶斯框架下开发了一种HMC算法，该算法联合采样系数、滞后长度和冲击数量。我们使用所提出的框架对美国宏观经济进行结构分析，其中冲击数量少于变量数量。

records.title_en: Partial identification of structural vector autoregressions with non-centred stochastic volatility
records.title_cn: 非中心随机波动下结构向量自回归的部分识别
records.abstract_en: We consider structural vector autoregressions that are identified through stochastic volatility under Bayesian estimation. Three contributions emerge from our exercise. First, we show that a non-centred parameterization of stochastic volatility yields a marginal prior for the conditional variances of structural shocks that is centred on homoskedasticity, with strong shrinkage and heavy tails—unlike the common centred parameterization. This feature makes it well suited for assessing partial identification of any shock of interest. Second, Monte Carlo experiments on small and large systems indicate that the non-centred setup estimates structural parameters more precisely and normalizes conditional variances efficiently. Third, revisiting prominent fiscal structural vector autoregressions, we show how the non-centred approach identifies tax shocks that are consistent with estimates reported in the literature.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考虑通过贝叶斯估计在随机波动下识别的结构向量自回归。三 贡献源于我们的研究。第一，我们展示了随机波动的非中心参数化如何为结构冲击的条件方差提供一个以同方差性为中心的边际先验，具有强收缩性和重尾特征——这与常见的中心参数化不同。这一特征使其非常适合评估任何感兴趣冲击的部分识别。第二，小型和大型系统的蒙特卡洛实验表明，非中心设置能够更精确地估计结构参数，并有效地标准化条件方差。第三，重新审视显著的财政结构向量自回归，我们展示了非中心方法如何识别与文献中报告的估计一致的税收冲击。

records.title_en: Identification and estimation in a time-varying endogenous random coefficient panel data model
records.title_cn: 时变内生随机系数面板数据模型中的识别与估计
records.abstract_en: This paper proposes a correlated random coefficient linear panel data model, where regressors can be correlated with time-varying and individual-specific random coefficients through both a fixed effect and a time-varying random shock. I develop a new panel data-based method to identify the average partial effect and the local average response function. The identification strategy employs a sufficient statistic to control for the fixed effect and a control variable for the random shock. Conditional on these two controls, the residual variation in the regressors is driven solely by the exogenous instrumental variables, and thus can be exploited to identify the parameters of interest. The constructive identification analysis leads to three-step series estimators, for which I establish rates of convergence and asymptotic normality. To illustrate the method, I estimate a heterogeneous Cobb-Douglas production function for manufacturing firms in China, finding substantial variations in output elasticities across firms that can be related to various firm characteristics.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一个相关随机系数线性面板数据模型，其中回归变量可以通过固定效应和时变随机冲击与随时间变化且个体特定的随机系数相关。我开发了一种新的基于面板数据的方法来识别平均部分效应和局部平均响应函数。识别策略采用充分统计量来控制固定效应，并用控制变量来处理随机冲击。在这两个控制条件下，回归变量中的剩余变异仅由外生工具变量驱动，因此可以用来识别感兴趣的参数。构造性识别分析导致了三步级数估计量，我为其建立了收敛速率和渐近正态性。为了说明该方法，我估计了中国制造业企业的异质性柯布-道格拉斯生产函数，发现企业间产出弹性存在显著差异，这些差异可与各种企业特征相关联。

records.title_en: Bayesian nonparametric inference in bank business models with transient and persistent cost inefficiency
records.title_cn: 具有瞬时和持久成本低效的银行商业模型的贝叶斯非参数推断
records.abstract_en: This paper introduces a novel econometric framework for identifying and modeling bank business models (BBMs), which dynamically evolve in response to changing financial and economic conditions. Building on the stochastic frontier literature, we extend the traditional cost-efficiency models by decomposing inefficiency into persistent and transient components. We propose a Bayesian nonparametric approach that adapts to the data through an infinite mixture model with predictor-dependent clustering, enabling a flexible classification of banks into distinct business models. Our method, based on the Logit Stick-Breaking Process (LSBP), provides a data-driven way to capture the heterogeneity in bank strategies, allowing for dynamic transitions between business models over time. This model offers a significant advancement over existing parametric and kernel-based approaches by combining the scalability of nonparametric methods with efficient computational routines. We apply the model to a dataset of European banks and identify four distinct business model clusters, providing novel insights into the evolution of bank performance and efficiency. Our findings contribute to the growing literature on the identification and measurement of bank business models, offering valuable implications for policy and regulatory frameworks.
records.abstract_cn: 本文介绍了一种新颖的计量经济学框架，用于识别和建模银行商业模型（BBMs），这些模型会根据不断变化的金融和经济条件动态演变。在随机前沿文献的基础上，我们通过将低效分解为持久和瞬时成分，扩展了传统的成本效率模型。我们提出了一种贝叶斯非参数方法，该方法通过具有预测因子依赖聚类的无限混合模型适应数据，从而实现对银行进行灵活分类为不同商业模型。我们的方法基于Logit Stick-Breaking Process (LSBP)，提供了一种数据驱动的方式来捕捉银行战略的异质性，允许商业模型在时间上动态转变。该模型在结合非参数方法的可扩展性与高效计算程序方面，相较于现有的参数和基于核的方法提供了显著的进步。我们将该模型应用于一组欧洲银行的数据集，识别出四个不同的商业模型集群，为银行绩效和效率的演变提供了新颖的见解。我们的研究结果为银行商业模型的识别和测量的日益增长的文献做出了贡献，为政策和监管框架提供了有价值的启示。

records.title_en: Text-term selection and analysis: Frequentist and Bayesian strategies and interpretations
records.title_cn: 文本术语选择与分析：频率主义和贝叶斯策略及其解释
records.abstract_en: Economic analysis based on text data has expanded rapidly, yet the ultra-high dimensionality of text data presents substantial challenges for term selection and estimation. We propose the Information-Adaptive Lasso and Information-Adaptive Spike-and-Slab Lasso as novel frequentist and Bayesian approaches to address these challenges. A key theoretical contribution of this study is the establishment of the rate of convergence in term-selection consistency, which we show to be faster than those achieved in the existing Lasso literature. Applying our methods to Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) statements, we identify and estimate high-impact terms driving fluctuations in monetary policy uncertainty.
records.abstract_cn: 基于文本数据的经济分析迅速扩展，但文本数据的超高维度性给术语选择和估计带来了重大挑战。我们提出信息自适应Lasso和信息自适应Spike-and-Slab Lasso作为应对这些挑战的新颖频率主义和贝叶斯方法。本研究的一个关键理论贡献是建立术语选择一致性的收敛速度，我们证明其比现有Lasso文献中实现的速度更快。将我们的方法应用于联邦公开市场委员会（FOMC）声明，我们识别并估计了驱动货币政策不确定性波动的高影响术语。

records.title_en: Likelihood specification in simultaneous equation models for discrete data
records.title_cn: 离散数据的 simultaneousequation 模型中的似然性规范
records.abstract_en: In this article, we examine the foundations of a rich and diverse literature in economics and derive the likelihood function of simultaneous equation models for discrete data as the invariant distribution of a suitably specified Markov process. This formulation offers a well-defined reduced form of the model and dispenses with the need for controversial recursivity requirements and ad hoc indeterminacy rules. The derivation resolves puzzling paradoxes highlighted in earlier work and shows that the likelihood is unique, proper, coherent, complete, and theoretically grounded in conditional distribution modeling – a framework that has yet to be popularized in economics. We note possible extensions and relevant links with other models, comment on computational issues, and implement the methodology in three empirical applications involving female labor force participation, the interactions between health and wealth, and the interplay between banks’ lending practices and their reliance on assistance from the lender of last resort during the Great Depression.
records.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们考察了经济学中丰富多样的文献基础，并推导出离散数据 simultaneousequation 模型的似然函数，作为适当指定的马尔可夫过程的不变分布。这种表述提供了模型的明确定义的简化形式，并消除了对有争议的递归要求和临时不确定性规则的需求。推导解决了早期工作中突出的问题悖论，并表明似然是唯一的、适当的、一致的、完整的，并在条件分布建模中理论上扎根——这一框架在经济学中尚未普及。我们注意到可能的扩展和与其他模型的相关联系，评论计算问题，并在 三 实证应用中实施该方法，涉及女性劳动参与、健康与财富之间的相互作用，以及银行贷款实践与在大萧条期间对最后贷款人援助的依赖之间的相互作用。

records.title_en: Macro-prudential policy under asymmetric risks: A Bayesian structural quantile VAR approach
records.title_cn: 不对称风险下的宏观审慎政策：一种贝叶斯结构量化VAR方法
records.abstract_en: Macro-prudential policymakers face a risk-management problem: they must assess medium-term downside risks to the real economy stemming from financial imbalances and the associated threat of future financial crises, while accounting for the cost of policy interventions in terms of foregone upside potential. This trade-off between limiting downside risks and preserving upside growth is inherently asymmetric and depends on the distribution of future macroeconomic outcomes. We formalize this decision problem by defining novel measures of downside risk and upside potential and by stipulating an explicit loss function for macro-prudential policy. To evaluate policy in this setting, we develop and apply a novel Bayesian structural quantile vector autoregressive model that delivers flexible and potentially asymmetric predictive distributions. Using quantile impulse responses, we assess the scope for macro-prudential policy to reduce growth volatility and negative skewness, infer the macro-prudential policy stance, and characterize the circumstances under which macro-prudential interventions are likely to be beneficial.
records.abstract_cn: 宏观审慎政策制定者面临风险管理问题：他们必须评估源于金融失衡的对实体经济的中期下行风险及未来金融危机的相关威胁，同时考虑政策干预在放弃上行潜力方面的成本。这种限制下行风险与保持上行增长之间的权衡本质上是非对称的，并且依赖于未来宏观经济结果的分布。我们通过定义新的下行风险和上行潜力的度量，并规定宏观审慎政策的明确损失函数，来形式化这一决策问题。为了在这一背景下评估政策，我们开发并应用了一种新的贝叶斯结构量化向量自回归模型，该模型提供灵活且可能是非对称的预测分布。通过量化脉冲响应，我们评估宏观审慎政策减少增长波动性和负偏度的潜力，推断宏观审慎政策立场，并描述宏观审慎干预可能带来益处的情境。

records.title_en: Concentrated MCMC estimation
records.title_cn: 集中式MCMC估计
records.abstract_en: This paper studies a concentrated Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) estimation method that offers significant computational advantages while delivering valid inference for parameters of interest. By reducing the dimension of parameters to be sampled, this method substantially decreases computational time and memory usage relative to both traditional and some state-of-the-art Bayesian algorithms. Its applicability extends to correctly specified or misspecified likelihood functions, as well as generalized method of moments objective functions. Monte Carlo studies demonstrate that the biases and root mean squared errors of the concentrated MCMC estimators are typically smaller than or comparable to those of conventional Bayesian estimators. Furthermore, this method exhibits reliable model selection performance. We establish the large sample properties of the concentrated MCMC estimator. An empirical application analyzing the network spillover effect of stock returns in the Chinese A-share market further illustrates the advantages of this method.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了一种集中式马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）估计方法，该方法在提供有效推断感兴趣参数的同时，具有显著的计算优势。通过减少需要采样的参数维度，该方法相较于传统方法和一些最先进的贝叶斯算法，显著降低了计算时间和内存使用。其适用性扩展到正确指定或错误指定的似然函数，以及广义矩方法目标函数。蒙特卡洛研究表明，集中式MCMC估计量的偏差和均方根误差通常小于或可与传统贝叶斯估计量相媲美。此外，该方法表现出可靠的模型选择性能。我们建立了集中式MCMC估计量的大样本性质。对中国A股市场股票收益网络溢出效应的实证应用进一步说明了该方法的优势。

records.title_en: Bayesian model averaging with non-conjugate priors
records.title_cn: 具有非共轭先验的贝叶斯模型平均
records.abstract_en: This paper considers the case of non-conjugate prior distributions for Bayesian model averaging (BMA). Although the natural conjugate setting is the default choice for BMA, mainly for reasons of analytical tractability, it has come under considerable criticism due to its unrealistic assumptions about prior information, among others. In this study, we extend the literature by considering two special cases of the multivariate Student-t distribution. We obtain closed-form solutions using Laplace approximations and apply our techniques to a controlled numerical experiment and cross-country growth regressions. Our results show that, under fine tuning of the hyperparameters, the proposed approach has similar performance to the conjugate alternatives on synthetic datasets, whereas in real data it favors, on average, more parsimonious models than the conjugate alternatives and also exhibits superior predictive performance.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考虑了贝叶斯模型平均（BMA）中非共轭先验分布的情况。尽管自然共轭设置是BMA的默认选择，主要是出于分析可处理性的考虑，但由于其对先验信息的不切实际假设等原因，受到了相当大的批评。在本研究中，我们通过考虑多元Student-t分布的二特例来扩展文献。我们使用拉普拉斯近似法获得闭式解，并将我们的技术应用于受控数值实验和跨国增长回归。我们的结果表明，在超参数的精细调整下，所提出的方法在合成数据集上的表现与共轭替代方案相似，而在真实数据中，它平均更倾向于比共轭替代方案更简约的模型，并且还表现出更优越的预测性能。

records.title_en: Bayesian methods in economics and finance: A unified survey and taxonomy
records.title_cn: 经济与金融中的贝叶斯方法：统一综述与分类
records.abstract_en: This special issue brings together 21 papers that reflect the expanding scope and methodological evolution of Bayesian econometrics. We introduce a new organizing taxonomy that distinguishes between Traditional Bayesian Approaches - rooted in conjugate priors, standard likelihood-based estimation, and established Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) techniques - and Contemporary Bayesian Frontiers, characterized by nonparametric methods, variational inference, high-dimensional shrinkage, and integration with machine learning. We further classify contributions across two broad domains covering applications in Economics (focusing on macroeconomics, microeconomics, and climate econometrics) and Finance (focusing on asset pricing, volatility, and bank business models). Across these fields, four cross-cutting themes emerge: (1) high-dimensionality, volatility, and time-varying dynamics; (2) structural identification and model uncertainty; (3) semiparametric and nonparametric flexibility; and (4) data quality, granularity, and novel data structures. This survey synthesizes the methodological and empirical contributions of the special issue, proposes a unifying framework for organizing recent advances in Bayesian econometrics, and identifies unresolved challenges and promising directions for future research.
records.abstract_cn: 本期特刊汇集了21篇论文，反映了贝叶斯计量经济学不断扩大的范围和方法论的演变。我们提出了一个新的组织分类法，将传统贝叶斯方法（基于共轭先验、标准似然估计和已建立的马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）技术）与当代贝叶斯前沿（以非参数方法、变分推断、高维收缩和与机器学习的整合为特征）区分开来。我们进一步将贡献分为两大领域，涵盖经济学（侧重宏观经济学、微观经济学和气候计量经济学）和金融学（侧重资产定价、波动性和银行业务模型）的应用。在这些领域中，出现了四个跨领域的主题：（1）高维度、波动性和时变动态；（2）结构识别和模型不确定性；（3）半参数和非参数灵活性；（4）数据质量、粒度和新型数据结构。本综述综合了特刊的方法论和实证贡献，提出了一个统一的框架来组织贝叶斯计量经济学的最新进展，并确定了未解决的挑战和未来研究的有希望的方向。

records.title_en: Stochastic volatility in mean: Efficient analysis by a generalized mixture sampler
records.title_cn: 均值中的随机波动性：通过广义混合采样器的高效分析
records.abstract_en: In this paper we consider the simulation-based Bayesian analysis of stochastic volatility in mean (SVM) models. Extending the highly efficient Markov chain Monte Carlo mixture sampler for the SV model proposed in Kim et al. (1998) and Omori et al. (2007), we develop an accurate approximation of the logarithm of the non-central chi-squared distribution as a mixture of thirty normal distributions. Under this mixture representation, we sample the parameters and latent volatilities in one block. We also detail a correction of the small approximation error by using additional Metropolis–Hastings steps. The proposed method is extended to the SVM model with leverage. The methodology and models are applied to excess holding yields and S&P500 returns in empirical studies, and the SVM models are shown to outperform other volatility models based on marginal likelihoods.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考虑了基于模拟的随机波动性在均值（SVM）模型的贝叶斯分析。扩展了Kim等人（1998）和Omori等人（2007）提出的SV模型的高效马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛混合采样器，我们开发了非中心卡方分布对数的准确近似，作为三十个正态分布的混合。在这种混合表示下，我们在一块中对参数和潜在波动性进行采样。我们还详细说明了通过使用额外的Metropolis-Hastings步骤来修正小的近似误差。所提出的方法扩展到具有杠杆效应的SVM模型。该方法和模型应用于超额持有收益和S&P500回报的实证研究，结果表明SVM模型在边际似然性方面优于其他波动性模型。

records.title_en: A dynamic state-space HAR model
records.title_cn: 动态状态空间HAR模型
records.abstract_en: The Heterogeneous AutoRegressive model for the logs of Realised Volatility (HARL) has established itself as the benchmark specification for modelling and forecasting return volatility, owing to its parsimony and ability to capture the strong persistence typically observed in RV. To address potential concerns such as measurement errors, nonlinearities, and non-spherical residuals, numerous variants of the baseline HARL model have been developed in the literature. This paper contributes to this body of work by proposing a new class of dynamic state-space models with time-varying parameters. The parameter dynamics are assumed to follow an autoregressive process, with or without stochastic volatility, giving rise to two specifications: SHARP and SHARP-SV. Both models are designed to capture the evolving nature of return volatility and are estimated via Bayesian inference using Particle Gibbs sampling. Empirical applications to high-frequency data on SPY, sector ETFs, representative NYSE stocks, and the VIX index demonstrate that our proposed models on average outperform alternative HARL-based specifications in forecasting volatility, particularly at medium- and long-term horizons. An extensive Monte Carlo analysis further illustrates the advantages of our approach in terms of both estimation accuracy and predictive performance.
records.abstract_cn: 异质自回归模型（HARL）已成为建模和预测收益波动的基准规范，因其简洁性和捕捉到的收益波动中通常观察到的强持久性。为了解决潜在的测量误差、非线性和非球形残差等问题，文献中开发了许多基线HARL模型的变体。本文通过提出一类具有时间变参数的动态状态空间模型，为这一研究领域做出了贡献。参数动态假设遵循自回归过程，可能带有或不带有随机波动，从而产生二规范：SHARP和SHARP-SV。这两种模型旨在捕捉收益波动的演变特性，并通过使用粒子吉布斯采样的贝叶斯推断进行估计。对SPY、高频数据、行业ETF、代表性NYSE股票和VIX指数的实证应用表明，我们提出的模型在预测波动性方面平均优于替代的基于HARL的规范，特别是在中长期视野下。广泛的蒙特卡洛分析进一步说明了我们的方法在估计准确性和预测性能方面的优势。

records.title_en: Testing for differences in high-frequency network connectedness from variance decompositions
records.title_cn: 基于方差分解的高频网络连接性差异检验
records.abstract_en: We develop a Bayesian Wald-type test for detecting temporal differences in connectedness from variance decompositions, and establish the asymptotic normality of impulse response functions and variance decomposition matrices at fixed local time points. The resulting test statistic is asymptotically χ2 distributed under the null hypothesis and performs well in Monte Carlo simulations. Applying our methodology to high-frequency options data on sectoral exchange-traded funds (ETFs) from January 2013 to June 2023, we identify and quantify monetary policy surprises following Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) announcements. Our empirical results indicate that total connectedness among sectoral ETF implied volatilities increases significantly following FOMC announcements, with these elevated connectedness levels persisting for approximately one hour on days with monetary policy surprises. Our findings indicate more than one-fifth of FOMC announcements surprise financial markets.
records.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一种贝叶斯 Wald 类型检验，用于检测方差分解中的时间差异连接性，并建立了在固定的局部时间点上冲击响应函数和方差分解矩阵的渐近正态性。结果的检验统计量在零假设下渐近服从 χ2 分布，并在蒙特卡罗模拟中表现良好。将我们的方法应用于从 2013 年 一月到 2023 年 六月的高频期权数据，涉及部门交易所交易基金（ETF），我们识别并量化联邦公开市场委员会（FOMC）公告后的货币政策惊喜。我们的实证结果表明，FOMC 公告后部门 ETF 暗示波动率之间的总连接性显著增加，这些提高的连接性水平在货币政策惊喜的日子里持续约一小时。我们的发现表明，超过五分之一的 FOMC 公告对金融市场来说是惊喜。

records.title_en: Unconventional monetary policy spillovers and the (in)convenience of Treasuries
records.title_cn: 非常规货币政策溢出效应与国债的（不）便利性
records.abstract_en: Foreign monetary policy shocks increasingly influence U.S. yields, particularly since the Global Financial Crisis. We show that this heightened sensitivity reflects both the adoption of unconventional monetary policy tools and a decline in the convenience of Treasuries. Using high frequency identification, we find that when Treasuries command a low convenience premium — behaving more like other assets — they respond more to ECB monetary policy, consistent with increased sensitivity to portfolio rebalancing. A two-country preferred-habitat model with time-varying covariance of yields rationalizes these results: when Treasuries are less convenient, they become closer substitutes for foreign equivalents, amplifying cross-border transmission of policy shocks.
records.abstract_cn: 外国货币政策冲击对美国收益率的影响日益增强，尤其是在全球金融危机之后。我们表明，这种敏感性的增强既反映了非常规货币政策工具的采用，也反映了国债便利性的下降。利用高频识别方法，我们发现当国债的便利溢价较低——表现得更像其他资产时——它们对欧洲央行货币政策的反应更大，这与对投资组合再平衡的敏感性增强相一致。一个具有时变收益率协方差的两国偏好栖息地模型解释了这些结果：当国债的便利性降低时，它们与外国同类资产的替代性增强，从而放大了政策冲击的跨境传导。

records.title_en: Payment data, information disclosure, and privacy
records.title_cn: 支付数据、信息披露和隐私
