records.title_cn: 常规研究文章技术在缩小生产力性别差距中的作用
records.abstract_en: Highlights•Female-managed firms are less productive, with larger gaps in lower-income economies.•Female- and male-managed firms adopt digital technologies equally.•Female-managed firms use less sophisticated sector-specific technologies.•Female-managed firms gain higher returns from technologies, reducing productivity gaps.•Technology gaps link to differences in managerial quality and government support.AbstractA growing body of literature documents productivity differences between male- and female-led businesses in developing countries. This paper examines these gaps through the lens of technology adoption. Using novel firm-level data from the World Bank’s Firm-level Adoption of Technology surveys, we measure differences in productivity and technology adoption between male- and female-managed firms. The results show that female-managed firms tend to adopt similar levels of technology sophistication in general business functions, but they lag in the adoption of more advanced sector-specific production technologies. We also find that female-managed firms achieve higher productivity gains from adopting advanced technologies, partially offsetting initial gaps. An Oaxaca–Blinder decomposition indicates that differences in managerial quality, access to government support, and sectoral composition account for part of the adoption gap. These findings underscore the role of technology adoption as a potential channel for narrowing gender-based productivity differences in developing economies.
records.abstract_cn: 亮点•女性管理的企业生产力较低，在低收入经济体中差距更大。•女性和男性管理的企业采用数字技术的程度相同。•女性管理的企业使用较不复杂的特定行业技术。•女性管理的企业从技术中获得更高的回报，缩小了生产力差距。•技术差距与管理质量和政府支持的差异有关。摘要越来越多的文献记录了发展中国家男性和女性领导的企业之间的生产力差异。本文通过技术采用的视角来考察这些差距。利用世界银行企业技术采用调查的新颖企业层面数据，我们衡量了男性和女性管理企业在生产力和技术采用方面的差异。结果表明，女性管理的企业在一般业务功能中倾向于采用相似水平的技术复杂性，但在采用更先进的特定行业生产技术方面落后。我们还发现，女性管理的企业从采用先进技术中获得更高的生产力收益，部分抵消了初始差距。Oaxaca-Blinder分解表明，管理质量、政府支持获取和部门构成的差异解释了部分采用差距。这些发现强调了技术采用作为缩小发展中经济体基于性别的生产力差异的潜在渠道的作用。

records.title_en: Regular Research ArticleOpportunistic behavior and discrimination in the mexican solar photovoltaic market: An audit experiment
records.title_cn: 常规研究文章墨西哥太阳能光伏市场中的机会主义行为与歧视：一项审计实验
records.abstract_en: Highlights•Women and high-SES customers face price discrimination; overcharges exceed 3%.•Surcharges for medium/high-SES female customers rise above 6%.•Less robust evidence for discrimination based on prior product knowledge or external financing.•Sellers often oversize system capacity relative to the optimal net present value.•Evidence of discrimination regarding system capacity oversizing is relatively weak.AbstractThis paper presents an empirical analysis of supply-side discrimination in the green technology market, with implications for policy optimization in emerging economies. We conduct an audit experiment using a messenger-based approach to investigate price discrimination and market behaviors in Mexico’s residential distributed solar photovoltaic (DPV) market. By using randomized fictitious customer profiles that vary by gender, socioeconomic status (SES), prior DPV knowledge, and access to external financing, we assess how these factors influence provider responses to quote requests. Our findings indicate that women and medium- to high-SES customers face significant overcharges, with combined surcharges exceeding 6% in some cases. Evidence of discriminatory practices based on product knowledge and access to financing is less robust. Oversizing of capacity by providers relative to the optimal size seems to be a common practice, although evidence of discrimination in this regard is rather weak.Discriminatory practices may reduce the cost-effectiveness and accessibility of DPV systems, ultimately hindering the impact of programs designed to promote green technology adoption. Addressing these biases is essential for improving market efficiency and enhancing the effectiveness of green technology initiatives aimed at promoting broader adoption across diverse populations.
records.abstract_cn: 亮点•女性和高社会经济地位客户面临价格歧视；超额收费超过3%。•中/高社会经济地位女性客户的附加费上升至6%以上。•基于先前产品知识或外部融资的歧视证据较弱。•卖方经常将系统容量过度配置至超过最优净现值。•关于系统容量过度配置的歧视证据相对较弱。摘要本文对绿色技术市场中的供给侧歧视进行了实证分析，对新兴经济体的政策优化具有启示意义。我们采用基于信使的审计实验方法，调查墨西哥住宅分布式太阳能光伏（DPV）市场中的价格歧视和市场行为。通过使用随机化的虚构客户档案，这些档案在性别、社会经济地位（SES）、先前DPV知识和外部融资获取方面有所不同，我们评估了这些因素如何影响供应商对报价请求的响应。我们的研究结果表明，女性和中高社会经济地位客户面临显著的超额收费，在某些情况下，综合附加费超过6%。基于产品知识和融资获取的歧视性做法证据较弱。供应商相对于最优规模过度配置容量似乎是一种常见做法，尽管这方面的歧视证据相对较弱。歧视性做法可能降低DPV系统的成本效益和可及性，最终阻碍旨在促进绿色技术采用的项目的影响。解决这些偏见对于提高市场效率和增强旨在促进更广泛人群采用绿色技术倡议的有效性至关重要。

records.title_en: Regular Research ArticleGendered networks and demand for an agricultural technology in India
records.title_cn: 常规研究文章：性别化网络与印度农业技术需求
records.abstract_en: Highlights•Women and men access distinct agricultural information networks.•The effect of women’s and men’s networks on household’s technology demand differs.•Women may have access to information, but it may not be valued within households.•Studying social learning in heads’ networks may miss how households make decisions.AbstractStudies on social learning and technology adoption often only consider the networks of a single individual in a household as a source of information influencing agricultural production decisions. We test the validity of this assumption by examining the role of men’s and women’s social networks in the adoption of a novel water-saving technology, laser land leveling (LLL), in India. Using network data from men and women in the same household, we test the influence of being connected to an adopter on demand for LLL. We identify the causal gender-specific network effects using a field experiment that combines an auction with a lottery for the technology, making the presence of adopters in networks exogenous. The data reveal that men’s and women’s networks vary in size and show little overlap. We find that whereas household demand for LLL increases when men are linked to an LLL-adopting household, it decreases when the network linkages run through women. These gender-differentiated effects are concentrated in households where the woman’s opinion about the technology is valued by the man and in non-poor households. The results highlight that social learning may interact with the socio-demographic characteristics of households in myriad ways to influence household technology adoption decisions, and that agricultural-based information interventions ought to also consider how information gets used in the household.
records.abstract_cn: 亮点•女性和男性获取不同的农业信息网络。•女性和男性网络对家庭技术需求的影响不同。•女性可能获得信息，但在家庭内部可能不被重视。•仅研究户主网络中的社会学习可能无法捕捉家庭决策方式。摘要关于社会学习和技术采用的研究通常只考虑家庭中单个个体的网络作为影响农业生产决策的信息来源。我们通过考察印度男性和女性社交网络在采用新型节水技术——激光平地（LLL）中的作用，来检验这一假设的有效性。利用同一家庭中男性和女性的网络数据，我们检验与采用者联系对LLL需求的影响。我们通过结合拍卖和彩票的田间实验，识别出因果性的性别特定网络效应，使网络中采用者的存在成为外生变量。数据显示，男性和女性的网络在规模上存在差异且重叠很少。我们发现，当男性与采用LLL的家庭有联系时，家庭对LLL的需求增加，而当网络联系通过女性时，需求则减少。这些性别差异效应集中在女性对技术的意见被男性重视的家庭以及非贫困家庭中。结果强调，社会学习可能以多种方式与家庭的社会人口特征相互作用，影响家庭技术采用决策，基于农业的信息干预也应考虑信息在家庭内部的使用方式。

records.title_en: Regular Research ArticleCOVID-19 and rural livelihoods: lessons from a longer-term assessment and the path to recovery
records.title_cn: 常规研究文章COVID-19与农村生计：长期评估的教训及复苏路径
records.abstract_en: Highlights•This paper provides a long-term assessment of COVID-19 impacts and post-pandemic recovery dynamics in rural Guatemala.•The analysis uses a four-round longitudinal survey of 1,262 smallholder households from 2019 to 2022.•Food security and dietary diversity improved by mid-2022, though several indicators remained below pre-pandemic levels.•We also observe a sustained increase in migration intentions since 2021, with levels more than twice those reported in 2019.•For a household subsample, estimates show average income declines alongside rising expenditure and indebtedness.AbstractThe COVID-19 pandemic had profound effects on livelihoods across rural populations worldwide. Building on earlier work that examined the initial effects of the pandemic on food security and nutrition among smallholder agricultural households in the Western Highlands of Guatemala, this study offers a longer-term assessment of the impacts and the path to recovery. We rely on a unique longitudinal survey of 1,262 households conducted over four rounds between 2019 and 2022, with the first round in person and the subsequent ones by phone. The results show substantial recoveries in food security and dietary diversity in the region by mid-2022 compared to 2020, but at levels still worse than pre-pandemic ones for some indicators. There is also a sustained increase in the intention to emigrate. The households that were initially more affected in terms of food security and nutrition but recovered faster include those located in one of the three studied departments and families living above the poverty line, while smallholders affected by hurricanes, non-coffee producers, and indigenous populations took longer to recover. We additionally provide quantitative estimates for a subsample of households interviewed in person during a fifth survey round at the end of 2022, showing an average decline of about 16 percent in total household income three years after the start of the pandemic, mainly driven by a decrease in agricultural income, combined with a 26-percent increase in expenditures and an important surge in indebtedness. Overall, the study offers valuable lessons regarding the recovery of vulnerable households following a major global crisis and in a context of additional shocks.
records.abstract_cn: 要点•本文对危地马拉农村地区COVID-19的影响及疫情后复苏动态进行了长期评估。•分析使用了从1,262年到2019年对2022个小农户家庭进行的四轮纵向调查。•到2022年中期，粮食安全和膳食多样性有所改善，但若干指标仍低于疫情前水平。•我们还观察到自2021年以来移民意愿持续上升，其水平是2019年报告的两倍多。•对于家庭子样本，估计显示平均收入下降，同时支出和负债上升。摘要COVID-19疫情对全球农村人口的生计产生了深远影响。基于先前研究疫情对危地马拉西部高地小农户农业家庭粮食安全和营养的初步影响的工作，本研究提供了对影响及复苏路径的长期评估。我们依赖于一项独特的纵向调查，该调查在1,262年至2019年间进行了四轮，涉及2022个家庭，第一轮为面对面调查，后续轮次通过电话进行。结果显示，与2022年相比，到2020年中期，该地区的粮食安全和膳食多样性显著恢复，但某些指标仍低于疫情前水平。移民意愿也持续上升。最初在粮食安全和营养方面受影响较大但恢复较快的家庭包括位于三个研究省份之一的家庭和生活在贫困线以上的家庭，而受飓风影响的小农户、非咖啡生产者和土著人群恢复时间较长。我们还为在2022年底第五轮调查中面对面访谈的家庭子样本提供了定量估计，显示疫情开始三年后，家庭总收入平均下降约16%，主要由于农业收入减少，同时支出增加26，负债显著上升。总体而言，该研究为重大全球危机后脆弱家庭的恢复提供了宝贵经验，并考虑了额外冲击的背景。

records.title_en: Regular Research ArticleGender, Development, and Recognition of Anthropogenic Climate Change
records.title_cn: 常规研究文章：性别、发展与对人为气候变化的认知
records.abstract_en: Highlights•Women in less developed countries are less likely than men to recognize climate change as human-caused.•Gender gap in climate knowledge closes as countries advance economically and democratically.•Educational disparities drive gender differences in understanding climate science globally.•Democratic freedoms and information access reduce gender gaps in climate change beliefs.•Study challenges narrative that women are universally more knowledgeable about climate change.AbstractThe impacts of climate change vary significantly across populations, with gender playing a crucial role in shaping how individuals think about and respond to climate risks. Despite evidence that in developed countries women generally express greater environmental concern, this study reveals a critical knowledge gap: women in less economically and democratically developed societies are less likely than men to think climate change is caused by human activities. Using data from 103 countries and territories (n = 92,691), we demonstrate that this gender disparity in thinking about climate causation stems from structural inequalities in access to education and information, particularly in contexts where women’s educational opportunities are limited. As countries advance economically and democratically, these gender gaps in recognizing climate change’s anthropogenic causes diminish. This research highlights how development pathways, particularly educational attainment and information access, shape gendered thinking about climate causation, underscoring the need for gender-responsive climate education initiatives that target women’s specific barriers to climate literacy.
records.abstract_cn: 亮点•在欠发达国家，女性比男性更不可能认识到气候变化是由人类活动引起的。•随着国家经济与民主的发展，气候知识方面的性别差距逐渐缩小。•教育差距在全球范围内驱动了理解气候科学上的性别差异。•民主自由和信息获取减少了气候变化信念中的性别差距。•研究挑战了女性普遍对气候变化更为了解的说法。摘要气候变化的影响在不同人群中差异显著，性别在塑造个人对气候风险的思考和反应方式中扮演关键角色。尽管有证据表明，在发达国家，女性通常表现出更强的环境关注，但本研究揭示了一个关键的知识差距：在经济和民主发展程度较低的社会中，女性比男性更不可能认为气候变化是由人类活动引起的。利用来自103个国家和地区的数据（n = 92,691），我们证明了这种关于气候变化成因思考的性别差异源于教育和信息获取方面的结构性不平等，尤其是在女性教育机会受限的环境中。随着国家在经济和民主上的进步，这些在认识气候变化人为原因上的性别差距逐渐缩小。本研究强调了发展路径，特别是教育成就和信息获取，如何塑造关于气候成因的性别化思维，并强调了针对女性气候素养特定障碍的性别响应型气候教育倡议的必要性。

records.title_en: Regular Research ArticleUnveiling Injustice: Analyzing Child Mortality Inequality across decades in Peru (1981–2017)
records.title_cn: 常规研究文章揭示不公：分析秘鲁数十年间儿童死亡率不平等（1981-2017）
records.abstract_en: Highlights•Progress hides gaps: Under-5 mortality fell from 117 to 12.8 per 1,000 (1981–2017), yet disparities persist across groups.•Maternal education is the most associated factor with child mortality inequality, and it has risen over time.•Rural and regional gaps have narrowed: Inequality by geography has declined but remains substantial, with rural children still facing an elevated mortality risk.•Intersectional matters: Indigenous, poor, rural children face 5–8 times higher mortality risk than the opposite group.•Structural inequality persists: group mortality gaps stayed stable despite overall improvements.AbstractPeru is a developing country that has significantly improved the average of almost all health indicators. Specifically, in the past four decades, child mortality decreased tenfold. However, the same is not necessarily true of equality, which remains a challenge. Using microdata from Peru’s population censuses in 1981, 1993, 2007, and 2017, we estimate the inequality in child mortality across different social groups. We estimate differences between ethnic groups, education levels, wealth quintiles, regions, and urban–rural groups and find that although inequality has decreased, it remains significantly high. The data show that inequality in child mortality increased between 1981 and 1993, declined between 1993 and 2007, and then increased between 2007 and 2017. Differences in education are the most crucial factor, associated with 45 % of the inequality in 1981 and 58 % in 2017. Differences between Lima and rural areas account for 27 % to 30 % of the inequality, while ethnicity contributes only 6 % in 1981 and 10 % in 2017.
records.abstract_cn: 亮点•进步掩盖差距：5岁以下儿童死亡率从每1,000名中的117例降至12.8例（1981-2017），但各群体间差异依然存在。•母亲教育与儿童死亡率不平等关联最强，且其影响随时间上升。•城乡和地区差距缩小：地理因素导致的不平等有所下降但仍显著，农村儿童仍面临更高的死亡风险。•交叉因素重要：土著、贫困、农村儿童面临的死亡风险比相反群体高5-8倍。•结构性不平等持续：尽管整体改善，群体间死亡率差距保持稳定。摘要秘鲁是一个发展中国家，几乎所有健康指标的平均水平都有显著提高。具体而言，在过去四十年中，儿童死亡率下降了十倍。然而，平等情况未必如此，这仍是一个挑战。利用秘鲁1981年、1993年、2007年和2017年人口普查的微观数据，我们估计了不同社会群体间儿童死亡率的不平等。我们估计了民族群体、教育水平、财富五分位、地区和城乡群体之间的差异，发现尽管不平等有所下降，但仍显著偏高。数据显示，儿童死亡率不平等在1981年至1993年间上升，1993年至2007年间下降，然后在2007年至2017年间再次上升。教育差异是最关键的因素，与1981年45%和2017年58%的不平等相关。利马与农村地区之间的差异占不平等的27%至30%，而民族因素在1981年仅贡献6%，在2017年贡献10%。

records.title_en: Regular Research ArticleClimate change impacts on commodity price stability through changing ENSO patterns
records.title_cn: 常规研究文章气候变化通过改变ENSO模式对商品价格稳定性的影响
records.abstract_en: Highlights•We propose a novel GFALP model to isolate the global transmission of ENSO shocks on commodity markets, accounting for macroeconomic conditions.•Unanticipated ENSO movements asymmetrically impact commodity price volatility, with distinct effects during El Niño and La Niña periods.•Climate change may alter ENSO frequency and intensity, exacerbating commodity price instability through non-linear effects.•We introduce an index quantifying commodity price exposure to ENSO-related climate disruptions, revealing heterogeneous vulnerabilities.•Commodity price volatility that could result from climate change is found to be amplified by financialization, production concentration, and limited global market participation.AbstractClimate change is a global phenomenon that has a significant impact on commodity prices. This paper analyzes the impact of El Niño–Southern Oscillation (ENSO) on global commodity prices, using a Global Factor Local Projections (GFALP) model. Firstly, we demonstrate that unanticipated ENSO movements contribute to commodity price volatility asymmetrically during El Niño and La Niña periods. Secondly, climate change might disrupt ENSO patterns. We compare the current situation with potential climate change outcomes to evaluate its impact on commodity price stability. We compute an index measuring commodity price exposure to these disruptions. We demonstrate that in most cases, these shifts exacerbate commodity price volatility. Finally, we explore several avenues to explain the observed heterogeneity in the exposure of commodity prices to the evolution of ENSO that could result from climate change, and we highlight the crucial role of international commodity markets in adapting to climate change.
records.abstract_cn: 亮点•我们提出了一种新颖的GFALP模型，以隔离ENSO冲击对商品市场的全球传导，同时考虑宏观经济条件。•未预期的ENSO变动对商品价格波动性产生不对称影响，在厄尔尼诺和拉尼娜期间具有不同的效应。•气候变化可能改变ENSO的频率和强度，通过非线性效应加剧商品价格不稳定。•我们引入了一个指数，量化商品价格对ENSO相关气候干扰的暴露程度，揭示出异质性的脆弱性。•发现可能由气候变化导致的商品价格波动性会被金融化、生产集中度和有限的全球市场参与所放大。摘要气候变化是一个全球现象，对商品价格有显著影响。本文使用全球因子局部投影（GFALP）模型，分析了厄尔尼诺-南方涛动（ENSO）对全球商品价格的影响。首先，我们证明未预期的ENSO变动在厄尔尼诺和拉尼娜期间对商品价格波动性产生不对称影响。其次，气候变化可能扰乱ENSO模式。我们将当前情况与潜在的气候变化结果进行比较，以评估其对商品价格稳定性的影响。我们计算了一个衡量商品价格对这些干扰暴露程度的指数。我们证明在大多数情况下，这些变化加剧了商品价格波动性。最后，我们探讨了几种途径来解释商品价格对可能由气候变化导致的ENSO演变暴露程度中观察到的异质性，并强调了国际商品市场在适应气候变化中的关键作用。

records.title_en: Regular Research ArticleUnpaid care work for the elderly in Thailand: does the social gender norm on altruistic behavior matter?
records.title_cn: 常规研究文章泰国老年人无偿照护工作：关于利他行为的社会性别规范是否重要？
records.abstract_en: Highlights•Thai women play a central role in providing informal elderly care within households, and gender unpaid care gaps are evident.•A novel Altruistic Time Ratio is constructed using national time-use data, showing women are more altruistic than men.•The Social Gender Norm (SGN) reveals regional and rural/urban disparities in social expectations.•The SGN affects caregiving time for women and men in opposite ways, mainly viaa direct channel, widening the gender care gap.•Trade-offs between paid work and leisure are strong across genders but the only women significantly swap work for caregiving.AbstractAgeing societies pose an increasing demand for elderly care, particularly in developing countries where formal long-term care infrastructure remains underdeveloped. In these contexts, unpaid family caregivers, especially women, play a crucial role. However, gender care gaps shaped by prevailing social gender norms are seldom quantified, and the underlying factors behind these gaps remain underexplored in the literature. This paper investigates gender differences in elderly caregiving and examines how social gender norms influence caregiving patterns. Using nationally representative Thai time-use data from 2014 to 15 and the Labor Force Survey from 2013 to 15, we address two main questions (i) How does the social gender norm around altruism affect the gender care gap for the elderly, directly or indirectly, and through which channels? and (ii) How do men and women trade off care burdens with paid work or leisure time? We contribute to the body of literature on unpaid care work by analyzing the gender differentials in trade-offs associated with elder caregiving as both main and secondary activities. We develop a novel altruistic time ratio (ATR), defined as the time individuals allocate to others relative to time spent on themselves. We quantify the social gender norm (SGN) as the gender mean difference in ATRs, aggregated at the district-area level. The wide variation of SGN across Thai regions offers a broader societal perspective beyond individual and household characteristics in understanding caregiving behavior. Our findings, derived from single and multi-equation Tobit models, reveal that (i) SGN increases elderly care time for women by inducing their ATR while reducing it for men and (ii) significant trade-offs exist between elderly care time, leisure time, and paid work. These results provide empirical evidence on how social expectations shape caregiving behaviors and underscore the importance of recognizing societal influences when designing policies that support equitable elder care arrangements beyond state-provided long-term care.
records.abstract_cn: 亮点•泰国女性在家庭内提供非正式老年人照护方面发挥核心作用，且性别无偿照护差距明显。•利用全国时间使用数据构建了一个新颖的利他时间比率，显示女性比男性更具利他性。•社会性别规范揭示了社会期望在区域和城乡之间的差异。•社会性别规范对女性和男性的照护时间产生相反方向的影响，主要通过直接渠道，扩大了性别照护差距。•有偿工作与休闲之间的权衡在性别间都很强烈，但只有女性显著地将工作转换为照护。摘要老龄化社会对老年人照护的需求日益增加，尤其是在正式长期照护基础设施尚不发达的发展中国家。在这些背景下，无偿家庭照护者，尤其是女性，发挥着至关重要的作用。然而，由主流社会性别规范塑造的性别照护差距很少被量化，且这些差距背后的潜在因素在文献中仍未得到充分探讨。本文研究了老年人照护中的性别差异，并考察了社会性别规范如何影响照护模式。利用2014年至15年具有全国代表性的泰国时间使用数据以及2013年至15年的劳动力调查数据，我们解决两个主要问题：（i）围绕利他主义的社会性别规范如何直接或间接地影响老年人照护的性别差距，并通过哪些渠道？（ii）男性和女性如何在照护负担与有偿工作或休闲时间之间进行权衡？我们通过分析作为主要和次要活动的老年人照护相关权衡中的性别差异，为无偿照护工作文献做出贡献。我们开发了一个新颖的利他时间比率（ATR），定义为个人分配给他人的时间相对于花在自己身上的时间。我们将社会性别规范（SGN）量化为ATR的性别均值差异，并在地区层面进行汇总。泰国各地区SGN的广泛差异为理解照护行为提供了超越个人和家庭特征的更广泛社会视角。我们的研究结果来自单一和多重方程Tobit模型，揭示：（i）SGN通过提高女性的ATR增加了她们的老年人照护时间，同时减少了男性的照护时间；（ii）老年人照护时间、休闲时间和有偿工作之间存在显著的权衡。这些结果为社会期望如何塑造照护行为提供了经验证据，并强调了在制定支持公平老年人照护安排的政策时，认识到社会影响的重要性，而不仅仅依赖国家提供的长期照护。

records.title_en: Regular Research ArticleCrop commercialization, structural change and income inequality: Insights from smallholder farmers in rural Southeast Asia
records.title_cn: 常规研究文章作物商业化、结构变迁与收入不平等：来自东南亚农村小农户的见解
records.abstract_en: Highlights•Structural change in agriculture plays an important role in the economic development of developing countries.•Crop commercialization has a positive correlation with the structural change.•An increase in commercialization can reduce income inequality in relative terms.•Policies on facilitating crop commercialization and supporting mechanization are suggested.AbstractStructural change in agriculture is an integral part of economic development in developing economies. The process of structural change is accompanied by adjustments within and outside agriculture, such as the development of mechanization and the shift to non-farm employment. We examine the correlations of crop commercialization with structural change and assess how the benefits of crop commercialization are distributed across farm and total income quantiles. We use a balanced panel of 2,867 rural smallholder farmers collected from Thailand and Vietnam, two middle-income countries in Southeast Asia for empirical analyses. Our panel includes three survey waves conducted in 2010, 2013, and 2016 with a total of 8,601 observations. Regarding the correlation of crop commercialization with structural change, our simultaneous equation model results show that crop commercialization is positively related to crop mechanization. The results of fixed-effects estimation with a control function approach indicate that an increase in crop commercialization has a positive correlation with non-farm employment. Besides, the results of unconditional quantile regression models suggest that an increase in crop commercialization leads to an increase of about 25.4% and 5.6% in per capita farm income of smallholders in the 10th and 25th quantile groups, while it increases the per capita total income of smallholders in the 10th and 25th quantile groups by about 10.2% and 5.7%, respectively. Hence, we recommend facilitating the commercialization of crops by smallholder farmers to stimulate the structural transformation of agriculture at the micro level and to reduce income inequality of smallholder farmers.
records.abstract_cn: 亮点•农业结构变迁在发展中国家经济发展中扮演重要角色。•作物商业化与结构变迁呈正相关。•商业化的增加可以在相对意义上减少收入不平等。•建议制定促进作物商业化和支持机械化的政策。摘要农业结构变迁是发展中经济体经济发展的重要组成部分。结构变迁过程伴随着农业内外部的调整，如机械化的发展和向非农就业的转变。我们考察了作物商业化与结构变迁的相关性，并评估了作物商业化的收益如何在农场收入和总收入分位数之间分配。我们使用了来自泰国和越南（东南亚两个中等收入国家）的2,867名农村小农户的平衡面板数据进行实证分析。我们的面板包括在2010、2013和2016年进行的三轮调查，共8,601个观测值。关于作物商业化与结构变迁的相关性，我们的联立方程模型结果显示，作物商业化与作物机械化呈正相关。采用控制函数方法的固定效应估计结果表明，作物商业化的增加与非农就业呈正相关。此外，无条件分位数回归模型的结果表明，作物商业化的增加导致小农户在10和25分位数组的人均农场收入增加约25.4%和5.6%，而分别使10和25分位数组的小农户人均总收入增加约10.2%和5.7%。因此，我们建议促进小农户的作物商业化，以在微观层面刺激农业的结构转型，并减少小农户的收入不平等。

records.title_en: Regular Research ArticleMicrowork as a development project: An ethnographic study of data annotators in Guizhou, China
records.title_cn: 常规研究文章微型工作作为发展项目：中国贵州数据标注员的民族志研究
records.abstract_en: Highlights•This paper examines how microwork is promoted as a development project in one of the poorest regions in China.•In addition to platform, local outsourced agencies participated in skills training and labor supervision.•Development studies need to take into consideration the central role of labor as an agency for change.AbstractThis paper adopts an ethnographic approach to explore microwork as a development project, focusing on the dynamic relations between the state, labor recruiting agency and workers. The Chinese state has made big investments to turn the poor and remote region of Guizhou into a big data hub, laying high hopes for high-tech to contribute to poverty alleviation. Soon the big data industry attracted the concentration of data annotation firms that vowed to train unskilled rural residents to work. We present the case of G Firm, a “complementary organizations to algorithms” (COTA) that conducts data annotation for AI platforms and meets the government’s demand for job creation. Conventional research on microwork largely focuses on how platforms such as AMT and Clickfarm exploit labor, but has paid little attention to the role of outsourced agencies in taking up the tasks of labor training and management. This paper looks at how G Firm offered a space of worker copresence to facilitate the social learning of labelling skills. However, whether annotation work is qualified or not is decided less on annotator’s individual embodied experience or peers’ social expertise than on the requirement of the inspectors. Therefore, COTA serves as an intermediary for the coding elites to exert indirect control over the cybertariat who often have to endure unpaid work due to the fast iteration process of AI. However, the fast turnover rate and fragmented division of labor made them difficult to build solidarity and assert better labor rights. Although data annotators can accomplish tasks that algorithms fail to do, given their lack of solidarity, their skills have not endowed them with high bargaining power. Our study has demonstrated the indispensable role of human labor to technological growth and would like to call for development studies to take into consideration the central role of labor as an agency for change.
records.abstract_cn: 亮点•本文探讨了微型工作如何在中国最贫困地区之一被推广为发展项目。•除平台外，本地外包机构参与了技能培训和劳动监督。•发展研究需要考虑劳动作为变革动力的核心作用。摘要本文采用民族志方法探讨微型工作作为发展项目，重点关注国家、劳动力招聘机构与工人之间的动态关系。中国政府已投入巨资将贫困偏远的贵州地区转变为大数据中心，寄厚望于高科技助力扶贫。不久，大数据产业吸引了数据标注公司的聚集，这些公司承诺培训无技能的农村居民就业。我们以G公司为例，这是一家“算法的补充组织”（COTA），为AI平台进行数据标注，并满足政府创造就业的需求。关于微型工作的传统研究主要关注AMT和Clickfarm等平台如何剥削劳动力，但很少关注外包机构在承担劳动力培训和管理任务中的作用。本文考察了G公司如何提供工人共处空间以促进标注技能的社会学习。然而，标注工作是否合格更多取决于检查员的要求，而非标注员个人的具身体验或同伴的社会专业知识。因此，COTA作为编码精英对网络无产阶级实施间接控制的中介，后者常因AI快速迭代过程而不得不忍受无薪工作。然而，高流动率和碎片化的劳动分工使他们难以建立团结并争取更好的劳动权益。尽管数据标注员能完成算法无法完成的任务，但由于缺乏团结，他们的技能并未赋予他们较高的议价能力。我们的研究证明了人类劳动对技术增长不可或缺的作用，并呼吁发展研究考虑劳动作为变革动力的核心作用。

records.title_en: Regular Research ArticleEchoes of colonial disruption: historicizing vulnerability, raiding, and violence in Northwestern Kenya
records.title_cn: 常规研究文章殖民扰动的回响：肯尼亚西北部脆弱性、劫掠与暴力的历史化
records.abstract_en: Highlights•The British conquest of the Turkana in the 1910s devastated the pastoral economy.•Colonial livestock theft and border enforcement made the Turkana vulnerable to environmental fluctuations.•In the colonial era, ecological conditions became the primary driver of conflict between the Turkana and neighboring groups.•The droughts in 1928 and 1933 mark the beginning of new conflict dynamics in Turkana.•The vulnerability and insecurity experienced in contemporary Turkana are legacies of colonial policies.
records.abstract_cn: 要点•1910年英国对图尔卡纳的征服摧毁了牧区经济。•殖民时期的牲畜盗窃和边境管制使图尔卡纳人易受环境波动影响。•在殖民时代，生态条件成为图尔卡纳人与邻近群体冲突的主要驱动因素。•1928年和1933年的干旱标志着图尔卡纳冲突动态的新开端。•当代图尔卡纳所经历的脆弱性和不安全感是殖民政策的遗留影响。

records.title_en: How to Sample and When to Stop Sampling: The Generalised Wald Problem and Minimax Policies
records.title_cn: 如何采样以及何时停止采样：广义 Wald 问题和极小极大策略
records.abstract_en: We study sequential experiments where sampling is costly and a decision-maker aims to determine the best treatment for full-scale implementation by (1) adaptively allocating units between two possible treatments, and (2) stopping the experiment when the expected welfare (inclusive of sampling costs) from implementing the chosen treatment is maximised. Working under a continuous time limit, we characterise the optimal policies under the minimax regret criterion. We show that the same policies also remain optimal under both parametric and non-parametric outcome distributions in an asymptotic regime where sampling costs approach zero. The minimax optimal sampling rule is just the Neyman allocation: it is independent of sampling costs and does not adapt to observed outcomes. The decision-maker halts sampling when the product of the average treatment difference and the number of observations surpasses a specific threshold. The results derived also apply to the so-called best-arm identification problem, where the number of observations is exogenously specified.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了抽样成本高昂的连续实验，决策者的目标是通过（1）在二种可能的治疗方法之间自适应地分配单位，并（2）在实施所选治疗方法的预期福利（包括抽样成本）最大化时停止实验，从而确定全面实施的最佳治疗方法。在连续时间限制下，我们描述了最小最大遗憾标准下的最优策略。我们表明，在采样成本接近零的渐进机制中，相同的策略在参数和非参数结果分布下也保持最优。极小极大最优抽样规则就是奈曼分配：它独立于抽样成本，并且不适应观察到的结果。当平均处理差异和观察数量的乘积超过特定阈值时，决策者停止采样。得出的结果也适用于所谓的最佳臂识别问题，其中观察数是外生指定的。

records.title_en: Colluding Against Environmental Regulation
records.title_cn: 串通环境监管
records.abstract_en: We study collusion among firms against imperfectly monitored environmental regulation. Firms increase variable profits by violating regulation and reduce expected noncompliance penalties by violating jointly. We consider a case of three German automakers colluding to reduce the effectiveness of emissions control technology. By estimating a structural model of the European automobile industry from 2007 to 2018, we find that collusion lowers expected noncompliance penalties substantially and increases buyer and producer surplus. Due to increased pollution, welfare decreases by € 1.57–5.57 billion. We show how environmental policy design and antitrust play complementary roles in preventing noncompliance.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了企业之间串通反对监管不完善的环境监管的情况。企业通过违反监管来增加可变利润，并通过联合违规来减少预期的违规处罚。我们考虑三德国汽车制造商串通降低排放控制技术有效性的案例。通过估计2007至2018欧洲汽车行业的结构模型，我们发现共谋大大降低了预期的违规处罚，并增加了买方和生产商剩余。由于污染加剧，福利减少了欧元1.57-5.57十亿。我们展示了环境政策设计和反垄断如何在防止违规行为方面发挥互补作用。

records.title_en: Efficient Conservation of the Brazilian Amazon: Estimates from a Dynamic Model
records.title_cn: 巴西亚马逊的有效保护：动态模型的估计
records.abstract_en: This paper estimates the Brazilian Amazon’s carbon-efficient forest cover—i.e. when farmers internalize the social cost of carbon. We propose a dynamic discrete choice land-use model and estimate it using a panel of land use and carbon stock of 5.7 billion pixels between 2008 and 2017. The business-as-usual scenario implies an inefficient release of 42 billion tons of CO2 in the long run, resulting from the deforestation of an area twice the size of France. A carbon tax that makes farmers internalize the social cost of carbon would implement the efficient allocation and generate welfare gains exceeding 1.6 trillion dollars. Responses from a carbon tax are highly convex: a carbon tax of only $10/ton would preserve 95% of the efficient carbon stock. An excise tax on cattle ranching, a second-best policy, achieves at most 87% of the first-best welfare gains.
records.abstract_cn: 本文估计了巴西亚马逊地区的碳效率森林覆盖率，即当农民将碳的社会成本内部化时。我们提出了一个动态离散选择土地利用模型，并使用 5.7 和 2008 之间 2017 十亿 像素的土地利用和碳储量面板对其进行估计。一切照旧的情景意味着从长远来看，由于面积是法国两倍的森林砍伐，将导致42十亿吨二氧化碳的低效释放。碳税使农民将碳的社会成本内在化，从而实现有效分配并产生超过1.6万亿美元的福利收益。碳税的反应是高度凸的：仅$10/吨的碳税将保留95%的有效碳储量。对养牛场征收消费税是一项第二-最佳政策，最多可实现87%的第一-最佳福利收益。

records.title_en: A Q-Theory of Banks
records.title_cn: 银行的 Q 理论
records.abstract_en: Bank capital requirements are based on book values, which are slow to reflect losses. In this article, we develop a dynamic model of banks to study the interaction of regulation and delayed accounting. Our model explains four stylized facts: book and market values diverge during crises, the market-to-book ratio predicts future profitability, book leverage constraints rarely bind strictly even as market leverage fans out during crises, and banks delever gradually after net-worth shocks. We show how delayed accounting can allow the regulator to achieve better outcomes than immediate (mark-to-market) accounting. In an estimated version of the model, the optimal regulation couples faster loan-loss recognition with a modest relaxation of the book leverage constraint.
records.abstract_cn: 银行资本要求基于账面价值，反映损失的速度很慢。在本文中，我们开发了一个银行动态模型来研究监管和延迟会计的相互作用。我们的模型解释了四典型的事实：危机期间账面价值和市值出现分歧，市账率预测未来盈利能力，账面杠杆约束很少受到严格约束，即使市场杠杆在危机期间呈扇形扩散，银行在净值冲击后逐渐去杠杆化。我们展示了延迟会计如何让监管机构取得比即时（按市价）会计更好的结果。在模型的估计版本中，最优监管将更快的贷款损失确认与适度放宽账面杠杆约束相结合。

records.title_en: The Economics and Econometrics of Gene–Environment Interplay
records.title_cn: 基因与环境相互作用的经济学和计量经济学
records.abstract_en: We discuss how to estimate the interplay between genes (nature) and environments (nurture), with an empirical illustration of the moderating effect of school starting age on one’s genetic predisposition towards educational attainment. We argue that gene–environment (G×E) studies can be instrumental for (i) assessing treatment effect heterogeneity, (ii) testing theoretical predictions, and (iii) uncovering mechanisms, thereby improving understanding of how (policy) interventions affect population subgroups. Empirically, we find that being old-for-grade and having a higher genetic propensity for education benefits children on assessment tests as they progress through school. In this setting, families appear to increase genetic inequalities while schools seem to reduce them.
records.abstract_cn: 我们讨论如何估计基因（先天）和环境（后天）之间的相互作用，并通过实证说明入学年龄对 一 受教育程度的遗传倾向的调节作用。我们认为，基因-环境（G×E）研究有助于（i）评估治疗效果异质性，（ii）测试理论预测，以及（iii）揭示机制，从而增进对（政策）干预措施如何影响人口亚组的理解。根据经验，我们发现，年级较高且具有较高的教育遗传倾向有利于儿童在学校进步时进行评估测试。在这种情况下，家庭似乎加剧了遗传不平等，而学校似乎减少了遗传不平等。

records.title_en: Global Value Chains and Trade Policy
records.title_cn: 全球价值链和贸易政策
records.abstract_en: How do global value chain (GVC) linkages modify countries’ incentives to impose import protection? Are these linkages important determinants of trade policy in practice? We develop a new approach to modelling tariff setting with GVCs, in which optimal policy depends on the nationality of value-added content embedded in home and foreign final goods. Theory predicts that discretionary tariffs will be decreasing in the domestic content of foreign-produced final goods and the foreign content of domestically produced final goods. Using data for 14 countries between 1995 and 2015, we show that governments set lower tariffs and curb their use of temporary trade barriers where GVC linkages are strongest, consistent with theory. Turning to quantitative model counterfactuals, we find that severing GVC linkages would lead to the disappearance of tariff preferences. Further, targeted policies to decouple China from GVCs would increase the optimal tariff set by G7 countries on Chinese exports.
records.abstract_cn: 全球价值链 (GVC) 联系如何改变各国实施进口保护的动机？这些联系是实践中贸易政策的重要决定因素吗？我们开发了一种利用全球价值链对关税设定进行建模的新方法，其中最优政策取决于国内外最终产品中嵌入的增值内容的国籍。理论预测，酌情关税将随着外国生产的最终产品的国内含量和国内生产的最终产品的国外含量而下降。使用14和1995之间2015国家的数据，我们表明政府在全球价值链联系最强的地方设定了较低的关税并限制使用临时贸易壁垒，这与理论一致。转向定量模型反事实，我们发现切断全球价值链联系将导致关税优惠的消失。此外，使中国与全球价值链脱钩的有针对性的政策将提高七国集团国家对中国出口设定的最优关税。

records.title_en: The U.S., Economic News, and the Global Financial Cycle
records.title_cn: 美国、经济新闻和全球金融周期
records.abstract_en: We provide evidence for a causal link between the U.S. economy and the global financial cycle. Using intraday data, we show that U.S. macroeconomic news releases have large and significant effects on global risky asset prices. Stock price indexes of 27 countries, the VIX, and commodity prices all jump instantaneously upon news releases. The responses of stock indexes co-move across countries and are large—often comparable in size to the response of the S&P 500. Further, U.S. macroeconomic news explains on average 23% of the quarterly variation in foreign stock markets. The joint behaviour of stock prices, bond yields, and risk premia suggests that systematic U.S. monetary policy reactions to news do not drive the estimated effects. Instead, the evidence points to a direct effect on investors’ risk-taking capacity. Our findings show that a byproduct of the U.S.’s central position in the global financial system is that news about its business cycle has large effects on global financial conditions.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提供了美国经济与全球金融周期之间因果关系的证据。利用日内数据，我们表明美国宏观经济新闻发布对全球风险资产价格具有巨大且显着的影响。 27国家的股票价格指数、波动率指数和大宗商品价格都会在新闻发布后立即上涨。股票指数的反应在不同国家之间共同变化并且很大——通常在规模上与标准普尔指数的反应相当500。此外，美国宏观经济新闻平均23%解释了外国股市的季度变化。股票价格、债券收益率和风险溢价的联合行为表明，美国货币政策对新闻的系统性反应并不会推动估计的影响。相反，有证据表明这对投资者的风险承担能力有直接影响。我们的研究结果表明，美国在全球金融体系中的中心地位的一个副产品是，有关其经济周期的新闻对全球金融状况有很大影响。

records.title_en: How People Use Statistics
records.title_cn: 人们如何使用统计数据
records.abstract_en: For standard statistical problems, we provide new evidence documenting (1) multimodality and (2) instability in probability estimates, including from irrelevant changes in problem description. The evidence motivates a model in which, when solving a problem, people represent each hypothesis by attending to its salient features while neglecting other, potentially more relevant, ones. Only the statistics associated with salient features are used. The model unifies biases in judgments about i.i.d. draws, such as the Gambler's Fallacy and insensitivity to sample size, with biases in inference such as under- and overreaction and insensitivity to the weight of evidence. The model makes predictions for how changes in the salience of specific features jointly shapes known biases and measured attention to features, but also create entirely new biases. We test and confirm these predictions experimentally. Salience-driven attention to features emerges as a unifying framework for biases conventionally explained using a variety of stable heuristics or distortions of Bayes' rule.
records.abstract_cn: 对于标准统计问题，我们提供了新的证据，记录了概率估计中的 (1) 多模态和 (2) 不稳定性，包括问题描述中不相关的变化。这些证据激发了一种模型，在该模型中，在解决问题时，人们通过关注其显着特征来表示每个假设，同时忽略其他可能更相关的特征。仅使用与显着特征相关的统计数据。该模型统一了独立同分布判断中的偏差。抽签，例如赌徒谬误和对样本大小不敏感，以及推理偏差，例如反应不足和过度反应以及对证据的重要性不敏感。该模型预测特定特征的显着性变化如何共同塑造已知的偏差和对特征的测量关注度，但也会产生全新的偏差。我们通过实验测试并证实这些预测。对特征的显着性驱动的关注成为一种统一框架，用于传统上使用各种稳定的启发式或贝叶斯规则的扭曲来解释的偏差。

records.title_en: Barriers to Entry and Regional Economic Growth in China
records.title_cn: 中国的进入壁垒和区域经济增长
records.abstract_en: Labour productivity in manufacturing differs starkly across regions in China. We document that productivity, wages, and start-up rates of non-state firms have nevertheless experienced rapid unconditional regional convergence after 1995. To analyse these patterns, we construct a Hopenhayn model that incorporates location-specific capital wedges, output wedges, and entry barriers. Using Chinese Industry Census data, we estimate these wedges and examine their role in explaining differences in performance and growth across prefectures. Entry barriers explain most of the differences. We investigate the empirical covariates of these entry barriers and find that changes in barriers are causally related to changes in the size of the state sector: a smaller state sector leads to lower entry barriers.
records.abstract_cn: 中国各地区制造业的劳动生产率存在明显差异。我们记录到，非国有企业的生产率、工资和开办率在1995之后经历了快速无条件的区域趋同。为了分析这些模式，我们构建了一个 Hopenhayn 模型，其中包含特定地点的资本楔子、输出楔子和进入壁垒。利用中国工业普查数据，我们估计了这些楔子，并检验了它们在解释各地区绩效和增长差异方面的作用。进入壁垒解释了大部分差异。我们研究了这些进入壁垒的实证协变量，发现壁垒的变化与国有部门规模的变化存在因果关系：国有部门规模较小导致进入壁垒较低。

records.title_en: Trauma at School: The Impacts of Shootings on Students’ Human Capital and Economic Outcomes
records.title_cn: 学校创伤：枪击事件对学生人力资本和经济成果的影响
records.abstract_en: We examine how shootings at schools—an increasingly common form of gun violence in the States—impact the educational and economic trajectories of students. Using linked schooling and labor market data in Texas from 1992 to 2018, we compare within-student and across-cohort changes in outcomes following a shooting to those experienced by students at matched control schools. We find that school shootings increase absenteeism and grade repetition, reduce high school graduation, college enrollment, and college completion; and reduce employment and earnings at ages 24–26 years. We further find school-level increases in the number of leadership staff and reductions in retention among teachers and teaching support staff in the years following a shooting. The adverse impacts of shootings span student characteristics, suggesting that the economic costs of school shootings are universal.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了学校枪击事件（美国日益常见的枪支暴力形式）如何影响学生的教育和经济轨迹。我们利用德克萨斯州从1992到2018的相关学校教育和劳动力市场数据，将枪击事件后学生内部和跨群体的结果变化与匹配对照学校的学生所经历的结果进行比较。我们发现，学校枪击事件增加了缺勤率和留级率，降低了高中毕业率、大学入学率和大学毕业率；并减少 24-26 岁的就业和收入。我们进一步发现，在枪击事件发生后的几年里，学校层面的领导人员数量有所增加，而教师和教学支持人员的保留率却有所下降。枪击事件的不利影响跨越了学生的特征，这表明校园枪击事件的经济成本是普遍存在的。

records.title_en: Identification and Inference in First-Price Auctions with Risk-Averse Bidders and Selective Entry
records.title_cn: 第一-规避风险的投标人和选择性进入的价格拍卖中的识别和推理
records.abstract_en: We study identification and inference in first-price auctions with risk-averse bidders and selective entry, building on a flexible framework we call the Affiliated Signal with Risk Aversion (AS-RA) model. Assuming exogenous variation in either the number of potential bidders (N) or a continuous instrument (z) shifting opportunity costs of entry, we provide a sharp characterization of the nonparametric restrictions implied by equilibrium bidding. This characterization implies that risk neutrality is nonparametrically testable. In addition, with sufficient variation in both N and z, the AS-RA model primitives are nonparametrically identified (up to a bounded constant) on their equilibrium domains. Finally, we explore new methods for inference in set-identified auction models based on Chen et al. (2018, Econometrica, vol. 86, 1965–2018), as well as novel and fast computational strategies using Mathematical Programming with Equilibrium Constraints. Simulation studies reveal the good finite-sample performance of our inference methods, which can readily be adapted to other set-identified flexible equilibrium models with parameter-dependent support.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了具有规避风险的投标人和选择性进入的第一价格拍卖中的识别和推理，建立在一个灵活的框架上，我们称之为风险规避附属信号（AS-RA）模型。假设潜在投标人数量 (N) 或连续工具 (z) 的外生变化改变了进入的机会成本，我们提供了均衡投标所隐含的非参数限制的清晰特征。这种特征意味着风险中性是不可参数测试的。此外，由于 N 和 z 都有足够的变化，AS-RA 模型基元在其平衡域上被非参数识别（最多有界常数）。最后，我们在 Chen 等人的基础上探索了集合识别拍卖模型的新推理方法。 （2018，计量经济学，第 86，1965-2018），以及使用具有平衡约束的数学规划的新颖且快速的计算策略。模拟研究揭示了我们的推理方法良好的有限样本性能，可以很容易地适应其他具有参数依赖支持的集合识别的灵活平衡模型。

records.title_en: “Bad” Oil, “Worse” Oil, and Carbon Misallocation
records.title_cn: “劣质”石油、“更差”石油和碳分配不当
records.abstract_en: Not all barrels of oil are created equal: their extraction varies in both private cost and carbon intensity. Leveraging a comprehensive micro-dataset on world oil fields, alongside detailed estimates of carbon intensities and private extraction costs, this study quantifies the additional emissions and costs from having extracted the “wrong” deposits. We do so by comparing historical deposit-level supplies to counterfactuals that factor in pollution costs, while keeping annual global consumption unchanged. Between 1992 and 2018, carbon misallocation amounted to at least 11.00 gigatons of CO2-equivalent (GtCO2eq), incurring an environmental cost evaluated at $2.2 trillion (US$ 2018). This translates into a significant supply-side ecological debt for major producers of high-carbon oil. Looking forward, we estimate the gains from making deposit-level extraction socially optimal at about 9.30 GtCO2eq, valued at $1.9 trillion, along a future aggregate demand pathway coherent with the objective of net-zero emissions in 2050, and document unequal reserve stranding across oil nations.
records.abstract_cn: 并非所有桶石油都是一样的：它们的开采在私人成本和碳强度方面都有所不同。这项研究利用世界油田的全面微观数据集，以及对碳强度和私人开采成本的详细估计，量化了因开采“错误”矿藏而产生的额外排放和成本。我们通过将历史存款水平供应与考虑污染成本的反事实进行比较，同时保持全球年度消费量不变来做到这一点。在1992和2018之间，碳分配不当至少达到11.00十亿吨二氧化碳当量（GtCO2eq），造成的环境成本估计为2.2万亿美元（2018美元）。这对于高碳石油的主要生产商来说意味着巨大的供应方生态债务。展望未来，我们估计，沿着与9.30净零排放目标相一致的未来总需求路径，使矿床水平开采在约1.9 GtCO2eq上达到社会最佳效益，价值为2050万亿美元，并记录石油国家之间不平等的储备搁浅。

records.title_en: Creating Cohesive Communities: A Youth Camp Experiment in India
records.title_cn: 创建有凝聚力的社区：印度的青年营实验
records.abstract_en: Non-family-based institutions for socializing young people may play a vital role in creating close-knit, inclusive communities. We study the potential for youth camps—integrating rituals, sports, and civics training—to strengthen intergroup cohesion. We randomly assigned Hindu and Muslim adolescent boys, from West Bengal, India, to 2-week camps or to a pure control arm. To isolate mechanisms, we cross-randomized collective rituals (such as singing the national anthem, wearing uniforms, chanting support during matches, and synchronous dancing) and the intensity of intergroup contact. We find that camps reduce ingroup bias, increase willingness to interact with outgroup members, and enhance psychological well-being. Campers continue to have twice as many outgroup friends than control participants 1 year after the camps ended. Meanwhile, additional camp elements have heterogeneous effects: rituals have more positive impacts for the Hindu majority than the Muslim minority, while higher intergroup contact backfires among Hindus but not Muslims. Our findings demonstrate that inclusive youth camps may be a powerful tool for bridging deep social divides. Yet, we also highlight the conceptual challenges in crafting optimal integrative camps that help all groups.
records.abstract_cn: 为年轻人提供社交服务的非家庭机构可能在创建紧密、包容的社区方面发挥着至关重要的作用。我们研究了青年营——整合仪式、体育和公民培训——增强群体间凝聚力的潜力。我们将来自印度西孟加拉邦的印度教和穆斯林青春期男孩随机分配到2周的营地或纯粹的对照组。为了隔离机制，我们交叉随机化了集体仪式（例如唱国歌、穿制服、比赛期间高呼支持、同步跳舞）和群体间接触的强度。我们发现营地减少了内群体偏见，增加了与外群体成员互动的意愿，并增强了心理健康。训练营结束一年后，营员的外群体朋友数量仍然是对照组参与者的两倍1。与此同时，额外的营地元素会产生异质性的影响：仪式对占多数的印度教徒比占少数的穆斯林有更积极的影响，而较高的群体间接触会适得其反，在印度教徒中而不是穆斯林中。我们的研究结果表明，包容性青年营可能是弥合深刻的社会分歧的有力工具。然而，我们也强调了打造帮助所有群体的最佳融合营地的概念挑战。

records.title_en: Retractions: Updating from Complex Information
records.title_cn: 撤回：从复杂信息中更新
records.abstract_en: We modify a canonical experimental design to identify the effectiveness of retractions. Comparing beliefs after retractions to beliefs (1) without the retracted information and (2) after equivalent new information, we find that retractions result in diminished belief updating in both cases. We propose this reflects updating from retractions being more complex, and our analysis supports this: we find longer response times, lower accuracy, and higher variability. The results—robust across diverse participant groups and design variations—enhance our understanding of belief updating and offer insights into addressing misinformation.
records.abstract_cn: 我们修改了规范的实验设计来确定撤回的有效性。将撤回后的信念与没有撤回信息的信念（1）和同等新信息后的信念（2）进行比较，我们发现在这两种情况下撤回都会导致信念更新减少。我们认为这反映了撤回更新变得更加复杂，我们的分析支持了这一点：我们发现响应时间更长、准确性更低、可变性更高。结果在不同的参与者群体和设计变化中都很稳健，增强了我们对信念更新的理解，并为解决错误信息提供了见解。

records.title_en: Unemployment Insurance Reforms and Labour Market Dynamics
records.title_cn: 失业保险改革与劳动力市场动态
records.abstract_en: A key question in labour market research is how the unemployment insurance system affects unemployment rates and labour market dynamics. We provide new answers to this old question by studying one of the largest unemployment insurance reforms in recent decades, the German Hartz reforms. On average, lower separation rates into unemployment account for 76% of declining unemployment after the reform, a fact unexplained by existing research focussing on job-finding rates. Exploiting institutional changes by age, employment duration, and wages, we establish a causal link between the reform and changes in labour market dynamics. Relying on the labour market theory, we generalize our empirical findings beyond the German case and establish separation rate changes as an important macroeconomic adjustment channel after unemployment insurance reforms. We derive analytically that the change of separation rates increases in proportion to average unemployment duration suggesting an equally important role for most other European labour markets.
records.abstract_cn: 劳动力市场研究的一个关键问题是失业保险制度如何影响失业率和劳动力市场动态。我们通过研究近几十年来最大规模的失业保险改革——德国哈茨改革，为这个老问题提供了新的答案。平均而言，改革后失业率下降的原因是失业率下降76%，这一事实在关注就业率的现有研究中无法解释。利用年龄、就业期限和工资的制度变化，我们在改革与劳动力市场动态变化之间建立了因果关系。依托劳动力市场理论，我们将实证结果推广到德国案例之外，并将分离率变化确立为失业保险改革后重要的宏观经济调节渠道。我们分析得出，离职率的变化与平均失业持续时间成正比，这表明大多数其他欧洲劳动力市场也发挥着同样重要的作用。

records.title_en: How Important Is Health Inequality for Lifetime Earnings Inequality?
records.title_cn: 健康不平等对于终生收入不平等有多重要？
records.abstract_en: Using a dynamic panel approach, we provide empirical evidence that negative health shocks significantly reduce earnings. The effect is primarily driven by the participation margin and is concentrated among the less educated and those in poor health. Next, we develop a life-cycle model of labour supply featuring risky and heterogeneous frailty profiles that affect individuals’ productivity, likelihood of access to social insurance, disutility from work, mortality, and medical expenses. Individuals can either work or not work and apply for social security disability insurance (SSDI/SSI). Eliminating health inequality in our model reduces the variance of log lifetime (accumulated) earnings by 28% at age 55. About 60% of this effect is due to the impact of poor health on the probability of obtaining SSDI/SSI benefits. Despite this, we show that eliminating the SSDI/SSI program reduces ex ante welfare.
records.abstract_cn: 使用动态面板方法，我们提供了经验证据，表明负面的健康冲击会显着降低收入。这种效应主要是由参与幅度驱动的，并且集中在受教育程度较低和健康状况不佳的人群中。接下来，我们开发了一个劳动力供应的生命周期模型，该模型具有风险和异质的脆弱性特征，影响个人的生产力、获得社会保险的可能性、工作负效用、死亡率和医疗费用。个人可以工作或不工作并申请社会保障残疾保险（SSDI/SSI）。消除我们模型中的健康不平等，可以将年龄 28% 时对数寿命（累积）收入的方差降低 55。这种影响的大约 60% 是由于健康状况不佳对获得 SSDI/SSI 福利的概率的影响。尽管如此，我们表明取消 SSDI/SSI 计划会降低事前福利。

records.title_en: The Value of Privacy in Cartels: An Analysis of the Inner Workings of a Bidding Ring
records.title_cn: 卡特尔中隐私的价值：投标环内部运作的分析
records.abstract_en: We study how incentive constraints can be relaxed by randomization in a repeated-game setting. Our study is motivated by the workings of a detected bidding cartel that adopted a protocol of keeping the winning bid secret from the designated losers when defection was a concern. Keeping the winning bid secret makes accurately undercutting the winning bid more difficult and makes defection less attractive as potential defectors risk not winning the auction even if they deviate. We formalize these ideas in the context of a repeated-game setting and show that a cartel can attain higher payoffs by having the pre-selected winner randomize its bid and keep it secret from other members. Calibration of the model to the bid data of the cartel suggests that randomization may increase firms’ profits by about 56%.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究如何通过重复游戏环境中的随机化来放松激励约束。我们的研究是受一个被发现的投标卡特尔运作的启发，该卡特尔采用了一项协议，当存在叛逃问题时，对指定的失败者保密中标投标。对中标竞价保密会使准确地削弱中标竞价变得更加困难，并且使叛逃者的吸引力降低，因为潜在的叛逃者即使偏离，也面临着无法赢得拍卖的风险。我们在重复博弈的背景下将这些想法形式化，并表明卡特尔可以通过让预先选定的获胜者随机化其出价并对其他成员保密来获得更高的回报。根据卡特尔的投标数据对模型进行校准表明，随机化可能会使公司的利润增加约56%。

records.title_en: Pareto Improvements in the Contest for College Admissions
records.title_cn: 大学招生竞赛中的帕累托改进
records.abstract_en: Many countries base college admissions on a centrally administered test. Students invest a great deal of resources to improve their performance on the test, and there is growing concern about the high costs associated with these activities. We consider modifying the test by introducing performance-disclosure policies that pool intervals of performance rankings. Pooling affects the equilibrium allocation of students to colleges, which hurts some students and benefits others, but also affects students’ effort. We investigate how such policies can improve students’ welfare in a Pareto sense, study the Pareto frontier of pooling policies, and identify improvements that are robust to the distribution of college seats. We illustrate the potential applicability of our results with an empirical estimation that uses data on college admissions in Turkey. We find that a policy that pools a large fraction of the lowest-performing students leads to a Pareto improvement in a contest based on the estimated parameters. A laboratory experiment based on the estimated parameters generally supports our theoretical predictions.
records.abstract_cn: 许多国家的大学招生以集中管理的考试为基础。学生投入大量资源来提高考试成绩，人们越来越担心与这些活动相关的高成本。我们考虑通过引入绩效披露政策来修改测试，这些政策汇集了绩效排名的区间。汇集影响了学生到大学的均衡分配，对一些学生不利，对另一些学生有利，但也影响了学生的努力程度。我们研究这些政策如何在帕累托意义上改善学生的福利，研究汇集政策的帕累托前沿，并找出对大学席位分配强有力的改进措施。我们通过使用土耳其大学招生数据的实证估计来说明我们的结果的潜在适用性。我们发现，将大部分表现最差的学生集中在一起的政策会导致基于估计参数的竞赛出现帕累托改进。基于估计参数的实验室实验通常支持我们的理论预测。

records.title_en: Attention Utility: Evidence from Individual Investors
records.title_cn: 注意力效用：来自个人投资者的证据
records.abstract_en: We study attention utility, the hedonic pleasure or pain derived purely from paying attention to information, which differs from the news utility that arises from gaining new information. The main, field, study examines brokerage account login data to show that investors pay disproportionate attention to already-known positive information on their stocks. Through its effect on logins, this selective attention affects their trading activity. Three experimental studies then show that (1) investors are more likely to engage in a paid task that will involve attention to a prior investment if that investment has gained value; (2) paying attention to a winning stock is more motivating than a doubling of monetary incentives; and that (3) attention has value independent of information acquisition.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究注意力效用，即纯粹因关注信息而产生的享乐或痛苦，这与获得新信息所产生的新闻效用不同。这项主要领域的研究检查了经纪账户登录数据，结果表明投资者对其股票的已知积极信息给予了过多的关注。通过对登录的影响，这种选择性关注会影响他们的交易活动。 三实验研究表明，(1)投资者更有可能参与一项有偿任务，如果该投资已经获得了价值，那么该任务将涉及对先前投资的关注； (2) 关注获胜股票比加倍金钱激励更有激励作用；并且（3）注意力具有独立于信息获取的价值。

records.title_en: Belief Identification by Proxy
records.title_cn: 代理信念识别
records.abstract_en: It is well-known that individual beliefs cannot be identified using traditional choice data, unless we exogenously assume state-independent utilities. In this paper, I propose a novel methodology that solves this long-standing identification problem in a simple way. This method relies on extending the state space by introducing a proxy, for which the agent has no stakes conditional on the original state space. The latter allows us to identify the agent’s conditional beliefs about the proxy given each state realization, which in turn suffices for indirectly identifying her beliefs about the original state space. This approach is analogous to the one of instrumental variables in econometrics. Similarly to instrumental variables, the appeal of this method comes from the flexibility in selecting a proxy.
records.abstract_cn: 众所周知，除非我们外生地假设与状态无关的效用，否则无法使用传统的选择数据来识别个人信念。在本文中，我提出了一种新颖的方法，以简单的方式解决了这个长期存在的识别问题。该方法依赖于通过引入代理来扩展状态空间，代理在原始状态空间上没有任何利益条件。后者允许我们在给定每个状态实现的情况下识别代理对代理的条件信念，这反过来又足以间接识别她对原始状态空间的信念。这种方法类似于计量经济学中工具变量的一。与工具变量类似，这种方法的吸引力来自于选择代理的灵活性。

records.title_en: An assessment of the ecosystem services content of green plans as an evaluation proxy for the delivery of urban green infrastructure
records.title_cn: 评估绿色规划的生态系统服务内容作为城市绿色基础设施交付的评价指标
records.abstract_en: To facilitate well-being and health amongst urban populations, there is a need for urban spatial plans to promote sustainable development, leading to considerable interest and practice related to the delivery of urban green infrastructure (UGI). One approach for delivering UGI is through the adoption of green plans. However, green plans vary considerably in their structure and content, and there is a pressing need to evaluate whether green plans incorporate the necessary range of ecosystem services (ES). In this paper, we adopt an existing evaluation method using coding to determine the extent to which ES are embedded explicitly and implicitly in green plans. We apply this to a unique situation of the Brazilian city of São Paulo which has four separate green plans (investigating each plan individually for potential ES delivery) and adapt the method to separate the rhetoric of plans from their tangible actions in order to get closer to an analysis of ES outcomes. The four green plans that make up the green area system present greater or lesser participation and intensity of the ES concept which can influence the UGI implementation. However, the analysis comparing the content and discursive representation of each green plan with its respective plan actions showed, except for one of the four plans, that the delivery of ES through the green plans focuses more on rhetoric than action. To deliver the desired UGI for ensuring urban sustainability, green plans must not only mention ES in their content but should embed ES in their plan actions.
records.abstract_cn: 为了促进城市人口的福祉和健康，需要制定城市空间规划来促进可持续发展，从而引起人们对城市绿色基础设施（UGI）的极大兴趣和实践。实现 UGI 的一种方法是采用绿色计划。然而，绿色计划的结构和内容差异很大，迫切需要评估绿色计划是否包含必要的生态系统服务（ES）范围。在本文中，我们采用现有的编码评估方法来确定ES在绿色计划中显式和隐式嵌入的程度。我们将其应用于巴西圣保罗市的独特情况，该市有四个独立的绿色计划（单独调查每个计划的潜在 ES 交付），并采用该方法将计划的言辞与实际行动分开，以便更接近对 ES 结果的分析。构成绿地系统的四个绿色规划或多或少地体现了ES概念的参与和强度，这可以影响UGI的实施。然而，将每个绿色计划的内容和话语表述与其各自的计划行动进行比较的分析表明，除了四个计划之一之外，通过绿色计划交付的ES更多地侧重于言辞而不是行动。为了提供所需的 UGI 以确保城市可持续发展，绿色规划不仅必须在其内容中提及 ES，而且还应将 ES 嵌入其计划行动中。

records.title_en: Amazon deforestation: Drivers, damages, and policies
records.title_cn: 亚马逊森林砍伐：驱动因素、损害与政策
records.abstract_en: This review discusses the economic drivers, the environmental damages, and the policies enacted to fight Amazon deforestation. It provides key statistics about conservation in the nine Amazon countries, and discusses the underlying causes leading to forest destruction in the region. Economic exploitation of the forest generates profits, but forest destruction creates harm on global, regional, and local levels. The global harm is the impact of greenhouse gas emissions on climate change. Regional damage is due to the impact of deforestation on rainfall, and the impact of forest fires on air pollution. On a local level, deforestation destroys ecosystem services, and mining activities pollute water bodies. The chapter proposes a typology of conservation policies: bans on deforestation, financial incentives, land tenure regulations, market access, sustainable practices, and indirect instruments. It discusses examples of policies and reviews impact evaluations.
records.abstract_cn: 本综述讨论了亚马逊森林砍伐的经济驱动因素、环境损害以及为应对砍伐而制定的政策。它提供了关于九个亚马逊国家保护的关键统计数据，并讨论了导致该地区森林破坏的根本原因。对森林的经济开发产生了利润，但森林破坏在全球、区域和地方层面造成了损害。全球损害是温室气体排放对气候变化的影响。区域损害是由于砍伐对降雨的影响，以及森林火灾对空气污染的影响。在地方层面，砍伐破坏了生态系统服务，采矿活动污染了水体。本章提出了保护政策的类型学：禁止砍伐、财政激励、土地权属法规、市场准入、可持续实践和间接工具。它讨论了政策实例并回顾了影响评估。

records.title_en: Scale mismatches and the value of social networks in access to sanitation facilities in Mwanza City, Tanzania: A Socio-Ecological Network analysis
records.title_cn: 规模错配与社会网络在坦桑尼亚姆万扎市卫生设施获取中的价值：社会-生态网络分析
records.abstract_en: While economic inequalities and poor governance are known to influence environmental practices, including access to sanitation, the mismatches in scale and the value of social networks within landscape patterns remain understudied. Understanding how scale mismatches and social networks impact access to sanitation facilities can help identify necessary strategies for improvement. However, research exploring how these elements of the Socio-Ecological Network (SEN) Approach influence access to sanitation facilities for residents of gentle slopes, sloping landscapes, and steep slopes is limited. This study analysed how scale mismatches and the value of social networks shape access to sanitation facilities. Data were generated from household surveys, key informant interviews, focus group discussion, and a review of relevant documents. Data analysis was carried out using descriptive statistics and ethnographic content analysis techniques. The results indicated that there was inadequate implementation of guidelines advocating for access to sanitation facilities for low-income individuals. Furthermore, variations in social networks were observed between residents in different landscape patterns and city actors, contributing to discrepancies in the proportion of households connected to water services. Specifically, gentle slopes had the highest connection rate (77.14 %), followed by sloping landscapes (64.97 %), and steep slopes (42.86 %). Overall, scale mismatches and social networks within and across landscape patterns significantly influence access to sanitation facilities. Further progress could be achieved through enhanced government oversight of settlement development, fostering harmonious relationships between steep slope residents and city actors, and implementing effective policy governance.
records.abstract_cn: 虽然经济不平等和治理不善已知会影响环境实践，包括卫生设施的获取，但景观格局中的规模错配和社会网络的价值仍未得到充分研究。理解规模错配和社会网络如何影响卫生设施的获取，有助于确定改进的必要策略。然而，探讨社会-生态网络（SEN）方法中这些要素如何影响缓坡、斜坡景观和陡坡居民获取卫生设施的研究有限。本研究分析了规模错配和社会网络的价值如何塑造卫生设施的获取。数据来源于家庭调查、关键知情人访谈、焦点小组讨论以及相关文献的回顾。数据分析采用描述性统计和民族志内容分析技术。结果表明，针对低收入个体获取卫生设施的指导方针执行不足。此外，不同景观格局的居民与城市行动者之间的社会网络存在差异，导致连接到供水服务的家庭比例出现差异。具体而言，缓坡的连接率最高（77.14%），其次是斜坡景观（64.97%），陡坡最低（42.86%）。总体而言，景观格局内部及跨景观格局的规模错配和社会网络显著影响卫生设施的获取。通过加强政府对定居点发展的监管、促进陡坡居民与城市行动者之间的和谐关系以及实施有效的政策治理，可以取得进一步进展。

records.title_en: Land use as a target for terrorism: A geospatial and temporal framework of terrorist preferences analysis in Egypt
records.title_cn: 土地利用作为恐怖主义的目标：埃及恐怖分子偏好分析的地理空间与时间框架
records.abstract_en: Many regions of the world are suffering from terrorist attacks. Terrorist groups are targeting certain types of land use based on their agendas. This study examines the spatial and temporal patterns of targeted land use types by terrorists over more than fifty years in Egypt between 1970 and 2020. We utilized quantitative statistical analysis and spatial and temporal analysis techniques to understand how terrorists target different land use types in Egypt. These analysis techniques include the Shannon diversity index (SDI), the Jaccard similarity index (JSI), standard distance (SD), global and local Moran's index, and the Local Indicators of Spatial Association (LISA). The analysis identified 19 distinct land use categories targeted by terrorist activities. Among these, police-related targets were the most frequent (33 %), followed by military targets (27 %) and private citizens/property (12 %). Cairo, the capital of the country, emerged as the most diverse in terms of targeted land uses. Terrorist attacks on businesses, police, and tourism-related land uses were found to be more geographically dispersed compared to other land use types. The North Sinai Governorate concentrated attacks on military and food/water-related land uses, while Cairo remained the epicenter for many terrorist targets. Temporal analysis indicated dynamic shifts in both the spatial dispersion and focal points of terrorist activity across land use types over time. Moran’s I spatial autocorrelation analysis revealed that attacks on ten land use categories followed a random spatial pattern, while the remaining categories including military exhibited significant spatial clustering. This study provides a replicable framework for analyzing terrorism’s geospatial dynamics for targeted land use. Policymakers can leverage these findings to enhance security measures, allocate resources efficiently, and mitigate future threats. The interdisciplinary approach bridges gaps in terrorism research, contributing to both academic discourse and practical security applications.
records.abstract_cn: 世界上许多地区正遭受恐怖袭击。恐怖组织根据其议程针对特定类型的土地利用。本研究考察了埃及在1970至2020年间五十多年中，恐怖分子针对的土地利用类型的空间和时间模式。我们利用定量统计分析以及空间和时间分析技术来理解恐怖分子如何在埃及针对不同的土地利用类型。这些分析技术包括香农多样性指数（SDI）、杰卡德相似性指数（JSI）、标准距离（SD）、全局和局部莫兰指数，以及空间关联局部指标（LISA）。分析识别出19种被恐怖活动针对的不同土地利用类别。其中，与警察相关的目标最为频繁（33%），其次是军事目标（27%）和普通公民/财产（12%）。该国首都开罗在针对的土地利用类型方面表现最多样化。针对商业、警察和旅游相关土地利用的恐怖袭击在地理分布上比其他土地利用类型更为分散。北西奈省集中了对军事和食品/水相关土地利用的袭击，而开罗仍然是许多恐怖目标的中心。时间分析表明，随着时间的推移，不同土地利用类型上恐怖活动的空间分散性和焦点均发生了动态变化。莫兰I空间自相关分析显示，对十种土地利用类别的袭击遵循随机空间模式，而其余类别（包括军事）表现出显著的空间聚集。本研究为分析恐怖主义针对土地利用的地理空间动态提供了一个可复制的框架。政策制定者可以利用这些发现来加强安全措施、有效分配资源并减轻未来威胁。这种跨学科方法弥合了恐怖主义研究中的空白，为学术讨论和实际安全应用都做出了贡献。

records.title_en: Optimizing developed cultivated pastures for sustainable rangeland management: Evidence of ecological efficiency from China’s agro-pastoral ecotone
records.title_cn: 优化开发型人工草场以实现可持续草地管理：来自中国农牧交错带的生态效率证据
records.abstract_en: The 'small versus large area principle' posits that establishing small-scale cultivated pastures can effectively help conserve large rangeland areas from degradation. This theory underpins the global promotion of developed cultivated pastures (DCP). However, its effectiveness in simultaneously supporting rangeland restoration and herder livelihoods remains uncertain, with studies reporting conflicting outcomes. Understanding the performance of cultivated pastures is crucial for promoting sustainable livestock systems in fragile areas. Based on 252 household surveys conducted in the agro-pastoral ecotone of northern China (APENC), this study investigates the impact of DCP on ecological efficiency (EE), an indicator reflecting the ability of households to achieve economic output with minimal inputs and environmental costs. EE is calculated using the slack-based measure (SBM) model, and the impact of DCP on EE is analyzed using the Tobit model. Major findings indicate a concave relationship between DCP and EE, with optimal balance at 3.29 ha. Beyond this threshold, further expansion of DCP may reduce EE by incentivizing herders to enlarge flock sizes. Particularly, these effects are pronounced among small households compared to large ones. The study provides household-level evidence on the eco-economic trade-offs of cultivated pastures, offering insights for rangeland management in ecologically fragile pastoral regions worldwide.
records.abstract_cn: '小面积原则'认为，建立小规模的人工草场可以有效帮助保护大面积草地免受退化。这一理论支撑了全球范围内开发型人工草场（DCP）的推广。然而，其在同时支持草地恢复和牧民生计方面的有效性仍不确定，研究报告了相互矛盾的结果。理解人工草场的绩效对于促进脆弱地区可持续畜牧系统至关重要。基于在中国北方农牧交错带（APENC）进行的252户家庭调查，本研究探讨了DCP对生态效率（EE）的影响，该指标反映了家庭以最少投入和环境成本实现经济产出的能力。EE使用基于松弛的测度（SBM）模型计算，DCP对EE的影响通过Tobit模型分析。主要发现表明，DCP与EE之间存在凹形关系，最优平衡点为3.29公顷。超过这一阈值，进一步扩大DCP可能通过激励牧民扩大畜群规模而降低EE。特别是，这些效应在小规模家庭中比大规模家庭更为显著。本研究提供了关于人工草场生态经济权衡的家庭层面证据，为全球生态脆弱牧区的草地管理提供了见解。

records.title_en: Evaluating the spatial-temporal impact of urban nature on urban vitality in Vancouver: A social media and GPS data approach
records.title_cn: 评估温哥华城市自然对城市活力的时空影响：一种社交媒体和GPS数据方法
records.abstract_en: Natural elements in urban environments enhance livability and health, strengthening urban vitality. However, existing research has primarily focused on physical indicators, with limited attention paid to the joint influence of behavioral and perceptual dimensions on urban vitality. To address this gap, this study integrates a spatiotemporal analytical framework encompassing three dimensions: natural elements, human perception, and activity diversity. Focusing on Vancouver, we utilized smartphone-GPS and social media data from 2018 to 2023 to explore temporal (weekdays vs. weekends) and spatial dimensions. Using machine learning techniques (Google vision, K-means and Sentiment analysis) on multivariate social media data, and we also analyzed changes in activity diversity over time. We assessed the multidimensional influences on urban vitality using the Geographically and Temporally Weighted Regression (GTWR) model. Our results show that during the pandemic, attention to nature and outdoor activities increased significantly, while cultural and social activities and transportation initially decreased but quickly recovered. Sentiment scores, natural elements, and human activity preferences significantly influenced urban vitality during COVID-19, with notable spatiotemporal heterogeneity. The pandemic intensified residents' reliance on natural spaces and green transportation, altering the spatial distribution of urban vitality. These findings provide a basis for optimizing natural spaces and sustainable transportation planning in future urban development.
records.abstract_cn: 城市环境中的自然元素提升了宜居性和健康水平，增强了城市活力。然而，现有研究主要关注物理指标，对行为和感知维度对城市活力的联合影响关注有限。为弥补这一空白，本研究整合了一个包含三个维度的时空分析框架：自然元素、人类感知和活动多样性。以温哥华为研究对象，我们利用了从2018年到2023年的智能手机GPS和社交媒体数据，探索了时间（工作日与周末）和空间维度。使用机器学习技术（Google视觉、K-means和情感分析）处理多变量社交媒体数据，我们还分析了活动多样性随时间的变化。我们使用地理和时间加权回归（GTWR）模型评估了对城市活力的多维影响。结果表明，在疫情期间，对自然和户外活动的关注显著增加，而文化和社会活动及交通最初减少但迅速恢复。情感得分、自然元素和人类活动偏好显著影响了COVID-19期间的城市活力，并表现出显著的时空异质性。疫情加剧了居民对自然空间和绿色交通的依赖，改变了城市活力的空间分布。这些发现为未来城市发展中优化自然空间和可持续交通规划提供了基础。

records.title_en: Asymmetric thermal effects of urban vegetation greening and browning
records.title_cn: 城市植被绿化和褐化的不对称热效应
records.abstract_en: Urban vegetation regulates local thermal environments, yet rapid urbanization has simultaneously driven widespread browning that undermines these benefits. Although greening is widely promoted as a heat-mitigation strategy, its capacity to mitigate the warming from browning remains unclear, particularly given the potentially asymmetric thermal responses of these processes. Here, using 30m-resolution Landsat data (2000–2024), we mapped greening and browning across the Yangtze River Economic Belt, quantified their thermal effects, and explored the underlying drivers. We found that browning (35.1 %) outpaced greening (21.6 %), with the former concentrated in expansion zones and the latter in urban cores. These changes produced strongly asymmetric thermal effects: while browning increased daytime land surface temperature (LST) by 0.44 °C, greening reduced it by 0.59 °C, offsetting 134 % of the warming. However, the cooling effect of greening was limited in the two sub-periods (2000–2012 and 2012–2024) and rapidly expanding cities, and even leading to nighttime warming. Vegetation greenness changes and the area of browning emerged as primary drivers of these outcomes. Our findings highlight the limitations of relying solely on greening strategies for urban heat mitigation, and emphasize the urgent need to curb browning through proactive land-use planning to support climate-resilient urban development.
records.abstract_cn: 城市植被调节当地的热环境，但快速的城市化同时导致了广泛的褐变，从而破坏了这些好处。尽管绿化作为一种​​缓解热量的策略被广泛推广，但其缓解褐变变暖的能力仍不清楚，特别是考虑到这些过程可能存在不对称的热响应。在这里，我们利用 30m 分辨率的陆地卫星数据 (2000-2024) 绘制了整个长江经济带的绿化和褐变图，量化了它们的热效应，并探讨了潜在的驱动因素。我们发现褐化（35.1%）超过了绿化（21.6%），前者集中在扩张区，后者集中在城市核心区。这些变化产生了强烈不对称的热效应：褐化使白天地表温度 (LST) 增加了 0.44 °C，而绿化则使白天地表温度 (LST) 降低了 0.59 °C，抵消了变暖的 134%。然而，在2000-2012和2012-2024两个子时期和快速扩张的城市中，绿化的降温效果有限，甚至导致夜间变暖。植被绿度变化和褐变面积成为这些结果的主要驱动因素。我们的研究结果强调了仅依靠绿化策略来缓解城市热量的局限性，并强调迫切需要通过积极主动的土地利用规划来抑制褐变，以支持气候适应型城市发展。

records.title_en: Influence pathways of village livelihood capital on the idle homesteads reuse
records.title_cn: 村庄生计资本对闲置宅基地再利用的影响路径
records.abstract_en: Rapid urbanization and rural restructuring have led to widespread idle homesteads, presenting significant challenges for sustainable rural development worldwide. This study investigates the configurational influences of livelihood capitals on idle homestead reuse at the village level in rural China. By explicitly incorporating institutional capital as a sixth dimension into the sustainable livelihood framework (SLF), we systematically examine how various capitals interact in nonlinear, complex configurations to drive homestead reuse outcomes. Methodologically, we integrate fuzzy-set Qualitative Comparative Analysis (fsQCA) and Necessary Condition Analysis (NCA) using comprehensive survey data collected from 43 villages. The findings reveal that no single type of livelihood capital independently constitutes a necessary condition; instead, idle homestead reuse results from five distinct and sufficient configurations, characterized by complex interactions among collective economic strength, internal trust, infrastructure completeness, organizational capacity, and resource endowments. Institutional capital emerges as particularly crucial, functioning variably across contexts: it serves as either a critical enabling factor, a complementary support, or even occasionally as a limiting condition, depending on the specific configuration of other livelihood capitals and regional circumstances. Furthermore, significant regional variations exist between western and non-western China, underscoring the necessity for differentiated and context-sensitive policy interventions. These findings enhance the theoretical understanding of rural land use transitions and provide valuable, actionable insights for policymakers aiming to promote sustainable rural development and optimize land resource utilization in developing regions.
records.abstract_cn: 快速城市化和农村重构导致了广泛的闲置宅基地，对全球可持续农村发展构成了重大挑战。本研究探讨了中国农村村庄层面生计资本对闲置宅基地再利用的组态影响。通过将制度资本明确纳入可持续生计框架（SLF）作为第六个维度，我们系统地考察了各种资本如何在非线性、复杂的组态中相互作用以推动宅基地再利用结果。在方法上，我们整合了模糊集定性比较分析（fsQCA）和必要条件分析（NCA），使用了从43个村庄收集的全面调查数据。研究发现，没有任何单一类型的生计资本独立构成必要条件；相反，闲置宅基地再利用源于五种不同且充分的组态，其特征是集体经济实力、内部信任、基础设施完善度、组织能力和资源禀赋之间的复杂互动。制度资本显得尤为关键，在不同情境中发挥不同作用：它要么作为关键赋能因素，要么作为补充支持，甚至偶尔作为限制条件，具体取决于其他生计资本和区域情况的具体组态。此外，中国西部与非西部之间存在显著的区域差异，强调了采取差异化且情境敏感的政策干预的必要性。这些发现增强了对农村土地转型的理论理解，并为旨在促进可持续农村发展和优化发展中地区土地资源利用的政策制定者提供了有价值的、可操作的见解。

records.title_en: Unveiling soil stewardship: plural values in the management of the Montado agro-silvo-pastoral system in Portugal
records.title_cn: 揭示土壤管理：葡萄牙蒙塔多农林牧复合系统中的多元价值
records.abstract_en: Farmers’ and landowners’ decisions affecting soil management reflect not only economic motivations related to productivity, but also deeper principles and values associated with soil health. However, such values are often implicit and not explicitly acknowledged in decision-making processes. In complex agro-silvo-pastoral systems like the Montado in Southern Iberia, where multiple productive and climatic pressures intersect, soil often remains hidden in farmers’ strategic priorities. This study investigates the values and motivations behind soil regeneration efforts in the Montado, a multifunctional system capable of delivering a wide range of ecosystem services but increasingly threatened by degradation and decline. Drawing on interviews with farmers and landowners, we developed a value-driven understanding of soil health through the analytical dimensions of care, knowledge, and agency. While Montado farmers show strong commitment to soil health and have sought out education and innovative practices, they often lack long-term planning capacity, technical support, and feel poorly supported by current policy instruments. This results in fragmented and short-term soil management strategies. At the same time, key stewardship values including place attachment, self-determination and responsibility, emerge as powerful motivators for regenerative practices. Yet these values alone are not sufficient to translate into effective agency when the agricultural knowledge and innovation system (AKIS) remains weak and uncoordinated. The case of Montado underscores the need for governance frameworks that recognize both instrumental and non-instrumental values, integrating them into policy and advisory systems. Doing so could better align support structures with farmers’ lived realities, enabling more coherent and scalable soil regeneration efforts.
records.abstract_cn: 影响土壤管理的农民和土地所有者的决策不仅反映了与生产力相关的经济动机，还反映了与土壤健康相关的更深层次的原则和价值观。然而，这些价值往往隐含在决策过程中，并未得到明确承认。在伊比利亚南部的蒙塔多等复杂农林牧复合系统中，多种生产和气候压力交织，土壤往往在农民的战略优先事项中被忽视。本研究调查了蒙塔多土壤再生努力背后的价值和动机，蒙塔多是一个多功能系统，能够提供广泛的生态系统服务，但日益受到退化和衰退的威胁。通过对农民和土地所有者的访谈，我们从关怀、知识和能动性三个分析维度发展了对土壤健康的基于价值的理解。虽然蒙塔多农民表现出对土壤健康的强烈承诺，并寻求教育和创新实践，但他们往往缺乏长期规划能力、技术支持，并感到当前政策工具支持不足。这导致了零散和短期的土壤管理策略。与此同时，包括地方依恋、自决和责任感在内的关键管理价值，作为再生实践的有力动机出现。然而，当农业知识和创新系统（AKIS）薄弱且不协调时，仅靠这些价值不足以转化为有效的能动性。蒙塔多的案例强调了治理框架的必要性，这些框架承认工具性和非工具性价值，并将其纳入政策和咨询系统。这样做可以更好地将支持结构与农民的实际生活现实对齐，从而实现更连贯和可扩展的土壤再生努力。

records.title_en: Rapid expansion of photovoltaic land in China's coastal regions: A doubling from 2020 to 2023
records.title_cn: 中国沿海地区光伏用地快速扩张：从2020到2023翻倍
records.abstract_en: Driven by SDG 7 and Carbon Peak and Carbon Neutrality Strategy, China has accelerated the construction of Photovoltaic (PV) in its coastal regions. However, the rapid expansion of PV land in these areas has intensified land-use conflicts. This study applies an improved random forest approach to extend PV land monitoring, analyzes its spatiotemporal changes and explored its driving factors. The findings reveal that by 2023, the total area of PV land in China’s coastal provinces reached 1962.89 km², doubling the area recorded before 2020. Over 70 % of the PV land area is located north of the Yangtze River. The combined areas of Agrivoltaics and Floating PV account for 57 % of the total PV land area, while 18 % of PV land in coastal regions are distributed on marginal land. Adequate solar energy resources, suitable terrain conditions, and well-developed power infrastructure are the main driving factors for the rapid development of photovoltaic land. The potential impact of photovoltaic land on farmland cultivation and grain production is enormous, which may affect grain production by 1.97 × 105 tons. This study suggests prioritizing the use of marginal land, low-cost land, and unused land, and developing more efficient photovoltaic equipment to reduce the land area required for photovoltaic systems. This study improved the extraction algorithm to monitor PV land distribution, quantitatively analyzes the driving factors behind PV land expansion in China’s coastal regions and investigates the potential impacts on agricultural production, providing scientific evidence for future policy development and regional planning of PV projects.
records.abstract_cn: 在可持续发展目标7和碳达峰与碳中和战略的推动下，中国加快了沿海地区光伏建设。然而，这些地区光伏用地的快速扩张，加剧了用地矛盾。本研究应用改进的随机森林方法来扩展光伏土地监测，分析其时空变化并探讨其驱动因素。调查结果显示，截至2023，中国沿海省份光伏用地总面积达到1962.89平方公里，是2020之前记录面积的两倍。超过70%的光伏土地面积位于长江以北。农业光伏和浮式光伏发电面积合计占光伏用地总面积的57%，而沿海地区光伏用地的18%分布在边际土地上。充足的太阳能资源、适宜的地形条件、发达的电力基础设施是光伏土地快速发展的主要驱动因素。光伏用地对农田耕种和粮食生产的潜在影响巨大，可能影响粮食产量1.97×105吨。本研究建议优先利用边际土地、低成本土地和未利用土地，开发更高效的光伏设备，以减少光伏系统所需的土地面积。本研究改进了光伏用地分布监测的提取算法，定量分析了中国沿海地区光伏用地扩张的驱动因素，并探讨了对农业生产的潜在影响，为未来光伏项目的政策制定和区域规划提供了科学依据。

records.title_en: The evolving landscape of farmland ownership in Europe: Implications for food system sustainability
records.title_cn: 欧洲农田所有权的演变格局：对粮食系统可持续性的影响
records.abstract_en: This study examines the evolving dynamics of farmland ownership in Europe, focusing on the implications of ownership changes, foreign direct investments (FDI), and land concentration on the sustainability and resilience of European food systems. A scoping review of academic literature, available data sources, and policy documents revealed a knowledge gap regarding the evolution of European farmland ownership and its sustainability impacts. To address this, a pan-European geospatial statistical analysis was conducted, identifying ownership patterns, temporal changes and related economic performance. Subsequently, the statistical analysis provides a foundation to assess how ownership transformations affect food system sustainability and resilience. Findings show that in 2020, family farms were the dominant landowners across Europe. However, between 2016 and 2020, a shift toward company-owned farms occurred, particularly in Central and Eastern Europe. Drawing on global research on land acquisitions and sustainable agriculture, the study underscores that while company-owned farms may offer economic efficiencies, family farm ownership is vital for food security and local control over land and production. The study calls for continued monitoring of ownership trends and deeper investigation into their benefits, risks, and consequences.
