records.abstract_en: This article introduces a nonlinear generalized matrix factor model, moving beyond the linear-Gaussian framework to accommodate a broader class of response models typically handled via logit, probit, Poisson, or Tobit structures. We introduce a novel Lagrange multiplier method carefully tailored to ensure that the penalized likelihood function is locally concave around the true factor and loading parameters. This leads to central limit theorems of the estimated factors and loadings which is nontrivial for nonlinear matrix factor modeling. We establish the convergence rates of the estimated factor and loading matrices for the generalized matrix factor model under general conditions that allow for correlations across samples, rows, and columns. We provide a model selection criterion to determine the numbers of row and column factors. Extensive simulation studies demonstrate the superiority in handling discrete and mixed-type variables of the generalized matrix factor model. An empirical data analysis of the company’s operating performance shows that the generalized matrix factor model does clustering and reconstruction well in the presence of discontinuous entries in the data matrix.
records.abstract_cn: 本文介绍了一种非线性广义矩阵因子模型，超越了线性高斯框架，以适应通常通过logit、probit、Poisson或Tobit结构处理的更广泛的响应模型类别。我们引入了一种新颖的拉格朗日乘子方法，精心定制以确保惩罚似然函数在真实因子和载荷参数附近局部凹性。这导致了估计因子和载荷的中心极限定理，这对于非线性矩阵因子建模而言是非平凡的。我们在允许样本、行和列之间相关的通用条件下，建立了广义矩阵因子模型估计因子和载荷矩阵的收敛速率。我们提供了一种模型选择准则来确定行因子和列因子的数量。广泛的模拟研究表明，广义矩阵因子模型在处理离散和混合类型变量方面具有优越性。对公司经营绩效的实证数据分析表明，广义矩阵因子模型在数据矩阵存在不连续条目时，能够很好地完成聚类和重构。

records.title_en: Doubly-robust inference for conditional average treatment effects with high-dimensional controls
records.title_cn: 高维控制变量下条件平均处理效应的双重稳健推断
records.abstract_en: Plausible identification of conditional average treatment effects (CATEs) can rely on controlling for a large number of variables to account for confounding factors. In these high-dimensional settings, estimation of the CATE requires estimating first-stage models whose consistency relies on correctly specifying their parametric forms. While doubly-robust estimators of the CATE exist, inference procedures based on the second-stage CATE estimator are not doubly-robust. Using the popular augmented inverse propensity weighting signal, we propose an estimator for the CATE whose resulting Wald-type confidence intervals are doubly-robust. We assume a logistic model for the propensity score and a linear model for the outcome regression, and estimate the parameters of these models using an ℓ1 (Lasso) penalty to address the high-dimensional covariates. Inference based on this estimator remains valid even if one of the logistic propensity score or linear outcome regression models are misspecified.
records.abstract_cn: 条件平均处理效应（CATE）的合理识别可以依赖于控制大量变量以解释混杂因素。在这些高维设置中，估计CATE需要估计第一阶段模型，其一致性依赖于对其参数形式的正确设定。尽管存在CATE的双重稳健估计量，但基于第二阶段CATE估计量的推断程序并非双重稳健。利用流行的增强逆倾向加权信号，我们提出了一种CATE估计量，其生成的Wald型置信区间是双重稳健的。我们假设倾向得分采用逻辑模型，结果回归采用线性模型，并使用ℓ1（Lasso）惩罚来估计这些模型的参数以处理高维协变量。基于该估计量的推断即使逻辑倾向得分或线性结果回归模型之一被错误设定，仍然有效。

records.title_en: GLS estimation of local projections: Trading robustness for efficiency
records.title_cn: 局部投影的GLS估计：以稳健性换取效率
records.abstract_en: Local projections (LPs) are widely used for estimating impulse responses (IRs) as they are considered more robust to model misspecification than forward-iterated IRs from dynamic models such as VARs. However, this robustness comes at the cost of higher variance, particularly at longer horizons. To mitigate this trade-off, several GLS transformations of LPs have been proposed. This paper analyzes two broad strands of GLS-type LP estimators: those that condition on residuals from an auxiliary VAR, and those that condition on residuals from previous-horizon LPs. We show that the former impose a VAR structure, which leads them to align with VAR IRs, while the latter preserve the unrestricted nature of LPs but end up replicating LP OLS estimates. Consequently, the intended efficiency gains are either not achieved or come at the expense of the very robustness that motivates the use of LPs.
records.abstract_cn: 局部投影（LPs）被广泛用于估计脉冲响应（IRs），因为它们被认为比从动态模型（如VAR）前向迭代得到的IRs对模型误设更具稳健性。然而，这种稳健性以更高的方差为代价，尤其是在较长的时间跨度上。为缓解这一权衡，已有多种LPs的GLS变换被提出。本文分析了两大类GLS型LP估计量：一类以辅助VAR的残差为条件，另一类以先前时间跨度LPs的残差为条件。我们表明，前者施加了VAR结构，使其与VAR IRs一致，而后者保留了LPs的无限制性质，但最终复制了LP OLS估计。因此，预期的效率提升要么未能实现，要么以牺牲促使使用LPs的稳健性为代价。

records.title_en: On generalized CCE estimation
records.title_cn: 广义CCE估计
records.abstract_en: The widely-used common correlated effects (CCE) estimator, pioneered by Pesaran (2006), is computed using least squares applied to auxiliary regressions where the observed regressors are augmented with cross-sectional averages of the dependent variable and regressors. However, the CCE estimator requires a crucial rank condition and becomes inconsistent when this condition is violated and the factor loadings of the x- and y -equations are correlated, causing an endogeneity issue. This paper proposes a generalized CCE (GCCE) estimator by augmenting the regression with both cross-sectional and time-series averages of the regressors. We argue that the time-series average can serve as “control variables” to address the endogeneity issue. We show that the GCCE and CCE estimators are asymptotically equivalent when the rank condition holds, and the GCCE estimator remains consistent even when the rank condition is violated under our “control variable” condition. Therefore, our GCCE estimator is doubly robust, achieving consistency under either the rank condition or the “control variable” condition. Furthermore, we propose a leave-one-out jackknife method to conduct valid inferences regardless of whether the rank condition holds. Monte Carlo simulations demonstrate excellent performance of our estimators and inference methods in finite samples. We apply our new methods to two datasets to estimate the production function and gravity equation.
records.abstract_cn: 由Pesaran（2006）首创的广泛使用的公共相关效应（CCE）估计器，是通过对辅助回归应用最小二乘法计算的，其中观测到的回归变量增加了因变量和回归变量的横截面平均值。然而，CCE估计器需要一个关键的秩条件，当该条件被违反且x方程和y方程的因子载荷相关时，会导致内生性问题，从而使估计不一致。本文通过增加回归变量和回归变量的横截面平均值及时间序列平均值，提出了一种广义CCE（GCCE）估计器。我们认为时间序列平均值可以作为“控制变量”来解决内生性问题。我们证明，当秩条件成立时，GCCE和CCE估计器是渐近等价的，而在我们的“控制变量”条件下，即使秩条件被违反，GCCE估计器仍然保持一致。因此，我们的GCCE估计器具有双重稳健性，在秩条件或“控制变量”条件下都能实现一致性。此外，我们提出了一种留一法刀切法，无论秩条件是否成立，都能进行有效的推断。蒙特卡洛模拟证明了我们的估计器和推断方法在有限样本中的优异表现。我们将新方法应用于两个数据集，以估计生产函数和引力方程。

records.title_en: Efficient estimation of structural models via sieves
records.title_cn: 通过筛子对结构模型的有效估计
records.abstract_en: We propose a class of sieve-based efficient estimators for structural models (SEES), which approximate the solution using a linear combination of basis functions and impose equilibrium conditions as a penalty to determine the best-fitting coefficients. Our estimators circumvent repeated solution of the structural model, apply to a broad class of models, and are consistent, asymptotically normal, and asymptotically efficient. Moreover, they solve unconstrained optimization problems with fewer unknowns and offer convenient standard error calculations. As an illustration, we apply our method to an entry game between Walmart and Kmart.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一类基于筛子的结构模型有效估计器（SEES），该方法使用基函数的线性组合来近似解，并通过施加均衡条件作为惩罚来确定最佳拟合系数。我们的估计器避免了重复求解结构模型，适用于广泛类别的模型，并且具有一致性、渐近正态性和渐近有效性。此外，它们解决了具有较少未知数的无约束优化问题，并提供了便捷的标准误计算。作为示例，我们将该方法应用于沃尔玛和凯马特之间的进入博弈。

records.title_en: Identification in nonlinear dynamic panel models under partial stationarity
records.title_cn: 部分平稳性下非线性动态面板模型的识别
records.abstract_en: This paper provides a general identification approach for a wide range of nonlinear panel data models, including binary choice, ordered response, and other types of limited dependent variable models. Our approach accommodates dynamic models with any number of lagged dependent variables as well as other types of endogenous covariates. Our identification strategy relies on a partial stationarity condition, which allows for not only an unknown distribution of errors, but also temporal dependencies in errors. We derive partial identification results under flexible model specifications and establish sharpness of our identified set in the binary choice setting. We demonstrate the robust finite-sample performance of our approach using Monte Carlo simulations, and apply the approach to the empirical analysis of income categories using various ordered choice models.
records.abstract_cn: 本文为广泛的非线性面板数据模型提供了一种通用的识别方法，包括二元选择、有序响应以及其他类型的受限因变量模型。我们的方法适用于具有任意数量滞后因变量的动态模型以及其他类型的内生协变量。我们的识别策略依赖于部分平稳性条件，该条件不仅允许误差分布未知，还允许误差存在时间依赖性。我们在灵活模型设定下推导出部分识别结果，并在二元选择设定中确立了识别集的锐利性。我们通过蒙特卡洛模拟展示了该方法稳健的有限样本性能，并将该方法应用于使用各种有序选择模型对收入类别的实证分析。

records.title_en: Dynamic panel data quantile regression with network-linked fixed effects
records.title_cn: 带有网络关联固定效应的动态面板数据分位数回归
records.abstract_en: This paper introduces a dynamic panel data quantile regression model with network-linked fixed effects, named DQR-NFE, in which unobserved individual heterogeneity is structured through an underlying network. The corresponding estimator is derived by incorporating a quantile network cohesion (QNC) penalty into the dynamic panel quantile regression framework. This penalty encourages connected units within the network to exhibit similar conditional quantiles, with a particularly increased capacity to capture tail network dependence. Relative to conventional fixed-effects specifications, the proposed framework improves the estimation of unobserved heterogeneity and enables more accurate prediction in cold-start settings where training data are unavailable. We establish the consistency and asymptotic normality of the DQR-NFE estimators within a general nonlinear structural framework. These theoretical guarantees hold under both correctly specified and misspecified network structures, with an explicit characterization of their dependence on the network topology. Simulation studies and empirical applications reveal that the proposed estimator outperforms competing approaches in terms of both estimation accuracy and out-of-sample forecasting.
records.abstract_cn: 本文介绍了一种带有网络关联固定效应的动态面板数据分位数回归模型，命名为DQR-NFE，其中未观测到的个体异质性通过潜在网络进行结构化。相应的估计量通过将分位数网络凝聚（QNC）惩罚纳入动态面板分位数回归框架中推导得出。该惩罚鼓励网络内相连单元表现出相似的条件分位数，特别增强了捕捉尾部网络依赖性的能力。相对于传统的固定效应设定，所提出的框架改进了未观测异质性的估计，并在训练数据不可用的冷启动环境中实现了更准确的预测。我们在一般非线性结构框架内建立了DQR-NFE估计量的一致性和渐近正态性。这些理论保证在正确设定和错误设定的网络结构下均成立，并明确刻画了它们对网络拓扑的依赖性。模拟研究和实证应用表明，所提出的估计量在估计精度和样本外预测方面均优于竞争方法。

records.title_en: Inference for two-stage experiments under covariate-adaptive randomization
records.title_cn: 协变量自适应随机化下两阶段实验的推断
records.abstract_en: This paper studies inference in two-stage randomized experiments under covariate-adaptive randomization. In the initial stage of this experimental design, clusters (e.g., households, schools, or graph partitions) are stratified and randomly assigned to control or treatment groups based on cluster-level covariates. Subsequently, an independent second-stage design is carried out, wherein units within each treated cluster are further stratified and randomly assigned to either control or treatment groups, based on individual-level covariates. Under the homogeneous partial interference assumption, I establish conditions under which the proposed difference-in-“average of averages” estimators are consistent and asymptotically normal for the corresponding average primary and spillover effects and develop consistent estimators of their asymptotic variances. Combining these results establishes the asymptotic validity of tests based on these estimators. My findings suggest that ignoring covariate information in the design stage can result in efficiency loss, and commonly used inference methods that ignore or improperly use covariate information can lead to either conservative or invalid inference. Then, I apply these results to studying optimal use of covariate information under covariate-adaptive randomization in large samples, and demonstrate that a specific generalized matched-pair design achieves minimum asymptotic variance for each proposed estimator. Finally, I discuss covariate adjustment, which incorporates additional baseline covariates not used for treatment assignment. The practical relevance of the theoretical results is illustrated through a simulation study and an empirical application.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了在协变量自适应随机化下两阶段随机实验的推断问题。在该实验设计的初始阶段，聚类（例如，家庭、学校或图划分）根据聚类层面的协变量进行分层，并随机分配到对照组或处理组。随后，进行独立的第二阶段设计，其中每个处理聚类内的单元根据个体层面的协变量进一步分层，并随机分配到对照组或处理组。在同质部分干扰假设下，我建立了所提出的“平均值之差”估计量对于相应的平均主要效应和溢出效应具有一致性和渐近正态性的条件，并开发了其渐近方差的一致估计量。结合这些结果，确立了基于这些估计量的检验的渐近有效性。我的发现表明，在设计阶段忽略协变量信息可能导致效率损失，而常见的不考虑或不当使用协变量信息的推断方法可能导致保守或无效的推断。然后，我将这些结果应用于研究在大样本下协变量自适应随机化中协变量信息的最优使用，并证明一种特定的广义匹配对设计对于每个提出的估计量都能达到最小渐近方差。最后，我讨论了协变量调整，该调整纳入了未用于处理分配的额外基线协变量。理论结果的实际相关性通过模拟研究和实证应用加以说明。

records.title_en: A simple, robust identification approach for first-price auctions
records.title_cn: 一种简单、稳健的一级价格拍卖识别方法
records.abstract_en: This paper proposes a new approach to the identification of first-price auctions that is robust to overbidding, but at the same time remains contiguous with the canonical point-identification approach of Guerre et al. (2000) (GPV) and its simple estimators. We show that a weak identifying restriction allows us to reinterpret the GPV estimates as a bound. We demonstrate that the identifying restriction holds in a set of commonly used auction models that can generate overbidding and is satisfied in the bid data from a laboratory experiment. We illustrate the approach in applications to laboratory data and field data. We recommend that practitioners continue to follow the GPV approach, but interpret the estimates as a bound in applications where they are concerned about overbidding.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种新的识别一级价格拍卖的方法，该方法对过度出价具有稳健性，但同时与Guerre等人（2000）（GPV）的经典点识别方法及其简单估计量保持连续性。我们证明，一个较弱的识别约束允许我们将GPV估计重新解释为一个界限。我们证明了该识别约束在一组能够产生过度出价的常用拍卖模型中成立，并且在实验室实验的出价数据中得到满足。我们在实验室数据和实地数据的应用中展示了该方法。我们建议实践者继续遵循GPV方法，但在担心过度出价的应用中，应将估计解释为一个界限。

records.title_en: The natural rate of interest through a hall of mirrors
records.title_cn: 透过镜像迷宫看自然利率
records.abstract_en: We propose a novel explanation for persistent movements in the natural rate of interest, or r-star, based on a model of two-sided learning between the central bank and the private sector. Each side has some information about r-star fundamentals and also learns from observing output, inflation and interest rates. When both sides fail to recognise that their actions influence the other’s beliefs, a “hall-of-mirrors” effect arises that causes persistent shifts in r-star in response to cyclical shocks. The model can explain the post-2008 decline in r-star without changes in long-run fundamentals, as well as the excess sensitivity of long-term yields to monetary policy surprises and the underreaction of interest rate forecasts. Aggressive policy easing designed to counter a recession can inadvertently lower r-star and endogenously narrow policy space.
records.abstract_cn: 我们基于中央银行与私人部门之间双向学习的模型，提出了对自然利率（即r-star）持续性变动的新解释。每一方都掌握一些关于r-star基本面的信息，并通过观察产出、通胀和利率来学习。当双方都未能认识到自身行为会影响对方的信念时，就会出现“镜像迷宫”效应，导致r-star对周期性冲击产生持续性变动。该模型可以解释2008年后r-star的下降，而无需改变长期基本面，同时也能解释长期收益率对货币政策意外的过度敏感以及利率预测的反应不足。为应对衰退而采取的激进政策宽松可能无意中降低r-star，并内生性地收窄政策空间。

records.title_en: Generating inflation expectations with large language models
records.title_cn: 利用大型语言模型生成通胀预期
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the generation of inflation expectations using generative AI in survey experiments, examining diverse agents created with both proprietary and open-source large language models (LLMs). It shows that model architecture significantly impacts expectations, with proprietary models generally exhibiting less disagreement in their responses than open-source alternatives. Some LLMs predict higher inflation than actual rates, aligning with patterns observed in the Survey of Consumer Expectations. Information treatments, particularly forward guidance on inflation, influence LLMs’ inflation expectations, though with varying magnitudes across model types. Customizing prompts with demographic personas induces heterogeneous responses that mirror human survey behaviors, with some biases similar to those documented in household surveys. The paper also demonstrates how central banks could leverage these models as communication policy tools to test messaging strategies before implementation.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究在调查实验中使用生成式人工智能生成通胀预期，考察了由专有和开源大型语言模型（LLMs）创建的不同智能体。研究表明，模型架构对预期有显著影响，专有模型在响应中的分歧通常小于开源替代模型。一些LLMs预测的通胀率高于实际水平，这与消费者预期调查中观察到的模式一致。信息处理，特别是关于通胀的前瞻性指引，会影响LLMs的通胀预期，尽管不同模型类型的影响幅度有所不同。使用人口统计特征定制提示词会引发异质性响应，这些响应反映了人类调查行为，其中一些偏差与家庭调查中记录的偏差相似。本文还展示了中央银行如何利用这些模型作为沟通政策工具，在实施前测试信息传递策略。

records.title_en: Biased surveys
records.title_cn: 有偏的调查
records.abstract_en: We find empirical evidence that surveys of professional forecasters are biased by strategic incentives. First, we find that individual forecasts overreact to idiosyncratic information but underreact to common information. We show this is consistent with a model of strategic diversification incentives in forecast reporting where forecasters want to optimally “stand out” from the crowd, and thus report forecasts that exaggerate the agents’ true beliefs. Second, we show that no such biases are present in forecasts data that is not subject to strategic incentives. We also test further comparative statics that also confirm the strategic incentive model. Overall, we conclude that strategic reporting biases the inference an econometrician can draw on the true underlying expectations formation process, and the precision and heterogeneity in agents’ information sets, and lastly we show how to correct for this.
records.abstract_cn: 我们发现了专业预测者调查因策略性激励而产生偏差的经验证据。首先，我们发现个体预测对特殊信息过度反应，但对公共信息反应不足。我们表明这与预测报告中策略性多样化激励的模型一致，其中预测者希望最优地“脱颖而出”，从而报告夸大代理人真实信念的预测。其次，我们表明在不受策略性激励影响的预测数据中不存在此类偏差。我们还测试了进一步比较静态分析，这些分析也证实了策略性激励模型。总体而言，我们得出结论，策略性报告会使计量经济学家对真实预期形成过程的推断，以及代理人信息集中的精确性和异质性产生偏差，最后我们展示了如何对此进行修正。

records.title_en: A theory of fear of floating
records.title_cn: 浮动恐惧理论
records.abstract_en: Central banks with flexible exchange rate regimes are often reluctant to let their currency float, a phenomenon known as “fear of floating.” We develop a framework in which a floating exchange rate may exacerbate vulnerability to self-fulfilling financial crises rather than provide the intended insulation against external shocks. A commitment to a crawling peg—where the currency can fluctuate within a predetermined band—can help mitigate the risk of self-fulfilling crises. In contrast to the Mundell–Fleming paradigm, the optimal exchange rate policy entails allowing the exchange rate to float in response to real shocks while maintaining it fixed in response to non-fundamental shocks.
records.abstract_cn: 实行浮动汇率制度的中央银行往往不愿让其货币浮动，这一现象被称为“浮动恐惧”。我们构建了一个框架，在该框架中，浮动汇率可能加剧对自我实现金融危机的脆弱性，而非提供预期的对外部冲击的隔离。承诺实行爬行盯住汇率制度——即货币可以在预定区间内波动——有助于缓解自我实现危机的风险。与蒙代尔-弗莱明范式相反，最优汇率政策要求允许汇率对实际冲击作出浮动反应，同时在对非基本面冲击时保持固定。

records.title_en: Dissecting the great retirement boom
records.title_cn: 解析大退休潮
records.abstract_en: Between 2020 and 2023, the fraction of retirees in the working-age population in the U.S. increased above its pre-pandemic trend. Several explanations have been proposed to rationalize this gap, including increases in net worth, the deterioration of the labor market with higher job separations, the expansion of fiscal transfer programs, and higher mortality risk. We develop an incomplete markets, overlapping generations model with a frictional labor market to quantitatively study the interaction of these factors and decompose their contributions to the rise in retirements. We find that new retirements were concentrated at the bottom of the income distribution, and the most important factors driving the rise in retirements were higher job separations and the expansion of fiscal transfers. We show that our model’s predictions on aggregate labor market moments and cross-sectional moments on retirement patterns across income and wealth distributions are in line with the data.
records.abstract_cn: 在2020年至2023年间，美国劳动年龄人口中退休人员的比例上升至高于疫情前趋势的水平。已有多种解释被提出以合理化这一差距，包括净资产增加、劳动力市场恶化导致更高的职位分离率、财政转移支付项目的扩张以及更高的死亡风险。我们构建了一个具有摩擦性劳动力市场的不完全市场世代交叠模型，以定量研究这些因素的相互作用，并分解它们对退休人数上升的贡献。我们发现，新增退休人员集中在收入分配的底部，而推动退休人数上升的最重要因素是更高的职位分离率和财政转移支付的扩张。我们表明，我们的模型在总体劳动力市场矩以及按收入和财富分布划分的退休模式的横截面矩方面的预测与数据相符。

records.title_en: Soft landing and inflation scares
records.title_cn: 软着陆与通胀恐慌
records.abstract_en: We discuss the timing and strength of the Fed’s reaction to the recent inflation surge within an estimated macroeconomic model where long-run inflation expectations are heterogeneous and can lose their anchoring to the target. The resulting inflation scare worsens the real cost of disinflation. We derive a closed-form solution that retains the entire time-varying cross-sectional distribution of subjective inflation beliefs. We estimate the model using Bayesian techniques on both US macroeconomic time series and forecast data from the Survey of Professional Forecasters. Counterfactual simulations show that the timing – rather than the strength – of the policy reaction to the inflation surge is critical to contain the development of an inflation scare and prevent the entrenchment of above-target inflation. We show that the Fed fell behind the curve in 2021 since an earlier tightening could have reduced the inflation peak without triggering a recession. However, further delays would have unanchored inflation expectations, aggravated the inflation scare and strengthened the inflation surge, resulting in larger output losses.
records.abstract_cn: 我们在一个估计的宏观经济模型中讨论了美联储对近期通胀飙升反应的时机和力度，该模型中长期通胀预期是异质的，并且可能失去对目标的锚定。由此产生的通胀恐慌加剧了反通胀的实际成本。我们推导出一个闭式解，该解保留了主观通胀信念的整个时变横截面分布。我们使用贝叶斯技术对美国宏观经济时间序列和来自专业预测者调查的预测数据进行模型估计。反事实模拟表明，政策对通胀飙升反应的时机——而非力度——对于遏制通胀恐慌的发展并防止高于目标的通胀根深蒂固至关重要。我们表明，美联储在2021年落后于曲线，因为更早的紧缩本可以降低通胀峰值而不引发衰退。然而，进一步的延迟会使通胀预期脱锚，加剧通胀恐慌并强化通胀飙升，从而导致更大的产出损失。

records.title_en: Inequality and asset prices during Sudden Stops
records.title_cn: 突然停止期间的不平等与资产价格
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the cross-sectional dimension of Fisher’s debt-deflation mechanism that triggers endogenous Sudden Stop crises — i.e., episodes with large reversals in the current account. Analyzing microdata from Mexico, we show that this dimension has macroeconomic implications that operate via opposing effects. First, an amplifying effect by which households with high leverage fire-sale their assets during crises, increasing downward pressure on asset prices. Second, a dampening effect by which wealthy households with low leverage buy depressed assets, relieving downward pressure on asset prices. As a result, the role of inequality during crises is ambiguous. We conduct a quantitative analysis using a calibrated small open economy, asset-pricing model with heterogeneous agents and aggregate risk to measure the effects of inequality during crises. The model suggests that economies with lower inequality, whether due to reduced idiosyncratic risk or wealth redistribution across agents, experience less severe crises, as observed in the data.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了费雪债务通缩机制的横截面维度，该机制触发内生性突然停止危机——即经常账户大幅逆转的时期。通过分析墨西哥的微观数据，我们表明这一维度通过相反的作用产生宏观经济影响。首先，放大效应，即高杠杆家庭在危机期间抛售资产，增加资产价格的下行压力。其次，抑制效应，即低杠杆的富裕家庭购买贬值资产，缓解资产价格的下行压力。因此，不平等在危机期间的作用是模糊的。我们使用校准的小型开放经济、资产定价模型，包含异质主体和总体风险，进行定量分析，以衡量危机期间不平等的影响。模型表明，不平等程度较低的经济体，无论是由于个体风险降低还是财富在主体间的再分配，经历的危机严重程度较低，正如数据所观察到的。

records.title_en: Bridging micro and macro production functions: The fiscal multiplier of infrastructure investment
records.title_cn: 连接微观与宏观生产函数：基础设施投资的财政乘数
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates the fiscal multiplier of infrastructure investment using an estimated heterogeneous-firm general equilibrium model. We theoretically and quantitatively show that the firm-level non-rivalry in infrastructure usage drives a significant discrepancy in the estimated input elasticities between the firm and state levels. Moreover, it microfounds the increasing returns to scale assumption in a representative-agent framework (Baxter and King, 1993). The quantitative findings indicate a fiscal multiplier of approximately 1.15 over a 2-year horizon, suggesting a significantly greater net economic benefit than the representative-agent model prediction. This is due to the low sensitivity of the firm-level investment to the general equilibrium effect, followed by a significantly dampened crowding out.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用一个估计的异质性企业一般均衡模型研究基础设施投资的财政乘数。我们在理论和数量上表明，企业层面在基础设施使用上的非竞争性导致了企业和国家层面估计的投入弹性之间存在显著差异。此外，它为代表性主体框架中的规模报酬递增假设提供了微观基础（Baxter和King，1993）。定量研究结果表明，在2年时间范围内，财政乘数约为1.15，这表明其净经济效益显著大于代表性主体模型的预测。这是由于企业层面的投资对一般均衡效应的敏感性较低，随后挤出效应显著减弱。

records.title_en: The rise of AI pricing: Trends, driving forces, and implications for firm performance
records.title_cn: AI定价的兴起：趋势、驱动力及其对企业绩效的影响
records.abstract_en: We document key stylized facts about the time-series trends and cross-sectional distributions of artificial intelligence (AI)-powered pricing and study its implications for firm performance, both on average and in response to monetary policy shocks. We use the online job postings data from Lightcast to measure the adoption of AI pricing. We infer that a firm is adopting AI pricing if it posts a job that requires AI-related skills and contains the keyword “pricing.” At the aggregate level, the share of AI pricing jobs in all pricing jobs has increased more than tenfold since 2010. The rise of AI pricing jobs has been broad-based, spreading across more industries than other types of AI jobs. At the firm level, larger and more productive firms are more likely to adopt AI pricing. Firms that adopted AI pricing experienced faster growth in sales, employment, assets, and markups, and their stock returns are also more responsive to high-frequency monetary policy surprises than non-adopters. We show that these empirical observations can be rationalized by a simple model where a monopolist firm with incomplete information about its demand function invests in AI pricing to acquire information.
records.abstract_cn: 我们记录了人工智能（AI）驱动定价的时间序列趋势和横截面分布的关键典型事实，并研究了其对企业绩效的影响，既包括平均影响，也包括对货币政策冲击的响应。我们使用来自Lightcast的在线职位发布数据来衡量AI定价的采用情况。我们推断，如果一家公司发布的职位要求具备AI相关技能并包含关键词“定价”，则该公司在采用AI定价。在总体层面，自2010年以来，AI定价职位在所有定价职位中的占比增长了十倍以上。AI定价职位的增长具有广泛性，其覆盖的行业范围比其他类型的AI职位更广。在企业层面，规模更大、生产率更高的企业更可能采用AI定价。采用AI定价的企业在销售额、就业、资产和加成率方面经历了更快的增长，其股票回报对高频货币政策意外事件的响应也强于未采用者。我们表明，这些实证观察可以通过一个简单模型来解释，在该模型中，对其需求函数信息不完全的垄断企业投资于AI定价以获取信息。

records.title_en: The impact of AI on global knowledge work
records.title_cn: 人工智能对全球知识工作的影响
records.abstract_en: We analyze how Artificial Intelligence (AI) reshapes global knowledge work in a two-region world where firms organize production hierarchically to use knowledge efficiently: the most knowledgeable individuals specialize in problem-solving, while others perform routine work. Before AI, the Advanced Economy specializes in problem-solving services, whereas the Emerging Economy focuses on routine work. AI converts compute — which is located in the Advanced Economy — into autonomous “AI agents” that perfectly substitute for humans with a given level of knowledge. Basic AI reduces the Advanced Economy’s net exports of problem-solving services, potentially reversing pre-AI trade patterns. In contrast, sophisticated AI expands these exports, reinforcing existing trade patterns. Finally, we show that a global ban on AI autonomy redistributes AI’s gains toward lower-skilled workers, while a regional ban — such as prohibiting autonomy only in the Emerging Economy — offers little benefit to lower-skilled workers and harms the most knowledgeable individuals in that region.
records.abstract_cn: 我们分析了人工智能（AI）如何在一个两区域世界中重塑全球知识工作，其中企业按层级组织生产以高效利用知识：知识最丰富的个体专门从事问题解决，而其他人则执行常规工作。在AI出现之前，发达经济体专门从事问题解决服务，而新兴经济体则专注于常规工作。AI将计算能力（位于发达经济体）转化为自主的“AI代理”，这些代理完美替代具有给定知识水平的人类。基础AI减少了发达经济体问题解决服务的净出口，可能逆转AI之前的贸易模式。相反，复杂的AI扩大了这些出口，强化了现有的贸易模式。最后，我们表明，全球禁止AI自主性将AI的收益重新分配给低技能工人，而区域禁令——例如仅在新兴经济体禁止自主性——对低技能工人的益处甚微，并损害该地区知识最丰富的个体。

records.title_en: AI and task efficiency
records.title_cn: 人工智能与任务效率
records.abstract_en: We model several ways in which AI may improve decisions, raise the productivity of firms, and raise human capital growth. Each focuses on activities that involve problem solving, with solutions being guided by signals. If AI raises the accuracy of the signals, humans will then make better decisions — individually and in groups.
records.abstract_cn: 我们构建了人工智能可能改善决策、提高企业生产率以及促进人力资本增长的几种模型。每种模型都聚焦于涉及问题解决的活动，其解决方案由信号引导。如果人工智能提高了信号的准确性，那么人类——无论是个人还是群体——将做出更好的决策。

records.title_en: Is it AI or data that drives firm market power?
records.title_cn: 是人工智能还是数据驱动了企业市场势力？
records.abstract_en: The technology revolution is transforming firm and industry dynamics, yet the roots of firm dominance in the modern economy remain unclear. Is industry dynamism driven by compute capabilities (AI), access to data, or the interaction between them? We develop a dynamic model in which firms gain knowledge from raw data using AI, but face “informational entropy”: without sufficient AI, more raw data leads to information overload and has negative returns. The model has two key predictions: (1) improvements in AI (compute) disproportionately benefit data-rich firms; and (2) access to processed data substitutes for compute, increasing industry dynamism and reducing market concentration. We confirm these predictions using novel data from 2000–2023 and two exogenous shocks: the 2006 launch of Amazon Web Services (AWS) and the 2017 introduction of transformer-based architectures. Our findings suggest that regulating data usability, not just AI models, is essential to preserving competition in the modern economy.
records.abstract_cn: 技术革命正在改变企业和行业动态，然而现代经济中企业主导地位的根源仍不明确。行业动态是由计算能力（人工智能）、数据获取还是它们之间的相互作用驱动的？我们开发了一个动态模型，其中企业利用人工智能从原始数据中获取知识，但面临“信息熵”：在没有足够人工智能的情况下，更多原始数据会导致信息过载并产生负回报。该模型有两个关键预测：（1）人工智能（计算）的改进不成比例地惠及数据丰富的企业；（2）获取处理后的数据替代计算，增加行业动态并降低市场集中度。我们使用来自2000-2023的新数据和两个外生冲击验证了这些预测：2006年亚马逊网络服务（AWS）的推出和2017年基于变换器架构的引入。我们的研究结果表明，监管数据可用性，而不仅仅是人工智能模型，对于维护现代经济中的竞争至关重要。

records.title_en: Multinational production and global shock propagation during the great recession
records.title_cn: 跨国生产与全球衰退期间的冲击传导
records.abstract_en: Using a new database on global multinational production (MP), I document that world multinational enterprise (MNE) sales declined as sharply as trade during the Great Recession (2008–2009). This collapse was driven by MNEs from a few key headquarters countries and associated with steeper GDP declines in MP-intensive countries. MNEs amplified the trade collapse because their overall sales fell while they maintained higher trade intensity than domestic firms. In a calibrated quantitative model with flexible vertical and horizontal MNE structures, international trade, and input–output linkages, I show that productivity shocks, which disproportionately affected trade-intensive MNEs, contributed more to the trade collapse than demand shocks. MNEs’ productivity shocks accounted for over half of the global GDP decline during the Great Recession. MP linkages significantly amplified the transmission of headquarters-country productivity shocks to global GDP, MP, and trade.
records.abstract_cn: 利用一个新的全球跨国生产（MP）数据库，我记录了在大衰退（2008-2009年）期间，世界跨国企业（MNE）的销售额下降幅度与贸易下降幅度一样剧烈。这一崩溃是由来自少数几个关键总部国家的跨国企业驱动的，并与跨国生产密集型国家的GDP下降更为陡峭相关。跨国企业放大了贸易崩溃，因为它们的总销售额下降，同时它们保持了比国内企业更高的贸易强度。在一个具有灵活垂直和水平跨国企业结构、国际贸易和投入产出关联的校准定量模型中，我表明，不成比例地影响贸易密集型跨国企业的生产率冲击，比需求冲击对贸易崩溃的贡献更大。跨国企业的生产率冲击占大衰退期间全球GDP下降的一半以上。跨国生产联系显著放大了总部国家生产率冲击对全球GDP、跨国生产和贸易的传导。

records.title_en: The price of intelligence: How should socially-minded firms price and deploy AI?
records.title_cn: 智能的价格：具有社会意识的公司应如何定价和部署人工智能？
records.abstract_en: Leading AI firms claim to prioritize social welfare. How should firms with a social mandate price and deploy AI? We derive pricing formulas that depart from profit maximization by incorporating incentives to improve welfare and reduce labor disruptions. Using US data, we evaluate several scenarios. A welfarist firm that values both profit and welfare should price closer to marginal cost, as efficiency gains outweigh distributional concerns. A conservative firm focused on labor-market stability should price above the profit-maximizing level in the short run, especially when its AI may displace low-income workers. Overall, socially minded firms face a trade-off between expanding access to AI and the resulting loss in profits and labor market risks.
records.abstract_cn: 领先的人工智能公司声称优先考虑社会福利。具有社会使命的公司应如何定价和部署人工智能？我们推导出的定价公式偏离了利润最大化，纳入了改善福利和减少劳动力中断的激励。利用美国数据，我们评估了几种情景。一个重视利润和福利的福利主义公司应将价格定得更接近边际成本，因为效率收益超过分配关切。一个专注于劳动力市场稳定的保守公司短期内应将价格定在利润最大化水平之上，尤其是当其人工智能可能取代低收入工人时。总体而言，具有社会意识的公司在扩大人工智能获取与由此产生的利润损失和劳动力市场风险之间面临权衡。

records.title_en: Expectation-driven term structure of equity and bond yields
records.title_cn: 预期驱动的股票与债券收益率期限结构
records.abstract_en: This paper develops a noisy-information equilibrium model to study how subjective expectations shape the joint dynamics of equity and bond yields. In our framework, movements in asset yields are driven by subjective expectations of dividend and GDP growth, rather than time-varying risk premia. A dual-component dividend structure, together with belief distortions, generates key asset-pricing facts: short-term equity yields are more volatile than long-term yields because short-run dividend growth expectations mean-revert to their stable long-run counterpart; the equity yield slope is procyclical due to countercyclical term structure of expected dividend growth; and the bond-stock correlation changes from positive to negative after the late 1990s, reflecting a shift in the correlation between expected GDP and dividend growth. The model also implies predictable dividend strip returns, with predictability declining with maturity due to dividend forecast revisions, and it successfully replicates the observed dynamics of equity yields and some aggregate moments.
records.abstract_cn: 本文开发了一个噪声信息均衡模型，研究主观预期如何塑造股票和债券收益率的联合动态。在我们的框架中，资产收益率的变动由股息和GDP增长的主观预期驱动，而非时变的风险溢价。双成分股息结构，连同信念扭曲，产生了关键的资产定价事实：短期股票收益率比长期收益率更具波动性，因为短期股息增长预期均值回归至其稳定的长期对应值；股票收益率斜率是顺周期的，因为预期股息增长的期限结构是逆周期的；债券-股票相关性在1990年代末之后由正转负，反映了预期GDP增长与股息增长之间相关性的转变。该模型还暗示了可预测的股息条回报，其可预测性随期限增加而下降，这是由于股息预测修正所致，并且它成功复制了观察到的股票收益率动态和一些总体矩。

records.title_en: A choice-based approach to the measurement of inflation expectations
records.title_cn: 基于选择的通胀预期测量方法
records.abstract_en: Economists widely rely on measures of inflation expectations and uncertainty elicited via density forecasts. This approach, which asks respondents to assign probabilities to pre-specified ranges, has proven highly informative, but also faced criticism in recent periods of elevated and volatile inflation. We propose a new method to elicit the full distribution of inflation expectations, which is rooted in decision theory and can be implemented in standard surveys. In two large surveys and a laboratory experiment, we demonstrate that the proposed method leads to well-defined expectations that fulfil both subjective and objective quality criteria. The method is neither perceived as more difficult nor does it take more time to complete compared to the current standard. In contrast to density forecasts, the method is robust to differences in the state of the economy and thus allows comparisons across time and across countries. The method is portable and can be applied to elicit different macroeconomic expectations.
records.abstract_cn: 经济学家广泛依赖通过密度预测引出的通胀预期和不确定性度量。这种方法要求受访者为预先设定的区间分配概率，已被证明信息量丰富，但在近期通胀高企且波动加剧的时期也面临批评。我们提出了一种新方法，用于引出通胀预期的完整分布，该方法植根于决策理论，并可在标准调查中实施。在两项大型调查和一项实验室实验中，我们证明了所提出的方法能够产生定义明确的预期，满足主观和客观质量标准。与当前标准相比，该方法既不被认为更困难，也不耗时更多。与密度预测相比，该方法对经济状态的差异具有稳健性，因此允许跨时间和跨国家的比较。该方法具有可移植性，可应用于引出不同的宏观经济预期。

records.title_en: Consumer durables and monetary policy according to HANK
records.title_cn: 消费者耐用品与货币政策：基于HANK模型的分析
records.abstract_en: Durables’ interest-rate sensitivity and their persistent comovement with nondurable spending are hallmarks of monetary policy transmission. We develop a two-sector HANK model that replicates this pattern—both across spending categories and among households sorted by liquid asset holdings, consistent with empirical evidence. Direct effects of real interest rate changes are quantitatively important in reproducing sectoral expenditure comovement, while infrequent information updating is crucial to match the hump-shaped dynamics of sectoral and aggregate expenditures. Income effects are essential to preventing counterfactual declines in nondurable spending resulting from fiscal interventions specifically aimed at stimulating durable purchases.
records.abstract_cn: 耐用品的利率敏感度及其与非耐用品支出的持续联动是货币政策传导的标志性特征。我们构建了一个两部门HANK模型，该模型复制了这一模式——无论是在支出类别之间，还是在按流动资产持有量排序的家庭之间，均与实证证据一致。实际利率变动的直接效应在再现部门支出联动方面具有定量重要性，而信息更新频率低对于匹配部门及总支出驼峰形动态至关重要。收入效应对于防止专门旨在刺激耐用品购买的财政干预导致非耐用品支出反事实下降至关重要。

records.title_en: Artificial intelligence and cognitive inequality
records.title_cn: 人工智能与认知不平等
records.abstract_en: We combine insights from the medical and artificial intelligence (AI) literatures to propose a novel model, which suggests that the expansion of AI may exacerbate cognitive inequality. Information providers maximize profit by tailoring the complexity of content, offering less cognition-enhancing content to less able customers. While individuals with high cognitive abilities may benefit from this increased within-cognitive-group homogeneity, those with lower cognitive abilities – and even children – may suffer adverse effects. Anecdotal data from political discourse and cognitive skills scores are consistent with the model predictions. The findings introduce a new consideration to the debate on financial literacy and AI regulation.
records.abstract_cn: 我们结合医学和人工智能（AI）文献的见解，提出一个新模型，该模型表明AI的扩展可能加剧认知不平等。信息提供者通过调整内容的复杂性来最大化利润，向能力较弱的客户提供较少促进认知的内容。虽然高认知能力的个体可能从这种认知群体内同质性的增加中受益，但认知能力较低的个体——甚至儿童——可能遭受不利影响。来自政治话语和认知技能得分的轶事数据与模型预测一致。这些发现为金融素养和AI监管的辩论引入了新的考量。

records.title_en: Lender concentration of external debts and sudden stops
records.title_cn: 外部债务的贷款人集中度与骤停
records.abstract_en: This paper studies how the lender structure of external debt affects open economies’ credit conditions via a model with lenders of varying sizes. While atomistic lenders take the collateral price as given, large lenders internalize the pecuniary externality whereby selling foreclosed collateral injects supply and reduces its price. Thus, concentrating external debt in a few large lenders supports a high collateral price during financial downturns, leading borrowers to demand less precautionary savings and overborrow. I document that emerging countries borrow from significantly fewer banks than advanced countries, implying that emerging countries tend to overborrow. This new mechanism complements the existing view of overborrowing due to the pecuniary externality of the borrowers. Under plausible parameterization, the size of the pecuniary externality internalized by lenders is two-thirds of that internalized by borrowers. Finally, allowing lender countries to optimally choose lender structure increases lender concentration, raises debt, and improves borrowers’ welfare.
records.abstract_cn: 本文通过一个包含不同规模贷款人的模型，研究外部债务的贷款人结构如何影响开放经济体的信贷条件。原子式贷款人将抵押品价格视为给定，而大型贷款人则将变卖止赎抵押品会增加供给并降低其价格这一金钱外部性内部化。因此，将外部债务集中在少数大型贷款人手中，能在金融下行期间支撑较高的抵押品价格，导致借款人减少预防性储蓄需求并过度借贷。本文记录到，新兴国家从显著少于发达国家的银行借款，这意味着新兴国家倾向于过度借贷。这一新机制补充了现有关于借款人金钱外部性导致过度借贷的观点。在合理的参数化下，贷款人内部化的金钱外部性规模为借款人所内部化规模的三分之二。最后，允许贷款国最优地选择贷款人结构会增加贷款人集中度，提高债务水平，并改善借款人的福利。

records.title_en: Unilateral environmental policy and offshoring
records.title_cn: 单边环境政策与离岸外包
records.abstract_en: This paper examines how offshoring shapes emissions leakage and global emissions in response to unilateral environmental policy. We use a general equilibrium offshoring model with heterogeneous firms, based on standard modeling assumptions, where firms allocate labor between production tasks and emissions abatement. We find that global emissions respond non-monotonically to a unilateral emissions tax increase: for small cross-country tax differentials, emissions fall; but as the difference widens, leakage exceeds 100%, raising global emissions due to a global technique effect. The cleanest domestic firms start offshoring and incumbent offshoring firms become dirtier under declining effective foreign taxes. We isolate the offshoring margin – one underexplored channel of leakage – and contrast our findings with comparable models of trade in final goods: the mode of globalization matters. Complementing the unilateral reform with a border carbon adjustment (BCA) prevents emissions leakage but may raise inequality between countries.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了离岸外包如何影响排放泄漏以及单边环境政策下的全球排放。我们使用一个基于标准建模假设、包含异质性企业的通用均衡离岸外包模型，其中企业在生产任务和减排之间分配劳动力。我们发现，全球排放对单边排放税增加的反应是非单调的：对于较小的跨国税率差异，排放下降；但随着差异扩大，泄漏超过100%，由于全球技术效应，全球排放上升。最清洁的国内企业开始离岸外包，而在外国有效税率下降的情况下，现有的离岸外包企业变得更加污染。我们分离了离岸外包边际——一个未被充分探索的泄漏渠道——并将我们的发现与可比性的最终商品贸易模型进行对比：全球化模式至关重要。将单边改革与边境碳调整（BCA）相结合可以防止排放泄漏，但可能加剧国家间的不平等。

records.title_en: What drives exporters’ market dynamics? A new framework for disentangling micro shocks
records.title_cn: 什么驱动了出口商的市场动态？一个用于分解微观冲击的新框架
records.abstract_en: Exporters frequently change their set of destination markets. This paper proposes a new approach to identifying the underlying drivers of changes in exporters’ market decisions over time. The approach exploits information on price and quantity changes in firms’ continuing markets to disentangle the micro shocks that drive firms’ market changes. Applying the method to customs data from China (2000–2006) and the UK (2010–2016), I find consistent results showing that most firm- and firm-product-level market changes are driven by demand-related shocks, with a nontrivial proportion of these changes being correlated across markets.
records.abstract_cn: 出口商经常改变其目的地市场组合。本文提出了一种新方法，用于识别随时间推移出口商市场决策变化的潜在驱动因素。该方法利用企业在持续市场中的价格和数量变化信息，以分解驱动企业市场变化的微观冲击。将该方法应用于中国（2000-2006年）和英国（2010-2016年）的海关数据，我发现一致的结果表明，大多数企业层面和企业-产品层面的市场变化是由需求相关冲击驱动的，其中相当一部分变化在不同市场间具有相关性。

records.title_en: Single and attractive: Uniqueness and stability of economic equilibria under monotonicity assumptions
records.title_cn: 单一且具有吸引力：单调性假设下经济均衡的唯一性与稳定性
records.abstract_en: This paper characterizes equilibrium properties of a broad class of economic models that allow multiple heterogeneous agents to interact in heterogeneous ways across several markets. Our key contribution is a new theorem that provides sufficient conditions for uniqueness, attractivity, and stability of solutions of non-linear equation systems. To illustrate the applicability of our theorem, we characterize the general equilibrium properties of an extended version of the “universal gravity” framework, which comprises a host of seminal trade models. Specifically, we provide conditions for uniqueness, stability, and attractivity when, in line with real-world observations, (i) supply elasticities are allowed to vary by country, or (ii) multiple sectors are introduced. We also provide a practical toolkit for future research on how our theorem can be applied to establish uniqueness, stability, and attractivity of equilibria in a broad set of economic models.
records.abstract_cn: 本文刻画了一类广泛经济模型的均衡性质，这些模型允许多个异质代理在多个市场中以异质方式相互作用。我们的主要贡献是一个新定理，该定理为非线性方程组的解的唯一性、吸引性和稳定性提供了充分条件。为了说明我们定理的适用性，我们刻画了扩展版“普遍引力”框架的一般均衡性质，该框架包含了许多开创性的贸易模型。具体而言，我们提供了在符合现实观察的情况下，即（i）供给弹性允许因国家而异，或（ii）引入多个部门时，唯一性、稳定性和吸引性的条件。我们还为未来研究提供了一个实用工具包，说明如何应用我们的定理来建立广泛经济模型中均衡的唯一性、稳定性和吸引性。

records.title_en: A swing-state theorem, with evidence
records.title_cn: 摇摆州定理及其证据
records.abstract_en: We study the effects of local partisanship in a model of electoral competition. Voters care about policy, but they also care about the identity of the party in power, with most states biassed toward one party or the other (i.e., ‘red’ or ‘blue’). We show that electoral competition leads to maximization of welfare with an extra weight on citizens of the ‘swing state:’ the one that is not biassed toward either party. We show empirically that the US tariff structure is biassed toward swing-state industries, such that a voter living in a non-swing state is treated as being worth 82% as much as a voter in a swing state. This represents a policy bias orders of magnitude greater than the bias found in studies of protection for sale.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了选举竞争模型中地方党派性的影响。选民关心政策，但也关心执政党的身份，大多数州偏向于某一政党（即“红”或“蓝”）。我们表明，选举竞争导致福利最大化，并对“摇摆州”——即不偏向任何一方的州——的公民给予额外权重。我们实证表明，美国关税结构偏向于摇摆州的产业，使得居住在非摇摆州的选民被视同于摇摆州选民的82%的价值。这代表了一种政策偏差，其数量级远大于“保护待售”研究中发现的偏差。

records.title_en: Sanctions, sales, and stigma: Intermediary online firms’ market role in sustaining trade
records.title_cn: 制裁、销售与污名：中介在线企业在维持贸易中的市场角色
records.abstract_en: In the wake of Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022, online intermediaries enabled brands to retain a presence in the Russian market as many global companies—presumably or actually—withdrew due to legal and reputational concerns. This paper examines how sales by intermediaries responded to international sanctions. Using novel data on customer transactions of 95 global brands from 1761 web shops, we show that sales to Russia dropped significantly after the invasion, especially among shops from countries enacting export restrictions. This drop was substantial yet not absolute. Guided by a stylized conceptual framework, we explore which intermediary shops helped sustain sales to Russia, linking their actions to economic incentives and the brand-specific legal and reputational concerns. Overall, we demonstrate how market structure shapes shops’ compliance with sanctions and highlight how economic incentives undermine compliance.
records.abstract_cn: 在俄罗斯于2022年二月全面入侵乌克兰之后，在线中介企业使品牌得以在俄罗斯市场保持存在，而许多全球公司——推测或实际上——因法律和声誉担忧而撤出。本文考察了中介企业的销售如何应对国际制裁。利用来自1761家网店的95个全球品牌的客户交易新数据，我们显示入侵后对俄罗斯的销售显著下降，尤其是来自实施出口限制国家的店铺。这一下降是显著的，但并非绝对。在风格化概念框架的指导下，我们探讨了哪些中介店铺帮助维持了对俄罗斯的销售，将其行为与经济激励以及品牌特定的法律和声誉担忧联系起来。总体而言，我们展示了市场结构如何塑造店铺对制裁的遵守，并强调了经济激励如何削弱合规性。

records.title_en: Expansionary fiscal rules under sovereign risk
records.title_cn: 主权风险下的扩张性财政规则
records.abstract_en: We study fiscal rules in a sovereign default model with private capital accumulation and long-term debt. Their adoption strengthens public finances and increases long-run income by mitigating two distortions: debt dilution and underinvestment. In the short run, however, the economy experiences a costly transition where consumption and investment drop to finance debt reduction. To study this tradeoff, we calibrate the model to Argentina and evaluate three rules: a debt limit, a deficit limit, and a dual rule combining both. The deficit limit is preferred only when implemented at high debt levels because it features smoother debt reduction but imposes strict discipline in all states. Otherwise, gains are highest under the dual rule that combines the flexibility of debt limits at low levels with the discipline of deficit limits at higher levels. Results are robust to alternative formulations for capital accumulation and stronger in the presence of political myopia.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在具有私人资本积累和长期债务的主权违约模型中的财政规则。它们的采用通过缓解两种扭曲——债务稀释和投资不足——来加强公共财政并增加长期收入。然而，在短期内，经济会经历一个代价高昂的转型期，消费和投资下降以资助债务削减。为了研究这种权衡，我们将模型校准到阿根廷，并评估三种规则：债务上限、赤字上限以及结合两者的双重规则。只有在高债务水平下实施时，赤字上限才更受青睐，因为它具有更平滑的债务削减特点，但在所有状态下都施加严格的纪律。否则，在双重规则下收益最高，该规则结合了低水平债务上限的灵活性与更高水平赤字上限的纪律性。结果对资本积累的替代形式具有稳健性，并且在政治短视存在时更为显著。

records.title_en: Dominant drivers of current account dynamics
records.title_cn: 经常账户动态的主导驱动因素
records.abstract_en: What are the key drivers of current account dynamics? We estimate shocks that explain most of the variation in the current account for the US and other G7 economies. Discovering that the dominant shocks contradict the expenditure switching effect at business cycle frequency, we then explore which macroeconomic shocks are behind these empirical dominant drivers of the current account. Rather than traditional aggregate shocks to supply and demand or recently emphasized financial shocks, shocks to the relative demand between home and foreign goods are found to play a pivotal role in current account dynamics.
records.abstract_cn: 经常账户动态的关键驱动因素是什么？我们估计了能够解释美国及其他七国集团经济体经常账户大部分变动的冲击。发现主导冲击在商业周期频率上与支出转换效应相矛盾，我们随后探讨了哪些宏观经济冲击是这些经验上主导的经常账户驱动因素背后的原因。与传统总供给和需求冲击或近期强调的金融冲击不同，研究发现，国内外商品相对需求冲击在经常账户动态中起着关键作用。

records.title_en: The causal effects of commodity shocks
records.title_cn: 商品冲击的因果效应
records.abstract_en: This paper disentangles the causal effects of commodity price movements on emerging market indicators from those driven by correlated external factors, such as global growth expectations and financial conditions. We employ an identification-through-heteroskedasticity approach using USDA Grain Stock reports, which have an exogenous impact on soybean, corn, and wheat prices. Our findings show that the causal effects of grain price shocks on default risk, stock indexes, and exchange rates are typically less than half the size of the unadjusted estimates.
records.abstract_cn: 本文区分了商品价格变动对新兴市场指标的因果效应与由相关外部因素（如全球增长预期和金融状况）驱动的效应。我们采用基于异方差性的识别方法，利用美国农业部谷物库存报告，这些报告对大豆、玉米和小麦价格具有外生影响。我们的研究结果表明，谷物价格冲击对违约风险、股票指数和汇率的因果效应通常不到未调整估计值的一半。

records.title_en: Using satellite imagery to measure the impacts of new highways: An application to India
records.title_cn: 利用卫星图像衡量新建高速公路的影响：以印度为例
records.abstract_en: This paper integrates daytime and nighttime satellite imagery into a spatial general-equilibrium model to evaluate the returns to investments in new motorways. Our approach has particular value in developing-country settings in which spatially granular economic data are scarce. To demonstrate our method, we use publicly available imagery to evaluate India’s road construction projects in the early 2000s. Estimating the model and evaluating welfare impacts only requires remotely-sensed data. We find that India’s road investments improved aggregate welfare, particularly for the largest and smallest urban markets. Welfare gains were unevenly distributed across space, with the Golden Quadrilateral disproportionately benefiting large, already connected markets, while national highway upgrades delivered greater gains to smaller, more remote locations. More generally, within-district variation explains a large share of the overall spatial variance in welfare changes during this period, underscoring the value of high-resolution satellite imagery for capturing localized economic effects.
records.abstract_cn: 本文整合白天和夜间卫星图像到一个空间一般均衡模型中，以评估新建高速公路投资的回报。我们的方法在空间粒度经济数据稀缺的发展中国家环境中尤其有价值。为演示我们的方法，我们使用公开可得的图像来评估印度在2000年代初期的道路建设项目。估计模型和评估福利影响仅需要遥感数据。我们发现印度的道路投资改善了总体福利，尤其是对最大和最小的城市市场。福利收益在空间上分布不均，其中金四边形走廊不成比例地惠及了大型且已连接的市场，而国家公路升级则为较小、更偏远的地区带来了更大的收益。更普遍地，区域内差异解释了这一时期福利变化总体空间差异的很大一部分，这凸显了高分辨率卫星图像在捕捉局部经济效应方面的价值。

records.title_en: Cross-product and cross-market adjustments within multiproduct firms: Evidence from antidumping actions
records.title_cn: 多产品企业内的跨产品与跨市场调整：来自反倾销行动的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper uses detailed firm–product–country-level export data to examine how an AD action, a very targeted trade policy against a specific product in a specific export destination, affects a multiproduct firm’s price and quantity decisions across its other products and export destinations. We find robust evidence for substantial interdependencies across a multiproduct firm’s products and markets, including a new phenomenon we call within-firm cross-product trade deflection whereby an AD action against one of the firm’s products in one of its export destinations is associated with increased sales of its other products across all markets. These effects are generally stronger for private (versus state-owned) firms and larger firms, and for deflection from a firm’s non-core products to core product. Our highly detailed data and analytical approach allow us to disentangle the extent to which these cross-product effects stem from cost and/or demand interdependencies within the multiproduct firm.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用详细的企业-产品-国家层面的出口数据，考察一项针对特定出口目的地特定产品的非常定向的贸易政策——反倾销行动，如何影响多产品企业在其其他产品和出口目的地上的价格和数量决策。我们发现了强有力的证据表明，多产品企业的产品和市场之间存在显著的相互依赖性，包括我们称之为企业内部跨产品贸易转移的新现象，即针对企业某一产品在某一出口目的地的反倾销行动与其其他产品在所有市场上的销售增加相关。这些效应通常对私营企业（相对于国有企业）和规模较大的企业更强，并且从企业的非核心产品向核心产品的转移更为明显。我们高度详细的数据和分析方法使我们能够厘清这些跨产品效应在多大程度上源于多产品企业内部的成本和/或需求相互依赖性。

records.title_en: Commercial rivalry as seller incidence shifting: Non-parametric accounting of the China shock
records.title_cn: 商业竞争作为卖方负担转移：中国冲击的非参数核算
records.abstract_en: Intense US–China commercial rivalry is quantified in this paper with novel non-parametric relative resistance sufficient statistics. China’s manufacturing seller incidence falls (seller price rises) 8.2% yearly as China’s sales share quadruples over 2000-14. US seller incidence rises 6.3% yearly as US sales share halves. A 10% rise in US (China) 2014 sales share reduces seller incidence 10.05% (9.74%) and raises average seller incidence of others. Trade elasticities very close to one fit trade shares to revealed relative resistances. Trade elasticities identified off variation in observable buyer prices or trade costs are biased upward by omitted variation in unobservable buyer frictions.
records.abstract_cn: 本文通过新颖的非参数相对阻力充分统计量量化了美中之间激烈的商业竞争。随着中国销售份额在2000-14年间翻了两番，中国制造业的卖方负担每年下降（卖方价格上涨）8.2%。美国卖方负担每年上升6.3%，而美国销售份额减半。美国（中国）2014年销售份额上升10%，会使卖方负担降低10.05%（9.74%），并提高其他国家的平均卖方负担。接近一的贸易弹性与贸易份额和揭示的相对阻力相匹配。基于可观察的买方价格或贸易成本变化识别的贸易弹性，因遗漏了不可观察的买方摩擦变化而存在向上偏误。

records.title_en: Export agriculture and rural poverty: Evidence from Indonesian palm oil
records.title_cn: 出口农业与农村贫困：来自印度尼西亚棕榈油的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper measures the impacts of Indonesia’s palm oil export expansion on district poverty and household expenditure from 2002 to 2015. Identification exploits geographic variation in agro-climatic suitability in a long difference instrumental variable framework. The main result is that a 10 percentage point increase in district area under cultivation for oil palm corresponds to around six percentage points faster poverty reduction and nine percent faster expenditure growth. The expenditure gains are principally explained by rising returns to agricultural labor. I find no evidence of labor reallocation across sectors: new farmland absorbed labor saved from palm adoption. The expansion increased local government revenues, spending and public goods, while increasing deforestation, forest fires, certain health problems and conflict. Indonesian palm oil thus provides a striking modern illustration of some of the trade-offs inherent in large changes in trade and land use.
records.abstract_cn: 本文衡量了印度尼西亚棕榈油出口扩张对2002年至2015年地区贫困和家庭支出的影响。识别策略利用农业气候适宜性的地理变异，在长差分工具变量框架下进行。主要结果是，油棕种植面积占地区面积的比例增加10个百分点，与贫困率下降约六个百分点的更快速度和支出增长约九个百分点相对应。支出增长主要归因于农业劳动力回报的提高。我没有发现劳动力在部门间重新配置的证据：新增农田吸收了因采用棕榈油而节省的劳动力。扩张增加了地方政府收入、支出和公共产品，同时加剧了森林砍伐、森林火灾、某些健康问题和冲突。因此，印度尼西亚棕榈油为贸易和土地利用大规模变化中固有的某些权衡提供了一个引人注目的现代例证。

records.title_en: Do geopolitical risks raise or lower inflation?
records.title_cn: 地缘政治风险是推高还是降低通货膨胀？
records.abstract_en: Do geopolitical risks raise or lower inflation? Using a unique dataset containing historical macroeconomic data since 1900 for 44 economies, we find that geopolitical risks foreshadow high inflation, with the intensity of this effect differing across countries and historical periods. The rise in inflation is accompanied by lower economic activity; an increase in military spending, public debt, and money growth; supply disruptions; and a decline in international trade. Geopolitical risks are also associated with higher inflation uncertainty and the risk of significant inflation increases. Using a monthly vector autoregression model estimated on global data since the 1970s, we confirm that global geopolitical risks increase inflation, with the inflationary effect of higher commodity prices and currency depreciation more than offsetting the deflationary effects of lower consumer sentiment and tighter financial conditions.
records.abstract_cn: 地缘政治风险是推高还是降低通货膨胀？利用一个包含自1900年以来44个经济体历史宏观经济数据的独特数据集，我们发现地缘政治风险预示着高通胀，且这种效应的强度在不同国家和历史时期有所差异。通胀上升伴随着经济活动减弱；军事支出、公共债务和货币增长增加；供应中断；以及国际贸易下降。地缘政治风险还与更高的通胀不确定性和显著通胀上升的风险相关。利用基于自1970年以来全球数据估计的月度向量自回归模型，我们确认全球地缘政治风险会推高通胀，其中大宗商品价格上涨和货币贬值带来的通胀效应，超过了消费者情绪低落和金融条件收紧带来的通缩效应。

records.title_en: Foreign direct investment, prices and efficiency: Evidence from India
records.title_cn: 外国直接投资、价格与效率：来自印度的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper uses a rich panel dataset of Indian manufacturers to analyze the effects of foreign direct investment (FDI) on domestic firms. Detailed product-level information on prices and quantities allows us to estimate physical productivity and marginal costs. In line with the previous literature, we find little evidence of horizontal spillovers based on commonly used measures of revenue productivity. In contrast, we measure sizable efficiency gains using measures that are not affected by pricing heterogeneity. Our results indicate that domestic firms do benefit from the ability of multinational subsidiaries to produce high-quality products at relatively low cost.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用印度制造商丰富的面板数据集，分析外国直接投资（FDI）对国内企业的影响。详细的产品层面价格和数量信息使我们能够估算实物生产率和边际成本。与先前文献一致，我们发现基于常用收入生产率指标的横向溢出效应证据很少。相反，我们使用不受定价异质性影响的指标衡量到了显著的效率提升。我们的结果表明，国内企业确实受益于跨国子公司以相对较低成本生产高质量产品的能力。

records.title_en: The canary in the coal decline: Appalachian household finance and the transition from fossil fuels
records.title_cn: 煤炭衰退中的金丝雀：阿巴拉契亚家庭金融与化石燃料转型
records.abstract_en: We use individual-level credit data to study how recent declines in Appalachian coal mining affected household finances between 2011 and 2018. Using exogenous variation in electricity sector demand for coal, we find declines in coal demand decreased credit scores and increased financial distress within two years of coal shocks. These effects cannot be explained solely by job losses in coal mine worker households. Credit score declines and financial distress were largest among older individuals and people with lower-middle credit scores. Our results suggest the transition away from fossil fuels may impose meaningful costs on other fossil fuel extraction communities.
records.abstract_cn: 我们使用个人层面的信用数据，研究近期阿巴拉契亚煤炭开采业的衰退如何在2011年至2018年间影响家庭财务。利用电力部门对煤炭需求的外生变化，我们发现煤炭需求的下降在煤炭冲击后的两年内降低了信用评分并增加了财务困境。这些影响不能仅由煤矿工人家庭的失业来解释。信用评分下降和财务困境在老年人和中低信用评分人群中最为显著。我们的结果表明，远离化石燃料的转型可能对其他化石燃料开采社区施加实质性成本。

records.title_en: Implicit extrapolation and the beliefs channel of investment demand
records.title_cn: 隐性外推与投资需求的信念渠道
records.abstract_en: We document implicit extrapolation in investment decision-making that exceeds the extrapolation inferable from stated expectations. Locally experienced returns predict individual real-estate investment decisions even conditional on an investor’s forecasted home-price growth and risk aversion. Moreover, estimates of this experience effect on investment are larger than implied by the combined effect of past returns on stated expectations and stated expectations on investment. We demonstrate that heterogeneous forecast confidence helps explain why many investors rely on past returns over their survey-elicited forecasts. As their rationale, such survey respondents frequently cite intentional extrapolation or a lack of confidence in other belief factors.
records.abstract_cn: 我们记录了投资决策中的隐性外推，其程度超过了可从陈述预期中推断出的外推。本地经历过的回报率能预测个人房地产投资决策，即使在控制投资者预测的房价增长率和风险厌恶的情况下也是如此。此外，这种经历对投资的影响估计值大于过去回报对陈述预期和陈述预期对投资的联合效应所暗示的值。我们证明，异质的预测信心有助于解释为何许多投资者依赖过去的回报而非调查中得出的预测。作为其理由，这些调查受访者经常引用有意外推或对其他信念因素缺乏信心。

records.title_en: Policy news and stock market volatility
records.title_cn: 政策新闻与股市波动
records.abstract_en: We use newspapers to create Equity Market Volatility (EMV) trackers at daily and monthly frequencies. Our headline EMV tracker moves closely with the VIX and the S&P500 returns volatility in and out of sample. We exploit the volume of newspaper text to construct forty category-specific EMV trackers. News about commodity markets, interest rates, real estate markets, aggregate activity, and inflation figure prominently in EMV articles. Policy news is another major source of market volatility: 30 % of EMV articles discuss tax policy, 30 % discuss monetary policy, and 25 % refer to some form of regulation. Combining our newspaper-based trackers with textual analysis of 10-K filings, we obtain monthly firm-level risk exposure measures. These measures help explain the cross-sectional structure of realized volatilities and its evolution over time, even after conditioning on firm and time fixed effects.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用报纸构建了日度和月度频率的股票市场波动（EMV）追踪指标。我们的主EMV追踪指标与VIX及S&P500收益波动在样本内外均紧密相关。我们利用报纸文本量构建了四十个特定类别的EMV追踪指标。关于商品市场、利率、房地产市场、总体经济活动以及通货膨胀的新闻在EMV文章中占据显著位置。政策新闻是市场波动的另一个主要来源：30%的EMV文章讨论税收政策，30%讨论货币政策，25%提及某种形式的监管。将基于报纸的追踪指标与10-K文件的文本分析相结合，我们获得了月度公司层面的风险暴露度量。这些度量有助于解释已实现波动的横截面结构及其随时间的演变，即使在控制了公司和时间固定效应之后也是如此。

records.title_en: Institutions’ return expectations across assets and time
records.title_cn: 机构在不同资产和时间上的回报预期
records.abstract_en: We study the equity, cash, and corporate bond risk premium expectations of asset managers, investment consultants, wealth advisors, public pension funds, and professional forecasters. Subjective risk premia vary one-to-one with objective risk premia that are available in real time and countercyclical. Despite their significant time-series variation, several subjective equity premia vary more in the cross-section of institutions than in the time series. This heterogeneity persists both over time and across asset classes. We tie the heterogeneity in subjective equity return expectations to heterogeneous expectations about long-term equity valuations: some institutions believe that the price–earnings ratio behaves like a random walk, whereas others believe in varying degrees of mean reversion.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了资产管理人、投资顾问、财富顾问、公共养老基金和专业预测者对股票、现金和公司债券风险溢价的预期。主观风险溢价与实时可得的客观风险溢价一一对应，并且呈逆周期变化。尽管其时间序列变化显著，但若干主观股票溢价在机构间的横截面变化大于时间序列变化。这种异质性在时间上和资产类别间均持续存在。我们将主观股票回报预期的异质性与对长期股票估值的异质性预期联系起来：一些机构认为市盈率表现为随机游走，而另一些机构则相信不同程度的均值回归。

records.title_en: Policy uncertainty reduces green innovation
records.title_cn: 政策不确定性减少绿色创新
records.abstract_en: Policy uncertainty can undermine the power of government subsidies to stimulate environmentally friendly research and development. We show that Chinese firms’ green R&D falls as the uncertainty of environmental subsidies rises: Exogenous, weather-driven air pollution variability induces subsidies to fluctuate, and firms in areas with high weather-driven subsidy variability undertake less green R&D and hire fewer technical employees, controlling for the average level of subsidies. Heavy emitters and environmental technology firms are more affected. The results also illustrate how policy uncertainty can arise when policymakers are influenced by conditions that are salient but with causes that are difficult to disentangle.
records.abstract_cn: 政策不确定性可能削弱政府补贴刺激环境友好型研发的力量。我们表明，随着环境补贴不确定性的上升，中国企业的绿色研发减少：外生的、由天气驱动的空气污染变异性导致补贴波动，而在天气驱动的补贴变异性较高的地区，企业进行的绿色研发较少，雇佣的技术员工也较少，同时控制了补贴的平均水平。重排放企业和环境技术企业受影响更大。结果还说明了当政策制定者受到显著但原因难以厘清的条件影响时，政策不确定性如何产生。

records.title_en: Discount factors and monetary policy: Evidence from dual-listed stocks
records.title_cn: 贴现因子与货币政策：来自双重上市股票的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the transmission of monetary policy to the stock market through investors’ discount factors. To isolate this channel, we investigate the effect of US monetary policy surprises on the ratio of prices of the same stock listed simultaneously in Hong Kong and Mainland China. We identify a strong discount rate channel driven exclusively by cycle-amplifying surprises, defined as rate cuts during easing cycles and surprise hikes during tightening cycles. A 100 basis point of such cycle-amplifying surprise induces a 30 basis point change in the price ratio within five days.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究货币政策通过投资者贴现因子向股票市场的传导。为隔离这一渠道，我们考察了美国货币政策意外对同时在香港和中国内地上市的同一股票价格比率的影响。我们识别出一个强劲的贴现率渠道，该渠道完全由周期放大性意外驱动，即宽松周期中的降息和紧缩周期中的意外加息。此类周期放大性意外的100个基点变动，会在五天内引起价格比率30个基点的变化。

records.title_en: Demand disagreement
records.title_cn: 需求分歧
records.abstract_en: Disagreement about macroeconomic fundamentals accounts for only part of the disagreement about future interest rates, creating a “disagreement correlation” puzzle. This puzzle arises because standard equilibrium models with belief differences predict a strong link between asset return disagreement and fundamental disagreement, a link not supported by the data. We address this puzzle by introducing a model where disagreement about future demand for savings—driven by disagreement over the prevalence of patient versus impatient investors in the economy—generates asset return disagreement. Our mechanism produces stochastic yield volatility, time-varying bond risk premia, and an upward-sloping yield curve. Empirically, we construct a proxy for demand disagreement by isolating the component of yield disagreement unrelated to disagreement about macro-fundamentals. This proxy is positively related to yields and their volatilities, and predicts future bond risk premia, consistent with the predictions of our demand disagreement model.
records.abstract_cn: 关于宏观经济基本面的分歧仅解释了未来利率分歧的一部分，从而产生了“分歧相关性”之谜。这一谜题的出现是因为标准均衡模型中的信念差异预测资产回报分歧与基本面分歧之间存在强关联，而这一关联并未得到数据的支持。我们通过引入一个模型来解决这一谜题，在该模型中，对未来储蓄需求的分歧——由经济中耐心投资者与非耐心投资者占比的分歧驱动——产生了资产回报分歧。我们的机制产生了随机收益率波动性、时变债券风险溢价以及向上倾斜的收益率曲线。在实证方面，我们通过分离与宏观基本面分歧无关的收益率分歧成分，构建了需求分歧的代理变量。该代理变量与收益率及其波动性正相关，并能预测未来的债券风险溢价，这与我们需求分歧模型的预测一致。

records.title_en: Securing technological leadership? The cost of export controls on firms
records.title_cn: 确保技术领导地位？出口管制对企业造成的成本
records.abstract_en: To safeguard its technological leadership, the U.S. has restricted domestic suppliers from exporting cutting-edge technologies to selected Chinese firms. Domestic firms affected by these export controls halt sales to Chinese customers, as intended, but struggle to establish new relations with alternative customers domestically or in politically aligned regions. Consequently, domestic suppliers experience sizable losses in market capitalization, along with reductions in profitability, employment, and bank lending. Chinese firms are more proactive in reconfiguring supply chains, though not without costs. Overall, export controls impose larger costs on U.S. firms developing the very technologies these policies aim to protect.
records.abstract_cn: 为维护其技术领导地位，美国限制国内供应商向部分中国企业出口尖端技术。受这些出口管制影响的国内企业如预期般停止了对中国客户的销售，但在国内或政治立场一致的地区难以与替代客户建立新关系。因此，国内供应商在市值上遭受了相当大的损失，同时盈利能力、就业和银行贷款也有所下降。中国企业在重构供应链方面更为主动，尽管并非没有代价。总体而言，出口管制给美国企业带来了更大的成本，而这些企业正是这些政策旨在保护的技术开发者。

records.title_en: How costly are cultural biases? Evidence from FinTech
records.title_cn: 文化偏见代价几何？来自金融科技的证据
records.abstract_en: We study the nature and effects of cultural biases in choice under risk and uncertainty by comparing peer-to-peer loans the same individuals (lenders) make alone and after observing robo-advised suggestions. When unassisted, lenders are more likely to choose co-ethnic borrowers, facing 8% higher defaults and 7.3pp lower returns. Robo-advising does not affect diversification but reduces lending to high-risk co-ethnic borrowers. Lenders in locations with high inter-ethnic animus drive the results, even when borrowers reside elsewhere. Biased beliefs explain these results better than a conscious taste for discrimination: lenders rarely override robo-advised matches to ethnicities they discriminated against when unassisted.
records.abstract_cn: 我们通过比较同一批个人（贷款人）在独自决策和观察机器人顾问建议后进行的点对点贷款，研究风险与不确定性选择中文化偏见的性质与影响。在无辅助情况下，贷款人更倾向于选择同族裔借款人，面临高出8%的违约率和低7个百分点的回报。机器人顾问不影响分散化，但减少了对高风险同族裔借款人的贷款。位于族裔间敌意较高地区的贷款人推动了这一结果，即使借款人居住在其他地方也是如此。偏见信念比有意识的歧视偏好更能解释这些结果：贷款人很少推翻机器人顾问匹配至他们在无辅助时曾歧视的族裔。

records.title_en: Higher-order forward guidance
records.title_cn: 高阶前瞻指引
records.abstract_en: This paper develops a model of business cycles with endogenous volatility at the zero lower bound (ZLB) and central-bank forward guidance. We deliver three main results. First, a credible commitment to future stabilization curbs excess volatility at the ZLB. Second, pledging not to stabilize later can shift the economy onto more favorable equilibrium paths, exposing a trade-off between future stabilization and reduced aggregate volatility at the ZLB. Third, keeping the timing of future stabilization uncertain strictly dominates other forward-guidance strategies.
records.abstract_cn: 本文构建了一个在零利率下限（ZLB）处具有内生波动性的经济周期模型，并纳入中央银行的前瞻指引。我们得出三个主要结果。第一，对未来稳定化的可信承诺抑制了零利率下限处的过度波动。第二，承诺未来不进行稳定化可以将经济转移到更有利的均衡路径上，揭示了未来稳定化与降低零利率下限处总体波动性之间的权衡。第三，保持未来稳定化时机的不确定性严格优于其他前瞻指引策略。

records.title_en: Partially constructed sequential equilibrium
records.title_cn: 部分构造的序贯均衡
records.abstract_en: This article identifies sufficient conditions under which a partial construction of sequential equilibrium—characterizing beliefs and behavior for only a subset of the information sets—is sufficient for the existence of a sequential equilibrium that coincides with the partial construction in a suitable way. Illustrative applications are also presented.
records.abstract_cn: 本文识别了充分条件，在这些条件下，序贯均衡的部分构造——仅对信息集的一个子集刻画信念和行为——足以保证存在一个序贯均衡，该均衡以适当方式与部分构造相吻合。文中还给出了示例性应用。

records.title_en: Robust product design and pricing
records.title_cn: 稳健的产品设计与定价
records.abstract_en: We study design and pricing by a monopolist who has no information about the distribution of consumers’ tastes and maximizes her profit under the worst-case scenario. We show that her optimal strategy takes a simple form of dividing the taste space into a finite number of equal-length intervals and serving consumers on a randomly chosen interval. We obtain this result by studying the dual problem of finding a distribution of consumers’ tastes that minimizes the seller’s profit and establishing strong duality. The profit-minimizing distributions exhibit a uniformity property, assigning equal probability mass to a finite number of partition cells of equal width. Through the dual, we also determine the seller’s lowest profit in the Bayesian setting, establish that it is strictly positive, and derive the set of achievable profits.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一个垄断者的设计与定价问题，该垄断者对消费者偏好的分布一无所知，并在最坏情况下最大化其利润。我们表明，她的最优策略采取一种简单形式：将偏好空间划分为有限个等长区间，并在随机选择的区间上服务消费者。我们通过研究寻找最小化卖方利润的消费者偏好分布的对偶问题并建立强对偶性来获得这一结果。利润最小化分布表现出一种均匀性性质，将相等的概率质量分配给有限个等宽的分区单元。通过对偶，我们还确定了贝叶斯设定下卖方的最低利润，证明其严格为正，并推导出可实现利润的集合。

records.title_en: Middlemen, inventories and economic dynamics
records.title_cn: 中间商、库存与经济动态
records.abstract_en: We study dynamics in frictional markets with intermediated trade, where middlemen can buy goods or assets from sellers, hold them as inventory, and sell when contacting appropriate buyers. Importantly, buyers have heterogeneous match-specific valuations, letting us characterize equilibrium in terms of reservation trading strategies (related papers with homogeneous valuations imply bang-bang solutions that are awkward for the economics and mathematics). Using bifurcation theory, we show there are equilibria where market participation, volume, prices, liquidity and other variables fluctuate as self-fulfilling prophecies. The dynamics emerge from strategic considerations, not mechanical assumptions, like increasing returns or other such devices in related models.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了存在中介贸易的摩擦市场中的动态，其中中间商可以从卖方购买商品或资产，将其作为库存持有，并在接触合适买方时出售。重要的是，买方具有异质的匹配特定估值，这使我们能够以保留交易策略来刻画均衡（相关文献中同质估值假设导致邦邦解，这在经济学和数学上均不理想）。利用分岔理论，我们证明存在均衡，其中市场参与、交易量、价格、流动性及其他变量会作为自我实现的预言而波动。这些动态源于策略性考虑，而非机械性假设，如相关模型中的收益递增或其他类似机制。

records.title_en: The multiple-volunteers principle
records.title_cn: 多重志愿者原则
records.abstract_en: We present a class of simple transfer-free rules for assigning an unpleasant task among a group of agents: agents decide simultaneously whether or not to volunteer; if the number of volunteers exceeds a threshold number, the task is assigned to a volunteer; otherwise, the task is assigned to a non-volunteer. In particular, the rule may ask for multiple volunteers although one agent is sufficient to perform the task. In a setting in which agents care about who performs the task, any multiple-volunteers rule yields a strict interim Pareto improvement over random task assignment. Some volunteers rule is utilitarian optimal across all transfer-free binary mechanisms, and a rule with a large threshold reaches the first-best approximately if the group is large. Similar results hold for the problem of assigning a pleasant task. In that case, the task is assigned to a volunteer if and only if there are sufficiently few volunteers.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一类简单的无转移规则，用于在一组代理人中分配一项不愉快的任务：代理人同时决定是否自愿参与；如果自愿者人数超过一个阈值，任务分配给自愿者；否则，任务分配给非自愿者。特别地，尽管一个人就足以完成任务，规则可能要求多个自愿者。在代理人关心谁执行任务的设定中，任何多重志愿者规则相对于随机任务分配都能产生严格的中间帕累托改进。某些志愿者规则在所有无转移二元机制中是功利最优的，并且如果群体规模大，具有大阈值的规则近似达到第一最优。类似的结果也适用于分配愉快任务的问题。在这种情况下，当且仅当自愿者人数足够少时，任务才分配给自愿者。

records.title_en: Optimal screening with securities
records.title_cn: 证券下的最优筛选
records.abstract_en: A liquidity-constrained asset owner screens an informed investor using financial securities. Information-insensitive securities reduce the investor’s information rents. The optimal screening mechanism consists of a monotone debt menu where more optimistic investor types purchase larger amounts of debt. Interestingly, the issuer may benefit from trading with a better informed investor. For any monotone debt menu, as the asset’s cash flows more accurately describe the investor’s private information (Lehmann, 1988), the trade surplus unambiguously increases. Further, fixing the optimal debt menu, when the investor’s private information originates from location experiments, increasing accuracy decreases (increases) information rents for low (high) types. We provide sufficient conditions that guarantee that the issuer strictly benefits from trading with a better informed investor. Our results imply that selling debt is an effective approach to raise funds in financial markets even when investors hold superior private information and provide a novel rationale for the emergence of venture debt.
records.abstract_cn: 一个面临流动性约束的资产所有者利用金融证券对知情投资者进行筛选。信息不敏感证券减少了投资者的信息租金。最优筛选机制由一个单调债务菜单组成，其中更乐观的投资者类型购买更大数额的债务。有趣的是，发行方可能因与信息更充分的投资者交易而受益。对于任何单调债务菜单，随着资产现金流更准确地描述投资者的私人信息（Lehmann, 1988），交易盈余明确增加。此外，固定最优债务菜单，当投资者的私人信息来源于位置实验时，提高准确性会降低（增加）低（高）类型的信息租金。我们提供了充分条件，保证发行方严格受益于与信息更充分的投资者交易。我们的结果表明，即使投资者持有优越的私人信息，出售债务也是在金融市场筹集资金的有效途径，并为风险债务的出现提供了新的解释。

records.title_en: A model of network formation for the overnight interbank market: When is core-periphery an illusion?
records.title_cn: 隔夜银行间市场网络形成模型：核心-边缘结构何时是幻象？
records.abstract_en: We develop a theoretical model of network formation in the overnight interbank market, where banks manage liquidity under reserve uncertainty by strategically forming bilateral lending relationships. The model incorporates counterparty risk and the central bank’s corridor system, yielding endogenously determined equilibrium networks. A key result, relevant for systemic stability policy, is that the equilibrium network is bipartite: active banks act either as lenders or borrowers, and no strategic (interbank) intermediation arises. We also show that, via temporal aggregation of equilibrium networks, apparent intermediation and a core-periphery structure emerge. We validate these predictions using e-MID market data, showing that the model reconciles the frequency-dependent network features documented in the empirical literature for this market.
records.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一个隔夜银行间市场网络形成的理论模型，其中银行在准备金不确定性下通过策略性地形成双边借贷关系来管理流动性。该模型纳入了交易对手风险和中央银行的走廊系统，内生地决定了均衡网络。一个与系统性稳定政策相关的关键结果是，均衡网络是二分的：活跃银行要么作为贷款人要么作为借款人，且不会出现策略性的（银行间）中介。我们还表明，通过对均衡网络的时间聚合，表面上的中介和核心-边缘结构会出现。我们使用e-MID市场数据验证了这些预测，表明该模型调和了实证文献中记录的该市场的频率依赖网络特征。

records.title_en: Intertemporal bundling
records.title_cn: 跨期捆绑
records.abstract_en: This paper studies when and how intertemporal bundling arises in optimal dynamic selling mechanisms in a two-period setting, where two objects (A and B) are sequentially available for sale. When the buyer’s values of the two objects (vA and vB respectively) are independent, in contrast to conventional insight from simultaneous sales, we find in our setting that there is no loss in relying on separate sales for optimal design. This result extends under widely adopted regularity conditions when the values are positively correlated in the sense that vB is stochastically increasing in vA. However, if vB is stochastically decreasing in vA, separate sales are no longer optimal, and the optimal integrated design features intertemporal bundling. When it is always efficient to provide each good, the optimal selling mechanism is implemented by offering a menu of intertemporal bundles with different prices, where each bundle consists of the second object together with a probabilistic proportion of the first object. In particular, if the buyer’s virtual value of the first good is always non-negative, pure bundling becomes optimal.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究在两期设定下，最优动态销售机制中跨期捆绑何时以及如何出现，其中两个物品（A和B）依次可供销售。当买方对两个物品的价值（分别为vA和vB）独立时，与同时销售的常规见解相反，我们发现，在我们的设定中，依赖单独销售进行最优设计没有损失。当价值在vB随vA随机递增的意义上正相关时，这一结果在广泛采用的规则性条件下得以扩展。然而，如果vB随vA随机递减，单独销售不再是最优的，最优的整合设计具有跨期捆绑的特征。当始终有效地提供每种商品时，最优销售机制通过提供一组不同价格的跨期捆绑菜单来实现，其中每个捆绑包含第二物品以及第一物品的一个概率比例。特别是，如果买方对第一商品的虚拟价值始终非负，则纯捆绑成为最优。

records.title_en: Comment on “Assignment problems with complementarities” [J. Econ. Theory 165 (2016) 209-241]
records.title_cn: 评论“具有互补性的指派问题”[J. Econ. Theory 165 (2016) 209-241]
records.abstract_en: Nguyen et al. (2016) introduce the Bundled Probabilistic Serial and Bundled Probabilistic Serial under Limited Complementarities mechanisms for allocating bundles of indivisible objects under ordinal preferences over bundles. They present efficiency, fairness, and incentive properties of the two mechanisms, showing both to be ordinally efficient, weakly envy-free, weakly strategy-proof, and asymptotically strategy-proof. We provide counterexamples demonstrating that the Bundled Probabilistic Serial mechanism is not weakly strategy-proof and the Bundled Probabilistic Serial under Limited Complementarities mechanism is not weakly envy-free, weakly strategy-proof, or asymptotically strategy-proof. We also revise proofs for the remaining properties.
records.abstract_cn: Nguyen等人（2016）引入了捆绑概率序列机制和有限互补性下的捆绑概率序列机制，用于在束上序数偏好下分配不可分割物品的束。他们展示了这两种机制的效率、公平性和激励属性，表明两者都是序数有效的、弱无嫉妒的、弱策略证明的和渐近策略证明的。我们提供了反例，证明捆绑概率序列机制不是弱策略证明的，而有限互补性下的捆绑概率序列机制不是弱无嫉妒的、弱策略证明的或渐近策略证明的。我们还修正了其余属性的证明。

records.title_en: Competitive price discrimination, imperfect information, and consumer search
records.title_cn: 竞争性价格歧视、不完全信息与消费者搜寻
records.abstract_en: I study a homogeneous goods’ model in which a consumer attains consumption opportunities via sequential search. Whenever a firm is visited by the consumer, the firm observes a private signal about the consumer’s valuation and price discriminates based on this information. If the signal is sufficiently precise and search costs are at intermediate levels, an equilibrium in which the consumer visits multiple firms with positive probability emerges. At low search costs, firms offer low prices to deter search, and the consumer does not visit multiple firms. The equilibrium prices are minimal if search costs are negligible and, if the signal is sufficiently precise, the equilibrium prices are maximal at intermediate levels of search costs.
records.abstract_cn: 我研究了一个同质商品模型，其中消费者通过序贯搜寻获得消费机会。每当消费者访问一家企业时，该企业会观察到关于消费者估值的私人信号，并基于此信息进行价格歧视。如果信号足够精确且搜寻成本处于中间水平，则会出现消费者以正概率访问多家企业的均衡。在低搜寻成本下，企业提供低价以阻止搜寻，消费者不会访问多家企业。当搜寻成本可忽略时，均衡价格最低，而如果信号足够精确，在搜寻成本的中间水平下均衡价格最高。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: The effect of extreme heat on economic growth: Evidence from Latin America
records.title_cn: 极端高温对经济增长的影响：来自拉丁美洲的证据
records.abstract_en: Climate change is projected to increase the frequency and intensity of extremely hot days. We use a panel regression framework at the sub-national (i.e., regional) level to identify the effect of extreme heat on economic growth in Latin America accounting for acclimation to the season and to the local climate. Extreme heat affects economic growth directly in addition to any indirect effect through higher seasonal mean temperatures.
