This review systematically analyzes TRBs from four perspectives: (i) concentration-gradient-based working principles and the three-stage operational cycle; (ii) key performance metrics and the inherent trade-off between efficiency and power density; (iii) thermodynamic limits evaluated through entropy generation and temperature–entropy (T-S) diagram analysis, which indicate that sensible heat loss during electrolyte regeneration is a major source of irreversibility; and (iv) a comparative benchmarking index, denoted as ZC, introduced as a preliminary, physics-informed screening descriptor for concentration-gradient-driven systems, for which the conventional thermoelectric figure of merit ZT is not directly applicable. Ammonia-based copper TRBs have demonstrated power densities of 20–80 W/m2 with Carnot-relative efficiencies of 10–20%, suggesting a more balanced trade-off between conversion efficiency and power output than many competing low-grade heat conversion technologies. Promising near-term applications include integrated systems for waste-heat recovery, photovoltaic hybridization, copper resource recovery, and CO2 capture. The analytical framework and new ZC index discussed in this review provide preliminary tools for guiding future scale-up, long-term stability evaluation, and techno-economic assessment.
records.abstract_cn: 低于100°C的低品位热能是工业过程和基础设施中最丰富但尚未充分利用的能源资源之一。热再生电池（TRBs）已成为一种独特的平台，通过电化学放电将热诱导的浓度梯度转化为电能来收集此类热量。与热电发电机或热电化学电池不同，TRBs可以暂时储存化学能，从而将热量输入与电力输送解耦。尽管研究活动日益增多，但缺乏一个统一的分析框架来基准测试TRB性能并识别热力学瓶颈。本综述从四个角度系统分析了TRBs：（i）基于浓度梯度的工作原理和三阶段运行循环；（ii）关键性能指标以及效率与功率密度之间的固有权衡；（iii）通过熵产生和温度-熵（T-S）图分析评估的热力学极限，表明电解质再生过程中的显热损失是不可逆性的主要来源；（iv）引入一个比较基准指数，记为ZC，作为浓度梯度驱动系统的初步物理信息筛选描述符，而传统的热电优值ZT不直接适用于此类系统。基于氨的铜TRBs已展示出20-80 W/m2的功率密度和10-20%的卡诺相对效率，表明与许多竞争性的低品位热转换技术相比，其在转换效率和功率输出之间具有更平衡的权衡。近期有前景的应用包括废热回收、光伏混合、铜资源回收和CO2捕集的集成系统。本综述讨论的分析框架和新的ZC指数为指导未来的规模化、长期稳定性评估和技术经济评估提供了初步工具。

records.title_en: UV‑LED waveband and dose optimization to enhance polyphenols in postharvest baby‑leaf lettuce
records.title_cn: 紫外LED波段和剂量优化以增强采后即食生菜中的多酚含量
records.abstract_en: Baby‑leaf lettuce for ready‑to‑eat (RTE) salads is typically low in antioxidant polyphenols because it is cultivated under UV‑blocking tunnels. Postharvest UV treatments can enhance phytochemical contents, but optimal spectral bands, intensities, and energy doses remain undefined. Here, bagged RTE lettuce was exposed postharvest to narrow‑band UV‑LED radiation during six days of refrigerated storage (5 °C). The effects of UV‑B (306 nm), UV‑A (366 nm), and their combination were assessed across multiple radiation intensities, exposure times, and corresponding daily energy doses. Epidermal phenols (EPhen) and chlorophyll were monitored non‑destructively. Individual polyphenols were profiled by HPLC‑DAD‑ESI‑QToF‑MS. Transcriptomic analysis was performed on samples subjected to the most effective UV‑B treatment. UV‑B increased the EPhen Index by 22% in cv. Falstaff and by 27% in cv. Luna Bionda, whereas UV‑A had no effect and UV‑A + UV‑B was less effective than UV‑B alone. In Falstaff, EPhen accumulation was linear at low (3.5 kJ m⁻²) daily UV‑B doses and became sigmoidal at higher ones (>10 kJ m⁻²), enabling identification of a minimal UV‑B energy threshold (∼16 kJ m⁻²) beyond which EPhen saturated. No macroscopic damage or chlorophyll loss occurred under UV‑B. Metabolomic analysis confirmed hydroxycinnamic acids and flavonols as the predominant polyphenolic classes, with UV‑B increasing total phenolic content by 28–42% depending on cultivar and dose, consistent with EPhen estimates. Post-treatment transcriptomics revealed up‑regulation of stress‑response and protein‑ubiquitination pathways, indicating activation of adaptive mechanisms that preserve tissue integrity under prolonged UV‑B exposure. Overall, this work defines a practical, damage‑free UV‑B LED treatment as a promising postharvest strategy to enhance the nutraceutical quality of RTE salads.
records.abstract_cn: 用于即食（RTE）沙拉的生菜叶片通常因在阻挡紫外线的隧道中栽培而抗氧化多酚含量较低。采后紫外线处理可以增强植物化学物质含量，但最佳光谱波段、强度和能量剂量仍未明确。本研究将袋装即食生菜在冷藏储存（5°C）六天内暴露于窄带紫外LED辐射。评估了UV-B（306 nm）、UV-A（366 nm）及其组合在多种辐射强度、暴露时间和相应每日能量剂量下的效果。通过非破坏性方式监测表皮酚类（EPhen）和叶绿素。使用HPLC-DAD-ESI-QToF-MS分析个体多酚。对接受最有效UV-B处理的样本进行了转录组分析。UV-B使cv. Falstaff的EPhen指数增加了22%，cv. Luna Bionda增加了27%，而UV-A无效果，UV-A + UV-B的效果不如单独UV-B。在Falstaff中，EPhen积累在低（3.5 kJ m⁻²）每日UV-B剂量下呈线性，在较高剂量（>10 kJ m⁻²）下变为S形，从而能够识别出EPhen饱和的最小UV-B能量阈值（约16 kJ m⁻²）。在UV-B下未发生宏观损伤或叶绿素损失。代谢组学分析确认羟基肉桂酸和黄酮醇为主要的多酚类，UV-B使总酚含量增加28-42%，具体取决于品种和剂量，与EPhen估计一致。处理后的转录组学显示应激反应和蛋白质泛素化途径上调，表明在长时间UV-B暴露下激活了适应性机制以保持组织完整性。总体而言，本研究定义了一种实用、无损伤的UV-B LED处理，作为增强即食沙拉营养品质的有前景的采后策略。

records.title_en: Combined effects of tiglic acid and red light irradiation on preserving the quality of fresh-cut sugarcane
records.title_cn: 惕各酸与红光照射联合处理对鲜切甘蔗品质保持的协同效应
records.abstract_en: The individual and combined effects of tiglic acid (TA) and red light treatments on the quality of fresh-cut sugarcane were compared in this study. The combined treatment (RTA) most effectively maintained original flavor, suppressed respiration, preserved soluble solids, scavenged 1O2, O2− and ·OH, alleviated membrane lipid peroxidation, and retained secondary metabolites. Transcriptomic analysis revealed that RTA significantly upregulated genes involved in sucrose biosynthesis, phosphatidylethanolamine biosynthesis, antioxidant defense, and phenylpropanoid metabolism. Mechanistically, red light primarily acted through metabolic regulation and the enhancement of the endogenous defense system, whereas TA mainly functioned through its intrinsic antioxidant capacity. These findings identify RTA as an efficient green preservation strategy and provide new insights into the self-defense mechanisms of fresh-cut produce under photooxidative stress.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究比较了惕各酸（TA）和红光处理单独及联合对鲜切甘蔗品质的影响。联合处理（RTA）最有效地保持了原有风味，抑制了呼吸作用，保留了可溶性固形物，清除了1O2、O2−和·OH，减轻了膜脂过氧化，并保留了次生代谢产物。转录组分析显示，RTA显著上调了参与蔗糖生物合成、磷脂酰乙醇胺生物合成、抗氧化防御和苯丙烷代谢的基因。机制上，红光主要通过代谢调节和内源防御系统的增强发挥作用，而TA主要通过其固有的抗氧化能力起作用。这些发现将RTA确定为一种高效的绿色保鲜策略，并为鲜切产品在光氧化胁迫下的自我防御机制提供了新见解。

records.title_en: Continuous microwave processing as a strategy to restrain <ce:italic>Aspergillus</ce:italic> contamination and mycotoxins in almonds
records.title_cn: 连续微波处理作为抑制杏仁中曲霉污染和真菌毒素的策略
records.abstract_en: Fungal and mycotoxin contamination represent major safety concerns in almond production, particularly under conditions favorable to the growth of Aspergillus species. This study evaluated the effectiveness of a continuous-flow microwave (MW) system in reducing fungal contamination and mycotoxin levels in almonds Prunus dulcis (Mill.). Almonds were artificially inoculated with Aspergillus carbonarius, A. flavus and A. niger and treated at different MW intensities (30–80 Hz). The same treatments were applied to fungal culture broths containing aflatoxins and ochratoxin A. MW exposure completely inhibited spore germination of all the tested fungal species, achieving total inhibition across all treatment intensities. In inoculated almonds, also the lowest MW treatment reduced fungal infection by 95% for A. flavus and 92% for A. niger and A. carbonarius. In culture broths, aflatoxins and ochratoxin A concentrations decreased by 22% and 14%, respectively, while in contaminated almonds, reductions of 15.0% for aflatoxins, and 17% for ochratoxin A were recorded. Statistical analysis confirmed significant differences (p < 0.01) between treated and untreated samples. These findings demonstrate that continuous MW technology effectively limits fungal development and partially reduces mycotoxin concentrations in almonds, providing a sustainable, chemical-free, and scalable solution to enhance the safety and quality of nut-based foods.
records.abstract_cn: 真菌和真菌毒素污染是杏仁生产中的主要安全问题，尤其是在有利于曲霉属生长的条件下。本研究评估了连续流微波（MW）系统在降低杏仁（Prunus dulcis (Mill.)）中真菌污染和真菌毒素水平方面的有效性。杏仁被人工接种黑曲霉（Aspergillus carbonarius）、黄曲霉（A. flavus）和黑曲霉（A. niger），并在不同的微波强度（30-80 Hz）下处理。相同的处理应用于含有黄曲霉毒素和赭曲霉毒素A的真菌培养液。微波暴露完全抑制了所有测试真菌物种的孢子萌发，在所有处理强度下均实现了完全抑制。在接种的杏仁中，即使是最低微波处理也将黄曲霉的真菌感染减少了95%，黑曲霉和黑曲霉减少了92%。在培养液中，黄曲霉毒素和赭曲霉毒素A的浓度分别降低了22%和14%，而在受污染的杏仁中，黄曲霉毒素减少了15.0%，赭曲霉毒素A减少了17%。统计分析确认处理组和未处理组之间存在显著差异（p < 0.01）。这些发现表明，连续微波技术有效限制了真菌发展并部分降低了杏仁中的真菌毒素浓度，为提升坚果类食品的安全性和质量提供了一种可持续、无化学物质且可扩展的解决方案。

records.title_en: Cepharanthine-mediated photodynamic inactivation and active gelatin packaging for pork preservation
records.title_cn: 千金藤素介导的光动力灭活及活性明胶包装用于猪肉保鲜
records.abstract_en: Photodynamic inactivation (PDI) offers a green, non-thermal and sustainable strategy for controlling foodborne pathogens and spoilage microorganisms in animal-derived foods, and natural products are increasingly being explored as photosensitizers. Here, we identify the previously underexplored photodynamic antibacterial activity of the natural alkaloid cepharanthine (CEP). SOSG fluorescence increased 6.88-fold after 10 min of irradiation, suggesting that CEP-mediated bacterial inactivation was predominantly associated with 1O2. Viable-count assays showed that CEP completely inactivated Staphylococcus aureus and Pseudomonas aeruginosa within 40 and 60 min, respectively. Its PDI activity was retained in 10% reconstituted milk without significant changes in pH or lipid oxidation. Incorporation of CEP into gelatin (Gel) films improved ultraviolet shielding, water-vapour barrier properties and mechanical strength. When applied to pork at 4 °C, CEP-Gel films markedly suppressed microbial growth, limiting total viable counts to 4.65 log CFU/g on day 12 compared with 7.50 log CFU/g in the control group. The films also delayed increases in pH, TVB-N, TBARS and weight loss. CEP-Gel significantly delayed microbial growth, lipid oxidation and protein degradation during the 12-day refrigerated storage period. Overall, this study expands the functional scope of CEP and establishes a promising strategy for the sustainable preservation of animal-derived foods.
records.abstract_cn: 光动力灭活（PDI）为控制动物源性食品中的食源性病原体和腐败微生物提供了一种绿色、非热且可持续的策略，天然产物作为光敏剂正日益受到探索。在此，我们发现了天然生物碱千金藤素（CEP）先前未被充分探索的光动力抗菌活性。照射10分钟后，SOSG荧光增加了6.88倍，表明CEP介导的细菌灭活主要与1O2有关。活菌计数实验显示，CEP在40和60分钟内分别完全灭活了金黄色葡萄球菌和铜绿假单胞菌。其PDI活性在10%复原乳中得以保留，且pH值或脂质氧化无显著变化。将CEP掺入明胶（Gel）薄膜中，改善了紫外线屏蔽、水蒸气阻隔性能和机械强度。当应用于4°C下的猪肉时，CEP-Gel薄膜显著抑制了微生物生长，在第12天将总活菌数限制在4.65 log CFU/g，而对照组为7.50 log CFU/g。该薄膜还延缓了pH值、TVB-N、TBARS和重量损失的增加。CEP-Gel在12天的冷藏储存期间显著延缓了微生物生长、脂质氧化和蛋白质降解。总体而言，本研究扩展了CEP的功能范围，并为动物源性食品的可持续保鲜建立了一种有前景的策略。

records.title_en: A superstretchable and ultratough hierarchical fluorescent hydrogel with antioxidant and antimicrobial activity for simultaneous multi-tiered information encryption and real-time seafood spoilage visualization
records.title_cn: 一种具有抗氧化和抗菌活性的超拉伸、超坚韧分级荧光水凝胶，用于同时实现多层次信息加密和实时海鲜腐败可视化
records.abstract_en: Product counterfeiting and Food spoilage present severe challenges to global supply chains, necessitating advanced packaging that ensures both safety and authenticity. Herein, we report a highly robust, multi-functional double-network hydrogel for advanced information encryption and real-time freshness monitoring. The hierarchical matrix integrates a covalent poly(acrylamide-co-gelatin methacrylate) network with an ionic calcium alginate network, critically reinforced by tannic acid (TA) acting as a molecular glue. This architecture endows the hydrogel with an extraordinary breaking elongation of ∼4250%, an exceptional toughness of ∼154 MJ/m3, and a high tearing energy of ∼1.7 kJ/m2. Furthermore, the controlled release of TA provides reliable, broad-spectrum tissue-level adhesiveness, alongside potent antioxidant and antimicrobial activities (near 100% bactericidal rate within 24 h). By embedding NH3-responsive carbon dots, the hydrogel exhibits distinct, reversible fluorescence shifts, enabling sophisticated, multi-tiered anticounterfeiting applications including erasable Morse code, mathematical matrices, and dynamic QR codes. Meanwhile, the fluorescent hydrogel sensor accurately mapped the real-time spoilage of tilefish at both 25 °C and 4 °C, demonstrating a near-perfect correlation (R2 ≥ 0.995) between Total Volatile Basic Nitrogen (TVB-N) accumulation and colorimetric variance (ΔE). This dual-functional hydrogel offers a highly promising platform for next-generation intelligent and active food packaging.
records.abstract_cn: 产品假冒和食品腐败对全球供应链构成严峻挑战，需要既能确保安全性又能保证真实性的先进包装。在此，我们报道了一种高度坚固、多功能的双网络水凝胶，用于先进的信息加密和实时新鲜度监测。分级基质将共价聚（丙烯酰胺-共-明胶甲基丙烯酸酯）网络与离子海藻酸钙网络相结合，并通过单宁酸（TA）作为分子胶进行关键增强。这种结构赋予水凝胶约4250%的非凡断裂伸长率、约154 MJ/m3的卓越韧性和约1.7 kJ/m2的高撕裂能。此外，TA的受控释放提供了可靠的、广谱的组织级粘附性，以及强效的抗氧化和抗菌活性（24小时内接近100%的杀菌率）。通过嵌入对NH3响应的碳点，水凝胶表现出明显可逆的荧光变化，实现了复杂的、多层次防伪应用，包括可擦除的莫尔斯电码、数学矩阵和动态二维码。同时，荧光水凝胶传感器在25°C和4°C下准确映射了方头鱼的实时腐败情况，显示出总挥发性碱性氮（TVB-N）积累与色差变化（ΔE）之间近乎完美的相关性（R2 ≥ 0.995）。这种双功能水凝胶为下一代智能和活性食品包装提供了一个极具前景的平台。

records.title_en: Degree of polymerization determines the absorption, metabolic fate, and urinary disposition of procyanidins in rats: A pharmacokinetic and metabolomic study
records.title_cn: 聚合度决定原花青素在大鼠体内的吸收、代谢归宿及尿排泄：一项药代动力学和代谢组学研究
records.abstract_en: The bioactivity of procyanidins (PCs) is closely associated with their degree of polymerization (DP), yet the pharmacokinetic mechanisms underlying these DP-dependent effects remain unclear. In this study, comparative pharmacokinetic and metabolomic analyses were performed in rats following gavage (250 mg/kg) of monomeric (−)-epicatechin (EC), dimeric procyanidin B2 (PCB2), and trimeric procyanidin C1 (PCC1). Systemic exposure and urinary recovery of intact PCs decreased progressively with increasing DP, with EC showing the highest plasma exposure (AUC0–48 h = 7975 μg·h/L) and 48 h urinary excretion (221.54 μg). In contrast, PCB2 produced the highest levels of depolymerization-derived flavan-3-ol monomers in plasma, yielding a combined EC and catechin AUC0–48 h of 1266.21 μg·h/L, suggesting enhanced metabolic conversion of dimeric PCs in vivo. Metabolomics further revealed that PCB2-derived metabolites exhibited greater plasma retention but lower urinary elimination than those detected in EC and PCC1 groups. PCC1 showed minimal absorption and excretion, indicating limited bioavailability of highly polymerized PCs. Collectively, this study reveals distinct DP-dependent pharmacokinetic and metabolic profiles of PCs and provides new insights into the structure–metabolism relationships of flavan-3-ols.
records.abstract_cn: 原花青素（PCs）的生物活性与其聚合度（DP）密切相关，然而这些DP依赖性效应背后的药代动力学机制仍不清楚。本研究通过给大鼠灌胃（250 mg/kg）单体(−)-表儿茶素（EC）、二聚体原花青素B2（PCB2）和三聚体原花青素C1（PCC1），进行了比较药代动力学和代谢组学分析。完整PCs的全身暴露和尿回收率随DP增加而逐渐降低，其中EC显示出最高的血浆暴露（AUC0–48 h = 7975 μg·h/L）和48 h尿排泄量（221.54 μg）。相反，PCB2在血浆中产生了最高水平的解聚衍生黄烷3-醇单体，其EC和儿茶素联合AUC0–48 h为1266.21 μg·h/L，表明二聚体PCs在体内增强了代谢转化。代谢组学进一步揭示，PCB2衍生的代谢物在血浆中保留时间更长，但尿消除低于EC和PCC1组检测到的代谢物。PCC1显示出极低的吸收和排泄，表明高聚合度PCs的生物利用度有限。总之，本研究揭示了PCs不同的DP依赖性药代动力学和代谢特征，并为黄烷3-醇的结构-代谢关系提供了新见解。

records.title_en: A focus on microplastics in daily life eateries: identification by FT-IR, AFM, pyrolysis GC/MS and microscopic studies
records.title_cn: 聚焦日常餐饮中的微塑料：通过FT-IR、AFM、热裂解GC/MS及显微研究进行鉴定
records.abstract_en: BackgroundMicroplastic contamination of food products has become an emerging environmental and food safety concern due to the extensive use of plastic packaging materials and the potential for human dietary exposure. However, information regarding the occurrence and characterization of MPs in commonly consumed packaged foods remains limited. This study aimed to investigate the occurrence, morphology, and polymer identification of microplastics in selected packed food and beverage products using complementary analytical techniques. MethodsRepresentative samples, including packed milk, water, lentils, carbonated beverages, and hot tea, were processed following standardized laboratory protocols. Recovered particles were characterized using stereomicroscopy, Fourier Transform Infrared Spectroscopy (FTIR), Scanning and Transmission Electron Microscopy (SEM and TEM), Atomic Force Microscopy (AFM), and Pyrolysis-Gas Chromatography/Mass Spectrometry (Py-GC/MS). Quality assurance and control measures included procedural blanks, airborne blanks, and instrumental validation. ResultsMicroscopic examination revealed particles exhibiting diverse sizes, shapes, and surface morphologies consistent with microplastics. FTIR, SEM, TEM and Py-GC/MS analyses indicated the probable presence of commonly used polymers, including polystyrene (PS), polycarbonate (PC), polyethylene (PE), and polypropylene (PP), with comparatively greater analytical confidence for PS and PC. Airborne blank analysis suggested minimal laboratory background contamination, whereas no particles were observed in procedural blanks. ConclusionsThe findings indicate that packaged food products may represent one potential source of dietary exposure to microplastics. The study highlights the importance of analytical protocols, comprehensive quality assurance procedures, and continued investigation to improve the detection, characterization, and understanding of microplastic contamination in packed food.
records.abstract_cn: 背景：食品中的微塑料污染已成为一个新兴的环境和食品安全问题，原因是塑料包装材料的广泛使用以及人类通过饮食摄入的潜在风险。然而，关于常见包装食品中微塑料的存在和特征的信息仍然有限。本研究旨在利用互补的分析技术，调查选定包装食品和饮料产品中微塑料的存在、形态和聚合物鉴定。方法：代表性样本，包括包装牛奶、水、扁豆、碳酸饮料和热茶，按照标准化实验室规程进行处理。回收的颗粒通过体视显微镜、傅里叶变换红外光谱（FTIR）、扫描和透射电子显微镜（SEM和TEM）、原子力显微镜（AFM）以及热裂解-气相色谱/质谱（Py-GC/MS）进行表征。质量保证和控制措施包括程序空白、空气空白和仪器验证。结果：显微检查揭示了具有不同大小、形状和表面形态的颗粒，与微塑料一致。FTIR、SEM、TEM和Py-GC/MS分析表明可能存在常用聚合物，包括聚苯乙烯（PS）、聚碳酸酯（PC）、聚乙烯（PE）和聚丙烯（PP），其中PS和PC的分析置信度相对较高。空气空白分析表明实验室背景污染最小，而程序空白中未观察到颗粒。结论：研究结果表明，包装食品可能是膳食微塑料暴露的一个潜在来源。该研究强调了分析规程、全面质量保证程序以及持续调查的重要性，以改进对包装食品中微塑料污染的检测、表征和理解。

records.title_en: Mitigating wildlife collisions with wind turbines: A review of techniques, evidence, knowledge gaps and avenues for future research
records.title_cn: 减轻野生动物与风力涡轮机碰撞：技术、证据、知识空白及未来研究途径综述
records.abstract_en: As global wind energy production rapidly expands, so too have concerns about collision impacts for bird and bat species conservation, driving development of a diversity of anticollision technology. This review compares seven metrics across bat and bird anticollision strategies: (1) detection range, (2) detection probability, (3) species specificity, (4) changes to avoidance behaviour, (5) collision fatalities, (6) setup and maintenance costs, and (7) energy production losses. Of 52 operational and deterrent strategies or tools reviewed, less than half have independent testing data available and many knowledge gaps persist, especially for newer or under-development methods. For large birds, radar systems have greatest detection range (6.13 ± 3.99 km), but limited species specificity, and have no available data for anticollision success. Cameras have shorter range (0.69 ± 0.44 km) but good identification accuracy for large birds (83 ± 20%), with 66 ± 23% collision reduction. Blade painting has had mixed results (two successful and two unsuccessful studies to date; average 7 ± 61% reduction in bird mortalities). For bats, acoustic detection reveals the most proximal collision risk, and acoustic-activated curtailment shows the greatest success in reducing fatalitites (66 ± 34% anticollision success), while ultrasonic bat deterrents have had limited success (23 ± 40% reduction in fatalities). Technology investment ranges from relatively low (e.g., blade feathering below cut-in, blanket curtailment, deterrents such as vegetation removal through mowing, or blade painting prior to construction), through to very high (e.g., radar, camera, and acoustic detection systems for smart curtailment), with varying degrees of maintenance also required. There is a general lack of data on the lost revenue due to energy production losses. Additional data on energy production losses are required to balance the economic costs of curtailment with conservation benefits (i.e. fatalities per MWh) to help inform decisions in selecting mitigation approaches for the wind industry. This review provides researchers, project proponents, and policy makers with a scientific and comprehensive reference for the effectivness of anticollision technology, improving biodiversity outcomes for this important renewable energy resource.
records.abstract_cn: 随着全球风能生产的迅速扩张，对鸟类和蝙蝠物种保护的碰撞影响的担忧也随之增加，推动了多种防碰撞技术的发展。本综述比较了蝙蝠和鸟类防碰撞策略中的七个指标：(1) 探测范围，(2) 探测概率，(3) 物种特异性，(4) 回避行为的变化，(5) 碰撞致死率，(6) 安装和维护成本，以及 (7) 能源生产损失。在审查的 52 种操作和威慑策略或工具中，不到一半有独立的测试数据可用，许多知识空白仍然存在，特别是对于较新或正在开发的方法。对于大型鸟类，雷达系统具有最大的探测范围 (6.13 ± 3.99 公里)，但物种特异性有限，且没有防碰撞成功的数据。摄像头探测范围较短 (0.69 ± 0.44 公里)，但对大型鸟类的识别准确率较高 (83 ± 20%)，碰撞减少率为 66 ± 23%。叶片涂漆结果不一（迄今为止有两项成功和两项不成功的研究；平均鸟类死亡率降低 7 ± 61%）。对于蝙蝠，声学探测揭示了最直接的碰撞风险，声学激活的限电在减少致死率方面显示出最大的成功（防碰撞成功率为 66 ± 34%），而超声波蝙蝠威慑器的成功有限（致死率降低 23 ± 40%）。技术投资范围从相对较低（例如，低于切入风速的叶片变桨、全面限电、通过割草清除植被等威慑措施，或施工前的叶片涂漆）到非常高（例如，用于智能限电的雷达、摄像头和声学探测系统），并且还需要不同程度的维护。关于能源生产损失导致的收入损失数据普遍缺乏。需要额外的能源生产损失数据，以平衡限电的经济成本与保护效益（即每兆瓦时的致死率），帮助为风能行业选择缓解方法提供决策信息。本综述为研究人员、项目支持者和政策制定者提供了关于防碰撞技术有效性的科学和全面参考，改善了这一重要可再生能源资源的生物多样性成果。

records.title_en: Advancing solar-to-hydrogen conversion efficiency in COF heterostructures: From design principles to sacrificial-agent-free overall water splitting
records.title_cn: 推进COF异质结构中的太阳能到氢能转换效率：从设计原则到无牺牲剂的全解水
records.abstract_en: Covalent organic frameworks (COFs) have emerged as designable, crystalline organic semiconductors for solar-to-hydrogen conversion. Despite this promise, their overall efficiency is tightly limited by a triad of interdependent challenges: poor exciton dissociation, anisotropic charge-transport, and slow interfacial reaction kinetics. This review summarizes COF-based photocatalytic hydrogen evolution and overall water splitting (when reported), with a focus on hydrogen-evolution rates, apparent quantum yields (AQY), and solar-to-hydrogen (STH) efficiencies. After outlining mechanistic fundamentals and heterojunction charge-transfer modes of COF-based photocatalysts, we examine why the photocatalytic performance of these materials is governed by three structural engineering motifs: (1) intrinsic COF design (linkage chemistry, donor-acceptor (D-A) polarization, and heteroatom modulation), (2) noble-metal-integrated composites and semiconductor/carbon heterostructures (Type-II, Z-scheme, and S-scheme interfaces), and (3) metal-site frameworks (covalent metal-organic frameworks and metalated COFs). Across these classes, linkage robustness, shortened transport lengths, and built-in electric fields at well-coupled interfaces repeatedly emerge as dominant determinants of high activity and photon utilization. Field-driven Z-/S-scheme junctions provide reliable performance gains, exemplified by a COF/WO3 Z-scheme reaching 5.93 × 105 μmol h−1 g−1 with 56.1% AQY (420 nm), while overall water splitting has advanced to STH efficiencies approaching 0.67% via electronic modulation in linkage chemistry. Strategies advancing toward sacrificial-agent-free overall water splitting are highlighted, followed by guidelines for rigorous reporting and an assessment of opportunities in earth-abundant cocatalysts and scalable synthesis.
records.abstract_cn: 共价有机框架（COFs）已成为可设计的、结晶性有机半导体，用于太阳能到氢能的转换。尽管前景广阔，但其整体效率受到三个相互关联挑战的严格限制：激子解离差、各向异性电荷传输和缓慢的界面反应动力学。本综述总结了基于COF的光催化产氢和全解水（如有报道），重点关注产氢速率、表观量子产率（AQY）和太阳能到氢能（STH）效率。在概述COF基光催化剂的机理基础和异质结电荷转移模式后，我们探讨了为什么这些材料的光催化性能受三种结构工程基序控制：（1）内在COF设计（连接化学、供体-受体（D-A）极化和杂原子调控），（2）贵金属集成复合材料和半导体/碳异质结构（Type-II、Z-scheme和S-scheme界面），以及（3）金属位点框架（共价金属有机框架和金属化COFs）。在这些类别中，连接稳健性、缩短的传输长度以及良好耦合界面处的内建电场反复出现，成为高活性和光子利用的主要决定因素。场驱动的Z-/S-scheme结提供了可靠的性能提升，例如COF/WO3 Z-scheme达到5.93 × 105 μmol h−1 g−1，AQY为56.1%（420 nm），而通过连接化学中的电子调控，全解水已推进至STH效率接近0.67%。重点介绍了迈向无牺牲剂全解水的策略，随后提供了严格报告的指南，并评估了地球丰富助催化剂和可扩展合成中的机遇。

records.title_en: Indirect thermal triboelectric nanogenerators for low-grade heat harvesting: Redefining coupled heat-motion-electricity systems via scenario-oriented design
records.title_cn: 间接热摩擦电纳米发电机用于低品位热能收集：通过场景导向设计重新定义热-运动-电耦合系统
records.abstract_en: Low-grade heat is abundant in industrial, environmental, and human-centered settings, yet its weak intensity, spatial dispersion, and temporal fluctuation hinder practical recovery. Indirect thermal triboelectric nanogenerators (IT-TENGs) convert heat into thermally induced motion and subsequently into triboelectric output. Although recent reviews have discussed thermal-management-related TENGs and low-grade heat harvesting technologies, IT-TENGs have not yet been systematically reorganized and benchmarked in terms of heat-induced motion, motion–TENG matching, and source–task-oriented device selection. Here, reported IT-TENGs are categorized into thermomagnetic, solid-state thermomechanical, thermofluidic, and hybrid architectures and evaluated using thermal accessibility, startup threshold, motion signature, motion–TENG matching, environmental tolerance, durability, energy management, and application suitability. Cross-architecture comparison reveals that no single route is universally superior; practical suitability depends on matching the thermal window, motion characteristics, interface stability, useable output, and target task. Accordingly, a source–task-oriented framework is proposed for self-powered monitoring, threshold warning, distributed IoT powering, and waste-heat recovery. By shifting evaluation from peak electrical output to coupling quality, reliability, and task compatibility, this review provides a unified basis for developing IT-TENGs as practical energy-information systems.
records.abstract_cn: 低品位热能广泛存在于工业、环境和人体中心环境中，但其强度弱、空间分散和时间波动性阻碍了实际回收。间接热摩擦电纳米发电机（IT-TENGs）将热能转化为热致运动，进而转化为摩擦电输出。尽管最近的综述讨论了与热管理相关的TENGs和低品位热能收集技术，但IT-TENGs尚未在热致运动、运动-TENG匹配以及源-任务导向设备选择方面进行系统整理和基准评估。在此，将已报道的IT-TENGs分类为热磁、固态热机械、热流体和混合架构，并使用热可达性、启动阈值、运动特征、运动-TENG匹配、环境耐受性、耐久性、能量管理和应用适用性进行评估。跨架构比较显示，没有单一途径普遍优越；实际适用性取决于热窗口、运动特性、界面稳定性、可用输出和目标任务的匹配。因此，提出了一个源-任务导向框架，用于自供电监测、阈值警告、分布式物联网供电和废热回收。通过将评估从峰值电输出转向耦合质量、可靠性和任务兼容性，本综述为开发IT-TENGs作为实用能源信息系统提供了统一基础。

records.title_en: Toward practical solar fuel production: Advancements in large-scale BiVO<ce:inf loc=post>4</ce:inf> photoelectrodes
records.title_cn: 迈向实用太阳能燃料生产：大规模 BiVO<ce:inf loc=post>4</ce:inf> 光电极的进展
records.abstract_en: Photoelectrochemical (PEC) water splitting offers a direct pathway for converting solar energy into storable hydrogen fuel. Bismuth vanadate (BiVO4) has emerged as one of the most promising photoanode materials due to its suitable bandgap for visible-light absorption and relatively favorable band alignment for water oxidation. However, scaling BiVO4 photoanodes from lab-scale devices (<1 cm2) to commercial sizes (>100 cm2) for large-scale solar fuel production presents severe challenges, including insufficient operational durability and rapid performance decay. In this review, we first discuss the principles, advancements and limitations of methods for fabricating large-area photoanodes. It then explores the device physics and key engineering strategies that are required to prevent performance losses when scaling up. A comparative analysis of integration architectures is presented, and reactor design for efficient light, thermal, and mass management are also discussed. Techno-economic analysis and life-cycle assessment are further integrated to evaluate the economic viability and environmental footprint of practical BiVO4 PEC systems. Finally, we summarize the key conclusions and future perspectives for realizing commercially viable BiVO4-based solar fuel production systems.
records.abstract_cn: 光电化学（PEC）水分解提供了将太阳能转化为可储存氢燃料的直接途径。钒酸铋（BiVO4）因其适合可见光吸收的带隙和相对有利的水氧化能带排列而成为最有前途的光阳极材料之一。然而，将 BiVO4 光阳极从实验室规模设备 (<1 cm2) 扩展到商业规模 (>100 cm2) 以进行大规模太阳能燃料生产面临着严峻的挑战，包括运行耐久性不足和性能快速衰减。在这篇综述中，我们首先讨论了大面积光电阳极制造方法的原理、进展和局限性。然后，它探讨了在扩大规模时防止性能损失所需的设备物理和关键工程策略。提出了集成架构的比较分析，并讨论了用于高效光、热和质量管理的反应堆设计。进一步整合技术经济分析和生命周期评估，以评估实际 BiVO4 PEC 系统的经济可行性和环境足迹。最后，我们总结了实现商业上可行的基于 BiVO4 的太阳能燃料生产系统的关键结论和未来前景。

records.title_en: Research progress on external defect detection technology for high-speed railway switchgear based on electrical olfactory perception
records.title_cn: 基于电嗅觉感知的高速铁路开关柜外部缺陷检测技术研究进展
records.abstract_en: High-speed railway switchgear has been in long-term service under complex working conditions with multiple stress couplings, which can easily induce the generation and accumulation of characteristic gases, and may further lead to serious accidents such as explosions and fires. The electrical olfactory perception technology can accurately identify and warn of early hazards by capturing the characteristic gases produced during the evolution of defects. This paper systematically reviews the research progress in this field: Firstly, it elaborates on the decomposition characteristics of gas-solid insulating media, the molecular-scale cracking mechanism, and the transmission and diffusion laws of escaping gases in high-speed railway scenarios. Secondly, the technical system of new gas-sensitive materials, multi-sensor fusion olfactory arrays, olfactory perception devices, and system integration is summarized. Furthermore, olfactory pattern recognition, multi-source information fusion diagnosis, and explosion-proof risk early-warning assessment methods for intelligent operation and maintenance are analysed. Finally, key technical challenges and future directions are discussed to support further research and engineering implementation of external defect detection for high-speed railway switchgear.
records.abstract_cn: 高速铁路开关柜在复杂工况和多应力耦合下长期服役，易诱发特征气体的产生与积聚，进而可能导致爆炸、火灾等严重事故。电嗅觉感知技术通过捕捉缺陷演化过程中产生的特征气体，能够准确识别并预警早期隐患。本文系统综述了该领域的研究进展：首先，阐述了气固绝缘介质的分解特性、分子尺度裂解机理以及逃逸气体在高速铁路场景中的传输与扩散规律。其次，总结了新型气敏材料、多传感器融合嗅觉阵列、嗅觉感知装置及系统集成的技术体系。此外，分析了嗅觉模式识别、多源信息融合诊断以及防爆风险预警评估方法在智能运维中的应用。最后，讨论了关键技术挑战和未来方向，以支持高速铁路开关柜外部缺陷检测的进一步研究和工程实施。

records.title_en: Spatio-temporal-functional assembly of <ce:italic>Daqu</ce:italic> microbiome: Mechanistic insights and quality improvement
records.title_cn: 大曲微生物组的时空-功能组装：机制洞察与品质提升
records.abstract_en: Daqu is the fermentation starter of traditional Chinese vinegar production. However, its quality is location-specific, experience-dependent, and batch-differential. This study aims to unveil the physiochemical and microbial dynamics of Daqu during fermentation and improve the qualities of Daqu as well as vinegar through engineering the microbiota. Layered and mixed Daqu samples were collected at six fermentation stages and subjected to physiochemical and microbiota analysis. Correlation analysis revealed that the Daqu microbiota-driving factors changed from daily average temperature and contents of water and soluble protein to accumulated temperature, pH, and reducing sugar content, resulting in the higher activities of acidic protease, amylase, cellulase, and xylanase at early stages and higher glucoamylase, pectinase, and esterase activities at late stages. Null-model inference based on the beta-nearest taxon index (βNTI) and the Bray–Curtis-based Raup–Crick metric (RCbray) revealed different assembly patterns in Daqu communities, with stronger deterministic assembly of bacterial communities and ecological drift in fungal communities. The core microbiota consisted of molds (Aspergillus, Thermoascus, Rhizopus, Rhizomucor, and Rasamsonia), yeast (Saccharomycopsis), actinomycete (Saccharopolyspora), and bacilli (Bacillus, Lactilactobacillus, Leuconostoc, and Weissella). Using the culturomics strategy, 443 distinct strains confined into 40 genera and 74 species were isolated, and 59 of them showed significant protease and/or carbohydrase activities. A synthetic microbial consoria (SynCom) of five strains (Aspergillus oryzea, Saccharomycopsis fibuligera, Lichtheimia ramosa, Bacillus velezensis, and Lactilactobacillus plantarum) was prepared referring to the core microbiota composition and hydrolytic performance, which supplementation significantly improved the Daqu quality as well as the fermentation efficacy for vinegar brewing, including higher activities of glucoamylase and protease, higher yields of alcohol, organic acids, and amino acid nitrogen, and better sensory properties. The SynCom-modified microbiome with low microecological vulnerability and upregulated metabolism of carbohydrates, amino acids, and lipids might be the underlying reason. This study advances the Daqu microbiome research and offers valuable ideas to engineer the Daqu microbiota for improved qualities of Daqu and vinegar.
records.abstract_cn: 大曲是传统中国醋生产中的发酵剂。然而，其品质具有地域特异性、经验依赖性和批次差异性。本研究旨在揭示大曲在发酵过程中的理化和微生物动态，并通过工程化微生物群来提升大曲及醋的品质。在六个发酵阶段采集了分层和混合的大曲样品，并进行了理化和微生物群分析。相关性分析显示，驱动大曲微生物群的因素从日均温度、水分和可溶性蛋白含量转变为积温、pH值和还原糖含量，导致早期阶段酸性蛋白酶、淀粉酶、纤维素酶和木聚糖酶活性较高，而晚期阶段葡糖淀粉酶、果胶酶和酯酶活性较高。基于β-最近分类单元指数（βNTI）和基于Bray-Curtis的Raup-Crick度量（RCbray）的零模型推断揭示了大曲群落中不同的组装模式，细菌群落表现出更强的确定性组装，而真菌群落则表现出生态漂移。核心微生物群包括霉菌（曲霉属、热子囊菌属、根霉属、根毛霉属和篮状菌属）、酵母（复膜孢酵母属）、放线菌（糖多孢菌属）和芽孢杆菌（芽孢杆菌属、乳酸乳杆菌属、明串珠菌属和魏斯氏菌属）。利用培养组学策略，分离出443株不同菌株，归属于40个属和74个种，其中59株表现出显著的蛋白酶和/或糖酶活性。参照核心微生物群组成和水解性能，制备了由五种菌株（米曲霉、扣囊复膜孢酵母、伞枝横梗霉、贝莱斯芽孢杆菌和植物乳植杆菌）组成的合成微生物群落（SynCom），其补充显著提升了大曲品质以及醋酿造的发酵效率，包括更高的葡糖淀粉酶和蛋白酶活性、更高的酒精、有机酸和氨基酸态氮产量，以及更好的感官特性。具有低微生态脆弱性和碳水化合物、氨基酸和脂质代谢上调的SynCom修饰微生物组可能是潜在原因。本研究推进了大曲微生物组研究，并为工程化大曲微生物群以提升大曲和醋的品质提供了宝贵思路。

records.title_en: S/O/W-based milk mineral-fortified emulsion: a delivery platform offering stability, enhanced bioavailability, and bone health support
records.title_cn: 基于S/O/W的乳矿物强化乳液：一种提供稳定性、增强生物利用度和支持骨骼健康的递送平台
records.abstract_en: Milk minerals (MMS) are a superior natural calcium source limited by poor dispersibility and stability. Although solid-in-oil-in-water (S/O/W) emulsions improve their stability and in vitro bioaccessibility, their in vivo efficacy remains unconfirmed. This study evaluated the efficacy of S/O/W-based MMS-fortified emulsions (MFEs) in enhancing calcium absorption and bone health using an ovariectomized (OVX) and low-calcium rat model. Over an 8-week period, rats were divided into a sham-operated group and several OVX groups. The OVX rats were randomized into seven subgroups receiving ultrapure water, alendronate (ALN, 1 mg/kg bw), CaCO₃ (Ca2+: 133.3 mg/kg bw), or low and high doses (Ca2+: 66.65 and 133.3 mg/kg bw, respectively) of MMS or MFEs. Compared to the low-dose MMS group (MMS-L), the low-dose MFEs group (MFEs-L) significantly increased calcium absorption by 17.06% and the retention rate by 18.35% (p < 0.05). Furthermore, MFEs-L improved bone mineral density (BMD) by 20.21%, preserved trabecular microarchitecture, enhanced bone biomechanics, and reduced osteoclast numbers. Additionally, MFEs upregulated tight junction proteins (ZO-1 and Occludin) and improved intestinal transit, alleviating the constipation typically caused by traditional calcium supplements. Concurrently, MFEs modulated the gut microbiota composition by enriching beneficial taxa, such as the Bacillota, Bifidobacterium and Lactobacillus, and promoted short-chain fatty acid (SCFA) production. These results indicate that S/O/W-based MFEs represent a promising dietary delivery strategy for MMS, effectively enhancing calcium bioavailability, supporting bone health, and alleviating constipation.
records.abstract_cn: 乳矿物（MMS）是一种优质的天然钙源，但受限于较差的分散性和稳定性。尽管固体-油-水（S/O/W）乳液改善了其稳定性和体外生物可及性，但其体内功效仍未得到证实。本研究使用去卵巢（OVX）和低钙大鼠模型，评估了基于S/O/W的MMS强化乳液（MFEs）在增强钙吸收和骨骼健康方面的功效。在为期8周的时间内，大鼠被分为假手术组和几个OVX组。OVX大鼠被随机分为七个亚组，分别接受超纯水、阿仑膦酸钠（ALN，1 mg/kg体重）、CaCO₃（Ca2+：133.3 mg/kg体重），或低剂量和高剂量（Ca2+：分别为66.65和133.3 mg/kg体重）的MMS或MFEs。与低剂量MMS组（MMS-L）相比，低剂量MFEs组（MFEs-L）的钙吸收显著增加了17.06%，保留率增加了18.35%（p < 0.05）。此外，MFEs-L将骨矿物质密度（BMD）提高了20.21%，保留了小梁微结构，增强了骨生物力学性能，并减少了破骨细胞数量。此外，MFEs上调了紧密连接蛋白（ZO-1和Occludin）并改善了肠道转运，缓解了传统钙补充剂通常引起的便秘。同时，MFEs通过富集有益菌群（如Bacillota、Bifidobacterium和Lactobacillus）调节了肠道微生物组成，并促进了短链脂肪酸（SCFA）的产生。这些结果表明，基于S/O/W的MFEs代表了一种有前景的MMS膳食递送策略，有效增强钙生物利用度、支持骨骼健康并缓解便秘。

records.title_en: A comprehensive review of strategies to enhance anaerobic digestion through biogas and digestate recirculation: Mechanisms, progress and prospects
records.title_cn: 通过沼气和沼液回流强化厌氧消化的综合策略综述：机制、进展与展望
records.abstract_en: Anaerobic digestion (AD) is a cost-effective and environmentally sustainable biotechnology for converting organic waste into renewable energy. Recent studies have demonstrated that recirculating elements within AD system (biogas and digestate) can significantly enhance process efficiency. At present, there remains a lack of systematic reviews that comprehensively synthesize the potential mechanisms, operational strategies, and full-scale implementation viability of biogas and digestate recirculation. In particular, existing reviews have largely examined biogas recirculation and digestate recirculation as separate strategies, while their possible synergistic effects and integrated application potential have not yet been systematically evaluated. This comprehensive review systematically synthesizes the mechanisms, technological strategies, synergistic effects, existing limitations, and future perspectives of biogas and digestate recirculation for AD intensification. Both biogas recirculation and digestate recirculation can promote gas-liquid mixing, regulate pH, and improve system stability. Furthermore, these recirculation strategies exhibit distinct operational merits. Specifically, biogas recirculation facilitates the bioconversion of carbon dioxide (CO2) to methane (CH4), enabling in-situ biogas upgrading. Meanwhile, digestate recirculation optimizes the hydraulic retention time, minimizes freshwater requirements for substrate dilution, and mitigates the environmental burdens associated with digestate disposal. Despite these advantages, large-scale application is restricted by unclear parameter optimization, inhibitor accumulation, high energy consumption, and operational safety risks. To overcome these limitations, this review suggests that future research should prioritize intelligent control systems, multi-technology integration, and techno-economic assessment to facilitate large-scale implementation. By advancing recirculation technologies, AD systems can achieve higher efficiency and sustainability, offering transformative solutions for organic waste valorization and renewable energy generation.
records.abstract_cn: 厌氧消化（AD）是一种经济高效且环境可持续的生物技术，用于将有机废物转化为可再生能源。近期研究表明，在厌氧消化系统内回流元素（沼气和沼液）可显著提高工艺效率。目前，尚缺乏系统性地综合阐述沼气和沼液回流的潜在机制、操作策略及全面实施可行性的综述。特别是，现有综述大多将沼气回流和沼液回流视为独立策略进行探讨，而它们可能的协同效应及集成应用潜力尚未得到系统评估。本综述系统地综合了沼气与沼液回流用于强化厌氧消化的机制、技术策略、协同效应、现有局限性及未来展望。沼气回流和沼液回流均能促进气液混合、调节pH值并提高系统稳定性。此外，这些回流策略展现出不同的操作优势。具体而言，沼气回流促进二氧化碳（CO2）向甲烷（CH4）的生物转化，实现原位沼气提纯。同时，沼液回流优化水力停留时间，减少基质稀释所需的新鲜水量，并减轻与沼液处置相关的环境负担。尽管有这些优势，但大规模应用仍受限于参数优化不明确、抑制剂积累、高能耗和操作安全风险。为克服这些限制，本综述建议未来研究应优先关注智能控制系统、多技术集成和技术经济评估，以促进大规模实施。通过推进回流技术，厌氧消化系统可实现更高的效率和可持续性，为有机废物资源化和可再生能源生产提供变革性解决方案。

records.title_en: Microwave-assisted pretreatment for advancing biowaste valorization: A comprehensive review
records.title_cn: 微波辅助预处理促进生物废弃物增值化：综合评述
records.abstract_en: Converting renewable lignocellulosic biomass into biofuels, bio-based chemicals, and materials is pivotal for achieving green and sustainable development. However, pretreatment is typically required to fractionate its three major components (lignin, cellulose, and hemicellulose) for high-quality product synthesis. Compared with conventional heating technologies, microwave-assisted pretreatment (rapid, volumetric and selective heating) has become an emerging research hotspot in recent years. This paper comprehensively reviews the research progress in microwave-assisted biowaste pretreatment technologies, with a dedicated focus on elucidating the intrinsic microwave intensification mechanism, which is widely recognized in academia to be dominated by thermal effects. Then, it highlights the state-of-the-art techniques for mechanistic investigation, including morphological characterization, parameter analysis, and model simulation, despite the notable lack of sufficient evidence for verifying the intrinsic mechanism for specific microwave-assisted biomass pretreatment processes. In addition, an in-depth analysis of pretreatment performance is conducted, covering key metrics such as separation efficiency of the three major components, target product yield and quality, and process energy consumption. Furthermore, the techno-economic feasibility and life cycle assessment of microwave-assisted pretreatment are discussed and the future research focuses are proposed, including providing more direct and robust evidence for mechanism studies, integrating intelligent process control technologies, and conducting comprehensive process evaluation, to accelerate the advancement of microwave-assisted pretreatment for the highly efficient valorization of biomass waste.
records.abstract_cn: 将可再生木质纤维素生物质转化为生物燃料、生物基化学品和材料，对于实现绿色可持续发展至关重要。然而，通常需要预处理来分离其三大主要组分（木质素、纤维素和半纤维素），以合成高质量产品。与传统加热技术相比，微波辅助预处理（快速、体积性和选择性加热）近年来已成为新兴研究热点。本文全面综述了微波辅助生物废弃物预处理技术的研究进展，并特别聚焦于阐明内在的微波强化机制，该机制在学术界被广泛认为以热效应为主导。随后，文章强调了机理研究的最新先进技术，包括形态表征、参数分析和模型模拟，尽管对于特定微波辅助生物质预处理过程的内在机制验证仍明显缺乏充分证据。此外，对预处理性能进行了深入分析，涵盖三大组分分离效率、目标产品产率和质量以及过程能耗等关键指标。进一步地，讨论了微波辅助预处理的技术经济可行性和生命周期评估，并提出了未来研究重点，包括为机理研究提供更直接和有力的证据、整合智能过程控制技术以及开展全面的过程评估，以加速微波辅助预处理在生物质废弃物高效增值化方面的进展。

records.title_en: Changes in the nanostructure of pectin and cell wall polysaccharides during postharvest softening of wax apple fruit. (<ce:italic>Syzygium samarangense</ce:italic>)
records.title_cn: 莲雾果实采后软化过程中果胶和细胞壁多糖纳米结构的变化
records.abstract_en: Wax apples soften rapidly postharvest and suffer from undesirable quality deterioration, which adversely affects consumer acceptance, shelf life, and market competitiveness. Postharvest texture softening in wax apple fruit was examined in relation to changes in cell wall composition and nanostructure, alongside key metabolic pathways and transcriptomic responses involved in cell wall polysaccharide degradation. A 97.8% increase in water-soluble pectin (WSP) content was observed during wax apple fruit softening, while the contents of CDTA-soluble pectin (CSP), Na₂CO₃-soluble pectin (NSP), and hemicellulose (HC) decreased by 26.9%, 70.9%, and 40.6%, respectively. Gradual loosening of the cell wall structure and cellular swelling were revealed through scanning electron microscopy (SEM) and transmission electron microscopy (TEM). Atomic force microscopy (AFM) analysis revealed that the depolymerization products of WSP, CSP, and NSP formed small aggregates. The apparent nanofibril widths units of the polysaccharide chain in CSP and NSP were inferred to be 23.5 nm, 20.1 nm, 18.5 nm, and 15.1 nm and 19.8 nm, 17.6 nm, 13.2 nm, and 11.0 nm, respectively. Furthermore, transcriptomic analysis revealed that the expression levels of genes associated with the degradation of cell wall polysaccharides were upregulated. This study reveals the patterns of cell wall changes in wax apple fruit during postharvest storage.
records.abstract_cn: 莲雾采后迅速软化并遭受不良的品质劣变，这对消费者接受度、货架期和市场竞争力产生不利影响。研究了莲雾果实采后质地软化与细胞壁组成和纳米结构变化的关系，以及参与细胞壁多糖降解的关键代谢途径和转录组响应。在莲雾果实软化过程中，水溶性果胶（WSP）含量增加了97.8%，而CDTA可溶性果胶（CSP）、Na₂CO₃可溶性果胶（NSP）和半纤维素（HC）的含量分别下降了26.9%、70.9%和40.6%。通过扫描电子显微镜（SEM）和透射电子显微镜（TEM）观察到细胞壁结构的逐渐松散和细胞肿胀。原子力显微镜（AFM）分析显示，WSP、CSP和NSP的解聚产物形成了小聚集体。CSP和NSP中多糖链的表观纳米纤维宽度单位分别推断为23.5 nm、20.1 nm、18.5 nm和15.1 nm以及19.8 nm、17.6 nm、13.2 nm和11.0 nm。此外，转录组分析显示，与细胞壁多糖降解相关的基因表达水平上调。本研究揭示了莲雾果实采后贮藏过程中细胞壁变化的模式。

records.title_en: The mechanism of molten-globule-state conformation transition from bulk phase to oleogel interface
records.title_cn: 熔球态构象从体相到油凝胶界面的转变机制
records.abstract_en: Oleogels have potentials as fat substitutes to improve emulsification stability, and unsaturation degree of oleogels affect molecular conformation transition and stability of oleogel-myofibrillar protein (MP) interface. The adsorption behavior and transition mechanism of molten-globule (MG)-state proteins were investigated at the oleogel interface, considering unsaturation degree of oil phase. Results indicated that β-sheets, hydrophobic interaction and active sulfydryls of bulk and interfacial MPs gradually decreased as adsorption time prolonged, in which MG-state conformation was transformed into unfolding conformation. As the unsaturation degree of triglyceride-type fatty acids in the oleogels increased, MG-state conformation was kept longer. Interfacial pressure and adsorption capacity significantly increased along with unsaturation degree. Moreover, oleogels with high unsaturation degree were conducive to penetration and film-forming as well as increment in Ed, Ev and E values. The oleogel interface with C20:5 and C22:6 facilitated to reach equilibrium state faster and to form a thicker interfacial adsorption layer with high elasticity compared C18:2 and C18:3. Hence, highly unsaturated triglycerides delayed MG-state conformation transition and enhanced the stability of oleogel-MP interface.
records.abstract_cn: 油凝胶具有作为脂肪替代品提高乳化稳定性的潜力，油凝胶的不饱和度影响油凝胶-肌原纤维蛋白（MP）界面的分子构象转变和稳定性。考虑油相的不饱和度，研究了熔球（MG）态蛋白质在油凝胶界面的吸附行为和转变机制。结果表明，随着吸附时间的延长，本体和界面MPs的β折叠、疏水相互作用和活性巯基逐渐减少，其中MG态构象转变为展开构象。随着油凝胶中甘油三酯型脂肪酸不饱和度的增加，MG态构象保持的时间越长。界面压力和吸附容量随着不饱和度的增加而显着增加。此外，高不饱和度的油凝胶有利于渗透成膜，有利于Ed、Ev、E值的增加。与C18:2和C18:3相比，C20:5和C22:6的油凝胶界面有利于更快地达到平衡状态，并形成更厚且具有高弹性的界面吸附层。因此，高度不饱和的甘油三酯延迟了MG态构象转变并增强了油凝胶-MP界面的稳定性。

records.title_en: Structure-dependent modulation of <ce:italic>Morchella esculenta</ce:italic> protein by ferulic and chlorogenic acids: Improving techno-functionality and digestibility of a fungal alternative protein
records.title_cn: 阿魏酸和绿原酸对羊肚菌蛋白的结构依赖性调控：提升真菌替代蛋白的技术功能性和消化性
records.abstract_en: Fungal proteins face poor processing functionality and low digestibility limiting their use in emulsified and structured foods. Here, Morchella esculenta protein (MP) was modified by ferulic acid (FA) and chlorogenic acid (CA) at 0.0375–1 mg/mL. Both phenolics bound MP concentration-dependently, CA exhibited stronger binding affinity (Ka = 3.242 × 106 L/Mol) and deeper conformational rearrangement, while FA relied on hydrophobic and π–π interactions. Moderate phenolic addition maximized MP performance: EAI rose from 2.44 to 3.99 m2/g and digestibility from 45.33% to 58.31%, with CA delivering superior antioxidant capacity (DPPH scavenging 69.67%). Excess phenolics triggered severe protein aggregation and weakened interfacial stability. This work clarifies structure-dependent differential regulation of MP by two phenolics, defines optimal concentration thresholds, and provides theoretical support for clean-label fungal protein food ingredients
records.abstract_cn: 真菌蛋白面临加工功能性差和消化率低的问题，限制了其在乳化和结构化食品中的应用。本研究采用阿魏酸（FA）和绿原酸（CA）在0.0375-1 mg/mL浓度下对羊肚菌蛋白（MP）进行修饰。两种酚类物质均以浓度依赖方式与MP结合，CA表现出更强的结合亲和力（Ka = 3.242 × 106 L/Mol）和更深的构象重排，而FA则依赖于疏水作用和π–π相互作用。适度的酚类添加使MP性能最大化：乳化活性指数（EAI）从2.44升至3.99 m2/g，消化率从45.33%升至58.31%，且CA提供了优异的抗氧化能力（DPPH清除率69.67%）。过量酚类物质引发严重的蛋白质聚集并削弱界面稳定性。本研究阐明了两种酚类物质对MP的结构依赖性差异调控，确定了最佳浓度阈值，并为清洁标签真菌蛋白食品配料提供了理论支持。

records.title_en: Modulation of starch ordering by cold storage and microwave reheating alters starch digestibility and glycemic response in cooked rice
records.title_cn: 冷藏和微波复热对淀粉有序性的调控改变了熟米饭的淀粉消化性和血糖反应
records.abstract_en: Cooked white rice was stored under cold-storage conditions representative of household practice, including refrigeration at 4 °C for 1–7 days or freezing at −18 °C for 3–21 days, with or without a selected microwave reheating (700 W, 90 s), to determine how storage and reheating modulate starch ordering, in vitro digestibility fractions, and murine glycemic response. Refrigeration induced more pronounced structural reorganization than freezing, increasing relative crystallinity from 12.1% in freshly cooked rice (CR) to 17.2% after 7 d and FT-IR absorbance ratio (R1047/1022) from 0.686 to 0.774, with detectable retrogradation enthalpy of 4.2 J/g. These changes reduced rapidly digestible starch (RDS) from 80.8% to 65.0%, increased slowly digestible starch (SDS) from 18.9% to 30.3% and resistant starch (RS) from 0.4% to 4.7%, and lowered murine glycemic response index (mGRI) from 86.0 to 74.0. Frozen storage produced less pronounced changes; after 21 d, relative crystallinity and R1047/1022 were 13.9% and 0.716, respectively, while RDS, RS, and mGRI were 73.7%, 2.8%, and 80.8, respectively. Under the selected microwave reheating condition, the storage-induced changes were partially reversed. In the 7-d refrigerated sample, reheating decreased relative crystallinity from 17.2% to 14.5%, while increasing RDS from 65.0% to 75.9% and mGRI from 74.0 to 78.3; however, these values did not return to those of CR. Correlation analysis showed that both short-range order (R1047/1022) and long-range crystallinity were comparably and strongly associated with RDS, RS, and mGRI, indicating that starch ordering at both scales was closely linked to starch digestibility and glycemic response in cold-stored, microwave-reheated cooked rice.
records.abstract_cn: 将煮熟的白米在代表家庭实践的冷藏条件下储存，包括在4°C下冷藏1-7天或在−18°C下冷冻3-21天，有或没有选定的微波复热（700 W，90秒），以确定储存和复热如何调节淀粉有序性、体外消化性组分和小鼠血糖反应。冷藏比冷冻引起更显著的结构重组，相对结晶度从新鲜煮熟米饭（CR）中的12.1%增加到7天后的17.2%，傅里叶变换红外光谱吸光度比（R1047/1022）从0.686增加到0.774，可检测的回生焓为4.2 J/g。这些变化使快速消化淀粉（RDS）从80.8%降至65.0%，慢速消化淀粉（SDS）从18.9%增至30.3%，抗性淀粉（RS）从0.4%增至4.7%，并降低了小鼠血糖反应指数（mGRI）从86.0降至74.0。冷冻储存产生的变化较小；21天后，相对结晶度和R1047/1022分别为13.9%和0.716，而RDS、RS和mGRI分别为73.7%、2.8%和80.8。在选定的微波复热条件下，储存引起的变化部分逆转。在7天冷藏样品中，复热使相对结晶度从17.2%降至14.5%，同时RDS从65.0%增至75.9%，mGRI从74.0增至78.3；然而，这些值并未恢复到CR的水平。相关性分析显示，短程有序性（R1047/1022）和长程结晶度均与RDS、RS和mGRI相当且强烈相关，表明在冷藏和微波复热的熟米饭中，两种尺度的淀粉有序性与淀粉消化性和血糖反应密切相关。

records.title_en: Graphene/metal-organic framework composites for electrochemical oxygen reactions
records.title_cn: 石墨烯/金属有机框架复合材料用于电化学氧反应
records.abstract_en: The urgent demand for efficient, sustainable, and cost-effective electrocatalysts for oxygen reactions has driven intensive research into hybrid nanostructures that combine the unique features of graphene and metal–organic frameworks (MOFs). Graphene-based MOF nanocomposites have gained attention for synergistically integrating the advantages of both materials. Graphene, with its high electrical conductivity, large surface area, and structural flexibility, provides an ideal platform for supporting MOFs, which contribute tunable porosity, abundant active sites, and diverse chemical functionalities. This review highlights recent advances in the rational design and synthesis of graphene–MOF nanocomposites, emphasizing their synergistic structural and electronic properties that enable superior catalytic performance. Particular focus is placed on strategies involving coordination complexes and polymers with graphene materials, which facilitate strong interfacial bonding and efficient electron transport. The requirements for ideal electrocatalyst design, structure–activity relationships governing the oxygen reduction reaction (ORR) and oxygen evolution reaction (OER), and their corresponding research trends are critically examined, along with bifunctional electrocatalytic applications. We also discussed emerging synthesis methods, mechanistic insights into oxygen electrocatalysis, and the role of graphene–MOF coordination in enhancing durability and activity. Finally, current challenges and future opportunities are outlined to guide the development of next-generation graphene–MOF electrocatalysts for renewable energy conversion and storage technologies.
records.abstract_cn: 对高效、可持续且成本低廉的氧反应电催化剂的迫切需求，推动了结合石墨烯和金属有机框架（MOFs）独特特性的混合纳米结构的深入研究。基于石墨烯的MOF纳米复合材料因其协同整合两种材料的优势而受到关注。石墨烯具有高电导率、大比表面积和结构灵活性，为支撑MOFs提供了理想平台，而MOFs则贡献了可调的孔隙率、丰富的活性位点和多样的化学功能性。本综述重点介绍了石墨烯-MOF纳米复合材料在合理设计与合成方面的最新进展，强调其协同的结构和电子特性，这些特性使其具备优异的催化性能。特别关注涉及配位络合物和聚合物与石墨烯材料的策略，这些策略促进了强界面键合和高效电子传输。本文严格审视了理想电催化剂设计的要求、控制氧还原反应（ORR）和氧析出反应（OER）的结构-活性关系及其相应研究趋势，以及双功能电催化应用。我们还讨论了新兴的合成方法、氧电催化的机理见解，以及石墨烯-MOF配位在增强耐久性和活性方面的作用。最后，概述了当前的挑战和未来的机遇，以指导下一代石墨烯-MOF电催化剂在可再生能源转换和存储技术中的开发。

records.title_en: Frequency regulation ancillary service market mechanisms: An international review and cross-market comparison
records.title_cn: 频率调节辅助服务市场机制：国际回顾与跨市场比较
records.abstract_en: During the energy transition, power systems are facing active power balancing challenges arising from generation portfolios with high variability, intermittency, and uncertainty, as well as frequency stability issues associated with the increasing penetration of inverter-based resources (IBRs). In recent years, many jurisdictions have continued to develop and refine frequency regulation markets, with substantial differences in product design, clearing models, control schemes, and settlement mechanisms. Although the existing literature has introduced some specific market practices, it still remains insufficient in terms of timeliness and coverage as new mechanisms and models continue to emerge. Moreover, there is still a lack of in-depth and systematic comparison across different markets from the perspective of market mechanism design. To address this gap, this paper adopts a comparative framework focusing on three core elements of the frequency regulation market process: regulation signal and product design, market organization and resource dispatch, and performance assessment and settlement compensation. It systematically reviews and compares the latest practices in representative markets in the United States, Australia, China, and Europe. By identifying common features and key differences across these design elements, the paper discusses the major trade-offs and applicability of alternative market mechanisms, and further distills an overarching framework and future directions for frequency regulation market design. The study provides a systematic and up-to-date reference for regulators, market participants, and researchers.
records.abstract_cn: 在能源转型期间，电力系统面临由高变异性、间歇性和不确定性的发电组合引起的有功功率平衡挑战，以及随着基于逆变器的资源（IBRs）渗透率增加而带来的频率稳定性问题。近年来，许多司法管辖区持续发展和完善频率调节市场，但在产品设计、出清模型、控制方案和结算机制方面存在显著差异。尽管现有文献已介绍了一些具体的市场实践，但随着新机制和模型的不断涌现，其在及时性和覆盖范围方面仍显不足。此外，从市场机制设计的角度对不同市场进行深入系统的比较仍然缺乏。为弥补这一空白，本文采用了一个比较框架，聚焦于频率调节市场过程的三个核心要素：调节信号与产品设计、市场组织与资源调度、以及性能评估与结算补偿。系统回顾并比较了美国、澳大利亚、中国和欧洲代表性市场的最新实践。通过识别这些设计要素中的共同特征和关键差异，本文讨论了替代市场机制的主要权衡和适用性，并进一步提炼出频率调节市场设计的总体框架和未来方向。该研究为监管机构、市场参与者和研究人员提供了系统且最新的参考。

records.title_en: Sorption-based passive dehumidification towards carbon-neutral buildings
records.title_cn: 基于吸附的被动除湿技术助力碳中和建筑
records.abstract_en: Humidity plays a crucial role in maintaining the structural integrity, indoor air quality, and thermal comfort in buildings. Current dehumidification strategies primarily rely on energy-intensive vapor-compression refrigeration systems. Alternatively, in some sectors, sorption-based dehumidification with fixed beds and desiccant wheels has been widely available and commercialized. However, these systems require significant thermal energy for regeneration. Recently, sorption-based passive dehumidification has attracted increasing attention due to its various advantages, such as simple configuration, easy fabrication, and great energy-saving potential. However, to the best of our knowledge, no systematic reviews have specifically focused on this sorption-based passive dehumidification technology. The primary objective of this paper is to establish a rigorous scientific definition of this strategy and provide a comprehensive overview of the latest developments of these building-integrated systems, focusing on their energy-saving potential and dehumidification capability. This review is systematically structured around three key dimensions: fundamental mechanisms, advanced sorption materials, and system design and optimization. Ultimately, this work identifies existing research gaps and explores promising approaches in passive dehumidification technologies towards carbon neutrality.
records.abstract_cn: 湿度在维持建筑结构完整性、室内空气质量和热舒适性方面起着至关重要的作用。当前的除湿策略主要依赖于高能耗的蒸汽压缩制冷系统。或者，在某些领域，基于吸附的固定床和干燥剂轮除湿系统已广泛可用并商业化。然而，这些系统需要大量的热能进行再生。近年来，基于吸附的被动除湿因其结构简单、易于制造和巨大的节能潜力等优点而受到越来越多的关注。然而，据我们所知，尚无系统综述专门针对这种基于吸附的被动除湿技术。本文的主要目标是建立该策略的严格科学定义，并全面概述这些建筑集成系统的最新发展，重点关注其节能潜力和除湿能力。本综述围绕三个关键维度系统构建：基本机制、先进吸附材料以及系统设计与优化。最终，本工作识别了现有研究空白，并探索了被动除湿技术迈向碳中和的有前景途径。

records.title_en: Antifungal activity and mechanism of 2-Fluoroadenine against <ce:italic>Botrytis cinerea</ce:italic> in postharvest tomato fruit
records.title_cn: 2-氟腺嘌呤对采后番茄果实灰葡萄孢的抗真菌活性及其机制
records.abstract_en: Botrytis cinerea is a major cause of postharvest gray mold in tomatoes. This study elucidates the novel antifungal mechanism of 2‑Fluoroadenine against this pathogen. In vitro and in vivo assays demonstrated that 2‑Fluoroadenine potently inhibits mycelial growth and controls fruit decay, with curative and protective efficacy of 71.6% and 63.1%, significantly surpassing the positive control boscalid (41.5% and 57.2%, respectively). The antifungal action of 2‑Fluoroadenine involved severe mycelial damage and plasma membrane disruption. Integrated transcriptomic and biochemical analyses revealed that 2‑Fluoroadenine disrupts central carbon metabolism by inducing an energy crisis and inhibiting the TCA cycle, which triggers a compensatory upregulation of glyoxylate and dicarboxylate metabolism. This disruption was evidenced by a sharp depletion of ATP and citrate to 27.8% and 34.2% of the control levels, respectively, and a concomitant upregulation of key enzymes in these pathways (e.g., isocitrate lyase activity increased to 114.1% of the control) as a cellular response to the resultant redox imbalance. This metabolism‑targeting mechanism effectively suppressed disease. 2‑Fluoroadenine effectively controlled gray mold under both room temperature and refrigerated storage conditions. In conclusion, 2‑Fluoroadenine is a promising compound for controlling postharvest decay through a distinctive metabolic inhibition strategy.
records.abstract_cn: 灰葡萄孢是番茄采后灰霉病的主要原因。本研究阐明了2-氟腺嘌呤针对该病原体的新型抗真菌机制。体外和体内试验表明，2-氟腺嘌呤能有效抑制菌丝生长并控制果实腐烂，其治疗和保护效果分别为71.6%和63.1%，显著优于阳性对照啶酰菌胺（分别为41.5%和57.2%）。2-氟腺嘌呤的抗真菌作用涉及严重的菌丝损伤和质膜破坏。整合转录组和生化分析揭示，2-氟腺嘌呤通过诱导能量危机和抑制三羧酸循环来破坏中心碳代谢，从而触发乙醛酸和二羧酸代谢的代偿性上调。这种破坏通过ATP和柠檬酸盐分别急剧耗竭至对照水平的27.8%和34.2%，以及这些途径中关键酶的同时上调（例如，异柠檬酸裂解酶活性增加至对照的114.1%）作为对由此产生的氧化还原失衡的细胞反应来证明。这种靶向代谢的机制有效抑制了病害。2-氟腺嘌呤在室温及冷藏储存条件下均能有效控制灰霉病。总之，2-氟腺嘌呤通过一种独特的代谢抑制策略，是一种控制采后腐烂的有前景的化合物。

records.title_en: Effects of exogenous application of Ursolic acid on apple cuticular wax biosynthesis and postharvest quality preservation
records.title_cn: 外源施用熊果酸对苹果表皮蜡质生物合成及采后品质保持的影响
records.abstract_en: The quality of apples directly affects the market economic benefits, especially the post-harvest fruit quality. Therefore, it is crucial to discover a safe and edible plant growth regulator to regulate the quality of apples. The wax substance on the apple's surface acts as a hydrophobic lipid barrier and is a key structure for regulating the physiological stability of the fruit. Ursolic acid (UA), as an endogenous triterpenoid compound, is widely present in the apple wax. This study exogenous application UA to the apple leaves and fruits during the fruit growth, to elucidate how cuticular wax biosynthesis functions in apple fruit and mediates the retention of postharvest quality. UA increases wax content by promoting transcript levels of wax biosynthetic genes, which is beneficial for maintaining postharvest quality and enhancing resistance to pathogens, thereby extend the apple fruits shelf life. This research provides a practical and feasible guidance plan for improving the quality and efficiency of the apple industry and post-harvest preservation.
records.abstract_cn: 苹果的品质直接影响市场经济效益，尤其是采后果实品质。因此，发现一种安全可食用的植物生长调节剂来调控苹果品质至关重要。苹果表面的蜡质物质作为疏水性脂质屏障，是调节果实生理稳定性的关键结构。熊果酸（UA）作为一种内源性三萜类化合物，广泛存在于苹果蜡质中。本研究在果实生长期间外源施用UA于苹果叶片和果实，以阐明表皮蜡质生物合成如何在苹果果实中发挥作用并介导采后品质的保持。UA通过促进蜡质生物合成基因的转录水平来增加蜡质含量，这有利于维持采后品质并增强对病原体的抗性，从而延长苹果果实的货架期。本研究为提高苹果产业的质量和效率以及采后保鲜提供了切实可行的指导方案。

records.title_en: <ce:sup loc=post>1</ce:sup>H NMR based-metabolomic approach to evaluate biocompost application on tomato fruit
records.title_cn: <ce:sup loc=post>1</ce:sup>基于 1H NMR 的代谢组学方法评估番茄果实上的生物堆肥应用
records.abstract_en: In the context of growing environmental concerns and the urgent need to reduce chemical inputs in agriculture, the adoption of sustainable fertilization practices has become essential. Transitioning to farming systems that minimize or eliminate the use of synthetic fertilizers can enhance soil health, meet consumer demands for safer and higher-quality products and reduce environmental pollution. This study focused on the application of probiotic-enriched compost on tomato crops, aiming to assess its impact on the fruit's metabolomic profile, using proton nuclear magnetic resonance (1H NMR) spectroscopy combined with multivariate statistical analysis (PCA and OPLS-DA). Compost-supplied samples were compared with those from integrated farming systems, using Demeter-organic (biodynamic) tomatoes as a benchmark. Tomatoes grown with compost showed a distinct metabolic signature, characterized by a higher sugar-to-acid ratio, while showing lower concentrations of certain amino acids. In the lipid fraction, compost-supplied tomatoes exhibited decreased in saturated fatty acids and carotenoids, including lycopene, compared to fruits from the other systems. These findings indicate that probiotic compost amendments may modulate tomato at the metabolic level. Moreover, although the reported variation in bioactive compounds suggest the need for further investigation into their balance, this work provides useful information for the optimization of organic amendments to improve quality crops within a sustainable agricultural framework.
records.abstract_cn: 在环境问题日益严重和迫切需要减少农业化学投入的背景下，采用可持续施肥实践变得至关重要。过渡到尽量减少或消除合成肥料使用的农业系统可以改善土壤健康，满足消费者对更安全和更高质量产品的需求，并减少环境污染。本研究重点关注富含益生菌的堆肥在番茄作物上的应用，旨在利用质子核磁共振 (1H NMR) 光谱结合多元统计分析（PCA 和 OPLS-DA）评估其对果实代谢组的影响。使用德米特有机（生物动力）番茄作为基准，将堆肥提供的样品与综合农业系统的样品进行比较。用堆肥种植的西红柿表现出独特的代谢特征，其特点是糖酸比较高，同时某些氨基酸的浓度较低。在脂质部分中，与其他系统的水果相比，堆肥提供的番茄的饱和脂肪酸和类胡萝卜素（包括番茄红素）含量有所减少。这些发现表明益生菌堆肥改良剂可以在代谢水平上调节番茄。此外，尽管报道的生物活性化合物的变化表明需要进一步研究其平衡，但这项工作为优化有机改良剂以在可持续农业框架内提高作物质量提供了有用的信息。

records.title_en: A microbiota-informed pipeline for in vitro characterisation of insulinotropic properties of dairy fermentates using static EndoC-βH1 and dynamic microfluidic models
records.title_cn: 基于微生物群的管道，利用静态EndoC-βH1和动态微流控模型对乳制品发酵物的胰岛素促分泌特性进行体外表征
records.abstract_en: Diabetes mellitus (DM), which encompasses Type 1, Type 2 and gestational diabetes, affects approximately 537 million adults, with prevalence continuing to rise. In addition to pregnancy, factors such as dietary choices, lifestyle and infections can lead to the development of DM. Given the increasing prevalence of DM, it is necessary to continue to identify approaches to control the release of insulin. Emerging evidence indicates that the gut microbiota plays a central role in mediating the metabolic effects of diet on the host, including the regulation of insulin secretion. Dietary interventions have been proven to be successful in this regard, but identifying foods and food components that influence insulin secretion is challenging due to the complexity of diet-microbiota-host interactions and the lack of fast and standardised screening tools. We have developed a novel screening framework based on the β-cell insulin response, using the human cell line EndoC-βH1 to assess candidate foods and ingredients with insulinotropic properties. As an initial proof-of-concept, we applied the framework to food ingredients, i.e., dairy-derived fermentates, which had first undergone simulated digestion followed by addition to an ex vivo colon model, allowing us to mimic the metabolic transformations taking place in the human gut. The processed colonic fermentation supernatants were then evaluated using a static and microfluidic platform, respectively, to capture dynamic insulin release profiles. Distinct fermentate compositions were associated with varying levels of insulin secretion. Our results suggest that this framework could be applied broadly to screen foods and food components for insulinotropic potential, providing an affordable approach for the development for anti-diabetic dietary applications.
records.abstract_cn: 糖尿病（DM），包括1型、2型和妊娠期糖尿病，影响约537亿成年人，且患病率持续上升。除妊娠外，饮食选择、生活方式和感染等因素也可能导致DM的发生。鉴于DM患病率的不断上升，有必要继续寻找控制胰岛素释放的方法。新兴证据表明，肠道微生物群在介导饮食对宿主的代谢效应（包括胰岛素分泌的调节）中发挥核心作用。饮食干预已被证明在这方面是成功的，但由于饮食-微生物群-宿主相互作用的复杂性以及缺乏快速且标准化的筛选工具，识别影响胰岛素分泌的食物和食物成分具有挑战性。我们开发了一种基于β细胞胰岛素反应的新型筛选框架，使用人细胞系EndoC-βH1来评估具有胰岛素促分泌特性的候选食物和成分。作为初步概念验证，我们将该框架应用于食物成分，即乳制品来源的发酵物，这些发酵物首先经过模拟消化，然后添加到离体结肠模型中，使我们能够模拟人体肠道中发生的代谢转化。随后，分别使用静态和微流控平台评估处理后的结肠发酵上清液，以捕获动态胰岛素释放曲线。不同的发酵物组成与不同水平的胰岛素分泌相关。我们的结果表明，该框架可广泛用于筛选食物和食物成分的胰岛素促分泌潜力，为开发抗糖尿病饮食应用提供了一种经济实惠的方法。

records.title_en: Engineering pH-responsive probiotic carriers for oral delivery: Design principles, gastrointestinal fate, and translational perspectives
records.title_cn: 工程化pH响应型益生菌口服递送载体：设计原理、胃肠道命运与转化前景
records.abstract_en: Probiotics play important roles in maintaining gut homeostasis and promoting host health. However, their oral delivery remains challenging because of substantial viability loss during gastrointestinal transit. pH-responsive delivery systems have emerged as a promising strategy to improve probiotic survival and achieve site-specific intestinal release by exploiting the natural pH gradient along the gastrointestinal tract. This review examines the physiological basis of pH-responsive probiotic delivery, including gastrointestinal pH variation and the major biological barriers affecting probiotic fate. Key design principles are discussed, with emphasis on protonation–deprotonation behavior, protection–release coupling, and multilayer structural engineering. Recent advances in material platforms, including polysaccharide matrices, protein–polysaccharide composites, enteric-coated systems, hybrid materials, and emulsion-based carriers, are summarized together with fabrication approaches such as extrusion gelation, emulsion templating, coating technologies, and microfluidics. The functional evolution of these systems is highlighted, demonstrating a shift from simple gastric protection toward gut-targeted delivery, prolonged intestinal retention, disease-oriented applications, and multifunctional probiotic systems. Current evaluation methods are critically assessed, particularly regarding the limitations of simplified in vitro digestion models and inconsistent viability metrics. Finally, the translational potential of pH-responsive probiotic carriers is discussed from the perspectives of material safety, processing compatibility, sensory impact, and scalability. Future developments are expected to focus on food-grade, adaptive, and function-oriented delivery systems that more effectively integrate gastrointestinal physiology with application-specific delivery objectives.
records.abstract_cn: 益生菌在维持肠道稳态和促进宿主健康方面发挥重要作用。然而，由于在胃肠道转运过程中存在显著的活力损失，其口服递送仍面临挑战。pH响应型递送系统已成为一种有前景的策略，通过利用胃肠道沿程的自然pH梯度来提高益生菌存活率并实现位点特异性肠道释放。本综述考察了pH响应型益生菌递送的生理基础，包括胃肠道pH变化及影响益生菌命运的主要生物屏障。讨论了关键设计原理，重点强调质子化-去质子化行为、保护-释放耦合以及多层结构工程。综述总结了材料平台的最新进展，包括多糖基质、蛋白质-多糖复合物、肠溶包衣系统、杂化材料和乳液基载体，以及挤出凝胶化、乳液模板、包衣技术和微流控等制备方法。突出了这些系统的功能演变，展示了从简单胃保护向肠道靶向递送、延长肠道滞留、疾病导向应用和多功能益生菌系统的转变。对当前评价方法进行了批判性评估，特别是关于简化体外消化模型的局限性和不一致的活力指标。最后，从材料安全性、加工兼容性、感官影响和可扩展性的角度讨论了pH响应型益生菌载体的转化潜力。未来发展方向预计将聚焦于食品级、适应性和功能导向的递送系统，以更有效地将胃肠道生理学与应用特异性递送目标相结合。

records.title_en: Perioperative administration of fucoidan induced changes in immune cell composition and resulted in no beneficiary outcomes in the acute phase of postoperative neurocognitive recovery
records.title_cn: 围手术期给予岩藻聚糖诱导免疫细胞组成变化，且在术后神经认知恢复急性期未产生有益结果
records.abstract_en: For many of the versatile functions of polysaccharides as natural ingredients in human foods, the immunomodulatory and anti-inflammatory activities of fucoidan, partly owing to its high sulfate content, attracted extensive attention in its potential application in cancer therapy as well as in prevention of neurodegeneration. In this study, we characterized the impact of long-term supplementation of Undaria pinnatifida-derived fucoidan on the gene expression and immune cell abundance in mouse PBMCs. Despite the significantly increased Th17 cells and activated NK cells, naïve B cells were substantially reduced in the PBMCs in fucoidan mice. Fucoidan supplementation induced prominent expression changes in genes associated with Th1/Th2 cell differentiation. Although fucoidan displayed a remarkable anti-inflammatory capacity in our mouse models, perioperative administration of fucoidan failed to show any noticeable beneficiary effect in relieving synaptic and cognitive dysfunction at the acute phase after surgery, which was believed to cause neurocognitive impairment by inducing neuroinflammation. Comparing with that of the mice with control diet, reduced microglia-neuron crosstalk, resulted in compromised neuronal surveillance, was also observed in mice with perioperative administration of fucoidan. In addition, no influence on either basal level or surgery-induced oxidative stress was observed in mice with fucoidan supplementation. Given the complex features of inflammation as the first response to various detrimental situations, we proposed that the anti-inflammation potential of fucoidan, and the changes in immune cell composition induced by which, did not induce favoring changes in mouse brains for impaired cognitive recovery at least at the immediate early postoperative stage.
records.abstract_cn: 鉴于多糖作为天然成分在人类食品中的多种功能，岩藻聚糖的免疫调节和抗炎活性（部分归因于其高硫酸盐含量）在癌症治疗及神经退行性疾病预防中的潜在应用引起了广泛关注。本研究表征了长期补充裙带菜来源的岩藻聚糖对小鼠外周血单个核细胞（PBMCs）中基因表达和免疫细胞丰度的影响。尽管岩藻聚糖组小鼠PBMCs中Th17细胞和活化NK细胞显著增加，但初始B细胞大幅减少。岩藻聚糖补充诱导了与Th1/Th2细胞分化相关基因的显著表达变化。尽管岩藻聚糖在小鼠模型中显示出显著的抗炎能力，但围手术期给予岩藻聚糖在术后急性期未能显示出任何明显的缓解突触和认知功能障碍的有益效果，而术后急性期被认为通过诱导神经炎症导致神经认知损伤。与对照饮食小鼠相比，围手术期给予岩藻聚糖的小鼠还观察到小胶质细胞-神经元串扰减少，导致神经元监视功能受损。此外，岩藻聚糖补充对基础水平或手术诱导的氧化应激均无影响。鉴于炎症作为对各种有害情况的首发反应的复杂特征，我们提出岩藻聚糖的抗炎潜力及其诱导的免疫细胞组成变化，至少在术后早期阶段，并未在小鼠大脑中诱导有利于受损认知恢复的变化。

records.title_en: Divergent and shared gut microbiota responses to repeated intervention with structurally distinct pectic polysaccharides from red raspberries
records.title_cn: 红树莓中结构不同的果胶多糖重复干预下肠道菌群的趋同与差异响应
records.abstract_en: This study investigated how gut microbiota responds to repeated interventions with two structurally distinct pectic polysaccharides (ALRP3 and USRP2) isolated from red raspberries and how structural variations influence fermentation outcomes. The low-molecular-weight and less branched ALRP3 was rapidly fermentable, while high-molecular-weight and more branched USRP2 was slowly fermentable. Both pectic polysaccharides modulated gut microbiota and promoted SCFA levels, and these effects were significantly influenced by polysaccharide structure, dosing cycles, and their interaction. During fed-batch fermentation, the substrates were initially added at 0 h and subsequently supplemented at 12, 24, and 36 h, resulting in four substrate additions in total. Following repeated supplementation, the fecal microbiota gradually formed new stable community structures, and SCFAs steadily accumulated, with both pectic polysaccharides reaching the peak total SCFA production after the third supplementation. They enriched similar beneficial bacteria but also induced distinct flora. ALRP3 specifically boosted butyrate-producing bacteria and butyrate production, while USRP2 enriched specific Bifidobacterium strains. These results support the targeted design of pectic polysaccharide-based microbiota regulation strategies.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了肠道菌群如何响应来自红树莓的两种结构不同的果胶多糖（ALRP3和USRP2）的重复干预，以及结构变异如何影响发酵结果。低分子量和较少分支的ALRP3可快速发酵，而高分子量和更多分支的USRP2则发酵缓慢。两种果胶多糖均调节肠道菌群并促进SCFA水平，这些效应显著受多糖结构、给药周期及其相互作用的影响。在补料分批发酵过程中，底物最初在0小时添加，随后在12、24和36小时补充，总共进行四次底物添加。重复补充后，粪便菌群逐渐形成新的稳定群落结构，SCFAs稳步积累，两种果胶多糖均在第三次补充后达到总SCFA产量的峰值。它们富集了相似的益生菌，但也诱导了不同的菌群。ALRP3特别促进了产丁酸菌和丁酸的产生，而USRP2富集了特定的双歧杆菌菌株。这些结果支持基于果胶多糖的微生物群调节策略的靶向设计。

records.title_en: Mechanistic modulation of macromolecular interactions between modified cellulose and myofibrillar protein under low salt conditions: effects on gel properties
records.title_cn: 低盐条件下改性纤维素与肌原纤维蛋白之间大分子相互作用的机制调控：对凝胶性质的影响
records.abstract_en: The effects and mechanisms of methylcellulose (MC), carboxymethylcellulose (CMC), hydroxypropyl methylcellulose (HPMC), and microcrystalline cellulose (MCC) on myofibrillar protein (MP) gelation at 0.3 M NaCl were investigated. Results showed that all celluloses enhanced the hardness, springiness, and water-holding capacity of low salt MP gel in a dose-dependent manner. Specifically, MC and HPMC reached optimal performance at 0.9% concentration, whereas CMC and MCC reached their peak at 0.3% addition. In particular, 0.9% MC addition gave the low-salt MP gel its highest hardness (502.98 g), water-holding capacity (98.7%), and storage modulus (3388 Pa), surpassing the normal-salt control. MC increased MP surface hydrophobicity from 58.9 to 86.1, facilitated disulfide and non-disulfide covalent cross-linking of myosin heavy chain intensity, and formed the densest gel microstructure. HPMC most strongly promoted low salt MP disulfide bond formation and achieved a water-holding capacity of 96.8%. However, its thermally reversible network partly dissociated upon cooling, limiting the storage modulus to 1656 Pa. CMC addition increased the absolute zeta potential from 17.4 mV to 34–37 mV via its carboxymethyl groups, generating electrostatic repulsion that impeded MP aggregation and led to a weak gel with high immobilized water but low water-holding capacity (86.8%). MCC behaved as an inert filler, yielding only marginal improvements. In conclusion, low-salt MP gel with MC addition surpassed normal-salt levels through hydrophobicity-driven unfolding and network reinforcement, with HPMC addition reaching normal-salt levels by enhancing disulfide bond formation, while the benefits of CMC and MCC additions were limited by electrostatic repulsion and inert filling.
records.abstract_cn: 研究了甲基纤维素（MC）、羧甲基纤维素（CMC）、羟丙基甲基纤维素（HPMC）和微晶纤维素（MCC）在0.3 M NaCl条件下对肌原纤维蛋白（MP）凝胶化的影响及机制。结果表明，所有纤维素均以剂量依赖方式增强了低盐MP凝胶的硬度、弹性和持水性。具体而言，MC和HPMC在0.9%浓度时达到最佳性能，而CMC和MCC在0.3%添加量时达到峰值。特别是，添加0.9% MC使低盐MP凝胶获得最高硬度（502.98 g）、持水性（98.7%）和储能模量（3388 Pa），超过了正常盐对照。MC将MP表面疏水性从58.9提高到86.1，促进了肌球蛋白重链的二硫键和非二硫键共价交联强度，并形成了最致密的凝胶微观结构。HPMC最强烈地促进了低盐MP二硫键的形成，并实现了96.8%的持水性。然而，其热可逆网络在冷却时部分解离，将储能模量限制在1656 Pa。CMC添加通过其羧甲基基团将绝对zeta电位从17.4 mV提高到34-37 mV，产生静电排斥，阻碍了MP聚集，导致形成具有高固定水但低持水性（86.8%）的弱凝胶。MCC表现为惰性填料，仅产生边际改善。总之，添加MC的低盐MP凝胶通过疏水性驱动的展开和网络增强超过了正常盐水平，添加HPMC通过增强二硫键形成达到正常盐水平，而CMC和MCC添加的益处受限于静电排斥和惰性填充。

records.title_en: Data driven reveals the upgrading mechanism of waste PET electrolysis: Research progress of machine learning in collaborative production of high-value chemicals and green hydrogen energy
records.title_cn: 数据驱动揭示废弃PET电解升级机制：机器学习在高价值化学品与绿色氢能协同生产中的研究进展
records.abstract_en: The pollution of polyethylene terephthalate (PET) plastics poses a global environmental challenge, and traditional recycling technologies are limited by downgrading cycles and high energy consumption. Electrocatalytic upgrading recycling can convert waste PET into high-value chemicals and synergistically produce hydrogen under mild conditions, but its multi-step electron/proton transfer, competitive reaction pathway, and complex catalyst structure-activity relationship make it difficult to efficiently break through traditional trial and error methods. Machine learning (ML), as a data-driven new paradigm, provides systematic solutions for rational catalyst design, deep mechanism analysis, and multi-objective system optimization by integrating multi-source data, constructing quantitative structure-activity relationships, analyzing reaction networks, and intelligently navigating parameter spaces. This review is the first to construct a full chain methodological framework of data algorithm application, systematically reviewing the latest progress of ML in the field of PET electrolysis collaborative production of high-value chemicals and green hydrogen energy, and looking forward to cutting-edge directions such as independent experiments, generative AI, and multimodal fusion, aiming to provide theoretical guidance for the technological development and knowledge system construction in this field.
records.abstract_cn: 聚对苯二甲酸乙二醇酯（PET）塑料的污染构成全球环境挑战，传统回收技术受限于降级循环和高能耗。电催化升级回收可在温和条件下将废弃PET转化为高价值化学品并协同产氢，但其多步电子/质子转移、竞争反应路径及复杂的催化剂结构-活性关系，使得传统试错方法难以高效突破。机器学习（ML）作为数据驱动的新范式，通过整合多源数据、构建定量构效关系、分析反应网络及智能导航参数空间，为理性催化剂设计、深层机理分析和多目标系统优化提供系统性解决方案。本综述首次构建了数据-算法应用的全链条方法论框架，系统梳理了ML在PET电解协同生产高价值化学品与绿色氢能领域的最新进展，并展望了自主实验、生成式人工智能及多模态融合等前沿方向，旨在为该领域的技术发展和知识体系建设提供理论指导。

records.title_en: From waste to functional material: Tuning oxygen-containing functional groups and managing leachable organic matter for targeted hydrochar applications
records.title_cn: 从废弃物到功能材料：调控含氧官能团与管理可淋溶有机物以实现水热炭的定向应用
records.abstract_en: Hydrothermal carbonization (HTC) offers a promising approach for converting organic solid waste (OSW) into multifunctional hydrochar. Oxygen-containing functional groups (OCFGs) critically determine its application performance. However, how OCFGs form during HTC, and how their functionality is modulated remain poorly understood. This review examines the formation mechanisms of hydrochar and clarifies two distinct pathways: Type Ⅰ “solid-solid carbonization” and Type II “hydrolysis-carbonization”, based on which the formation mechanisms of OCFGs and their structure-property-function correlation with hydrochar's core functionalities are assessed. A conceptual framework of raw hydrochar is then proposed, recognizing that leachable organic matter (LOM) plays an important role in modulating the function of OCFGs and their subsequent applications. Its composition, mobility, and effects may vary substantially with feedstock type and reaction conditions, and may either impair or, in specific cases, contribute to hydrochar performance. Existing studies have paid limited attention to the influence of LOM, leaving critical gaps in its practical application that warrant further investigation. To address these gaps, targeted modification strategies for OCFG optimization, LOM regulation, and porous structure upgrading strategies are summarized for pollutant remediation, energy storage, and soil improvement. Finally, this review concludes that further efforts to deepen the mechanistic understanding of carbonization, develop targeted strategies for LOM regulation, overcome technical bottlenecks in analytical characterization, and advance large-scale applications represent the key pathways to addressing current challenges and achieving sustainable, high-value utilization of hydrochar.
records.abstract_cn: 水热碳化（HTC）为将有机固体废弃物（OSW）转化为多功能水热炭提供了一种有前景的方法。含氧官能团（OCFGs）关键地决定了其应用性能。然而，关于OCFGs在水热碳化过程中如何形成，以及其功能如何被调控，目前仍知之甚少。本综述考察了水热炭的形成机制，并阐明了两种不同的路径：Ⅰ型“固-固碳化”和Ⅱ型“水解-碳化”，在此基础上评估了OCFGs的形成机制及其与水热炭核心功能之间的结构-性质-功能关联。随后提出了原始水热炭的概念框架，认识到可淋溶有机物（LOM）在调控OCFGs功能及其后续应用中发挥重要作用。其组成、迁移性及影响可能随原料类型和反应条件的不同而有显著差异，并可能损害或在特定情况下促进水热炭的性能。现有研究对LOM影响的关注有限，在其实际应用中留下了关键空白，值得进一步研究。为解决这些空白，针对污染物修复、能源储存和土壤改良，总结了OCFG优化、LOM调控和多孔结构升级的定向改性策略。最后，本综述得出结论：进一步深化碳化机理理解、制定LOM调控的定向策略、克服分析表征中的技术瓶颈，以及推进大规模应用，是应对当前挑战并实现水热炭可持续、高价值利用的关键途径。

records.title_en: Tailoring electronic structure of electrocatalysts for efficient oxygen evolution reaction in proton exchange membrane electrolyzers
records.title_cn: 调控电催化剂电子结构以实现质子交换膜电解槽中高效析氧反应
records.abstract_en: Substantial progress has been achieved in catalyst development but decrease in the performance of the electrocatalysts is the primary obstacle in proton exchange membrane (PEM) electrolyzers because of the corrosive environments in highly oxidizing operating conditions. Slow kinetics is the significant problem of oxygen evolution reaction (OER) particularly in acidic conditions. Effective methods for designing electrocatalysts for acidic OER with superior intrinsic performance have been developed to overcome this problem. An efficient way to increase OER is modulation in electronic structure of the active sites of catalyst which may be accomplished through doping, alloying, defect engineering, and strain engineering. This article provides an extensive summary of efficient methods for controlling the electronic environment to increase the performance of catalysts, based on the OER mechanism that is frequently seen in acidic environments. Lastly, several exciting new avenues for study are highlighted to increase the development of efficient acidic OER electrocatalysts.
records.abstract_cn: 在催化剂开发方面已取得显著进展，但电催化剂性能的下降是质子交换膜（PEM）电解槽中的主要障碍，因为其在高度氧化的操作条件下存在腐蚀性环境。缓慢的动力学是析氧反应（OER）的重要问题，尤其是在酸性条件下。为克服这一问题，已开发出设计具有优异本征性能的酸性OER电催化剂的有效方法。提高OER的一种有效途径是调控催化剂活性位点的电子结构，这可通过掺杂、合金化、缺陷工程和应变工程实现。本文基于酸性环境中常见的OER机制，对控制电子环境以提高催化剂性能的有效方法进行了全面总结。最后，强调了若干令人兴奋的新研究方向，以促进高效酸性OER电催化剂的开发。
