Carbon taxes act as negative supply shocks, raising inflation and lowering output, while subsidies to green energy firms reduce green energy prices, supporting the transition and easing recessions. Redistribution to constrained households boosts consumption but does not accelerate the green transition. Taxes on brown capital income lower both inflation and output by acting as demand shocks. Recycling revenue from this tax to subsidize green capital investment strengthens the shift to green energy and moderates economic contractions. Global coordination of carbon taxes delivers only modest additional macroeconomic effects compared to unilateral action, as substitution in energy use outweighs international spillovers. Sensitivity analyses confirm the robustness of these findings under alternative assumptions on price rigidity, substitution elasticities, and monetary policy.
records.abstract_cn: 我们使用欧元区和全球经济（EAGLE）模型的扩展版本探讨了促进欧元区绿色能源转型的气候政策的宏观经济影响。该模型区分了棕色能源部门和绿色能源部门，并纳入了碳税和棕色资本所得税。我们分析了单边和全球协调碳税的情景，以及有或没有向绿色企业和财务拮据的家庭进行收入再分配的情况。碳税会产生负面的供给冲击，导致通胀上升、产出下降，而对绿色能源公司的补贴则降低了绿色能源价格，支持转型并缓解衰退。对受限家庭的再分配会促进消费，但不会加速绿色转型。对棕色资本收入征税可以通过产生需求冲击来降低通货膨胀和产出。将这项税收的收入回收来补贴绿色资本投资，可以加强向绿色能源的转变，并缓解经济收缩。与单边行动相比，碳税的全球协调只能带来适度的额外宏观经济影响，因为能源使用的替代超过了国际溢出效应。敏感性分析证实了在价格刚性、替代弹性和货币政策的替代假设下这些发现的稳健性。

records.title_en: Consumer durables, monetary policy, and the green transition
records.title_cn: 耐用消费品、货币政策和绿色转型
records.abstract_en: As part of the green transition, the European cap-and-trade scheme for CO2 emissions will be extended to include consumer durables. We propose a New Keynesian model that features both “brown” and “green” durable goods, and show that if monetary policy follows a business-as-usual approach, the green transition will be inflationary, with headline inflation rising by up to 20 basis points. Monetary policy faces a tradeoff: strictly targeting headline inflation slows the green transition, as purchases of green durables are particularly sensitive to interest rates. We explore this tradeoff by comparing adjustment dynamics under a headline-inflation target and a core-inflation target.
records.abstract_cn: 作为绿色转型的一部分，欧洲CO2排放总量控制与交易计划将扩大到包括耐用消费品。我们提出了一个新凯恩斯主义模型，以“棕色”和“绿色”耐用品为特色，并表明，如果货币政策遵循一切照旧的方法，绿色转型将导致通货膨胀，总体通胀率将上升高达20个基点。货币政策面临权衡：严格瞄准总体通胀会减缓绿色转型，因为绿色耐用品的购买对利率特别敏感。我们通过比较总体通胀目标和核心通胀目标下的调整动态来探讨这种权衡。

records.title_en: Family stress and the intergenerational correlation in self-control
records.title_cn: 家庭压力与自我控制的代际相关性
records.abstract_en: We first examine the correlation in self-control between parents and their young-adult children, drawing on two decades of population-representative panel data. We then exploit variation in the family environment during childhood to investigate how family stress related to: i) parenting responsibilities; ii) parents’ relationship quality; iii) household finances; and iv) poor mental health shape the self-control of young adults. A finite mixture model is used to account for unobserved heterogeneity in young adults’ capacity for self-control. Our results indicate that some young people may be particularly sensitive to growing up in a stressful environment, opening the door for family stress to affect the formation of self-control.
records.abstract_cn: 我们首先利用二十年的人口代表性面板数据来研究父母与其年幼子女之间自我控制的相关性。然后，我们利用童年时期家庭环境的变化来调查家庭压力与以下因素之间的关系：i）养育责任； ii) 父母的关系质量； iii) 家庭财务； iv) 心理健康状况不佳会影响年轻人的自我控制能力。有限混合模型用于解释年轻人自我控制能力中未观察到的异质性。我们的研究结果表明，一些年轻人可能对在压力环境中成长特别敏感，这为家庭压力影响自我控制的形成打开了大门。

records.title_en: Climate change, catastrophes, insurance and the macroeconomy
records.title_cn: 气候变化、灾难、保险和宏观经济
records.abstract_en: This paper examines the role of insurance in mitigating the adverse macroeconomic effects of climate-related catastrophes. We first develop a stylised theoretical growth model which incorporates a role for natural catastrophes, climate change and insurance. This illustrates how insurance can mitigate the impact of catastrophes and articulates the potential effect of falling insurance coverage as global warming intensifies. The model also provides a basis for our empirical analysis which explores the link between insurance coverage and the macroeconomic impact of catastrophes for a sample of several thousand disaster events across 47 developed and middle income countries between 1996 and 2019. The results confirm that higher insurance coverage is associated with less severe macroeconomic consequences of disasters. With climate-related catastrophes becoming ever more frequent and severe, our findings highlight the importance of developing policies to reduce the climate insurance protection gap.
records.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了保险在减轻气候相关灾难对宏观经济不利影响方面的作用。我们首先开发了一个程式化的理论增长模型，其中纳入了自然灾害、气候变化和保险的作用。这说明了保险如何减轻灾难的影响，并阐明了随着全球变暖加剧，保险覆盖范围下降的潜在影响。该模型还为我们的实证分析提供了基础，该分析以47至1996之间2019发达和中等收入国家的数千个灾害事件为样本，探讨了保险承保范围与灾难的宏观经济影响之间的联系。结果证实，较高的保险覆盖范围与较轻的灾害宏观经济后果相关。随着与气候相关的灾难变得越来越频繁和严重，我们的研究结果凸显了制定政策以缩小气候保险保障缺口的重要性。

records.title_en: International lending channel, bank heterogeneity and capital inflows (Mis)allocation
records.title_cn: 国际贷款渠道、银行异质性和资本流入（错误）配置
records.abstract_en: This paper examines how heterogeneity among banks in international lending affects the allocation of capital inflows across firms, leveraging South Africa’s inclusion in the Citigroup World Government Bond Index (WGBI). Using bank-level data, we show that banks holding sovereign bonds prior to the inclusion expand their credit supply to non-financial firms following the shock, with this effect primarily driven by less capitalized banks. Using firm-level data from South Africa, we further demonstrate that the increased credit is allocated among less financially constrained and older firms, which are more likely to have established banking relationships before the inclusion. Importantly, as credit is allocated to unconstrained firms, we find little evidence of economically significant improvements in real outcomes. Our paper contributes to the literature by highlighting the interplay between banks’ heterogeneity, capital inflow shocks, and capital misallocation, shedding light on why the international lending channel may, in some instances, have a muted impact on both firms and the broader economy.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用南非被纳入花旗集团世界政府债券指数 (WGBI) 的优势，探讨了银行在国际贷款方面的异质性如何影响企业间资本流入的分配。使用银行层面的数据，我们表明，在纳入之前持有主权债券的银行在冲击后扩大了对非金融企业的信贷供应，这种效应主要是由资本较少的银行推动的。利用来自南非的企业层面的数据，我们进一步证明，增加的信贷分配给了财务约束较少的老企业，这些企业更有可能在纳入之前就已经建立了银行关系。重要的是，由于信贷被分配给不受约束的企业，我们几乎没有发现任何证据表明实际结果在经济上有显着改善。我们的论文通过强调银行的异质性、资本流入冲击和资本错配之间的相互作用，为文献做出了贡献，阐明了为什么国际贷款渠道在某些情况下可能对企业和更广泛的经济产生微弱的影响。

records.title_en: Do zombies rise when interest rates fall: A relationship banking model
records.title_cn: 当利率下降时，僵尸企业会崛起吗：关系银行模式
records.abstract_en: A relationship bank or market investors finance an entrepreneur’s risky project. Unlike investors, the bank can identify and liquidate bad projects at an interim stage. If the entrepreneur can provide only limited capital, the optimal loan contract induces an inefficient continuation decision, i.e., the bank engages in zombie lending. In the short run – for a given contract – the bank’s incentive to roll over bad loans is enhanced if the base interest rate drops. In the long run, however, the bank adjusts the contract to a drop in the interest rate, and the effect on zombification is reversed.
records.abstract_cn: 关系银行或市场投资者为企业家的风险项目提供资金。与投资者不同的是，银行可以在中期阶段识别并清算不良项目。如果企业家只能提供有限的资本，最优贷款契约会导致低效的延续决策，即银行进行僵尸贷款。从短期来看，对于给定的合同，如果基本利率下降，银行展期不良贷款的动力就会增强。然而，从长远来看，银行根据利率下降调整合约，对僵尸化的影响就会逆转。

records.title_en: Labor-market effects of introducing the 8-hour workday
records.title_cn: 引入8小时工作日对劳动力市场的影响
records.abstract_en: In 1919, the Danish craft and industrial sector permanently adopted the 8-hour workday, representing the largest reduction in working hours in the country’s history. We collected quarterly data on hourly wages and employment from 1914 to 1931 across occupation groups, covering Copenhagen and the aggregate of the provinces in Denmark. By exploiting variation in percent work-time reductions across occupation groups and regions, we examine the income and employment effects of the reform. Our findings reveal only a compensating rise in hourly wages in Copenhagen, though this increase was insufficient to offset the decline in weekly earnings due to fewer working hours. Furthermore, we observe that the reduction in working hours was mitigated by new hires, particularly of unskilled workers. Overall, our results suggest that reductions in working hours were not (in any region) fully compensated by gains in hourly wages but tend to support the “work-sharing” hypothesis.
records.abstract_cn: 1919年，丹麦手工艺和工业部门永久采用8小时工作日，这是该国历史上最大的工作时间减少幅度。我们收集了从1914到1931跨职业群体的小时工资和就业的季度数据，涵盖哥本哈根和丹麦各省的总体。通过利用不同职业群体和地区工作时间减少百分比的差异，我们研究了改革对收入和就业的影响。我们的研究结果显示，哥本哈根的时薪仅出现补偿性增长，尽管这种增长不足以抵消由于工作时间减少而导致的周收入下降。此外，我们观察到，新员工的加入，尤其是非技术工人的加入，缓解了工作时间的减少。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，工作时间的减少（在任何地区）都没有被小时工资的增长完全补偿，但往往支持“工作共享”假设。

records.title_en: "Potential" and the Gender Promotion Gap
records.title_cn: “潜力”与性别晋升差距
records.abstract_en: We show that subjective assessments of employee "potential" contribute to gender gaps in promotion and pay. Using data on 29,809 management-track employees from a large retail chain, we find that women receive substantially lower potential ratings despite receiving higher performance ratings. Differences in potential ratings account for approximately half of the gender promotion gap. Women's lower potential ratings do not reflect accurate forecasts of future performance: Women subsequently outperform male colleagues, both on average and on the margin of promotion. We highlight two mechanisms driving the gender potential gap: strategic retention and stereotyping.
records.abstract_cn: 我们表明，对员工“潜力”的主观评估会导致晋升和薪酬方面的性别差距。使用大型零售连锁店 29,809 管理层员工的数据，我们发现，尽管女性的绩效评级较高，但其潜在评级却明显较低。潜在评级的差异约占性别晋升差距的一半。女性较低的潜在评级并不能反映对未来绩效的准确预测：女性随后在平均表现和晋升幅度上都优于男性同事。我们强调二驱动性别潜在差距的机制：战略保留和刻板印象。

records.title_en: Evaluating the Impact of Urban Transit Infrastructure: Evidence from Bogotá's TransMilenio
records.title_cn: 评估城市交通基础设施的影响：来自波哥大 TransMilenio 的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper estimates the effects of improving public transit infrastructure on city structure and welfare. It develops a quantitative urban model with multiple worker groups and transit modes, and derives a special case yielding sufficient statistics for aggregate welfare in a broad class of models. The paper estimates reduced-form elasticities to implement the approach using data spanning construction of the world's largest Bus Rapid Transit system in Bogotá, Colombia. This class of models explains observed adjustments in economic activity. Standard value-of-time calculations capture only 52 percent of welfare gains. Accounting for reallocation and general equilibrium effects, distributional impacts are modest.
records.abstract_cn: 本文评估了改善公共交通基础设施对城市结构和福利的影响。它开发了一个具有多个工人群体和交通方式的定量城市模型，并得出了一个特例，为广泛的模型中的总福利提供了足够的统计数据。该论文利用哥伦比亚波哥大世界上最大的快速公交系统建设的数据，估计了实施该方法的简化形式弹性。此类模型解释了观察到的经济活动调整。标准时间价值计算仅捕获52%的福利收益。考虑到重新分配和一般均衡效应，分配影响不大。

records.title_en: Financial Frictions: Micro versus Macro Volatility
records.title_cn: 金融摩擦：微观波动与宏观波动
records.abstract_en: We argue that consumer credit spreads matter for household choices and that time-varying spreads have important distributional consequences. Studying Danish household data, we show that consumer credit spreads have heterogeneous impact on asset dynamics and consumption choices across the wealth distribution and that time-varying spreads induce a countercyclical marginal propensity to consume. We study a HANK model where banks provide consumer credit and corporate loans. Through countercyclical credit spreads, frictional finance amplifies aggregate shocks and induces consumption inequality. Economies with less leveraged banks experience reduced aggregate volatility but may face higher volatility and lower welfare at the household level.
records.abstract_cn: 我们认为，消费者信贷利差对家庭选择很重要，并且随时间变化的利差具有重要的分配后果。通过研究丹麦家庭数据，我们发现消费信贷利差对财富分配中的资产动态和消费选择具有异质性影响，并且随时间变化的利差会引发反周期边际消费倾向。我们研究了HANK模型，其中银行提供消费信贷和企业贷款。通过反周期信用利差，摩擦金融放大了总体冲击并导致消费不平等。银行杠杆率较低的经济体总体波动性降低，但家庭层面可能面临更高的波动性和更低的福利。

records.title_en: Raising the Stakes: Physician Facility Investments and Provider Agency
records.title_cn: 提高赌注：医师设施投资和提供商代理
records.abstract_en: Principal-agent problems often extend beyond what can be directly addressed through conventional incentive arrangements. We examine a context where physicians are likely under-incentivized to minimize total medical costs until their private financial interests align with those of patients. Leveraging novel data on physician ownership of ambulatory surgery centers—that is, same-day facilities—we show that these equity holdings cause a substitution away from higher cost, rival settings that lowers Medicare spending by 10–40 percent per physician. We find no clear evidence of perverse behavior following these investments. Instead, our findings demonstrate how entrepreneurial activity can indirectly limit principal-agent problems and improve efficiency.
records.abstract_cn: 委托代理问题往往超出了传统激励安排所能直接解决的范围。我们研究了这样一种情况：在医生的私人经济利益与患者的经济利益一致之前，他们可能没有动力将总医疗成本降至最低。利用关于医生拥有门诊手术中心（即当日手术设施）的新数据，我们表明，这些股权持有会导致成本较高、竞争环境的替代，从而使每位医生的医疗保险支出降低10-40%。我们没有发现这些投资后出现不当行为的明确证据。相反，我们的研究结果表明创业活动如何能够间接限制委托代理问题并提高效率。

records.title_en: Competition under Incomplete Contracts and the Design of Procurement Policies
records.title_cn: 不完全合同下的竞争与采购政策设计
records.abstract_en: We study the effects of intensifying competition for contracts in the context of US Defense procurement. Leveraging a discontinuous regulation that mandates agencies to publicize certain contract opportunities, we document that expanding the set of bidders reduces award prices but deteriorates post-award performance in terms of cost overruns and delays. We develop and estimate an auction model with endogenous entry and stochastic execution performance, in which the buyer endogenously chooses the intensity of competition. Model estimates indicate substantial heterogeneity in performance across contractors and show that simple adjustments to the current regulation could provide significant savings in procurement spending.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了美国国防采购背景下合同竞争加剧的影响。利用强制各机构公布某些合同机会的不连续监管，我们发现，扩大投标人范围会降低中标价格，但会恶化中标后在成本超支和延误方面的表现。我们开发并估计了具有内生进入和随机执行绩效的拍卖模型，其中买方内生选择竞争强度。模型估计表明，承包商之间的绩效存在显着差异，并表明对现行法规的简单调整可以显着节省采购支出。

records.title_en: Take the Goods and Run: Contracting Frictions and Market Power in Supply Chains
records.title_cn: 拿走货物就跑：供应链中的收缩摩擦和市场力量
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the efficiency of self-enforced relational agreements, a common solution to contracting frictions, when sellers have market power and contracts cannot be externally enforced. To this end, I develop a dynamic contracting model with limited enforcement in which buyers can default on their trade credit debt and estimate it using a novel dataset from the Ecuadorian manufacturing supply chain. The key empirical finding is that bilateral trade is inefficiently low in early periods of the relationship, but converges toward efficiency over time, despite sellers' market power. Counterfactual simulations imply that both market power and enforcement contribute to inefficiencies in trade.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了当卖方拥有市场力量且合同无法从外部执行时，自我执行的关系协议的效率，这是解决合同摩擦的常见方法。为此，我开发了一个执行有限的动态合同模型，在该模型中，买家可以拖欠其贸易信贷债务，并使用来自厄瓜多尔制造供应链的新颖数据集对其进行估算。关键的实证发现是，双边贸易在关系的早期阶段效率很低，但随着时间的推移，尽管卖方拥有市场力量，但会趋向于效率。反事实模拟意味着市场力量和执法都会导致贸易效率低下。

records.title_en: Consumer Credit and the Incidence of Tariffs: Evidence from the Auto Industry
records.title_cn: 消费者信贷与关税发生率：来自汽车行业的证据
records.abstract_en: Captive finance subsidiaries create a channel for trade policy to affect consumer credit. Examining the impact of the Trump administration's metal tariffs on captive automobile lenders, we find that consumers received higher interest rates from captive lenders after the tariffs relative to unaffected noncaptive lenders. Further, we document a disparate impact on low-income borrowers and in areas with less lending competition. Our results suggest that tariffs may impact not only the price of goods but also the financing terms of purchases. Thus, focusing solely on directly affected product prices may underestimate tariff pass-through significantly.
records.abstract_cn: 自保金融子公司为贸易政策影响消费者信贷创造了渠道。在研究特朗普政府的金属关税对自保汽车贷款机构的影响时，我们发现，相对于未受影响的非自保贷款机构，在征收关税后，消费者从自保贷款机构获得的利率更高。此外，我们记录了对低收入借款人和贷款竞争较少的地区的不同影响。我们的结果表明，关税不仅可能影响商品价格，还可能影响采购的融资条件。因此，仅关注直接受影响的产品价格可能会大大低估关税传导。

records.title_en: Work from Home and the Office Real Estate Apocalypse
records.title_cn: 在家工作和办公室房地产启示录
records.abstract_en: We show remote work led to large drops in lease revenues, occupancy, and market rents in the commercial office sector. We revalue New York City office buildings, taking into account both the cash flow and discount rate implications of these shocks, and find a 46 percent decline in long-run value. For all US office markets combined, we find a $556.8 billion value destruction. Higher-quality buildings were buffered against these trends due to a flight to quality, while lower-quality offices are at risk of becoming a stranded asset. These valuation changes have repercussions for financial stability and local public finances.
records.abstract_cn: 我们发现，远程工作导致商业办公领域的租赁收入、入住率和市场租金大幅下降。我们重新评估纽约市办公楼的价值，同时考虑到这些冲击对现金流和贴现率的影响，并发现长期价值下降了46%。对于所有美国写字楼市场的总和，我们发现 $556.8 十亿 价值遭到破坏。由于追求质量，较高质量的建筑受到了这些趋势的缓冲，而较低质量的办公室则面临成为搁浅资产的风险。这些估值变化会对金融稳定和地方公共财政产生影响。

records.title_en: A Theory of Supply Function Choice and Aggregate Supply
records.title_cn: 供给函数选择与总供给理论
records.abstract_en: Modern theories of aggregate supply are built on the foundation that firms set prices and commit to producing whatever the market demands. We remove this strategic restriction and allow firms to choose supply functions, mappings that describe the prices charged at each quantity of production. Theoretically, we characterize firms' optimal supply function choices in general equilibrium and study the resulting implications for aggregate supply. Aggregate supply flattens under lower inflation uncertainty, higher idiosyncratic demand uncertainty, and less elastic demand. Quantitatively, our theory can rationalize the flattening of aggregate supply during the Great Moderation and steepening during the 1970s and 2020s.
records.abstract_cn: 现代总供给理论建立在企业定价并承诺生产市场需求的基础上。我们消除了这种战略限制，并允许企业选择供给函数，即描述每种生产数量的价格的映射。从理论上讲，我们描述了一般均衡中企业的最优供给函数选择，并研究了由此产生的对总供给的影响。在通胀不确定性较低、特殊需求不确定性较高和需求弹性较小的情况下，总供给趋于平缓。从数量上讲，我们的理论可以合理解释“大稳健”期间总供给的扁平化和1970和2020期间总供给的陡峭化。

records.title_en: Gender Differences in Economics Seminars
records.title_cn: 经济学研讨会中的性别差异
records.abstract_en: We assess whether men and women are treated differently when presenting their economics research. We collected data across thousands of seminars, job market talks, and conference presentations, leveraging human judgment and audio-processing algorithms to measure the number, tone, and type of interruptions. Within a seminar series, women are interrupted more than men. This holds when controlling for characteristics of the presenter, paper, and audience. Interruptions that are negative in tenor or tone or cut off the presenter mid-sentence increase for women presenters. We also find greater engagement of female audience members with female presenters, suggesting a potential role model effect.
records.abstract_cn: 我们评估男性和女性在展示经济学研究时是否受到不同对待。我们收集了数千场研讨会、就业市场讲座和会议演示的数据，利用人类判断和音频处理算法来衡量中断的数量、语气和类型。在一系列研讨会中，女性比男性更容易被打断。当控制演讲者、论文和观众的特征时，这一点成立。对于女性演讲者来说，语气或语气消极的打断或打断演讲者的句子中间的情况会增加。我们还发现女性观众与女性主持人的互动程度更高，这表明潜在的榜样效应。

records.title_en: Trust at Scale: The Economic Limits of Cryptocurrencies and Blockchains
records.title_cn: 大规模信任：加密货币和区块链的经济限制
records.abstract_en: Satoshi Nakamoto (2008) invented a new kind of economic system that does not need the support of government or rule of law. Trust and security instead arise from a combination of cryptography and economic incentives, all in a completely anonymous and decentralized system. This article shows that Nakamoto’s novel form of trust, while undeniably ingenious, is deeply economically limited. The core argument is three equations. A zero-profit condition on the quantity of honest blockchain “trust support” (work, stake, etc.) and an incentive-compatibility condition on the system’s security against majority attack (the Achilles heel of all forms of permissionless consensus) together imply an equilibrium constraint, which says that the “flow” cost of blockchain trust has to be large at all times relative to the benefits of attacking the system. This is extremely expensive relative to traditional forms of trust and scales linearly with the value of attack. In scenarios that represent Nakamoto trust becoming a more significant part of the global financial system, the cost of trust would exceed global GDP. Nakamoto trust would become more attractive if an attacker lost the stock value of their capital in addition to paying the flow cost of attack, but this requires either collapse of the system (hardly reassuring) or external support from rule of law. The key difference between Nakamoto trust and traditional trust grounded in rule of law and complementary sources, such as reputations, relationships, and collateral, is economies of scale: society or a firm pays a fixed cost to enjoy trust over a large quantity of economic activity at low or zero marginal cost.
records.abstract_cn: 中本聪（Satoshi Nakamoto）（2008）发明了一种不需要政府或法治支持的新型经济体系。相反，信任和安全源于密码学和经济激励的结合，所有这些都在一个完全匿名和去中心化的系统中。本文表明，中本聪新颖的信任形式虽然无可否认是巧妙的，但在经济上却受到严重限制。核心论点是三方程。诚实区块链“信任支持”（工作、权益等）数量的零利润条件和系统针对多数攻击的安全性（所有形式的无许可共识的致命弱点）的激励兼容性条件一起意味着均衡约束，即相对于攻击系统的收益，区块链信任的“流动”成本必须始终很大。相对于传统形式的信任来说，这是极其昂贵的，并且与攻击的价值成线性比例。在中本聪信任成为全球金融体系更重要组成部分的情景中，信任成本将超过全球 GDP。如果攻击者除了支付攻击的流量成本之外还损失了其资本的股票价值，那么中本聪信任将变得更具吸引力，但这需要系统崩溃（很难让人放心）或来自法治的外部支持。中本聪信任与基于法治和声誉、关系和抵押品等互补来源的传统信任之间的主要区别在于规模经济：社会或企业支付固定成本，以较低或零边际成本在大量经济活动中享有信任。

records.title_en: A Welfare Analysis of Tax Audits Across the Income Distribution
records.title_cn: 收入分配中税务审计的福利分析
records.abstract_en: We estimate the returns to IRS audits of taxpayers across the income distribution. We find an additional $1 spent auditing taxpayers above the 90th income percentile yields more than $12 in revenue, while audits of below-median income taxpayers yield $5. We construct our estimates by drawing from comprehensive internal accounting information and audit-level enforcement logs. We begin by estimating the average initial return to all audits of U.S. taxpayers filing in tax years 2010–2014. On average, $1 in audit spending initially raises $2.17 in revenue. Audits of high-income taxpayers are more costly, but the additional revenue raised more than offsets the costs. Audits of the 99–99.9th percentile have a 3.2:1 initial return; audits of the top 0.1% return 6.3:1. We then exploit the 40% audit reduction between tax years 2010 and 2014 to examine the returns to marginal audits. We find they exceed the returns to average audits. Revenues remain relatively unchanged, but marginal costs fall below average costs due to economies of scale. Next, we use randomly selected audits to examine the effect of an initial audit on future revenue. This individual deterrence effect produces at least three times more revenue than the initial audit. Deterrence effects are relatively consistent across the income distribution. This results in the 12:1 return above the 90th percentile. We conclude by estimating the welfare consequences of audits using the MVPF framework and comparing audits to other revenue-raising policies. We find that audits raise revenue at lower welfare cost.
records.abstract_cn: 我们估计了国税局对整个收入分配纳税人的审计回报。我们发现，对高于 1 收入百分位数的纳税人进行额外的 $90 审计，产生的收入超过 $12 美元，而对收入中位数以下的纳税人进行审计，则产生 $5 美元。我们通过综合的内部会计信息和审计级别的执行日志来构建我们的估计。我们首先估计美国纳税人在纳税年度 2010-2014 中提交的所有审计的平均初始回报。平均而言，$1 的审计支出最初会增加 $2.17 的收入。对高收入纳税人的审计成本更高，但筹集的额外收入足以抵消成本。 99-99.9 百分位的审计具有 3.2:1 初始回报；顶部 0.1% 的审核返回 6.3:1。然后，我们利用纳税年度 40% 和 2010 之间的 2014 审计减少来检查边际审计的回报。我们发现它们超出了平均审计回报。收入保持相对不变，但由于规模经济，边际成本低于平均成本。接下来，我们使用随机选择的审计来检查初始审计对未来收入的影响。这种个人威慑效应产生的收入至少比初次审计多三倍。威慑效应在整个收入分配中相对一致。这导致 12:1 回报率高于 90 百分位。最后，我们使用 MVPF 框架估计审计的福利后果，并将审计与其他创收政策进行比较。我们发现审计以较低的福利成本增加收入。

records.title_en: Measuring and Mitigating Racial Disparities in Tax Audits
records.title_cn: 衡量和减轻税务审计中的种族差异
records.abstract_en: Tax authorities around the world rely on audits to detect underreported tax liabilities and to verify that taxpayers qualify for the benefits they claim. We study differences in Internal Revenue Service audit rates between Black and non-Black taxpayers. Because neither we nor the IRS observe taxpayer race, we propose and use a novel partial identification strategy to estimate these differences. Despite race-blind audit selection, we find that Black taxpayers are audited at 2.9 to 4.7 times the rate of non-Black taxpayers. An important driver of the disparity is differing audit rates by race among taxpayers claiming the Earned Income Tax Credit (EITC). Using counterfactual audit selection models to explore why the disparity arises, we find that maximizing the detection of underreported taxes would not lead to Black EITC claimants being audited at higher rates. Rather, the audit disparity among EITC claimants stems largely from a policy decision to prioritize detecting overclaims of refundable credits over other forms of noncompliance. Modifying the audit selection algorithm to target total underreported taxes while holding fixed the number of audited EITC claimants would reduce the share of audited taxpayers who are Black and would lead to more audits focused on accurate reporting of business income and deductions, fewer audits focused on the eligibility of claimed dependents, higher per audit costs, and more detected noncompliance.
records.abstract_cn: 世界各地的税务机关依靠审计来发现少报的纳税义务，并核实纳税人是否有资格享受他们声称的福利。我们研究黑人和非黑人纳税人之间国税局审计率的差异。因为我们和国税局都没有观察纳税人的种族，所以我们提出并使用一种新颖的部分识别策略来估计这些差异。尽管存在种族盲审计选择，我们发现黑人纳税人接受审计的比率是非黑人纳税人的 2.9 至 4.7 倍。造成这种差异的一个重要因素是，申请劳动所得税抵免 (EITC) 的纳税人因种族不同而存在不同的审计率。使用反事实审计选择模型来探讨出现差异的原因，我们发现最大限度地发现漏报的税收不会导致黑人 EITC 索赔人以更高的比率接受审计。相反，EITC 索赔人之间的审计差异很大程度上源于一项政策决定，即优先检测可退还信贷的过度索赔，而不是其他形式的违规行为。修改审计选择算法以瞄准漏报税款总额，同时保持经审计的 EITC 索赔人的数量固定，将减少经审计的黑人纳税人的比例，并导致更多的审计侧重于准确报告业务收入和扣除额，更少的审计侧重于申报的家属的资格，每项审计成本更高，并且发现更多的违规行为。

records.title_en: The Global Race for Talent: Brain Drain, Knowledge Transfer, and Growth
records.title_cn: 全球人才竞赛：人才流失、知识转移和增长
records.abstract_en: How does inventors’ migration affect international talent allocation, knowledge diffusion, and productivity growth? To answer this question, I build a novel two-country innovation-led endogenous growth model, where heterogeneous inventors produce innovations, learn from others, and make dynamic migration and return decisions. Migrants interact with individuals at origin and destination, diffusing knowledge within and across countries. To quantify this framework, I construct a micro-level data set of migrant inventors on the U.S.-EU corridor from patent data and document that (i) gross migration is asymmetric, with brain drain (net emigration) from the EU to the United States; (ii) migrants increase their patenting by 33% a year after migration; (iii) migrants continue working with inventors at origin after moving, although less frequently; (iv) migrants’ productivity gains spill over to their collaborators at origin, who increase patenting by 16% a year when a co-inventor emigrates. I calibrate the model to match the empirical results and study the effect of innovation and migration policy. A tax cut for foreigners and return migrants in the EU that eliminates the brain drain increases EU innovation but lowers U.S. innovation and knowledge spillovers. The former effect dominates in the first 25 years, increasing EU productivity growth by 3%, but the latter dominates in the long run, lowering growth by 3%. On the migration policy side, doubling the size of the U.S. H1B visa program increases U.S. and EU growth by 4% in the long run, because it sorts inventors to where they produce more innovations and knowledge spillovers.
records.abstract_cn: 发明家的移民如何影响国际人才配置、知识传播和生产率增长？为了回答这个问题，我构建了一个新颖的二国家创新主导的内生增长模型，在该模型中，异质发明人进行创新，向他人学习，并做出动态的迁移和返回决策。移民在原籍地和目的地与个人互动，在国家内部和国家之间传播知识。为了量化这个框架，我根据专利数据和文件构建了美国-欧盟走廊上移民发明人的微观数据集，并记录了以下内容：（i）总移民是不对称的，人才从欧盟流失（净移民）到美国； (ii) 移民一年后其专利申请量增加33%； (iii) 移民在移居后继续与原籍发明人合作，尽管频率较低； (iv) 移民生产力的提高会溢出到其原籍合作者身上，当共同发明人移民时，他们的专利申请量每年增加 16%。我校准模型以匹配实证结果，并研究创新和移民政策的效果。对欧盟的外国人和回国移民减税可以消除人才外流，从而增加了欧盟的创新，但降低了美国的创新和知识溢出。前一种效应在第一25年中占主导地位，使欧盟生产率增长3%，但从长远来看，后者占主导地位，降低增长3%。在移民政策方面，从长远来看，将美国 H1B 签证计划的规模扩大一倍将使美国和欧盟的经济增长4%，因为它将发明家分类到能够产生更多创新和知识溢出的地方。

records.title_en: Reserves Were Not So Ample After All
records.title_cn: 储备毕竟不是那么充足
records.abstract_en: We show that the likelihood of a liquidity crunch in wholesale U.S. dollar funding markets depends on levels of reserve balances at the financial institutions that are the most active intermediaries of these markets. Heightened risk of an imminent liquidity crunch is signaled by significant delays in intraday payments to these large financial institutions over the prior two weeks. Our study contributes to the broader dialogue surrounding the Federal Reserve’s ongoing quantitative tightening.
records.abstract_cn: 我们表明，美元批发融资市场出现流动性紧缩的可能性取决于作为这些市场最活跃中介机构的金融机构的准备金余额水平。前二周内向这些大型金融机构的盘中付款出现严重延迟，预示着流动性紧缩的风险加剧。我们的研究有助于围绕美联储正在进行的量化紧缩进行更广泛的对话。

records.title_en: LinkedOut? A Field Experiment on Discrimination in Job Network Formation
records.title_cn: LinkedOut？求职网络形成中的歧视：一项田野实验
records.abstract_en: We assess the impact of discrimination on Black individuals’ job networks across the United States using a two-stage field experiment with 400+ fictitious LinkedIn profiles. In the first stage, we vary race via AI-generated images only and find that Black profiles’ connection requests are 13% less likely to be accepted. Based on users’ CVs, we find widespread discrimination across social groups. In the second stage, we exogenously endow Black and white profiles with the same networks and ask connected users for career advice. We find no evidence of direct discrimination in information provision. However, when taking into account differences in the composition and size of networks, Black profiles receive substantially fewer replies. Our findings suggest that gatekeeping is a key driver of Black–white disparities.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用400多个虚构 LinkedIn 个人主页的两阶段田野实验，评估美国黑人群体在求职网络形成中的歧视程度。第一阶段仅通过 AI 生成图像改变种族，发现黑人主页的连接请求被接受的概率低13%。基于用户简历，我们发现不同社会群体之间普遍存在歧视。第二阶段我们外生地为黑人和白人主页赋予相同网络，并向其联系对象征询职业建议。结果显示，在信息提供环节没有直接歧视证据；但考虑网络构成和规模差异后，黑人主页得到的回复显著更少。我们的发现表明，网络把关机制是造成黑人与白人差距的重要驱动因素。

records.title_en: Overinference from Weak Signals and Underinference from Strong Signals
records.title_cn: 弱信号的过度推断和强信号的推断不足
records.abstract_en: When people receive new information, sometimes they revise their beliefs too much, and sometimes too little. We show that a key driver of whether people overinfer or underinfer is the strength of the information. Based on a model in which people know which direction to update in, but not exactly how much to update, we hypothesize that people will overinfer from weak signals and underinfer from strong signals. We then test this hypothesis across four different environments: abstract experiments, a naturalistic experiment, sports betting markets, and financial markets. In each environment, our consistent and robust finding is overinference from weak signals and underinference from strong signals. Our framework and findings can help harmonize apparently contradictory results from the experimental and empirical literatures.
records.abstract_cn: 当人们收到新信息时，有时他们会过多地修正自己的信念，有时又修正得太少。我们表明，人们过度推断或推断不足的关键驱动因素是信息的强度。基于人们知道更新方向但不知道更新多少的模型，我们假设人们会从弱信号中过度推断，从强信号中推断不足。然后，我们在四不同的环境中测试这个假设：抽象实验、自然主义实验、体育博彩市场和金融市场。在每种环境中，我们一致且可靠的发现是对弱信号的过度推断和对强信号的推断不足。我们的框架和研究结果可以帮助协调实验和实证文献中明显矛盾的结果。

records.title_en: Believed Gender Differences in Social Preferences
records.title_cn: 社会偏好方面的性别差异
records.abstract_en: While there is a vast (and mixed) literature on gender differences in social preferences, little is known about believed gender differences in social preferences. Using data from 15 studies and 8,979 individuals, we find that women are believed to be more generous and more equality-oriented than men. This believed gender gap is robust across a wide range of contexts that vary in terms of strategic considerations, selfish motives, fairness concepts, and payoffs. Yet this believed gender gap is largely inaccurate. Consistent with models of associative memory, specifically the role of similarity and interference, the believed gender gap is correlated with recalled prior life experiences from similar contexts and significantly affected by an experience that may interfere with the recall process of prior memories, even though this interfering experience should not affect the beliefs of perfect-memory Bayesians. Application studies further reveal that believed gender differences extend to the household (i.e., beliefs about contributions to the home, family, and upbringing of children), the workplace (i.e., beliefs about equal pay), and policy views (i.e., beliefs about redistribution, equal access to education, healthcare, and affordable housing).
records.abstract_cn: 虽然关于社会偏好中的性别差异有大量（且混合的）文献，但人们对社会偏好中所相信的性别差异知之甚少。利用15研究和8,979个人的数据，我们发现女性被认为比男性更慷慨、更注重平等。人们认为，性别差距在各种背景下都存在很大的差异，这些背景在战略考虑、自私动机、公平观念和回报方面各不相同。然而，这种认为的性别差距在很大程度上是不准确的。与联想记忆模型一致，特别是相似性和干扰的作用，所相信的性别差距与从相似背景中回忆起的先前生活经历相关，并且受到可能干扰先前记忆回忆过程的经历的显着影响，尽管这种干扰经历不应影响完美记忆贝叶斯主义者的信念。应用研究进一步表明，人们所认为的性别差异延伸到了家庭（即对家庭、家庭和养育子女的贡献的信念）、工作场所（即对同工同酬的信念）和政策观点（即对再分配、平等接受教育、医疗保健和经济适用住房的信念）。

records.title_en: The Long-Run Impacts of Public Industrial Investment on Local Development and Economic Mobility: Evidence from World War II
records.title_cn: 公共工业投资对地方发展和经济流动性的长期影响：二战的证据
records.abstract_en: This article studies the long-run effects of government-led construction of manufacturing plants on the regions where they were built and on individuals from those regions. Specifically, we examine publicly financed plants built in dispersed locations outside of major urban centers for security reasons during the U.S. industrial mobilization for World War II. Wartime plant construction had large and persistent effects on local development, characterized by an expansion of relatively high-wage manufacturing employment throughout the postwar era. These benefits were shared by incumbent residents; we find men born before World War II in counties where plants were built earned $1,200 (in 2020 dollars) or 2.5% more per year in adulthood relative to those born in counterfactual comparison regions, with larger benefits accruing to children of lower-income parents. The balance of evidence suggests that these individuals benefited primarily from the local expansion of higher-wage jobs to which they had access as adults, rather than because of developmental effects from exposure to better environments during childhood.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了政府主导的制造工厂建设对工厂所在地区以及这些地区个人的长期影响。具体来说，我们研究了二战期间美国工业动员期间出于安全原因在主要城市中心以外的分散地点建造的公共资助工厂。战时工厂建设对当地发展产生了巨大而持久的影响，其特点是整个战后时期相对高工资的制造业就业的扩大。这些福利由现任居民分享；我们发现，与出生在反事实对比地区的男性相比，二战前出生在建有工厂的县的男性成年后每年的收入要高出 1,200 美元（以 2020 美元计算）或 2.5%，低收入父母的孩子获得的收益更大。证据平衡表明，这些人主要受益于他们成年后可以获得的高薪工作在当地的扩张，而不是因为童年时期接触更好环境的发展影响。

records.title_en: War Reparations, Structural Change, and Intergenerational Mobility
records.title_cn: 战争赔款、结构变革和代际流动
records.abstract_en: From 1944 to 1952, largely agrarian Finland had to export, on average, 4% of its yearly GDP in industrial products to the Soviet Union as war reparations. To meet the reparation demands, the Finnish state needed to provide extensive temporary support to Soviet-assigned industries with insufficient production capacity. This article documents the long-term effects of this extensive and temporary industrial policy on industrial and local development and on individual outcomes. Using newly digitized data sets, I show in a difference-in-differences setup that the short-term nonmarket production persistently and significantly increased the employment and production of the manufacturing industries exposed to the policy. These industries plausibly benefited from large initial investments and exposure to export markets associated with the war reparations. The episode further led to local development and structural change, as the more exposed regions became persistently more industrialized. I substantiate these within-Finland results with triple-difference setups using comparable Norwegian data. I use Finnish administrative data to study the long-term individual effects of the episode. Tracking individuals over 30 years, I show that the initial state investments and the persistent change in the local industrial structure increased long-term incomes, led to more educational attainment, and promoted the upward mobility of children and young adults in the more exposed regions before the war reparations period. The observed effects are driven by the more advanced heavy industry, which received the majority of state assistance.
records.abstract_cn: 从1944到1952，以农业为主的芬兰平均每年必须向苏联出口4%的工业产品作为战争赔款。为了满足赔偿要求，芬兰政府需要向生产能力不足的苏联指定工业提供广泛的临时支持。本文记录了这种广泛而临时的产业政策对工业和地方发展以及个人成果的长期影响。使用新的数字化数据集，我在双重差分设置中显示，短期非市场生产持续显着增加了受政策影响的制造业的就业和生产。这些行业似乎受益于大量初始投资和与战争赔款相关的出口市场。这一事件进一步导致了当地的发展和结构变化，因为暴露程度较高的地区持续变得更加工业化。我使用可比较的挪威数据，通过三重差异设置证实了芬兰境内的这些结果。我使用芬兰的行政数据来研究这一事件对个人的长期影响。通过对个人长达30年的跟踪，我发现，最初的国家投资和当地产业结构的持续变化增加了长期收入，带来了更多的教育程度，并促进了战争赔款之前受影响较大地区的儿童和年轻人的向上流动。观察到的影响是由更先进的重工业推动的，该工业获得了大部分国家援助。

records.title_en: Mandatory Notice of Layoff, Job Search, and Efficiency
records.title_cn: 强制裁员通知、求职和效率
records.abstract_en: In all OECD countries, mandatory notice (MN) policies require firms to inform workers in advance of a layoff. In our theoretical framework, MN helps workers avoid unemployment and find better jobs by encouraging them to search for a new job while still employed, thereby increasing future production. The magnitude of this production gain depends on the relative effectiveness of search while employed versus unemployed. But on-the-job search and diminished work incentives reduce current production. If future gains outweigh current production losses, longer advance notice improves production efficiency. If not, Coasian bargaining predicts that firms offer a larger severance instead of longer notice. With bargaining, the sole efficiency loss of MN is due to delayed separations of unproductive job matches. We test these predictions using novel Swedish administrative data on layoff notifications. Workers eligible for extended MN receive longer notice and larger severance, resulting in less exposure to nonemployment spells and higher-paying jobs. These favorable labor market outcomes are solely due to longer notice; in contrast, larger severance delays job finding and has no impact on wages. We also show that advance notice replaces job search while unemployed with more effective search while employed. On the production side, we document a productivity drop among notified workers and estimate a production loss due to delayed separations. Using our estimates of production gains and losses to evaluate the overall production efficiency, we conclude that the gains of MN seem to outweigh the losses.
records.abstract_cn: 在所有经合组织国家，强制通知（MN）政策要求公司在裁员前通知工人。在我们的理论框架中，MN 通过鼓励工人在仍在工作的情况下寻找新工作来帮助他们避免失业并找到更好的工作，从而增加未来的产量。这种生产增益的大小取决于就业与失业期间搜索的相对有效性。但在职搜索和工作激励的减弱降低了当前的产量。如果未来的收益超过当前的生产损失，较长的提前通知可以提高生产效率。如果没有，科斯讨价还价预测，公司将提供更高的遣散费，而不是更长的通知时间。通过讨价还价，MN 唯一的效率损失是由于非生产性工作匹配的延迟分离造成的。我们使用瑞典有关裁员通知的新颖行政数据来测试这些预测。有资格享受延长 MN 的工人会收到更长的通知时间和更高的遣散费，从而减少失业期并获得更高薪的工作。这些有利的劳动力市场结果完全是由于更长的通知时间；相比之下，较高的遣散费会延迟找工作，并且对工资没有影响。我们还表明，提前通知取代了失业时的求职，而就业时的求职更为有效。在生产方面，我们记录了通知工人的生产力下降情况，并估计了由于延迟离职而造成的生产损失。使用我们对生产收益和损失的估计来评估整体生产效率，我们得出的结论是，MN 的收益似乎大于损失。

records.title_en: Do Financial Concerns Make Workers Less Productive?
records.title_cn: 财务问题会降低工人的生产力吗？
records.abstract_en: Workers who are worried about their personal finances may find it hard to focus at work. If so, reducing financial concerns could increase productivity. We test this hypothesis in a sample of low-income Indian piece-rate manufacturing workers. We stagger when wages are paid out: some workers are paid earlier and receive a cash infusion while others remain liquidity constrained. The cash infusion leads workers to reduce their financial concerns by immediately paying off debts and buying household essentials. Subsequently, they become more productive at work: their output increases by 7% (0.11 std. dev.), and they make fewer costly, unintentional mistakes. Workers with more cash on hand thus not only work faster but also more attentively, suggesting improved cognition. These effects are concentrated among more financially constrained workers. We argue that mechanisms such as gift exchange or nutrition cannot account for our results. Instead, our findings suggest that financial strain, at least partly through psychological channels, has the potential to reduce earnings exactly when money is most needed.
records.abstract_cn: 担心个人财务状况的员工可能会发现很难集中精力工作。如果是这样，减少财务问题可以提高生产力。我们在印度低收入计件制造业工人样本中检验了这一假设。我们在发放工资时犹豫不决：一些工人提前支付工资并获得现金注入，而另一些工人的流动性仍然受到限制。现金注入使工人们可以通过立即偿还债务和购买家庭必需品来减少财务担忧。随后，他们的工作效率变得更高：他们的产出增加了 7%（0.11 标准偏差），并且他们犯的代价高昂的无意错误也更少。因此，手头有更多现金的工人不仅工作速度更快，而且更专心，这表明认知能力有所提高。这些影响主要集中在经济拮据的工人身上。我们认为礼物交换或营养等机制无法解释我们的结果。相反，我们的研究结果表明，财务压力（至少部分通过心理渠道）有可能在最需要钱的时候减少收入。

records.title_en: Present Bias Amplifies the Household Balance-Sheet Channels of Macroeconomic Policy
records.title_cn: 当前的偏见扩大了宏观经济政策的家庭资产负债表渠道
records.abstract_en: We study the effect of monetary and fiscal policy in a heterogeneous-agent model where households have present-biased time preferences and naive beliefs. The model features a liquid asset and illiquid home equity, which households can use as collateral for borrowing. Because present bias substantially increases households’ marginal propensity to consume (MPC), present bias increases the effect of fiscal policy. Present bias also amplifies the effect of monetary policy, but at the same time, slows down the speed of monetary transmission. Interest rate cuts incentivize households to conduct cash-out refinances, which become targeted liquidity injections to high-MPC households. Present bias also introduces a motive for households to procrastinate refinancing their mortgages, which slows down the speed with which this monetary channel operates.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了异质代理模型中货币和财政政策的影响，其中家庭具有当前偏差的时间偏好和天真的信念。该模型具有流动性资产和非流动性房屋净值，家庭可以将其用作借款抵押品。由于当前偏差大大增加了家庭的边际消费倾向（MPC），因此当前偏差会增加财政政策的效果。当前的偏差也放大了货币政策的效果，但同时也减慢了货币传导的速度。降息会激励家庭进行现金再融资，从而成为高MPC家庭的有针对性的流动性注入。当前的偏见还导致家庭推迟抵押贷款再融资，从而减慢了这一货币渠道的运作速度。

records.title_en: A Cognitive View of Policing
records.title_cn: 警务的认知观
records.abstract_en: What causes adverse policing outcomes, such as excessive uses of force and unnecessary arrests? Prevailing explanations focus on problematic officers or deficient regulations and oversight. We introduce an overlooked perspective. We suggest that the cognitive demands inherent in policing can undermine officer decision making. Unless officers are prepared for these demands, they may jump to conclusions too quickly without fully considering alternative ways of seeing a situation. This can lead to adverse policing outcomes. To test this perspective, we created a new training that teaches officers to consider different ways of interpreting the situations they encounter. We evaluated this training using a randomized controlled trial with 2,070 officers from the Chicago Police Department. In a series of lab assessments, we find that treated officers were significantly more likely to consider a wider range of evidence and develop more explanations for subjects’ actions. Critically, we also find that training affected officer performance in the field, leading to reductions in uses of force, discretionary arrests, and arrests of Black civilians. Meanwhile, officer activity levels remained unchanged, and trained officers were less likely to be injured on duty. Our results highlight the value of considering the cognitive aspects of policing and demonstrate the power of using behaviorally informed approaches to improve officer decision making and policing outcomes.
records.abstract_cn: 是什么导致了不良的警务结果，例如过度使用武力和不必要的逮捕？普遍的解释集中在有问题的官员或监管和监督不足。我们引入一个被忽视的观点。我们认为，警务工作固有的认知需求可能会损害警官的决策。除非官员们对这些要求做好准备，否则他们可能会在没有充分考虑看待情况的其他方式的情况下过快下结论。这可能会导致不利的警务结果。为了检验这一观点，我们创建了一项新的培训，教警官考虑以不同的方式解释他们遇到的情况。我们使用芝加哥警察局 2,070 名警官进行的随机对照试验来评估本次培训。在一系列实验室评估中，我们发现接受治疗的警官更有可能考虑更广泛的证据，并对受试者的行为提出更多解释。至关重要的是，我们还发现培训影响了军官在战场上的表现，导致使用武力、酌情逮捕和逮捕黑人平民的减少。与此同时，警官的活动水平保持不变，受过训练的警官在执行任务时受伤的可能性较小。我们的结果强调了考虑警务认知方面的价值，并证明了使用行为知情方法来改善警官决策和警务结果的力量。

records.title_en: Costs of Financing U.S. Federal Debt Under a Gold Standard: 1791-1933
records.title_cn: 金本位制下的美国联邦债务融资成本：1791-1933
records.abstract_en: From a new data set, we infer time series of term structures of yields on U.S. federal bonds during the gold standard era from 1791–1933 and use our estimates to reassess historical narratives about how the United States expanded its fiscal capacity. We show that U.S. debt carried a default risk premium until the end of the nineteenth century, when it started being priced as an alternative safe asset to U.K. debt. During the Civil War, investors expected the United States to return to a gold standard so the federal government was able to borrow without facing denomination risk. After the introduction of the National Banking System, the slope of the yield curve switched from down to up and the premium on U.S. debt with maturity less than one year disappeared.
records.abstract_cn: 根据新的数据集，我们推断出1791-1933金本位时代美国联邦债券收益率期限结构的时间序列，并使用我们的估计来重新评估有关美国如何扩大其财政能力的历史叙述。我们的研究表明，直到十九世纪末，美国债务都带有违约风险溢价，当时它开始被定价为英国债务的替代安全资产。内战期间，投资者期望美国恢复金本位，以便联邦政府能够在不面临面额风险的情况下借款。引入国家银行体系后，收益率曲线的斜率由下转为上，期限小于一年的美国债务溢价消失。

records.title_en: Urban rewilding for sustainability and food security
records.title_cn: 城市再野化促进可持续性与粮食安全
records.abstract_en: Urban sustainability and food security remain pressing issues for cities across the world. Here, we argue that adapting rewilding to urban contexts unlocks new solutions for societal challenges. Rewilding is an established paradigm in ecological restoration, with the goal of restoring autonomous biotic and abiotic agents and processes. However, urban rewilding is an emerging but under-studied phenomenon that calls for multispecies coexistence and agency. Coupled with multispecies sustainability, urban rewilding can increase the operational autonomy of urban inhabitants through shared human-nonhuman co-stewardship of urban space. In this viewpoint paper, we explore the conceptual implications of rewilding for food security and land use planning across scales and infrastructures in urban settings. We then discuss how urban rewilding would particularly benefit food security across diverse urban contexts and examine some examples.
records.abstract_cn: 城市可持续性和粮食安全仍然是全球城市面临的紧迫问题。在此，我们认为将再野化适应于城市环境可为社会挑战解锁新的解决方案。再野化是生态恢复中的一个既定范式，其目标是恢复自主的生物和非生物因子及过程。然而，城市再野化是一个新兴但研究不足的现象，需要多物种共存和能动性。结合多物种可持续性，城市再野化可以通过共享的人类-非人类共同管理城市空间，提高城市居民的操作自主性。在这篇观点文章中，我们探讨了再野化对城市环境中跨尺度和基础设施的粮食安全及土地利用规划的概念性影响。随后，我们讨论了城市再野化如何在多样化的城市背景下特别有益于粮食安全，并考察了一些实例。

records.title_en: Spatiotemporal analysis of underlying factors in urban transformations: Quantifying the importance of urban plan intentions in the Austin Metropolitan Area, Texas
records.title_cn: 城市转型中潜在因素的时空分析：量化德克萨斯州奥斯汀大都会区城市规划意图的重要性
records.abstract_en: Urban planning has widely become a key policy tool for managing urban growth. However, understanding the role of urban planning in shaping land development and directing urbanization is still contentious across various socioeconomic and geographical contexts. This paper conducts an in-depth analysis of urban spatial transformation in Austin, Texas across three distinct periods: the pre-planning period (1992–2001), the Envision Central Texas (ECT) period (2001–2011), and the Imagine Austin Comprehensive Plan (IACP) period (2011–2019). The findings reveal a marked decline in urban sprawl and the construction of new low-intensity development zones after 2001. Simultaneously, there was a noticeable increase in the percentage of newly transitioned high-intensity developed land. Employing Geographically Weighted Logistic Regression (GWLR) modeling, the study provides a nuanced understanding of how spatially varying planning intentions guided spatial planning practices since the mid-2000s. The results indicate a diminishing influence of traditional factors on urban transformation while the role of planning intentions saw increasing prominence over time. Amongst the different planning intentions, those related to 'development centers' had less impact compared to those tied to protected areas and transport systems. The study establishes that IACP had a profound influence on Austin's urban spatial transformation, primarily due to its more clearly defined and explicit planning intentions compared to ECT. The research contributes to a deeper understanding of urban spatial transformation dynamics, which is vital for future planning initiatives aimed at sustainable urban development.
records.abstract_cn: 城市规划已广泛成为管理城市增长的关键政策工具。然而，理解城市规划在塑造土地开发和引导城市化中的作用，在不同社会经济和地理背景下仍存在争议。本文对德克萨斯州奥斯汀的城市空间转型进行了深入分析，涵盖三个不同时期：规划前期（1992-2001）、展望中央德克萨斯（ECT）时期（2001-2011）以及想象奥斯汀综合规划（IACP）时期（2011-2019）。研究结果显示，2001年后，城市蔓延和新建低强度开发区的数量显著下降。同时，新转型的高强度开发土地比例明显增加。采用地理加权逻辑回归（GWLR）模型，研究提供了自2000年代中期以来，空间变化的规划意图如何指导空间规划实践的细致理解。结果表明，传统因素对城市转型的影响逐渐减弱，而规划意图的作用随时间日益凸显。在不同规划意图中，与“发展中心”相关的意图相比，与保护区和交通系统相关的意图影响较小。研究确定，IACP对奥斯汀的城市空间转型产生了深远影响，这主要归因于其相比ECT更为明确和具体的规划意图。本研究有助于更深入地理解城市空间转型动态，这对未来旨在实现可持续城市发展的规划举措至关重要。

records.title_en: Promoting sustainable land management: An innovative approach to land-take decision-making
records.title_cn: 促进可持续土地管理：土地占用决策的创新方法
records.abstract_en: Land degradation presents significant global challenges, threatening natural resources, biodiversity, and food security. Addressing this issue requires more effective land-take decision-making processes, particularly in data-deficient cities where comprehensive land assessment methods are challenging to implement. This study introduces a streamlined land-take decision-making framework designed to promote sustainable land management practices. The framework consists of two key components: the Sustainable Development Index (SDI) for assessing current land-take decisions and the Decision-Making Rubric (DMR) for proposing mitigated solutions. Applied to a pilot case city in India, the framework demonstrated its practical utility by showing that land-take decisions between 2001 and 2021 resulted in a 69 % reduction of natural land cover. If these trends continue, the assessment of the 2031 master plan using SDI indicates that an additional 56 % of the remaining ecosystem-rich areas, which include regions with high biodiversity and ecological value, could be lost by 2031. However, the framework's application could potentially mitigate these impacts, reducing the projected 56 % loss to 14 %, thereby promoting more sustainable and equitable land management practices. The study's aim is to provide decision-makers with a practical tool to improve land identification methods and enhance the sustainability of land-take decisions. This research contributes to the existing body of knowledge by addressing the gap in practical, easily applicable tools for sustainable land management in data-deficient urban contexts.
records.abstract_cn: 土地退化带来了显著的全球性挑战，威胁着自然资源、生物多样性和粮食安全。解决这一问题需要更有效的土地占用决策过程，特别是在数据匮乏的城市中，全面的土地评估方法难以实施。本研究引入了一个简化的土地占用决策框架，旨在促进可持续土地管理实践。该框架由两个关键组成部分构成：用于评估当前土地占用决策的可持续发展指数（SDI）和用于提出缓解方案的决策评分标准（DMR）。应用于印度的一个试点案例城市，该框架展示了其实用性，表明2001年至2021年间的土地占用决策导致自然土地覆盖减少了69%。如果这些趋势持续下去，使用SDI对2031年总体规划的评估表明，到2031年，剩余生态系统丰富区域（包括具有高生物多样性和生态价值的地区）中额外56%的面积可能会丧失。然而，该框架的应用可能缓解这些影响，将预计的56%损失减少到14%，从而促进更可持续和公平的土地管理实践。本研究旨在为决策者提供一个实用工具，以改进土地识别方法并增强土地占用决策的可持续性。这项研究通过填补数据匮乏城市环境中可持续土地管理实用且易于应用工具的空白，为现有知识体系做出了贡献。

records.title_en: Towards the use of stool land revenue for community development in Ghana: Evidence from the Wassa Fiase traditional area
records.title_cn: 关于加纳使用部落土地收入促进社区发展的探讨：来自瓦萨菲亚塞传统地区的证据
records.abstract_en: Land generates a lot of revenue which could be used for development. Stool land revenue in the Wassa Fiase traditional area in particular, provides such an opportunity. In the Wassa Fiase area the dynamic land management practices serve as a prospect to mobilise more revenue from various sources. In a case study, and using semi-structured interviews and questionnaires in addition to a multi-stage sampling technique, the use of stool land revenue for the development of communities was investigated. It was revealed that the Wassa Fiase area generate a substantial amount of revenue but members of the community seem not to know exactly what the revenue was being used for. Although they agreed that such revenues could help propel the development of the area. The District Assemblies reported of various projects that are funded with stool land revenue which is laudable. Significantly, members of the community must be consulted in deciding projects stool land revenue is used for. The Office of the Administrator of Stool Lands is now empowered to ensure that stool land revenue is used to benefit communities with a new regulation. The Ghana Extractive Industry Transparency Initiative must continue their advocacy to ensure transparency and accountability of revenue from the extractive sector. The Mineral Development Fund must implement the Mining Community Development Scheme so that more development is carried out throughout the country.
records.abstract_cn: 土地产生大量可用于发展的收入。特别是瓦萨菲亚塞传统地区的部落土地收入，提供了这样的机会。在瓦萨菲亚塞地区，动态的土地管理实践为从各种来源筹集更多收入提供了前景。在一项案例研究中，采用半结构化访谈和问卷调查以及多阶段抽样技术，调查了部落土地收入用于社区发展的情况。结果显示，瓦萨菲亚塞地区产生了大量收入，但社区成员似乎并不确切知道这些收入被用于何处。尽管他们同意此类收入有助于推动该地区的发展。地区议会报告了由部落土地收入资助的各种项目，这是值得称赞的。重要的是，在决定部落土地收入用于哪些项目时，必须咨询社区成员。土地管理者办公室现在有权通过一项新法规确保部落土地收入用于造福社区。加纳采掘业透明度倡议必须继续其倡导工作，以确保采掘业收入的透明度和问责制。矿产发展基金必须实施采矿社区发展计划，以便在全国范围内开展更多发展项目。

records.title_en: Improving mechanization conditions or encouraging non-grain crop production? Strategies for mitigating farmland abandonment in China’s mountainous areas
records.title_cn: 改善机械化条件还是鼓励非粮作物生产？缓解中国山区耕地撂荒的策略
records.abstract_en: Food security is a critical global issue, requiring that the challenges of farmland abandonment be addressed. As a vital component of agricultural production in China, farmland use is affected by mechanization conditions and the crop cultivation decisions of rural households. With the decreasing economic viability of farmland in China’s mountainous areas, the effects of mechanization conditions and non-grain crop production on farmland abandonment remain controversial. This study developed a theoretical framework and used unique survey data from 2400 rural households in China’s mountainous areas to analyze the relationship between mechanization conditions, non-grain crop production, and farmland abandonment using multiple models, heterogeneity analysis, and factual characteristics analysis. These findings demonstrate that improving mechanization conditions and encouraging non-grain crop production could mitigate farmland abandonment. Non-grain crop production could mitigate abandonment through increasing agricultural labor input, and improving mechanization conditions could inhibit non-grain crop production. Additionally, improving mechanization conditions had a more significant effect on households with higher education level and lower incomes, while encouraging non-grain crop production showed an opposite trend. Both measures had greater effect in the western and low-altitude regions. Therefore, to protect farmland and ensure food security in mountainous areas, it is necessary to continue land consolidation appropriately, actively encourage non-grain crop production, and comprehensively balance the demands of different management objectives.
records.abstract_cn: 粮食安全是一个关键的全球性问题，需要解决耕地撂荒的挑战。作为中国农业生产的重要组成部分，耕地利用受到机械化条件和农村家庭作物种植决策的影响。随着中国山区耕地经济可行性的下降，机械化条件和非粮作物生产对耕地撂荒的影响仍存在争议。本研究构建了一个理论框架，并利用来自中国山区2400户农村家庭的独特调查数据，通过多种模型、异质性分析和事实特征分析，探讨了机械化条件、非粮作物生产与耕地撂荒之间的关系。研究结果表明，改善机械化条件和鼓励非粮作物生产可以缓解耕地撂荒。非粮作物生产可以通过增加农业劳动力投入来缓解撂荒，而改善机械化条件则会抑制非粮作物生产。此外，改善机械化条件对教育水平较高和收入较低的家庭影响更为显著，而鼓励非粮作物生产则呈现相反趋势。这两种措施在西部和低海拔地区效果更大。因此，为保护山区耕地和确保粮食安全，有必要适度继续土地整治，积极鼓励非粮作物生产，并全面平衡不同管理目标的需求。

records.title_en: Address the challenge of cultivated land abandonment by cultivated land adoption: An evolutionary game perspective
records.title_cn: 通过耕地认养应对耕地撂荒挑战：演化博弈视角
records.abstract_en: Cultivated land abandonment constitutes a global phenomenon that poses a significant threat to both the ecological environment and food security. The cultivated land adoption model emerges as an innovative agricultural business paradigm designed to address the challenges of cultivated land abandonment. To scrutinize the intrinsic mechanisms and conditions conducive to effective implementation, this paper constructs an evolutionary game model. It analyzes the synergistic cooperative behaviors and evolutionary stable equilibrium among urban residents, farmers, and the local government within the cultivated land adoption project. The findings reveal the potential for achieving six evolutionary stable equilibrium under specific conditions. Active government regulation, urban residents' adoption, and farmers' cooperation emerge as the ideal scenarios for effective regulation, promoting a substantial reduction in cultivated land abandonment. The government's regulatory conduct assumes a pivotal role in the success of cultivated land adoption project. A government with elevated political efficacy, reduced regulatory costs, significant penalties, and substantial subsidies demonstrates increased motivation and willingness to regulate effectively, thereby fostering cooperation between urban residents and farmers. The equitable distribution of benefits between urban residents and farmers emerges as a critical factor influencing cultivated land adoption initiatives. Urban residents exhibit greater motivation and willingness to participate when afforded increased green preference benefits, local sentiment preference benefits, and additional economic gains through cultivated land adoption. Similarly, farmers are more motivated and willing to cooperate with urban residents when presented with enhanced income opportunities from cultivated land adoption. The findings of this paper contribute to the refinement of land resource management theory and not only synthesize and integrate China's experience with cultivated land adoption but also offer a valuable management model for other countries to address the issue of land abandonment.
records.abstract_cn: 耕地撂荒是一个全球性现象，对生态环境和粮食安全构成重大威胁。耕地认养模式作为一种创新的农业经营范式应运而生，旨在应对耕地撂荒的挑战。为探究其有效实施的内在机制与条件，本文构建了一个演化博弈模型，分析了城市居民、农户和地方政府在耕地认养项目中的协同合作行为及演化稳定均衡。研究结果表明，在特定条件下可实现六种演化稳定均衡。积极的政府监管、城市居民的认养和农户的合作成为有效治理的理想情景，促进耕地撂荒大幅减少。政府的监管行为在耕地认养项目的成功中起着关键作用。具有较高政治效能、较低监管成本、显著惩罚和大量补贴的政府表现出更强的有效监管动机和意愿，从而促进城市居民与农户之间的合作。城市居民与农户之间的利益公平分配成为影响耕地认养举措的关键因素。当城市居民通过耕地认养获得更多绿色偏好收益、地方情感偏好收益和额外经济收益时，他们表现出更高的参与动机和意愿。同样，当农户通过耕地认养获得更高的收入机会时，他们更有动力和意愿与城市居民合作。本文的研究结果有助于完善土地资源管理理论，不仅综合和整合了中国耕地认养的经验，还为其他国家应对土地撂荒问题提供了有价值的管理模式。

records.title_en: Quantifying misallocation of public housing
records.title_cn: 量化公共住房的错配
records.abstract_en: We empirically investigate how rent control combined with the use of a non-market allocation mechanism – centralised waiting lists – affects the efficiency of housing allocation among public-housing tenants. We show that, on average, Dutch public-housing tenants consume a house whose value differs by 7.5% from what they would consume under an efficient allocation. This entails particularly large transfers in housing consumption from younger households to older households. The annual welfare loss arising from misallocation within the public-housing sector is modest, estimated at around €65 per tenant.
records.abstract_cn: 我们实证研究了租金管制与非市场分配机制（集中式等候名单）相结合如何影响公共住房租户之间的住房分配效率。我们表明，平均而言，荷兰公共住房租户所消费的房屋价值与在有效分配下他们本应消费的房屋价值相差7.5%。这导致了住房消费从年轻家庭向老年家庭的特别大规模转移。公共住房部门内部错配导致的年度福利损失较小，估计约为每位租户65欧元。

records.title_en: Correlation in state and local tax changes
records.title_cn: 州和地方税收变化的相关性
records.abstract_en: Empirical research in public economics, including our own, often uses variation in state and local taxes as an empirical laboratory to estimate causal relationships. A key concern is that other taxes might change at the same time. To assess this concern, we develop a dataset of state (1977–2022) and local (2000–2022) tax rates and revenue from personal income, corporate income, property, sales, and excise taxes. This new dataset generates two key results. First, we find that taxes of different types tend to co-move within a jurisdiction: a tax change of one type can more than double the likelihood of a second tax type changing in the same year. Local tax changes also co-move with tax changes enacted by the state they are located in. This positive correlation can upwardly bias elasticity estimates, but only moderately. For example, regressing state economic outcomes on the full set of state tax changes yields elasticities that are about 10%–30% smaller than those obtained from using a single tax type in isolation. Second, we document that the mix of taxes across state and local jurisdictions is very different, and that these differences have become more pronounced over time as jurisdictions have increasingly become reliant on the single tax type — sales, personal or corporate income tax — that was most prominent for them in the earliest part of our sample.
records.abstract_cn: 公共经济学中的实证研究，包括我们自己的研究，经常利用州和地方税收的变化作为实证实验室来估计因果关系。一个关键的担忧是，其他税收可能同时发生变化。为了评估这一担忧，我们构建了一个涵盖州（1977-2022年）和地方（2000-2022年）个人所得税、公司所得税、财产税、销售税和消费税税率及收入的数据集。这一新数据集产生了两个关键结果。首先，我们发现不同类型的税收往往在同一辖区内共同变动：一种税收类型的变化可能使另一种税收类型在同一年发生变化的可能性增加一倍以上。地方税收变化也与其所在州实施的税收变化共同变动。这种正相关性可能会向上偏误弹性估计，但幅度适中。例如，将州经济结果对全部州税收变化进行回归，得到的弹性比单独使用单一税收类型所得的弹性小约10%至30%。其次，我们记录了州和地方辖区之间的税收组合差异很大，并且随着辖区日益依赖单一税收类型——销售税、个人所得税或公司所得税——这些差异随时间变得更加明显，而这一单一税收类型在样本早期阶段对它们来说最为突出。

records.title_en: Student development in teacher–student interaction: Evidence from a randomized experiment in online education
records.title_cn: 师生互动中的学生发展：来自在线教育随机实验的证据
records.abstract_en: This study conducts the first investigation of how the teacher–student interaction in online education impacts the academic achievements and personality traits of primary school students using a field experiment. Our findings indicate that adding regular interactive online recitation sessions to pure online courses leads to significant improvements in students’ exam scores, as well as increased levels of extraversion, openness, and conscientiousness. The positive effects on students’ academic achievements and personality traits can be attributed to students’ enhanced learning motivation and engagement and increased levels of parental inputs, respectively.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究首次通过实地实验探讨了在线教育中师生互动对小学生学业成绩和个性特质的影响。我们的研究结果表明，在纯在线课程中加入定期的互动式在线背诵环节，能显著提高学生的考试成绩，并增强其外向性、开放性和尽责性水平。对学生学业成绩和个性特质的积极影响可分别归因于学生学习动机和参与度的提升，以及家长投入的增加。

records.title_en: The environmental cost of power outages: Evidence from Delhi
records.title_cn: 停电的环境成本：来自德里的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper examines an overlooked consequence of an unstable electricity supply: air pollution. Using a unique dataset with high-frequency records of outage events and pollution, we find that outages lead to a 0.4% and 1.3% increase in hourly NO2 and NO concentrations and a 0.4% increase in PM10 levels. This is likely attributable to the widespread use of highly polluting backup diesel generators. The environmental cost of outages exceeds the private cost for users when backup generators are adopted. Welfare analysis using bunching estimation highlights the importance of incorporating environmental benefits in the evaluation of policies aimed at mitigating outages.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了电力供应不稳定一个被忽视的后果：空气污染。利用包含停电事件和污染高频记录的独特数据集，我们发现停电导致每小时NO2和NO浓度分别增加0.4%和1.3%，PM10水平增加0.4%。这可能归因于高污染备用柴油发电机的广泛使用。当采用备用发电机时，停电的环境成本超过用户的私人成本。使用聚束估计的福利分析强调了在评估旨在缓解停电的政策时纳入环境效益的重要性。

records.title_en: The big sell: Privatizing East Germany’s economy
records.title_cn: 大甩卖：东德经济的私有化
records.abstract_en: Departing from communism, East Germany witnessed history’s most extensive privatization program. While the program sparked global interest as a blueprint for economic transformation, its effectiveness remains disputed. Using unique firm-level data, we examine the program’s objective to privatize the most competitive firms. We document that firms with higher baseline productivity are more likely to be privatized, yield higher prices, are more often acquired by West Germans, and are more likely to survive 20 years later. Inspecting the inner workings of the privatization agency, we illustrate challenges and lessons for how governments can design and implement industrial policy goals.
records.abstract_cn: 脱离共产主义后，东德见证了历史上最广泛的私有化计划。尽管该计划作为经济转型的蓝图引起了全球关注，但其有效性仍存争议。利用独特的企业层面数据，我们考察了该计划旨在私有化最具竞争力企业的目标。我们记录到，基线生产率较高的企业更有可能被私有化，获得更高的价格，更常被西德人收购，并且在20年后更有可能存活。通过审视私有化机构的内部运作，我们阐述了政府如何设计和实施产业政策目标的挑战与教训。

records.title_en: Labor market regulations and firm adjustments in skill demand
records.title_cn: 劳动力市场规制与企业技能需求的调整
records.abstract_en: We study how changes in labor market regulations may trigger firm adjustments in skill demand. Leveraging rich administrative data from Italy, we investigate the effects of a reform that, to increase job stability, reduced the firing costs for permanent employees and tightened the regulation of fixed-term contracts. Using a difference-in-differences (DID) design, we document that the reform had unintended effects, inducing firms to increase layoffs of low-skilled (LS) permanent employees and reduce hires of LS workers on fixed-term contracts. However, the reform had no effect on high-skilled workers or permanent hires. A theoretical search and matching model with heterogeneous skills and contract durations makes sense of our main findings.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了劳动力市场规制的变化如何引发企业在技能需求上的调整。利用意大利丰富的行政数据，我们考察了一项旨在提高工作稳定性、降低永久雇员解雇成本并收紧固定期限合同规制的改革的影响。采用双重差分（DID）设计，我们记录了该改革产生的意外效应，促使企业增加对低技能（LS）永久雇员的解雇，并减少对低技能工人的固定期限合同雇佣。然而，该改革对高技能工人或永久雇佣没有影响。一个包含异质性技能和合同期限的理论搜索与匹配模型解释了我们的主要发现。

records.title_en: How do business owners respond to a tax cut? Examining the 199A deduction for pass-through firms
records.title_cn: 企业主如何应对减税？考察穿透企业的199A扣除
records.abstract_en: We measure the responses of businesses and their owners to Section 199A, a deduction that reduced the effective tax rate on most U.S. pass-through business income beginning in 2018. Using tax records of individuals and businesses, we compare taxpayers with exogenously differing levels of exposure to the deduction, exploiting limitations within the statute. We find evidence of a 3 to 4 percent increase in reported business income eligible for the deduction during 2018 and 2019 for the more-exposed group relative to the less-exposed group. We also find some evidence of effects on specific hypothesized margins of adjustment. Partnerships reduced ineligible forms of compensation paid to owners by approximately 10 to 15 percent, in line with the incentives created by Section 199A, but S corporations did not reduce wages to owners. We find no evidence that Section 199A encouraged movements from employee to contractor status or increased contractor activity. Finally, we find little evidence of changes in real economic activity as measured by physical investment, wages to non-owners, or employment.
records.abstract_cn: 我们衡量了企业和其所有者对第199A条款的反应，该条款自2018年起降低了大多数美国穿透企业商业收入的有效税率。利用个人和企业的税务记录，我们比较了因法规限制而面临不同扣除暴露程度的纳税人。我们发现，在2018和2019年，相对于暴露程度较低的群体，暴露程度较高的群体报告的可享受扣除的商业收入增加了3至4%。我们还发现了一些对特定假设调整边际的影响证据。合伙企业减少了支付给所有者的不合格补偿形式，大约减少了10至15%，这与第199A条款产生的激励一致，但S公司并未减少支付给所有者的工资。我们没有发现第199A条款鼓励从雇员身份向承包商身份转变或增加承包商活动的证据。最后，我们几乎没有发现实际经济活动变化的证据，这些活动以实物投资、非所有者工资或就业来衡量。

records.title_en: Between a rock and a hard place: The costs and benefits of expanded unemployment insurance benefits
records.title_cn: 进退两难：扩大失业保险福利的成本与收益
records.abstract_en: We examine how the withdrawal of the largest expansion of unemployment insurance (UI) benefits in United States history affected job-finding, demand for other government assistance, and credit defaults. Using administrative UI data merged with credit records and applications for Medicaid and SNAP, we show that UI withdrawal led to an increase in job-finding that was most pronounced among financially constrained individuals with limited available credit. The cost savings from higher job-finding came at the expense of increased demand for other government services and higher defaults. Our results highlight an important interaction between UI, household finances, and other social insurance programs.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了美国历史上最大规模的失业保险（UI）福利撤销如何影响求职、对其他政府援助的需求以及信用违约。利用与信用记录及医疗补助和SNAP申请记录相匹配的行政UI数据，我们表明，UI撤销导致求职增加，这一效应在可用信贷有限的财务受限个体中最为显著。因求职增加而节省的成本，是以对其他政府服务需求的增加和更高的违约率为代价的。我们的结果凸显了UI、家庭财务与其他社会保险项目之间的重要互动。

records.title_en: Financial market exposure increases generalized trust
records.title_cn: 金融市场参与提升普遍信任
records.abstract_en: How can we build trust, especially in polarized societies? We propose that exposure to broad financial markets—where individuals place their assets in the hands of large groups of unfamiliar agents who nonetheless have the incentive and ability to promote their interests—can contribute to generalized trust. In a randomized controlled trial, we encourage Israelis to hold or trade stocks for up to seven weeks. We find that participation in financial markets increases the probability of expressing generalized trust by about 6 percentage points, equivalent to a quarter of the control group mean. The effects seem to be driven by political partisans along the left–right spectrum in Israel, and are robust to negative price changes. Thus, trust is not only a cause but can also be an effect of participation in financial markets.
records.abstract_cn: 我们如何建立信任，尤其是在两极分化的社会中？我们提出，参与广泛的金融市场——个人将资产交由大量不熟悉的代理人管理，而这些代理人既有激励也有能力促进其利益——可能有助于提升普遍信任。在一项随机对照试验中，我们鼓励以色列人持有或交易股票长达七周。我们发现，参与金融市场使表达普遍信任的概率提高了约6个百分点，相当于对照组均值的四分之一。这些效应似乎由以色列左右政治光谱中的党派人士驱动，并且对负面价格变化具有稳健性。因此，信任不仅是参与金融市场的原因，也可能是其结果。

records.title_en: The psychological gains from COVID-19 vaccination
records.title_cn: COVID-19疫苗接种带来的心理收益
records.abstract_en: We estimate the impact of COVID-19 vaccination on psychological well-being using information from a large-scale panel survey representative of the UK population. Exploiting exogenous variation in the timing of vaccinations, we find that vaccination increases psychological well-being (GHQ-12) by 0.12 standard deviations, compensating for one-half of the deterioration in mental health caused by the pandemic. This improvement persists for at least two months, and is linked to higher engagement in social activities and a decrease in the self-reported likelihood of contracting COVID-19. The main beneficiaries are individuals who became mentally distressed during the pandemic, supporting their prioritization in vaccination roll-outs. Conversely, individuals who harbored concerns about potential vaccine side effects show no improvement in psychological well-being upon vaccination, underscoring the importance of public confidence in vaccine safety and efficacy. Accounting for the improvement in psychological well-being increases the benefits of vaccination by around 50%.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用一项代表英国人口的大规模面板调查数据，估计了COVID-19疫苗接种对心理健康的影响。利用疫苗接种时间的外生变化，我们发现接种疫苗使心理健康（GHQ-12）提高0.12个标准差，弥补了疫情导致的心理健康恶化的一半。这种改善至少持续两个月，并与更高的社交活动参与度和自我报告的感染COVID-19可能性降低相关。主要受益者是在疫情期间出现心理困扰的个体，这支持了在疫苗接种推广中优先考虑他们。相反，对潜在疫苗副作用有顾虑的个体在接种后心理健康没有改善，这强调了公众对疫苗安全性和有效性信心的必要性。考虑到心理健康的改善，疫苗接种的收益增加了约50%。

records.title_en: The effect of a ‘None of the above’ ballot paper option on voting behavior and election outcomes
records.title_cn: 选票上“以上皆非”选项对投票行为与选举结果的影响
records.abstract_en: We study how an explicit blank vote option “None of the above” (NOTA) on the ballot paper affects the behavior of voters and political candidates as well as election results. In a series of survey and laboratory experiments we identify a tradeoff regarding making NOTA an explicit voting option. On the one hand it can reduce the vote share of candidates who voters consider as protest candidates, who often come from the extremes of the political spectrum, making it less likely that such a protest candidate wins the election. On the other hand, anticipating the above effect, establishment candidates may care less about the electorate when NOTA is on the ballot. Evidence on voters’ reaction to NOTA comes from two online survey experiments conducted in the weeks preceding the 2016 U.S. presidential election and the 2016 Austrian run-off election for president. Participants were subjected to either the original ballot paper or to a ballot paper where we added a NOTA option. We investigate the dynamic response of politicians to the presence of NOTA in a laboratory experiment in which an establishment candidate can decide between selfish and fair policy proposals and voters can choose between the establishment candidate and an inefficient protest option.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究选票上明确的空白投票选项“以上皆非”（NOTA）如何影响选民和政治候选人的行为以及选举结果。通过一系列调查和实验室实验，我们识别了将NOTA设为明确投票选项所涉及的权衡。一方面，它可以降低选民视为抗议候选人的得票率，这些候选人往往来自政治光谱的极端，从而降低此类抗议候选人赢得选举的可能性。另一方面，预见到上述效应，当选票上有NOTA时，建制派候选人可能对选民关注较少。关于选民对NOTA反应的证据来自两次在线调查实验，分别在2016年美国总统选举前几周和2016年奥地利总统决选前几周进行。参与者被随机分配至原始选票或我们添加了NOTA选项的选票。我们在实验室实验中调查了政治家对NOTA存在的动态反应，其中一名建制派候选人可以在自私和公平的政策提案之间做出选择，而选民可以在建制派候选人和低效的抗议选项之间进行选择。

records.title_en: Reducing child marriages through CCTs: Evidence from a large-scale policy intervention in Indonesia
records.title_cn: 通过有条件现金转移减少童婚：来自印度尼西亚大规模政策干预的证据
records.abstract_en: There is limited empirical evidence on whether poverty-targeted conditional cash transfers (CCTs) can be an effective tool in reducing child marriages. Employing a Fuzzy Regression Discontinuity design that uses administrative roll-out data matched to the government’s poverty census and targeting database in Indonesia, we estimate that the country’s flagship CCT (PKH) reduced child marriages of girls in rural Indonesia by about 3.5 percentage points (about 40 percent). We conclude that CCTs may help break the persistent practice of child marriages.
records.abstract_cn: 关于针对贫困的有条件现金转移（CCTs）能否有效减少童婚的实证证据有限。利用模糊断点回归设计，结合印度尼西亚政府的贫困普查和瞄准数据库的行政推广数据，我们估计该国旗舰CCT项目（PKH）将印度尼西亚农村地区女孩的童婚率降低了约3.5个百分点（约40%）。我们得出结论，CCTs可能有助于打破童婚的持续实践。

records.title_en: The Intergenerational Health Effects of Forced Displacement: Japanese American Incarceration during WWII
records.title_cn: 强制迁移的代际健康效应：二战期间日裔美国人的监禁
records.abstract_en: We study the intergenerational health consequences of forced displacement and incarceration of Japanese Americans in the US during WWII. Incarcerated mothers had babies who were less healthy at birth. This decrease in health represents a shift in the entire birthweight distribution due to exposure to prison camps. Imprisoned individuals were less likely to have children with fathers of other ethnic groups but were more likely to invest in education, and participate in the labor market. Despite these positive human capital effects, overall we find a negative effect of incarceration on intergenerational health.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了二战期间美国日裔美国人被迫迁移和监禁的代际健康后果。被监禁的母亲所生的婴儿出生时健康状况较差。这种健康下降代表了整个出生体重分布因暴露于监狱营而发生的转变。被监禁的个体不太可能与其他族裔的父亲生育子女，但更可能投资于教育并参与劳动力市场。尽管这些人力资本效应是积极的，但总体而言，我们发现监禁对代际健康有负面影响。

records.title_en: How in-person conversations shape political polarization: Quasi-experimental evidence from a nationwide initiative
records.title_cn: 面对面交谈如何影响政治极化：来自全国性倡议的准实验证据
records.abstract_en: Growing political polarization is often attributed to “echo chambers” among like-minded individuals and a lack of social interactions among contrary-minded individuals. We provide quasi-experimental evidence on the effects of in-person conversations on individual-level polarization outcomes, studying a large-scale intervention in Germany that matched pairs of strangers for private face-to-face meetings to discuss divisive political issues. We find asymmetric effects: conversations with like-minded individuals caused political views to become more extreme (ideological polarization); by contrast, conversations with contrary-minded individuals did not lead to a convergence of political views, but significantly reduced negative beliefs and attitudes toward ideological out-group members (affective polarization), while also improving perceived social cohesion more generally. These effects of contrary-minded conversations seem to be driven mostly by positive experiences of interpersonal contact.
records.abstract_cn: 日益加剧的政治极化常被归因于志同道合者之间的“回音室”效应以及异见者之间缺乏社会互动。我们通过研究德国一项大规模干预措施，提供了面对面交谈对个体层面极化结果影响的准实验证据，该干预措施将陌生两人配对进行私下面对面会议，讨论有争议的政治议题。我们发现不对称效应：与志同道合者的交谈导致政治观点变得更加极端（意识形态极化）；相比之下，与异见者的交谈并未导致政治观点的趋同，但显著减少了对意识形态外群体成员的负面信念和态度（情感极化），同时总体上改善了感知到的社会凝聚力。异见交谈的这些效应似乎主要由人际接触的积极体验驱动。

records.title_en: Learning the hard way: Conflicts, sanctions and military aid
records.title_cn: 艰难学习：冲突、制裁与军事援助
records.abstract_en: Countries involved in conflicts learn about their military strength from the battlefield. We study how a third party intervenes to manipulate this learning. An attacker and a defender engage in a conflict whose outcome conveys information about the attacker’s strength. A third party worries that the attacker becomes more confident about its military strength and can intervene to help the defender. This intervention is risky: if the attacker wins despite the help the defender receives, its confidence increases even further. We show that optimal third-party intervention is non-monotonic in the attacker’s strength. We also show that a high level of patriotism and resolve to defend itself improve the defender’s odds in the conflict by inducing third-party intervention.
records.abstract_cn: 卷入冲突的国家从战场上了解其军事力量。我们研究第三方如何干预以操纵这种学习过程。攻击方和防御方进行一场冲突，其结果传递关于攻击方实力的信息。第三方担心攻击方对其军事力量变得更加自信，并可能干预以帮助防御方。这种干预是有风险的：如果攻击方尽管得到了防御方的帮助仍获胜，其信心会进一步增加。我们表明，最优的第三方干预在攻击方实力上是非单调的。我们还表明，高度的爱国精神和自卫决心通过诱导第三方干预来提高防御方在冲突中的胜算。

records.title_en: The impact of standardized disease-specific healthcare coverage
records.title_cn: 标准化疾病特定医疗覆盖的影响
records.abstract_en: We study the impact of a healthcare reform that standardized procedures and timely coverage of a set of diseases. Using Chile’s universe of death records and a difference-in-differences research design, we show that mortality from the diseases covered by this reform decreased by 4.4% on average. Disease-specific shocks or a resource shift from non-covered to covered diseases do not explain this effect. Evidence from polytraumatized inpatients suggests that the reform equalized utilization rates as it reduced the dispersion of risk-adjusted surgery rates and spending across hospitals.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一项医疗改革的影响，该改革标准化了特定疾病组的程序和及时覆盖。利用智利的全量死亡记录和双重差分研究设计，我们表明，该改革覆盖的疾病死亡率平均下降了4.4%。特定疾病的冲击或资源从非覆盖疾病向覆盖疾病的转移并不能解释这一效应。来自多发性创伤住院患者的证据表明，改革通过降低各医院风险调整手术率和支出的离散度，使利用率趋于均等化。

records.title_en: The decline of manufacturing employment and the rise of the far-right in Austria
records.title_cn: 制造业就业的衰退与奥地利极右翼的崛起
records.abstract_en: In recent decades, right-wing populist parties have experienced increased electoral success in many Western democracies. This rise of the far-right, which is strongly built on the support of the working class, coincides with a sharp decline of the manufacturing sector. This paper analyzes the contribution of this manufacturing decline to the rise of the Austrian far-right. Overall, the decline in manufacturing employment has strongly contributed to this rightward shift in the political landscape, with the manufacturing decline explaining around one-third of the observed increase in far-right vote-shares between 1995 and 2019. Regarding the influences of the forces underlying the manufacturing decline, namely international trade and automation technologies, suggests that both forces contributed in roughly equal parts to this development.
