records.abstract_cn: 近几十年来，右翼民粹主义政党在许多西方民主国家中获得了越来越多的选举成功。这种极右翼的崛起，强烈建立在工人阶级的支持之上，恰逢制造业部门的急剧衰退。本文分析了这种制造业衰退对奥地利极右翼崛起的贡献。总体而言，制造业就业的衰退强烈促进了政治格局中的这种右倾转变，其中制造业衰退解释了1995年至2019年间观察到的极右翼选票份额增加的大约三分之一。关于制造业衰退背后的力量影响，即国际贸易和自动化技术，表明这两种力量对这一发展贡献大致相等。

records.title_en: Housing Improvement and Crime
records.title_cn: 住房改善与犯罪
records.abstract_en: We evaluate a policy implemented in Chicago geared towards improving the private housing stock in distressed neighborhoods. First, the program successfully increased housing renovations and reduced foreclosures, demonstrating tangible housing improvements. Next, treated areas experienced significant reductions in burglaries and robberies, with adjacent neighborhoods also documenting similar decreases in crime. We do not find evidence that gentrification with displacement of incumbent residents is responsible for the positive impacts of the program. Our findings provide evidence of substantial neighborhood gains from low-cost, place-based housing interventions that prioritize the preservation of existing housing stock.
records.abstract_cn: 我们评估了一项在芝加哥实施的政策，该政策旨在改善贫困社区的私人住房存量。首先，该项目成功增加了住房翻新并减少了止赎，显示出切实的住房改善。其次，受处理区域 burglaries 和 robberies 显著减少，邻近社区也记录了类似的犯罪下降。我们没有发现证据表明，伴随原住民搬迁的绅士化是该项目积极影响的原因。我们的研究结果提供了证据，表明以保护现有住房存量为优先的低成本、基于地点的住房干预措施能带来可观的社区收益。

records.title_en: Neighborhoods, perceived Inequality, and preferences for Redistribution: Evidence from Barcelona
records.title_cn: 邻里、感知不平等与再分配偏好：来自巴塞罗那的证据
records.abstract_en: I study the effects of neighborhood-level inequality on perceived national-level inequality and preferences for redistribution. I construct a novel measure of local inequality using geolocated housing data and elicit perceptions and preferences from an original survey conducted in Barcelona. Local inequality is positively associated with perceived inequality but not with preferences for redistribution. I address endogenous sorting by exploiting quasi-random variation in exposure to new apartment buildings; this increases perceived inequality by 7% and has a positive but not statistically significant effect on demand for redistribution. Effects come from higher perceived income at the top. Local inequality shapes national-level inequality perceptions, but if it influences demand for redistribution, the effect is small. This work suggests that individuals extrapolate from their local environments when forming beliefs and highlights the importance of data granularity when studying neighborhood effects.
records.abstract_cn: 我研究了邻里层面的不平等对感知的国家层面不平等及再分配偏好的影响。我利用地理定位的住房数据构建了一个新颖的地方不平等度量，并通过在巴塞罗那进行的原始调查来获取感知和偏好。地方不平等与感知不平等正相关，但与再分配偏好无关。我通过利用新公寓楼暴露的准随机变化来解决内生性排序问题；这使感知不平等增加了7%，但对再分配需求有正向但不具有统计显著性的影响。影响来自对顶层收入感知的提高。地方不平等塑造了国家层面的不平等感知，但如果它影响再分配需求，其效应也是微小的。这项工作表明，个体在形成信念时会从其当地环境中进行推断，并强调了在研究邻里效应时数据粒度的重要性。

records.title_en: Parents’ effective time endowment and divorce: Evidence from extended school days
records.title_cn: 父母的有效时间禀赋与离婚：来自延长学校日的证据
records.abstract_en: Policies that extend the school day in elementary school provide an implicit childcare subsidy for families. As such, they can affect parents’ time allocation and family dynamics. This paper examines how extending the school day affects families by focusing on marriage dissolution. We exploit the staggered adoption of a policy that extended the availability of full-time elementary schools across different municipalities in Mexico. Using administrative data on divorces, we find that extending the school day by 3.5 h leads to a significant increase in divorce rates. Moreover, the effect grows with every year of municipalities’ exposure to full-time schooling. The effects are largely driven by municipalities with non-traditional social norms about marriage, divorce, and women’s priority to jobs, and by women in households with school-age children. Increased female labor force participation due to the availability of childcare is likely to be one of the mechanisms that relaxed restrictions on marriage dissolution.
records.abstract_cn: 延长小学学校日的政策为家庭提供了隐性儿童保育补贴。因此，它们可以影响父母的时间分配和家庭动态。本文通过关注婚姻解体来研究延长学校日如何影响家庭。我们利用了墨西哥不同城市逐步采用延长全日制小学可用性的政策。利用离婚行政数据，我们发现将学校日延长3.5小时会导致离婚率显著上升。此外，随着城市接触全日制教育的年限增加，这种效应逐年增强。这些影响主要由关于婚姻、离婚和女性就业优先权的非传统社会规范的城市，以及有学龄儿童家庭中的女性驱动。由于儿童保育的可用性而导致的女性劳动力参与率增加，可能是放松婚姻解体限制的机制之一。

records.title_en: Nothing for something: Marketing cancer drugs to physicians increases prescribing without improving mortality
records.title_cn: 无谓的付出：向医生推销抗癌药物增加处方量但未改善死亡率
records.abstract_en: Physicians commonly receive marketing-related transfers from drug firms. We examine the impact of these relationships on the prescribing of physician-administered cancer drugs in Medicare. We find that prescribing of the associated drug increases 4% in the twelve months after a payment is received, with the increase beginning sharply in the month of payment and fading out within a year. A marketing payment also leads physicians to begin treating cancer patients with lower predicted mortality. While payments result in greater expenditure on cancer drugs, there are no associated improvements in patient mortality.
records.abstract_cn: 医生通常接受来自制药公司的营销相关转移支付。我们研究了这些关系对医疗保险中医生管理的抗癌药物处方的影响。我们发现，在收到付款后的十二个月内，相关药物的处方量增加了4%，这一增长在付款当月急剧开始，并在一年内逐渐消退。营销支付还导致医生开始治疗预测死亡率较低的癌症患者。虽然支付导致抗癌药物支出增加，但患者死亡率并未得到相应改善。

records.title_en: The environmental costs of political interference: Evidence from power plants in the Amazon
records.title_cn: 政治干预的环境成本：来自亚马逊发电厂的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper estimates the impacts of ten recently built hydroelectric power plants in the Brazilian Amazon on deforestation. Using the inventory of all sites with undeveloped hydropower potential, we apply the synthetic control method to estimate the causal impact of each power plant on forest loss. Overall, the construction of the ten plants contributed to 13 percent of the observed forest loss within a 50-kilometer radius of the construction site. Notably, this impact is solely attributed to four plants. In at least three of these plants, construction licenses were granted despite technical recommendations against them. In contrast, the remaining plants, which received technical clearance from the environmental agency, have negligible effects. These findings highlight the effectiveness of robust environmental regulations and underscore their vulnerability to high-level political interference.
records.abstract_cn: 本文估计了巴西亚马逊地区最近建成的十座水力发电厂对森林砍伐的影响。利用所有具有未开发水电潜力的地点的清单，我们应用综合控制方法来估计每个发电厂对森林损失的因果影响。总体而言，十座工厂的建设造成了施工地点半径 50 公里内观察到的森林损失的 13%。值得注意的是，这种影响仅归因于四家工厂。尽管存在技术建议，但其中至少三座工厂仍获得了施工许可证。相比之下，其余获得环境机构技术许可的工厂的影响可以忽略不计。这些发现凸显了强有力的环境法规的有效性，并强调了它们容易受到高层政治干预的影响。

records.title_en: Borda’s Rule and Arrow’s Independence Condition
records.title_cn: 博尔达规则和阿罗独立条件
records.abstract_en: We argue that Arrow’s independence of irrelevant alternatives (IIA) condition is unjustifiably stringent because it rules out making a social welfare function sensitive to individuals’ preference intensities. Accordingly, we propose a modified version of IIA, MIIA, that is a necessary and sufficient relaxation of IIA for taking account of intensities. Rather than obtaining an impossibility result, we show that MIIA together with several other axioms (satisfied by virtually all voting rules and social welfare functions used in practice and studied in theory) uniquely characterizes the Borda count (sometimes called rank-order voting) as a social welfare function.
records.abstract_cn: 我们认为，阿罗的不相关替代项独立性（IIA）条件过于严格，因为它排除了使社会福利函数对个人偏好强度敏感的可能性。因此，我们提出了IIA的修改版本，MIIA，这是考虑到强度而对IIA进行必要且充分的放宽。我们并没有获得不可能的结果，而是证明 MIIA 与其他几个公理（几乎满足实践中使用和理论研究的所有投票规则和社会福利函数）将博尔达计数（有时称为排序投票）独特地描述为社会福利函数。

records.title_en: Sorting with Teams
records.title_cn: 与团队排序
records.abstract_en: We fully solve a sorting problem with heterogeneous firms and multiple heterogeneous workers whose skills are imperfect substitutes. We show that optimal sorting, which we call mixed and countermonotonic, is comprised of two regions. In the first region, mediocre firms sort with mediocre workers and coworkers such that the output losses are equal across all these teams (mixing). In the second region, a high-skill worker sorts with low-skill coworkers and a high-productivity firm (countermonotonicity). We characterize the equilibrium wages and firm values. Quantitatively, our model can generate the dispersion of earnings within and across US firms.
records.abstract_cn: 我们完全解决了异质公司和多个异质工人的排序问题，他们的技能是不完美的替代品。我们证明了最优排序（我们称之为混合排序和反单调排序）由 二 区域组成。在第一地区，平庸的公司与平庸的工人和同事进行排序，使得所有这些团队的产出损失相等（混合）。在第二区域，高技能工人与低技能同事和高生产率公司进行排序（反单调性）。我们描述均衡工资和公司价值的特征。从数量上讲，我们的模型可以产生美国公司内部和之间的收益离散度。

records.title_en: Enhancing Human Capital in Children: A Case Study on Scaling
records.title_cn: 增强儿童人力资本：规模化案例研究
records.abstract_en: This paper provides novel insights into the science of scaling by examining an educational mentoring program in Mexico. The empirical analysis encompasses two independent field experiments and seizes a unique opportunity to learn from the government’s implementation of the same intervention. While the program originally implemented at scale demonstrates limited effectiveness, the introduction of a new modality with enhanced mentor training significantly improves children’s outcomes. Mentor-parent interactions are found to stimulate parental engagement at the community-school level. Our findings support the hypothesis that parents can play an important role in facilitating the scalability of educational programs.
records.abstract_cn: 本文通过研究墨西哥的教育指导项目，提供了对扩展科学的新颖见解。实证分析包括二独立的现场实验，并抓住了一个独特的机会来学习政府实施相同干预措施的经验。虽然该计划最初大规模实施的效果有限，但引入加强导师培训的新模式显着改善了儿童的学习成果。研究发现，导师与家长的互动可以刺激家长在社区-学校层面的参与。我们的研究结果支持这样的假设：父母可以在促进教育计划的可扩展性方面发挥重要作用。

records.title_en: The Impact of Working-Memory Training on Children’s Cognitive and Noncognitive Skills
records.title_cn: 工作记忆训练对儿童认知和非认知技能的影响
records.abstract_en: Working-memory (WM) capacity is a key component of a wide range of cognitive and noncognitive skills—such as fluid IQ, math, reading, and inhibitory control—but can WM training improve these skills? Here, we examine the causal impact of WM training embedded in regular school teaching, using a randomized educational intervention with 6–7-year-old children. We find substantial gains in WM capacity and document positive spillover effects on geometry, fluid IQ, and inhibitory control. Three years later, treated children are 16 percentage points more likely to enter an advanced secondary school track.
records.abstract_cn: 工作记忆 (WM) 能力是一系列认知和非认知技能（例如流畅的智商、数学、阅读和抑制控制）的关键组成部分，但 WM 训练能否提高这些技能？在这里，我们通过对 6-7 岁儿童进行随机教育干预，研究了纳入常规学校教学的 WM 培训的因果影响。我们发现 WM 能力显着提高，并记录了对几何、流体智商和抑制控制的积极溢出效应。 三年后，接受治疗的儿童进入高级中学的可能性提高16个百分点。

records.title_en: Contiguous Search: Exploration and Ambition on Uncharted Terrain
records.title_cn: 连续搜索：未知领域的探索与野心
records.abstract_en: We provide a framework for analyzing search across correlated samples. The agent—a mineral prospecting team, a drug company, a politician—tracks observations over a Brownian path. The agent chooses the search speed and retrospectively picks the best observation when deciding to complete the search. We show that the optimal search speed is U-shaped: it is highest when approaching a breakthrough or when nearing search termination. Unlike search across independent samples, search optimally stops when observations are sufficiently discouraging, following a drawdown stopping boundary. We also show the tractability and features of optimal search contracts in our setting.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提供了一个用于分析相关样本搜索的框架。代理人——一个矿产勘探队、一家制药公司、一名政治家——追踪布朗路径上的观察结果。代理选择搜索速度，并在决定完成搜索时回顾性地选择最佳观察结果。我们证明最佳搜索速度是 U 形的：当接近突破或接近搜索终止时速度最高。与跨独立样本的搜索不同，当观察结果足够令人沮丧时，搜索会在下降停止边界后停止。我们还展示了我们设置中最佳搜索合约的易处理性和特征。

records.title_en: Are Tax Cuts Contractionary at the Zero Lower Bound? Evidence from a Century of Data
records.title_cn: 减税是否处于零下限的紧缩性？一个世纪的数据证据
records.abstract_en: Popular New Keynesian macroeconomic models predict that cuts in various types of distortionary taxes are contractionary when monetary policy is constrained at the zero lower bound (ZLB). We turn to a long span of history in the United Kingdom to test this hypothesis. Using a new long-run dataset of narrative-identified tax changes from 1918 to 2020, we show that tax cuts are expansionary in both low-interest-rate environments and more normal times. We do not find evidence of a deflationary spiral at the ZLB. Tax cuts may therefore still be a useful tool to stimulate economic activity when monetary policy is constrained.
records.abstract_cn: 流行的新凯恩斯主义宏观经济模型预测，当货币政策被限制在零下限（ZLB）时，各种类型的扭曲性税收的削减都是紧缩性的。我们转向英国漫长的历史来检验这一假设。使用从1918到2020的叙述性税收变化的新长期数据集，我们表明减税在低利率环境和更正常的时期都是扩张性的。我们没有发现零利率下限出现螺旋式通货紧缩的证据。因此，当货币政策受到限制时，减税可能仍然是刺激经济活动的有用工具。

records.title_en: Targeting Precision Medicine: Evidence from Prenatal Screening
records.title_cn: 针对精准医学：产前筛查的证据
records.abstract_en: We study the introduction of a noninvasive prenatal screening—cell-free DNA (cfDNA) screening—which is used to target a more costly invasive test that elevates miscarriage risk. Using Swedish administrative data, we document that coverage of cfDNA substantially increases cfDNA screening and reduces invasive testing. We develop and estimate a stylized model of prenatal choices and find that narrow targeting of cfDNA coverage can improve outcomes and reduce costs, while broader coverage also improves outcomes but with increased costs. These findings point to the potential gains from well-designed targeting of screening but at the same time highlight the importance of the targeting design.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究引入无创产前筛查——无细胞 DNA (cfDNA) 筛查——用于针对成本更高、会增加流产风险的侵入性检测。使用瑞典的行政数据，我们记录了 cfDNA 的覆盖范围大大增加了 cfDNA 筛查并减少了侵入性检测。我们开发并评估了产前选择的程式化模型，发现 cfDNA 覆盖范围的狭窄目标可以改善结果并降低成本，而更广泛的覆盖范围也可以改善结果，但成本会增加。这些发现指出了精心设计的靶向筛选的潜在收益，但同时也强调了靶向设计的重要性。

records.title_en: Insider Imitation
records.title_cn: 内幕模仿
records.abstract_en: We study how regulating data usage impacts innovation in digital markets. Platforms commonly use proprietary data about third-party sellers to inform their own competing offerings, dampening incentives for innovation. We model this interaction and characterize how data usage restrictions reshape these incentives. An outright ban on data usage may boost or curtail innovation, depending on the thickness of the right tail of demand for new products. More flexible rules controlling when and what data are made available can always improve the effectiveness of regulation. Our results contribute to an ongoing policy discussion regarding competition in digital markets.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究监管数据使用如何影响数字市场的创新。平台通常使用有关第三方卖家的专有数据来告知自己的竞争产品，从而抑制创新的动力。我们对这种交互进行建模，并描述数据使用限制如何重塑这些激励措施。彻底禁止数据使用可能会促进或抑制创新，具体取决于新产品右尾需求的厚度。控制何时提供数据以及提供哪些数据的更灵活的规则始终可以提高监管的有效性。我们的结果有助于有关数字市场竞争的持续政策讨论。

records.title_en: The impact of impact investing
records.title_cn: 影响力投资的影响
records.abstract_en: The change in the cost of capital that results from a divestiture strategy can be closely approximated by a simple function of three parameters: (1) the fraction of socially conscious capital, (2) the fraction of targeted firms in the economy and (3) the return correlation between the targeted firms and the rest of the stock market. When calibrated to current data, we demonstrate that the impact on the cost of capital is too small to meaningfully affect real investment decisions. We then derive the conditions that would be required for the strategy to have a meaningful impact. We empirically corroborate our theoretical results by studying firm changes in ESG status and are unable to detect an impact of ESG divestiture strategies on the cost of capital of treated firms. Our results suggest that to have impact, instead of divesting, socially conscious investors should invest and exercise their rights of control to change corporate policy.
records.abstract_cn: 撤资策略导致的资本成本变化可以近似为三个参数的简单函数：（1）社会意识资本的比例，（2）目标企业在经济中的比例，以及（3）目标企业与股票市场其他部分之间的收益相关性。当根据当前数据进行校准后，我们证明对资本成本的影响太小，不足以实质性地影响实际投资决策。然后，我们推导出该策略要产生有意义影响所需的条件。我们通过研究企业ESG状态的变化来实证验证我们的理论结果，但未能检测到ESG撤资策略对受处理企业资本成本的影响。我们的结果表明，为了产生影响，社会意识投资者应投资并行使控制权以改变企业政策，而非撤资。

records.title_en: Strategic insider trading and its consequences for outsiders: Evidence from the eighteenth century
records.title_cn: 战略性内幕交易及其对局外人的影响：十八世纪的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper uses hand-collected historical data to provide empirical evidence on the strategic trading behavior of insiders and its consequences for outsiders. Specifically, we collect all equity trades of all insiders and outsiders in an era without legal restrictions on insider trading and a market where trading is non-anonymous. We find that access to private information creates a significant gap between the post-trade returns of insiders and outsiders. Consistent with theory, insiders capitalize on their information advantage by hiding their identity and timing their trades. Both experienced and inexperienced outsiders face expected losses due to this strategic insider trading.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用手工收集的历史数据，为内部人士的战略交易行为及其对外部人士的后果提供实证证据。具体来说，我们收集了在内幕交易没有法律限制的时代以及交易非匿名的市场中所有内幕人士和外幕人士的所有股权交易。我们发现，获取私人信息会导致内部人士和外部人士的交易后回报之间存在巨大差距。与理论一致，内部人士通过隐藏身份和安排交易时机来利用他们的信息优势。由于这种战略性内幕交易，经验丰富的和缺乏经验的外部人士都面临着预期的损失。

records.title_en: Four facts about ESG beliefs and investor portfolios
records.title_cn: 关于 ESG 信念和投资者投资组合的四个事实
records.abstract_en: We analyze survey data on ESG beliefs and preferences in a large panel of retail investors linked to administrative data on their investment portfolios. The survey elicits investors’ expectations of long-term ESG equity returns and asks about their motivations, if any, to invest in ESG assets. We document four facts. First, investors generally expected ESG investments to underperform the market. Between mid-2021 and late-2023, the average expected 10-year annualized return of ESG investments relative to the overall stock market was −2.1%. Second, there is substantial heterogeneity across investors in their ESG return expectations and their motives for ESG investing: 48% of survey respondents do not see any reason to invest in ESG, 24% are primarily motivated by ethical considerations, 22% are driven by climate hedging motives, and 6% are motivated by return expectations. Third, there is a strong link between individuals’ reported ESG investment motives and their actual investment behaviors, with the highest ESG portfolio holdings among individuals who report ethics-driven investment motives. Fourth, financial considerations matter independently of other investment motives: we find meaningful ESG holdings only for investors who expect these investments to outperform the market, even among those investors who reported that their most important ESG investment motives were ethical or hedging reasons.
records.abstract_cn: 我们分析了大量散户投资者的 ESG 信念和偏好的调查数据，并与其投资组合的管理数据相关联。该调查引出了投资者对长期 ESG 股权回报的预期，并询问他们投资 ESG 资产的动机（如果有）。我们记录了四个事实。首先，投资者普遍预期ESG投资的表现将逊于市场。 2021年中至2023年末，ESG投资相对于整体股市的平均预期10年年化回报率为−2.1%。其次，投资者对 ESG 回报预期和 ESG 投资动机存在很大差异：48% 的调查受访者认为没有任何理由投资 ESG，24% 主要出于道德考虑，22% 受到气候对冲动机驱动，6% 受到回报预期驱动。第三，个人报告的 ESG 投资动机与其实际投资行为之间存在密切联系，报告道德驱动投资动机的个人持有的 ESG 投资组合最高。第四，财务考虑因素独立于其他投资动机：我们发现，只有那些期望这些投资跑赢市场的投资者才有意义地持有 ESG 股份，即使是那些报告称其最重要的 ESG 投资动机是道德或对冲原因的投资者也是如此。

records.title_en: Regulating inattention in fee-based financial advice
records.title_cn: 规范收费型金融咨询中的注意力不足
records.abstract_en: We study the impact of disclosure and inattention on the decision to retain fee-based financial advice using a two-tiered natural regulatory experiment. Increased salience in fee disclosure raises the drop rate for advice, implying improved attention — particularly for relatively sophisticated investors. However, a novel auto-drop requirement for inattentive investors generates far more drops, implying limited attention despite salient disclosure — particularly for the unsophisticated. Contrary to studies of commission-based advice, we find that investors benefit from fee-based advice. Benefits are higher for less sophisticated investors, who tend to be detrimentally auto-dropped. Drops triggered by salient disclosure tend to be beneficial.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用一个双层自然监管实验，研究信息披露和注意力不足对保留收费型金融咨询决策的影响。费用披露显著性的提高增加了咨询的退出率，表明注意力有所改善——尤其是对于相对成熟的投资者。然而，一项针对注意力不足投资者的新颖自动退出要求产生了更多的退出，表明尽管有显著的信息披露，注意力仍然有限——尤其是对于不成熟的投资者。与基于佣金的咨询研究相反，我们发现投资者从收费型咨询中获益。对于不太成熟的投资者，收益更高，而他们往往会被不利地自动退出。由显著信息披露引发的退出往往是有益的。

records.title_en: Extracting extrapolative beliefs from market prices: An augmented present-value approach
records.title_cn: 从市场价格中提取外推信念：一种增强的现值方法
records.abstract_en: We propose a latent-variables approach to recover extrapolative beliefs from asset prices. We estimate a present-value model of the price–dividend ratio of the market that embeds both return extrapolation and cash-flow extrapolation, alongside discount rates and rational expectations of dividend growth. This approach allows us to measure extrapolation bias without having to rely on survey data, and it inherently guarantees that the researcher focuses on a set of beliefs that matter for price formation. We show that extrapolative beliefs extracted from prices are highly correlated with surveys and that survey-based and price-based extrapolative beliefs share similar predictive properties for future returns, with the former improving upon the latter.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种潜在变量方法，从资产价格中恢复外推信念。我们估计了一个市场的价格-股息比率的现值模型，该模型同时嵌入了收益外推和现金流外推，以及贴现率和股息增长的理性预期。这种方法使我们能够在不依赖调查数据的情况下测量外推偏差，并且固有地保证了研究者关注一组对价格形成重要的信念。我们表明，从价格中提取的外推信念与调查高度相关，并且基于调查和基于价格的外推信念对未来收益具有相似的预测特性，前者优于后者。

records.title_en: Biodiversity finance
records.title_cn: 生物多样性金融
records.abstract_en: We study biodiversity finance—the use of private capital to finance biodiversity conservation and restoration—which is a new practice in sustainable finance. First, we provide a conceptual framework that lays out how biodiversity can be financed by pure private capital and blended financing structures. In the latter, private capital is blended with public or philanthropic capital, whose aim is to de-risk private capital investments. The main element underlying both types of financing is the “monetization” of biodiversity, that is, using investments in biodiversity to generate a financial return for private investors. Second, we provide empirical evidence using deal-level data from a leading biodiversity finance institution. Our findings are consistent with a three-dimensional efficient frontier (return, risk, and biodiversity impact)—deals with a favorable risk-return profile tend to be financed by pure private capital, whereas for other deals the biodiversity impact needs to be sufficiently large for blended finance to be used. Overall, our results suggest that blended finance is an important tool for improving the risk-return profile of these projects, thereby increasing their appeal to private investors and crowding in private capital. Finally, our results suggest that private capital is unlikely to substitute for effective public policies in addressing the biodiversity crisis.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究生物多样性金融——利用私人资本为生物多样性保护和恢复提供资金——这是可持续金融中的一种新实践。首先，我们提供了一个概念框架，阐述生物多样性如何通过纯私人资本和混合融资结构来融资。在后者中，私人资本与公共或慈善资本混合，其目的是降低私人资本投资的风险。这两种融资类型的主要基础要素是生物多样性的“货币化”，即利用对生物多样性的投资为私人投资者产生财务回报。其次，我们使用来自一家领先生物多样性金融机构的交易级数据提供实证证据。我们的发现与三维有效前沿（回报、风险和生物多样性影响）一致——具有有利风险-回报特征的交易往往由纯私人资本融资，而对于其他交易，生物多样性影响需要足够大才能使用混合融资。总体而言，我们的结果表明，混合融资是改善这些项目风险-回报特征的重要工具，从而增加其对私人投资者的吸引力并吸引私人资本。最后，我们的结果表明，私人资本不太可能替代有效的公共政策来应对生物多样性危机。

records.title_en: The SOFR discount
records.title_cn: SOFR折价
records.abstract_en: The transition from London Interbank Offered Rate (LIBOR) to Secured Overnight Financing Rate (SOFR) affects the reference rate of floating-rate debt worth trillions of dollars. We provide the first evidence highlighting a benefit of the benchmark transition for debt markets. Focusing on the market for dollar-denominated floating rate notes (FRNs), we compare the yield spreads of FRNs linked to LIBOR and SOFR, issued by the same entity during the same month. After adjusting for the maturity-matched spreads from derivatives markets, we find significantly lower spreads for SOFR-linked FRNs. We link this SOFR discount to the enhanced price stability of SOFR-linked FRNs.
records.abstract_cn: 从伦敦银行间同业拆借利率（LIBOR）向有担保隔夜融资利率（SOFR）的转变影响了价值数万亿美元的浮动利率债务的参考利率。我们提供了首个证据，突显基准转换对债务市场的益处。聚焦于美元计价浮动利率票据（FRNs）市场，我们比较了同一实体在同一月份发行的与LIBOR和SOFR挂钩的FRNs的收益率利差。在根据衍生品市场的期限匹配利差进行调整后，我们发现与SOFR挂钩的FRNs的利差显著更低。我们将这一SOFR折价与SOFR挂钩FRNs增强的价格稳定性联系起来。

records.title_en: JAQ of all trades: Job mismatch, firm productivity and managerial quality
records.title_cn: 全能之JAQ：岗位错配、企业生产率与管理质量
records.abstract_en: We develop a novel measure of job-worker allocation quality (JAQ) by exploiting employer-employee data with machine learning techniques. Based on our measure, the quality of job-worker matching correlates positively with individual labor earnings and firm productivity, as well as with market competition, non-family firm status, and employees’ human capital. Management plays a key role in job-worker matching: when managerial hirings and firings persistently raise management quality, the matching of rank-and-file workers to their jobs improves. JAQ can be constructed from any employer–employee data set including workers’ occupations, and used to explore research questions in corporate finance and organization economics.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用机器学习技术，通过雇主-雇员数据开发了一种新颖的岗位-工人配置质量（JAQ）度量方法。基于我们的度量，岗位与工人的匹配质量与个人劳动收入、企业生产率以及市场竞争、非家族企业状态和员工人力资本呈正相关。管理在岗位-工人匹配中扮演关键角色：当管理层的招聘和解雇持续提升管理质量时，普通员工与其岗位的匹配也会得到改善。JAQ可以从任何包含工人职业信息的雇主-雇员数据集中构建，并用于探索公司金融和组织经济学中的研究问题。

records.title_en: Household mobility and mortgage rate lock
records.title_cn: 家庭流动性与抵押贷款利率锁定
records.abstract_en: Rising interest rates can create “mortgage rate lock” for homeowners with fixed rate mortgages, who can hold onto their low rates as long as they stay in their homes but would have to take on new mortgages with higher rates if they moved. We show mobility rates fell in 2022 and 2023 for homeowners with mortgages, as market rates rose. We observe both absolute declines and declines relative to homeowners without mortgages, who are unaffected by mortgage rate lock. Mobility declines are not explained by changes in home values. Overall, our estimates imply that rising interest rates reduced mobility in 2022 and 2023 for households with mortgages by 16% and caused $20bn of deadweight loss.
records.abstract_cn: 利率上升可能对持有固定利率抵押贷款的房主造成“抵押贷款利率锁定”，只要他们留在自己的房屋中，就可以继续享受低利率，但如果搬家，则必须承担更高利率的新抵押贷款。我们显示，随着市场利率上升，2022年和2023年有抵押贷款的房主的流动性率下降。我们观察到绝对下降以及相对于没有抵押贷款的房主的下降，后者不受抵押贷款利率锁定的影响。流动性下降并不能由房屋价值变化来解释。总体而言，我们的估计表明，利率上升使2022年和2023年有抵押贷款家庭的流动性降低了16%，并造成了二百亿美元的无谓损失。

records.title_en: Gender differences in political career progression
records.title_cn: 政治职业晋升中的性别差异
records.abstract_en: This paper quantifies the gender gap in the returns to electoral success on the career progression of novice U.S. state legislators. Using a regression discontinuity design, we find that narrowly winning a state legislature election doubles the probability that a female politician will later compete for a higher-level legislative seat compared to narrowly elected male politicians. While the gender gap in the effect of local political experience on winning a higher-level election also favors women, it is not precisely estimated. The gender difference in the effect of winning a state legislature seat is larger when serving in positions that closely resemble the responsibilities and workload of higher-level positions. We conclude that the pathway from local to higher-level political offices functions at least as effectively for women as for men. Therefore, supporting the recruitment, funding, and campaigning of women in local elections can be an effective strategy to increase their representation at the highest levels of government.
records.abstract_cn: 本文量化了选举成功对新手美国州议员职业晋升回报的性别差距。利用断点回归设计，我们发现，与勉强当选的男性政治家相比，勉强赢得州议会选举的女性政治家后来竞争更高级别立法席位的概率翻倍。尽管地方政治经验对赢得更高级别选举的影响中的性别差距也偏向女性，但这一估计并不精确。当担任与更高级别职位职责和工作量密切相似的职位时，赢得州议会席位效应的性别差异更大。我们得出结论，从地方到更高级别政治职位的路径对女性至少与男性一样有效。因此，支持女性在地方选举中的招募、资助和竞选活动，可以成为增加她们在政府最高层代表比例的有效策略。

records.title_en: Falling and failing (to learn): Evidence from a nation-wide cybersecurity field experiment with SMEs
records.title_cn: 跌落与未能（学习）：来自全国性中小企业网络安全实地实验的证据
records.abstract_en: Prior experiences are crucial in shaping risk prevention behavior. Previous studies have shown that experiencing a simulated phishing attack (a “phishing drill”) reduces the likelihood of clicking on unsafe links and disclosing one’s password. In a large field experiment involving 670 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and their 33,000 employees, we examined the impact of experience on individuals’ ability to detect cyber-security threats, and whether this effect persisted over several months. We collected data at both the company and individual levels, including risk preference, time preference, and trust. Our findings indicate only a non-systematic, short-term effect of previous phishing emails on clicking behavior. A cluster of individuals with greater patience, trust, and risk seeking was more likely to click on phishing links in the first place but then also more likely to benefit from phishing drills.
records.abstract_cn: 先前的经验在塑造风险预防行为中至关重要。先前的研究表明，经历模拟钓鱼攻击（“钓鱼演练”）会降低点击不安全链接和泄露密码的可能性。在一项涉及670家中小企业及其33,000名员工的大型实地实验中，我们考察了经验对个人检测网络安全威胁能力的影响，以及这种效应是否在数月内持续存在。我们在公司和个体层面收集了数据，包括风险偏好、时间偏好和信任度。我们的研究结果表明，先前的钓鱼邮件对点击行为仅产生非系统性的短期影响。一群更具耐心、信任和风险寻求倾向的个体，最初更可能点击钓鱼链接，但也更可能从钓鱼演练中受益。

records.title_en: A behavioral model of consumer response to price information
records.title_cn: 消费者对价格信息反应的行为模型
records.abstract_en: This paper introduces a model of choice that captures heuristics and reference dependence in consumers’ responses to price information. In the model, a product’s quality is positively distorted when its price is close to the reference price. The model is consistent with a kinked and upward-sloping demand curve. The price and cross-price elasticities of demand can be positive or negative, asymmetric, and product-dependent. The model provides an explanation for quality-dependent price stickiness, justifies the adoption of complex pricing strategies, and allows for the derivation of closed-form expressions for the optimal price and reference price set by a monopolist. The model is fully characterized by testable restrictions on demand data, offering a method for identifying the reference price.
records.abstract_cn: 本文介绍了一个选择模型，该模型捕捉了消费者对价格信息反应中的启发式方法和参考依赖。在该模型中，当产品价格接近参考价格时，其质量会被正向扭曲。该模型与一条有折点且向上倾斜的需求曲线一致。需求的价格弹性和交叉价格弹性可以是正的或负的、不对称的，并且依赖于产品。该模型为质量依赖的价格粘性提供了解释，证明了采用复杂定价策略的合理性，并允许推导出垄断者设定的最优价格和参考价格的闭式表达式。该模型完全由需求数据上的可检验限制所刻画，提供了一种识别参考价格的方法。

records.title_en: Information as a catalyst for industrialization
records.title_cn: 信息作为工业化的催化剂
records.abstract_en: Technological innovations in the materials and biological sciences ensure more consistent raw materials as production process inputs while IT improves material attribute discernment. When raw materials of two types are to be sorted, we provide a Bayesian information processing model with three parameters, one each to summarize product consistency, signals to discern raw material attributes, and incentives to correctly categorize materials. Consistency and discernment substitute when mis-categorization costs are symmetric. They can complement when mis-categorization into the prevalent type is heavily penalized. A single commodity market emerges whenever consistency is near 100 % but otherwise two may arise. A Catalyst Effect occurs whereby improvements in materials and biological technologies first increases demand for both discernment and consistency but then eliminates demand for discernment while further boosting demand for consistency.
records.abstract_cn: 材料科学和生物科学中的技术创新确保了作为生产过程输入的原材料更加一致，而信息技术则改善了对材料属性的辨别。当需要对两种类型的原材料进行分类时，我们提供了一个贝叶斯信息处理模型，该模型包含三个参数，分别用于概括产品一致性、辨别原材料属性的信号以及正确分类材料的激励。当错误分类成本对称时，一致性和辨别力互为替代。当错误分类为普遍类型受到严厉惩罚时，它们可以互补。当一致性接近100时，会出现单一商品市场，否则可能出现两个市场。存在一种催化剂效应，即材料和生物技术的改进首先增加了对辨别力和一致性的需求，但随后消除了对辨别力的需求，同时进一步增加了对一致性的需求。

records.title_en: Taking from charity? Political contributions and the market for charitable funds
records.title_cn: 从慈善中索取？政治献金与慈善资金市场
records.abstract_en: How do charities respond to cyclical increases in competition from political campaigns? This paper is the first to estimate the elasticity of charities’ fundraising expenses to political contributions, and the first to use charity-level data to estimate the cross-elasticity of private charitable giving to political contributions. When political donations rise, they lead the average charity to cut back on fundraising. This is costly: political contributions crowd out private charitable giving at a rate of $0.37 per dollar. After netting out the negative effect of political contributions on fundraising, political giving crowds charitable giving in, rather than out. Substantial heterogeneity is documented across cause areas.
records.abstract_cn: 慈善组织如何应对政治竞选带来的周期性竞争加剧？本文首次估计了慈善组织筹款支出对政治献金的弹性，并首次利用慈善组织层面的数据估计了私人慈善捐赠对政治献金的交叉弹性。当政治捐款增加时，它们导致平均慈善组织削减筹款活动。这是有代价的：政治献金以每美元0.37美元的比例挤出私人慈善捐赠。在扣除政治献金对筹款的负面影响后，政治捐赠反而挤入而非挤出慈善捐赠。不同公益领域之间存在显著的异质性。

records.title_en: Does credit expansion encourage small businesses to incorporate? Evidence from US bank deregulations
records.title_cn: 信贷扩张是否鼓励小企业注册成立公司？来自美国银行放松管制的证据
records.abstract_en: We use state-level bank deregulations to study the impact of changes in credit on incorporation among unincorporated self-employed business owners. Exploiting the variation in the staggered timing of banking deregulations and using the recent advances in difference-in-differences (DiD) estimation techniques, we find that banking reforms considerably increased unincorporated businesses to incorporate. Further, the effects of reforms are different across groups based on gender, race, education, and age. We find stronger effects on incorporated business creation among female, less-educated, and younger unincorporated business owners. Our results are robust to the choice of controls, samples, and estimation approaches.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用州级银行放松管制来研究信贷变化对未注册自雇企业主注册成立公司的影响。利用银行放松管制交错时间的变化，并采用差异中差异（DiD）估计技术的最新进展，我们发现银行改革显著增加了未注册企业注册成立公司的比例。此外，改革的效果因性别、种族、教育程度和年龄的不同群体而异。我们发现，在女性、受教育程度较低和较年轻的未注册企业主中，注册成立公司的效果更强。我们的结果对于控制变量的选择、样本和估计方法均具有稳健性。

records.title_en: Business drinking: Evidence from a lab-in-the-field experiment
records.title_cn: 商务饮酒：来自实地实验室实验的证据
records.abstract_en: Alcohol consumption is an important component of business negotiations across many cultures, yet this behavior remains unmodeled and its potential explanations untested. Here, we develop a theory that combines guilt-aversion with the canonical alcohol myopia framework. Our GAAM (guilt aversion and alcohol myopia) model predicts that intoxication increases promise-making, and will not decrease rate of promise-breaking. We test these predictions using a Prisoner's Dilemma game with pre-play communication in a lab-in-the-field experiment. Among males, we find behavior consistent with predictions: intoxication promotes promise-making but does not impact the rate at which promises are broken. Importantly, this implies intoxication increases the efficiency of communication. We do not observe intoxication to impact female promise-making or promise-breaking behaviors. This is consistent with previous empirical findings that females can display less sensitivity than males to alcohol-induced myopia. Our results provide an explanation for the widespread phenomenon of business drinking.
records.abstract_cn: 饮酒在许多文化的商务谈判中是一个重要组成部分，然而这种行为尚未被建模，其潜在解释也未得到检验。在此，我们发展了一个结合内疚厌恶与经典酒精近视框架的理论。我们的GAAM（内疚厌恶与酒精近视）模型预测，醉酒会增加承诺的做出，并且不会降低违背承诺的比率。我们通过一个包含预沟通的囚徒困境游戏在实地实验室实验中检验这些预测。在男性中，我们发现行为与预测一致：醉酒促进承诺的做出，但不影响承诺被违背的比率。重要的是，这意味着醉酒提高了沟通的效率。我们未观察到醉酒影响女性的承诺做出或违背行为。这与先前实证发现一致，即女性对酒精诱导的近视可能表现出比男性更低的敏感性。我们的结果为商务饮酒这一普遍现象提供了解释。

records.title_en: Gender differences in graduate degree choices
records.title_cn: 研究生学位选择中的性别差异
records.abstract_en: While gender differences in the decision of what to study at undergraduate level are much studied, there is relatively little attention paid to subsequent study decisions of graduates. Given the increased importance of graduate education in recent decades, these decisions can have major labour market implications. In this paper, we use administrative data from Ireland to study these choices. We find systematic and substantial differences by gender in choice of graduate field, even when taking account of the exact undergraduate programme attended and a large set of controls measuring academic interests and aptitudes. Female graduates are less likely to do further study in STEM fields and more likely to enter teaching and health programmes. When we explore the effect of these choices on early career gender gaps in earnings, we find that they tend to exacerbate earnings gaps. Even after accounting for the exact undergraduate programme and detailed school subject choices and grades, the choice of graduate programme can explain about 20% of the gender earnings gap at age 33 for persons who pursued a graduate degree.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管本科阶段学习选择中的性别差异已被广泛研究，但对毕业生后续学习决策的关注相对较少。鉴于近几十年来研究生教育重要性的增加，这些决策可能对劳动力市场产生重大影响。在本文中，我们使用爱尔兰的行政数据来研究这些选择。我们发现，即使在考虑了具体本科专业以及衡量学术兴趣和能力的广泛控制变量后，研究生领域的选择仍存在系统性和显著的性别差异。女性毕业生在STEM领域继续深造的可能性较低，而更倾向于进入教育和健康相关专业。当我们探讨这些选择对早期职业生涯性别收入差距的影响时，发现它们往往会加剧收入差距。即使在考虑了具体本科专业、详细的中学科目选择和成绩后，研究生专业的选择可以解释在33岁时追求研究生学位者性别收入差距的约20%。

records.title_en: Power distance and dishonest behavior
records.title_cn: 权力距离与不诚实行为
records.abstract_en: Despite an extensive literature on the determinants of dishonesty, our understanding of how cultural values influence such behavior is limited. To address this gap, we conduct experiments to examine whether power distance, a cultural dimension identified by Hofstede (1984) and defined as the extent to which an individual accepts that power is unequally distributed, affects dishonest behavior. We find that power distance is not only positively correlated with dishonest behavior at both the individual and the country level, but also causally affects the likelihood of engaging in dishonest behavior. Our findings shed light on the role of cultural values in dishonest behavior.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管关于不诚实决定因素的文献广泛，但我们对文化价值观如何影响此类行为的理解仍然有限。为弥补这一空白，我们进行了实验，以考察权力距离——霍夫斯泰德（1984）识别的一种文化维度，定义为个体接受权力不平等分配的程度——是否影响不诚实行为。我们发现，权力距离不仅在个体和国家层面上与不诚实行为正相关，而且因果性地影响从事不诚实行为的可能性。我们的发现揭示了文化价值观在不诚实行为中的作用。

records.title_en: Theory-of-mind ability and cooperation
records.title_cn: 心智理论能力与合作
records.abstract_en: The ability to accurately assess others’ intents, beliefs, and emotions—called Theory of Mind (ToM)—is important for social cooperation. We study the role of ToM ability in fostering cooperation in the Simultaneous and Sequential Prisoners Dilemma (PD) games. We theoretically examine multiple models of social preferences and find that the relationship between ToM ability and cooperation is complex and sensitive to subtle changes in context such as population characteristics, beliefs, and the sequencing of moves. To resolve the theoretical uncertainty, we conduct a series of experiments to test how ToM influences cooperation in one-shot PD interactions. We find that differences in ToM ability are not correlated with cooperation in Simultaneous PD, but that higher ToM ability is correlated with increased cooperation in Sequential PD. Moreover, ToM ability affects cooperation via accuracy in beliefs about others’ cooperativeness rather than an association with fixed preference traits. Finally, we show that when direct inference of emotional states is possible, individuals with high ToM ability are better at recognizing the potential cooperativeness of others, thereby enabling a payoff advantage to having high ToM. Overall, our paper demonstrates how individual-level differences in ToM help to explain differences in cooperativeness.
records.abstract_cn: 准确评估他人意图、信念和情绪的能力——称为心智理论（ToM）——对于社会合作至关重要。我们研究了ToM能力在促进同时和序贯囚徒困境（PD）博弈中合作的作用。我们从理论上考察了多种社会偏好模型，发现ToM能力与合作之间的关系复杂且对情境中的细微变化敏感，如人口特征、信念和行动顺序。为解决理论不确定性，我们进行了一系列实验来测试ToM如何影响一次性PD互动中的合作。我们发现，在同时PD中，ToM能力的差异与合作不相关，但在序贯PD中，较高的ToM能力与增加的合作相关。此外，ToM能力通过关于他人合作性的信念准确性影响合作，而非与固定偏好特质相关联。最后，我们表明，当直接推断情绪状态成为可能时，高ToM能力的个体更擅长识别他人的潜在合作性，从而赋予高ToM以收益优势。总体而言，我们的论文展示了ToM的个体差异如何有助于解释合作性的差异。

records.title_en: A high resolution input–output model to assess the economic impact of floods
records.title_cn: 高分辨率投入产出模型评估洪水经济影响
records.abstract_en: The frequency and intensity of extreme weather events are rising due to global warming. Beyond damaging physical assets, these events can cause substantial economic losses through business interruptions and cascading shocks across production networks. The paper introduces a computational inter-regional input–output framework to assess the economic impacts of river floods in Italy. The model leverages a georeferenced database of productive plants built from the ASIA-local units database. By aligning plant coordinates with inundation maps, it enhances the identification of affected units, their associated water depth, and the shock caused to sectors’ productive capacity. To demonstrate the utility of this approach, we apply it to the major flood event that struck Emilia-Romagna in May 2023, quantifying both direct and indirect economic losses from business interruptions across sectoral, regional, and national levels.
records.abstract_cn: 由于全球变暖，极端天气事件的频率和强度正在上升。除了损害实物资产外，这些事件还可能通过业务中断和生产网络中的级联冲击造成重大经济损失。本文引入了一个计算性的区域间投入产出框架，以评估意大利河流洪水的经济影响。该模型利用了基于ASIA本地单位数据库构建的生产性工厂地理参考数据库。通过将工厂坐标与淹没图对齐，它增强了对受影响单位、其相关水深以及部门生产能力所受冲击的识别。为展示该方法的实用性，我们将其应用于五月 2023年袭击艾米利亚-罗马涅的重大洪水事件，量化了部门、区域和国家层面业务中断造成的直接和间接经济损失。

records.title_en: Long-term impacts of early adversity on subjective well-being: Evidence from the Chinese great famine
records.title_cn: 早期逆境对主观幸福感的长期影响：来自中国大饥荒的证据
records.abstract_en: Employing a difference-in-differences method across birth cohorts and regions with nationally representative data, this study examines the impact of the 1959–1961 Chinese Great Famine on survivors’ subjective well-being (SWB) fifty years later. Early-life exposure significantly reduces emotional and eudaimonic SWB, especially among females; evaluative SWB remains unaffected. Mechanism analysis highlights health status and social integration as primary channels, with socioeconomic status playing a limited role. This study is the first to systematically analyze the famine's SWB effects, revealing variability across well-being dimensions. Our findings underscore early-life circumstances’ pivotal role in SWB and the enduring consequences of adversity and public disasters.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究利用具有全国代表性的数据，采用跨出生队列和地区的双重差分方法，考察了1959-1961年中国大饥荒对幸存者五十年后主观幸福感的影响。早期生活暴露显著降低了情感和实现型幸福感，尤其是在女性中；评价型幸福感未受影响。机制分析强调健康状况和社会融合是主要渠道，社会经济地位的作用有限。本研究首次系统分析了饥荒对主观幸福感的影响，揭示了幸福感各维度间的差异性。我们的发现强调了早期生活状况在主观幸福感中的关键作用，以及逆境和公共灾难的持久后果。

records.title_en: Inattention and credit card repayment date
records.title_cn: 注意力不足与信用卡还款日期
records.abstract_en: This paper presents an analysis of how inattention affects credit card repayment dates. Data from an Asian commercial bank reveal that 70 % of repayments are made prior to the due date and 21 % are late. We show that exogenous reductions in attention levels, stemming from weekday-weekend variations in billing dates and natural disasters, amplify late repayments and diminish early repayments. We find that early repayments are not random errors, and consumers learn to pay earlier or sign up for automatic payment after historical delays. We introduce a model based on inattention and heterogeneous awareness to explain these findings.
records.abstract_cn: 本文分析了注意力不足如何影响信用卡还款日期。来自一家亚洲商业银行的数据显示，70的还款在到期日之前进行，21的还款逾期。我们表明，由账单日的周末-工作日差异和自然灾害引起的外生注意力水平降低，会加剧逾期还款并减少提前还款。我们发现提前还款并非随机错误，消费者在经历历史性延迟后会学会提前还款或注册自动支付。我们引入了一个基于注意力不足和异质性意识的模型来解释这些发现。

records.title_en: Pandemics and intergenerational mobility in education: Evidence from the 2003 Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SARS) epidemic in China
records.title_cn: 流行病与教育代际流动性：来自中国2003年严重急性呼吸综合征（SARS）疫情的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper examines the impact of the 2003 SARS epidemic on student academic and labour market outcomes. Using data from the 2010 Chinese census and variations in SARS cases across cities, we conduct a difference-in-differences analysis. Our findings indicate that among those who took the college entrance exam in 2003 during the epidemic, SARS hurts the performance of students from less educated families but benefits students from higher educated families, which increases educational inequality and lowers intergenerational mobility in education. This effect is stronger for female students and for admission to four-year bachelor programmes. Furthermore, we find suggestive evidence that SARS significantly increases the likelihood of children from more educated families having more prestigious jobs and earning higher incomes in the medium run. The mechanism analysis reveals that the adverse effect of SARS is not significant in more educated families because better-educated mothers increase their engagement in children's academic activities during the epidemic, which may make up for education loss during the period.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了2003年SARS疫情对学生学业和劳动力市场结果的影响。利用2010年中国人口普查数据及不同城市SARS病例的差异，我们进行了双重差分分析。研究结果表明，在2003年疫情期间参加高考的学生中，SARS损害了来自教育背景较低家庭学生的表现，但有利于来自教育背景较高家庭的学生，这加剧了教育不平等并降低了教育代际流动性。这一效应在女性学生和四年制本科项目录取中更为显著。此外，我们发现有提示性证据表明，SARS显著增加了来自教育背景较高家庭的孩子在中期内获得更体面工作和更高收入的可能性。机制分析显示，SARS的不利影响在教育背景较高的家庭中并不显著，因为受教育程度较高的母亲在疫情期间增加了对孩子学业活动的参与，这可能弥补了该时期的教育损失。

records.title_en: For better or for worse: How Mutual Credit Systems bolster resilience of small firms
records.title_cn: 无论好坏：互助信用体系如何增强小企业的韧性
records.abstract_en: This study provides the first firm-level evidence of the impact of a Mutual Credit System (MCS) on firm resilience. MCSs were introduced in local economies as monetary systems for firms, with the explicit intention of offering their member firms a network of support. We employ a staggered difference-in-differences approach on a novel transaction dataset to assess the impact of MCS membership on firm liquidity and revenue. Our findings unveil a nuanced pattern: during periods of stability, MCS membership appears to entail costs, but its impact turns decidedly positive in periods of economic turbulence. Small firms reap the most significant benefits, particularly those engaging in more transactions and higher credit exchange volumes. Our results emphasize the importance of combining credit and social mechanisms to enhance financial resilience. These findings underscore the role of MCSs as a safety net for small firms, providing crucial support precisely when these firms are most vulnerable in times of crisis.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究提供了关于互助信用体系（MCS）对企业韧性影响的首个企业层面证据。MCS作为面向企业的货币体系被引入地方经济，明确意图是为其成员企业提供支持网络。我们采用交错双重差分方法，基于一个新颖的交易数据集，评估MCS成员资格对企业流动性和收入的影响。我们的发现揭示了一个微妙的模式：在稳定时期，MCS成员资格似乎带来成本，但在经济动荡时期，其影响转为明显的正面。小企业获益最大，尤其是那些参与更多交易和更高信用交换量的企业。我们的结果强调了结合信用和社会机制以增强金融韧性的重要性。这些发现凸显了MCS作为小企业安全网的作用，在企业最脆弱的危机时期提供关键支持。

records.title_en: Television exposure in early childhood and subsequent cognitive outcomes: Evidence from rural China
records.title_cn: 幼儿期电视暴露与后续认知结果：来自中国农村的证据
records.abstract_en: This study estimates the effect of television exposure in early childhood on subsequent cognitive outcomes using data from rural China. Exploiting the variations in the year of television access at the village level and children’s birth year, this study employs an extended two-way fixed effects (ETWFE) approach introduced by Wooldridge (2021). Baseline estimates, which are robust to staggered treatments, show that cognitive scores at ages 10–15 are significantly improved by full television exposure in early childhood (ages 0-5). Furthermore, there is suggestive evidence that this effect could be explained by the direct channel through which television enhances general knowledge level.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究利用中国农村的数据，估计了幼儿期电视暴露对后续认知结果的影响。利用村庄层面电视接入年份和儿童出生年份的变异，本研究采用了Wooldridge（2021）提出的扩展双向固定效应（ETWFE）方法。基线估计结果对交错处理具有稳健性，显示在10-15岁时的认知得分因幼儿期（0-5岁）的完全电视暴露而显著提高。此外，有提示性证据表明，这一效应可能通过电视增强一般知识水平的直接渠道来解释。

records.title_en: How helpful are the “hidden costs of food systems” numbers?
records.title_cn: “食品系统的隐性成本”数字有多大帮助？
records.abstract_en: The “hidden costs of foods systems” calculations reported by the Food and Land Use Coalition, the Food System Economic Commission and the UN Food and Agriculture Organization may not provide helpful policy guidance for the transformation of food systems for both economic and political reasons. Economically, the hidden costs numbers exclude countervailing social benefits which imply unavoidable trade-offs across policy objectives. They also aggregate costs that are fundamentally different in their economic character and require different policy approaches, while including some costs that are not attributable to food systems at all. Politically, the headline numbers risk impeding transformative change because they identify food systems participants – particularly farmers –in terms of the damage they inflict while ignoring critical benefits they confer, and implicate them in social failings for which they are not primarily responsible. However, the hidden costs numbers can be useful if integrated into a more balanced assessment of the performance of food systems. Such an approach could support a positive agenda which engages the actors whose contributions will be indispensable.
records.abstract_cn: 食品与土地利用联盟、食品系统经济委员会和联合国粮食及农业组织报告的“食品系统隐性成本”计算，可能无法为食品系统的转型提供有用的政策指导，原因既有经济方面的，也有政治方面的。在经济上，隐性成本数字排除了抵消性的社会效益，这暗示了政策目标之间不可避免的权衡取舍。它们还汇总了在经济性质上根本不同、需要不同政策方法的成本，同时包含了一些根本不属于食品系统的成本。在政治上，这些头条数字可能阻碍变革性进展，因为它们将食品系统的参与者——尤其是农民——定义为造成损害的一方，而忽略了他们带来的关键利益，并将他们牵连到并非主要责任的社会失败中。然而，如果将这些隐性成本数字整合到对食品系统绩效的更平衡评估中，它们可能是有用的。这种方法可以支持一个积极的议程，吸引那些贡献不可或缺的行动者参与。

records.title_en: The emerging short-form video platforms improve household dietary diversity of rural residents: Evidence from China
records.title_cn: 新兴短视频平台改善农村居民家庭膳食多样性：来自中国的证据
records.abstract_en: Hidden hunger and malnutrition threaten rural households in developing countries. Therefore, an effective and low-cost strategy is urgently required to improve the dietary diversity of rural households. Short-form video platforms (SVPs) are emerging media that can deliver diet-related information, and their potential impact on the dietary diversity of rural households cannot be neglected. Based on primary data collected from rural households in China, this study employs the IV-Poisson model to explore whether SVPs improve the dietary diversity of rural households, uses the IV-Probit model to examine whether SVPs encourage rural residents to consume food groups that are not self-produced, and applies the endogenous-treatment Poisson regression (ETPR) model to identify the heterogeneous effects of SVP participation on the dietary diversity of rural households with different distances from the county center. The results reveal that household cooks’ participation in SVPs significantly increases the dietary diversity of rural households. Specifically, households in which cooks participate in SVPs have 29.5% higher household dietary diversity scores than those in which cooks do not. The results indicate that household cooks’ participation in SVPs encourages rural residents to consume food groups that are not self-produced, thus improving their dietary diversity. In addition, the results indicate that household cooks’ participation in SVPs has a greater positive effect on the dietary diversity of rural households closer to the county center compared to those farther from the center.
records.abstract_cn: 隐性饥饿和营养不良威胁着发展中国家的农村家庭。因此，迫切需要一种有效且低成本的策略来改善农村家庭的膳食多样性。短视频平台（SVPs）是能够传递饮食相关信息的新兴媒体，其对农村家庭膳食多样性的潜在影响不容忽视。基于从中国农村家庭收集的一手数据，本研究采用IV-Poisson模型探讨SVPs是否改善农村家庭的膳食多样性，使用IV-Probit模型检验SVPs是否鼓励农村居民消费非自产食物组，并应用内生处理泊松回归（ETPR）模型识别SVP参与对距县城中心不同距离的农村家庭膳食多样性的异质性影响。结果表明，家庭厨师参与SVPs显著提高了农村家庭的膳食多样性。具体而言，厨师参与SVPs的家庭的膳食多样性得分比厨师未参与的家庭高29.5%。结果还表明，家庭厨师参与SVPs鼓励农村居民消费非自产食物组，从而改善其膳食多样性。此外，结果还表明，与距离县城中心较远的农村家庭相比，家庭厨师参与SVPs对距离县城中心较近的农村家庭的膳食多样性具有更大的正向影响。

records.title_en: Understanding the barriers to purchasing healthier, more environmentally sustainable food for people living with obesity and varying experiences of food insecurity in the UK
records.title_cn: 理解英国肥胖及不同程度食物不安全人群购买更健康、更环境可持续食品的障碍
records.abstract_en: In westernised countries, food insecurity (FI) is robustly associated with low diet quality, and obesity. Grocery stores are one promising arena for interventions to facilitate purchasing of healthier, more environmentally sustainable food. However, we currently lack understanding of the barriers experienced by people living with obesity (PLWO) and FI when shopping for such food. Using an online survey (N = 583), adults residing in England or Scotland with a body mass index of ≥ 30 kg/m2 self-reported on FI, diet quality, and their experiences of shopping in a grocery store for healthy and environmentally sustainable food. Participants also ranked different grocery store interventions on their helpfulness in supporting healthier, more environmentally sustainable purchasing. Structural equation modelling revealed that greater experiences of FI were directly associated with greater experiences of barriers from the food environment (e.g., price), food preparation practices, lower healthy diet knowledge and physical ill-health. Moreover, greater experiences of FI were indirectly associated with lower diet quality via mental ill-health and greater experiences of anticipated stigma associated with being food insecure. Grocery store interventions based on price/ incentivisation were ranked most helpful in supporting healthier, more environmentally sustainable purchasing. These findings highlight the challenges faced by PLWO and with greater experiences of FI when shopping for healthy and environmentally sustainable food. Findings also underscore the need for policy development relating to price and affordability at a population-level, and for policymakers and healthcare professionals to consider how to address mental health and how to minimise anticipated stigma experienced by this vulnerable group.
records.abstract_cn: 在西方化国家，食物不安全（FI）与低饮食质量和肥胖密切相关。杂货店是促进购买更健康、更环境可持续食品的干预措施的一个有前景的场所。然而，目前我们缺乏对肥胖人群（PLWO）和FI人群在购买此类食品时所遇障碍的理解。通过一项在线调查（N = 583），居住在英格兰或苏格兰、体重指数≥ 30 kg/m2的成年人自我报告了FI、饮食质量以及他们在杂货店购买健康和环境可持续食品的经历。参与者还对不同的杂货店干预措施在支持更健康、更环境可持续购买方面的帮助程度进行了排序。结构方程模型显示，更高程度的FI经历与来自食品环境（如价格）、食品准备实践、较低的健康饮食知识和身体疾病方面的更大障碍经历直接相关。此外，更高程度的FI经历通过心理健康问题和与食物不安全相关的预期污名经历，间接与较低的饮食质量相关。基于价格/激励的杂货店干预措施在支持更健康、更环境可持续购买方面被列为最有帮助。这些发现强调了PLWO和FI经历较多人群在购买健康和环境可持续食品时所面临的挑战。研究结果还强调了在人口层面制定与价格和可负担性相关的政策的必要性，并提示政策制定者和医疗保健专业人员考虑如何解决心理健康问题以及如何最小化这一弱势群体所经历的预期污名。

records.title_en: Reporting nutritional information on wine packaging: Does it affect consumers’ choices? Evidence from a choice experiment in Italy
records.title_cn: 葡萄酒包装上的营养信息报告：是否影响消费者的选择？来自意大利选择实验的证据
records.abstract_en: At the end of 2023, EU Commission mandated the adoption of nutritional labelling on wine products. This was intended to tackle irresponsible drinking behaviour and excessive energy intake from alcohol, but the alcohol industry stakeholders have remained skeptical. In this study, we seek clarification on: (1) whether nutritional labelling on alcoholic beverages can nudge consumers toward lower alcohol and hence lower calorie choices, (2) whether it can affect consumers’ evaluations for quality attributes, and (3) whether it beneficially affects choices by those who are most vulnerable. We conduct an online Choice Experiment on Italian consumers with a between-subjects approach, to simulate pre- and post-policy scenarios and observe choices by consumers who are informed about nutritional features (i.e. calorie content) and contrast these to those by uninformed consumers (i.e. the control group). We focus on red wine since, in Italy, wine is part of the traditional food diet and, at the same time, quality attributes represent a major component of product distinctiveness. Results from a Latent Class Random Parameter Logit Model (LC-RPL) weakly support nutritional labelling being an effective nudge toward low-alcohol wines, specifically in the case of less vulnerable consumers who are health-conscious, with lower BMI, who enjoy red wine during social gatherings and don’t typically read wine labels. Nutritional labelling on wine bottles either did not affect or enhanced mWTP for quality attributes. Consumers generally valued calorie content on wine packaging. This supports the implementation of nutritional labelling policies.
records.abstract_cn: 在2023年底，欧盟委员会强制要求葡萄酒产品采用营养标签。此举旨在解决不负责任的饮酒行为和酒精导致的过量能量摄入，但酒精行业利益相关者仍持怀疑态度。在本研究中，我们寻求澄清以下问题：（1）酒精饮料上的营养标签是否能引导消费者选择低酒精因而低热量的选项，（2）它是否能影响消费者对质量属性的评价，以及（3）它是否对最脆弱群体的选择产生有益影响。我们对意大利消费者进行了一项在线选择实验，采用受试者间设计，模拟政策前后情景，并观察了解营养特征（即卡路里含量）的消费者与不了解的消费者（即对照组）的选择。我们专注于红葡萄酒，因为在意大利，葡萄酒是传统饮食的一部分，同时质量属性是产品差异化的主要组成部分。潜在类别随机参数Logit模型（LC-RPL）的结果弱支持营养标签作为引导消费者选择低酒精葡萄酒的有效推动力，特别是在那些注重健康、BMI较低、在社交聚会中享用红葡萄酒且通常不阅读葡萄酒标签的较不脆弱消费者中。葡萄酒瓶上的营养标签要么不影响，要么提高了对质量属性的边际支付意愿（mWTP）。消费者普遍重视葡萄酒包装上的卡路里含量。这支持了营养标签政策的实施。

records.title_en: Trade protection via tariff rate quota administration
records.title_cn: 关税配额管理下的贸易保护
records.abstract_en: In January 2022, the first dispute settlement panel convened under the United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement (USMCA) ruled that administration procedures for Canadian tariff rate quotas (TRQs) on U.S. dairy products violated Canadian trade obligations. Canada subsequently published new dairy quota administration policies to comply with the ruling. Using a dataset with monthly bilateral dairy trade flows at the 6-digit level from January 2014 to October 2023, we empirically assess the economic outcomes associated with this dispute from the perspective of the U.S. dairy industry. We find that — even under Canada’s original quota administration procedures — Canadian dairy TRQ concessions represented meaningful trade liberalization relative to the pre-USMCA status quo. However, in light of Canada’s revised procedures following the panel ruling, U.S. exports to Canada experienced a substantial increase for affected dairy products. This indicates that Canada’s original quota administration procedures represented a “binding” trade restriction beyond the negotiated quota. USMCA dispute settlement procedures effectively worked to remove the barrier.
records.abstract_cn: 在2022年一月，根据《美国-墨西哥-加拿大协定》（USMCA）设立的首个争端解决专家组裁定，加拿大对美国乳制品的关税配额（TRQs）管理程序违反了加拿大的贸易义务。加拿大随后公布了新的乳制品配额管理政策以遵守该裁决。利用2014年一月至2023年十月期间月度双边乳制品贸易流量的6位码数据集，我们从美国乳制品行业的角度实证评估了这一争端相关的经济结果。我们发现，即使在加拿大原有的配额管理程序下，加拿大的乳制品关税配额减让相对于USMCA之前的现状也代表了有意义的贸易自由化。然而，鉴于专家组裁决后加拿大修订的程序，美国对加拿大的受影响乳制品出口出现了显著增长。这表明加拿大原有的配额管理程序构成了超出谈判配额的“约束性”贸易限制。USMCA争端解决程序有效地消除了这一障碍。

records.title_en: Urban food policy councils as politicized spaces: The case of Arusha, Tanzania
records.title_cn: 城市食品政策委员会作为政治化空间：坦桑尼亚阿鲁沙的案例
records.abstract_en: Informal food vendors constitute a significant portion of the workforce in Arusha, Tanzania, and play a crucial role in the local food system. Despite their importance, these vendors lack political and social agency, resulting in their underrepresentation in decision-making processes. This study explores the potential of urban food policy councils (UFPCs) to support these vendors, focusing on the Arusha Sustainable Food System Platform. Recently, the platform faced a government directive to relocate street vendors without their participation. This case study examines the platform’s response to this directive.
records.abstract_cn: 在坦桑尼亚阿鲁沙，非正规食品商贩构成了劳动力中的重要部分，并在当地食品系统中扮演关键角色。尽管他们很重要，但这些商贩缺乏政治和社会能动性，导致他们在决策过程中代表性不足。本研究探讨了城市食品政策委员会（UFPCs）支持这些商贩的潜力，重点关注阿鲁沙可持续食品系统平台。近期，该平台面临政府指令，要求在没有商贩参与的情况下迁移街头商贩。本案例研究考察了该平台对这一指令的回应。

records.title_en: Much ado about nothing? An empirical analysis of consumer behaviour in the presence of ‘dual food quality’
records.title_cn: 无事生非？‘双重食品质量’存在下的消费者行为实证分析
records.abstract_en: Marketing food products with slightly different compositions as identical across countries is a common practice in the food industry. While food companies argue that different versions reflect taste preferences, some Central and Eastern European consumers allege that multinational companies sell lower quality products using the same brand name and packaging as in Western European countries. The political attention gathered by this practice, exemplified by the dual food quality (DFQ) debate in the European Union (EU), has largely neglected how the presence of DFQ affects consumers’ purchase decisions. This study aims to help fill this gap. Additionally, it examines the impact of a policy intervention consisting of a ‘made for’ claim and the role of the brand name on consumer choices. Through online discrete-choice experiments and laboratory tasting and rating experiments in six EU countries, no systematic support is found for either the industry’s or the consumers’ arguments. Results also indicate that a policy requiring consumers to be informed about the destination market of different versions would increase consumers’ valuation of domestic products, while at the same time improving transparency and avoiding misleading consumers.
records.abstract_cn: 在食品行业中，将成分略有不同的食品产品作为相同产品在不同国家销售是一种常见做法。虽然食品公司辩称不同版本反映了口味偏好，但一些中欧和东欧消费者声称，跨国公司使用与西欧国家相同的品牌名称和包装销售质量较低的产品。这一做法引发的政治关注，以欧盟（EU）中的双重食品质量（DFQ）辩论为例，在很大程度上忽视了DFQ的存在如何影响消费者的购买决策。本研究旨在帮助填补这一空白。此外，本研究还考察了由‘专为’声明组成的政策干预的影响以及品牌名称在消费者选择中的作用。通过在六个欧盟国家进行的在线离散选择实验和实验室品尝与评分实验，未发现对行业或消费者论点的系统性支持。结果还表明，要求消费者了解不同版本目标市场的政策将提高消费者对国内产品的估值，同时提高透明度并避免误导消费者。

records.title_en: Assessing consumers’ valuation for Front-of-Package ‘Health’ labeling under FDA guidelines
records.title_cn: 评估FDA指南下消费者对包装正面“健康”标签的估值
records.abstract_en: Suboptimal diets contribute significantly to diet-related chronic diseases and mortality in the United States. To address this, Front-of-Pack (FOP) labels have been proposed to help consumers make healthier food choices. In 2022, the FDA introduced 15 potential health labels aimed at providing critical information and nudging consumers toward healthier food choices, yet the effects of these labels on consumer preferences remain ambiguous. Using the Becker–DeGroot–Marschak mechanism in a laboratory experiment, this study investigates the influence of health and taste labels, and information provision, on consumer willingness to pay (WTP) for yogurt qualifying for the FDA-endorsed health label. Findings indicate that health labels alone reduce WTP, potentially due to perceived compromises on taste and skepticism towards health claims. However, the addition of credible information regarding FDA qualification mitigates these negative effects. Exploratory subsample analyses reveal that the health label is discounted among consumers who are nutritionally knowledgeable, health-conscious, pleasure driven, and frequent label users. However, providing information about the health label mitigates this discount among the former three types of consumers. The study underscores the importance of providing credible, detailed information and targeted educational campaigns to enhance the effectiveness of health labels. These insights can inform policymakers and stakeholders in developing more effective food labeling strategies to promote healthier dietary choices and improve public health outcomes. By unraveling the nuances of how consumers respond to health and taste labels, our research offers valuable guidance for designing labeling strategies that resonate with consumer values and preferences.
records.abstract_cn: 次优饮食显著导致美国饮食相关慢性疾病和死亡率。为解决这一问题，包装正面（FOP）标签被提出以帮助消费者做出更健康的食品选择。在2022年，FDA引入了15种潜在健康标签，旨在提供关键信息并引导消费者选择更健康的食品，但这些标签对消费者偏好的影响仍不明确。本研究采用Becker-DeGroot-Marschak机制进行实验室实验，探讨健康标签、口味标签及信息提供对消费者对符合FDA认可健康标签的酸奶支付意愿（WTP）的影响。研究发现，仅健康标签会降低WTP，可能是由于消费者对口味妥协的感知及对健康声明的怀疑。然而，增加关于FDA资格的可靠信息可缓解这些负面影响。探索性子样本分析显示，健康标签在具有营养知识、健康意识、享乐驱动及频繁使用标签的消费者中被折价。但提供健康标签信息可缓解前三类消费者的折价现象。本研究强调了提供可靠、详细信息及针对性教育活动以增强健康标签有效性的重要性。这些见解可为政策制定者和利益相关者提供指导，以制定更有效的食品标签策略，促进更健康的饮食选择并改善公共健康结果。通过揭示消费者对健康和口味标签反应的细微差别，我们的研究为设计符合消费者价值观和偏好的标签策略提供了宝贵指导。

records.title_en: Analysis of the Italian regulatory framework on the welfare of aquatic organisms, with a focus on live crustaceans
records.title_cn: 意大利水生生物福利监管框架分析，重点关注活体甲壳类动物
records.abstract_en: The European Union regulatory framework for the welfare of aquatic organisms (AOW), live seafood (LSW) and live crustaceans intended for human consumption (LCW) is still in its nascent stages. Member States have tackled the subject with different regulatory approach, represented in Italy, by municipal regulations. The present study was designed to provide an overview of the municipal regulations pertaining to AOW, LSW, and LCW issued in Italy to date. A search was conducted on Google from December 2023 to March 2024 using specific keywords. The analysis of the regulations entailed the scrutiny of provisions concerning AOW and LSW during transport, maintenance, display and, additionally, LCW during stunning and slaughter. A total of 771 municipal regulations on animal welfare issued from 2001 to 2023 were collected. A total of 542 provisions concerning AOW were identified, while 234 and 181 provisions also addressed LSW and LCW, respectively. As regards LCW, specific regulations included the prohibition of the claws banding (85.1%), slaughter prior to sale (59.1%), and boiling of live crustaceans (33.1%). Conversely, the obligation to slaughter before sale (12.1%), after stunning (10.5%) and out of sight of the consumer (5%) were reported. The divergent and generally not scientifically-based nature of the regulations suggests limitations of the Italian approach in AOW, LSW and LCW management. In anticipation of the risk assessment-based revision of EU legislation on AOW, the results provide an updated basis for the drafting of national technical guidelines, including species-specific control checklists, for the monitoring of LCW along the entire supply chain.
records.abstract_cn: 欧盟关于水生生物福利（AOW）、供人食用的活海鲜（LSW）和活体甲壳类动物（LCW）的监管框架仍处于起步阶段。成员国以不同的监管方式处理该问题，在意大利表现为市政法规。本研究旨在概述意大利迄今发布的与AOW、LSW和LCW相关的市政法规。使用特定关键词在Google上从2023年十二月至2024年三月进行了搜索。对法规的分析涉及审查关于运输、维持、展示期间AOW和LSW的规定，以及击晕和屠宰期间LCW的规定。共收集了2001年至2023年间发布的771项关于动物福利的市政法规。共识别出542项涉及AOW的规定，其中234项和181项分别涉及LSW和LCW。关于LCW，具体规定包括禁止钳子捆绑（85.1%）、销售前屠宰（59.1%）和活煮甲壳类动物（33.1%）。相反，销售前屠宰（12.1%）、击晕后屠宰（10.5%）和消费者视线外屠宰（5%）的义务被报告。法规的分歧性和普遍缺乏科学依据表明意大利在AOW、LSW和LCW管理方法上的局限性。鉴于基于风险评估的欧盟AOW立法修订预期，结果为起草国家技术指南（包括物种特定控制检查表）提供了最新基础，用于监测整个供应链中的LCW。

records.title_en: Decompose food price disparities in China: Evidence from wholesale markets
records.title_cn: 分解中国食品价格差异：来自批发市场的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper examines regional variations in food prices in China and the underlying factors contributing to these disparities. Leveraging administrative data from agricultural wholesale markets, we construct spatial price indices and reveal consistent monthly trends in disparities. Using our proposed decomposition method, we identify livestock products, particularly beef and pork, as the main components driving regional food price differences. We examine the role of local supply–demand factors in explaining spatial food price variations and find that local gasoline prices are a significant contributor to food price disparity. A one percent increase in local gasoline prices leads to a 0.6 percent rise in local food prices and exacerbates spatial food price disparities by 0.5–1.0 percent. These results highlight the importance of considering transportation costs and regional supply–demand dynamics in understanding food price variations across regions. Our findings have implications for policy aiming to address regional food price disparities and ensure food affordability.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了中国食品价格的区域差异及其背后的影响因素。利用农产品批发市场的行政数据，我们构建了空间价格指数，并揭示了差异中一致的月度趋势。通过我们提出的分解方法，我们识别出畜产品，特别是牛肉和猪肉，是驱动区域食品价格差异的主要组成部分。我们考察了当地供需因素在解释空间食品价格变动中的作用，并发现当地汽油价格是食品价格差异的重要贡献因素。当地汽油价格每上涨百分之一，会导致当地食品价格上涨0.6%，并加剧空间食品价格差异0.5-1.0%。这些结果强调了在理解跨区域食品价格变动时考虑运输成本和区域供需动态的重要性。我们的发现对旨在解决区域食品价格差异和确保食品可负担性的政策具有启示意义。

records.title_en: Coping or hoping? Livelihood diversification and food insecurity in the COVID-19 pandemic
records.title_cn: 应对还是寄望？COVID-19疫情期间的生计多样化与粮食不安全
records.abstract_en: We examine the relationship between livelihood diversification and food insecurity amid the COVID-19 pandemic. Our analysis uses household panel data from Ethiopia, Malawi, and Nigeria in which the first round was collected immediately prior to the pandemic and extends through multiple rounds of monthly data collection during the pandemic. Using this pre- and post-outbreak data, and guided by a pre-analysis plan, we estimate conditional associations between livelihood diversification and food insecurity. Our results do not support the hypothesis that livelihood diversification correlates with household resilience. Though income diversification may serve as an effective coping mechanism for small-scale shocks, we find that for a disaster on the scale of the pandemic this strategy is not effective. Policymakers looking to prepare for the increased occurrence of large-scale disasters will need to grapple with the fact that coping strategies that gave people hope in the past may fail them as they try to cope with the future.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了COVID-19疫情期间生计多样化与粮食不安全之间的关系。我们的分析使用了来自埃塞俄比亚、马拉维和尼日利亚的家庭面板数据，其中第一轮数据在疫情爆发前立即收集，并延伸至疫情期间多轮月度数据收集。利用这些疫情前后的数据，并在预分析计划的指导下，我们估计了生计多样化与粮食不安全之间的条件关联。我们的结果不支持生计多样化与家庭韧性相关的假设。尽管收入多样化可能作为小规模冲击的有效应对机制，但我们发现，对于疫情规模级别的灾难，这一策略并不有效。寻求为日益频繁的大规模灾害做准备的政策制定者将不得不面对这样一个事实：过去给人们带来希望的应对策略，在他们试图应对未来时可能会失效。

records.title_en: Promises and uncertainties in the cultivated proteins market: Perspectives from Germany and Brazil
records.title_cn: 培养蛋白市场中的承诺与不确定性：来自德国和巴西的视角
authors: Beatrice de Freitas Martins da Silva
records.abstract_en: Cultivated meat offers an alternative to ensure food security and mitigate greenhouse gas emissions from conventional animal production. As the innovation remains in its nascent stages, policymakers require a better understanding of the market’s potential, trajectory and future development perspectives. To support policymakers in developing flexible and effective policy frameworks for cultivated meat, we analyze perspectives about the trajectory of the cultivated meat market by 2040 in a comparative study of two countries, which are both major conventional meat markets and developers of alternative protein sources: Brazil and Germany. We use the Q-methodology to identify future perspectives and examine the influence of conventional meat industry incumbents on cultivated meat governance. Our sample includes 59 stakeholders working on cultivated and conventional meat. These perspectives can aid in decision-making related to investments in technological development, improvements in the sensory attributes of cultivated products, support for entrepreneurial ecosystems and startups, product hybridization, consumer and stakeholder engagement, the development of human capital, and regulatory schemes.
records.abstract_cn: 培养肉提供了一种替代方案，以确保食品安全并减少传统动物生产产生的温室气体排放。由于该创新仍处于初期阶段，政策制定者需要更好地了解市场的潜力、发展轨迹和未来前景。为了支持政策制定者制定灵活有效的培养肉政策框架，我们在一项比较研究中分析了到2040年培养肉市场发展轨迹的视角，研究对象是两个既是传统肉类主要市场又是替代蛋白来源开发者的国家：巴西和德国。我们使用Q方法论来识别未来视角，并考察传统肉类行业现有企业对培养肉治理的影响。我们的样本包括59名从事培养肉和传统肉类的利益相关者。这些视角有助于与技术开发投资、培养产品感官属性改进、创业生态系统和初创企业支持、产品杂交、消费者和利益相关者参与、人力资本开发以及监管方案相关的决策。

records.title_en: Vulnerability of US dairy farms to extreme heat
records.title_cn: 美国奶牛场对极端高温的脆弱性
records.abstract_en: Livestock agriculture, and dairy more specifically, is threatened by climate change as extreme weather conditions become more frequent. When temperature and humidity increase above critical levels, dairy cows become heat-stressed and experience a drop in milk production. We quantify the impact of heat stress on the dairy industry throughout the Midwestern and Eastern United States in the years 2012–2016 using animal-level production data. We estimate that 1% of total annual yield is lost to heat stress, and losses are predicted to increase about 30% by 2050 on average under various climate scenarios. We provide three new insights compared to previous estimates with aggregated data. (1) Heat stress disproportionately affects milk quality, having larger impacts on farm income and nutritional value than previously estimated. (2) Small farms experience the largest losses to heat stress, suggesting they face barriers to adaptation. (3) Cows in the highest-yield production stage are the most vulnerable to heat stress in both relative and absolute terms. Our results have global implications given the prevalence of dairy as a source of income and nutrition in high- and low-income contexts. We outline ways that funds for climate-smart agriculture could be used to increase climate resilience in the dairy industry.
records.abstract_cn: 畜牧业，尤其是奶牛养殖，正受到气候变化的威胁，因为极端天气事件变得更加频繁。当温度和湿度超过临界水平时，奶牛会遭受热应激，导致产奶量下降。我们利用动物层面的生产数据，量化了2012-2016年间美国中西部和东部地区热应激对奶牛养殖业的影响。我们估计，每年总产量的1%因热应激而损失，并且在各种气候情景下，到2050年损失预计平均增加约30%。与以往使用汇总数据的估计相比，我们提供了三个新见解。（1）热应激对牛奶质量的影响不成比例地大，对农场收入和营养价值的影响比以往估计的更大。（2）小型农场因热应激遭受的损失最大，这表明它们面临适应障碍。（3）处于最高产奶阶段的奶牛在相对和绝对意义上都最容易受到热应激的影响。鉴于奶牛养殖在高低收入环境中作为收入和营养来源的普遍性，我们的结果具有全球意义。我们概述了气候智能型农业资金可用于提高奶牛养殖业气候韧性的途径。

records.title_en: Consumer support of policy measures to increase sustainability in food consumption
records.title_cn: 消费者对提高食品消费可持续性的政策措施的支持
records.abstract_en: The modern global food system is an important driver of climate change. Policy measures are one potential lever for shifting consumption towards more sustainability. Public acceptance can be a major barrier for the implementation of such measures. Thus, a profound understanding of consumers is needed to facilitate policy support. In the present study, we therefore invited 453 participants from German-speaking parts of Switzerland to participate in an online survey in which we tested 15 policy measures for their consumer acceptance. Furthermore, we explored individual predictors that contribute to policy support. Our results show that there is a difference in the support of policy measures depending on the level of intrusiveness, making less intrusive measures more accepted than more intrusive measures. Support also varied depending on the targeted product category. Measures targeting dairy and meat products tended to be less accepted than measures targeting vegetables. Using a regression analysis, we identified behaviour (i.e. meat and dairy consumption) and food sustainability knowledge as an important predictor of policy support. The findings have important implications for policymakers, as they illustrate that personal involvement is a crucial factor in policy support. Taken together, our findings can help inform future food policies to increase consumer support and thereby facilitate sustainable behaviour change.
records.abstract_cn: 现代全球食品系统是气候变化的重要驱动因素。政策措施是推动消费向更可持续方向转变的一个潜在杠杆。公众接受度可能是实施此类措施的主要障碍。因此，深入了解消费者对于促进政策支持至关重要。在本研究中，我们邀请了来自瑞士德语区的453名参与者参加一项在线调查，测试了15项政策措施的消费者接受度。此外，我们探讨了有助于政策支持的个人预测因素。我们的结果显示，政策措施的支持度因其干预程度的不同而有所差异，干预程度较低的措施比干预程度较高的措施更容易被接受。支持度也因目标产品类别而异。针对乳制品和肉类的措施往往不如针对蔬菜的措施被接受。通过回归分析，我们确定了行为（即肉类和乳制品消费）和食品可持续性知识是政策支持的重要预测因素。这些发现对政策制定者具有重要意义，因为它们表明个人参与是政策支持的关键因素。总的来说，我们的发现可以为未来的食品政策提供信息，以增加消费者支持，从而促进可持续行为改变。

records.title_en: Can differentiated value-added tax rates promote healthier diets? The case of Costa Rica
records.title_cn: 差别增值税税率能否促进更健康的饮食？哥斯达黎加的案例
records.abstract_en: In February 2023, Costa Rica reformed its basic value-added tax basket on which a reduced rate applies to “guarantee a balanced diet”. This paper assesses ex-ante the impact of the reform on nutrient availability and household spending across income groups. Price elasticities are estimated using pooled National Household Income and Expenditure Survey data and a two-step censored quadratic almost ideal demand system model accounting for price and total expenditure endogeneity. Nutritional information is derived from food composition tables. Food items are grouped by processing level as a proxy to explore differences in own- and cross-price effects between ‘healthier’ and ‘less healthy’ items. The demand for ultra-processed sweet and savoury foods is price-inelastic (−0.74 and −0.81, respectively). Lower-income households’ demand is more price-sensitive. The reform applies a reduced rate to a significant number of ultra-processed savoury food items and is associated with an increase in household purchases of calories (0.7%), sugar (0.4%), and saturated fat (1.2%). A counterfactual scenario with a basic tax basket defined based on the Pan American Health Organization nutrient profile model criteria is associated with the largest reductions in calories (−0.2%), sodium (−1.0%), and saturated fat (−0.6%), with higher benefits for lower-income households. It results in minor decreases in household spending (−0.2%). While an increasing number of countries contemplate the taxation of foods high in fat, salt, or sugar, Costa Rica is unique in mandating the consideration of nutritional aspects in determining value-added tax rates. However, the recently adopted basic tax basket may not fulfil this potential.
records.abstract_cn: 2023年二月，哥斯达黎加改革了其基本增值税篮子，对适用低税率的商品以“保障均衡饮食”。本文事前评估了该改革对不同收入群体营养素可获得性和家庭支出的影响。使用汇总的国家家庭收入与支出调查数据，并采用考虑价格和总支出内生性的两步审查二次几乎理想需求系统模型估计价格弹性。营养信息来源于食物成分表。食品按加工水平分组，作为探索‘更健康’与‘不太健康’商品之间自身和交叉价格效应差异的代理。超加工甜味和咸味食品的需求缺乏价格弹性（分别为-0.74和-0.81）。低收入家庭的需求对价格更敏感。该改革对大量超加工咸味食品适用低税率，并与家庭卡路里（0.7%）、糖（0.4%）和饱和脂肪（1.2%）购买量的增加相关。基于泛美卫生组织营养素概况模型标准定义基本税收篮子的反事实情景，与卡路里（-0.2%）、钠（-1.0%）和饱和脂肪（-0.6%）的最大减少相关，对低收入家庭带来更大益处。这导致家庭支出小幅减少（-0.2%）。虽然越来越多的国家考虑对高脂肪、高盐或高糖食品征税，但哥斯达黎加在确定增值税税率时强制考虑营养方面是独特的。然而，最近采用的基本税收篮子可能无法实现这一潜力。

records.title_en: Machine learning on national shopping data reliably estimates childhood obesity prevalence and socio-economic deprivation
records.title_cn: 基于全国购物数据的机器学习可靠估计儿童肥胖患病率与社会经济剥夺
records.abstract_en: Deprivation pushes people to choose cheap, calorie-dense foods instead of nutritious but expensive alternatives. Diseases, such as obesity, cardiovascular disease, and diabetes, resulting from these poor dietary choices place a significant burden on public health systems. Measuring nutritional insecurity is difficult to achieve at scale and so the ability to study the relationship between nutritional outcomes and deprivation at a national level is very challenging. This makes it difficult to understand the effect of new policies or track changes over time. To address this challenge, we develop a machine learning approach using massive anonymised transactional data (4 million members and 2.5 billion transactions) in partnership with the retailer The Co-operative Group UK. We engineer a series of variables related to obesogenic diets, including a new measure called ‘Calorie-oriented purchasing’. These variables help illustrate how large-scale transactional data can discriminate between neighbourhoods most affected by deprivation and childhood obesity. Through comparative assessment of machine learning approaches, we find better performance from tree-based models (Random Forest, XGBoost) with the best-achieving accuracy of 0.88 for predicting deprivation and an accuracy of 0.79 for childhood obesity. Calorie-oriented purchasing emerges as a robust predictor of deprivation and childhood obesity at the census area level. Results show this approach can help summarise nutritional insecurity, and support its spatio-temporal monitoring. We conclude with policy implications and recommend retailers adopt new measures for measuring national nutrition insecurity.
records.abstract_cn: 剥夺促使人们选择廉价、高热量的食物，而非营养丰富但昂贵的替代品。由这些不良饮食选择导致的疾病，如肥胖、心血管疾病和糖尿病，给公共卫生系统带来了沉重负担。大规模衡量营养不安全难以实现，因此在全国层面研究营养结果与剥夺之间的关系非常具有挑战性。这使得理解新政策的效果或随时间追踪变化变得困难。为应对这一挑战，我们与零售商The Co-operative Group UK合作，开发了一种机器学习方法，使用大规模匿名交易数据（4百万会员和2.5十亿笔交易）。我们设计了一系列与致肥胖饮食相关的变量，包括一项名为“卡路里导向购买”的新指标。这些变量有助于说明大规模交易数据如何区分受剥夺和儿童肥胖影响最严重的社区。通过机器学习方法的比较评估，我们发现基于树的模型（随机森林、XGBoost）表现更好，预测剥夺的最佳准确率为0.88，预测儿童肥胖的准确率为0.79。卡路里导向购买在人口普查区层面成为剥夺和儿童肥胖的稳健预测因子。结果表明，这种方法有助于总结营养不安全，并支持其时空监测。我们最后提出政策含义，并建议零售商采用新措施来衡量国家营养不安全。

records.title_en: Where to buy and what to eat: The relationship between purchasing channels and nutrient intake in Japan
records.title_cn: 在哪里购买与吃什么：日本购买渠道与营养素摄入之间的关系
