By formalising these qualitative insights, we provide a mathematical structure that explains the emergence of these explosive phenomena, facilitates comparisons across different systems, and enables predictive insights into future evolutionary trajectories. Moreover, by comparing discrete and continuous formalisations of the theory, we emphasise that the occurrence and observation of these presumed singularities should be carefully considered, as they arise from the continuous limit of inherently discrete models.
records.abstract_cn: 宏观进化动力学经常表现出突然的、爆炸性的激增，系统在经历经常超过传统指数增长的急剧加速之前，会在较长时间内保持相对稳定。这种模式在生物进化、文化变迁和技术进步中很明显，通常被称为奇点的出现。尽管它们广泛发生，但这些爆炸源于不同领域的不同潜在机制。在这种背景下，我们提出了一个统一的框架，通过组合创新理论捕捉这些动态。基于邻近可能理论，我们将宏观进化变化建模为一个由系统内预先存在的元素重新组合驱动的过程。通过形式化这些定性见解，我们提供了一个数学结构，可以解释这些爆炸性现象的出现，促进不同系统之间的比较，并能够对未来的进化轨迹进行预测性见解。此外，通过比较理论的离散和连续形式化，我们强调应该仔细考虑这些假定奇点的出现和观察，因为它们源于固有离散模型的连续极限。

records.title_en: Taxes and gender equality: The incidence of the ‘tampon tax’
records.title_cn: 税收和性别平等：“卫生棉条税”的发生率
records.abstract_en: This paper uses a permanent reduction of the “tampon tax” in Germany to study the price and unit-sales effects of the tax. Exploiting an extensive data set on the sales and scanner prices of feminine hygiene products in Germany and Italy, our results show that the incidence of tampon taxes is fully on consumers, while demand for these products is price-inelastic. We do not find cross-price effects for a closely related product group, which remained taxed at the standard tax rate. We conclude that reducing taxes on feminine hygiene products could be an effective measure to address “period poverty”.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用德国永久降低“卫生棉条税”来研究该税收对价格和销量的影响。我们利用有关德国和意大利女性卫生用品销售和扫描仪价格的广泛数据集，结果表明卫生棉条税的发生完全由消费者承担，而这些产品的需求缺乏价格弹性。我们没有发现密切相关的产品组存在交叉价格效应，该产品组仍按标准税率征税。我们的结论是，减少女性卫生用品的税收可能是解决“经期贫困”的有效措施。

records.title_en: Repeated contests with commitment types
records.title_cn: 与承诺类型的重复竞赛
records.abstract_en: Contestants fight in repeated contests and privately know whether they are rational utility maximizers or automatons committed to always fighting “all-in.” In the unique symmetric equilibrium, rational contestants fight all-in in early contests as doing so buys a beneficial “all-in look” that intimidates rivals in future contests. In equilibrium, several structural differences emerge between periods in which multiple contestants maintain an all-in look, as opposed to one: most prominently, only in the former case aggregate efforts may exceed the per-period prize, and only in the latter payoffs can be positive.
records.abstract_cn: 参赛者在反复的比赛中战斗，私下里知道他们是理性的效用最大化者，还是致力于始终“全押”战斗的机器人。在独特的对称均衡中，理性的参赛者在早期比赛中全押，因为这样做会获得有益的“全押外观”，从而在未来的比赛中恐吓对手。在均衡状态下，多个参赛者保持全押的时期之间会出现一些结构性差异，而不是一个时期：最突出的是，只有在前一种情况下，总的努力可能会超过每期的奖金，并且只有在后一种情况下，回报才能是正的。

records.title_en: Running the risk: Immunity and mobility in response to a pandemic
records.title_cn: 冒风险：应对大流行的免疫力和流动性
records.abstract_en: The relative effectiveness of non-pharmaceutical interventions, such as lockdowns and work-from-home mandates, depends on whether individuals adjust their social behavior in response to infection risk when policy restrictions are absent. Exploiting geographic variation in COVID-19 exposure during the first wave, three key results emerge. First, we find evidence that areas with relatively high excess death rates during the first wave of the pandemic had relatively low excess death rates during the second wave. Second, using granular mobility data from GPS devices, we show that the same areas saw relatively high mobility during the second wave, which may suggest that the first finding is driven by an immunity effect. Finally, the heterogeneity analysis reveals that scarring, behavioral responses, and immunization may operate with varying intensity across municipalities with different age compositions, yielding observable differences in both second-wave mobility and mortality patterns.
records.abstract_cn: 封锁和在家工作等非药物干预措施的相对有效性，取决于在没有政策限制的情况下，个人是否会调整其社会行为以应对感染风险。利用第一波期间 COVID-19 暴露的地理差异，出现了三个关键结果。首先，我们发现有证据表明，第一波疫情期间超额死亡率相对较高的地区，第二波疫情期间超额死亡率相对较低。其次，使用来自 GPS 设备的精细移动性数据，我们发现在第二波浪潮中，相同区域的移动性相对较高，这可能表明第一个发现是由免疫效应驱动的。最后，异质性分析表明，疤痕、行为反应和免疫接种可能在不同年龄构成的城市中以不同的强度发挥作用，从而在第二波流动性和死亡率模式上产生明显的差异。

records.title_en: Robustness Measures for Welfare Analysis
records.title_cn: 福利分析的稳健性措施
records.abstract_en: Economists routinely make functional form assumptions on demand curves to derive welfare conclusions. How sensitive are these conclusions to such assumptions? In this paper, we develop robustness measures that quantify the extent to which the true demand curve must deviate from common functional form assumptions in order to overturn a welfare conclusion. We parametrize this variability in terms of the gradient and curvature of the demand curve. By leveraging tools from information design, we show that our measures are easy to compute. Our measures are also flexible and easy to use, as we illustrate through empirical applications.
records.abstract_cn: 经济学家通常对需求曲线进行函数形式假设，以得出福利结论。这些结论对此类假设有多敏感？在本文中，我们开发了稳健性度量，以量化真实需求曲线必须偏离常见函数形式假设的程度，以便推翻福利结论。我们根据需求曲线的梯度和曲率来参数化这种变化。通过利用信息设计的工具，我们表明我们的措施很容易计算。正如我们通过实证应用所说明的那样，我们的措施也灵活且易于使用。

records.title_en: Keep Your Enemies Closer: Strategic Platform Adjustments during US and French Elections
records.title_cn: 拉近你的敌人：美国和法国大选期间的战略平台调整
records.abstract_en: We study changes in political discourse during campaigns, using a novel dataset of candidate websites for US House elections, 2002–2016, and manifestos for French parliamentary and local elections, 1958–2022. We find that candidates move to the center in ideology and rhetorical complexity between the first round (or primary) and the second round (or general election). This convergence reflects candidates' strategic adjustment to their opponents, as predicted by Downsian competition: Using an RDD we show that candidates converge to the platform of opponents who narrowly qualified for the last round as opposed to those who narrowly failed to qualify.
records.abstract_cn: 我们使用美国众议院选举候选人网站 2002-2016 以及法国议会和地方选举宣言 1958-2022 的新颖数据集来研究竞选期间政治话语的变化。我们发现，在 第一 轮（或初选）和 第二 轮（或大选）之间，候选人在意识形态和修辞复杂性方面向中间移动。这种收敛反映了候选人对其对手的战略调整，正如 Downsian 竞争所预测的那样：使用 RDD，我们表明候选人收敛到以微弱优势晋级最后一轮的对手的平台，而不是那些以微弱优势未能晋级的对手的平台。

records.title_en: Employers and Unemployment Insurance Take-Up
records.title_cn: 雇主和失业保险的领取
records.abstract_en: We quantify the employer's role in unemployment insurance (UI) take-up. Employer effects on claiming and appeals are substantial, and those effects are negatively correlated, consistent with appeals deterring claims. Low-wage workers are less likely to claim and more likely to have their claims appealed than median-wage workers. Employer effects help explain these income gradients, so equalizing employer effects on claiming would increase the progressivity of UI. Finally, the main source of targeting error in UI is that eligible workers do not claim.
records.abstract_cn: 我们量化了雇主在失业保险 (UI) 领取中的作用。雇主对索赔和上诉的影响很大，并且这些影响呈负相关，这与上诉阻止索赔的情况一致。与中等工资工人相比，低工资工人提出索赔的可能性较小，而且更有可能提出上诉。雇主效应有助于解释这些收入梯度，因此均衡雇主对申领失业救济金的影响将提高失业保险的累进性。最后，UI 中定位错误的主要来源是符合条件的工人没有提出索赔。

records.title_en: Power Flows: Transmission Lines, Allocative Efficiency, and Corporate Profits
records.title_cn: 潮流：输电线路、配置效率和企业利润
records.abstract_en: Accelerated investment in electricity transmission could reduce total costs and enhance renewable integration. I document static allocative inefficiencies induced by incomplete market integration in 2 major US markets; these have risen over time and totaled $2 billion in 2022. I also argue that estimating firm-level impacts is important, as incumbents may have the power to block new lines and other reforms. I show that 4 firms would have experienced a collective $1.3 billion drop in net revenues in 2022 had the market been integrated, and there are reports of some of these firms blocking transmission projects.
records.abstract_cn: 加快输电投资可以降低总成本并加强可再生能源并网。我记录了2美国主要市场因市场一体化不完全而导致的静态配置效率低下；随着时间的推移，这些费用不断增加，2 的总金额为 2022 十亿 美元。我还认为，估计公司层面的影响很重要，因为现任者可能有权阻止新线路和其他改革。我表明，如果市场一体化，4家公司在1.3年的净收入将集体下降$2022十亿美元，并且有报道称其中一些公司阻止了输电项目。

records.title_en: Cursed Sequential Equilibrium
records.title_cn: 被诅咒的顺序平衡
records.abstract_en: This paper develops a framework to extend the strategic form analysis of cursed equilibrium (CE) developed by Eyster and Rabin (2005) to multistage games. The approach uses behavioral strategies rather than normal form mixed strategies and imposes sequential rationality. We define and characterize properties of cursed sequential equilibrium (CSE) and apply it to four canonical economic applications: signaling games, reputation building, durable goods monopoly, and the dirty faces game. These applications illustrate various implications of CSE, show how and why it differs from sequential equilibrium and CE, and provide evidence from laboratory experiments that support the empirical relevance of CSE.
records.abstract_cn: 本文开发了一个框架，将 Eyster 和 Rabin (2005) 开发的诅咒均衡 (CE) 策略形式分析扩展到多阶段博弈。该方法使用行为策略而不是正常形式的混合策略，并强加顺序理性。我们定义并描述了受诅咒的顺序均衡 (CSE) 的属性，并将其应用于 四 规范经济应用：信号游戏、声誉建设、耐用品垄断和脏脸游戏。这些应用说明了 CSE 的各种含义，展示了它与顺序均衡和 CE 的不同之处以及原因，并提供了支持 CSE 经验相关性的实验室实验证据。

records.title_en: The Negligible Effect of Free Contraception on Fertility: Experimental Evidence from Burkina Faso
records.title_cn: 免费避孕对生育能力的影响可以忽略不计：来自布基纳法索的实验证据
records.abstract_en: We conducted a randomized trial among 14,545 households in rural Burkina Faso to test the oft-cited hypothesis that limited access to contraception is an important driver of high fertility rates in West Africa. We do not find support for this hypothesis. Women who were given free access to modern contraception for three years did not have lower birth rates; we can reject even modest effects. We cross-randomized additional interventions to address inefficiencies that might depress demand for free contraception, specifically misperceptions about the child mortality rate and social norms. Free contraception did not significantly influence fertility even in combination with these interventions.
records.abstract_cn: 我们在布基纳法索农村地区的 14,545 家庭中进行了一项随机试验，以检验经常被引用的假设，即避孕手段有限是西非高生育率的重要驱动因素。我们没有找到支持这一假设的证据。在 三 年内免费获得现代避孕措施的妇女的出生率并没有降低；我们甚至可以拒绝轻微的影响。我们交叉随机地采取了额外的干预措施，以解决可能抑制免费避孕需求的低效率问题，特别是对儿童死亡率和社会规范的误解。即使与这些干预措施结合使用，免费避孕也不会显着影响生育能力。

records.title_en: Monopsony and Employer Misoptimization Explain Why Wages Bunch at Round Numbers
records.title_cn: 垄断和雇主错误优化解释了为什么工资成整数
records.abstract_en: We show that administrative hourly wage data exhibit considerable bunching at round numbers. We run two experiments randomizing wages around $0.10 and $1.00 to experimentally measure left-digit bias for identical tasks on Amazon Mechanical Turk; we fail to find any evidence of discontinuity in the labor supply function at round numbers despite estimating a considerable degree of monopsony. We replicate these results in administrative worker-firm hourly wage data from Oregon. We can rule out inattention estimates found in the behavioral product market literature. We provide evidence that firms "misoptimize" wage setting. More monopsony requires less employer misoptimization to explain bunching.
records.abstract_cn: 我们表明，行政小时工资数据在整数方面表现出相当大的聚集。我们运行 二 实验，将 $0.10 和 $1.00 周围的工资随机化，以实验性地测量 Amazon Mechanical Turk 上相同任务的左位数偏差；尽管估计存在相当程度的垄断，但我们未能找到任何证据表明劳动力供给函数在整数方面存在不连续性。我们将这些结果复制到俄勒冈州行政工人企业的小时工资数据中。我们可以排除行为产品市场文献中发现的注意力不集中估计。我们提供的证据表明企业“错误优化”了工资设定。更多的垄断需要更少的雇主错误优化来解释聚集。

records.title_en: From Retributive to Restorative: An Alternative Approach to Justice in Schools
records.title_cn: 从报应性到恢复性：学校司法的另一种方法
records.abstract_en: School districts historically approached conflict resolution from the perspective that suspending disruptive students was necessary to protect their classmates, even if this caused harm to perceived offenders. Restorative practices (RP)—focusing on reparation, accountability, and shared ownership of disciplinary justice—are designed to address undesirable behavior without harming students. We study Chicago Public Schools' adoption of RP and find that suspensions and arrests decreased, driven by effects for Black students. We find null effects on test score value added, ruling out meaningful average declines. We estimate a 15 percent decrease in out-of-school arrests, consistent with RP substantively changing student behavior.
records.abstract_cn: 历来，学区在解决冲突时都认为，为了保护同学，有必要让有破坏性的学生停学，即使这会对被视为违规者造成伤害。恢复性做法（RP）——侧重于赔偿、问责和纪律正义的共同所有权——旨在在不伤害学生的情况下解决不良行为。我们研究了芝加哥公立学校采用 RP 的情况，发现由于黑人学生的影响，停学和逮捕的情况有所减少。我们发现对测试分数附加值没有影响，排除了有意义的平均下降。我们估计校外逮捕人数将减少 15%，这与 RP 实质性改变学生行为的情况一致。

records.title_en: Underbidding for Oil and Gas Tracts
records.title_cn: 石油和天然气领域的投标不足
records.abstract_en: Common values auction models, where bidder decisions depend on noisy signals of common values, provide predictions about Bayesian Nash equilibrium (BNE) outcomes. In settings where these common values can be estimated, these predictions can be tested. We propose a series of tests, robust to assumptions about the signal structure, to determine whether the observed data could have been generated by a Bayesian Nash equilibrium. In the setting of oil and gas lease auctions in New Mexico, we find evidence that participation decisions are correlated and that participants systematically underbid in light of ex post outcomes.
records.abstract_cn: 共同价值拍卖模型中，投标人的决策取决于共同价值的噪声信号，提供有关贝叶斯纳什均衡 (BNE) 结果的预测。在可以估计这些共同值的环境中，可以测试这些预测。我们提出了一系列对信号结构假设稳健的测试，以确定观察到的数据是否可以由贝叶斯纳什均衡生成。在新墨西哥州的石油和天然气租赁拍卖中，我们发现有证据表明参与决策是相关的，并且参与者根据事后结果系统性地低估了出价。

records.title_en: Direct and Indirect Effects of Investment Tax Incentives
records.title_cn: 投资税收优惠的直接和间接影响
records.abstract_en: This paper estimates the direct effects and indirect spillover effects of investment tax credits on firms. Exploiting a differential tax credit rate change by firm size in the German manufacturing sector, I find that lowering a firm's investment cost by 7.6 percent increases its capital stock by 17.7 percent and employment by 12.0 percent. Positive local spillovers generate one additional manufacturing job for each directly created job, are strongest between firms in industries connected through input-output linkages, and arise within distances of five kilometers. Firms dependent on local consumer demand also increase employment, while within-industry spillovers generate small negative effects.
records.abstract_cn: 本文估计了投资税收抵免对企业的直接效应和间接溢出效应。利用德国制造业中企业规模不同的差别税收抵免率变化，我发现将企业的投资成本降低 7.6% 会增加其资本存量 17.7% 和就业人数 12.0%。积极的当地溢出效应为每个直接创造的就业机会带来 一 额外的制造业就业机会，在通过投入产出联系相连的行业中的企业之间最为强大，并且出现在 五 公里的距离内。依赖当地消费者需求的企业也会增加就业，而行业内的溢出效应只会产生较小的负面影响。

records.title_en: Does institutional design matter? Constitutional regime types and party system closure in Asia
records.title_cn: 制度设计重要吗？亚洲宪政政体类型与政党制度封闭
records.abstract_en: Constitutional regime types matter for democratic consolidation. However, how these institutional factors shape party system development has been rarely studied. Applying Casal Bértoa and Enyedi (2016, 2021) conceptualization and operationalization of party system institutionalization (PSI) – party system closure – as consequences, and using a mixed-methods approach, we provide the mechanisms of why institutional characteristics denoting presidential regimes have a detrimental impact on PSI. Our analysis of an original dataset of all Asian party systems, which spans more than 70 years from the aftermath of the World War II to the end of 2020, shows that (1) direct presidential elections, compared to regimes with no such elections, (2) presidentialism vis-à-vis parliamentary and semi-presidential regimes, and (3) a cabinet’s collective responsibility to the president, as opposed to such responsibility solely to the legislature, all have statistically significant and negative effects on PSI. Our case-study of Indonesia, which changed from parliamentarism to presidentialism in 2004, confirms all these three points. Given the greater chance of the rise of populist outsiders in presidential and president-parliamentary semi-presidential regimes, our findings that party systems are more inchoate and parties may become weaker in properly playing a gatekeeping role in these regimes are particularly concerning.
records.abstract_cn: 宪政体制类型对于民主巩固至关重要。然而，这些制度因素如何影响政党制度的发展却很少被研究。应用Casal Bértoa和Enyedi（2016，2021）政党制度制度化（PSI）的概念化和操作化——政党制度封闭——作为后果，并使用混合方法，我们提供了为什么表示总统政权的制度特征对PSI产生有害影响的机制。我们对所有亚洲政党制度的原始数据集进行了分析，时间跨度超过70年，从二战结束后到2020结束，结果表明，与没有这种选举的政权相比，(1)直接总统选举，(2)总统制相对于议会和半总统制政权，以及(3)内阁对总统的集体责任，而不是直接选举。仅由立法机关承担此类责任，所有这些都对 PSI 产生统计上显着的负面影响。我们对印度尼西亚的案例研究，在2004中从议会制转变为总统制，证实了所有这三点。鉴于民粹主义局外人在总统制和总统-议会半总统制政权中崛起的可能性更大，我们的发现尤其令人担忧，即政党制度更加不成熟，政党在这些政权中适当发挥把关作用的能力可能会减弱。

records.title_en: Trade agreements and sustainable fisheries
records.title_cn: 贸易协定与可持续渔业
records.abstract_en: This study examines the impact of trade agreements and their specific provisions on the sustainability of marine fisheries resources. Using global data on the Mean Trophic Level (MTL) between 1950 and 2018 and a comprehensive dataset of environmental provisions from trade agreements signed between 1947 and 2018, we estimate the impact on the MTL of signing (i) a free trade agreement and (ii) a free trade agreement including fishery-related provisions. To address potential endogeneity problems associated with fisheries-related provisions, we use a difference-in-differences (DID) propensity score matching method. Our results show that while trade agreements tend to negatively impact the MTL, including fisheries-related provisions offsets this negative impact among signatory countries. By examining the potential mechanisms underlying this result, we are able to temper the optimistic findings in the existing literature on the beneficial environmental outcomes of environmental provisions. Our findings suggest that these provisions do not foster the adoption of more effective resource management practices. Instead, they appear to reduce trade opportunities, which is contrary to the objective of trade creation in trade agreements.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了贸易协定及其具体条款对海洋渔业资源可持续性的影响。利用1950年至2018年间全球平均营养级（MTL）数据以及1947年至2018年间签署的贸易协定中环境条款的综合数据集，我们估计了签署（i）自由贸易协定和（ii）包含渔业相关条款的自由贸易协定对MTL的影响。为解决与渔业相关条款相关的潜在内生性问题，我们采用了双重差分（DID）倾向得分匹配方法。我们的结果表明，虽然贸易协定往往对MTL产生负面影响，但包含渔业相关条款在签署国之间抵消了这一负面影响。通过考察这一结果背后的潜在机制，我们能够缓和现有文献中关于环境条款有益环境结果的乐观发现。我们的研究结果表明，这些条款并未促进更有效的资源管理实践的采纳。相反，它们似乎减少了贸易机会，这与贸易协定中贸易创造的目标相悖。

records.title_en: Citizen science, mobile technology, and environmental justice in Africa: rights-based legal pathways for community empowerment
records.title_cn: 公民科学、移动技术与非洲环境正义：社区赋权的权利本位法律路径
records.abstract_en: This paper critically examines the legal potential of citizen science, enhanced by mobile technology, as a tool for advancing environmental justice and enforcing the right to a healthy environment in Africa. In light of widespread environmental degradation and weak regulatory capacity, it explores how citizen-generated environmental data can bridge accountability gaps in both formal governance systems and judicial processes. Drawing on African communitarian traditions, international environmental law, and comparative jurisprudence, including landmark cases from the US and Europe, it interrogates the evidentiary and procedural barriers that currently undermine the admissibility of citizen data in legal forums. The paper argues for comprehensive legal reform encompassing constitutional interpretation, legislative innovation, regulatory clarity and judicial openness to non-traditional evidence. By integrating citizen science into the legal architecture of environmental governance, African states can democratise environmental monitoring, empower marginalised communities and strengthen compliance with environmental obligations. The study contributes to emerging interdisciplinary discourse at the intersection of environmental law, human rights and digital technology in the Global South.
records.abstract_cn: 本文批判性地审视了公民科学（辅以移动技术）作为推进环境正义和实施健康环境权利工具的法律潜力，特别是在非洲背景下。鉴于广泛的环境退化和薄弱的监管能力，本文探讨了公民生成的环境数据如何在正式治理体系和司法程序中弥合问责缺口。借鉴非洲社群主义传统、国际环境法以及比较法理学（包括美国和欧洲的里程碑式案例），本文审视了当前在法庭上削弱公民数据可采性的证据和程序障碍。本文主张进行全面的法律改革，涵盖宪法解释、立法创新、监管清晰度以及对非传统证据的司法开放性。通过将公民科学融入环境治理的法律架构，非洲国家可以民主化环境监测、赋权边缘化社区并加强对环境义务的遵守。本研究为全球南方环境法、人权和数字技术交叉领域的新兴跨学科讨论做出了贡献。

records.title_en: Power and its discontents: The long road to systemic change in the aid sector
records.title_cn: 权力及其不满：援助部门系统性变革的漫长道路
records.abstract_en: Power inequalities between Northern and Southern NGOs have historically plagued development cooperation. A growing momentum towards localisation, locally-led development, and shift the power is indicative of widespread efforts to respond to these inequalities. Drawing upon new survey data, we explore the nature of specific actions taken by a sample of NNGOs and SNGOs to address these power inequalities and analyse the extent to which these equalize power. We find that organisations in our sample are taking important steps toward reconfiguring traditional power dynamics and fostering more collaborative and accountable relationships between Northern and Southern actors. Yet a deeper analysis of these raises questions around whether actions are deep enough to rebalance or upturn unequal relationships and contribute to broader systems change. We find that innovations within the aid system are making incremental improvements without fundamentally shifting where decision-making power and financial power lie. Significant to scholars and practitioners alike, these findings underscore the need for more substantive and systemic changes to achieve genuine equity in development cooperation.
records.abstract_cn: 北方与南方非政府组织之间的权力不平等历来困扰着发展合作。朝向本地化、本地主导发展和权力转移的日益增长势头，表明了对这些不平等现象的广泛回应努力。基于新的调查数据，我们探讨了一组北方非政府组织和南方非政府组织为解决这些权力不平等所采取的具体行动的性质，并分析了这些行动在多大程度上实现了权力平等化。我们发现，样本中的组织正在采取重要步骤，重新配置传统权力动态，并在北方和南方行动者之间培育更加协作和负责任的关系。然而，对这些行动的深入分析引发了疑问：这些行动是否足够深入，以重新平衡或颠覆不平等关系，并促进更广泛的系统变革。我们发现，援助体系内的创新正在带来渐进式的改进，但并未从根本上改变决策权和财政权的所在。对学者和实践者 alike 而言，这些发现强调了需要更实质性和系统性的变革，以实现发展合作中的真正公平。

records.title_en: Humor for health: a randomized controlled trial of clown visits in Palestinian hospitals
records.title_cn: 幽默促进健康：巴勒斯坦医院小丑探访的随机对照试验
records.abstract_en: Hospitalization can be a highly stressful experience for children, potentially affecting their well-being and recovery. This study evaluates the impact of hospital clown visits on pediatric patients in Palestine. The health system of the country is severely challenged by the ongoing conflict and sociopolitical tensions which have major implications for the physical and mental health of children and obstruct patients’ access to healthcare services. We conducted a randomized controlled trial (RCT) to estimate the effects of clown visits on caregiver-rated health outcomes: children’s well-being during hospitalization, subjective recovery, and perceptions of hospital quality. We find that clown visits had a statistically significant positive effect on children’s well-being with levels of well-being in the treatment group being 0.25 standard deviations higher than in the control group. The effect was stronger among children from higher socio-economic backgrounds and those with a favorable predisposition towards clowns. We found no significant effects on caregiver-rated subjective recovery or perceptions of hospital quality. Our findings suggest that low-cost, non-medical interventions can play a meaningful role in improving the hospital experience for children, particularly in fragile and conflict-affected settings.
records.abstract_cn: 住院对儿童来说可能是一种高度压力的经历，可能影响他们的福祉和康复。本研究评估了巴勒斯坦儿科患者中医院小丑探访的影响。该国的卫生系统正受到持续冲突和社会政治紧张局势的严重挑战，这些对儿童的身心健康产生重大影响，并阻碍患者获得医疗服务。我们进行了一项随机对照试验（RCT），以估计小丑探访对照顾者评定的健康结果的影响：住院期间儿童的福祉、主观恢复情况以及对医院质量的感知。我们发现，小丑探访对儿童福祉有统计学上显著的积极影响，治疗组的福祉水平比对照组高出0.25个标准差。这种影响在来自较高社会经济背景的儿童以及对小丑有积极倾向的儿童中更为显著。我们没有发现对照顾者评定的主观恢复或医院质量感知有显著影响。我们的研究结果表明，低成本、非医疗干预措施可以在改善儿童住院体验方面发挥重要作用，特别是在脆弱和受冲突影响的地区。

records.title_en: Genocide, women’s empowerment, and intergenerational transmission of violent attitudes
records.title_cn: 种族灭绝、女性赋权与暴力态度的代际传递
records.abstract_en: In this paper, we explore how mass violence shapes attitudes on violence against children, and we examine how these attitudes are transmitted across generations in the context of the Rwandan genocide. We exploit spatial variation in genocide intensity from the Gacaca records and temporal variation in women’s timing of socialization from three rounds of the Demographic and Health Surveys (DHS) in a difference-in-differences framework and find that younger women from regions more affected by genocide hold less violent attitudes compared to their peers from less-affected regions. Using an instrumental variable approach to estimate the transmission effect, we also show that descendants of these younger women from regions more affected by genocide are similarly less likely to develop violent attitudes. We provide evidence that genocide-induced women’s empowerment is the underlying mechanism. As such, our findings underscore previous evidence on the conflict–prosociality link by showing that mass violence can catalyze progressive norm change across generations, but also call for a more detailed investigation of the underlying adaptation mechanisms of the second generation.
records.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们探讨了大规模暴力如何影响对儿童暴力的态度，并考察了在卢旺达种族灭绝背景下这些态度如何跨代传递。我们利用加卡卡记录中种族灭绝强度的空间变异以及人口与健康调查（DHS）三轮数据中女性社会化时间的时序变异，采用双重差分框架，发现来自受种族灭绝影响更严重地区的年轻女性相比来自受影响较轻地区的同龄人持有更少的暴力态度。使用工具变量方法估计传递效应，我们还表明，这些来自受影响更严重地区的年轻女性的后代同样不太可能形成暴力态度。我们提供的证据表明，种族灭绝引发的女性赋权是潜在的机制。因此，我们的发现强调了先前关于冲突与亲社会性联系的研究，表明大规模暴力可以催化跨代的进步性规范变迁，但也呼吁对第二代潜在适应机制进行更详细的研究。

records.title_en: Empathy in action: unravelling crowdfunding dynamics for female refugee entrepreneurs in Lebanon, Jordan, and Palestine
records.title_cn: 行动中的共情：揭示黎巴嫩、约旦和巴勒斯坦女性难民创业者的众筹动态
records.abstract_en: Crowdfunding has become a vital tool for bridging funding gaps, particularly for marginalised groups such as women and refugee entrepreneurs. This study aims to investigate the impact of entrepreneur gender and sectorial dominance on crowdfunding outcomes for female and male refugees, using the lens of sector studies and Role Congruity Theory. To empirically test our hypotheses, we gathered data about refugee entrepreneurs who seek capital for their business ventures on the Kiva crowdfunded microfinance platform. Our research highlights the unique challenges faced by female refugee entrepreneurs, including discriminatory financing practices and lack of formal documentation. However, crowdfunding platforms like Kiva offer crucial financial access, outperforming traditional financial institutions. We found that female refugee entrepreneurs often outperform their male counterparts in crowdfunding, especially in male-dominated activities. Moreover, campaigns located in refugee camps show positive crowdfunding outcomes, emphasising the value of these settings for women-led initiatives. Overall, crowdfunding offers a promising alternative for female refugees, overcoming significant barriers to entrepreneurship in both refugee camps and broader contexts, as well as providing implications for enhancing financial inclusion and supporting gender equity in entrepreneurial spaces.
records.abstract_cn: 众筹已成为弥合资金缺口的重要工具，尤其对于女性和难民创业者等边缘化群体而言。本研究旨在通过行业研究和角色一致性理论的视角，探讨创业者性别和行业主导性对女性和男性难民众筹结果的影响。为实证检验我们的假设，我们收集了在Kiva众筹微型金融平台上寻求商业资本支持的难民创业者的数据。我们的研究强调了女性难民创业者面临的独特挑战，包括歧视性融资实践和缺乏正式文件。然而，像Kiva这样的众筹平台提供了关键的金融准入，表现优于传统金融机构。我们发现，女性难民创业者在众筹中往往优于男性同行，尤其是在男性主导的活动中。此外，位于难民营的活动显示出积极的众筹结果，强调了这些环境对女性主导倡议的价值。总体而言，众筹为女性难民提供了一种有前景的替代方案，克服了在难民营和更广泛背景下创业的重大障碍，并为增强金融包容性和支持创业领域的性别平等提供了启示。

records.title_en: Impact of climate change adaptation on welfare and child nutrition of farm households in rural Ethiopia: A panel data analysis
records.title_cn: 气候变化适应对埃塞俄比亚农村农户福利和儿童营养的影响：面板数据分析
records.abstract_en: This study evaluates the potential impact of adopting climate change adaptation practices on the welfare and child nutrition of farm households in Ethiopia. The study uses a balanced panel of household-level data from the Ethiopian Socioeconomic Survey of rural households conducted in 2013/2014 and again in 2015/2016. For household welfare, measures of real consumption expenditure per adult equivalent and a food shortage indicator are used. For child nutrition outcomes, weights for height and body mass index are considered. The potential selection bias introduced by including adoption decisions of climate change adaptation strategies and evaluating how these strategies impact household and child outcomes is addressed by applying a panel data multinomial endogenous switching regression model. The climate change adaptation practice sets considered are categorized as soil and water conservation (SW), crop rotation (CR), and improved inputs (IM), at times alone and also in various combinations. We present findings on what household characteristics make it more or less likely that households will adopt a particular adaptation practice set strategy. The results demonstrate that in many cases, adoption of climate change adaptation practices set is positively associated with improved household welfare and child nutrition outcomes. In addition we find that larger positive impacts are observed when farmers combine multiple complementary practice sets. Our findings imply that policies should encourage smallholder farmers to adopt multiple climate change adaptation practice sets to improve the status of households’ welfare and children’s nutrition.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究评估了在埃塞俄比亚采用气候变化适应实践对农户福利和儿童营养的潜在影响。研究使用了来自埃塞俄比亚农村住户社会经济调查的平衡面板数据，该调查分别于2013/2014和2015/2016进行。对于家庭福利，采用了实际消费支出（按成人等价单位计算）和食物短缺指标作为衡量标准。对于儿童营养结果，考虑了身高别体重和身体质量指数。通过应用面板数据多项内生转换回归模型，解决了因纳入气候变化适应策略的采用决策以及评估这些策略如何影响家庭和儿童结果而可能引入的选择偏差。考虑的气候变化适应实践集被分类为水土保持（SW）、轮作（CR）和改良投入（IM），有时单独采用，有时以不同组合采用。我们展示了哪些家庭特征使得家庭更可能或更不可能采用特定的适应实践集策略。结果表明，在许多情况下，采用气候变化适应实践集与改善家庭福利和儿童营养结果正相关。此外，我们发现当农民结合多种互补的实践集时，观察到更大的积极影响。我们的发现意味着政策应鼓励小农采用多种气候变化适应实践集，以改善家庭福利和儿童营养状况。

records.title_en: Catastrophe’s long reach: How historical natural disasters shape modern entrepreneurship?
records.title_cn: 灾难的深远影响：历史自然灾害如何塑造现代创业精神？
records.abstract_en: The interaction between historical adversity and the evolution of culture traits can leave a long-lasting imprint on contemporary economic outcomes. This paper investigates the enduring impact of historical natural disasters during China’s Ming and Qing dynasties on modern entrepreneurship. We find that individuals originating from regions with higher density of historical natural disasters show a reduced inclination towards entrepreneurship, which could be attributed to the negative effects of historical disasters on the risk-taking attitude, cultivation of interpersonal trust, and human capital investment. These results remain consistent after utilizing both the regression discontinuity method and IV approach to address endogeneity concerns. Overall, these insights not only highlight the persistent historical legacy in shaping the spirit of modern entrepreneurial endeavors, but also shed light on the broader, long-term economic impacts of climate change.
records.abstract_cn: 历史逆境与文化特质演变之间的相互作用，可以对当代经济结果留下持久的印记。本文研究了中国明清时期历史自然灾害对现代创业精神的持久影响。我们发现，来自历史自然灾害密度较高地区的个体，其创业倾向较低，这可归因于历史灾害对风险承担态度、人际信任培养及人力资本投资的负面影响。在采用回归断点方法和工具变量法处理内生性问题后，这些结果依然稳健。总体而言，这些见解不仅突显了历史遗产在塑造现代创业精神中的持久作用，也揭示了气候变化更广泛、长期的经济影响。

records.title_en: Policies for aspirations. And opportunities
records.title_cn: 关于抱负与机会的政策
records.abstract_en: Policy interventions designed to enhance aspirations, using strategies such as exposure to role models, are increasingly implemented to help students, women, microentrepreneurs, farmers, and poor individuals access untapped opportunities. Many of these interventions were successful, but various others failed to generate meaningful changes or even worsened beneficiaries’ situation. This paper argues that policies aimed at raising aspirations cannot be designed or assessed in isolation from the opportunities individuals face. We propose a simple framework that jointly considers aspirations (people’s life goals for education, work, social status, and more) and opportunities (the resources, markets, and support that make those goals attainable). The framework highlights four scenarios — alignment, poverty traps, aspirations traps, and frustration — and clarifies how misalignment between aspirations and opportunities can lead to underinvestment and welfare losses. We then conduct a narrative review of policy interventions that target aspirations, opportunities, or both. Interventions that deliberately combine aspiration and opportunity-enhancing components, or that target one dimension in settings where the other is credibly sufficient, are more likely to generate sustained gains in outcomes. By contrast, aspiration-only or opportunity-only interventions often show mixed or null effects and can, in some cases, increase frustration. We discuss practical lessons for policy in light of these conclusions.
records.abstract_cn: 旨在提升抱负的政策干预，例如通过接触榜样等策略，越来越多地被用于帮助学生、女性、微型企业家、农民和贫困个体获取未开发的机会。许多此类干预取得了成功，但其他各种干预未能产生有意义的改变，甚至恶化了受益者的处境。本文认为，旨在提升抱负的政策不能脱离个体所面临的机会来单独设计或评估。我们提出了一个简单框架，该框架同时考虑抱负（人们对于教育、工作、社会地位等方面的生活目标）和机会（使这些目标得以实现的资源、市场和支持）。该框架突出了四种情景——一致性、贫困陷阱、抱负陷阱和挫败感——并阐明了抱负与机会之间的错位如何导致投资不足和福利损失。随后，我们对针对抱负、机会或两者的政策干预进行了叙述性综述。那些有意结合提升抱负和增强机会组成部分的干预，或在其他维度可信地充足的情况下针对某一维度的干预，更有可能在结果上产生持续收益。相比之下，仅针对抱负或仅针对机会的干预往往显示出混合或无效的效果，并且在某些情况下可能增加挫败感。我们根据这些结论讨论了政策的实际经验教训。

records.title_en: DEVELOPMENT AS EQUALITY: A gender lens on progress and its hidden barriers
records.title_cn: 发展即平等：从性别角度看待进步及其隐藏的障碍
records.abstract_en: Progress towards gender equality − economically, socially and politically − is a key measure of development, as well as a means of achieving it. This essay traces both the advances made (theoretical, empirical and in policy) in reducing gender inequality since the mid-1970s, when it was recognised internationally in development discourse, and the limits to that progress, given the persistence of gender inequality in most forms today. It is argued here that underlying visible measures of inequality, such as in women’s property ownership, labour market outcomes, and the governance of public institutions are hidden inequalities, embedded in biased social norms, social perceptions, and the social legitimacy of claims. Tackling these hidden barriers and their visible outcomes will require charting unconventional pathways, in particular shifting away from the dominant individualistic approaches to development to group approaches and collective action as necessary components for change.
records.abstract_cn: 在经济、社会和政治方面实现性别平等的进展是发展的关键衡量标准，也是实现发展的手段。本文追溯了自1970中期以来在减少性别不平等方面取得的进展（理论、经验和政策），当时性别不平等在发展话语中得到国际认可，以及鉴于当今大多数形式的性别不平等持续存在，这一进展的局限性。这里有人认为，潜在的可见的不平等衡量标准，例如妇女的财产所有权、劳动力市场结果和公共机构的治理，是隐藏的不平等，嵌入在有偏见的社会规范、社会观念和主张的社会合法性中。解决这些隐藏的障碍及其可见的结果将需要制定非常规的路径，特别是从占主导地位的个人主义发展方法转向群体方法和集体行动作为变革的必要组成部分。

records.title_en: Clientelist politics in Nigeria: Core voters, control and compliance
records.title_cn: 尼日利亚的庇护政治：核心选民、控制与服从
records.abstract_en: Clientelismis a defining feature of electoral politics in Nigeria, where political parties prioritize clientelist transfers to core supporters over transfers to swing voters or public goods appeals.What sustains these clientelist partisan pacts?Why are core voters more intensively targeted by clientelist transfers? Drawing on original survey data and key informant interviews, this article shows that core voters possess attributes that make them especially attractive to clientelist parties seeking to reduce defection risks. First, they are more deeply embedded in social networks on which parties can rely to gather information on their preferences and electoral behavior. Second, they are more likely to rely on their networks for voting advice or information. Third, they are more likely toperceivethat the party can monitor their votes. And finally, they are more likely to comply with the clientelist bargain. This makes them in effect a safer bet for clientelist investments. In that context, clientelist targeting leads parties to sustain a core-support group of reliable votes delivery, rather than expand distributive promises to non-core voters. The findings highlight the impotance of voter-level attributes – particularly social network embeddedness – in shaping clientelist targeting and sustaining clientelist partisan pacts.
records.abstract_cn: 庇护主义是尼日利亚选举政治的一个决定性特征，政党优先考虑对核心支持者的庇护性转移，而非对摇摆选民的转移或公共物品诉求。是什么维持了这些庇护性的党派契约？为什么核心选民更受到庇护性转移的密集针对？基于原始调查数据和关键知情人访谈，本文表明，核心选民具备使其对寻求减少叛逃风险的庇护政党特别有吸引力的属性。首先，他们更深入地嵌入在社交网络中，政党可以依赖这些网络来收集关于其偏好和选举行为的信息。其次，他们更可能依赖其网络获取投票建议或信息。第三，他们更可能感知到政党能够监控其投票。最后，他们更可能遵守庇护性交易。这使得他们实际上成为庇护投资的更安全选择。在这种背景下，庇护性针对导致政党维持一个可靠投票交付的核心支持群体，而不是将分配承诺扩展到非核心选民。研究结果强调了选民层面属性——特别是社交网络嵌入性——在塑造庇护性针对和维持庇护性党派契约中的重要性。

records.title_en: Populism and global infrastructure investment
records.title_cn: 民粹主义与全球基础设施投资
records.abstract_en: Populism has surged globally amid increasing globalization and political polarization. This study examines the divergent effects of left-wing and right-wing populist governments on infrastructure investment. Using panel data from 59 countries between 1990 and 2019, we find that left-wing populist governments significantly reduce infrastructure investment, while right-wing populist governments do not exhibit a similar impact. Mechanism analysis reveals that left-wing populist governments impair infrastructure investment by weakening legal institutions and deteriorating market governance institutions, whereas right-wing populist governments do not have such effects. Furthermore, the negative effects of left populism are particularly pronounced in three types of countries: those with multi-chamber parliamentary systems, those classified as low-income economies, and those with higher debt-to-GDP ratios. This research enriches the understanding of the economic consequences of populism and the lasting impacts of populist policies on infrastructure development, and contributes to the ongoing debate on the complex relationship between populism and economic outcomes.
records.abstract_cn: 在全球化和政治极化加剧的背景下，民粹主义在全球范围内兴起。本研究考察了左翼和右翼民粹主义政府对基础设施投资的不同影响。利用1990年至2019年间59个国家的面板数据，我们发现左翼民粹主义政府显著减少了基础设施投资，而右翼民粹主义政府则未表现出类似影响。机制分析揭示，左翼民粹主义政府通过削弱法律制度和恶化市场治理制度来损害基础设施投资，而右翼民粹主义政府则无此类效应。此外，左翼民粹主义的负面影响在三种类型的国家中尤为显著：多议院议会制国家、被归类为低收入经济体的国家以及债务占GDP比率较高的国家。本研究丰富了关于民粹主义经济后果及民粹主义政策对基础设施发展持久影响的理解，并有助于当前关于民粹主义与经济结果之间复杂关系的辩论。

records.title_en: Government data accessibility and firm dynamics: Encouraging entrepreneurship or accelerating exit?
records.title_cn: 政府数据可及性与企业动态：鼓励创业还是加速退出？
records.abstract_en: Data monopolies erode a firm’s competitive vitality and threaten the sustainable growth of developing economies. Open government data (OGD) provides a crucial supplementary channel for firms to fairly access data resources. However, past work knows little about how OGD reshapes firm dynamics (firm entry and firm exit). To investigate this, we employ a difference-in-differences model on a comprehensive dataset of high-precision firm registry and OGD launch data. This method leverages the staggered adoption of OGD platforms across Chinese cities, allowing us to isolate the causal effect on firm dynamics. Our findings evidence that while OGD accelerates firm entry, it also triggers risks of firm exit and declining survival rates. Improving the public data support level, especially the quantity and scope of datasets, will effectively mitigate the adverse effects. In terms of data utilization, we emphasize that insufficient algorithmic reserve capacity will accelerate firm exit, while, conversely, entrepreneurship benefits from high reserves in algorithms and computing power. Moreover, we evidence that OGD’s impact on firm dynamics is related to firm scale, industry, and operational models. Grounded in dynamic capability theory, we reveal that digital talent reserves, productivity, and information friction costs are the underlying mechanisms of OGD’s impact on firm dynamics. Nevertheless, we demonstrate that OGD has promoted the allocation of digital talent in non-digital sectors, increased average wages, but at the cost of greater labor displacement. Our findings provide new insights for emerging economies to enhance market competitive vitality through developing public data, while also highlighting the risks of OGD in accelerating the exit of vulnerable firms and unemployment.
records.abstract_cn: 数据垄断侵蚀企业的竞争活力，并威胁发展中经济体的可持续增长。开放政府数据（OGD）为企业公平获取数据资源提供了重要的补充渠道。然而，以往研究对OGD如何重塑企业动态（企业进入和企业退出）知之甚少。为探究此问题，我们采用双重差分模型，基于高精度企业注册数据和OGD启动数据的综合数据集进行分析。该方法利用中国各城市OGD平台分阶段采用的特性，使我们能够隔离对企业动态的因果效应。我们的研究结果表明，虽然OGD加速了企业进入，但也引发了企业退出和存活率下降的风险。提高公共数据支持水平，尤其是数据集的数量和范围，将有效缓解不利影响。在数据利用方面，我们强调算法储备能力不足将加速企业退出，而相反，创业活动则受益于算法和计算能力的高储备。此外，我们证明OGD对企业动态的影响与企业规模、行业和运营模式相关。基于动态能力理论，我们揭示数字人才储备、生产率和信息摩擦成本是OGD影响企业动态的潜在机制。尽管如此，我们证明OGD促进了非数字部门数字人才的配置，提高了平均工资，但代价是更大的劳动力替代。我们的发现为新兴经济体通过发展公共数据增强市场竞争活力提供了新见解，同时也强调了OGD在加速脆弱企业退出和失业方面的风险。

records.title_en: Restricting mothers’ international migration and human capital investment
records.title_cn: 限制母亲国际迁移与人力资本投资
records.abstract_en: International migration offers significant economic opportunities for developing countries, but it can also separate parents from their children, potentially harming child development. This paper examines the effects of restricting mothers’ international migration on left-behind children, leveraging a unique Sri Lankan policy that restricted mothers with children under age five from migrating abroad for employment. Using a difference-in-differences approach, the results reveal the following: First, the policy reduces international migration, increasing mothers’ presence at home. Second, policy exposure leads to better healthcare outcomes, including a significant reduction in inpatient stays, particularly treatment for illnesses. This improvement appears to result from increased childcare and monitoring by mothers. Although the policy decreases remittances from abroad, this reduction is offset by an increase in domestic remittances. Furthermore, we find evidence of positive spillovers on non-targeted children with younger, policy-targeted siblings, as indicated by reduced grade retention. These findings highlight the trade-offs between a mother’s presence and the economic opportunities associated with international migration in shaping human capital development.
records.abstract_cn: 国际迁移为发展中国家提供了显著的经济机会，但也可能使父母与子女分离，潜在地损害儿童发展。本文利用斯里兰卡一项独特的政策，该政策限制有五岁以下子女的母亲出国就业，考察了限制母亲国际迁移对留守儿童的影响。采用双重差分方法，结果揭示如下：第一，该政策减少了国际迁移，增加了母亲在家的陪伴时间。第二，政策暴露带来了更好的医疗保健结果，包括住院次数显著减少，尤其是疾病治疗。这一改善似乎源于母亲增加的儿童照护和监督。尽管该政策减少了来自国外的汇款，但这一减少被国内汇款的增加所抵消。此外，我们发现有证据表明，对拥有年龄较小的政策目标兄弟姐妹的非目标儿童存在正向溢出效应，表现为留级率降低。这些发现凸显了母亲在场与国际迁移带来的经济机会在塑造人力资本发展中的权衡。

records.title_en: Does free maternity care improve uptake and save lives? Quasi-experimental evidence from Kenya
records.title_cn: 免费孕产妇保健能否提高利用率并挽救生命？来自肯尼亚的准实验证据
records.abstract_en: Many assume that user-fees deter healthcare-seeking in low- and middle-income countries and are therefore partially responsible for high mortality rates. This paper estimates the causal effect of a national user-fee removal programme in Kenya on healthcare seeking and mortality, using a difference-in-differences design exploiting variation in treatment intensity across local communities. Results indicate a small increase in the uptake of antenatal care but no average effects on facility delivery, mortality or the quality of healthcare. Several potential mechanisms are examined and findings suggest heterogeneous treatment effects based on the physical accessibility of care as well as community-level preferences regarding household decision-making.
records.abstract_cn: 许多人认为，在低收入和中等收入国家，使用费会阻碍人们寻求医疗保健，因此部分导致了高死亡率。本文利用双重差分设计，利用地方社区间治疗强度的差异，估计了肯尼亚一项全国性取消使用费项目对医疗保健寻求行为和死亡率的因果效应。结果显示，产前保健利用率略有增加，但对设施分娩、死亡率或医疗保健质量没有平均效应。研究考察了几种可能的机制，发现治疗效果因医疗服务的物理可及性以及社区层面关于家庭决策的偏好而异。

records.title_en: The long shadow of natural disasters: educational impacts of the 1991 cyclone in Bangladesh
records.title_cn: 自然灾害的长期阴影：1991年孟加拉国气旋对教育的影响
records.abstract_en: Using the 1991 cyclone in Bangladesh as a natural experiment, this paper examines the long-term educational impacts of early-life disaster exposure. We employ a differences-in-differences approach with data from the 2019 Multiple Indicator Cluster Survey to compare educational outcomes between disaster-affected and unaffected districts across birth cohorts with varying exposure timing. The results reveal substantial and persistent negative effects of early-life cyclone exposure on educational attainment. Children exposed during critical early developmental periods (ages 0–3) experience approximately one year reduction in completed schooling, with secondary completion falling by 12–19 percentage points and higher secondary completion by 10–17 percentage points. Mechanism analysis reveals economic hardship as the primary transmission channel, operating through household budget constraints that force reductions in educational investment. Infrastructure damage creates additional barriers through reduced access, while maternal psychological stress extends impacts to post-disaster birth cohorts. Disaster impacts exacerbate existing inequalities: girls experience roughly double the educational losses of boys, while rural populations face consistently larger impacts. The concentration of effects at secondary and higher secondary education levels suggests that disasters may perpetuate intergenerational poverty by blocking access to the formal labor market, where secondary education is often the minimum requirement. Robustness checks, including threats to identification and placebo tests, confirmed that these results reflected a genuine impact of the cyclone rather than coincidental patterns. These findings are urgent given projected increases in extreme weather frequency under climate change, providing strong justification for integrating disaster resilience into human capital development strategies in vulnerable developing countries.
records.abstract_cn: 利用1991年孟加拉国气旋作为自然实验，本文考察了生命早期遭受灾害对教育的长期影响。我们采用双重差分方法，使用2019年多指标类集调查数据，比较不同出生队列在暴露时间不同的受灾与非受灾地区的教育成果。结果显示，生命早期遭受气旋对教育程度产生了显著且持续的负面影响。在关键早期发展阶段（0-3岁）暴露的儿童，完成学业年限大约减少一年，中学完成率下降12-19个百分点，高中以上完成率下降10-17个百分点。机制分析揭示经济困难是主要传导渠道，通过家庭预算约束迫使教育投资减少。基础设施损坏通过减少入学机会造成额外障碍，而母亲的心理压力将影响扩展到灾后出生队列。灾害影响加剧了现有不平等：女孩的教育损失约为男孩的两倍，而农村人口持续面临更大的影响。影响集中在中学和高中以上教育水平，表明灾害可能通过阻断进入正规劳动力市场（中学教育通常是最低要求）而使代际贫困长期化。稳健性检验，包括对识别威胁的检验和安慰剂测试，确认这些结果反映了气旋的真实影响而非巧合模式。鉴于气候变化下极端天气频率预计增加，这些发现具有紧迫性，为将灾害韧性纳入脆弱发展中国家的人力资本发展战略提供了有力依据。

records.title_en: The defanging effect of education and autocratic survival
records.title_cn: 教育的去牙化效应与专制政权的存续
records.abstract_en: The modernisation theory of regime change is often perceived to be a murky paradigm, lacking theoretical or empirical foundations. In response, we clarify the links between education and regime change. More specifically, we propose that education contributes indirectly to the collapse of autocratic regimes because educated people engage in non-violent (civil) resistance that reduces the effectiveness of the security apparatus. We empirically test the validity of this ‘defanging effect’ of education. We indeed find that the combination of high autocracy and high education levels tends to trigger non-violent campaigns, which in turn increases the likelihood of a regime change, likely to be associated with political liberalisation.
records.abstract_cn: 现代化理论关于政权更迭的观点常被视为一个模糊的范式，缺乏理论和实证基础。对此，我们澄清了教育与政权更迭之间的联系。更具体地说，我们提出教育间接促进专制政权的崩溃，因为受教育者参与非暴力（公民）抵抗，这降低了安全机构的效能。我们实证检验了这种教育的“去牙化效应”的有效性。我们确实发现，高度专制与高教育水平的结合往往引发非暴力运动，这反过来增加了政权更迭的可能性，且这种更迭可能伴随政治自由化。

records.title_en: Labor law and workplace injuries
records.title_cn: 劳动法与工伤
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the effect of the Law of Employer Criminal Liability in Uruguay, which criminalizes workplace safety violations. Using detailed data on reported workplace injuries, we employ a Regression Discontinuity in Time design to identify the causal effect of the law. Following the adoption of the law, Uruguay experienced a significant 23 % reduction in reported workplace injuries, with the most pronounced reduction occurring in the industrial and primary sectors. We attribute these results to the law’s deterrent effect rather than to increased prosecutions, as only two employers were convicted under the new legislation. Our findings demonstrate the potential of punitive approaches to enhance workplace safety even in contexts where proactive enforcement is challenging or costly. In addition, they show that laws establishing greater employer liability can significantly reduce injuries without imposing additional administrative burdens.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了乌拉圭《雇主刑事责任法》的效果，该法将工作场所安全违规行为定为犯罪。利用详细的工伤报告数据，我们采用时间断点回归设计来识别该法的因果效应。该法通过后，乌拉圭报告的工伤数量显著减少了23%，其中工业和初级部门的减少最为明显。我们将这些结果归因于法律的威慑效应，而非起诉增加，因为在新立法下仅有两位雇主被定罪。我们的研究结果表明，即使在主动执法具有挑战性或成本高昂的环境中，惩罚性方法也能增强工作场所安全。此外，它们表明，确立更大雇主责任的法律可以在不增加额外行政负担的情况下显著减少工伤。

records.title_en: Using spatial data to identify food accessibility in large African cities
records.title_cn: 利用空间数据识别非洲大城市中的食物可及性
records.abstract_en: Current food security metrics are poorly suited to evaluate urban food security in Africa because they do not capture important spatial dimensions of food accessibility. The spatial dimensions of food accessibility are related to the interaction between changes in individual entitlements, or the ability to acquire food, and the availability of and accessibility to different forms of food-related infrastructure. The unavailability or periodicity of food security data, and high cost of collecting on-the-ground data, further complicates our ability to measure urban food security in rapidly growing urban areas. Leveraging and integrating spatial data on food retailer distribution, public transportation and road networks, population density, and access to electricity (nighttime lights) can provide sub-residential area scale insights into urban food accessibility and food environments − the areas where individuals acquire and consume food. We integrate a food access measure with a poverty index derived from remotely sensed data to empirically demonstrate spatial food access variability across food environments in Lusaka, Zambia. This novel spatial approach identifies areas of low food access and high poverty at a sub-residential area scale, highlighting areas that are most vulnerable to food insecurity. This method can be applied to other urban contexts to improve intervention targeting by policymakers and development practitioners. We demonstrate that highlighting the role of the spatial dimensions of food accessibility emphasizes the interaction between city planning and infrastructure, which contributes to the food environment, while also providing a means of understanding the spatial and systemic conditions that contribute to or hinder urban food security.
records.abstract_cn: 当前的粮食安全指标并不适合评估非洲的城市粮食安全，因为它们未能捕捉食物可及性的重要空间维度。食物可及性的空间维度与个人权利变化（即获取食物的能力）以及不同类型食物相关基础设施的可用性和可及性之间的相互作用有关。粮食安全数据的不可获得性或周期性，以及实地数据收集的高成本，进一步复杂化了我们在快速增长的城区衡量城市粮食安全的能力。利用并整合关于食品零售商分布、公共交通和道路网络、人口密度以及电力获取（夜间灯光）的空间数据，可以提供亚住宅区尺度上对城市食物可及性和食物环境的洞察——即个人获取和消费食物的区域。我们将一种食物可及性度量与从遥感数据中得出的贫困指数相结合，以实证展示赞比亚卢萨卡不同食物环境中食物可及性的空间变异性。这种新颖的空间方法在亚住宅区尺度上识别出低食物可及性和高贫困的区域，突出显示最易受粮食不安全影响的区域。该方法可应用于其他城市背景，以改善政策制定者和发展从业者的干预目标定位。我们证明，强调食物可及性空间维度的作用，突出了城市规划与基础设施之间的相互作用，这有助于食物环境的形成，同时也提供了一种理解促成或阻碍城市粮食安全的空间和系统性条件的手段。

records.title_en: Resilience of what and for whom? Climate change mitigation and adaptation in the global, Ethiopian, and Tanzanian coffee sectors
records.title_cn: 什么是韧性，为谁而韧性？全球、埃塞俄比亚和坦桑尼亚咖啡行业的气候变化减缓和适应
records.abstract_en: Rapid climate change is making climate resilience a key concern in the agricultural sector. Yet, in practice, efforts to support resilience are often vague about ultimate goals, as well as which systems and perturbations need to be considered to achieve key objectives. This article presents a multi-scalar climate resilience framework that distinguishes between resilience at the sectoral, country, community, and household scale involved in coffee production. We then apply the framework by comparing the ambitions of climate resilience approaches pursued by companies and global development agencies with strategies driven by producing country institutions and coffee farming communities. We triangulate evidence from a novel dataset documenting climate-resilience interventions in the global coffee sector with original survey, interview, and focus group discussion data from fieldwork in Tanzania and Ethiopia. We find that interventions originating in importing countries primarily focus on ensuring continued coffee production in service of sectoral resilience, and rarely foreground alternative livelihood strategies that would benefit household-level resilience. Activities led by origin countries focus on productivity and quality improvements, but rarely center on climate resilience. Farmers themselves, while strongly valuing coffee as a livelihood strategy, highlight the need for diversification and pragmatic adjustments in the face of growing climate threats. We conclude that there is a need for more farmer-centric climate change interventions that strengthen not only absorptive and adaptive, but also transformative capacities.
records.abstract_cn: 快速的气候变化使气候适应能力成为农业部门的一个关键问题。然而，在实践中，支持复原力的努力往往对​​最终目标以及需要考虑哪些系统和扰动以实现关键目标含糊不清。本文提出了一个多尺度气候复原力框架，该框架区分了咖啡生产涉及的部门、国家、社区和家庭规模的复原力。然后，我们通过比较公司和全球发展机构所追求的气候适应方法的雄心与生产国机构和咖啡种植社区推动的战略来应用该框架。我们利用来自坦桑尼亚和埃塞俄比亚实地考察的原始调查、访谈和焦点小组讨论数据，对记录全球咖啡行业气候适应力干预措施的新数据集的证据进行三角测量。我们发现，源自进口国的干预措施主要侧重于确保咖啡的持续生产，以服务于部门复原力，而很少强调有利于家庭层面复原力的替代生计战略。原籍国主导的活动侧重于生产力和质量的提高，但很少关注气候适应能力。农民本身虽然高度重视咖啡作为一种生计策略，但强调面对日益严重的气候威胁，需要进行多样化和务实调整。我们的结论是，需要采取更多以农民为中心的气候变化干预措施，不仅加强吸收和适应能力，而且加强变革能力。

records.title_en: The dual role of small-scale fisheries on food security and poverty eradication in Vietnam: A latent profile analysis
records.title_cn: 小规模渔业在越南粮食安全和消除贫困中的双重作用：潜在剖面分析
records.abstract_en: Small-scale fisheries are crucial for supporting the welfare of coastal communities. Nonetheless, in Vietnam prolonged overexploitation and inadequate management have led small-scale fisheries into an uncertain future, leaving fishing households vulnerable to poverty and food insecurity. This study examines the role of small-scale fisheries in Vietnam in promoting food security and alleviating poverty within fishing households. Utilizing latent profile analysis, we categorize fishing households based on dimensions of poverty and food insecurity as well as explore the potential of fisheries management measures in eradicating poverty and improving food security. Our findings reveal that, small-scale fisheries in Vietnam have significantly contributed to the well-being of fishing households, enhancing both income and food security. However, we identify two distinct groups of fishers. One group, representing 65 percent of households in our sample, is characterized by higher incomes and greater food security, is denoted in the study as “protected households”. The second group, comprising 35 percent of our sample, faces challenges in both dimensions, and is denoted as “vulnerable households”. Protected households are more likely to be located in areas where access limitations are enforced, often accompanied by livelihood enhancement opportunities. These results suggest that future policies for small-scale fisheries could benefit from developing synergies among various interventions targeting the conservation of fisheries resources, poverty alleviation, and food security.
records.abstract_cn: 小规模渔业对于支持沿海社区的福祉至关重要。然而，在越南，长期的过度捕捞和管理不善已使小规模渔业陷入不确定的未来，使渔业家庭面临贫困和粮食不安全的风险。本研究考察了越南小规模渔业在促进渔业家庭粮食安全和减轻贫困方面的作用。利用潜在剖面分析，我们根据贫困和粮食不安全的维度对渔业家庭进行分类，并探讨渔业管理措施在消除贫困和改善粮食安全方面的潜力。我们的研究结果显示，越南的小规模渔业显著促进了渔业家庭的福祉，提高了收入和粮食安全。然而，我们识别出两类不同的渔民群体。一个群体，占我们样本中家庭的65%，以较高的收入和更大的粮食安全为特征，在研究中被标记为“受保护家庭”。第二个群体，占我们样本的35%，在这两个维度上面临挑战，被标记为“脆弱家庭”。受保护家庭更可能位于实施准入限制的地区，这些地区通常伴随着生计改善机会。这些结果表明，未来针对小规模渔业政策可能受益于制定各种干预措施之间的协同作用，这些干预措施旨在保护渔业资源、减轻贫困和保障粮食安全。

records.title_en: Contested forests: how transnational networks mitigate and reproduce conflict
records.title_cn: 争议森林：跨国网络如何缓解与再生产冲突
records.abstract_en: This article examines how transnational networks, through their interactions with legal and societal structures, both mitigate and exacerbate forest conflicts, which often stem from competing interests over forest use, unclear property rights, deforestation, and state policy. Foregrounding the central thesis that strengthening legal frameworks and empowerment mechanisms can significantly enhance the conflict-resolution potential of transnational networks, the paper adopts a reframed socio-legal analytical approach that investigates the interplay between societal norms, power asymmetries, and institutional arrangements. We first examine the structural drivers and embedded nature of forest conflict, before exploring the dual role played by transnational networks in both aggravating and resolving tensions. The paper then assesses how power imbalances, environmental safeguards, and participatory mechanisms affect network efficacy. By critically examining case examples such as REDD+, FSC, and IPLC advocacy alliances, we show that while transnational networks hold promise in democratizing forest governance, their potential is contingent upon inclusive structures, balanced power dynamics, and enforceable safeguards. This article contributes to forest governance literature by offering a nuanced understanding of how legal empowerment and network-based governance intersect in conflict-prone settings.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了跨国网络如何通过与法律和社会结构的互动，既缓解又加剧森林冲突，这些冲突往往源于森林利用的竞争利益、产权不清、森林砍伐和国家政策。文章突出核心论点，即加强法律框架和赋权机制可以显著提升跨国网络解决冲突的潜力，采用重新框架的社会-法律分析方法，探讨社会规范、权力不对称和制度安排之间的相互作用。我们首先考察森林冲突的结构性驱动因素及其嵌入性，然后探讨跨国网络在加剧和解决紧张局势中的双重角色。随后，文章评估权力不平衡、环境保障和参与机制如何影响网络效能。通过批判性审视诸如REDD+、FSC和IPLC倡导联盟等案例，我们表明，尽管跨国网络在民主化森林治理方面具有前景，但其潜力取决于包容性结构、平衡的权力动态和可执行的保障措施。本文通过提供对法律赋权和基于网络的治理在冲突易发环境中如何交叉的细致理解，为森林治理文献做出贡献。

records.title_en: Barriers or catalysts? Traditional institutions and social mobility in rural India
records.title_cn: 障碍还是催化剂？传统制度与印度农村的社会流动性
records.abstract_en: We examine how village-level social group dominance affects the educational and occupational mobility of minority and other social groups in rural India across multiple generations. Theoretically, we distinguish between upper caste and own group dominance and examine the mechanisms underpinning inequality in mobility outcomes. We find inequality in upward educational mobility to have significantly narrowed over time. Scheduled Castes (SCs) have higher educational mobility in upper caste and own dominated villages, while Scheduled Tribes (STs) and Muslims perform worse in own dominated villages. In contrast, for occupational mobility, we find that Muslims used to be on par with upper castes but have experienced setbacks in the recent generation. There is no evidence of other minority groups catching up with upper castes while SCs and STs are particularly disadvantaged. SCs, once more, perform better in their own dominated villages. Exploring mechanisms that explain the relationships between land dominance regimes and intergenerational mobility, we find notable inequalities in the provision of a wide range of public goods with Muslim and ST dominated villages being particularly disadvantaged. We find location in unfavorable agroecological zones, village infrastructure, and social cohesion to be pathways through which upper caste and own group dominance affect the educational and occupational mobility of minority groups. Our findings suggest that traditional institutions can be both a barrier to or catalyst for social mobility, depending on the social identity of the dominant group in the village.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考察了村庄层面的社会群体主导地位如何影响印度农村少数群体及其他社会群体跨代的教育和职业流动性。理论上，我们区分了上层种姓主导和本群体主导，并考察了流动性结果不平等的潜在机制。我们发现，向上教育流动的不平等随时间显著缩小。在表列种姓（SCs）中，他们在上层种姓主导和本群体主导的村庄中具有更高的教育流动性，而表列部落（STs）和穆斯林在本群体主导的村庄中表现较差。相反，对于职业流动性，我们发现穆斯林曾与上层种姓持平，但在最近一代中遭遇挫折。没有证据表明其他少数群体正在追赶上层种姓，而SCs和STs尤其处于不利地位。SCs再次在本群体主导的村庄中表现更好。通过探索解释土地主导制度与代际流动性之间关系的机制，我们发现公共物品供给存在显著不平等，其中穆斯林和ST主导的村庄尤其处于不利地位。我们发现，不利的农业生态区域位置、村庄基础设施和社会凝聚力是上层种姓和本群体主导影响少数群体教育和职业流动性的途径。我们的研究结果表明，传统制度既可能是社会流动性的障碍，也可能是催化剂，这取决于村庄中主导群体的社会身份。

records.title_en: Settlements as dispossession: Forest conservation and frontiers’ violence in Mau Forest, Kenya
records.title_cn: 作为剥夺的定居：肯尼亚茅森林的保护与边疆暴力
records.abstract_en: State-run forest conservation in the postcolony often comes with various forms of violence and dispossession of local populations. In this article we investigate how conservation policies and practices relate to intercommunal conflict among forest residents. We look at the case of evictions of forest residents and intercommunal clashes in the Mau Forest area, Kenya, in the years following 2018, in conjunction with a long-durée perspective on land conflicts in the region. While political ecology literature on “green grabbing” and “slow violence” of conservation has so far hardly addressed ‘second-order’ impacts of forest evictions on group conflicts, we find political ecology fruitful as a theoretical framework to understand the links between state evictions and intercommunal conflicts. Using archival research and qualitative interviews conducted between 2018 and 2023, combined with ACLED conflict data (1997–2022), the authors show how colonial and postcolonial land policies, including attempts to conserve or rehabilitate Mau Forest, fostered dispossession, contributing to today’s violence. Past research tends to attribute intercommunal violence in Kenya to elections or resource competition, but this article explores deeper mechanisms tied to land reforms and settlement schemes that fuel identity-based conflicts. In areas like East Mau (Nakuru) and Maasai Mau (Narok), socioecological shifts—such as agricultural expansion—, coupled with population growth and unclear forest boundaries, intensified tensions. These transformations have commodified landscapes, producing new frontiers of conflict and exclusion. The results are significant for forest conservation and climate finance projects because they show how the impacts of contemporary conservation enforcement practices combine with long-durée impacts of both “brute” and “slow” violence to fuel intercommunal conflicts.
records.abstract_cn: 后殖民国家主导的森林保护往往伴随着各种形式的暴力和对当地居民的剥夺。在本文中，我们调查保护政策与实践如何与森林居民间的族群冲突相关联。我们以肯尼亚茅森林地区在2018年之后的几年中发生的森林居民驱逐和族群间冲突为案例，并结合对该地区土地冲突的长期视角。尽管关于“绿色掠夺”和保护“慢性暴力”的政治生态学文献迄今很少涉及森林驱逐对群体冲突的“二阶”影响，我们发现政治生态学作为理解国家驱逐与族群间冲突之间联系的理论框架是富有成效的。通过档案研究和在2018至2023年间进行的定性访谈，结合ACLED冲突数据（1997-2022），作者展示了殖民和后殖民土地政策，包括试图保护或恢复茅森林的政策，如何促成剥夺，从而助长了当今的暴力。过去的研究倾向于将肯尼亚的族群间暴力归因于选举或资源竞争，但本文探讨了与土地改革和定居计划相关的更深层机制，这些机制助长了基于身份的冲突。在东茅（纳库鲁）和马赛茅（纳罗克）等地区，社会生态变迁——如农业扩张——加上人口增长和森林边界不清，加剧了紧张局势。这些转变使景观商品化，产生了新的冲突和排斥边疆。研究结果对森林保护和气候融资项目具有重要意义，因为它们展示了当代保护执法实践的影响如何与“粗暴”和“缓慢”暴力的长期影响相结合，助长族群间冲突。

records.title_en: Unemployment impact of network sectors and employment protection legislation reforms: Evidence from selected african countries
records.title_cn: 网络部门与就业保护立法改革的失业影响：来自部分非洲国家的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper examines the dynamic effects of Employment Protection Legislation (EPL) reforms and Network Sector reforms on unemployment in selected African countries from 1990 to 2014. Reforms refer to changes in the EPL or Network Sector institutions index. Using local projections combined with augmented inverse probability weighting (LP–AIPW) and Entropy Balancing techniques to address endogeneity concerns, our findings show that EPL reforms reduce unemployment from the first year after their implementation, while Network Sector reforms also lower unemployment, with significant effects emerging from the second year onward. Robustness checks confirm that these results are consistent across alternative specifications, different definitions of reform episodes, and alternative labor-market outcomes such as employment and labor force participation. The heterogeneity analysis shows that both types of reforms reduce unemployment among men and young workers aged 15–24, while significant effects for women are concentrated among young female workers. Finally, we identify key transmission channels through which the reforms operate, including reductions in informality, increases in domestic investment and foreign direct investment, and short-run improvements in total factor productivity.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了1990年至2014年间部分非洲国家就业保护立法（EPL）改革和网络部门改革对失业的动态影响。改革指的是EPL或网络部门制度指数的变化。使用局部投影结合增强逆概率加权（LP–AIPW）和熵平衡技术来解决内生性问题，我们的研究结果表明，EPL改革在实施后的第一年即降低失业率，而网络部门改革也降低了失业率，其显著效应从第二年开始显现。稳健性检验证实，这些结果在替代规格、改革事件的不同定义以及就业和劳动力参与等替代劳动力市场结果中保持一致。异质性分析显示，两类改革均降低了男性和15-24岁年轻工人的失业率，而对女性的显著效应主要集中在年轻女性工人中。最后，我们识别了改革发挥作用的关键传导渠道，包括非正规性减少、国内投资和外国直接投资增加，以及全要素生产率的短期改善。

records.title_en: 50 Years of World Development
records.title_cn: 世界发展50年
records.abstract_en: Since its launch in 1973,World Development(WD) has both reflected and challenged prevailing development paradigms. We provide the first longitudinal, replicable portrait of WD’s intellectual landscape and its influence on global development discourse. Leveraging correlated topic modelling (CTM) and bibliometrics, this study maps the journal’s full research archive (8,711 articles) from 1973 to 2022. We identify five major thematic waves—from basic–needs economics to climate–resilient sustainability—trace their co–evolution with theWorld Development Report(WDR), and spotlight how WD scholarship often anticipates WDR agendas by two to five years. Region–specific analyses reveal distinctive research trajectories for China, India, Africa and Latin America, while authorship data show a six–fold rise in women’s representation. We conclude with a research agenda for the next decade emphasizing the importance of keeping WD’s core intellectual history in development economics even as it diversifies into development studies.
records.abstract_cn: 自1973年创刊以来，《世界发展》（WD）既反映了主流发展范式，也对其提出了挑战。我们首次提供了WD知识版图及其对全球发展话语影响的纵向、可复制性描述。利用相关主题模型（CTM）和文献计量学，本研究绘制了该期刊从1973年到2022年的全部研究档案（8,711篇文章）。我们识别出五个主要主题浪潮——从基本需求经济学到气候韧性可持续性——追踪其与《世界发展报告》（WDR）的共同演进，并突出WD学术研究往往比WDR议程提前两到五年。区域特定分析揭示了中国、印度、非洲和拉丁美洲的独特研究轨迹，而作者数据显示女性代表性增长了六倍。最后，我们提出了未来十年的研究议程，强调在WD向发展研究多元化发展的同时，保持其在发展经济学中的核心思想史的重要性。

records.title_en: Immigration, hukou system and crime: Evidence from China
records.title_cn: 移民、户籍制度与犯罪：来自中国的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates the causal effect of the hukou (household registration) system on urban crime. During the hukou reform in 2016, the central government of China removed the migration barriers for some cities and rural migrant population, allowing us to adopt a difference-in-differences method. We evaluate this natural experiment with reform information linked to crime from city-level Prosecutor’s Office. The results show that the hukou reform suppresses criminal activities, leading to a significant decrease in urban crime. Further, we provide two possible mechanisms for the negative effect: promoting equalization of public services and changing skill structure of the inflowing population. In addition, we find that increasing registered population does not adversely affect service provisions for the originally registered individuals. Overall, our analysis sheds new light on the social effects of migration control policies and public services in developing countries.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了户籍制度对城市犯罪的因果效应。在2016年的户籍改革期间，中国政府取消了一些城市和农村流动人口的迁移障碍，使我们能够采用双重差分方法。我们利用与市级检察院犯罪数据相关联的改革信息来评估这一自然实验。结果表明，户籍改革抑制了犯罪活动，导致城市犯罪显著减少。此外，我们为这种负面效应提供了两种可能的机制：促进公共服务均等化和改变流入人口的技能结构。另外，我们发现，登记人口的增加并未对原有登记个体的服务供给产生不利影响。总体而言，我们的分析为发展中国家迁移控制政策和公共服务的社会效应提供了新的视角。

records.title_en: Has land finance driven China’s economic growth? Evidence from a quantitative counterfactual analysis
records.title_cn: 土地财政是否推动了中国经济增长？来自定量反事实分析的证据
records.abstract_en: The Chinese government’s reliance on land finance to mobilize resources for economic development has attracted significant attention from other developing countries. Given the critical role of rural migrant workers in China’s economic growth, we construct a quantitative dynamic multi-sector model that captures the distinctive features of China’s urban–rural dual economic structure. Our findings demonstrate that land finance in China effectively stimulated economic growth; However, it did so at the expense of reduced consumption of urban residents. Land finance drove China’s economic growth through two main channels: increasing investment in urban and rural infrastructure and promoting the employment of rural migrant workers, and the ratio of the contribution of these two channels was about 5:4. Moreover, although the new land finance policy aims to allocate more land finance revenue to rural residents, such redistribution can only promote economic growth if accompanied by appropriate policy measures.
records.abstract_cn: 中国政府依赖土地财政调动资源促进经济发展，这一做法引起了其他发展中国家的广泛关注。鉴于农村流动劳动力在中国经济增长中的关键作用，我们构建了一个定量动态多部门模型，以捕捉中国城乡二元经济结构的独特特征。我们的研究结果表明，中国的土地财政有效刺激了经济增长；然而，这是以牺牲城镇居民消费为代价的。土地财政通过两个主要渠道推动了中国经济增长：增加城乡基础设施投资和促进农村流动劳动力就业，这两个渠道的贡献比例约为5:4。此外，尽管新的土地财政政策旨在将更多土地财政收入分配给农村居民，但这种再分配只有在伴随适当政策措施的情况下才能促进经济增长。

records.title_en: What will it mean to end poverty?
records.title_cn: 消除贫困意味着什么？
records.abstract_en: How we think about development hinges in large part on how we think about poverty. The world community has embraced the goal to end global extreme poverty as a cornerstone of development policy, but we show how success will hinge on how “poverty” is understood. We argue that global poverty will not be eliminated even if the global headcount of poverty is brought to zero. This is because much poverty is experienced within the year by people who are not typically designated as “poor”. Their deprivations may be substantial, but they systematically go uncounted through the process of annualizing data. We consider poverty as experienced during the year and describe the steps needed to truly achieve the goal of ending poverty.
records.abstract_cn: 我们对发展的思考在很大程度上取决于我们对贫困的思考。国际社会已将消除全球极端贫困作为发展政策的基石，但我们表明，成功将取决于如何理解“贫困”。我们认为，即使全球贫困人口数量降至零，全球贫困也不会被消除。这是因为许多贫困是在年内由那些通常不被指定为“贫困”的人所经历的。他们的匮乏可能是实质性的，但通过年度化数据的过程，他们系统性地未被计入。我们考虑年内所经历的贫困，并描述真正实现消除贫困目标所需的步骤。

records.title_en: On social inequality, financial inclusion, and poverty at the bottom of the pyramid: Is financial equity enough?
records.title_cn: 论社会不平等、金融包容性与金字塔底层贫困：金融公平是否足够？
records.abstract_en: Researchers worldwide are looking for ways to positively impact those afflicted by poverty at the socioeconomic bottom of the pyramid (BOP). It has been suggested that one of the critical pathways to poverty alleviation is through initiatives that encourage financial inclusion. Such inclusion is often seen as “leveling the playing field” by encouraging savings, entrepreneurship, and creating other related avenues for production and consumption. Yet, many programs targeting the BOP demonstrate limited utilization among the intended beneficiaries. In the current study, we discuss this issue with a specific focus on entrenched social stratification – the view that some communities are inherently superior or inferior based on birth. The current study examines whether social disadvantage – being on the low end of the social stratification continuum – influences the impact that financial inclusion has on access to sanitation, clean energy, and clean fuel. We ask: if one is considered “unequal” or “inferior” to start with, does this lead to subsequent challenges even after one achieves economic equity? Based on a field study, we identify limitations on how effectively financial inclusion and equity can address the challenges faced by the BOP. We conclude that existing social inequality may be at least partially disconnected from the effects of financial inclusion on poverty. Consequently, financial inclusion by itself cannot ensure poverty alleviation, as it may fail to address the deeply rooted social stratification prevalent at the BOP.
records.abstract_cn: 全球研究人员正在寻找方法，以积极影响社会经济金字塔底层（BOP）受贫困困扰的人群。有人提出，通过鼓励金融包容性的倡议是减贫的关键途径之一。这种包容性通常被视为通过鼓励储蓄、创业以及创造其他相关的生产和消费途径来“公平竞争”。然而，许多针对BOP的项目在预期受益者中的利用率有限。在当前研究中，我们特别关注根深蒂固的社会分层——即某些社群基于出身而天生优越或低劣的观点。当前研究考察社会劣势——处于社会分层连续体的低端——是否影响金融包容性在获取卫生设施、清洁能源和清洁燃料方面的影响。我们问：如果一个人一开始就被视为“不平等”或“低劣”，即使在实现经济公平后，这是否会导致后续挑战？基于一项实地研究，我们识别了金融包容性和公平在应对BOP所面临挑战方面的局限性。我们得出结论，现有的社会不平等可能至少部分地与金融包容性对贫困的影响脱节。因此，金融包容性本身不能确保减贫，因为它可能无法解决BOP中普遍存在的根深蒂固的社会分层问题。

records.title_en: Conflicts and prosocial preferences
records.title_cn: 冲突与亲社会偏好
records.abstract_en: How economic agents’ preferences—such as individual time preferences, risk preferences, and prosocial preferences—are formed is a central question in economics, with important implications for understanding decision-making behavior. This study examines the nonlinear effect of conflict exposure on prosocial preferences, measured using “tax game” survey questions from the 2008 Aceh Reintegration and Livelihood Survey (ARLS). Leveraging variation in individual conflict exposure during one of the longest-lasting conflicts in recent history in Aceh, Indonesia, the analysis reveals a nonlinear relationship between conflict intensity and individuals’ willingness to contribute to public goods. Specifically, contributions decrease as conflict exposure intensifies up to a certain threshold, beyond which contributions increase. These findings are robust to alternative measures of conflict exposure and the inclusion of relevant control variables, providing consistent evidence of the nonlinear association.
records.abstract_cn: 经济主体的偏好——如个人时间偏好、风险偏好和亲社会偏好——是如何形成的，是经济学中的一个核心问题，对理解决策行为具有重要意义。本研究考察了冲突暴露对亲社会偏好的非线性影响，亲社会偏好通过2008年亚齐重返社会与生计调查（ARLS）中的“税收博弈”调查问题来衡量。利用印度尼西亚亚齐近期历史上持续时间最长的冲突之一中个体冲突暴露的差异，分析揭示了冲突强度与个体对公共物品贡献意愿之间的非线性关系。具体而言，随着冲突暴露强度增加至某一阈值，贡献减少；超过该阈值后，贡献增加。这些发现在替代性冲突暴露衡量指标和纳入相关控制变量的情况下依然稳健，为非线性关联提供了一致的证据。

records.title_en: Poor performance of west Sumatran governments in resolving palm oil conflicts: a procedural justice perspective
records.title_cn: 西苏门答腊政府在解决棕榈油冲突中的不佳表现：程序正义视角
records.abstract_en: Expanding palm oil cultivation in Indonesia has led to significant conflicts between local communities and palm oil companies. Research indicates that these communities often rely on local governments to resolve the disputes. However, there is currently a lack of studies exploring the effectiveness of local governments in this context. This research gap highlights the importance of the present study, which aims to investigate this pressing issue by employing conflict analysis, procedural justice frameworks, and mixed methods. This article addresses how effectively local governments resolve conflicts between local communities and palm oil companies, focusing on district governments in West Sumatera, Indonesia. The findings suggest that the performance of local governments in resolving these conflicts is inadequate due to their relative inaccessibility and weak process. To achieve sustainable outcomes, there is a pressing need for fair and equitable approaches that prioritize community rights.
records.abstract_cn: 印度尼西亚棕榈油种植的扩张导致了当地社区与棕榈油公司之间的重大冲突。研究表明，这些社区往往依赖地方政府来解决争端。然而，目前缺乏探讨地方政府在此背景下有效性的研究。这一研究空白凸显了本研究的重要性，旨在通过冲突分析、程序正义框架和混合方法来调查这一紧迫问题。本文探讨了地方政府如何有效解决当地社区与棕榈油公司之间的冲突，重点关注印度尼西亚西苏门答腊的地区政府。研究结果表明，地方政府在解决这些冲突方面的表现不足，原因是其相对难以接近和程序薄弱。为了实现可持续的成果，迫切需要优先考虑社区权利的公平公正的方法。

records.title_en: Reinterpreting Japanese planning tools in the global south: A viewpoint from policy transfer to knowledge co-production
records.title_cn: 重新解读日本规划工具在南半球的适用性：从政策转移到知识共创的视角
records.abstract_en: Against the urban duality challenges of the Global South under high urbanization pressure, (1) rapid urbanization versus emerging population decline, (2) formal planning systems versus informal urban growth, and (3) global urban development versus local community management, planning tools of Japan, which experienced rapid urbanization would be effective, but not as a model but as a reference. This paper aims to set a viewpoint on how selected Japanese strategic planning tools, that is, agile master planning, urban growth boundaries, and basic building regulations, can serve the Global South cities by interpreting them from the concepts of policy mobility, lesson-drawing, and hybridity.
records.abstract_cn: 面对高城市化压力下南半球城市的二元性挑战，即（1）快速城市化与新兴人口减少，（2）正式规划体系与非正式城市增长，以及（3）全球城市发展与地方社区管理，经历过快速城市化的日本规划工具可能有效，但并非作为模式，而是作为参考。本文旨在通过政策流动性、经验借鉴和混合性概念，对选定的日本战略规划工具，即敏捷总体规划、城市增长边界和基本建筑法规，如何服务于南半球城市设定一个视角。

records.title_en: How does land transfer intervention promote farmers’ land investment? Evidence from China
records.title_cn: 土地流转干预如何促进农户土地投资？来自中国的证据
records.abstract_en: Land investment plays a critical role in sustainable land use and agricultural development, but little is known about how to effectively promote land investment. Using data from the China Household Finance Survey, this study explores how land transfer interventions stimulate farmers’ land investment. This study finds that land transfer interventions significantly enhance investment in leased land. The main reason for this is that interventions have increased the level of formalization of land transfers, including payment of rental, cash transactions, and defined lease durations. Meanwhile, interventions extended the duration of land leases and enlarged the areas leased. Moreover, interventions during the negotiation and pricing stages, supervisory stages, and governmental involvement exert the most pronounced influence on land investment. Finally, this study also finds that interventions increase household expenditures on fertilizers, pesticides, and seeds except for leased land. The findings above offer valuable insights for policymakers aiming to refine land institutions and promote land investments.
records.abstract_cn: 土地投资在可持续土地利用和农业发展中扮演关键角色，但关于如何有效促进土地投资的知识尚属有限。利用中国家庭金融调查数据，本研究探讨了土地流转干预如何刺激农户的土地投资。研究发现，土地流转干预显著增强了租入土地的投资。主要原因在于干预提高了土地流转的正式化程度，包括租金支付、现金交易和明确的租赁期限。同时，干预延长了土地租赁的期限并扩大了租赁面积。此外，在谈判与定价阶段、监督阶段以及政府参与方面的干预对土地投资的影响最为显著。最后，本研究还发现，干预增加了农户在化肥、农药和种子上的支出，而不仅仅是针对租入土地。上述发现为旨在完善土地制度和促进土地投资的政策制定者提供了宝贵的见解。

records.title_en: Optimizing county-level land use for sustainable photovoltaic development in China: A multi-scenario analysis
records.title_cn: 优化中国县域土地利用以促进光伏可持续发展：多情景分析
records.abstract_en: Land scarcity in China intensifies conflicts between photovoltaic (PV) infrastructure and agricultural, ecological, and urban land uses. This study addresses the gap in county-level research by proposing a novel framework integrating land-type clustering, multi-objective optimization, and geospatial simulation to evaluate sustainable land use under PV expansion scenarios. Analyzing 562 counties in central and eastern China, counties are categorized into woodland-dominant, farmland-dominant, urban-dominant, and balanced types. Three scenarios are assessed: PV development (PV), business-as-usual (BS), and low-carbon emission (CE). The PV scenario balances BS and CE, curbing carbon source expansion while protecting farmland—e.g., farmland in Cangnan (woodland-dominant), Sheyang (farmland-dominant), and Lingbao (balanced) counties increased by 1.09 %, 2.35 %, and 1.1 % versus CE. Farmland-dominant and balanced counties show high adaptability, with economic and environmental benefits rising 67 % and 37 %. Urban-dominant counties have limited PV potential, and woodland-dominant counties are unsuitable for large-scale PV, with total benefits dropping 1 % and ecological impacts rising. Medium-density PV (80 % coverage) maximizes returns, with a 20.25-year payback. Policies should prioritize PV on agricultural and construction lands in farmland-dominant and balanced counties, while protecting ecology in urban- and woodland-dominant ones to support carbon neutrality.
records.abstract_cn: 中国的土地稀缺加剧了光伏（PV）基础设施与农业、生态和城市土地利用之间的冲突。本研究通过提出一种新颖的框架，整合土地类型聚类、多目标优化和地理空间模拟，以评估光伏扩张情景下的可持续土地利用，填补了县域层面研究的空白。分析中国中东部562个县，将县划分为林地主导型、农田主导型、城市主导型和均衡型四类。评估了三种情景：光伏发展（PV）、一切照旧（BS）和低碳排放（CE）。PV情景平衡了BS和CE，抑制了碳源扩张，同时保护农田——例如，苍南（林地主导型）、射阳（农田主导型）和灵宝（均衡型）县的农田相比CE分别增加了1.09%、2.35%和1.1%。农田主导型和均衡型县表现出高适应性，经济和环境效益分别上升67%和37%。城市主导型县的光伏潜力有限，林地主导型县不适合大规模光伏开发，总效益下降1%，生态影响上升。中等密度光伏（80%覆盖率）实现最大回报，投资回收期为20.25年。政策应优先在农田主导型和均衡型县的农业和建设用地部署光伏，同时保护城市和林地主导型县的生态，以支持碳中和目标。
