records.abstract_en: Boarding schools, offering an alternative residential arrangement to the traditional home environment, have been under-studied regarding their impacts on students’ non-cognitive development. This study presents findings derived from a quasi-experimental design where changes in local educational policy caused a transition from voluntary to compulsory boarding. Results indicate that boarding students outperform their non-boarding counterparts in both cognitive and non-cognitive outcomes, with disadvantaged students exhibiting the largest gains. We attribute these effects to increased teacher engagement in course preparation, closer teacher-student interactions, and heightened student effort toward academic pursuits. These findings underscore the potential of boarding schools as a powerful catalyst for enhancing students’ human capital.
records.abstract_cn: 寄宿学校提供了一种替代传统家庭环境的居住安排，但其对学生非认知发展的影响研究不足。本研究基于一项准实验设计的结果，该设计中地方教育政策的变化导致了从自愿寄宿向强制寄宿的转变。结果表明，寄宿学生在认知和非认知结果上均优于非寄宿学生，其中处于不利地位的学生获益最大。我们将这些效应归因于教师课程准备投入的增加、师生互动的加强以及学生对学业追求的努力提升。这些发现强调了寄宿学校作为增强学生人力资本的强大催化剂的潜力。

records.title_en: Dollar store impact on local labor markets and retail activity
records.title_cn: 一元店对当地劳动力市场与零售活动的影响
records.abstract_en: This study examines the relationship between dollar store expansion and local labor market outcomes, including employment, earnings, and retail establishment counts within the general merchandise and food and beverage sectors. We compare these relationships across urban and rural counties. Using an instrumental variables approach to address potential endogeneity in store location decisions, we find that dollar store presence corresponds with higher employment levels within the general merchandise retail sector. While absolute employment increases are larger in urban counties, the relative changes compared to baseline employment levels are more substantial in rural counties than urban ones (11.86% versus 5.22%). We find contemporaneous decreases in average weekly earnings, but lagged results show a positive, compensating association with dollar store expansion in urban areas, while rural wages show no significant changes. We find modest employment increases in the food and beverage sector in urban areas with no significant relationship in rural areas. These findings provide empirical evidence that dollar store expansion corresponds with job creation, particularly in the general merchandise retail sector, despite the displacement of existing establishments.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了一元店扩张与当地劳动力市场结果之间的关系，包括一般商品及食品饮料行业的就业、收入和零售机构数量。我们比较了城市和农村县之间的这些关系。采用工具变量方法以解决店铺选址决策中的潜在内生性问题，我们发现一元店的存在与一般商品零售行业较高的就业水平相对应。虽然城市县的绝对就业增长更大，但相对于基线就业水平的变化，农村县比城市县更为显著（11.86%对比5.22%）。我们发现平均周薪同期下降，但滞后结果显示，在城市地区，一元店扩张与工资呈正相关补偿关系，而农村工资则无显著变化。我们发现城市地区食品饮料行业就业适度增长，而农村地区无显著关系。这些发现提供了经验证据，表明一元店扩张与就业创造相对应，尤其是在一般商品零售行业，尽管存在对现有机构的替代效应。

records.title_en: Fish as food: Prioritizing domestic fish consumption to reduce the health burden
records.title_cn: 鱼类作为食物：优先考虑国内鱼类消费以减轻健康负担
records.abstract_en: The current fish trade increases fish availability and provides essential nutrients to most countries globally. However, many countries still consume less fish than they produce. A health-sensitive trade policy could help address this imbalance. In this study, we examined how prioritizing domestic fish consumption in some net-exporting countries with low fish consumption could improve fish availability and impact global and regional health burdens. Using bilateral fish trade data from 2010 to 2019 and diet-disease relationships, we compared the impact of current trade versus trade patterns (focused on domestic consumption) on reducing deaths from ischemic heart disease (IHD), the world’s leading cause of death. Our results showed that the current trade system delivered health benefits and could have prevented approximately 130,000 IHD deaths worldwide; one-third of these benefits went to high-income countries, where health gains were mainly transferred from net-exporting low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) with relatively high IHD death rates. Shifting a portion of exports to prioritize domestic consumption in net-exporting countries may reduce IHD deaths by 26% in LMICs and prevent an additional 15,400 IHD deaths globally compared with the current trade. Moreover, it would only cause a 0.7% reduction in health benefits in net-importing countries and no reduction in low- and lower-middle-income net-importing countries. Thus, increasing fish consumption in countries with low fish intake could be more effective in reducing the global burden of disease. Our findings could assist policymakers in developing health-sensitive policies to improve health outcomes.
records.abstract_cn: 当前的鱼类贸易增加了鱼类供应量，并为全球大多数国家提供了必需的营养素。然而，许多国家的鱼类消费量仍低于其产量。健康敏感的贸易政策可能有助于解决这一不平衡问题。在本研究中，我们考察了在一些鱼类消费量低的净出口国优先考虑国内鱼类消费如何改善鱼类供应量并影响全球和区域健康负担。利用2010年至2019年的双边鱼类贸易数据和饮食-疾病关系，我们比较了当前贸易与（侧重于国内消费的）贸易模式在减少缺血性心脏病（IHD）死亡（全球主要死因）方面的影响。我们的结果表明，当前的贸易体系带来了健康益处，并可能在全球范围内预防了约130,000例IHD死亡；其中三分之一的益处流向了高收入国家，这些健康收益主要从IHD死亡率相对较高的净出口低收入和中等收入国家（LMICs）转移而来。将部分出口转向优先考虑净出口国的国内消费，与当前贸易相比，可能使LMICs的IHD死亡减少26%，并在全球范围内额外预防15,400例IHD死亡。此外，这只会导致净进口国的健康益处减少0.7%，而低收入和低中等收入净进口国则不会减少。因此，在鱼类摄入量低的国家增加鱼类消费可能更有效地减轻全球疾病负担。我们的发现可帮助政策制定者制定健康敏感政策以改善健康结果。

records.title_en: India’s export restrictions and response of African and Asian retail rice prices
records.title_cn: 印度的出口限制与非洲和亚洲零售大米价格的响应
records.abstract_en: •India, the world’s top rice exporter, imposed a ban on non-basmati rice.•Investigate price movements on key rice markets in Africa before and after the ban.•Findings show smaller price increases in Africa compared to Asia.•Possible reasons include favorable weather conditions and production expansion in Africa.
records.abstract_cn: •印度，全球最大的大米出口国，对非巴斯马蒂大米实施了禁令。•调查禁令前后非洲关键大米市场的价格变动。•结果显示非洲的价格涨幅小于亚洲。•可能的原因包括非洲有利的天气条件和生产扩张。

records.title_en: Role of nutrition-sensitive agriculture in enhancing sustainable humanitarian assistance: Evidence from orange-fleshed sweetpotato interventions in Kenya
records.title_cn: 营养敏感型农业在增强可持续人道主义援助中的作用：来自肯尼亚橙色果肉甘薯干预措施的证据
records.abstract_en: The increasing frequency of climate-related shocks in arid and semi-arid regions has subjected local populations to cyclical livelihood disruptions and poverty traps. Humanitarian assistance is key to sustainable livelihoods in such regions, but this has largely been in the form of emergency aid. Sustainability concerns and public fiscal burden have necessitated a shift towards resilience building. Such interventions include biofortification, an important nutrition-sensitive agricultural approach that can sustainably improve food and nutrition security among vulnerable populations. However, there is limited evidence of success and lessons for scaling this approach. Using a sample of 636 households drawn from three arid and semi-arid counties in Kenya, this study uses a doubly robust estimator and non-parametric methods to investigate the effect of promoting vitamin-A-biofortified sweet potato as a nutrition-sensitive, climate-smart agricultural intervention to improve nutritional outcomes in humanitarian settings. We find that interventions combining demand-creation strategies and access to biofortified planting material significantly enhance nutrition knowledge and household nutrition indicators such as dietary diversity and food security. Individual interventions that either create demand or provide access to planting material enhance nutrition awareness but do not lead to primary nutrition outcomes such as dietary diversity. Lastly, enhancing access to planting material leads to higher nutritional outcomes compared to demand-creation strategies carried out in isolation.
records.abstract_cn: 干旱和半干旱地区气候相关冲击的频率增加，使当地人口遭受周期性生计中断和贫困陷阱。人道主义援助是此类地区可持续生计的关键，但援助形式主要是紧急救助。可持续性问题和公共财政负担促使援助转向韧性建设。此类干预措施包括生物强化，这是一种重要的营养敏感型农业方法，可以可持续地改善脆弱人群的粮食和营养安全。然而，关于该方法成功和推广经验的证据有限。本研究使用来自肯尼亚三个干旱和半干旱县的636户家庭样本，采用双重稳健估计量和非参数方法，研究推广维生素A生物强化甘薯作为营养敏感型气候智能农业干预措施，以改善人道主义环境中的营养结果。我们发现，结合需求创造策略和获得生物强化种植材料的干预措施显著提高了营养知识和家庭营养指标，如饮食多样性和粮食安全。单独创造需求或提供种植材料的干预措施增强了营养意识，但并未带来主要营养结果，如饮食多样性。最后，与单独实施的需求创造策略相比，增强种植材料的获取带来了更高的营养结果。

records.title_en: Taxing fat versus behavioural interventions: Multiple discrete–continuous extreme value (MDCEV) models and the PCSHOP randomized trial of shopping behaviour
records.title_cn: 对脂肪征税与行为干预：多重离散-连续极值（MDCEV）模型及PCSHOP购物行为随机试验
records.abstract_en: Understanding food purchasing behaviours is complex because people make both choices among goods and volumes of those goods that they choose. We use the novel Multiple Discrete-Continuous Extreme Value (MDCEV) model, capable of handling both aspects of behaviour, on real-world food shopping behaviour data from a clinical trial. We compared the impact of providing general dietary advice, general dietary advice plus personalised shopping advice, or taxation, and combinations thereof, on the amount of saturated fat in consumers’ shopping baskets, using simulation. We used supermarket loyalty card data from a randomized controlled trial of 111 adults with raised cholesterol in Oxfordshire (UK). A Danish fat tax simulation alone is less effective than the tax in combination with dietary and shopping advice. These data illustrate the potential of MDCEV models for these behaviours and, by extension, informing food policies.
records.abstract_cn: 理解食品购买行为是复杂的，因为人们既要在商品之间做出选择，也要选择所购商品的数量。我们采用新颖的多重离散-连续极值（MDCEV）模型，该模型能够同时处理行为的这两个方面，并将其应用于一项临床试验中的真实食品购物行为数据。我们通过模拟，比较了提供一般饮食建议、一般饮食建议加个性化购物建议、或征税，以及这些措施的组合，对消费者购物篮中饱和脂肪含量的影响。我们使用了来自英国牛津郡一项针对111名胆固醇升高成人的随机对照试验的超市会员卡数据。仅模拟丹麦脂肪税的效果不如税收与饮食及购物建议相结合的效果。这些数据说明了MDCEV模型在这些行为研究中的潜力，并进而为食品政策提供信息。

records.title_en: Public transfers, food consumption and dietary diversity. The case of Tarjeta Uruguay Social
records.title_cn: 公共转移支付、食品消费与膳食多样性：乌拉圭社会卡案例
records.abstract_en: Social protection systems in several Latin American countries are increasingly adopting prepaid magnetic cards to promote the consumption of food and other essential goods. However, little is known about how these transfers affect household expenditure and consumption patterns or their advantages over cash options in high- and middle-income countries. Based on a fuzzy regression discontinuity design that exploits programme assignment rules, we assess the effect of the Uruguayan Tarjeta Uruguay Social (TUS) on food expenditure patterns and a dietary diversity score (DDS). We also analyse non-food expenditure and its components, and three potential explanatory channels: the infra/extra-marginality of the transfer; labour market attachment of the beneficiaries; and self-reported consumption decisions within the household. We do not find effects regarding food expenditure and the DDS, which could be mainly associated with the infra-marginality of the transfer. However, poorer households receiving doubled TUS amounts show positive changes in DDS (3%) and expenditure on fruit (17%) and legumes (9%) relative to a control group. In addition, TUS increases spending on housing for all beneficiaries, which is also reflected in an improvement in the quality of housing materials. Although it does not change the balance between cash and credit purchases, it does lead to a reduction in indebtedness, appears to act as an income stabilizer. These elements suggest that, for most households, TUS behaves like a purely cash transfer.
records.abstract_cn: 拉丁美洲多个国家的社会保障体系日益采用预付磁卡来促进食品及其他必需品的消费。然而，关于这些转移支付如何影响家庭支出和消费模式，以及相较于现金选项在高收入和中等收入国家中的优势，目前知之甚少。基于模糊回归不连续设计，利用项目分配规则，我们评估了乌拉圭社会卡（TUS）对食品支出模式和膳食多样性评分（DDS）的影响。我们还分析了非食品支出及其组成部分，以及三个潜在的解释渠道：转移支付的边际内/边际外性质；受益人的劳动力市场参与度；以及家庭内部自我报告的消费决策。我们未发现对食品支出和DDS有影响，这可能主要与转移支付的边际内性质有关。然而，获得双倍TUS金额的较贫困家庭在DDS（3%）、水果支出（17%）和豆类支出（9%）方面相对于对照组显示出正向变化。此外，TUS增加了所有受益人的住房支出，这也反映在住房材料质量的改善上。虽然它没有改变现金与信用购买之间的平衡，但确实导致了负债的减少，似乎起到了收入稳定器的作用。这些因素表明，对于大多数家庭而言，TUS的行为类似于纯粹的现金转移支付。

records.title_en: The unmet financial needs of intermediary firms within agri-food value chains in Uganda and Bangladesh
records.title_cn: 乌干达和孟加拉国农业食品价值链中中间企业的未满足金融需求
records.abstract_en: Intermediary firms within agri-food value chains — operating between the farmgate and retailers — typically account for at least as much, if not more, value added as the primary agricultural production sector of the economy, but little is known about how these small and largely informal firms conduct their business. Drawing on a set of innovative surveys implemented amid the arabica coffee and soybean value chains in Uganda and the rice and potato value chains in Bangladesh, we describe the financial activities of these intermediary firms. We document four sets of results. First, across all intermediary actors in our data the overwhelming majority of transactions are cash-based. Second, although many intermediary actors are un-banked, access to financial accounts varies considerably by value chain segment, commodity, and country. Third, while most intermediary actors report using mobile money for personal purposes, especially in Uganda, very few use mobile money to facilitate business transactions. Fourth, although intermediary actors frequently report exposure to risk, very few effectively manage this risk. We conclude by discussing how intermediary agri-food value chain actors represent an underappreciated population for the promotion of new technologies to improve outcomes among both intermediary actors themselves and smallholder farmers.
records.abstract_cn: 农业食品价值链中的中间企业——在农场门口和零售商之间运营——通常至少占经济中初级农业生产部门增加值同等或更多的份额，但关于这些小型且大多非正式的企业如何开展业务，我们知之甚少。利用在乌干达的阿拉比卡咖啡和大豆价值链以及孟加拉国的水稻和马铃薯价值链中实施的一系列创新调查，我们描述了这些中间企业的金融活动。我们记录了四组结果。第一，在我们的数据中，所有中间参与者的绝大多数交易都是以现金为基础的。第二，尽管许多中间参与者没有银行账户，但金融账户的获取因价值链环节、商品和国家而异。第三，虽然大多数中间参与者报告将移动货币用于个人目的，尤其是在乌干达，但很少有人使用移动货币来促进商业交易。第四，尽管中间参与者经常报告面临风险，但很少有人有效管理这种风险。最后，我们讨论了中间农业食品价值链参与者如何成为推广新技术以改善中间参与者自身和小农户成果的未被充分重视的人群。

records.title_en: Enhancing nutrition availability through international trade: U.S. and global dairy exports to emerging markets
records.title_cn: 通过国际贸易提升营养可得性：美国及全球乳制品对新兴市场的出口
records.abstract_en: This study examines the importance of trade liberalization via U.S. free trade agreements (FTAs) to distribute nutritionally valuable foods to lower- and middle-income countries (LMICs). Focusing on dairy products that are rich in essential nutrients and linked to important health benefits, we construct 24 years of bilateral trade data (1998–2021) augmented with nutrient composition information. A structural gravity model is developed to quantify the nutrient availability within U.S. FTAs. Results indicate that while U.S. FTAs increased the value of dairy imports by 86 %, on average, they more than doubled the availability of dairy protein and key micronutrients. Second, trade increases among LMIC FTA partners were not due to trade diversion away from non-member suppliers. Rather, we find some evidence that LMICs increased dairy trade with both U.S. and non-U.S. export suppliers. Third, using population data, we translate FTA trade effects into gains in nutrient availability for consumers. As a percentage of recommended dietary allowance from all food sources, U.S. dairy exports to LMIC FTA partners contributed to an increase of 0.9 and 1.8 percentage points, on average, in the availability of calcium and vitamin B12. Finally, the estimated gains in nutrient availability correspond to significant reductions in dairy trade costs over the study period (e.g. Mexico, −50 %). These findings highlight the importance of trade liberalization as a key mechanism to distribute essential nutrients to regions with insufficient availability through their own domestic production. They also underscore an underexplored avenue for policymakers to advance the United Nations’ Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).
records.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了通过美国自由贸易协定（FTAs）实现贸易自由化，向中低收入国家（LMICs）分配营养丰富食品的重要性。聚焦于富含必需营养素且与重要健康益处相关的乳制品，我们构建了24年的双边贸易数据（1998-2021），并补充了营养成分信息。开发了一个结构引力模型来量化美国自由贸易协定内的营养可得性。结果表明，尽管美国自由贸易协定平均使乳制品进口价值增加了86，但它们使乳制品蛋白质和关键微量营养素的可得性增加了一倍以上。其次，中低收入国家自贸协定伙伴之间贸易的增加并非由于从非成员供应商的贸易转移。相反，我们发现一些证据表明，中低收入国家同时增加了与美国和非美国出口供应商的乳制品贸易。第三，利用人口数据，我们将自贸协定贸易效应转化为消费者营养可得性的收益。作为所有食物来源推荐膳食摄入量的百分比，美国对中低收入国家自贸协定伙伴的乳制品出口平均使钙和维生素B12的可得性增加了0.9和1.8个百分点。最后，估计的营养可得性收益对应于研究期间乳制品贸易成本的显著降低（例如，墨西哥，-50）。这些发现强调了贸易自由化作为向国内生产不足地区分配必需营养素的关键机制的重要性。它们也强调了政策制定者推进联合国可持续发展目标（SDGs）的一个未被充分探索的途径。

records.title_en: Global poverty and the cost of a healthy diet
records.title_cn: 全球贫困与健康饮食成本
records.abstract_en: Access to a healthy diet is a fundamental human need, yet a significant portion of the global population faces barriers to realizing it. Conventional poverty metrics are designed around actual food consumption by low-income people scaled to recommended caloric intake, which is often inadequate for lifelong health. We propose poverty lines based on the cost of a healthy diet, including elements of relative poverty, and explore their key metrics such as headcount ratios and the poverty gap. According to our proposed poverty lines, 2,283 to 2,865 million people were poor in 2022, facing a shortfall of US$ 1,657 to US$ 2,370 billion per year to meet their basic needs. This is in contrast to 654 million people who are considered to live in extreme poverty according to the World Bank’s conventional poverty line. Further, these poverty lines identify 286 to 868 million more people as poor compared to the Societal Poverty Line, with the majority of these individuals concentrated in South Asia and Sub-Saharan Africa.
records.abstract_cn: 获得健康饮食是一项基本人类需求，然而全球相当一部分人口在实现这一需求时面临障碍。传统贫困指标围绕低收入人群的实际食品消费设计，并按推荐卡路里摄入量进行缩放，这往往不足以维持终身健康。我们提出基于健康饮食成本的贫困线，包括相对贫困的要素，并探讨其关键指标，如贫困人口比例和贫困缺口。根据我们提出的贫困线，2,283年有2,865亿至2022亿人处于贫困状态，每年面临1,657亿至2,370亿美元的缺口以满足其基本需求。这与世界银行传统贫困线所认定的654亿极端贫困人口形成对比。此外，与 societal poverty line 相比，这些贫困线识别出286亿至868亿额外贫困人口，其中大多数集中在南亚和撒哈拉以南非洲地区。

records.title_en: U.S. public sentiment toward policy action targeting emissions from beef production
records.title_cn: 美国公众对针对牛肉生产排放的政策行动的态度
records.abstract_en: Many countries have begun introducing policies aiming to reduce emissions from beef production. Several strategies are being researched and developed to reduce such emissions. This study explores U.S. public sentiment toward various beef production emissions-reduction strategies and quantifies support for potential policy measures. Using data from a nationally representative survey, we find that feeding seaweed to cattle is the most preferred strategy followed by letting either the beef industry or the U.S. Department of Agriculture decide how to reduce emissions from beef production. The U.S. public shows greater support for subsidies versus mandates if they recognize that mandates could increase the price of beef. The strategy with the highest estimated subsidy support, as funded by the U.S. public, is seaweed. However, these subsidy levels are less than the projected cost of the product in practice, so producer adoption of seaweed as triggered by a U.S. public-supported subsidy is unlikely. A more plausible solution to subsidizing a subset of beef producers to reduce emissions may be connecting climate-concerned residents who are willing to fund a subsidy to producers who are willing to adopt climate-focused practices.
records.abstract_cn: 许多国家已开始出台旨在减少牛肉生产排放的政策。目前正在研究和开发多种策略以减少此类排放。本研究探讨了美国公众对各种牛肉生产减排策略的态度，并量化了对潜在政策措施的支持度。利用一项全国代表性调查的数据，我们发现，给牛喂食海藻是最受青睐的策略，其次是让牛肉行业或美国农业部决定如何减少牛肉生产排放。如果公众认识到强制措施可能推高牛肉价格，他们对补贴的支持度会高于对强制措施的支持度。由美国公众资助的估计补贴支持度最高的策略是海藻。然而，这些补贴水平低于该产品在实践中的预计成本，因此，由美国公众支持的补贴引发的生产者采用海藻的可能性不大。一个更为可行的补贴部分牛肉生产者以减少排放的解决方案，可能是将愿意资助补贴的关心气候的居民与愿意采用气候友好型实践的生产者联系起来。

records.title_en: Training, credit, and infrastructure for improving market access among small-scale producers in the Philippines
records.title_cn: 培训、信贷与基础设施改善菲律宾小规模生产者市场准入的研究
records.abstract_en: Market access offers opportunities for technology adoption, productivity gains, and welfare improvement. Yet, small-scale producers in developing countries sell less than a quarter of their production in the market. The role of bundled interventions combining rural infrastructures, particularly farm-to-market roads, with access to extension and credit to improve market access remains insufficiently explored. This study investigates the impact of such bundled intervention on market participation and livelihood outcomes of small-scale producers in the Philippines. Results indicate higher market participation and income for treatment households, with a more pronounced impact among those near farm-to-market roads constructed by the project. Findings underscore the importance of implementing interventions that combine production support with infrastructure development to support the livelihoods of small-scale producers in remote areas.
records.abstract_cn: 市场准入为技术采纳、生产率提升和福利改善提供了机会。然而，发展中国家的的小规模生产者仅将其不到四分之一的生产投入市场销售。结合农村基础设施（特别是农场到市场道路）与推广服务和信贷的捆绑干预措施，在改善市场准入方面的作用尚未得到充分探讨。本研究考察了此类捆绑干预对菲律宾小规模生产者市场参与和生计成果的影响。结果表明，处理组家庭的市场参与度和收入更高，且这一影响在项目修建的农场到市场道路附近的家庭中更为显著。研究结果强调了实施将生产支持与基础设施发展相结合的干预措施，以支持偏远地区小规模生产者生计的重要性。

records.title_en: Economic evaluation of lettuce traceability systems in mitigating foodborne illness risks
records.title_cn: 生菜追溯系统在降低食源性疾病风险中的经济评估
records.abstract_en: Foodborne illnesses in fresh produce markets pose a significant public health risk. Although traceability systems are recognized for their potential to mitigate contamination impacts, the economic benefits of such systems remain underexplored. This study addresses this gap by evaluating the value of traceability in managing foodborne illness outbreaks using lettuce as a case study. We quantify the economic benefits of lettuce traceability and assess its sensitivity to contamination severity (quantity and virulence of the pathogen), pathogen persistence (survival of the pathogen on produce over time), and illness latency (time from exposure to symptoms of infection). Using an economic model with a pathogen dose–response formulation, we simulate the economic and health impacts of E. coli contamination originating from irrigation water. The results indicate that traceability benefits range from $4 to $91 million per outbreak, depending on shelf life, contamination severity, and latency of illness symptoms. Shorter shelf lives and contamination severity amplify the benefits. Traceability reduces illness by swiftly identifying and removing contaminated produce from the supply chain. The findings highlight the cost-effectiveness of traceability systems, especially for managing frequent or severe outbreaks. The study also demonstrates the contextual sensitivity of tracing benefits that stakeholders, including producers, retailers, and policymakers, should consider. Future studies should consider alternative contexts where benefit and costs may deviate from the estimates in this study.
records.abstract_cn: 新鲜农产品市场中的食源性疾病构成重大公共卫生风险。尽管追溯系统被认为具有减轻污染影响的潜力，但其经济效益仍未得到充分探索。本研究通过以生菜为案例，评估追溯在管理食源性疾病暴发中的价值，填补了这一空白。我们量化了生菜追溯的经济效益，并评估其对污染严重程度（病原体的数量和毒力）、病原体持久性（病原体在农产品上随时间的存活情况）以及疾病潜伏期（从暴露到感染症状出现的时间）的敏感性。使用带有病原体剂量-反应关系的经济模型，我们模拟了源自灌溉水的大肠杆菌污染的经济和健康影响。结果表明，追溯效益范围从每次暴发的$4百万到$91百万不等，具体取决于货架期、污染严重程度和疾病症状的潜伏期。较短的货架期和污染严重程度会放大效益。追溯通过迅速识别并从供应链中移除受污染产品来减少疾病。研究结果强调了追溯系统的成本效益，特别是在管理频繁或严重暴发方面。研究还展示了追溯效益的情境敏感性，生产者、零售商和政策制定者等利益相关者应考虑这一点。未来研究应考虑效益和成本可能偏离本研究估计的其他情境。

records.title_en: Transformative policies in Brazilian agri-food systems: An analysis of family farm procurement under the national school feeding program
records.title_cn: 巴西农食系统中的变革性政策：国家学校供餐计划下家庭农场采购分析
records.abstract_en: Public procurement is a key policy tool for promoting more sustainable agri-food systems. In Brazil, the National School Feeding Program (PNAE) has played an important role in integrating family farmers into institutional markets, yet various factors affect their participation. This study investigates the most important factors influencing family farmers’ participation in public procurement under the PNAE. It examines three analytical dimensions: demographic characteristics, state capacities, and family farming features. Using logistic regressions and classification trees, the research finds that municipality density negatively impacts family farm procurement targets, while state capacities have positive effects. Agricultural characteristics such as the proportion of family farming establishments relative to all agricultural establishments, technical assistance, financing, and formalization also play significant roles. The findings underscore the importance of regional variables in Brazilian agricultural dynamics. By analyzing all Brazilian municipalities with both linear and nonlinear analytical techniques, this study contributes to understanding the effective implementation of the PNAE, providing valuable insights for researchers and public managers.
records.abstract_cn: 公共采购是促进更可持续农食系统的关键政策工具。在巴西，国家学校供餐计划（PNAE）在将家庭农民纳入机构市场方面发挥了重要作用，但多种因素影响了他们的参与。本研究调查了影响家庭农民参与PNAE下公共采购的最重要因素。它考察了三个分析维度：人口特征、国家能力和家庭农业特征。使用逻辑回归和分类树，研究发现，市镇密度对家庭农场采购目标产生负面影响，而国家能力则产生积极影响。农业特征，如家庭农业机构占所有农业机构的比例、技术援助、融资和正规化，也发挥了重要作用。研究结果强调了区域变量在巴西农业动态中的重要性。通过使用线性和非线性分析技术分析所有巴西市镇，本研究有助于理解PNAE的有效实施，为研究人员和公共管理者提供了宝贵的见解。

records.title_en: Internalizing the external costs to achieve environmental and economic Goals: A Case study of rice production in China
records.title_cn: 内部化外部成本以实现环境与经济目标：中国水稻生产案例研究
records.abstract_en: This study addresses the critical issue of internalizing externalities in grain production, a key challenge in aligning economic growth with environmental sustainability in agricultural policy, particularly in the context of cross-regional grain trade. Using data from 30,524 rice circulation samples across China, we map inter-provincial rice flows and quantify the external costs of rice production at the provincial level. Our finding indicates that total external costs reach 8,810.4 million CNY, including greenhouse gas emissions and environmental impacts resulting from the inefficient use of fertilizers and pesticides. To address this, we propose an external cost-sharing mechanism in which consuming provinces compensate producing provinces with 4,955.7 million CNY. This innovative framework aims to harmonize economic growth with sustainable rice production while establishing a solid foundation for implementing inter-provincial horizontal benefit compensation policies in China. Moreover, it serves as a valuable reference for cross-regional ecological compensation strategies. By addressing both economic and environmental dimensions, this study contributes to the discourse on sustainable agricultural policy and regional equity.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了粮食生产中外部性内部化的关键问题，这是农业政策中协调经济增长与环境可持续性所面临的主要挑战，尤其是在跨区域粮食贸易的背景下。利用中国30,524个水稻流通样本数据，我们绘制了省际水稻流动图，并在省级层面量化了水稻生产的外部成本。研究发现，总外部成本达到8,810.4百万元人民币，包括温室气体排放以及化肥和农药低效使用造成的环境影响。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种外部成本分担机制，即消费省份向生产省份补偿4,955.7百万元人民币。这一创新框架旨在协调经济增长与可持续水稻生产，同时为中国实施省际横向利益补偿政策奠定坚实基础。此外，它为跨区域生态补偿策略提供了有价值的参考。通过兼顾经济与环境维度，本研究为可持续农业政策和区域公平的讨论做出了贡献。

records.title_en: Demand for local meat by US public schools: An EASI application to Iowa
records.title_cn: 美国公立学校对本地肉类的需求：一项针对爱荷华州的EASI应用
records.abstract_en: Using the Exact Affine Stone Index (EASI) demand model and USDA Farm-to-School data on Iowa public schools, this paper provides the first set of estimates of public school demand for local beef, pork, and chicken in the United States. We find that public schools are more sensitive to price changes than conventional consumers, and chicken benefits more than beef and pork from an increase in school expenditure on the three types of meat. Using back-of-the-envelope calculations, we conclude that while the economic impact on rural economies is currently minor, it could potentially become significant as the percentage of schools purchasing local meat increases.
records.abstract_cn: 利用精确仿射斯通指数（EASI）需求模型和美国农业部关于爱荷华州公立学校的农场到学校数据，本文提供了美国公立学校对本地牛肉、猪肉和鸡肉需求的首批估计。我们发现，公立学校对价格变化的敏感度高于传统消费者，且在学校对这三种肉类的支出增加时，鸡肉受益程度大于牛肉和猪肉。通过粗略计算，我们得出结论：尽管目前对农村经济的经济影响较小，但随着采购本地肉类的学校比例增加，其影响可能变得显著。

records.title_en: Contribution of Community Seed Banks to farmer seed systems and food security in Northern and Central Malawi
records.title_cn: 社区种子银行对马拉维北部和中部农民种子系统及粮食安全的贡献
records.abstract_en: Community Seed Banks (CSBs) are promoted as an approach to support farmers’ access to quality seeds of adapted varieties. While the adoption and impact of varieties distributed through conventional formal seed systems have been extensively studied, research on how participation in CSBs relates to farmers’ seed systems and food security is limited. This paper uses survey data covering 688 households and 1600 plots from Northern and Central Malawi, combined with historical climate data, to assess the extent to which farmers are utilizing CSBs as a seed source and the association of farmer participation in CSBs with a range of other foods system variables. We find that CSBs are the source of about 1/3 of the seeds of maize, groundnut, and soyabean used by the participants and that they source less of their seeds from their own harvest compared to non-participants. While the use of CSB seeds of different crops shows mixed associations with yields at the plot-level, we find that CSB participation is positively associated with higher household food security overall. Furthermore, we find a positive association between exposure to high mean temperatures and rainfall shortages and the propensity to participate in CSBs, suggesting CSBs play a role in adaptation. This study thus shows that CSB participation is associated with several positive food system outcomes, but more research is needed to understand the causal links as well as the efficiency of CSBs compared to other approaches to strengthen farmers’ seed security.
records.abstract_cn: 社区种子银行（CSBs）被推广为一种支持农民获取适应当地品种优质种子的方法。虽然通过常规正式种子系统分发品种的采用和影响已被广泛研究，但关于参与CSBs与农民种子系统和粮食安全之间关系的研究有限。本文利用覆盖马拉维北部和中部688户家庭和1600块地块的调查数据，结合历史气候数据，评估农民利用CSBs作为种子来源的程度，以及农民参与CSBs与一系列其他粮食系统变量的关联。我们发现，CSBs是参与者使用的玉米、花生和大豆种子中约1/3的来源，且与非参与者相比，他们从自己收成中获取的种子较少。虽然不同作物使用CSB种子与地块层面的产量显示出混合关联，但我们发现CSB参与总体上与更高的家庭粮食安全正相关。此外，我们发现暴露于高平均气温和降雨短缺与参与CSBs的倾向之间存在正相关，表明CSBs在适应中发挥作用。因此，本研究表明CSB参与与若干积极的粮食系统结果相关，但需要更多研究来理解因果联系以及CSBs相对于其他加强农民种子安全方法的效率。

records.title_en: Deposit market concentration and monetary transmission: Evidence from the euro area
records.title_cn: 存款市场集中度与货币政策传导：来自欧元区的证据
records.abstract_en: I study the transmission of monetary policy to deposit rates in the euro area with a focus on asymmetries and the role of banking sector concentration. Using a local projections framework with 2003–2023 country-level and bank-level data for thirteen euro area member states, I find that deposit rates respond symmetrically to an unexpected tightening or easing of monetary policy. However, more concentrated domestic banking sectors do pass-on unexpected monetary tightening (easing) more slowly (quickly) than less concentrated banking sectors, which contributes to a temporary divergence of deposit rates across the euro area. These results suggest that heterogeneity in the degree of banking sector concentration matters for the transmission of monetary policy to deposit rates, which in turn may affect banking sector profitability.
records.abstract_cn: 我研究了欧元区货币政策向存款利率的传导，重点关注不对称性以及银行业集中度的作用。利用一个局部投影框架，结合2003-2023年十三个欧元区成员国的国家和银行层面数据，我发现存款利率对意外的货币政策紧缩或宽松反应是对称的。然而，更集中的国内银行业部门对意外的货币政策紧缩（宽松）的传导速度较慢（较快），这导致了欧元区存款利率的暂时性分化。这些结果表明，银行业集中度的异质性对货币政策向存款利率的传导有影响，进而可能影响银行业的盈利能力。

records.title_en: Make-up strategies with incomplete markets and bounded rationality
records.title_cn: 不完全市场与有限理性下的补偿策略
records.abstract_en: We study the impact of market incompleteness and bounded rationality on the effectiveness of make-up strategies. Using a heterogeneous-agent New Keynesian model with reflective expectations, we show that make-up strategies can mitigate the negative consequences of an occasionally-binding effective lower bound. However, the benefits are small when cognitive ability is in line with micro-evidence. These findings are independent of market (in)completeness, emphasising the importance of rational expectations. While market incompleteness and bounded rationality complement each other in attenuating the effects of forward guidance, we do not observe such a complementarity for the effectiveness of make-up strategies.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了市场不完全性和有限理性对补偿策略有效性的影响。通过使用具有反思性预期的异质性代理人新凯恩斯模型，我们表明补偿策略可以缓解偶尔生效的有效下限带来的负面后果。然而，当认知能力与微观证据一致时，其收益较小。这些发现与市场（不）完全性无关，强调了理性预期的重要性。虽然市场不完全性和有限理性在削弱前瞻指引效应方面相互补充，但我们并未观察到这种互补性对补偿策略有效性的影响。

records.title_en: The dynamics of automation adoption: Firm-level heterogeneity and aggregate employment effects
records.title_cn: 自动化采用动态：企业层面异质性与总体就业效应
records.abstract_en: We investigate the impact of investment in automation-related goods on adopting and non-adopting firms in the Italian economy during 2011–2019. We integrate datasets on trade activities, firms’, and workers’ characteristics for the population of Italian importing firms and estimate the effects on adopters’ outcomes within a difference-in-differences design exploiting import lumpiness in product categories linked to automation technologies (including robots). We find a positive average adoption effect on the adopters’ employment: firms are, on average, around 3% larger in terms of employment after an automation spike. Crucially, the employment effect is heterogeneous across firms: a positive effect is predominant among small firms, which are around 5% larger five years after the spike; on the contrary, a negative displacement effect is predominant among medium and large firms, with an employment contraction at five years of around −4%. This result can shed light on one potential reason behind the mixed results found in previous studies, which often rely on samples with different size distributions. We complete the framework with a 5-digit sector-level analysis showing that adopting automation technologies has an overall weak negative effect on aggregate employment, and with an analysis of the competition effects of automation, showing that non-adopters suffer a loss in sales and employment.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在2011-2019年期间，意大利经济中投资于自动化相关商品对采用和未采用自动化技术的企业的影响。我们整合了意大利进口企业总体中关于贸易活动、企业特征和工人特征的数据集，并利用与自动化技术（包括机器人）相关的产品类别中的进口不连续性，在双重差分设计下估计了对采用者结果的影响。我们发现，自动化采用对采用者就业的平均效应为正：在自动化冲击后，企业平均就业规模大约增加3%。关键在于，就业效应在企业间存在异质性：正效应主要出现在小企业中，这些企业在冲击后五年规模大约增加5%；相反，负的替代效应主要出现在中型和大型企业中，五年后就业收缩约−4%。这一结果可能揭示先前研究中发现混合结果的一个潜在原因，这些研究往往依赖于规模分布不同的样本。我们通过一个5位数行业层面的分析完善了框架，该分析表明采用自动化技术对总体就业有整体微弱的负效应，并通过对自动化竞争效应的分析表明，未采用者在销售和就业方面遭受损失。

records.title_en: Recourse and (strategic) mortgage defaults: Evidence from changes in housing market laws
records.title_cn: 追索权和（战略）抵押贷款违约：来自房地产市场法律变化的证据
records.abstract_en: We study the impact of a legislative change in Romania that retroactively modified mortgage recourse policies, providing a natural experiment to analyze borrower behavior under envolving legal frameworks. Using a granular dataset of mortgage loans originated between 2003 and 2016, combined with individual income tax records, we exploit an exogenous policy shift that transitioned mortgages from a creditor-friendly to a debtor-friendly regime. Our findings provide robust evidence that eliminating penalties for default significantly increased the probability of default among existing borrowers, particularly among high-income individuals and borrowers who are less liquidity-constrained – groups traditionally considered less prone to default. These findings underscore the unintended consequences of retroactive legislative changes, including deteriorated payment discipline and increased strategic default behavior.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了罗马尼亚立法变革的影响，该变革追溯性地修改了抵押贷款追索政策，为分析相关法律框架下借款人的行为提供了一个自然的实验。使用2003和2016之间产生的抵押贷款的详细数据集，结合个人所得税记录，我们利用了一种外生政策转变，将抵押贷款从债权人友好型制度转变为债务人友好型制度。我们的研究结果提供了强有力的证据，表明取消违约处罚显着增加了现有借款人的违约可能性，特别是高收入个人和流动性约束较少的借款人（传统上被认为不太容易违约的群体）。这些发现强调了追溯性立法变革的意外后果，包括支付纪律恶化和战略违约行为增加。

records.title_en: Resolving puzzles of monetary policy transmission in emerging markets
records.title_cn: 破解新兴市场货币政策传导难题
records.abstract_en: Conventional empirical models of monetary policy transmission in emerging market economies produce puzzling results: monetary tightening often leads to an increase in prices (the price puzzle) and depreciation of the currency (the foreign exchange puzzle). This paper shows that incorporating forward-looking expectations into standard open economy structural vector autoregressive models resolves these puzzles. Specifically, the models are augmented with novel survey-based measures of expectations based on consumer, business, and professional forecasts. The findings show that the rise in prices following monetary tightening is related to currency depreciation, so eliminating the foreign exchange puzzle helps solve the price puzzle.
records.abstract_cn: 新兴市场经济体货币政策传导的传统实证模型产生了令人费解的结果：货币紧缩往往导致价格上涨（价格之谜）和货币贬值（外汇之谜）。本文表明，将前瞻性预期纳入标准开放经济结构向量自回归模型可以解决这些难题。具体来说，这些模型通过基于消费者、商业和专业预测的新颖的基于调查的期望测量得到了增强。研究结果表明，货币紧缩带来的物价上涨与货币贬值有关，因此消除外汇难题有助于解决价格难题。

records.title_en: Preying on the young: Intergenerational conflict, rent seeking and growth
records.title_cn: 掠夺年轻人：代际冲突、寻租与增长
records.abstract_en: This paper argues that the distribution of political power across generations in democracies affects rent seeking and growth. The basis for this argument is that it takes time to acquire the skills and connections that are necessary to collect rents. As a result, mostly older individuals can benefit from rent seeking. Consequently, the old use their political power to induce more rents. This activity increases government spending, which crowds out investment, reduces growth and generates rents. The paper explores these ideas, with the help of an infinite overlapping generations model, with probabilistic voting and time consistent government policy. A calibration of the model indicates that it is consistent with key economic features of OECD countries.
records.abstract_cn: 本文认为，民主国家中代际政治权力的分配会影响寻租和增长。这一论点的基础是，获得收取租金所需的技能和人脉关系需要时间。因此，大多数老年人都可以从寻租中受益。因此，老年人利用他们的政治权力来收取更多的租金。这种活动增加了政府支出，从而挤出了投资、降低了增长并产生了租金。本文借助无限重叠代模型、概率投票和时间一致的政府政策探讨了这些想法。模型的校准表明它符合 OECD 国家的主要经济特征。

records.title_en: Coasian equilibria in sequential auctions
records.title_cn: 顺序拍卖中的科斯均衡
records.abstract_en: We study stationary equilibria in a sequential auction setting. A seller runs a sequence of standard first-price or second-price auctions to sell an indivisible object to potential buyers. The seller can commit to the rule of the auction and the reserve price of the current period but not to reserve prices of future periods. We prove the existence of stationary equilibria and establish a uniform Coase conjecture—as the period length goes to zero, the seller’s profit from running sequential auctions converges to the profit of running an efficient auction uniformly across all points in time and all symmetric stationary equilibria.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究顺序拍卖环境中的平稳均衡。卖方进行一系列标准的第一价格或第二价格拍卖，将不可分割的物品出售给潜在买家。卖方可以承诺拍卖规则和当期的保留价，但不能承诺未来各期的保留价。我们证明了平稳均衡的存在，并建立了统一的科斯猜想——当周期长度变为零时，卖方通过连续拍卖获得的利润收敛于在所有时间点和所有对称平稳均衡上统一进行有效拍卖的利润。

records.title_en: The wealth of working nations
records.title_cn: 劳动国家的财富
records.abstract_en: Due to aging populations, the gap between GDP growth per capita and GDP growth per working-age adult (or per hour worked) has widened in many advanced economies. Countries like Japan, which have shown lackluster GDP growth per capita, have performed surprisingly well in terms of GDP growth per working-age adult (or per hour worked). Many advanced economies are also following similar balanced growth paths per working-age adult despite significant differences in the levels of GDP per working-age adult. We calibrate a standard neoclassical growth model to reflect changes in the working-age population for each economy. This model aligns more closely with the data for all the economies in our sample when we match GDP growth per working-age adult rather than when we match GDP growth per capita, the “canonical” calibration target.
records.abstract_cn: 由于人口老龄化，许多发达经济体的人均 GDP 增长与每个工作年龄成年人（或每小时工作）的 GDP 增长之间的差距已经扩大。日本等人均 GDP 增长乏力的国家，在人均劳动年龄成年人（或每小时工作）的 GDP 增长方面却表现出奇的好。尽管每个工作年龄成年人的 GDP 水平存在显着差异，但许多发达经济体也遵循类似的每个工作年龄成年人的平衡增长路径。我们校准标准的新古典增长模型，以反映每个经济体劳动年龄人口的变化。当我们匹配每个工作年龄成年人的 GDP 增长时，而不是当我们匹配人均 GDP 增长（“规范”校准目标）时，该模型与我们样本中所有经济体的数据更加一致。

records.title_en: Reallocation, productivity, and monetary policy in an energy crisis
records.title_cn: 能源危机中的重新分配、生产率和货币政策
records.abstract_en: This paper presents a New Keynesian multi-sector model incorporating firm heterogeneity, entry-exit dynamics, and energy production from both fossil fuels and renewables. We investigate the effects of a sustained increase in fossil fuel prices on sectoral size, labor productivity, and inflation. A rise in fossil fuel prices leads to higher energy costs. Due to ex-ante heterogeneity in energy intensity, sectoral profitability is impacted asymmetrically. As production costs rise, new entrants must have higher idiosyncratic productivity to remain profitable, boosting average labor productivity but reducing firm entry and the number of active firms in each sector. When the price effects of the shock are persistent, a central bank with a strong anti-inflationary stance can mitigate the resulting inflation by curbing wage costs. This policy entails higher output costs and a milder response in average productivity, but enables a faster recovery in business dynamism. Our results thus reveal a novel trade-off for monetary policy between stabilizing aggregate activity and business dynamism.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种新凯恩斯主义多部门模型，该模型结合了企业异质性、进入-退出动态以及化石燃料和可再生能源的能源生产。我们研究化石燃料价格持续上涨对部门规模、劳动生产率和通货膨胀的影响。化石燃料价格上涨导致能源成本上升。由于能源强度的事前异质性，部门盈利能力受到不对称的影响。随着生产成本上升，新进入者必须拥有更高的特殊生产率才能保持盈利，从而提高平均劳动生产率，但减少企业进入和每个部门的活跃企业数量。当冲击的价格影响持续存在时，采取强有力的反通胀立场的央行可以通过抑制工资成本来缓解由此产生的通胀。这一政策会带来更高的产出成本和对平均生产率的温和反应，但可以更快地恢复商业活力。因此，我们的结果揭示了货币政策在稳定总体活动和商业活力之间的一种新颖的权衡。

records.title_en: Explaining institutional technology
records.title_cn: 解释制度技术
records.abstract_en: This paper offers a review and several refinements and extensions of Explaining Technology, by Koppl et al. (2023), which develops a combinatorial theory of the evolution of technology. First, we suggest that the mechanism of tinkering can be formulated in the theory of user innovation. Second, we propose that a useful refinement is to focus on institutional technologies. This offers a better explanation of emergent levels of evolutionary selection, or major transitions, and also adapts their framework to better explain the nature of a digital economy. Third, we propose a more ambitious line of generalisation from explaining technology to explaining knowledge. We suggest this is possible from the rubric of the new ‘physics of information’ in constructor theory, assembly theory and Bayesian mechanics.
records.abstract_cn: 本文对 Koppl 等人的解释技术进行了回顾以及一些改进和扩展。 （2023），它发展了技术演化的组合理论。首先，我们建议可以在用户创新理论中制定修补机制。其次，我们建议一个有用的改进是关注制度技术。这为进化选择或重大转变的新兴水平提供了更好的解释，并且还调整了他们的框架以更好地解释数字经济的本质。第三，我们提出了一条从解释技术到解释知识的更雄心勃勃的概括路线。我们认为，从构造函数理论、装配理论和贝叶斯力学中新的“信息物理学”的标题来看，这是可能的。

records.title_en: Monetary–fiscal interaction and the liquidity of government debt
records.title_cn: 货币财政互动与政府债务流动性
records.abstract_en: How does the monetary and fiscal policy mix alter households’ saving incentives? To answer these questions, we build a heterogeneous agents New Keynesian model where three different types of agents can save in assets with different liquidity profiles to insure against idiosyncratic risk. Policy mixes affect saving incentives differently according to their effect on the liquidity premium- the return difference between less liquid assets and public debt. We derive an intuitive analytical expression linking the liquidity premium with consumption differentials amongst different types of agents. This underscores the presence of a transmission mechanism through which the interaction of monetary and fiscal policy shapes economic stability via its effect on the portfolio choice of private agents. We call it the self-insurance demand channel, which moves the liquidity premium in the opposite direction to the standard policy-driven supply channel. Our analysis thus reveals the presence of two competing forces driving the liquidity premium. We show that the relative strength of the two is tightly linked to the policy mix in place and the type of business cycle shock hitting the economy. This implies that to stabilize the economy, monetary policy should consider the impact of the self-insurance on the liquidity premium.
records.abstract_cn: 货币和财政政策组合如何改变家庭的储蓄动机？为了回答这些问题，我们构建了一个异构代理新凯恩斯主义模型，其中三种不同类型的代理可以保存具有不同流动性状况的资产，以防范特殊风险。政策组合根据其对流动性溢价（流动性较低的资产与公共债务之间的回报差）的影响，对储蓄激励产生不同的影响。我们得出了一个直观的分析表达式，将流动性溢价与不同类型代理之间的消费差异联系起来。这强调了一种传导机制的存在，通过这种机制，货币和财政政策的相互作用通过影响私人机构的投资组合选择来塑造经济稳定。我们称之为自保需求渠道，它将流动性溢价向与标准政策驱动的供给渠道相反的方向移动。因此，我们的分析揭示了驱动流动性溢价的两种竞争力量的存在。我们表明，两者的相对强度与现行政策组合和经济周期冲击的类型密切相关。这意味着，为了稳定经济，货币政策应该考虑自我保险对流动性溢价的影响。

records.title_en: Exporters, multinationals and residual wage inequality: Evidence and theory
records.title_cn: 出口商、跨国公司和剩余工资不平等：证据和理论
records.abstract_en: A growing empirical literature underscores the pivotal role of ”global firms” in shaping labour market outcomes, including inequality. These are firms that participate in the international economy across multiple dimensions, including both trade and foreign direct investment (FDI). This prompts an important question: Is wage inequality among workers with similar characteristics primarily influenced by firms engaged solely in exporting, those involved solely in FDI, or by multinational enterprises (MNEs) that do both? Using linked employer–employee panel data for Germany, this paper unveils nuanced patterns in wage premia among various internationalising establishments, where I identify sorting between workers and establishments as a key driver. I interpret these patterns using a theoretical model that incorporates trade and FDI with monopolistic competition, wherein heterogeneous firms operate within frictional labour markets as they search for workers. My model gives rise to a novel channel for the MNE wage premium, stemming from their ability to transfer their human resource practices to their plant abroad.
records.abstract_cn: 越来越多的实证文献强调“全球企业”在塑造劳动力市场结果（包括不平等）方面的关键作用。这些公司在多个层面参与国际经济，包括贸易和外国直接投资 (FDI)。这就提出了一个重要问题：具有相似特征的工人之间的工资不平等是否主要受到仅从事出口的公司、仅参与外国直接投资的公司或同时从事这两种业务的跨国企业（MNE）的影响？本文使用德国关联的雇主-雇员面板数据，揭示了各种国际化企业之间工资溢价的微妙模式，其中我认为工人和企业之间的分类是一个关键驱动因素。我使用一个理论模型来解释这些模式，该模型将贸易和外国直接投资与垄断竞争结合起来，其中异质企业在寻找工人时在摩擦性劳动力市场中运作。我的模型为跨国公司工资溢价创造了一个新的渠道，源于他们将人力资源实践转移到国外工厂的能力。

records.title_en: Delegation of learning from multiple sources of information
records.title_cn: 委托从多种信息来源学习
records.abstract_en: A principal delegates a decision to a biased expert. Before taking the decision, the expert may undertake incremental learning about the unknown binary state from two alternative information sources. There are no transfers but the principal retains the right to terminate the expert’s learning to take the decision herself. The right to terminate learning benefits the principal when the preferences of the principal and the expert are sufficiently misaligned but may be detrimental when the preferences are sufficiently closely aligned.
records.abstract_cn: 委托人将决定委托给有偏见的专家。在做出决定之前，专家可以从两个替代信息源对未知的二元状态进行增量学习。没有转让，但委托人保留终止专家学习以自行做出决定的权利。当委托人与专家的偏好充分不一致时，终止学习的权利对委托人有利，但当偏好足够接近时，终止学习的权利可能是有害的。

records.title_en: Growth and adaptation to climate change in the long run
records.title_cn: 从长远来看，增长和适应气候变化
records.abstract_en: As the climate is changing, the global economy is adapting. This paper describes a novel method of estimating climate adaptation globally. We quantify how much the global economy has adapted to climate change historically, how much it has cost, and how much it has reduced the direct impacts of climate change. The method is based on a structurally estimated model of long-run growth, which identifies how changes in consumption, fertility, innovation, and land use allow the economy to adapt to climate change. Agriculture plays a key role, because it is vulnerable to climate change and food cannot be perfectly substituted. We estimate that adaptation has been highly effective in reducing negative climate impacts on agricultural production. However, the cost of adaptation has been a reallocation of resources out of the rest of the economy, which has in effect slowed down the process of structural change out of agriculture into manufacturing and services. We also use the model to estimate optimal future carbon taxation. Because adaptation is effective but costly, reducing future greenhouse gas emissions would improve welfare substantially.
records.abstract_cn: 随着气候的变化，全球经济也在适应。本文描述了一种估计全球气候适应的新方法。我们量化历史上全球经济适应气候变化的程度、成本以及减少气候变化直接影响的程度。该方法基于长期增长的结构估计模型，该模型确定了消费、生育率、创新和土地利用的变化如何使经济适应气候变化。农业发挥着关键作用，因为它容易受到气候变化的影响，而且粮食无法完全替代。我们估计，适应对于减少气候对农业生产的负面影响非常有效。然而，适应的成本是从其他经济部门重新分配资源，这实际上减缓了从农业到制造业和服务业的结构转型进程。我们还使用该模型来估计未来的最佳碳税。由于适应措施有效但成本高昂，减少未来温室气体排放将大幅改善福利。

records.title_en: Strategic parental investments in a competitive marriage market
records.title_cn: 竞争激烈的婚姻市场中的战略性父母投资
records.abstract_en: We examine the effect of a more male-biased local sex ratio on the difference between parental investments in boys and in girls in China. Relative to parents with a first-born girl, parents of a first-born boy increase labor supply and migration as the male bias in the local sex ratio rises, and they change their investment composition: they increase housing investment while reducing educational investment. These findings provide support for a theoretical model of premarital investments, where men who are in excess supply on the marriage market, are unable to commit to sharing future labor income at the time of marriage, making housing a more credible commitment device. We also discuss alternative explanations that may align with the empirical evidence. Our empirical strategy employs a novel instrument for the local sex ratio.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了中国男性偏重的当地性别比例对父母对男孩和女孩的投资差异的影响。相对于一胎女孩的父母，一胎男孩的父母随着当地性别比例的男性偏见上升而增加了劳动力供给和人口流动，并改变了投资结构：增加住房投资，同时减少教育投资。这些发现为婚前投资的理论模型提供了支持，即婚姻市场上供应过剩的男性无法承诺在结婚时分享未来的劳动收入，从而使住房成为更可信的承诺工具。我们还讨论了可能与经验证据相符的替代解释。我们的实证策略采用了一种新颖的工具来测量当地的性别比例。

records.title_en: Status classification by lottery contests
records.title_cn: 按抽奖比赛的状态分类
records.abstract_en: We study the optimal design of status classifications in organizational structures under the assumption that agents in a lottery (Tullock) contest care about their relative position. For each such a contest with any number of status categories that is smaller than or equal to the number of agents, we provide sufficient conditions for the optimal partition, which is the distribution of agents among the status categories that maximizes the agents’ symmetric equilibrium effort. We show that, for any number of status categories, in the optimal partition of status categories, the higher the status category, the more agents are included in it. However, in the optimal partition of status categories, a higher status category may not contain more agents than a lower status category when agents receive monetary rewards in addition to the payoff from their relative position (status).
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了组织结构中状态分类的优化设计，假设彩票（塔洛克）竞赛中的代理人关心他们的相对位置。对于每个这样的具有小于或等于代理数量的任何数量的状态类别的竞争，我们为最佳划分提供充分的条件，即代理在状态类别中的分配，以最大化代理的对称均衡努力。我们表明，对于任意数量的状态类别，在状态类别的最佳划分中，状态类别越高，其中包含的代理越多。然而，在状态类别的最优划分中，当主体除了从其相对位置（状态）获得的收益之外还获得金钱奖励时，较高状态类别可能不会比较低状态类别包含更多主体。

records.title_en: Presidential Address: The Economist as Designer in the Innovation Process for Socially Impactful Digital Products
records.title_cn: 主席致辞：经济学家作为具有社会影响力的数字产品创新过程中的设计师
records.abstract_en: This paper provides an economic perspective on data-driven innovation in digital products, focusing on the role of complex experiments in measuring and improving social impact. The discussion highlights how tools and insights from economics contribute to each stage of the innovation process. Key contributions include identifying problems, developing theoretical frameworks, translating goals into measurable outcomes, analyzing historical data, and estimating counterfactual outcomes. The paper also surveys recently developed tools designed to address challenges in designing and analyzing data from complex experiments.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提供了数字产品中数据驱动创新的经济学视角，重点关注复杂实验在衡量和改善社会影响方面的作用。讨论强调了经济学的工具和见解如何为创新过程的每个阶段做出贡献。主要贡献包括识别问题、开发理论框架、将目标转化为可衡量的结果、分析历史数据以及估计反事实结果。本文还调查了最近开发的工具，旨在解决设计和分析复杂实验数据的挑战。

records.title_en: Fragile New Economy: Intangible Capital, Corporate Savings Glut, and Financial Instability
records.title_cn: 脆弱的新经济：无形资本、企业储蓄过剩和金融不稳定
records.abstract_en: The transition toward an intangible-intensive economy reshapes financial systems by creating a self-perpetuating savings glut in the production sector. As intangibles become increasingly important, firms hoard liquidity to finance investment in intangibles of limited pledgeability. Firms' savings feed cheap leverage to financial intermediaries and allow intermediaries to bid up asset prices, which in turn encourages firms to save more for asset creation. This paper develops a macrofinance model that offers a coherent account of rising corporate savings, debt-fueled growth of intermediaries, declining interest rates, and rising asset valuation. Along these secular trends, endogenous financial risk accumulates.
records.abstract_cn: 向无形密集型经济的转型通过在生产部门造成自我延续的储蓄过剩来重塑金融体系。随着无形资产变得越来越重要，企业囤积流动性来为可质押性有限的无形资产的投资提供资金。企业的储蓄为金融中介机构提供了廉价的杠杆，并允许中介机构抬高资产价格，这反过来又鼓励企业为资产创造而储蓄更多。本文开发了一个宏观金融模型，对企业储蓄增加、债务推动的中介机构增长、利率下降和资产估值上升提供了连贯的解释。沿着这些长期趋势，内生性金融风险不断累积。

records.title_en: Trade Shocks and Credit Reallocation
records.title_cn: 贸易冲击和信贷重新分配
records.abstract_en: This paper identifies a credit-supply contraction that arises endogenously after trade liberalization. Banks with loan portfolios concentrated in sectors exposed to competition from China face an increase in nonperforming loans after China's entry into the World Trade Organization. As a result, they reduce the supply of credit to firms, irrespective of the firm's sector of operation. This cut in credit translates into lower employment, investment, and output. Through this mechanism, the financial channel amplifies the shock to firms already hit by import competition from China and passes it on to firms in sectors expected to expand upon trade liberalization.
records.abstract_cn: 本文指出了贸易自由化后内生出现的信贷供给收缩。中国加入世界贸易组织后，贷款组合集中于面临中国竞争的行业的银行将面临不良贷款增加的问题。结果，它们减少了对公司的信贷供应，无论公司的经营部门如何。信贷削减导致就业、投资和产出下降。通过这一机制，金融渠道放大了对已经受到中国进口竞争打击的企业的冲击，并将其传递给预计将在贸易自由化后扩张的行业的企业。

records.title_en: Product Differentiation and Oligopoly: A Network Approach
records.title_cn: 产品差异化和寡头垄断：网络方法
records.abstract_en: I present a new theory of oligopoly and markups in general equilibrium, based on an innovative, scalable hedonic demand system, which I take to the data for the universe of US public firms. In my model, firms compete in a network of product market rivalries that emerge endogenously out of the characteristics of the products they supply. I estimate that consumer surplus is almost three times as large as profits; decompose firm-level markups into metrics of quality-adjusted productivity and market centrality; and analyze the extent, evolution, and drivers of monopoly power in the United States between 1995 and 2021.
records.abstract_cn: 我提出了一种新的一般均衡中的寡头垄断和加价理论，该理论基于创新的、可扩展的享乐需求系统，并将其应用于美国上市公司的数据中。在我的模型中，企业在产品市场竞争网络中进行竞争，这些竞争是从它们所提供的产品的特性中内生出来的。我估计消费者剩余几乎是利润的 三 倍；将公司层面的加价分解为质量调整后的生产率和市场中心度的指标；并分析 1995 和 2021 之间美国垄断权力的程度、演变和驱动因素。

records.title_en: Weighted Linear Discrete Choice
records.title_cn: 加权线性离散选择
records.abstract_en: We introduce a new model of stochastic choice that assigns each choice option a utility, along with a salience parameter reflecting economic frictions. We characterize our model behaviorally and investigate its comparative statics properties. We show that the model generates intuitive closed-form solutions in equilibrium settings where firms can choose price, quality, and advertising. In addition, we show that the model allows for flexible substitution patterns and changes in market shares across choice sets. We demonstrate that our model can be easily identified and can outperform alternatives in demand prediction.
records.abstract_cn: 我们引入了一种新的随机选择模型，为每个选择选项分配一个效用，以及反映经济摩擦的显着性参数。我们从行为上表征我们的模型并研究其比较静态特性。我们表明，该模型在均衡设置下生成直观的封闭式解决方案，企业可以在其中选择价格、质量和广告。此外，我们还表明该模型允许灵活的替代模式和跨选择集的市场份额变化。我们证明，我们的模型可以轻松识别，并且在需求预测方面优于其他模型。

records.title_en: Fighting Climate Change: International Attitudes toward Climate Policies
records.title_cn: 应对气候变化：国际社会对气候政策的态度
records.abstract_en: This paper explores global perceptions and understanding of climate change and policies, examining factors that influence support for climate action and the impact of different types of information. We conduct large-scale surveys with 40,000 respondents from 20 countries, providing new international data on attitudes toward climate change and respondents' socioeconomic backgrounds and lifestyles. We identify three key perceptions affecting policy support: perceived effectiveness of policies in reducing emissions, their impact on low-income households, and their effect on respondents' households (self-interest). Educational videos clarifying policy mechanisms increase support for climate policies; those merely highlighting climate change's impacts do not.
records.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了全球对气候变化和政策的看法和理解，研究了影响气候行动支持的因素以及不同类型信息的影响。我们对来自 40,000 国家的 20 受访者进行了大规模调查，提供了有关气候变化态度以及受访者社会经济背景和生活方式的新国际数据。我们确定了 三 影响政策支持的关键看法：减排政策的有效性、对低收入家庭的影响以及对受访者家庭的影响（自身利益）。澄清政策机制的教育视频增加了对气候政策的支持；那些仅仅强调气候变化影响的文章则没有。

records.title_en: When Money Dies: The Dynamics of Speculative Hyperinflations
records.title_cn: 当金钱消亡时：投机性恶性通货膨胀的动态
records.abstract_en: How quickly does a fiat money become valueless? I study the speculative hyperinflation equilibria of continuous-time economies with decentralized markets where money is essential. I establish necessary and sufficient conditions under which money dies in finite time. A necessary condition is that the liquidity return of money grows unbounded as the value of money approaches zero. Under CRRA preferences, the longevity of money shrinks with the money growth rate and the frequency of liquidity needs, but it increases with seller's market power. Money duration also depends on the strictness of legal restrictions and the rates of return of competing currencies.
records.abstract_cn: 法定货币多久就会变得毫无价值？我研究了连续时间经济体的投机性恶性通货膨胀均衡，该经济体具有分散的市场，其中货币至关重要。我建立了货币在有限时间内消亡的充分必要条件。一个必要条件是，随着货币价值接近 零，货币的流动性回报无限增长。在CRRA偏好下，货币寿命随着货币增长率和流动性需求频率的增加而缩短，但随着卖方市场力量的增加而增加。资金期限还取决于法律限制的严格程度和竞争货币的回报率。

records.title_en: Cultural Distance and Ethnic Civil Conflict
records.title_cn: 文化距离与民族内部冲突
records.abstract_en: Ethnically diverse countries are more prone to conflict, but why do some groups engage in conflict, while others do not? I show that civil conflict in Africa is explained by ethnic groups' cultural distance to the central government: an increase in cultural distance, proxied by linguistic distance, increases an ethnicity's propensity to fight over government power. To identify this effect, I leverage within-ethnicity variation in linguistic distance resulting from power transitions between ethnic groups over time. I provide evidence that the effects can be attributed to differences in preferences over both the allocation and the type of public goods.
records.abstract_cn: 种族多元化的国家更容易发生冲突，但为什么有些群体会发生冲突，而另一些群体却不会呢？我表明，非洲的内部冲突是由族群与中央政府的文化距离来解释的：以语言距离为代表的文化距离的增加，增加了族群争夺政府权力的倾向。为了确定这种影响，我利用了种族内部随着时间的推移权力转移而导致的语言距离差异。我提供的证据表明，这种影响可以归因于对公共物品的分配和类型的偏好差异。

records.title_en: Naive calibration
records.title_cn: 天真的校准
records.abstract_en: We develop a model of non-Bayesian decision-making in which an agent obtains an estimate of the state of a relevant economic fundamental but does not know the joint distribution of the two. To make use of the estimate, she relies on an endogenously generated dataset that consists of previous estimates and state realizations. She attributes a systematic difference between the estimates and state realizations in her dataset to a systematic bias in the estimate and naively calibrates it. Her subsequent action affects the probability with which the estimate and the corresponding state realization will be recorded in the dataset that will be used in future decisions. We investigate the steady state of the naive calibration procedure and show that it results in a seemingly pessimistic behavior that is exacerbated by feedback loops. We apply our model to project selection problems and second-price IPV auctions.
records.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个非贝叶斯决策模型，其中代理人获得了相关经济基本面状态的估计值，但不知道估计值与状态的联合分布。为了利用该估计值，代理人依赖一个内生生成的数据集，该数据集由先前的估计值和状态实现组成。她将数据集中估计值与状态实现之间的系统性差异归因于估计值的系统性偏差，并天真地对其进行校准。其后续行为会影响估计值及相应状态实现被记录进未来决策所用数据集的概率。我们研究了天真校准程序的稳态，发现其导致一种表面上悲观的行为，并且该行为因反馈循环而加剧。我们将模型应用于项目选择问题和价格IPV拍卖。

records.title_en: Markovian persuasion
records.title_cn: 马尔可夫说服
records.abstract_en: In the classical Bayesian persuasion model, an informed player and an uninformed one engage in a static interaction. This work extends this classical model to a dynamic setting where the state of nature evolves according to a Markovian law, allowing for a more realistic representation of real-world situations where the state of nature evolves over time. In this repeated persuasion model, an optimal disclosure strategy of the sender must balance between obtaining a high-stage payoff and disclosing information that may have negative implications on future payoffs. We discuss optimal strategies under different discount factors and characterize when the asymptotic value achieves the maximal possible value.
records.abstract_cn: 在经典的贝叶斯说服模型中，一名知情玩家与一名不知情玩家进行静态互动。本文将该经典模型扩展到动态情境，其中自然状态按照马尔可夫规律演变，从而更真实地反映自然状态随时间变化的现实情况。在该重复说服模型中，发送者的最优信息披露策略必须在获得高阶段收益与披露可能对未来收益产生负面影响的信息之间取得平衡。我们讨论了不同贴现因子下的最优策略，并刻画了渐近价值何时达到最大可能值。

records.title_en: Transparent matching mechanisms
records.title_cn: 透明匹配机制
records.abstract_en: In the standard one-to-one agent-object matching model, I consider a central matching authority that publicly announces a strategy-proof mechanism and then initiates a matching. Following Akbarpour and Li (2020), the authority's commitment to the announced mechanism is limited to mechanisms rendering participants' observations indistinguishable from it. I call an announced mechanism transparent. if any deviation from it would be detected. The main findings identify trade-offs regarding transparency and other desirable properties: under stability or efficiency, strategy-proof mechanisms are transparent if and only if they are dictatorial. At the same time, the agent-proposing Deferred Acceptance (DA) mechanism is equivalent to committing to stability, while efficient mechanisms often fail to commit to efficiency. This transparency trade-off between stability and efficiency persists when strategy-proofness is guaranteed.
records.abstract_cn: 在标准的一到一的代理-对象匹配模型中，我考虑一个中央匹配机构，该机构公开宣布一个策略无关机制，然后启动匹配。继Akbarpour和Li（2020）之后，机构对所宣布机制的承诺仅限于使参与者的观察无法与之区分的机制。我称所宣布的机制为透明机制，如果任何偏离该机制的行为都会被检测到。主要发现识别了关于透明性和其他期望属性的权衡：在稳定性或效率条件下，策略无关机制当且仅当是独裁机制时才是透明的。与此同时，代理提出的延迟接受（DA）机制等同于承诺稳定性，而高效机制往往无法承诺效率。当保证策略无关性时，这种稳定性与效率之间的透明性权衡依然存在。

records.title_en: Chaos and unpredictability with time inconsistent policy makers
records.title_cn: 具有时间不一致政策制定者的混沌与不可预测性
records.abstract_en: We analyze the existence of equilibria with complex dynamics in a policy framework with time-inconsistency. We consider an economy where, in each period, the policy maker in power determines the level of a durable public good (or bad) that creates strategic linkages across policy periods. When the decision-making process is time-consistent---such as when a benevolent planner sets policy in every period---the economy exhibits a unique equilibrium where the state converges to a deterministic steady state. When the identity of the decision-maker changes probabilistically over time as in a political equilibrium, the decision-making process becomes time-inconsistent. In this scenario, we identify conditions under which equilibria with cycles of more than two periods and chaotic dynamics can emerge. Depending on the economy's fundamental parameters, these equilibria may produce ergodic distributions in which the state variable either persistently overshoots the planner's steady state or fluctuates around it. The extent of chaotic behavior is influenced by the degree of time inconsistency: as the degree of time inconsistency approaches zero, the size of the support of the ergodic distribution converges to zero as well.
records.abstract_cn: 我们分析了在时间不一致政策框架下具有复杂动态的均衡存在性。我们考虑一个经济体，其中每一时期，掌权的政策制定者决定耐用公共物品（或公共坏物）的水平，该物品在政策时期之间产生战略联系。当决策过程是时间一致的——例如当一个仁慈的规划者在每个时期设定政策时——经济表现出唯一均衡，状态收敛到确定性的稳态。当决策者的身份随时间以概率方式变化，如政治均衡中所示，决策过程变为时间不一致。在这种情形下，我们确定了均衡可能出现周期超过二时期及混沌动态的条件。根据经济的基本参数，这些均衡可能产生遍历分布，其中状态变量要么持续超越规划者的稳态，要么围绕其波动。混沌行为的程度受时间不一致程度的影响：随着时间不一致程度接近零，遍历分布的支撑大小也收敛到零。

records.title_en: Coordination with sequential information acquisition
records.title_cn: 具有顺序信息获取的协调
records.abstract_en: We investigate how differences in initial beliefs and sequential information choices affect the likelihood of coordination failure. To do so, we embed interim information acquisition (i.e., information acquisition after observing initial private information) into a standard global game mode with a normal information structure and improper prior. We find that the likelihood of coordination on welfare-inferior equilibrium is invariant to precision, cost, and availability of information. We show that agents’ information choices feature two-sided inefficiency where too many agents with high posteriors and too few agents with low posteriors acquire information. Instead, under efficient information choices, the likelihood of coordination failure vanishes as the number of signals that agents can acquire tends to infinity. Unfortunately, efficient information choices are not implementable unless policymakers can observe agents’ private information.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了初始信念差异和顺序信息选择如何影响协调失败的可能性。为此，我们将中期信息获取（即在观察初始私人信息后获取信息）嵌入到具有正态信息结构和不当先验的标准全球博弈模型中。我们发现，协调于福利较差均衡的可能性对信息的精确度、成本和可用性保持不变。我们表明，代理人的信息选择表现出二单边低效性，即后验较高的代理人获取信息过多，而后验较低的代理人获取信息过少。相反，在有效的信息选择下，随着代理人可获取信号数量趋于无穷，协调失败的可能性消失。不幸的是，除非政策制定者能够观察代理人的私人信息，否则有效的信息选择无法实现。

records.title_en: Mechanism design for acquisition of/stochastic evidence
records.title_cn: 获取/随机证据的机制设计
records.abstract_en: We explore two interrelated models of ``hard information.'' In the evidence--acquisition model, an agent with private information searches for evidence to show the principal about her type. In the signal--choice model, a privately informed agent chooses an action generating a random signal whose realization may be correlated with her type. The signal--choice model is a special case and, as we show, under certain conditions, a reduced form of the evidence--acquisition model. We develop tools for characterizing optimal mechanisms for these models by giving conditions under which some aspects of the principal's optimal choices can be identified only from the information structure, without regard to the utility functions or the principal's priors.
records.abstract_cn: 我们探讨了二相互关联的“硬信息”模型。在证据获取模型中，具有私人信息的代理人搜索证据以向委托人展示其类型。在信号选择模型中，私人知情的代理人选择一个动作，该动作生成一个随机信号，其实现可能与代理人的类型相关。信号选择模型是证据获取模型的一个特例，并且如我们所示，在某些条件下，是证据获取模型的简化形式。我们开发了用于刻画这些模型最优机制的工具，给出了在何种条件下委托人最优选择的某些方面仅能从信息结构中识别，而无需考虑效用函数或委托人的先验。

records.title_en: Strategic exits in stochastic partnerships: the curse of profitability
records.title_cn: 随机合伙中的战略退出：盈利的诅咒
records.abstract_en: We study dynamic partnerships where the output evolves stochastically, each player can exit at any time, and players who have exited continue to accrue some benefits if the remaining players keep contributing to the partnership. Players can strategically exit to free-ride on their partners' contributions, knowing that it may trigger subsequent exits of their partners. We characterize the unique Pareto-optimal equilibrium. When players have sufficiently large free-riding incentives and a medium level of mutual reliance, this equilibrium exhibits a curse of profitability: An increase in the partnership's output may strictly harm all the players. Another main finding is that Pareto-improvement can be achieved if any player commits not to exit first.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究动态合伙关系，其中产出随机演变，每个参与者可以随时退出，且已退出的参与者如果剩余参与者继续为合伙贡献，仍能获得部分收益。参与者可以战略性地退出以搭便车利用合伙伙伴的贡献，且他们知道这可能引发伙伴的后续退出。我们刻画了唯一的帕累托最优均衡。当参与者具有足够大的搭便车激励和中等水平的相互依赖时，该均衡表现出盈利的诅咒：合伙产出的增加可能严格损害所有参与者。另一个主要发现是，如果任何参与者承诺不退出，帕累托改进是可以实现的。

records.title_en: Lemonade from lemons: information design and adverse selection
records.title_cn: 以柠檬做柠檬水：信息设计与逆向选择
records.abstract_en: A seller posts a price for a single object. The seller's and buyer's values may be interdependent. We characterize the set of payoff vectors across all information structures. Simple feasibility and individual-rationality constraints identify the payoff set. The buyer can obtain the entire surplus; often, non-informational mechanisms cannot enlarge the payoff set. We also study payoffs when the buyer is more informed than the seller, and when the buyer is fully informed. All three payoff sets coincide (only) in notable special cases-in particular, when there is complete breakdown in a "lemons market" with an uninformed seller and fully-informed buyer.
records.abstract_cn: 卖方为单一物品公布价格。卖方和买方的价值可能相互依赖。我们刻画了所有信息结构下的收益向量集合。简单的可行性和个体理性约束确定了收益集合。买方可以获得全部剩余；通常，非信息机制无法扩大收益集合。我们还研究了买方比卖方更知情以及买方完全知情时的收益。所有三收益集合仅在显著特殊情况下重合——特别是在“柠檬市场”中，卖方不知情而买方完全知情时，市场完全崩溃。

records.title_en: Bayesian games with nested information
records.title_cn: 具有嵌套信息的贝叶斯博弈
records.abstract_en: A Bayesian game is said to have nested information if the players are ordered, and each player knows the types of all players that follow her in that order. We prove that all multiplayer Bayesian games with finite actions spaces, bounded payoffs, Polish type spaces, and nested information admit a Bayesian equilibrium.
records.abstract_cn: 如果玩家有序排列，且每个玩家知道在该顺序中所有排在其之后的玩家的类型，则称贝叶斯博弈具有嵌套信息。我们证明了所有具有有限行动空间、有界收益、波兰类型空间和嵌套信息的多玩家贝叶斯博弈均存在贝叶斯均衡。

records.title_en: Choice or competition: does integration benefit everyone?
records.title_cn: 选择还是竞争：整合是否惠及所有人？
records.abstract_en: Matching markets are often fragmented, organized at a small local level. While integration of matching markets may lead to welfare gains by expanding choice, it may also harm some market participants by increasing competition for the same resources. We show that every "good" mechanism fails the monotonicity requirement that no individuals be hurt by integration. Then we provide characterization results that identify conditions under which monotonicity becomes compatible with other desirable properties of matching mechanisms.
records.abstract_cn: 匹配市场通常是分散的，在较小的地方层面组织。虽然匹配市场的整合可能通过扩大选择带来福利增益，但也可能因增加对相同资源的竞争而损害部分市场参与者。我们证明了每一种“良好”机制都未能满足单调性要求，即整合不应伤害任何个体。随后，我们提供了表征结果，识别出单调性与匹配机制其他理想属性兼容的条件。

records.title_en: Binary choice under asymmetric loss in a data‐rich environment: Theory and an application to algorithmic fairness
records.title_cn: 数据丰富环境中不对称损失下的二元选择：算法公平性的理论与应用
records.abstract_en: We study the binary choice problem in a data‐rich environment with asymmetric loss functions. The econometrics literature covers nonparametric binary choice problems but does not offer computationally attractive solutions in data‐rich environments. The machine learning literature has many algorithms but is focused mostly on loss functions that are independent of covariates. We show that theoretically valid decisions on binary outcomes with general loss functions can be achieved via a very simple loss‐based reweighting of logistic regression or state‐of‐the‐art machine learning techniques. We apply our analysis to algorithmic fairness in pretrial detentions.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究具有不对称损失函数的数据丰富环境中的二元选择问题。计量经济学文献涵盖了非参数二元选择问题，但没有在数据丰富的环境中提供计算上有吸引力的解决方案。机器学习文献有许多算法，但主要关注独立于协变量的损失函数。我们表明，理论上可以通过非常简单的基于损失的逻辑回归重新加权或最先进的机器学习技术来实现对具有一般损失函数的二元结果的有效决策。我们将分析应用于审前拘留中的算法公平性。

records.title_en: DeepHAM: A global solution method for heterogeneous agent models with aggregate shocks
records.title_cn: DeepHAM：一种针对具有总量冲击的异质代理模型的全球解决方法
records.abstract_en: We propose an efficient, reliable, and interpretable global solution method, the Deep learning‐based algorithm for Heterogeneous Agent Models (DeepHAM), for solving high‐dimensional heterogeneous agent models with aggregate shocks. The state distribution is approximately represented by a set of optimal generalized moments. Deep neural networks are used to approximate the value and policy functions, and the objective is optimized over directly simulated paths. In addition to being an accurate global solver, this method has three additional features. First, it is computationally efficient in solving complex heterogeneous agent models, and it does not suffer from the curse of dimensionality. Second, it provides a general and interpretable representation of the distribution over individual states, which is crucial in addressing the classical question of whether and how heterogeneity matters in macroeconomics. Third, it solves the constrained efficiency problem as easily as it solves the competitive equilibrium, which opens up new possibilities for normative studies. As a new application, we study constrained efficiency in heterogeneous agent models with aggregate shocks. We find that in the presence of aggregate risk, a utilitarian planner would raise aggregate capital for redistribution less than in absence of it because poor households do more precautionary savings and thus rely less on labor income.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种高效、可靠且可解释的全球解决方法——基于深度学习的异质代理模型算法（DeepHAM），用于解决具有总量冲击的高维异质代理模型。状态分布通过一组最优广义矩进行近似表示。深度神经网络用于近似价值和政策函数，目标在直接模拟路径上进行优化。除了作为一个准确的全球求解器外，该方法还具有 三 额外特性。第一，它在解决复杂的异质代理模型时计算效率高，并且不受维度诅咒的影响。第二，它提供了对个体状态分布的通用且可解释的表示，这在解决异质性在宏观经济学中是否以及如何重要的经典问题时至关重要。第三，它解决约束效率问题的难度与解决竞争均衡问题相当，这为规范研究开辟了新的可能性。作为一种新应用，我们研究了具有总量冲击的异质代理模型中的约束效率。我们发现，在存在总量风险的情况下，效用主义规划者会比在没有总量风险的情况下减少用于再分配的总资本，因为贫困家庭进行更多的预防性储蓄，因此对劳动收入的依赖减少。

records.title_en: Remittance frictions and seasonal poverty
records.title_cn: 汇款摩擦和季节性贫困
records.abstract_en: Seasonal migration is a common strategy to mitigate rural seasonal deprivation, but migrants need to remit money during the lean season to family members facing food shortages. We observe counterintuitively low remittances in rural Nepal during periods of seasonal hunger, and migrants return with remittances later during harvest when food is relatively abundant. To indirectly overcome this apparent constraint in remittance timing, we provide a $90 consumption loan to randomly selected rural households during the pre‐harvest lean season. Loan‐recipient households increase pre‐harvest investments in fertilizer and time spent working on their own farm, smooth consumption, and save more of their migration income to bring it back home. Food security, subjective well‐being, rice harvest, and revenues improve. Ninety‐eight percent of beneficiaries repay the loan with the increased harvest‐period remittance. In a two‐period model of household decision making, we show that remittance frictions—a market failure—are necessary to qualitatively match our experimental results.
records.abstract_cn: 季节性移民是缓解农村季节性贫困的常见策略，但移民需要在青黄不接的季节向面临粮食短缺的家庭成员汇款。我们观察到，在季节性饥饿期间，尼泊尔农村地区的汇款出乎意料地低，而移民则在粮食相对丰富的收获季节带着汇款返回。为了间接克服汇款时间上的这种明显限制，我们在收获前的淡季期间向随机选择的农村家庭提供90美元的消费贷款。贷款接受户增加收获前化肥投资和自家农场劳动时间，平稳消费，并节省更多外出务工收入带回家。粮食安全、主观幸福感、水稻丰收和收入改善。百分之九十的受益人通过增加收获期汇款偿还贷款。在家庭决策的二周期模型中，我们表明汇款摩擦（市场失灵）对于定性地匹配我们的实验结果是必要的。

records.title_en: Forecasting with panel data: Estimation uncertainty versus parameter heterogeneity
records.title_cn: 面板数据预测：估计不确定性与参数异质性
records.abstract_en: We provide a comprehensive examination of the predictive accuracy of panel forecasting methods based on individual, pooling, fixed effects, and empirical Bayes estimation, and propose optimal weights for forecast combination schemes. We consider linear panel data models, allowing for weakly exogenous regressors and correlated heterogeneity. We quantify the gains from exploiting panel data and demonstrate how forecasting performance depends on the degree of parameter heterogeneity, whether such heterogeneity is correlated with the regressors, the goodness‐of‐fit of the model, and the dimensions of the data. Monte Carlo simulations and empirical applications to house prices and CPI inflation show that empirical Bayes and forecast combination methods perform best overall and rarely produce the least accurate forecasts for individual series.
records.abstract_cn: 我们对基于个体、合并、固定效应和经验贝叶斯估计的面板预测方法的预测准确性进行了全面的检验，并提出了预测组合方案的最佳权重。我们考虑线性面板数据模型，允许存在弱外生回归变量和相关异质性。我们量化了利用面板数据的收益，并展示了预测性能如何依赖于参数异质性的程度、这种异质性是否与回归变量相关、模型的拟合优度以及数据的维度。蒙特卡洛模拟和对房价及CPI通胀的实证应用表明，经验贝叶斯和预测组合方法在整体上表现最佳，并且很少为个别系列产生最不准确的预测。

records.title_en: Large structural VARs with multiple sign and ranking restrictions
records.title_cn: 具有多重符号和排名限制的大型结构 VAR
records.abstract_en: Large VARs are increasingly used in structural analysis as a unified framework to study the impacts of multiple structural shocks simultaneously. However, the concurrent identification of multiple shocks using sign and ranking restrictions poses significant practical challenges to the point where existing algorithms cannot be used with such large VARs. To address this, we introduce a new numerically efficient algorithm that facilitates the estimation of impulse responses and related measures in large structural VARs identified with a large number of structural restrictions on impulse responses. The methodology is illustrated using a 35‐variable VAR with over 100 sign and ranking restrictions to identify 8 structural shocks.
records.abstract_cn: 大型 VAR 越来越多地用于结构分析，作为同时研究多种结构冲击影响的统一框架。然而，使用符号和排序限制同时识别多个冲击提出了重大的实际挑战，现有算法无法与如此大的 VAR 一起使用。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了一种新的数值高效算法，该算法有助于估计大型结构 VAR 中的脉冲响应和相关措施，该 VAR 被识别为对脉冲响应有大量结构限制。该方法使用具有超过 35 符号和排序限制的 100 变量 VAR 来识别 8 结构性冲击。

records.title_en: The price responsiveness of shale producers: Evidence from micro data
records.title_cn: 页岩生产者的价格响应性：来自微观数据的证据
records.abstract_en: We show that U.S. shale oil producers exhibit a high degree of short‐run price responsiveness, primarily through the timing of well completions and refracturing. Using a novel monthly well‐level panel covering over 120,000 shale wells across ten states from 2005 to 2019, we document significant supply adjustments to price signals. The response varies significantly across states and firm types, highlighting the importance of accounting for micro‐level heterogeneity in production behavior. Mechanisms include accelerating completion of drilled but uncompleted wells and refracturing older wells when forward‐looking price signals are favorable. These findings challenge the common assumption of short‐run supply inelasticity and call for oil market models that incorporate operational flexibility and forward‐looking behavior of shale oil producers.
records.abstract_cn: 我们表明，美国页岩油生产者在短期内表现出高度的价格响应性，主要通过井完工和再压裂的时机。使用覆盖超过120,000个页岩井的创新性月度井级面板数据，涵盖十个州，从2005到2019，我们记录了对价格信号的显著供应调整。响应在不同州和公司类型之间差异显著，突显了考虑生产行为微观层面异质性的重要性。机制包括加速完工已钻但未完工的井，以及在前瞻性价格信号有利时对老井进行再压裂。这些发现挑战了短期供应无弹性的普遍假设，并呼吁石油市场模型纳入页岩油生产者的操作灵活性和前瞻性行为。

records.title_en: Welfare and spending effects of consumption stimulus policies
records.title_cn: 消费刺激政策的福利和支出效应
records.abstract_en: Using a heterogeneous agent model calibrated to match spending dynamics over four years following an income shock (Fagereng, Holm, and Natvik (2021)), we assess the effectiveness of three fiscal stimulus policies implemented during recent recessions. Unemployment insurance (UI) extensions are the “bang for the buck” winner when the metric is effectiveness in boosting utility. Stimulus checks are second‐best and have two advantages (over UI): they arrive faster, and are scalable. A temporary (two‐year) cut in wage taxation is considerably less effective than the other policies and has negligible effects in the version of our model without a multiplier.
records.abstract_cn: 使用经过校准以匹配收入冲击后 四 年支出动态的异质代理模型（Fagereng、Holm 和 Natvik (2021)），我们评估了最近经济衰退期间实施的 三 财政刺激政策的有效性。当衡量提高效用的有效性时，失业保险（UI）延期是“物有所值”的赢家。刺激检查是第二最好的，并且具有二优势（相对于UI）：它们到达速度更快，并且可扩展。临时（二年）削减工资税的效果远低于其他政策，并且在我们没有乘数的模型版本中的影响可以忽略不计。
